title: Product Management - Senior Product Manager - Futures & Options (F&O) / Derivatives
description:
About Us:Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About team :
Paytm Money is the wealth-tech and stockbroking platform of Paytm. It offers services including stock trading, mutual funds, ETFs, IPOs, Futures & Options (F&O), and retirement products through intuitive mobile and web platforms. The team is focused on building simple, reliable, and scalable investing and trading experiences for millions of retail investors across India.

About the Role
We are seeking a passionate and detail-oriented Product Manager – Futures & Options (F&O) / Derivatives to join the Paytm Money Product team. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of India's listed derivatives market, trader workflows, risk management, exchange regulations, and digital trading platforms. This is an Individual Contributor (IC) role with end-to-end ownership of F&O products—from strategy and discovery to execution and continuous optimization.

Key Responsibilities
• Own end-to-end product lifecycle for F&O products including Index & Stock Futures, Equity & Index Options, Option Chain, Strategy Builder, Basket Orders, Multi-leg Orders, GTT Orders, Margin Calculator, Position Management, and P&L Analytics
• Define product vision, roadmap, and strategy aligned with customer needs, business goals, and regulatory requirements
• Collaborate with engineering, design, risk, compliance, operations, brokerage, marketing, and business teams to build and launch trading features
• Conduct market research, competitor benchmarking, customer interviews, and trading behavior analysis to identify opportunities
• Translate requirements into PRDs, wireframes, user journeys, APIs, and acceptance criteria
• Build seamless, low-latency, high-reliability order placement and execution experiences
• Ensure compliance with SEBI, NSE, BSE, Clearing Corporation, and exchange regulations including margins, peak margin, risk disclosures, and suitability norms
• Drive acquisition, activation, engagement, trading frequency, and revenue growth through experimentation and data-driven improvements
• Define success metrics, monitor performance, and optimize funnels using analytics and insights
• Stay updated on derivatives market trends, exchange circulars, microstructure, and trader behavior

Requirements
• 3+ years of overall experience
• Minimum 1+ years in F&O, Derivatives, Broking, Capital Markets, or WealthTech Product Management
• Strong understanding of derivatives lifecycle, order flows, margin systems, RMS, clearing & settlement, and compliance frameworks
• Experience with digital trading or capital market platforms
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with data-driven decision making
• Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills
• Strong communication skills and experience writing detailed PRDs
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced fintech environment

Superpowers that will help you to succeed
• Deep understanding of Indian derivatives market and trader behavior
• Experience building Option Chain, Option Greeks, Strategy Builder, Basket Orders, Margin Calculator, TradingView integrations, and advanced charting tools
• Knowledge of options pricing, Greeks, volatility, payoff strategies, and risk management
• Familiarity with exchange APIs, OMS/RMS architecture, market data systems, and real-time trading infrastructure
• Experience scaling B2C fintech or trading products using product-led growth

Why join us : We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Compensation: If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants, and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

title: Lead Ambulatory Service Representative
description:
We’re searching for a Lead Ambulatory Service Representative, someone who’s ready to be part of the best ranked children’s hospital in Texas, and among the best in the nation. In this position, you will work directly with licensed providers or a group of providers in a virtual or non-virtual care setting. The Lead Ambulatory Services Representative assists the care team by coordinating complex patient care activities, administering the patient scheduling system for the designated provider(s) and supporting patient flow and serving as an expert or MD liaison for clinic unlicensed functions and patients/families.

Think you’ve got what it takes?

Job Duties & Responsibilities

Conducts patient admission process, including check-in/welcome desk, PAR's, registration, past pending.

May ensure patient is oriented to the virtual visit process and has all technology set up to successfully complete.

Performs patient registration procedures per department process.

Ensures that all necessary patient forms are provided and filled out for the clinic visit

Communicates with patients, staff and providers regarding patient arrivals, delays, and clinic processes.

Alerts staff and providers of any changes or discrepancies in patient’s scheduled appointment

May refer all patients with no or inadequate funding to the financial counselor with zero reported complaints.

Changes status of all appointments daily to reflect arrived, cancelled, no-show, or rescheduled status.

May maintain an organized filing system of current referrals in progress and already appointed, communicates all missed appointments to PCP and destroy missed referrals after one month.

May review new referrals with provider of the day regarding appropriate appointment status. Reviews provider schedule for open slots to appoint patients. Contact Central Scheduling with parents to schedule an appointment.

Assists, as needed, licensed staff with the non-financial aspects of the inpatient admission process, e.g., calls escort, helps with paperwork as needed.

May perform closing procedures (i.e. - reconciling fee receipts, completing deposit notification forms, reconciling petty cash, balancing the credit card machines, completing batch reports for Texas Children’s and Baylor, making deposits) in accordance with department processes.

Provides insurance authorization and collection of cash and deposits for hospital.

Coordinates schedules for clinic.

Performs charge entry and reconciliation.

Provides appropriate customer service and communication to patients and families.

Provides basic office support which may include ordering and maintaining office/clinic supplies; maintaining office equipment; managing correspondence; copying, faxing, mailing and filing documents; and collecting and distributing mail.

Ensures efficient patient flow and room management.

Assists in guiding the work of the Ambulatory Services Representatives and Senior Ambulatory Services Representatives.

As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and healthy workplace, all successful candidates will be required to undergo respiratory fit testing in compliance with occupational health and safety standards.

Skills & Requirements

Required H.S. Diploma or GED

Required 3 years' Experience in a healthcare setting with preferred pediatric and supervisory experience

title: (Sr.) Medical Science Liaison, GI
description:
Typical Accountabilities

Scientific Expertise

  • Maintain clinical/scientific expertise in disease state management, AstraZeneca products, emerging therapies, and the competitive landscape.

  • Contribute to the development and provide project leadership/ management of the therapeutic area Field Medical Strategic Plan (FMSP).

  • Share pertinent information regarding clinical trials and scientific treatment trends with healthcare professionals in their respective areas of expertise.

  • Supports training of AstraZeneca’s internal stakeholders to enhance their scientific understanding of the molecule or disease area.

Scientific Exchange

  • Segment and prioritize engagements with healthcare institutions, focusing on enhancing patient outcomes and creating positive patient impact.

  • Identify and establish relationships with key customers and other scientific thought leaders for engaging them in ongoing scientific dialogue on AstraZeneca products and unsolicited discussions about compounds in development.

  • Identify, assess, and engage with Local Medical Societies, Hospitals/Institutions, Payers, Health Care Professionals (including physicians, nurses, pharmacists, nutritionists, etc.), and Key External Experts (KEEs) in accordance with the therapeutic area's medical strategy.

  • Concentrate efforts on healthcare institutions and their Multi-Disciplinary Teams pertaining to the assigned therapy area. Collaborate closely with these teams to ensure a holistic approach to patient care within the healthcare ecosystem.

  • Organize and facilitate scientific events such as MSL events, Symposiums, Scientific Exchanges, Advisory Boards/Expert Panels, non-promotional standalone events, Meet the Professor sessions, etc., with KEEs and HCPs. Prioritize these events based on their relevance in the patient journey for the related disease.

  • Deliver informative lectures at scientific events tailored to healthcare professionals, aligning with the field medical communication strategy.

  • Expand outreach by visiting a broader spectrum of Health Care Professionals (HCPs) and Key External Experts (KEEs) within the assigned territory and Therapy Area to enhance scientific engagement and awareness.

  • Engage with local or global clinical study projects within the therapeutic area, coordinating with Clinical Research Operations when necessary (participation in Site Initiation Visits, Investigators Meetings, and recruitment improvement efforts).

  • Collaborate with KEEs on study proposals (ESR or Local Study) and/or publications of interest to AstraZeneca.

Customer Insights

  • Effectively identify, gather, analyse, synthesise, report and forward relevant new knowledge about the external scientific/medical environments to internal stakeholders

  • Provide internal stakeholders with actionable items related to medical / brand strategy or clinical development based on customer perspectives.

  • Partner with traditional and non-traditional stakeholders to identify gaps in the patient experience journey as insights to be included in the medical / product strategies.

Access

  • Enhance medicine accessibility within designated healthcare institutions by actively integrating into their healthcare framework. Partner with payers and offer medical-scientific presentations tailored to the therapeutic area's medical strategy and the Key Account Plan, adhering to the Unified Key Account Management approach.

  • Gain a deep insight into the patient experience and the specific scientific requirements of the assigned institutions. Suggest and implement scientifically grounded collaborations to bolster access to medications and health resources.

  • Demonstrate the intrinsic value and efficacy of medicines, ensuring that healthcare institutions recognize their importance and benefits for optimal patient care.

  • Partnership with traditional and non-traditional stakeholder to identify gaps in the patient experience journey as insights to be included in the medical / brand strategies.

Skills Requirements Defined

Scientific and Strategic Leadership

The geography or account based field medical role plays a pivotal and adaptable role within AstraZeneca, contributing significantly to the lifecycle of products, from pre-launch to loss of exclusivity (LoE) focused on patient outcomes within assigned territory.

  • Identifies and analyzes priority Hospitals/Institutions across the assigned territory, mapping and engaging key strategic stakeholders to establish science-based partnerships that enhance outcomes and foster win-win relationships between institutions, AZ, and the healthcare system.

  • Develops a comprehensive understanding of the medical strategy and priorities, crafting short and mid-term local medical strategy plans that optimize both quantitative and qualitative impacts and results.

  • Adopts a Key Account Management mindset, working cross-functionally with AZ counterparts to pinpoint areas of opportunity based on scope of impact and readiness, enhancing equitable patient access, and driving changes in local clinical practice.

  • Possesses a Patient-Centric Mindset, deeply analyzing the patient journey for specific diseases, identifying barriers to optimal disease management and patient outcomes, and engaging strategic KEEs, HCPs, and external stakeholders to develop solutions and generate advocacy for practice changes.

  • Responsible for leveraging Digital and innovation / technology as enabler for patient centric solutions.

  • Demonstrates a profound scientific understanding of diseases in which AZ has products or products in the pipeline, continually monitoring global clinical trials to advise on product development and emerging clinical progress.

  • Provides the medical community with access to the latest scientific and medical information, responding to off-label queries transparently and based on objective scientific data.

  • Possesses extensive knowledge of clinical practice across various therapeutic areas, identifying unmet needs in the patient journey, providing insights, and advancing medical communication.

  • Understands treatment guidelines, the regulatory environment, and access and reimbursement dynamics. Cultivates trusted relationships with leading KEEs, HCPs, medical associations, and patient advocacy groups, effectively managing projects that enhance the healthcare system.

  • Actively participates in MSL global or international projects to support local development.

  • Effectively translates scientific principles and product mode of action into compelling communications, guiding KEEs' thinking and handling objections with balance and transparency.

  • Proficiently addresses scientific questions, facilitating deeper understanding among healthcare professionals.


Cross-Functional Knowledge

  • Proficient in commercial aspects, with deep understanding of AZ products and competitor attributes, leveraging this knowledge to enhance medical communication and support decision-making.

  • Collaborates with internal business colleagues, including the sales force, marketing, key account managers and other therapeutic areas, to align with local needs and national strategies.

  • Demonstrates effective budget management skills for small-scale projects, aligning with AZ's commercial, branding, and financial planning.

  • Capable of effectively engaging key payers in the country, comprehending their perspectives on science, molecules, pharmacoeconomic, and budgetary impacts. Prepared to contribute the scientific viewpoint in HMO/payer meetings and KAM visits.

Medical Excellence and Clinical Operations

  • Possesses a solid grasp of pharmacovigilance and GxP principles, showcasing a clear understanding of their significance. This includes practical knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), various types of clinical studies, and requirements for reporting adverse events (AEs).

  • Displays familiarity with key documents associated with generating evidence, such as Phase IIIB-IV clinical trials. Additionally, holds a general understanding of AstraZeneca-sponsored clinical trials, external sponsored research (ESR) policies and procedures, as well as observational research and real-world evidence (RWE) policies and procedures.

  • Exhibits a robust understanding of the Ethical Interactions Policy, along with relevant standards, local laws, and regulations. Moreover, possesses the ability to provide training to others in this domain.

Typical Accountabilities (Per AZ framework and regulatory expectations)

  • Conduct activities and interactions consistent with Company values and in compliance with the Code of Conduct and supporting Policies and Standards relevant to your role. Complete all required training on the AZ Code of Conduct and supporting Policies and Standards on time. Report potential issues of non-compliance.

What is the global remit?

Operates in: Own country

Education, Qualifications, Skills and Experience

Essential

  • Scientific and or a master’s degree in a scientific discipline

  • Possesses foundational skills in presentation, negotiation, and leadership techniques.

  • Demonstrates basic knowledge of market access and Pharmacoeconomics.

  • Exhibits strong interpersonal networking abilities with both internal and external stakeholders.

  • Displays excellent oral written /communication skills.

  • Familiar with foundations of Project Management

  • Available for business trips as needed.

  • Possesses a foundational understanding of the pharmaceutical business.

Desirable

  • Doctoral degree in a scientific discipline (e.g. M.D., Ph.D., Pharm.D.)

  • Experience in pharmaceutical industry, regulatory environment, clinical or preclinical research, and knowledge of a therapeutic area disease state and treatment.

  • Demonstrates a history of successful team and inter-team collaboration.

  • Previous experience as an MSL (Medical Science Liaison) or equivalent role is preferred.

  • Possesses exceptional skills in presentation techniques.

Key Relationships to reach solutions

Internal (to AZ or team)

  • Medical Function (MA, RA, PV, MI, NS, Dx, etc)

  • Commercial Function (Marketing & Sales)

  • Compliance Team

  • Market Access

  • Key Account Management

External (to AZ)

  • Healthcare professionals (physicians, pharmacists, nurses, nutritionists, etc.)

  • Researchers

  • Healthcare organizations and hospitals

  • Healthcare administrators and payers

  • Service providers

  • Medical societies

  • Patient Association, PAGs

  • Other regional and local partners

title: Trygg ledare med affärsdriv? Bli Depåchef i Sundsvall
description:
Lambertsson är en av Skandinaviens största uthyrare och tjänsteleverantörer inom bygg- och industrilösningar.

Med vår kunskap och erfarenhet kan vi hjälpa dig med att få alla bitar på plats, från minsta skruvdragare till marknadens största kranar. Vi ger dig helt enkelt kraften och musklerna för ditt byggprojekt. Kortare byggtider, bättre kontroll över kostnaderna och smidigare processer är bara några av fördelarna med att anlita oss.

På Lambertsson är vi verkligen experter på vad vi gör. Våra anställda är specialister inom sitt specifika område, vilket garanterar ett utfört arbete av högsta kvalitet. En annan styrka är vårt kundorienterade arbetssätt. Ett nytt projekt inleds med ett uppstartsmöte, där vi tillsammans med dig som kund analyserar projektet. Därefter gör vi upp en plan, anpassad efter dina behov. Rätt lösning till rätt ekonomi, med andra ord. En filosofi som visat sig vara framgångsrik.

Vill du ta nästa steg i din karriär och leda en verksamhet med stort affärsfokus i en av Sveriges mest expansiva regioner? Nu söker vi en depåchef till Sundsvall, en nyckelroll för dig som vill vara med och bygga upp och utveckla en stark och lönsam verksamhet. Här får du möjlighet att påverka, driva förändring och skapa resultat tillsammans med ditt team.

Information om företaget

Lambertsson är det personliga företaget där människan är i fokus. De är en av Skandinaviens största uthyrare och tjänsteleverantörer inom bygg- och industrilösningar. De erbjuder totallösningar samt tjänster inom uthyrning, tillfällig-el, kranar, moduler och trafikanordningar samt även energioptimerade lösningar.

Lambertsson är ett dotterbolag inom Peabkoncernen. Deras kärnvärden jordnära, utvecklande, personliga och pålitliga är en naturlig del av vardagen, och vi söker dig som känner igen dig i dessa och vill arbeta utifrån dem. Hos Lambertsson finns stora möjligheter till personlig utveckling.

Information om tjänsten

Professionals Nord söker för Lambertssons räkning en Depåchef. Tjänsten är en direktrekrytering vilket innebär att rekryteringsprocessen sker genom Professionals Nord och att du anställs direkt hos Lambertsson.

Den här rekryteringsprocessen hanteras av Professionals Nord och Lambertssons önskemål är att alla frågor kring tjänsten går till stina.vidmark@pn.se (mailto:stina.vidmark@pn.se)

Du erbjuds

  • En nyckelroll med stort ansvar och möjlighet att påverka verksamhetens utveckling
  • En varierad roll med både strategiskt och operativt ansvar
  • En trygg anställning med konkurrenskraftiga villkor och stark företagskultur

Arbetsuppgifter

Som depåchef ansvarar du för verksamheten i Sundsvall och driver affären med fullt resultat- och budgetansvar. Du arbetar nära både medarbetare och kunder och har en central roll i att utveckla affären, stärka kundrelationer och säkerställa en effektiv och lönsam verksamhet.

Du leder ett team bestående av depåsäljare och servicemedarbetare och skapar förutsättningar för en trygg, strukturerad och högpresterande arbetsmiljö.

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:

  • Ansvara för affärsplan, budget, prognoser och uppföljning
  • Driva försäljning och aktiv kundbearbetning
  • Leda, coacha och utveckla medarbetare
  • Ansvara för arbetsmiljöarbetet på depån
  • Representera Lambertsson i lokala nätverk och projekt

Vi söker dig som

  • Har erfarenhet från en roll med ansvar för exempelvis projekt, affär eller verksamhet, gärna med personalansvar
  • Har god affärsförståelse och erfarenhet av budget och ekonomisk uppföljning
  • Är van att arbeta kundnära och har förståelse för vad som skapar en lönsam affär
  • Behärskar svenska och engelska i tal och skrift
  • B-körkort

Vi tror att dina personliga egenskaper är avgörande för hur väl du kommer trivas och lyckas i rollen hos Lambertsson. Du är:

  • Trygg och tydlig ledare som skapar förtroende
  • Affärsdriven och motiveras av att utveckla verksamhet och förbättra resultat
  • Strukturerad och initiativtagande
  • Trivs i en roll som kombinerar strategiskt och operativt arbete

title: Senior Engineer, Site Closure
location: Pittsburgh, PA; Point Comfort, TX; Rockdale, TX; Burlington, VT; Bauxite, AR; Duncan, SC; Lake Charles, LA; Badin, NC; Knoxville, TN; Montréal, QC; Alcoa, TN; Richmond, VA; Remote
description:
Senior Engineer - Site Closure

Location: United States, PA, Pittsburgh, United States, TX, Point Comfort, United States, TX, Rockdale, United States, VT, Burlington, United States, AR, Bauxite, United States, SC, Duncan, United States, LA, Lake Charles, United States, NC, Badin, United States, TN, Knoxville, Canada, QC, Montréal, United States, TN, Alcoa, United States, VA, Richmond

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Shape Your World

At Alcoa, you will become an essential part of our purpose: to turn raw potential into real progress. The way we see it, every Alcoan is a work-shaper, team-shaper, idea-shaper & world-shaper.

Alcoa Transformation group is looking to fill the role of a Senior Engineer - Site Closure! Transformation is charged with the global responsibility to manage Alcoa’s identified environmental liabilities and assets at closed locations and to provide technical assistance for operating locations’ waste management needs to meet overall financial and risk avoidance goals.

This role is responsible for providing strategic technical support to Transformation Locations for all aspects relating to impoundment operations, maintenance, and closure, and ensuring adherence to the Global Industry Standard for Tailings Management (GISTM) and Alcoa’s Impoundment Management System (IMS). This role will also serve as the Lead for the Integrated Closure Committee leading initiatives to enhance processes for Global site closure planning and Asset Retirement Obligation cost estimating.

Technical Lead – Integrated Closure Committee

  • Provide strategic technical input into the development of Global policies, standards, and guidelines establishing the framework to ensure implementation of cost-effective closure solutions that meet applicable regulatory and Alcoa requirements.
  • Perform technical gap assessments of site closure plans and associated cost estimates and support development of gap closure plans.
  • Provide recommendations to optimize the geotechnical designs, construction, and monitoring of Global closure strategies and designs
  • Conduct risk assessments and readiness reviews for closure execution.

Technical Consultant – Technical Support for Transformation Closure Projects

  • Perform technical reviews of studies, data, and reports including geotechnical investigation reports, seepage analyses, closure designs, monitoring data, QA/QC protocols, and related documents.
  • Provide technical guidance to Locations to perform required geotechnical site investigations, stability analyses, closure works, and maintenance and monitoring activities.
  • Interpret monitoring data and recommend modifications to optimize operations and maintenance programs.
  • Perform site visits to support development of closure plans, optimize O&M Programs, and provide technical support during active construction projects.

Technical Consultant – GISTM & Alcoa IMS Program Oversight, Maintenance, and Optimization

  • Provide technical support to Locations to develop scopes of work, review deliverables, and perform risk assessments for various impoundment projects.
  • Oversee program maintenance requirements to ensure ongoing conformance with Alcoa requirements while actively identifying opportunities to improve program efficiency and reduce risk.
  • Coordinate internal assurance reviews and external audits related to impoundment management with project teams.
  • Update technical standards, guidelines, and procedures based on lessons learned and industry standard practices.
  • Coordinate collection of relevant site data from the locations to support internal reporting requirements.

General Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Geotechnical Engineering, Geology, Civil Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline.
  • Master’s degree preferred in: Geotechnical Engineering, Geological Engineering, or similar field.
  • PE or PG license is preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years’ progressive engineering experience working on projects in an industrial, mining, process, manufacturing, or similar environment
  • Sound knowledge of internationally recognized tailings management standards and industry guidelines such as ICMM, ANCOLD, MAC/CDA, and GISTM.
  • Demonstrated experience in geotechnical engineering aspects of tailings dam closure planning, execution, and monitoring.
  • Experience performing geotechnical investigations, slope stability analyses and consolidation modelling.
  • Experience performing geotechnical risk assessments in accordance with industry practices, including evaluation of structural stability, and long‑term performance of legacy impoundments.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, interpersonal and influencing skills with demonstrated ability to challenge effectively and drive outcomes.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, capacity to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously and drive aggressive implementation plans and schedules
  • Travel requirements up to 15%

_____________________________________________________________________________

Chez Alcoa, vous pouvez contribuer à façonner la façon dont les responsabilités liées aux passifs environnementaux complexes et à la fermeture sont gérées à l’échelle d’un portefeuille mondial. À titre d’ingénieur principal au sein du groupe Transformation, vous fournirez un leadership technique pour l’exploitation, l’entretien et la fermeture des bassins de retenue, en soutenant la réduction des risques, l’alignement réglementaire et une planification efficace de la fermeture à long terme pour les sites fermés et en exploitation.

À propos du rôle

Vous offrirez un soutien stratégique aux sites de Transformation pour l’exploitation et l’entretien des bassins de retenue, la planification de la fermeture et la supervision des programmes. Vous contribuerez à assurer l’alignement avec la Global Industry Standard for Tailings Management (GISTM) et le système de gestion des bassins de retenue d’Alcoa (IMS), tout en agissant comme responsable de l’ingénierie géotechnique pour le comité intégré de fermeture afin d’améliorer la planification globale de la fermeture des sites et l’estimation des coûts liés aux obligations de mise hors service des actifs.

Responsabilités clés

  • Diriger les contributions géotechniques aux politiques, normes, lignes directrices, plans de fermeture et estimations de coûts à l’échelle mondiale afin de soutenir des solutions rentables qui répondent aux exigences réglementaires et à celles d’Alcoa.

  • Évaluer les écarts techniques dans les plans de fermeture des sites, les estimations de coûts et l’état de préparation à l’exécution, puis soutenir l’élaboration de plans concrets pour les combler.

  • Examiner les études géotechniques, les rapports d’investigation, les analyses d’infiltration, les conceptions de fermeture, les données de surveillance, les protocoles d’assurance et de contrôle de la qualité ainsi que les livrables techniques connexes.

  • Conseiller les sites sur les investigations géotechniques, les analyses de stabilité, les travaux de fermeture, les activités d’entretien, les programmes de surveillance et les évaluations des risques.

  • Soutenir la supervision de la gestion des bassins de retenue en maintenant les exigences des programmes GISTM et IMS, en coordonnant les examens d’assurance et les audits, et en identifiant les occasions d’améliorer l’efficacité et de réduire les risques.

  • Utiliser les leçons apprises, les données des sites et les pratiques de l’industrie pour mettre à jour les normes techniques, les lignes directrices, les procédures et les exigences de rapports internes.

Ce que vous apportez au rôle

  • Un baccalauréat en génie géotechnique, en géologie, en génie civil ou dans une discipline d’ingénierie étroitement liée; une maîtrise en génie géotechnique, en génie géologique ou dans un domaine similaire est un atout.

  • Au moins cinq années d’expérience progressive en ingénierie dans un environnement industriel, minier, de procédé, manufacturier ou similaire.

  • Une connaissance des normes et lignes directrices internationalement reconnues en gestion des résidus, notamment ICMM, ANCOLD, MAC/CDA et GISTM, afin de soutenir des décisions techniques cohérentes et éclairées.

  • Une expérience en planification, exécution et surveillance de la fermeture de barrages de résidus, ainsi qu’en investigations géotechniques, analyses de stabilité des pentes, modélisation de la consolidation et évaluations des risques pour des bassins de retenue existants.

  • De solides compétences en communication, relations interpersonnelles, influence, organisation et gestion du temps pour remettre en question de façon constructive, prioriser le travail, gérer plusieurs initiatives et obtenir des résultats.

  • Un engagement démontré envers les pratiques de travail sécuritaires et la conscience des risques lors de l’examen des conceptions, de l’évaluation des conditions sur le terrain, du soutien aux visites de sites et des conseils liés aux bassins de retenue et aux activités de fermeture; un permis PE ou PG est un atout, et des déplacements peuvent être requis jusqu’à 15 % du temps.

Dans cette publication, le masculin est utilisé afin d’alléger le texte. Alcoa est fière d’être un milieu de travail offrant l’égalité des chances et un employeur appliquant des mesures d’action positive. Elle fait également partie des groupes mondiaux d’inclusion AWARE, AWN, EAGLE et ABLE. Seuls les candidats sélectionnés dans le cadre du processus seront contactés.

About the Location

Alcoa is an international company with multiple locations and joint ventures across six continents. Wherever you choose to join us, you'll be joining a global team committed to advancing sustainability and delivering excellence and innovation. As industry pioneers, we are redefining what it means to be a sustainable aluminum company, bridging the journey from mines to metal.

As a proud equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer, Alcoa is dedicated to providing equal opportunities and equal access to all individuals regardless of a person’s gender, age, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, nation of origin, disability, veteran status, language spoken or any other characteristic or status protected by the laws or regulations in the places where we operate.

Vid frågor, kontakta rekryterare David Nyrén på david.nyren@jobway.se. Urval sker löpande – tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Din ansökan behandlas konfidentiellt.

Idag är vi 35 anställda, men med inhyrda maskinister, stensättare m.m. sysselsätter vi många fler ute i våra projekt.

Huvudkontoret ligger i Västerås och vi har vår huvudverksamhet i Mälardalsregionen, men är också verksamma i angränsande län då vi även har ett kontor i Uppsala.

Öppen för alla Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

title: Data DevOps Engineer
description:
Data DevOps Engineer

Location: Bangkok Office - Bangkok, Thailand

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Join our dynamic corporate team and become part of Aman Group. With offices strategically located around the world (Zug, London, Dubai, Singapore, Bangkok, Miami and New York), our corporate colleagues are at the forefront of driving innovation and excellence for our ultra-luxury brand.

Data DevOps Engineer

Role:

We are seeking a Data DevOps Engineer reporting to the Sales Platform Manager, to ensure the stability, performance and scalability of Aman’s Salesforce platform and data infrastructure. This role combines hands-on Salesforce development (Apex, Lightning Web Components, integrations) with DevOps ownership, including CI/CD pipelines, release management, and environment strategy.

Working closely with the Sales Platform Manager and Data Engineering teams, you will support the development, deployment and monitoring of data pipelines and platform enhancements, ensuring efficient delivery and reliable, continuous operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and build custom solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC) and SOQL
  • Develop integrations with external systems via REST/SOAP APIs
  • Customize objects, data models, and user interfaces tailored to the end users
  • Design, implement, and manage automated data infrastructure workflows, including CI/CD pipelines for data ingestion, transformation, and deployment
  • Maintain and optimize build and release processes for data systems, ensuring repeatable, high-quality deployments
  • Set up and maintain observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus, Azure Monitor) to track data system performance, uptime and latency
  • Implement and maintain log management and error alerting for proactive issue resolution
  • Manage environment configurations for development, staging, and production data systems
  • Coordinate system updates and performance optimization efforts with Data Engineering and IT Infrastructure
  • Implement security best practices for data environments, including access control, encryption, and secure credential management
  • Partner with IT Security and Legal / Compliance to ensure compliance with global data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR)
  • Maintain audit logs and traceability across data environments to support governance requirements
  • Support incident response procedures and conduct root-cause analyses for system outages or data loss
  • Work closely with the Salesforce Platform Manager to translate architecture designs into deployable and maintainable infrastructure
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of configurations, deployment processes, and troubleshooting protocols

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in CI/CD pipeline management and associated toolsets
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or related technical field
  • Strong experience with Salesforce development and building / operating / enhancing that environment
  • Deep expertise across Salesforce modules (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and Experience Cloud)
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce data architecture, APIs, and integration frameworks
  • Experience with Apex, LWC (Lightning Web Components), or Flow development
  • Strong understanding of data pipeline orchestration, ELT frameworks (DBT, Matillion), and data warehouse management
  • Manage source-driven development workflows and version control strategies using GitHub
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as SQL, Python, Bash, or PowerShell for automation
  • Experience with cloud-based data lakehouses (Snowflake, Databricks)
  • Experience in a customer-focused industry a strong plus

Benefits

At Aman Group, we believe that our colleagues are at the core of our success. We offer competitive benefits including exciting international career opportunities in a company that is expanding rapidly. We prioritise and support your career journey, making you feel valued, included and at home.

If you thrive in an ultra-luxury environment and are passionate about ensuring flawless distribution systems and supporting seamless guest experiences, we invite you to apply to join us on our journey

description:
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

The EHS NPI team is dedicated to ensuring safety is built-in to new platforms and other products that enter our data centers. We work to ensure that safety and ergonomic risks are identified and properly mitigated for all touchpoints across the lifecycle for deployments in the Google data center environment. Our team is committed to enabling Google to lead the industry in keeping our people safe while remaining on the cutting edge of hardware development and deployment.

Safety and Ergonomics play a crucial role in ensuring the safety and usability of new product designs.

As an EHS NPI Technical Program Manager, you will proactively review product designs at all stages of development, identify potential safety hazards and ergonomic risks, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement effective mitigation measures. The primary objective is to minimize the risk of safety incidents and promote the well-being of end-users by integrating safety and ergonomic considerations into the product development lifecycle.

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and HVAC systems in the world. We are an upbeat, creative, team-oriented group of engineers committed to building and operating powerful data centers.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $138000 - $197000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Provide EHS leadership for the introduction of new hardware products, implementing mitigations to ensure the highest level of safety possible. Evaluate new data center hardware for employee hazards to servers, racks, tools and related infrastructure, coordinating equipment changes with cross-functional teams to enable risk mitigation across the product life cycle.
  • Manage safety requirement integration into design standards, coordinate equipment reviews with cross-functional teams to perform job hazard analysis.
  • Review incidents with cross functional teams to evaluate risk mitigation options for current and future deployed equipment.
  • Manage and report risk and mitigation data to partner and stakeholder teams.
  • Travel of 15-20% as needed.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Environmental Health and Safety, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience in program management.
  • 2 years of experience working in product design, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.
  • Experience in product/hardware platform design safety.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
  • Ability to quickly understand new equipment, creative problem solving and ability to think outside the box.
  • Applied project management skills and ability to create workable project plans with project scope, and execute on such plans.
  • Strong communication (written and verbal) and presentation skills, data quality troubleshooting and problem solving skills, outstanding collaboration and project management skills, and experience working with cross-functional teams and executive-level stakeholders.
  • Data driven problem-solving skills and ability to identify key issues, gather and analyze large complex data sets to support hypotheses and develop actionable recommendations.

title: Data Engineer – vil du udvikle moderne dataløsninger i cloud med Snowflake, dbt og AI?
description:
Data Engineer - vil du udvikle moderne dataløsninger i cloud med Snowflake, dbt og AI? 
				
  

			
 
 Vil du være med til at bygge fremtidens dataløsninger i skyen og skabe værdi gennem data? Hos LB Forsikring betragter vi data som en af vores mest værdsatte ressourcer, og nu har du muligheden for at slutte dig til vores Data Team, hvor vi udvikler vores moderne dataplatform i skyen.  

 Vil du gerne forandre og være noget særligt for andre? Som medarbejder i LB får du mere substans i dit job, hvor vilkår, goder og fleksibilitet gavner det hele menneske. Hos LB Forsikring lægger vi sjæl i arbejdet, og vi møder medlemmer, kolleger og omverden med skærpet sans. Du bliver en del af et medlemsejet fællesskab, hvor vi er der for hinanden. Vi deler også målet om at gøre forsikring overflødig. 

 Vi arbejder for at skabe en arbejdsplads, hvor innovation, samarbejde og vedvarende læring er i fokus. Du bliver en del af et team af engagerede og dygtige fagfolk, hvor vi værdsætter åben kommunikation, kreativitet og en sund balance mellem arbejde og privatliv. 

 Lyder de her opgaver som noget for dig? 

 Som data engineer bliver du en del af vores centraliserede datateam med ca. 25 specialister inden for data engineering, data governance og data operations.  

 Du får en central rolle i den videre udvikling af vores moderne cloud-baserede dataplatform, hvor Snowflake og dbt er centrale teknologier. Vi arbejder med standardisering, automatisering og moderne udviklingsmetoder for at skabe en skalerbar, robust og fremtidssikret dataplatform. Samtidig ser vi AI og agentbaserede løsninger som en vigtig del af fremtidens dataudvikling og forventer, at du bidrager til at anvende disse teknologier til at optimere vores udviklingsprocesser og skabe endnu mere værdi gennem data. 

 Dine væsentligste opgaver i stillingen vil være: 
 
 Udvikle, optimere og vedligeholde robuste datapipelines i Snowflake og dbt 

 Integrere og strukturere data fra både interne systemer og eksterne kilder 

 Modellere og transformere komplekse forretningsdata til dimensionelle datamodeller 

 Sikre høj datakvalitet gennem overvågning, test, validering og automatiserede kontroller 

 Udvikle semantiske lag og bidrage til standardisering af fælles datamodeller og definitioner 

 Dokumentere datastrukturer, datamodeller og processer, så data kan anvendes bredt og sikkert i organisationen 

 Samarbejde med forretningen og analytikere om at gøre data tilgængelige, forståelige og værdiskabende 

 Anvende AI-assistenter og Copilots til at effektivisere udviklingsarbejdet, fx kodeforslag, dokumentation, test og kvalitetssikring 

 Bidrage til at afprøve agentbaserede løsninger, der kan automatisere rutineopgaver og understøtte en mere effektiv dataudviklingsproces 

 Være med til at etablere best practices for ansvarlig og værdiskabende brug af AI i data engineering 
 
   

 Vil du være en del af vores fællesskab? 

 Vi ønsker, at du trives, og at vi når vores mål sammen. Derfor kigger vi blandt andet på, om du har følgende faglige og personlige færdigheder til jobbet: 
 
 Minimum 2-5 års erfaring som Data Engineer eller lignende rolle  

 Solid praktisk erfaring med Snowflake og dbt (certificeringer er en fordel) 

 Solide SQL-kompetencer og erfaring med datamodellering 

 Erfaring med CI/CD, Git og gerne Infrastructure as Code  

 Erfaring med eller stor interesse for anvendelse af AI, Copilots og agentbaserede løsninger i udviklingsarbejdet 

 Forståelse for datasikkerhed og compliance (fx GDPR) 

 Kendskab til Power BI 

 Forståelse for, hvordan AI kan bruges ansvarligt til at automatisere, optimere og kvalitetssikre dataudviklingsprocesser 

 Interesse for automatisering, standardisering og skalerbare løsninger 

 Nysgerrighed på nye teknologier og lyst til løbende at udfordre og forbedre arbejdsmetoder 
 
 Du er nysgerrig på, hvordan et solidt datafundament understøtter AI-løsninger, og du ser AI som et naturligt værktøj i den moderne udviklingsproces. Du har lyst til at eksperimentere med AI-assistenter og agentbaserede løsninger, der kan automatisere rutineopgaver, forbedre kvaliteten og frigøre tid til mere værdiskabende udvikling. 

 Du motiveres af at skabe forretningsværdi gennem moderne datateknologier og sikre løsninger, der er både solide og valide. Du udfolder dig bedst i et teamorienteret, agilt miljø, hvor samarbejde på tværs er essentielt for at nå målene. Samtidig kan du tage egne initiativer, bære ansvaret for dine opgaver og har lyst til at finde optimale løsninger. 

   

 Vi har spurgt tre af dine kommende kolleger om, hvordan de oplever LB 

 Vi kan godt lide hinanden, vi vil gerne hinanden, og vi er der for hinanden. Sådan skal det være at gå på arbejde. LB er et fællesskab, man er en del af - både i ens eget team og med alle de andre herinde. Vi bruger mange vågne timer sammen, så det betyder alt, at vi har sans for hinanden. 

 Vores arbejdsplads har sjæl. Der er en summen og en stemning. Det er så åbent et landskab, der er kunst og historie alle vegne, og der bliver gjort noget ud af vores arrangementer. Der bliver taget rigtig godt hånd om en som medarbejder. Alle i LB siger godmorgen til hinanden, og der er altid nogen at række ud til, hvis man har brug for noget.  

 Jeg vil gerne gøre noget for dem, der gør noget for andre. 
 

            

             
                Ansøg
             

			


    
 
         Del i dit netværk 

               

               

               

               

               

               
     

    

			
  

			
 Om os
            
 LB Forsikring er et medlemsejet forsikringsselskab med næsten 140 års erfaring. Vi er Danmarks 4. største forsikringsselskab på det private marked, har over 400.000 medlemmer og består af forsikrings-grupperne:
            
 
            
 Lærerstandens Brandforsikring - for lærere, pædagoger og andre i undervisningssektoren
            
 Bauta Forsikring - for sygeplejersker, læger og andre personalegrupper i sundhedssektoren
            
 Runa Forsikring - for medlemmer af udvalgte faglige foreninger
            
 
            
 Omdrejningspunktet for os er vores medlemmer og at drive en god forretning for dem. Vi har et højt image i branchen, tilfredse og loyale medlemmer og produkter der igen og igen er kåret bedst i test af Forbrugerrådets blad Tænk Penge
            
 Læs mere om os på  www.lbforsikring.dk .

 Hvis du synes, jobbet lyder spændende og gerne vil høre mere, så kontakt Afdelingschef for Dataplatform Anette Schrøder Mikkelsen på mail  aesn@lb.dk  eller tlf. 6120 5152.

description:
Anläggare till spännande projekt i Uppsala

Vill du arbeta i projekt där din kompetens verkligen gör skillnad? På Prowork söker vi nu flera erfarna och engagerade anläggare till uppdrag i Uppsala!

Hos oss får du inte bara ett jobb - du får möjligheten att vara en del av ett starkt team, utvecklas i din yrkesroll och arbeta i välplanerade projekt med fokus på kvalitet, säkerhet och yrkesstolthet.

Om rollen

Som anläggare via Prowork blir du en viktig del av projektens framgång. Du arbetar nära arbetsledning och kollegor för att säkerställa att arbetet utförs effektivt, säkert och enligt plan.

Vi samarbetar med etablerade aktörer inom mark och anläggning, vilket innebär varierande projekt och goda möjligheter till långsiktiga uppdrag.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

  • Utföra mark- och anläggningsarbeten enligt ritning och instruktion
  • Säkerställa att arbetet följer gällande säkerhetskrav och rutiner
  • Bidra till att projekt levereras enligt tidsplan och kvalitetsmål
  • Hantera verktyg, material och maskiner på ett ansvarsfullt sätt
  • Samarbeta tätt med arbetsledning, maskinförare och övriga teamet

Exempel på arbetsmoment

  • Schaktning, fyllning och packning
  • VA-arbeten, dagvatten och dränering
  • Sättning av kantsten, plattor och andra ytskikt
  • Förberedelse inför asfalt, grus och grönytor
  • Höjd- och lägeskontroller med laser/mätinstrument
  • Enklare maskinarbeten (vid behörighet)

Vi söker dig som:

  • Har minst 2 års erfarenhet av anläggningsarbete
  • Kan läsa och arbeta efter ritningar
  • Innehar B-körkort
  • Är noggrann, ansvarstagande och lösningsorienterad
  • Trivs i team och bidrar till en god arbetsmiljö

Vi erbjuder dig:

En arbetsgivare som sätter våra medarbetare i fokus. Vi vet att engagerade och trygga medarbetare skapar de bästa resultaten. Vi erbjuder:

  • Trygga anställningsvillkor
  • Möjlighet till utveckling och långsiktiga uppdrag
  • Ett nära och personligt samarbete
  • Projekt hos seriösa och etablerade kunder


Vi matchar rätt person med rätt projekt - och vi följer dig längs vägen.

title: Comparative Medicine Technician I- Center for Comparative Medicine
description:
Comparative Medicine Tech I is responsible for basic sanitation/disinfection and maintenance of the animal facility, and for daily record-keeping and operation of major laboratory equipment. CM Tech I will perform general husbandry for laboratory animals related to cash wash, as well as being responsible for stocking inventory of PPE and supplies. CM Tech I is also responsible for sanitizing laboratory space, including animal holding rooms, cage wash areas and associated corridors as per federal, state and local guidelines and for autoclaving all equipment and keeping records for temperature for the autoclave and rack washer. CM Tech I will provide daily animal care to small animal species in the animal facility. Other duties may be required per management.

  • CAGE MAINTENANCE - 50%
    • Provide animals with clean cages, water, and food. Identify functional caging equipment and reports equipment maintenance. Sanitize cages using washroom equipment. Removal of waste material such as bedding, trash etc.
  • EQUIPMENT MAINTENANCE - 10%
    • Ensure clean and operating equipment (racks and biological cabinets). Make adjustments to equipment as needed and make minor decisions in use of equipment. Understand the function of various equipment within facility (tunnel washer, rack washer, autoclave, bottle filler, etc.) to prevent damage or loss of time.
  • FACILITY MAINTENANCE - 5%
    • Provide a clean and safe work environment. Report facility damage to supervisor.
  • ENVIRONMENTAL MONITORING - 10%
    • Maintain clean work area. Sanitize and disinfect cage wash, equipment and other facility areas. Identify, record, and report environmental conditions.
  • HEALTH MONITORING - 10%
    • Record and report issues to supervisor and/or veterinary staff. Comply with institutional certifications and requirements for working with infectious disease waste from BSL-2 and/or BSL-3 environment.
  • DOCUMENTATION - 5%
    • Ability to follow detailed written instructions in performing routine work paying close attention to details. Record cage census as required.
  • QUALITY ASSURANCE - 5%
    • Provide a clean and safe atmosphere for animals, employees, and facility users. Contribute and recommend new ideas and input on problem solving issues.
  • PROFESSIONAL TRAINING - 5%
    • Participate in departmental training of various areas comprising animal, facility, and employment-related issues. Contribute to the workforce and environment by exhibiting newly learned skills and sharing newly found knowledge with others. Prepare for ALAT certification.
  • H.S./G.E.D.
  • Minimum 6 months of animal care experience
  • Purina Test

title: Lead Automation Tester in JS
description:
We are seeking a Lead Automation Tester in JS to set quality strategy and automation architecture for web platforms using Playwright and JavaScript. You will define quality standards, lead shift-left practices, and embed robust UI, API, and integration testing across complex enterprise-scale systems. Join the team to raise release readiness and help quality scale as the platform grows—apply now

Responsibilities

  • Design and own the end-to-end automation strategy using Playwright and JavaScript
  • Define automation architecture, patterns, and best practices for the team
  • Ensure test suites remain scalable, maintainable, and performant as coverage grows
  • Drive shift-left testing adoption across the delivery lifecycle
  • Establish quality gates and enforcement within CI/CD pipelines
  • Implement and oversee UI, API, and integration test coverage
  • Create test strategies for complex user journeys and external integrations
  • Manage test data and orchestrate environments for reliable execution
  • Lead code reviews for test automation code and standards
  • Eliminate flaky tests and improve overall execution reliability
  • Mentor mid-level and junior Quality Engineers through coaching and guidance
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Delivery leaders to assess release readiness

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience of 5+ years in Quality Engineering or Test Automation
  • Proven track record acting as a Lead QE or Automation Lead
  • Deep expertise with Playwright at scale
  • High proficiency in JavaScript
  • Solid understanding of frontend and backend architectures
  • Practical experience testing REST APIs

title: Principal Enterprise Architect, Business Systems & Data (R5535)
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Job Description:

The Principal Enterprise Architect is a senior individual contributor responsible for shaping the enterprise systems and data landscape across business domains, with particular focus on regulated, multi-environment architecture and long-range technology rationalization. It defines how enterprise systems, data platforms, and domain technologies should work together across commercial and future government-hosted environments, in partnership with the cloud/infrastructure team and domain leaders.

This role is intended to establish the enterprise architecture practice within Enterprise Data & Architecture. It will lead efforts such as assessing domain technology stacks, defining target-state architecture and integration patterns, and guiding decisions about where systems, platforms, and sensitive data should reside based on business capability, regulatory constraints, and long-term maintainability.

What you'll do:

  • Define and evolve the target-state enterprise systems and data architecture across major business domains, including G&A, product, engineering, operations, and supply-chain-adjacent capabilities. dataforest+4
  • Lead the discovery and rationalization of function-level and shadow IT stacks, documenting current-state architectures, identifying overlap and risk, and proposing a phased roadmap toward a more coherent enterprise landscape.
  • Design and govern architecture patterns for regulated multi-environment operations, including commercial and future government-hosted systems, with clear principles for data zoning, system placement, and cross-environment interaction.
  • Partner with the Cloud & Infrastructure and Security & Compliance teams on the infrastructure and security implications of architectural decisions, while remaining focused on system, data, and integration architecture.
  • Define approved integration patterns between business systems, data platforms, and domain technologies, including API, event-driven, and batch data movement approaches where appropriate.
  • Guide decisions about where sensitive, controlled, or regulated data and workloads should live, and how enterprise systems should interact without violating policy or creating unsustainable architecture debt.
  • Provide architectural oversight and decision support for major cross-domain, strategic programs such as ERP implementation, data platform modernization, domain onboarding, and future product/engineering data initiatives.
  • Establish architecture review practices, reference architectures, and reusable standards so teams can move faster without solving the same structural problems repeatedly.
  • Coach software engineering teams on enterprise architecture principles, design standards, and system trade-offs through design reviews, architecture forums, and hands-on guidance that raises architectural maturity across the organization
  • Act as a strategic partner to the Sr. Director of Enterprise Data & Architecture, helping extend leadership coverage across domains and enabling a durable enterprise architecture practice.

    • Required qualifications:

  • 15+ years of relevant experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture, or senior architecture roles spanning multiple business domains and technology platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience shaping enterprise technology landscapes across applications, data platforms, and integration patterns, not just designing one platform in isolation.
  • Experience in regulated, security-sensitive, or government-adjacent environments with meaningful architectural constraints around sensitive data handling, segmentation, and compliance.
  • Experience working in hybrid or multi-environment architectures, such as commercial plus government-hosted, cloud plus on-prem, or otherwise segregated environments.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns and the architectural trade-offs between APIs, eventing, batch movement, replication, and system coupling.
  • Ability to engage effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, security/compliance, and infrastructure leaders.
  • Strong judgment, communication, and facilitation skills in ambiguous environments with incomplete information and competing priorities.

    • Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with Oracle ERP, SAP, or another major enterprise platform in finance, supply chain, manufacturing, or product-adjacent environments.
  • Experience with modern cloud data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or similar, sufficient to guide enterprise architecture decisions affecting data and analytics platforms.
  • Experience leading architecture rationalization or modernization efforts across decentralized organizations.
  • Experience in defense, aerospace, federal, or another environment with highly controlled data and systems.

description:

Job Description:

The Senior Data & Analytics Engineer is a hybrid builder role focused on enabling business domains onto the Databricks platform by developing governed Silver and Gold assets, reusable semantic patterns, and domain-ready analytical models. This role sits between pure data engineering and pure analytics engineering: it requires enough technical depth to work comfortably with transformations and lakehouse patterns, and enough business fluency to build trustworthy models that business stakeholders can use and extend.

Initial focus for this role is expected to be G&A and GTM-oriented domains such as Accounting, Program Finance, RevOps, Marketing, HR, and adjacent business functions, while remaining flexible enough to support more complex future domains such as Product or Engineering as the team matures. This role is not a dashboard factory; it is responsible for durable, governed datasets and semantic assets that accelerate domain self-service while maintaining enterprise consistency.

What you'll do:

  • Build and maintain Silver and Gold data models, domain marts, curated datasets, and semantic assets for priority domains onboarding to Databricks.
  • Partner directly with business stakeholders to translate domain requirements and KPI definitions into governed, testable, and reusable transformation logic.
  • Apply enterprise modeling standards, naming conventions, semantic definitions, and promotion rules, contributing practical improvements back into those standards.
  • Create reusable domain patterns and analytical building blocks that allow teams such as FP&A, RevOps, and Marketing to operate more self-service over time.
  • Support the design of semantic views and curated layers that can be consumed by BI tools, Databricks SQL, and Genie or related AI/BI experiences.
  • Work across domain boundaries when metrics overlap or interact, especially where G&A, GTM, workforce, and product-adjacent concepts intersect.
  • Ensure data sensitivity, classification, and approved use are reflected in modeling choices, joins, and semantic exposure, particularly for regulated or restricted datasets.
  • Review and refine partner-delivered or domain-contributed data models to ensure they are production-worthy, understandable, and aligned with enterprise definitions.
  • Help domain teams grow into more self-service analytics by providing patterns, documentation, examples, and technical guidance rather than permanently centralizing every request.

    • Required qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, BI engineering, data engineering, or a hybrid role spanning modeling and transformation work.
  • Strong dimensional modeling and semantic design skills, including facts, dimensions, grain, conformed dimensions, and business-friendly analytical structures.
  • Strong SQL skills and comfort working with modern cloud data platforms such as Databricks.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into precise, auditable, and reusable data models.
  • Enough data engineering fluency to work comfortably in Silver-to-Gold transformations, testing, performance tuning, and production deployment contexts.
  • Ability to understand the business meaning and usage constraints of the data being modeled, not just the technical transformations involved.
  • Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with business stakeholders in domains with evolving definitions and priorities.

    • Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in finance, program finance, RevOps, marketing analytics, HR analytics, product analytics, or another cross-functional business domain.
  • Experience building modular, tested transformation pipelines on Databricks (SQL/pyspark, Delta Live Tables, or equivalent).
  • Experience with semantic layer tooling, governed metrics, or AI/BI consumption layers.
  • Experience in regulated or security-sensitive industries.
  • Ability and interest to expand from initial G&A/GTM domain focus into more technical domains such as Product or Engineering over time.

title: IT Specialist
description:

Troubleshoot, modify, support, manage, and maintain applications programs and user accounts. title: Senior .Net Developer
description:
Axos Business Center, Corp

About This Job

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Backend .NET API Developer with strong expertise in financial services platforms to design, build, and optimize secure, scalable backend systems. The ideal candidate will have deep experience in .NET Core / ASP.NET APIs, microservices architecture, and high-volume transactional systems, with a strong understanding of banking/financial domain requirements such as security, compliance, and real-time processing.
This role goes beyond development — the candidate is expected to actively participate in production incident (ITN) calls, take ownership of issue resolution, and drive root cause fixes to ensure system stability, uptime, and customer impact mitigation.

Key Responsibilities

Production Support & Incident Management (Critical Responsibility)

  • Actively participate in ITN / production incident bridge calls and provide real-time technical troubleshooting
  • Take end-to-end ownership of production issues impacting APIs and backend services
  • Perform rapid debugging, issue isolation, and hotfix implementation during incidents
  • Drive root cause analysis (RCA) and implement permanent fixes to prevent recurrence
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (QA, DevOps, Infra) to restore service within SLA timelines
  • Monitor logs, metrics, and tracing tools to quickly identify production failures
  • Ensure post-incident documentation, learnings, and preventive measures are implemented

Backend & API Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs and microservices using .NET Core / ASP.NET Core
  • Build scalable backend services supporting high-volume transactions and financial workflows
  • Implement robust business logic for payments, accounts, transactions, and integrations

Architecture & System Design

  • Lead backend architecture design focusing on scalability, security, and performance
  • Define API contracts, service interfaces, and data models
  • Design distributed systems, event-driven or microservices architectures

Financial Domain & Compliance

  • Ensure systems comply with financial regulations, security standards, and audit requirements
  • Implement secure transaction processing and data protection strategies
  • Work with domain teams on risk, reporting, settlement, or payment systems

Database & Data Management

  • Design and optimize relational and NoSQL databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB)
  • Ensure data integrity, consistency, and performance tuning

Integration & Collaboration

  • Integrate with external systems (e.g., payment gateways, banking APIs, third-party services)
  • Collaborate with architects, product teams, QA, and DevOps teams

Code Quality & Leadership

  • Conduct code reviews, mentoring, and enforce best practices
  • Drive technical design discussions and solution architecture
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum processes

Performance & Operations

  • Optimize systems for low latency, high availability, and reliability
  • Troubleshoot production issues and perform root-cause analysis

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 8–12+ years of experience in backend development
  • Strong experience in financial services / banking / fintech domain (mandatory)
  • Proven experience building enterprise-grade applications and APIs

Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in C#, .NET Core / .NET 8+ / ASP.NET Core
  • Hands-on experience with REST APIs, Web APIs, and microservices
  • Solid knowledge of SQL Server and database design
  • Experience with Entity Framework / ORM tools
  • Understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architecture

Architecture & Cloud

  • Experience with cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP)
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines
  • Knowledge of system design and scalability patterns

Security & Compliance

  • Strong understanding of:
    • API security (OAuth2, JWT, OIDC)
    • Data encryption and protection
    • Financial compliance standards (PCI, SOX, etc.)

Other Skills

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management
  • Experience mentoring and leading engineers

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with low-latency trading or real-time systems [builtin.com]
  • Knowledge of payment systems (ACH, RTP, cards, SWIFT, etc.)
  • Experience with event streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
  • Exposure to Domain-Driven Design (DDD)

Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

What Success Looks Like

  • Delivering secure, scalable APIs powering financial transactions
  • Maintaining high system uptime and performance under load
  • Driving architecture modernization and microservices adoption
  • Enabling compliant and reliable financial integrations

Nice-to-Have (Based on Your Context – Optional Add-on)

If you plan to tailor this for core banking / enterprise services (like your environment at Axos), you can explicitly add:

  • Experience with identity platforms, payments systems, or core banking integrations
  • Familiarity with event-driven enterprise platforms (Redis, RabbitMQ)
  • Exposure to API gateways (Apigee).

About Axos

Born digital-first, Axos delivers financial tools and services that allow individuals, small businesses, and companies to access and manage their money how, when, and where they want. We’re a diverse team of dynamic, insightful, and independent innovators who are excited to provide technology-driven solutions that offer unbeatable value to our customers.

Axos Financial is our holding company and is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "AX" (NYSE: AX).

Learn More about working at Axos Business Center

All offers are contingent upon the candidate successfully passing a credit check, criminal background check, and pre-employment medical and drug screening.

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religious creed, color, sex (including pregnancy, breast feeding and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, military and veteran status, marital status, age, protected medical condition, genetic information, physical disability, mental disability, or any other protected status in accordance with all applicable federal, state, and local laws.
