title: Business Advisor till Citedo
description:
Tjänstebeskrivning & erbjudande

Citedo är en ledande IT-tjänsteleverantör som gör IT-lösningar, informationshantering, mötesteknik och utskriftslösningar enklare, effektivare och säkrare. Med över 70 engagerade medarbetare och lokal närvaro på flera orter bygger Citedo långsiktiga relationer och siktar på att bli Sveriges bästa IT-tjänsteleverantör. Nu söker vi dig som vill bli vårt ansikte utåt! Ditt främsta fokus blir att öppna dörrar till nya affärer för att sen lämna över till en specialist som tar affären i mål. Du kommer att vara den första kontakten som får kunder att bli nyfikna på oss och vårt erbjudande. Du trivs i en kundnära roll och du har tidigare haft framgång med att fånga kunders intresse där du skapat värde. Som Business Advisor kommer du träffa spännande företag och få en inblick i hur de arbetar med IT, utskriftslösningar och konferensteknik. Du erbjuds en stabil fast lön tillsammans med en attraktiv provisionsmodell och möjlighet till hybrid arbetsplats som kombinerar flexibilitet, frihet och balans mellan arbete och privatliv.

Personprofil

Vi söker dig som med en positiv attityd och ett starkt affärssinne – och som alltid ser möjligheter där andra ser hinder. Du har erfarenhet av relationsbyggande försäljning och trivs i en roll där du långsiktigt utvecklar affärer och kundrelationer. Du är trygg i mötet med chefer och beslutsfattare, bygger förtroende naturligt och har en stark förmåga att skapa verkligt värde för dina kunder. Det viktigaste för oss är din positiva attityd, ditt starka driv att skapa affärer och din målinriktade inställning där du aldrig ger upp. Med rätt inställning och vilja att utvecklas ger vi dig förutsättningarna att lyckas. Vi värderar dina egenskaper högt och ser gärna att du har en bakgrund inom idrott- och föreningslivet. Berätta vilken aktivitet du utövat, på vilket sätt det har format dig som person samt hur du tror att detta påverkar dig i en roll som Business Advisor hos oss på Citedo.

Övrigt

Plats: Jönköping Omfattning: heltid och tillsvidare Start: enligt överenskommelse Körkort är ett krav. PerformIQ – rekrytering av personal med egenskaper från idrott/föreningsliv, är vår samarbetspartner och vi hänvisar eventuella frågor om tjänsten till Rekryteringskonsult Mattias Söderberg på telefonnummer 072-157 27 76 eller mattias.soderberg@performiq.se Skicka in din ansökan redan idag då intervjuer sker löpande. Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Välkommen in med din ansökan!

title: Process Monitoring and Optimization Engineer
description:
Total Number of Openings

1

The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.

Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.

About the position

The Specialty Operations Biodiesel and Renewable Diesel (BD/RD) Process Monitoring and Optimization Engineer is a member of the Facilities Process Engineering organization within Chevron ENGINE. This role provides process monitoring, optimization, and technical assurance support focused on biodiesel and renewable diesel process units, including feedstock handling, reaction systems, separation, treating, product upgrading, and utilities interfaces. The engineer plays a critical role in supporting safe, reliable, and efficient production of renewable fuels through proactive monitoring, analysis, and optimization of complex process systems.

Engineers will work closely with Operations, Process Engineering, Digital, Control Systems, Maintenance, and Environmental teams to deliver work priorities including routine process monitoring, yield and energy optimization, operating envelope assurance, data quality validation, and engineering analysis. Engineers will interface directly with Chevron biodiesel and renewable diesel assets to provide technical ownership and remote support for monitoring tools, methodologies, and performance insights.

Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, and work hours are aligned to business needs. Standard working hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM or 1:30 PM to 10:30 PM, Monday to Friday. These may evolve based on operational or business requirements.

Key responsibilities

  • Provide daily and periodic monitoring of biodiesel and renewable diesel process units, with emphasis on process stability, yields, operating efficiency, and constraint management.

  • Monitor and analyze key process parameters associated with feedstock variability, catalyst performance, reaction severity, separation efficiency, and product quality.

  • Develop, maintain, and standardize process monitoring methodologies, dashboards, and analytics to ensure consistent application across biodiesel and renewable diesel facilities.

  • Perform engineering analysis to support mass and energy balances, yield accounting, loss identification, and process performance trending.

  • Develop and maintain process monitoring and data analytics tools (e.g., PI, SEEQ, Power BI or similar) to support operational decision-making and optimization.

  • Identify and develop process improvement and digital enablement opportunities to enhance throughput, yield, energy efficiency, and operability.

  • Monitor process trends and operating conditions to support continuous improvement, early issue detection, and abnormal situation prevention.

  • Collaborate with Operations and Process Engineering teams to address reliability risks, operability challenges, and performance gaps.

  • Provide technical support for troubleshooting process upsets, performance deviations, control issues, and data anomalies.

  • Support audits, technical reviews, and internal assurance activities related to process performance, monitoring practices, and data integrity.

  • Provide analytical and technical input for incident investigations, root cause analyses, and corrective action development related to biodiesel or renewable diesel operations.

  • Support integrity operating window (IOW) monitoring related to critical process parameters, equipment limits, and safe operating envelopes.

  • Participate in HAZOPs, management of change (MOC), and process safety reviews with a focus on operability, safeguards, and loss prevention.

  • Constraint management: proactive monitoring to identify constraints as early as possible. Quantify impact, develop interim mitigations, EOR projections, and turnaround scope justification.

  • Key equipment monitoring: single points of failure, for example H2 compressors, HI Charge Pump, etc. Develop heat exchanger monitoring dashboards in HexMon-Pi.

  • Update, validate, and issue Daily Production Report (DPR)- weekly and on the 1st of the month.

  • Monitor and track utility, i.e. steam, natural gas, fuel gas, nitrogen, and hydrogen usage.

  • Provide environmental release calculations.

  • Conduct weekly or as required sulfur balance to track and schedule LPG Desulfurizer and Excess Gas Desulfurizer media replacement.

About you

We know our greatest resource is the ingenuity, creativity and innovation of our people. Applications from motivated, talented individuals with a keen interest in the energy industry are encouraged. To be considered for this role, applicants should have:

Required Qualifications

  • 5–10+ years of process engineering or operations support experience within refining, renewable fuels, specialty chemicals, or complex process manufacturing environments.

  • Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering or related engineering discipline from an accredited university.

  • Proficiency with process monitoring, data analysis, and visualization tools such as PI, SEEQ, Power BI, Pro II, Hysys, HTRI, or similar platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting biodiesel, renewable diesel, or other renewable fuels facilities in an operating environment.

  • Experience with continuous process units involving reaction, separation, and treating systems.

  • Knowledge of feedstock variability impacts, catalyst performance considerations, and yield optimization concepts.

  • Strong process engineering fundamentals, including mass balance, thermodynamics, reaction engineering, heat transfer, and fluid flow.

  • Familiarity with HAZOP, root cause analysis, and process safety management practices.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with operations, technical teams, and leadership across multiple biodiesel and renewable diesel assets.


What we can offer you

Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way.

Have the opportunity to take part in world-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace.

  • Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work.

  • Work in thoughtfully designed environments that support focus, well-being, and innovation enhanced by digital tools that enable seamless collaboration.

  • Grow through structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to impactful projects that align with Chevron’s values and business priorities.

  • Access comprehensive benefits that support your health, well-being, and work-life balance.

  • Engage with emerging technologies and digital solutions that are shaping the future of energy and enterprise.

How to apply

  • To be a part of our success, click APPLY to submit your application.

  • Chevron regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time-limited Visa status for this position.

Privacy and Terms and Conditions

  • We respect the privacy of candidates for employment. This Privacy Notice sets forth how we will use the information we obtain when you apply for a position through this career site. If you do not consent to the terms of this Privacy Notice, please do not submit information to us.

  • Please access the Global Application Statements, select the country where you are applying for employment. By applying, you acknowledge that you have read and agree to the country specific statement.

Terms of Use

  • “ENGINE” refers to the Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center, which operates under Chevron Global Technology and Services Private Limited, an affiliate of Chevron Corporation. References to ENGINE in this document are for convenience only and do not denote a separate legal entity.

  • This job advertisement is intended to provide a general overview of the role and workplace environment. Role details and outcomes may vary based on business needs and individual performance.

Chevron participates in E-Verify in certain locations as required by law.

title: Senior API Developer
description:
Senior API Developer

Reporting To: Tech Lead

Location: Krakow - Poland / Bournemouth / Bristol / Remote with monthly travel to Bournemouth if not Krakow based.

Job Type: Full Time 37.5 hours a week

Our Purpose: A Better Life for Everyone

Nourish is not simply a technology company; we are a digital partner for the social and health care sector rooted in human connections, with the person being supported at its core. We offer a range of co-produced software solutions tailored to the unique challenges of care, while still being flexible enough to meet the specific needs of each individual service we work with.

We are at an exciting stage of growth. While we are the market leader, we remain ambitious and dedicated to our mission. We continue to revolutionise the sector by investing in our platform and our incredible employees who make this impact possible.

Our Ecosystem

At Nourish, you will contribute to a sophisticated ecosystem that includes:

  • Technology that impacts a million people every day: Our core products are used by over 425,000 carers to support 417,000+ individuals

  • The Nourish Partnership Programme (NPP): A sector-leading programme that manages strategic integrations with third-party systems to ensure seamless data syncing and interoperability across the care journey.

Our Culture & Values

We look for people who align with the way we work. If you join us, you are joining a culture defined by:

  • Making a Difference: We remember who we serve. We are passionate about making a meaningful, positive impact on the lives of carers and those we support

  • Agility: We continuously refine and adapt. There is no room for complacency here; we are driven to constantly review and improve our products and processes.

  • Collective Effort: We help each other out because we know that when one person wins, we all win. It’s "all hands-on deck" - everyone is in it together.

  • Every Person Counts: We treat everyone as a very significant part of our community. We welcome people being their true and authentic selves and value the diverse perspectives they bring.

  • Openness to Learning: We believe no question is a silly question and all insights are valuable. Mistakes are part of the improvement process; we dust ourselves off and begin again.

The Team & Role

The Empower API team builds the services that power the next generation of care agency management solutions. The team is currently transitioning our platform from a legacy PHP Symfony codebase to a modern Go backend, with linting, static analysis, and automated tests built in from the outset. The team sits within a wider engineering department of around 80, alongside approximately 30 Product and Design colleagues. We run a Dockerised stack deployed via CI into an AWS Kubernetes environment and expect all engineers to take an active interest in deployment and infrastructure. As a Senior Developer, you will bring a broad passion for programming and problem solving, alongside deeper expertise in the languages and frameworks you specialise in and will play a leading role in shaping technical direction and mentoring others through this transition.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintaining, building, and improving the Empower API.

  • Leading or contributing to the migration of legacy Symfony functionality to Go.

  • Build the new Vue.js front end as part of the migration from the existing Drupal application.

  • Working as part of an Agile team to deliver improvements to our software solutions.

  • Participating in Agile ceremonies and committing to sprint goals as a team.

  • Analysing logs and metrics to understand how we can improve our systems, or guide partners to better utilise our APIs.

  • Supporting client facing colleagues to diagnose and solve issues that may arise.

  • Mentoring team members through code reviews and knowledge sharing.

Requirements

  • Experience: Significant commercial full stack development experience (typically 5+ years).

  • Technical/Functional Alignment: Commercial experience with Go and Vue/React plus familiarity with PHP or Symfony to support legacy transition work, commercial familiarity with at least three AWS services, familiarity with Git, Linux command line, and SQL databases, experience working within an Agile team using Scrum or Kanban, unit testing experience, and experience in at least one other language.

  • AI-Assisted Development: Experience using AI coding tools in daily development.

  • Sector Interest: A genuine interest in the UK social care sector and how technology can improve interoperability.

  • Mindset: A pragmatic, collaborative, and warm approach to problem-solving.

Nourish Benefits

Annual Leave: 25 days basic + Public Holidays + an extra day for your Birthday.

Service-Related Leave: 1 extra day for each completed year of service (up to 5 additional days).

Health & Wellbeing: Private Medical Insurance (including a personal health fund), Health & Wellbeing platform with 24/7 GP access, and an Employee Assistance Programme (EAP).

Family & Security: Enhanced Maternity Leave, Group Life Assurance, and Pension Contribution.

Growth & Connection: Regular career reviews, Referral Bonus schemes, and social events throughout the year.

All positions at Nourish are subject to a satisfactory Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check, references, and receipt of appropriate Right to Work documents.

Nourish is proud to be an equal opportunities employer and we actively seek and embrace differences in thinking, experience, ethnicity, age, gender, faith, personalities, and styles.

title: Real Estate Investment Intern
description:
Role Overview & Key Responsibilities

We are seeking an RE Investment Intern to join our investment team and actively contribute to the origination, qualification, and acquisition of real estate opportunities in Milan, Turin and Bologna. This is a strategic, market-facing role positioned at the top of the acquisition pipeline, with a strong commercial and analytical component.

The RE Investment Intern will be responsible for identifying and assessing both on-market and off-market investment opportunities in line with the company’s investment strategy, primarily focused on value-add residential assets. The role requires a high degree of autonomy, regular field activity, and strong analytical, commercial, and relationship-building skills.

Key Responsibilities include:

  • Sourcing and identifying real estate investment opportunities in line with defined acquisition criteria and investment strategy.

  • Building and maintaining strong commercial relationships with brokers, private owners, property managers, administrators, and other local market stakeholders to ensure a consistent and qualified investment pipeline.

  • Proactively developing new sourcing channels and market relationships, adopting an entrepreneurial, opportunity-driven approach.

  • Conducting site visits and performing preliminary asset assessments, identifying value creation potential as well as early risk indicators (technical, legal, planning, and commercial).

  • Leading preliminary negotiations with sellers and intermediaries to secure favorable acquisition terms, protect target returns, and mitigate downside risks.

  • Supporting the Investment Manager in the preparation of investment memoranda for the internal Investment Committee, highlighting key pricing metrics, financial projections, capex requirements, potential exit strategies, and key risk factors.

  • Collaborating with internal stakeholders and corporate functions (Investment, Legal, Casavo Agents) to ensure a smooth and efficient deal flow across the entire transaction lifecycle.

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Engineering, Finance, or a Real Estate related field.

  • Basic understanding of key real estate investment concepts and metrics.

  • Excellent command of Microsoft Office, with strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.

  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to establish and maintain long-term, trust-based relationships with market participants.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership; able to work independently, take initiative, and operate in a fast-paced environment.

  • Genuine passion for real estate, curiosity about market dynamics, and a practical, hands-on, field-oriented approach.

  • High level of discipline, consistency, and motivation to grow within a performance-driven and meritocratic environment.

     Kundemedarbejder til Aarhus 

        
 
            
 Trives du med at skabe struktur og overblik i en arbejdsdag med mange forskellige opgaver? 
 Og vil du gerne være med til at understøtte både kunder og kollegaer? 

 Så er du måske den kundemedarbejder, vi søger til vores afdeling på Åboulevarden i hjertet af Aarhus. 

 Som kundemedarbejder bliver du en del af vores supportgruppe Support Privat Østjylland, og du får arbejdssted i vores afdeling på Åboulevarden i Aarhus. Du kommer til at assistere rådgiverne med opgaver inden for produktion og support til privatkunder med særligt fokus på bolig og pension. 

 Om teamet
 Vi er 11 kollegaer i Support Privat Østjylland, og vi arbejder fra afdelingerne i Odder, Galten, Viby og på Åboulevarden. Vi hjælper og sparrer med hinanden til hverdag - og vi sørger for, at du får en god start. Du får plads til at træffe beslutninger, som er baseret på sund fornuft, og vi har fokus på både personlig og faglig udvikling. 

 "Supportteamet har et bredt kompetenceniveau, som gør, at vi supplerer hinanden godt. 
 Vores kultur er kendetegnet ved en engageret holdånd, og du vil
  opleve en arbejdsplads med et inspirerende miljø og mange muligheder," 
 siger afdelingsdirektør for support Helena Schmidt. 

 Vi tilbyder en arbejdsplads med godt kollegaskab og stor arbejdsglæde, hvor vi altid er klar til at yde en ekstra indsats, når det er nødvendigt. Vi skaber sammen en arbejdsdag for den enkelte, hvor der er balance mellem arbejds- og familielivet med udgangspunkt i vores bærende værdier. 

 Om jobbet
 Som kundemedarbejder bliver dine kommunikative og administrative evner sat i spil. Sammen med supportgruppen og rådgiverne sørger du for, at nye kunder bliver godt modtaget i sparekassen, samtidig med at du understøtter eksisterende kunders forretninger. 

 Du får mulighed for at bruge din sans for detaljer og struktur i det daglige, hvor du primært arbejder med administrative boligsager og sagsbehandling inden for pension og investering. Derudover er det vigtigt, at du har lyst til at give kunderne oplevelser ud over det forventede. 

 For at klare dig godt i rollen er det her vigtigt at vide
 Du arbejder i dag som kundemedarbejder, kunderådgiver eller specialist i et pengeinstitut - eller har en finansiel uddannelse. Du har erfaring fra den finansielle branche, som du bringer i spil i rollen som som kundemedarbejder. 

 Du vil sandsynligvis trives godt i rollen, hvis du: 
 
   arbejder omhyggeligt og bidrager til høj kvalitet i opgaveløsningen 

   arbejder struktureret - også når deadlines nærmer sig 

   trives med at løse opgaver både sammen med andre og på egen hånd 

   har en bred viden om finansielle ydelser 

   har erfaring med sagsbehandling inden for bolig, pension og investering 

   er åben for at lære nyt og tage nye metoder i brug 

   bidrager med dine erfaringer og medvirker til et godt kollegialt og fagligt miljø. 
          

        
 
             Om sparekassen 
            
 Sparekassen Danmark er en garantsparekasse. 

 Med vores 400.000 kunder og mere end 1.800 medarbejdere er vi blandt de seks største pengeinstitutter i Danmark. Du finder os på hele 71 adresser i Jylland, på Fyn og i København. 

 Vi driver pengeinstitut ud fra tre værdier: Ambitiøs, sund fornuft og tillid. 

 I praksis betyder det, at vi er ambitiøse i forhold til at gøre en forskel i kundernes liv. At den enkelte har frihed til at bruge sin sunde fornuft i den daglige drift. Og at vi udviser gensidig tillid til hinanden, til vores kunder - og til de beslutninger, der bliver truffet. 

 Du kan læse mere om sparekassens formål og værdier, og hvad du kan forvente at opleve som medarbejder i sparekassen, på vores karrieresite.  Klik hér  .

title: Arlington Tour Guide
description:
Arlington Tour Guide

Location: Arlington

Compensation: $27 per hour

Are you brave enough to be a ghost tour guide? Ready to share incredible experiences as you bewitch and enchant audiences? Then embrace the shadows and become our next ghost tour guide.

Our passion at US Ghost Adventures is enchanting storytelling. We specialize in dark, forgotten, and secret history. We are looking for individuals with theater or acting experience, creatives, history buffs, true crime junkies, and paranormal enthusiasts willing to dive deeper into the dark side of humanity.

We thrive on igniting a sense of wonder in every guest on our ghost tours, and as a guide, you will weave enthralling stories while leading tours down the ghastly streets of Arlington.

The Perks (Pay & Benefits)

  • Pay: $40 per 90-minute tour
  • Fantastic Tip Potential: $20 to over $100 per tour
  • Performance-based bonuses
  • Free or discounted ghost tours for you and your close family and friends nationwide
  • Flexible scheduling that fits your lifestyle

Who We're Looking For

  • Skilled and confident public speakers
  • Individuals passionate about storytelling, local history, and the paranormal
  • Theater or acting experience is a plus
  • History buffs, creatives, true crime enthusiasts, and lovers of all things spooky

About US Ghost Adventures

US Ghost Adventures offers entertaining, historic, and authentic ghost tours in some of the most haunted cities across the United States. Our mission is to deliver fun, engaging, and historically grounded experiences while sharing the eerie legends and documented hauntings that make each city unique.

While our stories are rooted in extensive historical research, every ghost tour is enriched by the chilling tales and firsthand experiences shared by our nationwide network of expert guides. Join us in bringing history—and its ghosts—to life.

title: Är du en positiv lagerarbetare som är redo för att ta nästa steg?
description:

Vi söker nu dig som trivs på lagret, gillar tempo och teamwork och som är redo att kliva fram när det behövs. Det här är en perfekt roll för dig som vill utvecklas, ta mer ansvar och visa vad du går för. Du kommer att arbeta som stöd och ersättare för ordinarie arbetsledare vid sjukdom eller ledighet. Utöver det arbetar du minst en fast dag i veckan (fredag eller söndag) då ordinarie inte är på plats. Det här är alltså en roll för dig som gillar att vara mitt i verksamheten men också är redo att axla lite mer ansvar. title: Network and Security Operations Engineer - Federal Government
description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What you’ll be doing:

As a Network and Security Operations Engineer, you will manage, secure, and optimize our hybrid network and cloud operations supporting business-critical infrastructure for Federal Government clients in Canberra. In this role, you will take hands-on ownership of operational and security tasks, proactively mitigate risks, resolve complex incidents within SLA timeframes, and ensure high service availability and reliability.

Responsibilities:

  • Providing Level 2 support, including the installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and continuous monitoring of enterprise network and security hardware and software.

  • Maintaining high uptime for business-critical services by systematically resolving incidents within defined SLA boundaries and performing smooth escalations.

  • Proactively applying security patches and carrying out routine system upgrades to harden the environment and prevent security breaches.

  • Evaluating security infrastructure, identifying potential risks, and providing actionable remediation recommendations to clients to address security gaps.

  • Collaborating across end-users, partners, and stakeholders to resolve security and network issues efficiently while minimizing operational downtime.

  • Authoring and maintaining comprehensive technical documentation, including operational policies, support guides, and procedural runbooks.

  • Participating in an on-call roster, including scheduled shifts and occasional weekend availability, to guarantee continuous operational integrity.

What we’re looking for:

You enjoy solving tough technical problems, keeping network ecosystems secure, and keeping business-critical services running smoothly. You are a proactive engineer with deep hands-on expertise across routing, switching, security appliances, and enterprise network hardening.

You’ll need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.

  • Four or more years of relevant work experience in Network and Security operations or support.

  • Hands-on technical experience with networking protocols (TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, IPSec) and concepts (Routing, VPNs, VLANs, NAT, and Software-Defined Access/SDA).

  • Practical expertise with core security technologies, including Firewalls, Proxy/CASB, IDS/IPS, Load Balancing, Remote Access, Antivirus, and DLP solutions.

  • Active AGSVA NV1 Security clearance or above.

Even better if you have:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field.

  • Current industry-recognized networking and security certifications (e.g., CCNA, CCNP, JNCIA, or JNCIS).

  • Active ITIL certification or practical experience operating within an ITIL-aligned service management environment.

  • Working knowledge of enterprise cloud platforms, specifically AWS and Azure.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a proven track record of managing stakeholder expectations and explaining complex technical issues.

  • A collaborative, proactive mindset with a drive to mentor junior engineers and excel in dynamic, high-pressure environments.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

title: Investigator
description:
ABOUT US: Ethos Risk Services is a leading insurance claims investigation and medical management company, specializing in surveillance and fraud detection. At the forefront, we provide accurate data and actionable insights that translate into better decision-making for our clients.

JOB SUMMARY:

Our dynamic Ethos team is seeking an Experienced Field Investigator to conduct surveillance and investigative activities to identify potential fraudulent insurance claims. This role involves performing both stationary and mobile surveillance, obtaining video and photographic evidence, and preparing thorough, detailed reports for clients.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Case Preparation: Prepare for surveillance assignment by reviewing Ethos' preliminary reports and case information.
  • Field Surveillance: Perform covert surveillance from your vehicle by tracking and capturing high-quality video evidence of surveillance targets.
  • Report Writing: Draft detailed and court-ready investigative reports summarizing activity and key findings.
  • Documentation: Finalize case file by submitting case reports and uploading video footage via personal laptop at the end of the day.
  • Communication: Work closely with the field supervisor and operations teams, receiving regular guidance and mentorship.


REQUIREMENTS:

  • Previous Experience: Demonstrated proficiency in covert surveillance techniques, capturing high-quality video footage, and preparing thorough, well-organized investigative reports.
  • Driver's License: Valid driver's license and proof of automobile insurance.
  • Personal Vehicle: A well-maintained vehicle that is always reliable (preferably with tinted windows).
  • Surveillance Equipment: A handheld camcorder with high-quality zoom and a covert camera device. Use of stabilization equipment (gimbals, tripods, etc.) is strongly encouraged.
  • Technology: A reliable laptop, cell phone, and internet service are needed for communication and administrative tasks.
  • Private Investigator License: Active Private Investigator license or willingness to obtain one (where required by state).


WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • While we aim to keep assignments within a 2-hour drive of your residence, occasional further travel and overnight stays (covered by the company) may be required
  • Most surveillance cases start at 6:00AM. End time can vary depending on activity and a typical workday can vary from 3-12 hours.
  • Weekends/holidays are common workdays as claimants are more likely to be active.
  • This is an independent role often requiring long hours alone in your vehicle, regardless of weather conditions.
  • Must remain alert with no external distractions, ready to use videography equipment to document subjects.


Ethos Risk Services is an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of religious creed, sex, national origin, race, veteran status, disability, age, marital status, color or sexual orientation or any other characteristic.

A background check will be conducted, in accordance to the local state law and regulations.

title: Sr. Account Technology Strategist - Mfg. & Conglomerates
description:
Overview

India's largest manufacturers are deciding right now how AI will run their factories, supply chains, and boardrooms — and they're asking Microsoft to help them get it right. As an Account Technology Strategist, you'll be the technology voice in that room: the person who turns a CIO's ambition into a roadmap the CEO can fund. If you want your technical judgment to shape a customer's next decade, not just their next deployment, this is the seat.

You'll join Microsoft's Enterprise Manufacturing & Conglomerates ATU in India — a small, senior account team where you own the end-to-end technical strategy for some of the country's most recognizable industrial names. You'll lead Frontier Discovery, using the Customer Secure AI Assessment to translate readiness insights into an executive-ready strategy that feeds the Frontier Account Plan, the 3 Horizon plan, and the technical roadmap — then orchestrate AI, Azure, Copilot, data, and security specialists to turn that strategy into consumption, usage, and billed revenue. You'll be backed by a team that expects you to operate at executive altitude, removes the noise that isn't yours to carry, and celebrates the wins you make reusable for everyone else. You will bring industry-relevant solutions to help the customers to securely adopt and embrace AI technologies. With a proven history of innovating technical solutions to achieve customers’ business objectives and achieving account growth targets, this role will give you the opportunity to combine your technology and industry knowledge to deliver on secure AI solutions to accelerate your customers’ AI vision and to ultimately become their trusted technology advisor.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities



1. Own Frontier Discovery Technical Strategy: Lead technical C‑suite AI, data, and security conversations by translating Customer Secure AI Assessment (CSAA) insights into clear executive strategy and decisions across Frontier Account planning, 3 Horizon, and strategic technical roadmap.​

2. Drive Execution & Technical Leadership: Convert AI, Azure, Security and Copilot strategy into consumption plans and business impact by orchestrating delivery, removing blockers, and owning the end‑to‑end technical narrative.

3. Customer AI and Security Strategy Leadership - Document and articulate the customer’s business objectives, technology landscape and AI and Security strategy to lead and drive security and AI conversations.

4.Customer Technology Leadership - Develop and nurture trusted relationships with C-level technology executives across the business.

5. Drive Operational and Commercial Excellence- Lead technical decision maker conversations and governance with the customer and the v team to ensure the customer is using and getting value from Microsoft’s portfolio of solutions.

6. Engage deeply with the customers using consultative selling skills and challenge customers’ assumptions with constructive dialogue about their business and technology.

7. Industry Knowledge Articulate and understand specific industry-related market trends, as well as customer threats, opportunities, and barriers to growth as they relate to the customer's broader industry.

8. Own the Customer’s Frontier Discovery Technology Strategy​

  • Own and deliver a customer‑backed technology Frontier Discovery aligned to business outcomes across AI, data, and security​

  • Lead outcome‑driven C‑suite and line of business stakeholder engagements by framing clear technical strategic roadmaps, trade‑offs, and recommendations to drive customer decisions​

  • Leverage Customer Secure AI Assessment-CSAA to translate readiness insights into an executive ready Frontier Discovery strategy and embed outputs directly into Frontier Account Planning, 3 Horizon plans, and offramp to the STU/CSU/Services​

    9. Drive Execution, Value, Consumption, and Usage​

  • Ensure strategy converts to execution, value, and grow ACR consumption/Billed Revenue/Copilot-Security usage​

  • Lead and land new MACCs with a consumption planning value, attach, and pipeline execution to hit ACR and Copilot targets​

  • Own and secure renewals, drive recapture to protect revenue and prevent attrition​

    10. Orchestrate Technical Leadership and Raise the Bar​

  • Sets the standard for the technology strategy by driving clear ownership/orchestrating cross-solution alignment across STU/CSU/Services/Partners to deliver industry-focused customer outcomes​

  • Own the end‑to‑end technical narrative across the customer lifecycle Frontier Discovery through value realization​

  • Demonstrate strong executive storytelling and thought leadership in AI, Security, Sovereignty, and Agentic architect



Qualifications

Required/minimum qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or related field AND 15+ years technical consulting, technical consultative selling, business consulting, practice building, or related technical/sales experience OR equivalent experience.

Additional or preferred qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or related field AND 15+ years technical consulting, technical consultative selling, business consulting, practice building, or related technical/sales experience OR equivalent experience.
15+ years experience in relevant customer industry.
5+ years experience in digital transformation, or using technology to drive customer business outcomes.

Business Relationship Management The ability to develop and maintain positive working relationships with supervisors, staff, managers, customers, and vendors. This includes expressing empathy and compassion when dealing with the needs and problems of others, being approachable, taking time to address the concerns of coworkers, and treating others with respect and dignity.

Executive Relationships The ability to interact confidently with senior leaders of the organization in order to present/defend/clarify concerns or issues regarding an existing project, program, or solution. title: Cloud Services Database Specialist
description:
Cloud Services Database Specialist

Location: Campbell, CA

Remote Type: Home Based/Remote

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

About Centric Software:

Centric Software® is a global leader, providing an innovative and AI-enabled product-concept-to-commercialization platform for retailers, brands and manufacturers of all sizes. We equip retail, fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home and consumer goods brands with pioneering best-of-breed solutions to plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, sell and replenish products. Our technology powers brands to streamline processes, drive efficiency and operate with confidence in an ever-changing market.

Our story is one of rapid growth, bold ideas and extraordinary opportunities. We’re here to challenge the status quo—and we’re looking for brilliant people who want to do the same. No matter where you are in the world, this is your chance to be part of something exceptional.

Job Title: Cloud Services Escalation Lead
Location: Remote – USA or Canada (ET)
Compensation: $130.000 - $160,000 USD (depending on location)

Job Summary:

As a Database Specialist, you will be responsible for working with common relational databases (Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL Server, and PostgreSQL), as well as preferably have an understanding of NoSQL databases (MongoDB specifically), deployed on both traditional servers, as well as Cloud Managed instances (AWS, Azure and GCP), as well as containerized versions.


From a day-to-day perspective, you will be the subject matter expert assisting our global operations team who are responsible for a large number of databases, separated across multiple customer environments, to be proactive in managing instances where underlying issues are to do with those databases, be that such things as long-running queries, or issues relating to their general configuration. This aspect of the work will be working alongside the Cloud Operations team.


While this role does not involve designing database schemas for our core products, it will require you to be able to appreciate, discuss, and understand issues relating to performance with our R&D/DBA community, Performance Testing and DevOps teams, and how we have built this essential component that underpins our software products.


Database design experience will be essential for handling, and working on, internal Cloud Services projects, that underpin the ability of the Cloud Services department to support our day-to-day operational practices.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitor various databases across multiple environments, using established tools, such as DataDog, on a day-to-day basis

  • Supporting the Cloud Operations team in handling database issues, and acting as a subject matter expert/escalation point

  • Assist in investigating issues related to various databases, and where necessary, liaise with other internal teams in resolving issues

  • Work with the Cloud Services Infrastructure Architect in implementing robust backup and disaster recovery strategies for various database platforms for both customer accounts and internal applications

  • Supporting the Cloud Operations team in handling Disaster Recovery (DR) operations for databases for customers

  • Ensuring database security in respect to the ways in which Centric implements customer databases

  • Work on Cloud Services projects, where there is a need for database implementations, to ensure they are performant and secure, to meet our security needs

Qualifications:

Must Haves

  • Microsoft Certified: Database Administrator Associate, plus,

  • Certification in at least one of the three main cloud providers, especially those that relate to Cloud Managed Database platforms certification:

  • AWS: AWS Certified Database – Specialty

  • Azure: Azure Database Administrator Associate

  • GCP: Cloud Database Engineer

  • A degree in a Database-related subject

Experience and Skills:

  • 10+ years of proven experience as a Database Administrator/Specialist, including Cloud Managed instances.

  • Hands-on experience in monitoring databases via centralized tools, such as DataDog

  • Experience in troubleshooting performance issues on relational and non-relational databases

  • The ability to work out how databases and database objects work in relation to applications, with or without documentation

  • Experience in handling disaster recovery scenarios for databases, as well as other related areas such as backup management and data retention policies

  • Solid skills in designing and implementing various database platforms, using tools such as Terraform for deployment, and providing support to other teams developing such scripts

  • Experience and knowledge of data security frameworks, including such areas as NIST, ISO27001, and data privacy standards

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with internal teams, cloud providers, and external customers

  • Ability to work both independently and in a team-oriented, fast-paced environment.

  • A keen interest in keeping up-to-date with advancements in database technologies

Nice to Have:

  • Relevant certifications in PostGreSQL and/or MongoDB Administration

  • Any exposure to AI data engineering

Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience and relevant education or training. title: Lähihoitaja, arjen toiminnan ohjaaja, Onnikoti Katariina, Helsinki
description:
Lähihoitaja, arjen toiminnan ohjaaja, Onnikoti Katariina, Helsinki

Tule tekemään kehitysvammaisten ohjaustyötä sekä arjen toimintaa ainutlaatuiseen joukkoomme uuteen yksikköömme Onnikoti Katariinaan, Helsinkiin!

Rakennamme uutta tiimiä, ja etsimme joukkoomme lähihoitajaa arjen toiminnan ohjaajaksi vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden päästä mukaan rakentamaan toimivaa arkea aivan uudessa, viihtyisässä kodissamme yhdessä iloisen ja moniammatillisen tiimin kanssa. Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan, kehittämään ja jättämään oman kädenjälkesi työn arkeen.

Mihin tulet töihin?
Onnikoti Katariina sijaitsee keskeisellä paikalla Helsingin Munkkiniemessä. Tarjoamme ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista täysi-ikäisille kehitysvammaisille, jotka eivät vammaisuutensa vuoksi kykene itsenäiseen asumiseen kotona tai läheisten luona. Onnikodeille on tärkeää, että jokainen asukas voi asua ja elää omannäköistään elämää sekä keskittyä itselleen tärkeisiin asioihin turvallisessa ja välittävässä ympäristössä. Onnikoti Katariinassa on paikka 25 asukkaalle ja meillä työskentelee joukko monipuolisia ammattilaisia.

Mitä pääset tekemään?
Työ koostuu asumisen ohjaajan tehtävästä sekä arjen toiminnan ohjaajan työstä yksikön Atrium sisäpihalla. Atrium tarjoaa Onnikotien sekä Mainiokotien asukkaille yhteisen olohuoneen sekä mukavaa puuhaa eri arjen toimintojen ympärillä. Atriumin toimintoihin kuuluu myös pienen kahvilapuodin pyörittäminen. Tarjoamme sinulle lisäksi mahdollisuuden tehdä merkityksellistä ohjaustyötä sekä vaikuttaa yksikkömme toiminnan kehittämiseen. Arkemme on aktiivista ja toiminnallista, ja järjestämme monipuolisia aktiviteetteja asukkaillemme. Ohjaajana toimit asukkaiden tukena päivittäisessä arjessa. Vastaat arjen toiminnan ohjauksesta ja sen kehittämisestä yhdessä työparisi ja esihenkilösi kanssa. Meillä saat käyttää vahvuuksiasi ja tuoda rohkeasti esiin omia ideoitasi ja osaamistasi yhteisen toiminnan rikastuttamiseksi.

Kuka sinä olet?
Olet koulutukseltasi lähihoitaja. Joukossamme viihtyy parhaiten positiivisesti asioihin suhtautuva ja oma-aloitteinen henkilö, joka on aidosti kiinnostunut työskentelemään kehitysvammaisten parissa. Jos innostut uuden luomisesta ja haluat olla osa merkityksellistä työtä tekevässä yhteisössä, saatat olla juuri oikea henkilö meille. Sinulle on luontaista toimia toinen toisiaan opettaen ja kannustaen kohti yhteistä päämäärää, laadukkaasti sekä yksilöllisesti. Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen kehitysvammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työskentelystä, vaihtoehtoisten kommunikaatiomenetelmien käytöstä sekä päivätoiminnan tai muun arjen toiminnan suunnittelusta, ohjaamisesta ja kehittämisestä.

Miksi tulisit meille töihin?
Onnikoti Katariinassa pääset osaksi yhteen hiileen puhaltavaa työyhteisöä, jossa töitä tehdään hymy huulilla. Olemme joustava työnantaja ja meillä kaikki saavat osallistua työvuorosuunnitteluun. Mehiläisenä saat käyttöösi hyvät henkilöstöedut, kuten liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun, työterveyshuollon ja digiklinikan palvelut 24/7. Onnikotien työtekijänä sinulla on monipuoliset koulutus- ja kehittymismahdollisuudet.

Työ on 2-vuorotyötä ja tehtävän palkkaus on yksityisen sosiaalialan TES:n mukainen. Tehtävä on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen. Hoitotyön tehtävien hoitaminen edellyttää B1 tai vastaavaa suomen ja ruotsin kielen kielitaitotasoa. sekä sitoutumista kielitaidon ylläpitämiseen. Lisäksi tehtävässä vaaditaan hygieniapassia, koska kahvilatoiminnot kuuluvat työtehtävääsi.

Sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti tehtävään valittavien ikääntyvien tai vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työskentelevien on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitetturikosrekisteriote. Edellytämme myös tartuntatautilain 48§ mukaista rokotesuojaa.

Hae tehtävää rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta mahdollisimman pian. Hakemuksia aloitamme käymään läpi elokuun alussa ja haastattelut toteutuvat 6-12.8. välisenä aikana.

Työ alkaa 27.8.2026 ja täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä

Kerron mielelläni lisää:
Yksikönjohtaja Sanna Paunonen
puh. 040 125 6047 (arkisin klo 8–16)
sanna.paunonen@onnikodit.fi

Tutustu kotiimme: https://onnikodit.fi/toimipaikat/onnikoti-katariina

Tehtävänä ainutlaatuinen elämä.

Onnikodeissa tarjoamme tukea tarvitsevalle kodin, jossa hän voi elää mahdollisimman antoisaa ja turvallista arkea. Panostamme yksilöllisyyteen sekä laatuun ja palvelumme lähtökohtana ovat aina asukkaan omat ainutlaatuiset ominaisuudet, vahvuudet, mielenkiinnon kohteet sekä tuen tarpeet.

Onnikodit on osa Mehiläistä. Mehiläisen sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluiden ammattilaiset työskentelevät joka päivä tinkimättömästi yksityis-, yritys- ja hyvinvointialueasiakkaidemme hyväksi. Tervetuloa mukaan vahvistamaan ammattilaistemme joukkoa!

title: Data Science & AI Innovation Postdoctoral Fellow
description:
Data Science & AI Innovation Postdoctoral Fellow

Location: San Diego

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Band

Level 3


Job Description Summary

We are excited to invite applications for the Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program, a unique training opportunity designed for exceptional early-career scientists eager to tackle some of the most challenging problems in biomedical research and drug discovery.

As a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, you will join Translational Medicine in Basel, Cambridge, or San Diego and pursue an innovative research project at the forefront of biomedical science and drug discovery. You will work alongside leading scientists in a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary environment while gaining exposure to the broader ecosystem that translates scientific discovery into medicines.

Our fellows are empowered to ask bold scientific questions, apply cutting-edge technologies, and develop approaches that have the potential to transform patient care.


Job Description

Internal Job Title: Discovery Postdoctoral Fellow

Position Location: San Diego, CA, onsite

#LI-Onsite

  • This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

  • Please note that relocation support is not available for this position.

  • This is a full-time training position of up to three years in duration.

  • The start date for the 2026 Novartis BR Postdoctoral Fellowship Program cohort is October 1, 2026. Please confirm your availability to meet this date in your cover letter.

Research Opportunity

This role aims to develop a multi-agent AI platform that enables scientists to efficiently access, analyze, and integrate knowledge from diverse biomedical data sources across the drug discovery and development continuum. The system combines specialized AI agents, domain-specific tools, and scientific data repositories to assist subject matter experts in tasks such as biomarker discovery, human genetics interpretation, omics data analysis, literature synthesis, and translational evidence generation. Rather than replacing scientific expertise, the platform is designed to augment decision-making by automating repetitive analytical tasks while maintaining a human-in-the-loop workflow.

This project focuses on operationalizing scientific AI capabilities within a centralized enterprise agent platform. Unlike general-purpose AI applications, biomedical research requires agents to operate across complex, heterogeneous data modalities while adhering to stringent governance and compliance requirements. The project addresses the technical and organizational challenges of integrating specialized AI agents, scientific workflows, and knowledge assets into a secure, interoperable, and scalable framework for drug discovery and development.

The position offers a unique opportunity to conduct impactful research while developing the skills necessary for a successful career in biomedical science.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and integrate scientific AI agents into the enterprise agent platform. Adapt and operationalize domain-specific AI agents, workflows, and knowledge assets to support biomarker discovery, translational research, human genetics, and multi-omics analysis.

  • Drive novel translational medicine use cases. Identify, develop, and evaluate high-impact applications of multi-agent AI systems across translational medicine, leveraging diverse biomedical data sources to address scientific and clinical research questions.

  • Enable adoption of enterprise multi-agent capabilities. Collaborate with platform and engineering teams to integrate scientific agents within existing enterprise frameworks, ensuring interoperability, scalability, and compliance with organizational standards.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders. Partner with scientists, data scientists, engineers, and platform teams to translate research needs into reusable AI-enabled workflows and scientific applications.

  • Establish evaluation and governance frameworks. Develop benchmarks, validation approaches, and best practices to assess scientific utility, reliability, and responsible deployment of AI agents in drug discovery and development.

Essential Requirements

  • PhD (or equivalent doctoral degree) in a relevant scientific discipline completed prior to the fellowship start date. The program is intended for scientists immediately following their PhD training (PhD conferred in 2026 only).

  • Demonstrated record of scientific achievement (publications, presentations, patents, or equivalent)

  • Strong commitment to learning, innovation, and professional development

Desirable Requirements

  • Experience applying artificial intelligence, machine learning, computational biology, or data science methods to biomedical research, with demonstrated interest in translational medicine, drug discovery, or related domains.

  • Familiarity with complex biomedical data modalities (e.g., human genetics, multi-omics, clinical trial data, or biomedical literature) and an interest in developing AI-driven solutions within regulated research environments.

Why Join the Program?

The Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program is designed to develop the next generation of scientific leaders and power the future of medicine through rigorous research and immersive learning experiences, including the implementation of AI tools in biomedical research.

Postdoctoral Research Fellows benefit from:

  • Mentorship from accomplished scientific leaders and subject matter experts.

  • Access to advanced technologies, platforms, and research capabilities.

  • Collaboration across disciplines and organizational boundaries.

  • Participation in a global and diverse postdoctoral community.

  • Dedicated learning and development programming designed to support long-term career growth.

  • Personalized experiential learning opportunities through the Postdoc Practicum.

  • Opportunities to publish research, present at leading scientific conferences, and build an international scientific network.

  • Exposure to emerging technologies and artificial intelligence applications that are shaping the future of biomedical research.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and cover letter by August 21, 2026.

In your cover letter, please describe your research interests, career aspirations, and how participation in the Novartis Biomedical Research Postdoctoral Fellowship Program will support your long-term development.

Compensation & Benefits

The starting salary for this position is 87,000 USD per year (this is for Job Post US only).
US-based employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package including health, life, and disability coverage, a 401(k) plan with company contribution, and a generous time-off package.

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. (this is for US Job Post only)

Please note that relocation support is not available for this position.

The start date for the 2026 Novartis BR Postdoctoral Fellowship Program cohort is October 1, 2026. Please confirm your availability to meet this date in your cover letter.

Cross-functional Partnership

  • Drive accountability across stakeholders by tracking operational deliverables, risks, dependencies, and action items through completion.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with American Express risk and governance frameworks or similar enterprise control environments.
  • Experience working with Jira, Confluence, GitHub, and knowledge management platforms.

  • Working knowledge of SQL, CRMA or similar reporting and analytics tools.

Leadership Competencies

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • Ability to influence cross-functional partners in a highly matrixed organization.
  • Strong risk awareness and commitment to operational excellence.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical capabilities.
  • Customer-first thinking with a focus on delivering high-quality product experiences.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Continuous improvement mindset with a passion for simplifying processes and reducing operational risk.

Why Join American Express?

As a Senior Associate in Product Operations, you will play a critical role in ensuring our products are delivered with the operational excellence, governance, and customer focus that define the American Express brand. You'll have the opportunity to influence enterprise-scale product operations, strengthen risk and compliance practices, and help teams deliver innovative solutions with confidence and control.

title: Säljare inom Information Management till Citedo
description:
Tjänstebeskrivning & erbjudande

Citedo är en ledande IT-tjänsteleverantör som gör IT-lösningar, informationshantering, mötesteknik och utskriftslösningar enklare, effektivare och säkrare. Med över 70 engagerade medarbetare och lokal närvaro på flera orter bygger Citedo långsiktiga relationer och siktar på att bli Sveriges bästa IT-tjänsteleverantör. Vi söker nu en driven och affärsinriktad säljare med erfarenhet av Information Management, ECM och DMS lösningar eller annan mjukvaruförsäljning inom B2B. Vi erbjuder • En nyckelroll i ett växande affärsområde • Attraktiv ersättningsmodell • En organisation med möjlighet att växa Som säljare inom Information Management ansvarar du för att identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter och befintliga kunder genom att bygga långsiktiga kundrelationer och driva hela säljprocessen från prospektering till avslut. Du arbetar med moderna informations- och dokumenthanteringslösningar som skapar tydligt affärsvärde för våra kunder. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter • Aktiv nykundsbearbetning och prospektering • Förvalta och utveckla befintliga kunder • Försäljning av lösningar som hjälper företag att effektivisera och automatisera sin dokument- och informationshantering. • Genomföra kundmöten, behovsanalyser och presentationer • Driva och följa upp affärer genom hela säljcykeln • Samarbete med tekniska specialister Som säljare inom Information Management hos Citedo får du möjlighet att arbeta nära företag och organisationer för att förstå deras informationsflöden och affärsprocesser. Du hjälper kunder att effektivisera sin verksamhet genom moderna ECM- och DMS-lösningar, samtidigt som du får en inblick i hur organisationer arbetar med IT, utskriftslösningar och konferensteknik. Du erbjuds en stabil fast lön i kombination med en attraktiv provisionsmodell samt möjlighet till en hybrid arbetsplats som ger flexibilitet och balans mellan arbete och privatliv.

Personprofil

Vi söker dig som har dokumenterad erfarenhet av B2B-försäljning och som trivs i en roll där du får driva affärer, bygga relationer och skapa affärsvärde för dina kunder. Du har tidigare arbetat med försäljning inom ECM/DMS, Information Management eller närliggande mjukvarulösningar och har en god förståelse för hur kunders affärsprocesser fungerar. Har du dessutom erfarenhet av försäljning av fakturahanteringslösningar ser vi det som meriterande. Som person är du självgående och trivs med att ta ansvar för hela säljprocessen – från att identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter till att driva affären i mål. Du arbetar strukturerat, är resultatorienterad och motiveras av att nå uppsatta mål. Samtidigt är du en stark relationsbyggare med ett tydligt affärsmässigt driv och en förmåga att skapa förtroende hos både nya och befintliga kunder. Du har även förmågan att arbeta både strategiskt och operativt, där du kan växla mellan att planera och utveckla affärer på längre sikt och att arbeta aktivt i det dagliga säljarbetet. Rollen passar dig som vill kombinera affärsutveckling, kunddialog och försäljning i en dynamisk och framåtlutad miljö. Vi värderar dina egenskaper högt och ser gärna att du har en bakgrund inom idrott- och föreningslivet. Berätta vilken aktivitet du utövat, på vilket sätt det har format dig som person samt hur du tror att detta påverkar dig i din yrkesroll.

Övrigt

Plats: Stockholm Omfattning: heltid och tillsvidare Start: enligt överenskommelse Körkort är ett krav. PerformIQ – rekrytering av personal med egenskaper från idrott/föreningsliv, är vår samarbetspartner och vi hänvisar eventuella frågor om tjänsten till Rekryteringskonsult Mattias Söderberg på telefonnummer 072-157 27 76 eller mattias.soderberg@performiq.se Skicka in din ansökan redan idag då intervjuer sker löpande. Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Välkommen in med din ansökan!

title: Videographer and Photographer (Maternity Cover)
description:
About GESS
As one of the leading international schools in Singapore, GESS is home to students from over 70 nations worldwide. We are for many families the home away from home and we are very happy that they are part of our school community which is based on mutual support and solidarity. With our language programme, we support our students to nurture this part of their identity and want to preserve the opportunity that they can grow up with multiple languages to be best prepared for an international environment. With the German International Abitur or the IB Programme they are perfectly prepared for their career after school. Our students enjoy lifelong learning and we take pride in our GESS values of respect, openness and diversity which our students will nurture in their life after school.

We were awarded with the “Deutsche Schulpreis” (German school prize) 2022, which was given to us for our extraordinary concept according to their motto “Make teaching better”. We stand out as the only German school abroad nominated for this award.

We are seeking a skilled and creative Videographer/Photographer to join our team on a maternity cover basis.

As a Videographer/Photographer, you will be responsible for creating high-quality and engaging visual content to document school activities, events, and support our marketing and communications initiatives. Your role will involve planning, filming, photographing, and editing content to ensure it effectively captures and conveys the school’s activities and stories.

Please note that this is a temporary maternity cover position and may require occasional overtime depending on school events and operational needs. Any overtime worked will be compensated in accordance with the school’s applicable policies.

Key Accountabilities

  • Review and fulfil video and photo requests submitted through the Request Portal, ensuring accuracy and client satisfaction.
  • Plan and execute video and photo shoots for marketing and documenting purposes, from pre-planning stages, filming to post-production.
  • Capture videos and photos during school events, including performances, recitals, annual events, assemblies, exhibitions, and other relevant occasions.
  • Set up and manage a photobooth during selected school events, ensuring high-quality and engaging photos for the school community.
  • Work with Student Media Makers, mentoring, training and guiding them in videography and photography techniques, and liaising with them to support their content creation efforts.
  • Adhere to visual brand guidelines to maintain consistency in our visual image.
  • Assist in organizing and adding to design database and video/ photo repository.
  • Actively contribute ideas and suggestions to enhance the professionalism and visual appeal of the school's visual image.
  • Assist in streamlining the request form process when necessary.
  • Participate in meetings with requestors to gather requirements and ensure alignment.
  • Participate in meetings within External Communications, Marketing, and Admissions Department to discuss strategies, campaigns, and projects.

    • Knowledge and Experience

  • Strong understanding of video production techniques, lighting, and composition.
  • Ability to conceptualize video shoots based on the target audience and intended message.
  • Proficiency in video editing software to create visually compelling and engaging videos.
  • Familiarity with cameras, stage recording, lenses, and memory cards.
  • Experience with drone photography/videography would be a bonus.
  • Fundamental understanding of creating video visuals to enhance video editing.

    • Technical and Soft Skills

  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Premiere Pro and After Effects. (Bonus: Audition)
  • Proficiency in working with MacOS workstations.
  • Proficiency in operating, maintaining, and setting up photography, video, audio, and lighting equipment.
  • Results-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality work.
  • Time-conscious with the ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Creative thinker with a passion for visual storytelling.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, capable of working with different communication styles.
  • Ability to mentor and support Student Media Makers in developing photography and videography skills
  • Willingness to learn, collaborate, and contribute as a team player.
    • Fair Recruitment and Safeguarding: We are committed to fair recruitment practices and safeguarding the welfare of all students. We ensure that our hiring processes are free from discrimination and bias on the basis of age, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy status, caregiving responsibilities, race, religion, language or disability. As part of our commitment to safeguarding, we conduct thorough background checks on all candidates which include criminal background checks in all countries lived and worked in for the last ten years, as well as reference checks. Any offer is subject to the satisfactory completion of such checks. Our school prioritises the safety and well-being of our students, and we expect all staff members to uphold these values.

title: Mobile Senior Lending Manager
description:
What’s the role?

As a Mobile Senior Lending Manager, you’ll help people take one of the biggest steps in their lives—buying a home. You’ll work on the move, meeting customers where it suits them, and guiding them through the home loan process with confidence and care.

This isn’t a desk job. You’ll manage your own schedule, build strong referral networks, and generate new business opportunities. You’ll be the face of Westpac in your community—trusted, knowledgeable, and ready to deliver real value across Regional Victoria.

What do I need?

We’re looking for someone who knows home lending inside and out. You’ll need:

  • Proven experience in home lending, with a strong understanding of the end-to-end process
  • A solid track record in sales or business development
  • Experience building and maintaining referral networks
  • Strong time management and multitasking skills
  • A self-starter attitude with a focus on customer outcomes

Why join us?

We’re obsessed with becoming our customers' #1 banking partner for life and we’re looking for people who are passionate about helping us achieve that goal. In return, we’re committed to making Westpac the best place to work in the country. Here are just a few of the ways we’re already doing that:

  • Special offers on banking products and discounts from top brands, including generous employee-only mortgage rates!
  • Flexible work arrangements to help you achieve a greater work/life balance, and a variety of leave options including Culture, Lifestyle and Wellbeing leave.
  • Tailored learning and development opportunities to help your grow your career within the bank.
  • Lots of opportunities to ‘give back’ to the Community by getting involved in our many volunteering initiatives.

Create your future today

To get started, simply click on the APPLY or APPLY NOW button

We’re all about creating a supportive and inclusive community. We welcome everyone – no matter your age, gender, background, or abilities. We also provide additional support to welcome our veterans, Indigenous Australians and neurodiverse community.

If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, you can find more information and contact details on our FAQs and how to contact us page, under the ‘Diversity, sustainability and flexibility’ section.

title: Principal Cloud Architect - Federal Government
description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What you’ll be doing...

As a Principal Cloud Architect, you will lead the design, implementation, assessment, optimization, and consultation of our hybrid multi-cloud environment supporting business-critical infrastructure for Government clients. In this role, you will drive complex cloud migrations, embed robust security controls, and champion a culture of operational and technical excellence.

Responsibilities:

  • Leading the design and architectural strategy for enterprise-level hybrid multi-cloud (AWS and Azure) environments to ensure high availability, fault tolerance, scalability, and robust security.

  • Spearheading the migration of legacy applications and guiding greenfield deployments, leveraging experience with legacy networking and security infrastructure to ensure seamless, secure transitions.

  • Leading cloud integration with existing on-premises infrastructure, including networking, identity, security, monitoring, and operational processes.

  • Championing automation by designing, provisioning, and maintaining Infrastructure as Code (IaC) blueprints using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, and Puppet.

  • Building, managing, and improving CI/CD pipelines using GitLab and AWS CodePipeline to support infrastructure and application deployment.

  • Embedding security best practices into cloud architectures in alignment with the ACSC Cloud Security Framework, Information Security Manual (ISM), and Australian regulatory frameworks.

  • Monitoring cloud usage and driving cloud cost optimization, performing capacity planning, and architecting cost-effective solutions across AWS and Azure.

What we’re looking for…

You enjoy solving tough technical problems and building solutions that deliver real results. You are a skilled architect with deep AWS expertise, solid Azure skills, and proven experience bridging cloud platforms with existing on-prem infrastructure.

You’ll need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.

  • Ten or more years of relevant work experience in IT.

  • Six or more years as a Cloud Architect for enterprise-scale environments supporting Federal Government projects and programs.

  • Experience moving complex workloads from legacy data centres to AWS and Azure.

  • Experience with VPC, EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, and related services.

  • Practical experience with Git workflows, CI/CD pipelines (GitLab/AWS CodePipeline), and scripting (Python, Bash, or PowerShell).

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect certifications – Associate or Professional.

  • Active NV1 Security clearance (or above) required on day one.

Even better if you have:

  • Degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.

  • Deep understanding of Australian security policies (PSPF, ISM, Essential 8).

  • Strong background in cloud networking (Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, VPNs, Transit Gateways).

  • Hands-on experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/EKS, AKS).

  • Working knowledge of core Azure services (VNet, Azure SQL, Entra ID, Azure Monitor).

  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for government leaders.

  • Passion for mentoring junior engineers and creating operational runbooks.

​If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Acknowledgement of Country...

Verizon acknowledges the Traditional Owners of Country throughout Australia and their continuing connection to lands, waters, and communities and pays respect to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Elders, past and present.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

38

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

 Oplysning om indsamling af dine personoplysninger:

Ved udfyldelse af spørgeskemaet indhentes oplysninger om dit navn, e-mail, køn, CV og ansøgning.


Vi behandler de personoplysninger, du har afgivet i dette spørgeskema. Derefter indhenter og behandler vi eventuelt yderligere oplysninger om dine arbejdsevner fra referencer og sociale medier med henblik på en vurdering af dine kompetencer og erfaringer i relation til den pågældende stilling. På grundlag af alle disse oplysninger udarbejder vi en profil, som vi registrerer og opbevarer i en periode på 6 måneder.


Formålet med ovennævnte behandling af dine personoplysninger er en vurdering af dine kompetencer i forhold til det konkrete opslag hos virksomheden/organisationen, du har søgt ansættelse hos, samt i forhold til fremtidige stillinger.


Dine oplysninger i dette spørgeskema kan blive omfattet af en automatisk afgørelse, herunder profilering. Logikken bag denne afgørelse er brug af saglige kriterier, som gør det muligt at finde frem til de registrerede, som har de kompetencer, som søges til den pågældende stilling.


Som led i vurderingen kan dine dokumenter (fx CV og ansøgning) blive analyseret ved hjælp af kunstig intelligens (AI) med det formål at generere indsigter til brug for vurderingen. AI-analysen anvendes som støtte og træffer ikke selvstændige afgørelser - den endelige vurdering foretages altid med menneskelig involvering. Behandlingen kan indebære overførsel af dine oplysninger til tredjelande uden for EU/EØS, som sker på grundlag af EU-Kommissionens standardkontraktsbestemmelser (SCC) og/eller EU-US Data Privacy Framework. Du kan få oplyst det nærmere overførselsgrundlag ved henvendelse til den dataansvarlige.


Behandlingen af dine personoplysninger er baseret på dit samtykke.


Dit samtykke til de ovennævnte behandlinger af dine oplysninger kan til enhver tid tilbagekaldes med det resultat, at registreringen af oplysningerne slettes. Tilbagekaldelse kan ske ved henvendelse til den dataansvarlige.


Dine personoplysninger vil blive opbevaret i en periode på 6 måneder og derefter slettet.


Det er frivilligt at besvare de stillede spørgsmål, men undlader du at besvare spørgsmålene, bevirker det, at den dataansvarlige ikke vil være i stand til at vurdere din kompetence på den forudsatte måde.


AnnullerAccepter






Ansøg

Vil du være med til at styrke informationssikkerheden i en bank, hvor IT-sikkerhed, governance og operationel robusthed er en vigtig del af hverdagen?

Fynske Bank søger en IT-sikkerhedskonsulent, der kan være med til at omsætte krav, politikker og kontroller til konkrete processer og aktiviteter i organisationen. Du bliver en del af IT-Service som består af tre engagerede kolleger, mens den samlede IT-afdeling også omfatter fire kolleger i Data & Digitalisering. Sammen har vi ansvaret for at understøtte bankens drift, sikkerhed, udvikling og digitale transformation.

Som IT-sikkerhedskonsulent får du en central rolle i arbejdet med IT-sikkerhed, risikostyring, beredskab, awareness og løbende kontroller. Rollen er ikke en klassisk teknisk cybersikkerhedsrolle. Du skal i stedet være med til at sikre, at regulatoriske krav, beslutninger og sikkerhedstiltag bliver gjort operationelle i banken. Som finansielt pengeinstitut er Fynske Bank underlagt DORA, og du vil derfor arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem governance, compliance og praktisk implementering. 

Du får derfor en bred kontaktflade på tværs af banken og bliver en vigtig sparringspartner i arbejdet med at omsætte regulatoriske krav, politikker og beslutninger til konkrete handlinger. Du kommer til at samarbejde tæt med kolleger, ledere, leverandører og eksterne samarbejdspartnere for at sikre, at informationssikkerhed bliver en naturlig og integreret del af den måde, vi arbejder på.

Vi lægger vægt på et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, videndeling og en uformel omgangstone, hvor der er kort vej fra idé til handling.
