title: Underwriting Quality Auditor
description:
Company

Shared Services

Argo and Farm Family are specialty property and casualty insurance brands whose underwriting companies are wholly-owned subsidaries of Clearbrook Holdings Inc. Argo and Farm Family partner with agents and brokers to provide insurance solutions that enable businesses to manage risks with confidence.


Job Description

The Underwriting Quality Auditor independently evaluates underwriting files to assess quality, consistency, accuracy, authority management, appetite alignment, and compliance with company guidelines and regulatory requirements. This role identifies risk and process gaps, documents findings, provides actionable feedback, and partners with underwriting leadership and other stakeholders to support remediation, training, and continuous improvement.

This is a fully onsite position.


Key Responsibilities

  • Independently plan and execute underwriting quality audits across assigned lines of business, products, or review populations.
  • Audit underwriting files to assess quality, accuracy, documentation completeness, authority compliance, appetite alignment, rating execution, and adherence to underwriting guidelines, regulatory requirements, and company policies.
  • Evaluate the severity, impact, and root cause of underwriting errors or process gaps and recommend appropriate remediation actions.
  • Document findings in a clear, concise, and supportable manner and provide constructive feedback and recommendations to underwriters, managers, and business partners.
  • Identify training opportunities, process improvements, and control enhancements to reduce recurring error trends and strengthen underwriting performance.
  • Prepare reports and presentations summarizing audit results, trends, recommendations, and remediation status for management and senior management stakeholders.
  • Partner with underwriting leadership to discuss findings, validate remediation plans, and monitor improvement actions.
  • Maintain awareness of regulatory, market, guideline, appetite, authority, and internal policy changes impacting underwriting standards and audit criteria.
  • Support internal and external audit requests and contribute to the ongoing enhancement of the underwriting Quality Assurance framework.
  • Participate in regular departmental planning meetings and complete other projects as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of underwriting experience with an Excess & Surplus or Property & Casualty insurance carrier.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret underwriting guidelines, authority statements, appetite criteria, documentation requirements, and insurance regulations.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365, including Microsoft Excel and presentation tools.
  • Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills, including a high degree of interpersonal effectiveness, with the ability to discuss findings and influence corrective actions across profit centers.
  • Discipline and self-motivation to manage multiple audits, competing priorities, and deadlines with limited day-to-day supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in quality assurance, claims, compliance, specialty lines, or multiple insurance lines.
  • Working knowledge of underwriting systems, raters, workflows, and quality assurance tools.
  • 4-year degree from an accredited university.

The base salary range provided below is for hires in those geographic areas only and will be commensurate with candidate experience. Pay ranges for candidates in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for an annual bonus based on company and individual performance as well as a generous benefits package.

  • Richmond Pay Range: $75,000 - $107,000
  • Chicago Pay Range: $82,000 - $117,000
  • New York City Pay Range: $89,000 - $120,000

PLEASE NOTE:

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. At this time, we are not able to sponsor or assume sponsorship of employment visas.


If you have a disability under the Americans with Disabilities Act or similar state or local law and you wish to discuss potential reasonable accommodations related to applying for employment with us, please contact our Benefits Department at 210-321-8400.


Benefits and Compensation

We offer a competitive compensation package, performance-based incentives, and a comprehensive benefits program—including health, dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.


Core Values

At Clearbrook our Core Values are Integrity, Collaboration, Pursuit of Excellence and Forward Thinking. These values reflect who we are today and who we apsire to be - guiding how we work, how we lead and how we succeed.

					Vagtcentralmedarbejder søges				

				

				

						

							

			


		

						

				

				

						

					
Brænder du for at gøre en forskel for især svage og ældre medborgere, og kan du bevare overblikket i pressede situationer? Trives du med at arbejde på skæve tider af døgnet? Så er du måske vores nye vagtcentralmedarbejder.


Som vagtcentralmedarbejder har du en nøglerolle i kommunikationen med borgere, kunder og vores operative mandskab. Vi passer på 3.500 ældre og sårbare borgere via deres visiterede nødkald, og det er derfor afgørende, at du er serviceminded og motiveres af at finde den bedste løsning for de mennesker, du er i kontakt med. Vi vægter højt, at du har en positiv tilgang til opgaverne og forståelse og empati for andre mennesker.


Vagtcentralen er døgnbemandet, og du vil indgå i en fast vagtplan med to dagvagter efterfulgt af en nattevagt. Dagvagterne har en længde på mellem 11 og 12 timer, mens en nattevagt varer 13 timer. Imellem vagtrul vil der typisk være fem fridage.


I sommerferien (uge 25-33) arbejdes dog med tre fridage mellem vagterne.


Det er vigtigt, at du trives med skiftende arbejdstider og kan få arbejdslivet til at hænge sammen med privatlivet.


Din arbejdsplads bliver på vores vagtcentral i Kokkedal, hvor vi deler hus med den øvrige administration i brandvæsnet.

Dine opgaver


Modtage og håndtere nødkald fra borgere


Disponere brand-, rednings- og serviceopgaver


Koordinere kommunikation under indsatser


Overvåge og håndtere tekniske alarmer


Formidle borgerhenvendelser til hjemmepleje og drift


Vi forventer, at du


Har overblik og arbejder struktureret


Kan træffe beslutninger under pres


Er stærk i mundtligt og skriftligt dansk


Har solid IT-forståelse


Har erfaring fra beredskab, hjemmepleje, vagtcentral eller lignende


Personligt er du


Empatisk og professionel i mødet med borgere og samarbejdspartnere


En teamplayer


Ansvarsbevidst og fleksibel


Vi tilbyder


En fast stilling i en samfundsvigtig funktion med stort ansvar


Et professionelt og uformelt arbejdsmiljø med engagerede kolleger


Fokus på faglig udvikling og trivsel


Sundhedsordning


Grundig oplæring i systemer og arbejdsgange

Send dit CV sammen med en motiveret ansøgning via Jobindex QuickApply.


Nordsjællands Brandvæsen ønsker at fremme ligestillingen og opfordrer alle kvalificerede til at søge uanset alder, køn, religion, etnisk tilhørsforhold eller handicap.

Som ansat hos Nordsjællands Brandvæsen bliver du en del af en organisation, der bygger på et beredskabsmæssigt fundament. For mange ansatte betyder det, at fuldtidsarbejdet kombineres med jobbet som deltidsbrandmand. Det er ikke et krav, men noget vi ser meget positivt på.

                    Senior Director Analyst, MDM
                    
                

            

        

    


    





    

        
            

                Description


                 
 Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have research, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Senior Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Research and Advisory sector, establishing oneself as a credible voice within their designated market at local, regional and global levels. 
  
 Utilizing exceptional research and analytical skills, a Senior Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative research which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations. 
  
 The successful candidate is a subject matter expert in Master Data Management (MDM) and understands its application across people, processes, and technologies. The candidate will focus on written and customer-facing deliverables to support Data & Analytics Leaders who face the challenges of improving/establishing/reviving MDM initiatives. This role will require in depth knowledge of the MDM Market in addition to a strategic level understanding of the topic. 
  
 What you will need: 
    
  
 Subject matter expertise, with demonstrated knowledge of Master Data Management (MDM) Strategy. 
  
  
  
 Deep understanding of the MDM market including (but not limited to): who the key players are, what core capabilities are required, the evolution of the market. 
  
  
  
 Detailed knowledge of one or more MDM Product(s), hands on experience of implementing an MDM solution is a plus. 
  
  
  
 Bachelor's Degree, Advanced Professional Qualification, or 12+ years direct experience in a field related to Data and Analytics. 
  
      
  
 Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders 
  
  
  
 Strong organizational skills, ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables 
  
  
  
 Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability 
  
  
  
 Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions 
  
  
  
 Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges 
  
  
  
 Strong communicator who can explain complex concepts concisely and simply 
  
  
  
 Subject matter expert comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements 
  
  
  
 Strong business and financial acumen 
  
  
  
 Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market 
  
  
  
 Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team 
  
      
  
 Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments 
  
      
  
 Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels 
  
  
  
 Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable) 
  
    
 What you will do: 
    
  
 Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have research" content 
  
  
  
 Develop new research and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act 
  
      
  
 Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward 
  
  
  
 Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing research positions across a team of analysts 
  
  
  
 Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda 
  
      
  
 Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights 
  
      
  
 Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions 
  
      
  
 Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings 
  
      
  
 Support Research and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help research teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business 
  
  
  
 Provide high quality and timely research content peer review 
  
  
  
 Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner research, methodology and strategy 
  
  
  
 Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the research community 
  
  
  
 Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and Research & Advisory provide excellent service delivery 
  
  
  
 Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members

title: Mechanical Inspector
description:
Think bigger scale. Think higher profile. Think ground-breaking. Join WSP, and you’ll be at the heart of a team of international experts all dedicated to growing and sharing their expertise, and working on projects that transform society for all of us.

WSP is currently searching for an accomplished and experienced professional to join our team as a Mechanical Inspector.

  • Assist in the design and development of mechanical systems, components, and products using CAD software and engineering principles.
  • Conduct analysis and simulation studies to evaluate the performance, reliability, and safety of mechanical designs.Participate in prototyping and testing activities to validate designs and identify areas for improvement.
  • Prepare technical documentation, reports, and presentations to communicate design concepts, analysis results, and project updates.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineers from other disciplines, to integrate mechanical systems with electrical, software, and other components.

  • Proficiency in interpreting engineering drawings, schematics, and technical documents.
  • Experience using inspection tools, equipment, and testing instruments.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

title: Rekryterare/konsultchef till Inpeople i Växjö
description:
Dina arbetsuppgifter

Sedan 2010 har vi hjälpt företag att hitta, attrahera och utveckla rätt kompetens. Idag samarbetar vi med cirka 150 företag, har omkring 250 medarbetare i koncernen och fortsätter att utveckla vårt erbjudande inom rekrytering, bemanning och HR-tjänster. Hos oss får du en roll med stort eget ansvar och du är med och tar ut riktningen för framtiden. Du blir en viktig del av ett bolag där beslutsvägarna är korta, dina idéer är viktiga och din insats märks. Både i teamet, hos kunderna och i affären. Du får arbeta nära kunder och kandidater i en verksamhet där kvalitet, relationer och resultat går hand i hand. Vi är engagerade, prestigelösa och vi hjälps åt eftersom vi har höga krav på leverans till våra kunder, kandidater och konsulter och de förtjänar det bästa. Hos oss får du ett sammanhang där hjärta, passion och ansvar inte bara är ord, utan något vi levererar varje dag. Inom vad man kan kalla People Management arbetar du med alla delar i HR cykeln som att ta fram kravprofiler, annonsera, göra urval, göra intervjuer, använda analysverktyg, referenstagning, anställa, utveckla, avveckla. Du arbetar både som rekryterare och personalansvarig. Inom vad man kan kalla Business management är du till exempel med och utvecklar framtidens lösningar med våra kunder och prospekts. Du gör kundbesök och sätter dig in i kundens verksamhet, lämnar offerter, presenterar bolaget och du är med på olika event mm. Hos oss är HR lagsport. Du måste gilla att spela i ett lag och att du tar stort ansvar för laget och din egen prestation. I laget arbetar du nära kunder, kandidater och konsulter. Du blir en viktig partner för företag som behöver hitta, attrahera och behålla rätt kompetens – och du driver processer framåt med struktur, kvalitet och affärsfokus. Ena dagen hjälper du en kund att ringa in ett affärskritiskt kompetensbehov. Nästa driver du en rekryteringsprocess, intervjuar kandidater eller följer upp en konsult hos kund. Däremellan utvecklar du befintliga kundrelationer och fångar nya affärsmöjligheter. Du arbetar mitt i livet, med människor och affär. Det handlar om relationer – men också om leverans, lönsamhet, kvalitet och förmågan att skapa långsiktigt kundvärde.

Din profil

Vi söker dig som tycker om människor och drivs av att skapa resultat tillsammans med andra. Du bygger förtroende, tar ansvar för det du lovar och trivs i mötet mellan människor och affär. Du är nyfiken, prestigelös och har förmågan att se både kundens behov och affärens möjligheter. Samtidigt är du en lagspelare som gärna bidrar till att både kollegor, kandidater och kunder lyckas. Samlar vi ihop viktiga nyckelkvaliteter hos den vi söker är det: - Relationsskapande - Ansvarstagande - Affärsmässig - Lagorienterad Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av att leda människor, team eller verksamheter och känner dig trygg i att ta ansvar, fatta beslut och driva arbete framåt. Du har en bakgrund inom HR eller försäljning och har flera års arbetslivserfarenhet med goda resultat. Du har förmodligen en examen från PA eller ekonomi på universitetsnivå. Eller kanske inte. Du kan tala och skriva svenska och engelska obehindrat. Du har också god systemvana och lätt för att sätta dig in i nya digitala verktyg och arbetssätt. Du har dessutom körkort. Tjänsten är på heltid med placering på Inpeoples kontor i Växjö.

Vem tror vi att du är?

Känner du att detta skulle kunna vara du? Ta kontakt med oss för ett förutsättningslöst samtal, eller sök jobbet direkt. Tjänsten är tänkt att starta omgående eller enligt överenskommelse. Vi arbetar med löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag, så vänta inte för länge med att höra av dig. Jag heter Anna Sjödahl och är VD på Inpeople, ring mig på 072-3536993 om du undrar något eller bara vill prata lite konfidentiellt.

Om oss

Sedan 2010 har vi som finns inom koncernen Ingroup HRM, dvs Inpeople och Head Consulting, hjälpt smarta företag med olika delar inom personal. Vi driver hr-branschen framåt med ett modernt, professionellt och inkluderande synsätt. Hos oss är HR en lagsport och våra värderingar hjärta, passion och ansvar bestämmer vilka aktiviteter vi gör och vår metodik. Våra mest sålda produkter är rekrytering, personaluthyrning och utbildning men vi har många fler artiklar och vi utvecklar vårt erbjudande inom HRM varje dag. Vår nisch är hög kvalitet och bolag som uppskattar hög kvalitet är gärna kunder till oss. Just nu har vi kontor i Växjö och Ljungby men vi kommer sannolikt att expandera med fler kontor under 2027. Ingroup HRM samarbetar idag med ca 150 bolag, har ca 250 anställda. Omsättningen de senaste åren är ca 70–100 MSEK.

title: MarTech Solutions Architect
description:
MarTech Solutions Architect

Team: Marketing Services

Location: London

Commitment: Full-Time Permanent

Workplace Type: remote

ABOUT APPLY
APPLY is the Agentic Customer Experience (ACx) partner for the world's most ambitious consumer and entertainment brands. We bring together deep domain expertise across Retail, CPG, Sports, and Media with AI-native delivery capability, designing and delivering agentic solutions that turn CX vision into commercial reality. We are the partner of choice for brands like Arc'teryx, NFL, Lululemon, and Kraft Heinz. For more information, visit applydigital.com.

About Us: Apply Digital’s Marketing Services division is a rapidly expanding full-service Martech team with team members in the US, Europe, LATAM, and Asia. As a personalization agency, we bridge the gap between creative, marketing, and strategy. We specialize in cross-channel content strategy, creation, and distribution (email, paid social, push, SMS), and MarTech implementations. We work with 50+ clients, ranging in size from companies like YETI, Upside, and Nutrafol to established marquee brands like A+E Networks, Afterpay, and Stanley Black & Decker.
The Role: We are looking to bring on a full-time Solutions Architect with a particular strength in integrating Customer Data Platforms and marketing automation tools. The ideal candidate is someone who is wholly invested in a full-time career in MarTech, AdTech, and product, and wants to grow with our company.
The candidate has the opportunity to provide expert consultation across a wide variety of clients, directly influencing the technical outcome of their tech stack.
LOCATION: Apply Digital is hybrid/remote friendly. The preferred candidate should be based in Canada, working in hours that align to ET (Eastern Timezone) or PT or in Spain, working in hours that overlap with ET (Eastern Timezone) or PT (Pacific Timezone).

Responsibilities:

  • Guiding an implementation for a CDP (such as Hightouch or Segment) and/or Marketing Automation system (such as Braze or Iterable) from beginning to end, leading the documentation and planning process, all the way through writing requirements for the implementation of the actual code.
  • Recognize opportunities and solutions to key business challenges through technology, recommending additional tools and providing guidance on getting more value out of current tools, along with designing entire Martech stacks from scratch.
  • Provide specifications and requirements for the internal technical team, working with the technical project manager and engineers to ensure a successful outcome.
  • Leading implementation projects and consistently communicating on project deliverables with clients.
  • Acting as an SME (Subject Matter Expert) on certain sales presentations and standup meetings with clients, with the ability to speak confidently about their deliverables, ideas, and best practices.
  • Marketing analytics and reporting support as needed. Understanding user journeys, marketing automation, and customer data.
  • Understand multi/omnichannel transactional and marketing messaging.
  • A good understanding of user states, events, and user journey mapping.

Examples of projects this role would lead include:

  • Multi-tool MarTech implementations, including CDP and Marketing Automation Platforms according to business use cases and prioritization alongside business strategists.
  • Assisting in the creation of new marketing programs by translating technical requirements into the required code for various data sources, and how they would flow down into each destination.
  • Marketing automation migrations, including ensuring proper data schemas to maintain parity for clients’ existing lifecycle programs, optimizing for new use cases, and enabling clients with new tool features.
  • Optimizing clients’ existing lifecycle programs by improving data accuracy, identifying schema improvements, or identifying other efficiencies to drive greater personalized messaging.

The ideal candidate:

  • Experience determining cross-platform technical requirements for tools across the MarTech stack.
  • Has platform experience designing and implementing solutions within Segment, Rudderstack, mParticle, Tealium, or similar CDPs.
  • Has technical experience configuring automated campaigns and journeys within Lifecycle marketing tools such as Braze, Iterable, Klaviyo, customer.io, or similar platforms.
  • Has experience with other tools across the MarTech stack, including analytics, enrichment, and attribution.
  • Understands multi/omnichannel transactional and marketing messaging.
  • Understands marketing attribution and can audit platform integrations and attribution data.
  • Proficient with JSON or SQL/data modeling best practices.
  • Experience in data activation using reverse ETL tools like Hightouch or Census.
  • Proficient with scripting languages and lambda functions.
  • Has the ability to clearly articulate/present technical topics to a non-technical audience.
  • Has superior written skills, epic organization, email etiquette, and communication skills.
  • Is a people person. Has a good attitude, friendly, and thrives in a team environment.
  • Has excellent attention to detail, with the ability to read through emails and documents, and fully take in all information and break it down into tasks.
  • Is a self-starter and motivated.
  • Platform experience with Shopify or Magento.
LIFE AT APPLY
People are at the core of everything we do at APPLY. We provide you with modern tools, systems and approaches, value your time, safety, and health, and strive to build a work community where you can thrive and grow. Here are a few benefits we offer to support you:
Agentic Delivery: Our people work in a modern way to deliver client outcomes. Broaden your skills on a range of engagements with international brands that have a global impact.
An inclusive and safe environment: We’re truly committed to building a culture where you are celebrated and everyone feels welcome and safe.
AI & Strategic Upskilling: Accelerate your professional growth with generous training budgets and mentorship, with a specific focus on Agentic AI expertise and the critical human skills required for the future of work.
Generous vacation policy: Work-life balance is key to our team’s success, so we offer ample time away from work to promote overall well-being.
Customizable benefits: Tailor your extended health and dental plan to your needs, priorities, and preferences.
Flexible work arrangements: We work in a variety of ways, from remote, to in-office, to a blend of both.
APPLY is a safe, respectful, and inclusive community where differences are celebrated. We are committed to equal opportunity and fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. Learn more in our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) section. For recruitment accommodations, please email careers@applydigital.com.

We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

The Effectors Center within the Systems Engineering and Test Capabilities (SE&TC) organization is currently hiring a Senior Principal Systems Engineer to serve as the Coyote CUAS Lead Systems Engineer (LSE) to join our Tucson, AZ location on the Coyote programs. The Coyote CUAS programs have several contracts with both Army and Navy customers with ongoing development, production and sustainment. SE&TC is an exciting and challenging environment where you will have the opportunity to design, develop and partner with multi-disciplines to shape innovative solutions for our customers.

The LSE is responsible for technical guidance and mentorship of multi-disciplined engineering teams. The LSE is also one of the senior technical interfaces with internal and external customers, industry partners, contractors, suppliers, and other stakeholders. The Coyote CUAS LSE is responsible for supporting the Chief Engineer (CE) in helping define and maintain the appropriate level of technical rigor and coordination across functions and engineering disciplines across the various production and sustainment efforts within the program. The candidate will also need prior multidiscipline engineering knowledge and experience, as well as production experience. The LSE is expected to mentor engineers both technically and with their career.

The primary focus of this LSE position will be to drive system analysis, requirements development, design, system performance, integration, test and qualification along with providing a direct engineering interface for production. The LSE will be expected to directly interface with the customer from the United States Government (USG) and partner with contractual requirements such as achieving DD250.

What You Will Do

  • Protect the system technical integrity to ensure we deliver a product that meets the customers’ and warfighters’ needs while working through challenges to accelerate

  • Coordinate efforts across multiple disciplines and program efforts, to include coordination with other Raytheon products and external customer entities

Provide guidance to multiple teams of multi-disciplined engineers in support of product production.

  • Interact and coordinate with program stakeholders, including program customers, government organizations, industry partners, contractors, suppliers, and other stakeholders to influence and guide program production efforts.

  • Rapidly assimilate and apply knowledge in varied and disparate technical fields to achieve balanced system performance.

  • Accurately interpret internal and external customer requirements and objectives, effectively decomposing such into actionable direction to the program team and stakeholders.

  • Experience across the product lifecycle, including concept development, architecture, design, integration, verification, qualification and production

  • Experience with test/support equipment

  • Ability to develop effective internal and external customer/stakeholder relationships to ensure customer/stakeholder satisfaction and continued business

  • Experience with Engineering Risk and Opportunity (R&O) and FRACAS Management

What We Offer

  • Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

title: Participatiecoach op AZC Wageningen
description:
Wat draag je bij?


Als participatiecoach maak jij het verschil. Jij begeleidt mensen op weg naar deelname aan de samenleving, in de stad. Dit doe je door samen te onderzoeken wat de mogelijkheden zijn. Dit kan bijvoorbeeld zijn; hulp bij het vinden van vrijwilligerswerk, een activiteit in de stad of voorbereiden voor een opleiding. Het kan ook zijn dat je samen met een client een nieuwe activiteit gaat opzetten. Zo geef jij iemand weer een toekomst én vertrouwen!

Wat ga je doen?

  • Samen met de vluchteling breng je diens ervaring en opleiding in kaart of ontdekt waar talenten, kwaliteiten en wensen liggen.

  • Je begeleidt, ondersteunt en coacht cliënten oa bij het vinden en behouden van vrijwilligerswerk of een (voor)opleiding.

  • Je legt cliënten de geschreven en ongeschreven regels van de Nederlandse samenleving uit.

  • Je hebt geduld (kleine stapjes) en bent in staat om te investeren in een vertrouwensrelatie

  • Je werkt allereerst op 1 van de twee AZC’s : Bosrandweg of Keyenbergseweg.

  • Je monitort en begeleidt cliënten bij de afgesproken vervolgstappen voor tot 6 maanden.

Wie ben jij?

  • Beschikbaarheid: voorlopig op maandagmiddag of woensdagmiddag (ten tijde loket Meedoenbalie). Daarnaast een tweede dagdeel.

  • De intentie om je voor minimaal 6-12 maanden te verbinden aan deze rol.

  • Je kunt goed luisteren en durft ook door te vragen.

  • Vermogen om creatief te communiceren, denk aan non-verbaal, vertaal apps, tekenen, simpel en langzaam spreken. Onze cliënten zijn bezig met het leren van het Nederlands. Soms spreken de cliënten Engels. Velen spreken arabisch.

  • Het volgen van onze basiscursus en een aantal trainingen binnen VWN.

  • Goed Nederlands spreken.

  • Kennis van basis werknemersvaardigheden.

  • Zelfstandig kunnen werken.

  • Creatief en in oplossingen en kansen kunnen denken.

  • Inlevingsvermogen, geduld, overtuigingskracht.

  • Samenwerken met collega arbeidscoaches en vrijwillige tolken

  • Planmatig werken richting doel van het traject en bereid om maatwerk te leveren en mogelijkheden in Wageningen te onderzoeken.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een uitdagende omgeving, met collega’s en een stad die bereid is om plek te bieden aan asielzoekers: oa bij partnerorganisaties, wijkcentra en ontmoetingsplekken.

  • De kans om iets te kunnen betekenen voor anderen.

  • Fijne contacten en gezelligheid in een divers team.

  • Volop mogelijkheden om te leren over andere achtergronden en culturen.

  • Ruimte voor eigen ontwikkeling en initiatief.

  • Ondersteuning van een beroepskracht (teamleider).

  • Een inwerkprogramma en samenwerking met de Meedoenbalie op het AZC.

  • Mogelijkheden om e-learnings, trainingen en cursussen te volgen bij de VluchtelingenWerk Academie.

Heb je interesse?

Laat dan hier je gegevens achter en wij nemen zo snel mogelijk contact met je op.

The Segment Leader gathers customer feedback and provides input on product and solution definitions and requirements. They also work closely with commercial and product marketing teams, as well as global and international strategic marketing, to lead the deployment of innovative modality strategies.

As a member of the Japan Ultrasound leadership team, the Segment Leader defines appropriate channels (direct, indirect, digital), regional go-to-market strategies, and key commercial enhancement programs. They manage quarterly and annual forecasts for market/orders/sales/profit, set annual targets, and ensure achievement against those goals.

Key Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

  • Possess deep product knowledge.
  • Lead and foster GE HealthCare’s values of integrity and teamwork.
  • Manage the domestic sales team: recruit, train, and develop talent to maximize effectiveness. Promote cross-segment collaboration to enhance commercial strength and growth opportunities.
  • Collaborate with product and marketing managers to develop growth strategies for equipment and service businesses.
  • Ensure optimal sales coverage in each region, review and improve performance of regional sales managers and teams.
  • Work closely with global and international product managers to drive product releases that support customer satisfaction, international market opportunities, and growth potential.
  • As part of Japan’s senior leadership team, ensure seamless teamwork with equipment/service operations and other channels to deliver customer satisfaction. Promote cross-modality collaboration to maximize product synergies and P&L sales.
  • Deploy resources to achieve financial and operational goals such as orders, revenue, contribution margin, and cost control.
  • Proactively identify customer needs and develop/implement tailored solutions.
  • Ensure all direct reports have approved annual goals and objectives, and receive performance evaluations based on them.
  • Maintain deep knowledge and understanding of modality market trends and requirements.
  • Interpret internal and external business challenges and recommend best practices to improve products, processes, or services. Leverage industry trends in decision-making.
  • Identify unmet needs and lead portfolio management. Collaborate cross-functionally to identify and evaluate the value of new commercial concepts and technologies.
  • Participate in or lead the development of modality growth playbooks and marketing blueprints.
  • Align cross-business marketing resources with modality priorities to deliver unified messaging and comprehensive value propositions to customers.
  • Lead market research and analysis.
  • Provide input on pricing strategies for existing and new products.
  • Support strategy development for modality markets:
  • Define strategies for growth (sales and profitability).

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in commercial or product management roles.
  • Strong business acumen and experience in product domains.
  • Experience collaborating with internal teams and external customers in solution-based sales processes.
  • Ability to solve complex problems within functional or specialized areas.
  • Strong communication skills to simplify and convey complex issues.
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly within Japan.
  • Business-level proficiency in English and Japanese.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proven track record of thought leadership and clear strategic thinking.
  • Experience managing professional sales managers.
  • Experience working in a matrix environment within a large corporation.
  • Ability to energize, develop, and build rapport across all organizational levels.
  • Proven leadership in aligning resources and motivating teams.
  • Experience managing P&L.
  • Inclusive leadership that builds workforce connections through personal engagement and trust.
  • Ability to drive and lead transformation through excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to challenge the status quo, drive continuous process improvement, and achieve organizational goals.
  • Understanding of customer/market dynamics and factors influencing customer behavior.

 HVAD TILBYDER VI DIG 

 Du får chancen for at arbejde i en Retail virksomhed, der stræber efter at være medarbejders førstevalg. Som sælger i JYSK får du: 
 
 Mulighed for udvikling og ansvar - vi stræber efter at finde størstedelen af vores ledere internt. Læs mere om udviklingsmulighederne i JYSK  her

description:

        Vi søger betonchauffør til Unicon Avedøre og Prøvestenen
        

        

        

  



    

		

			

				
Vil du køre nogle af Danmarks mest ikoniske lastbiler og være med til at levere fundamentet for fremtidens byggeri?



Hos Unicon søger vi en betonchauffør til vores fabrik i Fredericia. Som betonchauffør hos os er du meget mere end chauffør. Du er en vigtig del af støbningen og den, der sikrer, at betonen kommer sikkert frem, i den rette kvalitet og på det rigtige tidspunkt.

Du trives bag rattet i en stor bil, men mindst lige så vigtigt er det, at du kan samarbejde med kunderne på byggepladsen og arbejde tæt sammen med kollegerne på fabrikken.


Du bliver en vigtig del af byggepladsen

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du betonen fra fabrikken til byggepladsen, hvor du samarbejder med både kunden, pumpechaufføren og kollegerne om at få støbningen til at forløbe som planlagt.

Du leverer ikke bare et produkt - du er med til at sikre, at byggeriet kan fortsætte.

Nogle leverancer losses direkte fra bilens bånd, mens andre overføres til en betonpumpe. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du kan samarbejde med de mennesker, der modtager betonen, og bidrage til, at arbejdet udføres sikkert og effektivt.

Du kommer til at navigere på byggepladser, hvor pladsen ofte er trang, og hvor præcision og overblik er afgørende. Det kræver gode køreevner, sikkerhedsfokus og evnen til at holde hovedet koldt, når forholdene er udfordrende.


Mere byggeplads end landevej

Hvis du drømmer om lange ture gennem Europa, er dette nok ikke det rette job.

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du typisk mange korte ture mellem fabrikken og lokale byggepladser. Til gengæld bliver du en del af byggeprojekterne og får en hverdag med tæt kontakt til kunder, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere.

Det er et job for dig, der kan lide variation, ansvar og en arbejdsdag, hvor du gør en synlig forskel.


Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

Har stort kørekort inkl. hænger/trailer (CE)

Har EU-bevis

Har fokus på din egen og andres sikkerhed

Trives med at køre og manøvrere store køretøjer under krævende forhold

Er serviceminded og professionel i mødet med kunderne

Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine leverancer

Har fysik til rengøring og vedligeholdelse af bilen

Holder orden omkring dig og dit materiel

Det er en fordel, hvis du har krancertifikat eller erfaring fra bygge-, entreprenør- eller transportbranchen, men det er ikke et krav.


Derfor skal du vælge Unicon

Hos Unicon bliver du en del af Danmarks førende betonproducent og et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor sikkerhed, kvalitet og samarbejde går hånd i hånd.

Vi tilbyder:

Branchens bedste ansættelsesforhold

Grundig oplæring og introduktion til jobbet

Moderne materiel og gode arbejdsforhold

Betalt arbejdstøjsordning inklusive vask

Gode udviklingsmuligheder - både fagligt og personligt

En unik holdånd og stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

Overenskomst gennem Dansk Industri og 3F

En hverdag med selvstændighed og ansvar

En arbejdsdag, hvor kunderne er med til at sætte dagsordenen

Som betonchauffør er din arbejdsdag styret af byggepladsernes behov og dagens leverancer.

Du får typisk besked om mødetid den følgende dag om eftermiddagen, når næste dags produktion og leverancer er planlagt. Arbejdsdagen slutter, når den sidste tur er kørt, og dagens leverancer er gennemført.

Derfor er det ikke et traditionelt 7-15-job.

Nogle dage bliver kortere end forventet, mens andre dage bliver længere. Overarbejde forekommer jævnligt, men bliver naturligvis honoreret, og vi har gode muligheder for både udbetaling og opsparing af afspadsering, som mange af vores chauffører bruger til hele fridage.

Hvis du trives med variation, ansvar og en hverdag, hvor opgaven bliver gjort færdig, vil du passe godt ind hos os.


Sådan bliver du en del af holdet

Med udgangspunkt fra vores fabrik i Avedøre eller Prøvestenen bliver du en del af et stærkt team af chauffører og kolleger, som hver dag arbejder sammen om at levere beton til nogle af områdets vigtigste byggeprojekter.

Du refererer til fabrikkens daglige leder.

Kan du se dig selv i rollen, hører vi gerne fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte fabriksleder Michael Rud Larsen på telefon 40181421.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi finder den rette kandidat.

 

Om Unicon 


Unicon Danmark tilbyder lige muligheder for alle og har aktivt fokus på at fremme et arbejdsmiljø, der er fri for diskrimination, og hvor medarbejdere behandles med værdighed og respekt. I vores virksomhed er ansættelse baseret på den enkeltes fortjenester og kvalifikationer, som er direkte relateret til kompetencekrav i jobbet. Vi diskriminerer ikke nogen medarbejder eller jobansøger baseret på race, etnicitet, nationalitet, herkomst, genetiske oplysninger, statsborgerskab, religion, alder, køn, kønsidentitet/udtryk, seksuel orientering, graviditet, civilstand, handicap eller andre beskyttede karakteristika efter gældende love eller regler. Vi overholder disse principper i alle aspekter af ansættelse, herunder rekruttering, ansættelse, uddannelse, kompensation, forfremmelse og fordele.

title: Senior Road Engineers
description:
Help us build the future and we’ll help you build a rewarding and purposeful career.

Our global network is made up of architects, designers, planners, engineers, and environmental scientists all working towards the same goal.

Join a team that brings inspirational architecture, landscapes, townscapes and places to our world, and we’ll provide you unlimited space to grow.

We are looking for Senior Road Engineers to join our Roads Delivery team to help deliver quality design models, drawings, reports, and calculations for a wide range of projects. Working with established standards and procedures, you’ll bring sound judgement, technical curiosity and a collaborative mindset to help shape practical drainage solutions.

Duties and responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Perform road engineering duties, including but not limited to:
  • Develop and deliver geometric road designs and associated infrastructure, including intersections, roundabouts, car parks, active transport facilities, earthworks, access roads, and other related infrastructure.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to deliver integrated engineering solutions.
  • Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and support to junior engineers and designers.
  • Perform engineering calculations, assessments and prepare technical reports.
  • Engage effectively with clients and project teams.
  • Ensure designs comply with relevant standards, project requirements, and industry best practices.

What you will bring to the team:

  • Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Civil Engineering or a related discipline.
  • At least 10 years or more of experience in road and transport infrastructure engineering.
  • Strong understanding of road design principles and international road design standards.
  • Australian design experience is highly regarded.
  • Other international civil engineering project experience will also be highly regarded.
  • Experience in a consulting, engineering, or infrastructure delivery environment.
  • Strong technical writing, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with diverse clients and project teams.
  • Experience with 12d and/or OpenRoads is highly regarded
  • Experience delivering multidisciplinary infrastructure projects.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and lead project teams.

Our Hybrid Work Model:

Be part of the dynamic culture! Our workplace thrives on a hybrid model, combining in-office collaboration and flexibility. Join us in office, three days a week to contribute, connect and excel in our vibrant environment.

This role can be based in Makati, Quezon City, or Cebu City office depending on your home base or location.

title: Supplier Development Engineer
description:
Career Area:

Procurement

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition

Assesses the supplier quality and ensures that all the products are free from defects and are in compliance with manufacturing specifications and legal standards. Supports the Large Engine capacity uplift through supplier development, risk management, and launch readiness activities.

Responsibilities

  • Supplier Evaluations and Certification: Knowledge of Engine Components supplier evaluations and certification; ability to identify the methods, tools and documentation for evaluating, selecting and certifying worldclass supply base for our business.
  • Supplier Development & Process Establishment: Developing and fostering strong relationships with suppliers that will yield optimized and repeatable delivered quality. Also, will support suppliers in improving their performance through process enhancements, implementing process controls, and developing quality assurance plans to ensure sourced parts from suppliers meet all the quality requirements for the numerous sourcing projects.
  • Production Part Approval Process (PPAP): Knowledge of Production Part Approval Processes (PPAP) elements, submissions, and objectives; ability to determine whether a supplier can manufacture products that meet the quality requirements and standards of their customers consistently.
  • Coordination & Collaboration: Coordinate with engineering personnel on matters regarding Concurrent Product and Process Development (CPPD), New Product Introduction (NPI), New Source Introduction (NSI), Continuous Process Improvement (CPI) teams; prove design to production, engineering changes, deviations, supplier designs, specification approvals, meeting cost reduction goals, and participates in the Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA) process with suppliers manufacturing processes.
  • Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
  • Supports and participates in BIQ, LEAN initiatives with facilities, category teams, and suppliers. The incumbent will collaborate with Buyers to improve supplier cost, quality, and throughput.

What Skills You Will Have:

  • Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviours.

  • Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

  • Process Improvement: Understanding and insight into evaluating current product quality and production methods and ability to maintains focus on the continuous improvement of processes, products and services.

  • Quality Orientation: Knowledge of quality management methods, tools, and techniques; ability to create and support an environment that meets the quality goals of the organization.

  • Production Part Approval Process (PPAP): Knowledge of Production Part Approval Processes (PPAP) elements, submissions, and objectives; ability to determine whether a supplier can manufacture products that meet the quality requirements and standards of their customers consistently.

  • Manufacturing Standards, Procedures and Policies: Knowledge of organizational standards, procedures and policies in manufacturing activities; ability to plan, guide, and monitor manufacturing processes for compliance.

  • Supplier Management - MFG: Knowledge of processes and methods to effectively manage business relationships and transactions with suppliers of raw materials or product components; ability to apply related knowledge, experience and skills into real practice.

  • Supplier Evaluations and Certification: Knowledge of supplier evaluations and certification; ability to identify the methods, tools and documentation for evaluating, selecting and certifying vendors, suppliers and partners.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in engineering
  • Minimum of 5 years of job-related experience

Desired Qualifications:

  • Technical and manufacturing experience: Practical experience with casting, welding, assembly, or related manufacturing processes in an OEM or Tier 1/Tier 2 supplier environment.
  • Supplier development and industrialization: Ability to support supplier development, manufacturing process reviews, and component industrialization activities, with partial ownership of assigned components or suppliers.
  • Quality planning and approval processes: Working knowledge of APQP/PPAP, DFMEA, PFMEA, and quality processes for casting, welding or assembly components.
  • Communication and collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills, including the ability to address sensitive issues, develop others, build consensus, and work effectively with cross-functional and global teams.
  • English capability: Fluent communication in English.
  • Continuous improvement: Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, or related problem-solving experience is preferred but not required.

Additional Information:

  • Travel time is expected to be 30-50% of working time.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.

Posting Dates:

August 12, 2026 - August 23, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

title: Sr. Validation Engineer (Medical Industry)
company: BEPC Inc. - Business Excellence Professional Consulting
description:
BEPC Inc. provides Specialized Engineering Solutions and IT Project Management services to Fortune 500 companies in the Life Science and Technology industries. BEPC Mexico, a division of BEPC Incorporated, provides and manages consulting services for Automotive and Medical device companies throughout Mexico and around the globe.


At BEPC Inc., we are looking for a Senior Validation Engineer with deep expertise in process, equipment, and computer systems validation, including IQ/OQ/PQ, CSV, TMV, and SAT. This role will lead validation strategies, execute Design of Experiments (DOE), apply Lean and Six Sigma methodologies, and support validation projects from planning through execution in regulated medical device environments.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide technical engineering support for validations, write, and execute Installation Qualification (IQ) protocols, and provide data to write completion reports for assigned validations.
  • Provide technical engineering support for validations, write, and execute Operational Qualification (OQ) protocols, and provide data to write completion reports for assigned validations.
  • Provide technical engineering support for validations, write, and execute Performance Qualification (PQ) protocols, and provide data to write completion reports for assigned validations.
  • Provide technical engineering support for validations, write, and execute Computer Systems Validation (CSV) protocols.
  • Provide technical engineering support for validations, write, and execute Test Method Validation (TMV) protocols.
  • Provide technical engineering support for validations, write, and execute SAT (Site Acceptance Testing) validation protocols, and provide data to write completion reports for assigned validations.
  • Responsible for running experiments during the pre-validation phase, run other experiments as needed.
  • Ensure that assigned validation activities are performed in a timely manner and in accordance with current requirements and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
  • Demonstrate sufficient knowledge in validation skills, GMP, Good Documentation Practices (GDP).
  • Responsible for the execution of validation, including the creation of forms to create calibration and preventive maintenance records.


QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Engineering Degree (master’s in science is a plus)
  • 4 – 5 years of experience in medical industry
  • Good presentation skills before groups/clients.
  • Solid skills in developing Factorial Experiments (DOE´s) - Must
  • Extensive knowledge in Lean.
  • Intermediate knowledge in Six Sigma, DMAIC and Kaizen.
  • Intermediate knowledge of Project Management.
  • Extensive knowledge of statistics.
  • Advanced English proficiency

    Åbn det tyske marked for Bixter: Skab strategiske partnerskaber, omsæt stærke relationer til forretning, og få frihed til at drive væksten fra første kontakt til aftale.

      

      
    
  
    
    Ansøg om dette job

  









  



    
      

      
  

    Market Partnership Developer - til at åbne det tyske marked

Har du et stærkt netværk i Tyskland, et kommercielt mindset og evnen til at åbne døre, skabe partnerskaber og få mennesker til at se mulighederne i et samarbejde? Taler du flydende tysk, og motiveres du af at skabe forretning gennem relationer, der kan udvikle sig til mere end ét salg?

Så har vi måske en ret særlig mulighed til dig.

Hos Bixter i Kolding arbejder vi med international rekruttering, uddannelse og workforce solutions. Vi hjælper virksomheder med at få adgang til kvalificeret arbejdskraft - og mennesker med at få en vej ind på arbejdsmarkedet.

Nu vil vi længere ind på det tyske marked. Derfor leder vi efter vores Market Partnership Developer, som skal være med til at åbne nye kommercielle kanaler og gøre Bixter synlig, relevant og attraktiv hos relevante virksomheder, organisationer og samarbejdspartnere.


Du skal ikke overtage et marked. Du skal være med til at åbne det.
Det betyder, at du ikke kun skal finde den næste kunde, men tænke større: Hvilke organisationer kan give Bixter adgang til mange arbejdsgivere? Hvem har allerede stærke relationer til vores målgruppe? Og hvordan kan én stærk relation kan føre flere potentielle kunder?

Det kan være branche- og arbejdsgiverorganisationer, landbrugsorganisationer, rådgivere, staffing- og rekrutteringsvirksomheder, leverandører, HR- og payrollvirksomheder, hotel- og restaurantgrupper, logistikkæder eller andre aktører med adgang til de arbejdsgivere, vi ønsker at samarbejde med.


Lidt mere konkret er det dig, der:


Åbner nye markeder og kommercielle kanaler gennem strategiske partnerskaber



Opbygger et stærkt netværk blandt relevante tyske virksomheder og organisationer



Identificerer aktører, der kan skabe adgang til flere potentielle arbejdsgivere



Skaber introduktioner og relationer på ejer-, direktør- og ledelsesniveau



Udvikler relationer til konkrete kommercielle samarbejder og nye arbejdsgivere



Præsenterer og forhandler Bixters rekrutterings-, uddannelses- og workforce-løsninger



Opbygger en stærk pipeline og driver mulighederne hele vejen fra første kontakt til aftale



Repræsenterer Bixter på messer, konferencer og relevante branche- og netværksarrangementer


Kort sagt: Du åbner dørene. Du skaber partnerskaberne. Sammen skaber vi forretningen.


Vi leder efter en market opener - ikke en klassisk sælger
Måske har du arbejdet med business development, strategiske partnerskaber, key account management eller salg. Måske har du erfaring fra rekruttering, HR, bemanding, landbrug, fødevareproduktion, hospitality, logistik, produktion eller industri.

Det afgørende er ikke din titel, men at du dokumenteret har skabt nye kommercielle muligheder gennem relationer og partnerskaber. Du er vant til at tænke længere end det direkte salg og ser potentialet i at bruge organisationer, netværk og eksisterende relationer som genvej til nye kunder.

Du er samtidig meget kommerciel, vedholdende og resultatorienteret. Et godt møde eller et stort netværk er ikke målet i sig selv. Du ved, hvordan du omsætter relationer til introduktioner, leads, pipeline, nye arbejdsgivere og reel forretning.

Da det tyske marked bliver din arbejdsplads, er det vigtigt, at tysk er en naturlig del af din professionelle værktøjskasse - både mundtligt og skriftligt. Du begår dig også sikkert på engelsk og har erfaring med det tyske marked og tysk forretningskultur.


En central rolle i Bixters ekspansion
Rollen bliver en vigtig del af Bixters kommercielle ekspansion i Tyskland og kommer fremadrettet til at ligge under vores kommende CSO.

Du får stor frihed til at identificere muligheder, udvikle partnerskaber og prioritere din indsats. Samtidig arbejder du tæt sammen med ledelsen, rekrutteringsteamet, Bixter Academy, marketing og de operationelle teams.

Ambitionen er høj: Du skal være med til at skabe nye udviklings- og salgskanaler, der kan skaleres og bidrage markant til Bixters vækst på det tyske marked.

Hvis du motiveres af at være den, der finder de nye veje ind på et marked - og efterfølgende får dem til at blive til forretning - får du her mulighed for at sætte et meget synligt aftryk på Bixters næste vækstfase.


Ser du dig selv i rollen?

title: ASIAKASPALVELIJOITA TALVISESONKIIN!
description:
ASIAKASPALVELIJOITA TALVISESONKIIN!

Haluaisitko työskennellä talven kansainvälisessä työympäristössä Lapin upeissa maisemissa? Etsimme asiakkaallemme useampaa asiakaspalvelijaa talvisesonkiin vastaamaan matkailijoiden asiakaskokemuksesta.

Työt ovat Rovaniemellä ja etsimme lähtökohtaisesti paikallista tekijää, sillä toistaiseksi meillä ei ole tarjolla majoitusmahdollisuutta.

Työt alkavat marraskuussa kattavalla perehdytysjaksolla, ja sesongin kesto alustavasti huhtikuun alkuun saakka. Aiempi kokemus asiakaspalvelutyöstä ei ole välttämätöntä, vaan tärkeintä on iloinen asenne, rohkeus kohdata ihmisiä ja halu oppia uutta!



TYÖTEHTÄVÄT
Asiakaspalvelijana toimit asiakkaiden ensikontaktina safarialueella, opastat, neuvot ja vastaat heitä askarruttaviin kysymyksiin. Lisäksi annat turvallisuus- ja ajo-opetusta sekä teet tiivistä yhteistyötä muun henkilöstön kanssa. Pärjäät työssä loistavasti, kun nautit ihmisten kohtaamisesta ja uskallat käyttää englantia työkielenä päivittäin.


TARJOAMME
-kokoaikaisen työn talvisesongin ajaksi
-mahdollisuuden lisä- ja ylityötunteihin sesongin kiireisimpinä aikoina
-hyvän perehdytyksen

title: MYYNTIJOHTAJAKSI GRANOLLE
description:
Grano on Suomen johtava markkinoinnin ja viestinnän monitoimialayhtiö. Autamme asiakkaitamme rakentamaan näkyvyyttä, vaikuttavuutta ja kasvua yhdistämällä luovuuden, teknologian sekä laadukkaan tuotannon yhdeksi saumattomaksi kokonaisuudeksi. Toteutamme ratkaisuja, jotka näkyvät, puhuttelevat ja tuottavat tuloksia – digitaalisissa kanavissa, painotuotteissa ja fyysisissä kohtaamispisteissä. Meitä on noin 700 asiantuntijaa eri puolilla Suomea.
Grano on vahvassa uudistumisen vaiheessa. Rakennamme tulevaisuuden markkinoinnin ja viestinnän kumppania – yritystä, jossa yhdistyvät kunnianhimoinen kasvu, rohkea uudistuminen ja kyky toteuttaa ratkaisuja, joilla on todellista liiketoimintavaikutusta.
Haemme Granolle myyntijohtajaa Näkyvyys-liiketoimintaan
Nykyisen myyntijohtajamme siirtyessä talon sisällä muihin tehtäviin, etsimme kokenutta ja tavoitteellista myyntijohtajaa vastaamaan Granon Näkyvyys-liiketoiminnan myynnistä, asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä ja kasvusta. Tässä liiketoiminnan avainroolissa johdat omaa myyntiorganisaatiotasi, rakennat kasvua yhdessä tiimisi kanssa ja vaikutat aktiivisesti koko Granon kaupalliseen menestykseen.
Raportoit Näkyvyys-liiketoiminnan liiketoimintajohtajalle ja toimit osana liiketoiminnan johtoryhmää. Johdat myyjistä ja asiakkuuspäälliköistä koostuvaa tiimiä sekä teet tiivistä yhteistyötä muiden liiketoimintojen myyntijohtajien kanssa tunnistaaksesi uusia kasvumahdollisuuksia ja varmistaaksesi, että asiakkaat hyödyntävät Granon koko palveluvalikoimaa.
Roolissa yhdistyvät strateginen myynnin johtaminen, vahva henkilökohtainen asiakastyö ja ymmärrys toimialamme keskeisistä erityispiirteistä. Et johda myyntiä ainoastaan tavoitteiden ja mittareiden kautta, vaan toimit aktiivisesti myyntitiimisi sparraajana ja kaupallisena tukena. Autat myyjiä rakentamaan asiakkaille vaikuttavia ratkaisuja, kehittämään kokonaisuuksia, perustelemaan niiden arvoa ja löytämään toimivat hinnoitteluratkaisut.
Keskeiset vastuualueesi
- Vastaat Näkyvyys-liiketoiminnan myynnin kasvusta, tuloksesta ja kaupallisten tavoitteiden saavuttamisesta.
- Johdat, valmennat ja kehität myyjistä ja asiakkuuspäälliköistä koostuvaa myyntitiimiä.
- Sparraat myyjiä aktiivisesti asiakasratkaisujen rakentamisessa, hinnoittelussa, tarjouskokonaisuuksien kehittämisessä ja kaupallisten perustelujen hiomisessa.
- Varmistat, että myyntitiimillä on vahva ymmärrys Granon tarjoomasta, kilpailueduista, kustannusrakenteesta ja asiakkaalle tuotettavasta liiketoimintahyödystä.
- Rakennat aktiivisesti uusia asiakkuuksia sekä kehität ja kasvatat strategisesti merkittäviä asiakkuuksia.
- Luot ja vahvistat verkostoja asiakkaiden, yhteistyökumppaneiden ja sidosryhmien kanssa.
- Tunnistat markkinan muutoksia ja uusia liiketoimintamahdollisuuksia sekä rakennat niiden pohjalta kasvua.
- Kehität myynnin toimintamalleja ja varmistat laadukkaan myynnin johtamisen omassa liiketoiminnassasi.
- Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä muiden liiketoimintojen myyntijohtajien sekä asiantuntijoiden kanssa hyödyntääksesi Granon koko palvelutarjooman asiakkaiden hyväksi.

Mitä odotamme sinulta
Sinulla on vahva kokemus B2B-ratkaisumyynnistä ja näyttöjä menestyksekkäästä myynnin johtamisesta. Olet johtanut tavoitteellista myyntitiimiä ja osaat yhdistää ihmisten johtamisen, asiakkuuksien kehittämisen ja tuloksellisen myynnin.
Sinulla on myös vahva toimialaosaaminen tai kyky omaksua se nopeasti. Ymmärrät, kuinka ratkaisuja rakennetaan asiakkaiden tarpeisiin, miten kokonaisuuksia hinnoitellaan kannattavasti ja kuinka myyjiä sparrataan onnistumaan vaativissa myyntitilanteissa. Osaat haastaa, tukea ja kehittää myyntitiimiäsi käytännön tekemisessä – et pelkästään johtaa toimintaa.
Sinulla on laajat verkostot tai erinomainen kyky rakentaa niitä nopeasti. Viihdyt asiakkaiden parissa ja pystyt luomaan luottamuksellisia suhteita yritysten päättäjiin. Olet aktiivinen markkinassa, tunnistat uusia liiketoimintamahdollisuuksia ja viet ne määrätietoisesti maaliin.
Katsomme eduksi kokemuksen markkinoinnin, näkyvyysratkaisujen tai muun vastaavan toimialan parista. Ennen kaikkea etsimme henkilöä, joka yhdistää vahvan kaupallisen johtamisen, käytännön myyntiosaamisen ja kyvyn valmentaa muita onnistumaan. Menestyt tehtävässä, jos johdat esimerkillä, toimit määrätietoisesti ja innostat myös tiimisi onnistumaan. Rakennat yhteistyötä yli liiketoimintarajojen ja näet Granon liiketoiminnat yhteisenä kilpailuetuna asiakkaalle. Sinulla on vahva tulosorientaatio, erinomaiset vuorovaikutustaidot ja kyky johtaa kasvua muuttuvassa markkinassa.
Ymmärrämme, että täydellisyys ei ole aina mahdollista, ja siksi suhtaudumme työhön realistisesti. Olemme jatkuvalla tutkimusmatkalla, jossa vanhoja oppeja ei hylätä vain uusien ja kiiltävien ideoiden vuoksi. Luovumme kuitenkin mielellämme sellaisesta, mikä ei toimi, ja opimme tilalle jotain vaikuttavampaa. Toimimme arvojemme Rakkaudesta tekemiseen, Rehdisti yhdessä ja Rohkeasti uudistuen mukaisesti.
Upeaa, jos tehtävä herätti mielenkiintosi. Hae nyt ja tule osaksi luottojoukkuettamme!
Rekrytointi toteutetaan yhteistyössä ManpowerGroupin / Experiksen kanssa. Hae tehtävään mahdollisimman pian oheisen linkin kautta ja liitä mukaan hakemusdokumenttisi (CV ja hakemuskirje) viimeistään 31.8.2026. https://www.experis.fi/fi/tyo/44316/myyntijohtaja
Tutustumme hakemuksiin jo hakuaikana ja saatamme myös edetä haastatteluihin, joten laitathan oman hakemuksesi matkaan heti, kun siltä tuntuu. Emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse tietoturvasyistä.
Lisätietoa tehtävästä antaa Granon Liiketoimintajohtaja Hanna Kauste, p. 040 5261 263 seuraavina ajankohtina: ti 18.8. klo 15-16 ja to 20.8. klo 15-16.

title: Critical Care Tech Intensive Care Peds
description:
Job Description:

The Critical Care Technician functions as a clinical support partner in the Critical Care and Emergency Department settings. They assist the patient care team in performing various tasks and procedures for critically ill patients or patients requiring special skills or observation. They act under the direction and supervision of appropriate licensed clinical personnel.

Essential Functions

  • Responds to patient care needs by answering call lights, assisting with hygiene care, obtaining vital signs, and communicating effectively with the care team.
  • Performs 12-lead EKG duties and other tasks within the level of training and competency.
  • Applies, checks, and documents restraints as directed by RN or physician.
  • Assists with patient transfers, admissions, and discharges, ensuring safe patient handling.
  • Orders and maintains office and patient care floor stock/supplies and performs unit secretary duties.
  • Reports and records patient care findings and data in a timely manner and quickly secures assistance for changes in patient condition.
  • Assists with emergency resuscitation, set-up for line insertion, and retrieval of supplies and equipment.
  • Provides excellent customer service to patients and families, ensuring their requests are met promptly.
  • Recognizes and completes unit and patient care needs with minimal supervision, collaborating with RNs and the interdisciplinary team.
  • Adheres to infection prevention standards and promotes the mission, vision, and values of Intermountain Health.

Skills

  • Patient Care
  • Nursing
  • Life Support
  • Intensive Care Units
  • Point of Care Testing
  • Vital Signs
  • Cardiac Monitoring
  • Patient Information
  • Resuscitation
  • Teamwork

Shift Details: Part time. 24hrs/wk. Rotating shifts.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Current C.N.A. Certification in state of practice.

-OR-

  • EMT or Paramedic Certification in state of practice.

-OR-

  • Medical Assistant (MA) Certification from an accredited Medical Assistant program OR one with which Intermountain Health has a valid affiliation agreement.
  • Basic Life Support for Healthcare Providers (BLS-HCP) certification upon hire
  • If doing Point of Care Testing: Must have a High School diploma or GED in compliance with CLIA regulations.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • One (1) year of experience as a C.N.A., EMT, Paramedic, or Medical Assistant, or other applicable healthcare experience.
  • Current enrollment in nursing school program.
  • Proficient in basic computer skills.

Physical Requirements

  • Ongoing need for employee to see and read information, labels, assess patient needs, operate monitors, identify equipment and supplies.
  • Frequent interactions with patient care providers, patients, and visitors that require employee to verbally communicate as well as hear and understand spoken information, alarms, needs, and issues quickly and accurately, particularly during emergency situations.
  • Manual dexterity of hands and fingers to manipulate complex and delicate equipment with precision and accuracy. This includes frequent computer use and typing for documenting patient care, accessing needed information, medication preparation, etc.
  • Expected to lift and utilize full range of movement to transfer patients. Will also bend to retrieve, lift, and carry supplies and equipment. Typically includes items of varying weights, up to and including heavy items.
  • Need to walk and assist with transporting/ambulating patients and obtaining and distributing supplies and equipment. This includes pushing/pulling gurneys and portable equipment, including heavy items. Often required to navigate crowded and busy rooms (full of equipment, power cords on the floor, etc.)
  • May be expected to stand in a stationary position for an extended period of time.
  • For roles requiring driving: Expected to drive a vehicle which requires sitting, seeing and reading signs, traffic signals, and other vehicles.

title: Customer Quality and Audit Engineer
description:
R&R Overview


Responsible for overall coordination, tracking and execution of all customer‑quality activities across North America. Support plant quality teams in planning, execution, tracking‑analysis, summary and improvement of customer‑quality work to meet business performance targets


Detailed R&R


1. Compile annual customer satisfaction data, conduct analysis, draw conclusions and drive improvement actions.

2. Apply for and set‑up customer Portal accounts; proficiently operate customer Portals and keep

change‑points updated in real time.

3. Collect Customer‑Specific Requirements (CSR), and support system engineers to sort out and release CSR documents.

4. Monitor customer scorecard performance to ensure target achievement. Understand scorecard operating logic and maintain real‑time updates for change‑points. Adopt weekly tracking routines, send timely alerts to plants and escalate risks to management. Define and refine customer scorecard management procedures.

5. Follow up customer chargeback cases, drive chargeback‑process execution; define and optimize

customer chargeback workflows and management rules.

6. Track overall external quality‑related costs, including customer chargeback expenses and customer‑site containment costs.

7. Support fast response and resolution for major customer quality incidents.

8. Understand customer system requirements and assist system engineers with requirement deployment. Prepare for or support customer audit readiness. Track customer audit schedules & findings; drive deployment of customer system requirements and corrective actions against audit non‑conformances to prevent major audit observations.

9. Monitor overall customer‑quality performance and propose improvement directions.

10. Support Quality Academy development and build competency for plant quality teams.


Educational Background:


Bachelor’s degree and above, major in mechanics or engineering related preferred.


Experience:


— Minimum 2‑year experience in quality‑related roles including quality management.

— Automotive manufacturing background (OEM or Tier‑1 supplier). Multi‑customer interface experience; prior project exposure to BMW, Tesla, GM, VW, Audi, Mazda, Lear, Adient, Magna is preferred.

— Proven track record in closed‑loop product issue resolution; hands‑on experience with quality tools and 8D methodology preferred.

— Strong capability in information governance and data analytics; Power BI and AI Agent experience preferred.

Job Description Summary

Location: Menges, Slovenia #onsite

Klinična proizvodnja | Inženiring in avtomatizacija
Soustvarjajte prihodnost bioloških zdravil
V Novartisu soustvarjamo prihodnost zgodnje faze razvoja bioloških zdravil. V okviru te poti se BioCampus Mengeš razvija v najsodobnejši, integriran klinični proizvodni obrat za učinkovino (Drug Substance) in končni izdelek (Drug Product).
Za podporo tej rasti iščemo izkušenega inženirja avtomatizacije, ki želi imeti dejanski vpliv v visoko avtomatiziranem, GMP‑reguliranem okolju.
Vaša vloga
Kot inženir avtomatizacije boste ključni tehnični strokovnjak, odgovoren za avtomatizirane sisteme v proizvodnji in podpornih sistemih. Tesno boste sodelovali z oddelki inženiringa, proizvodnje, zagotavljanja kakovosti (QA), IT/OT ter zunanjimi partnerji, pri čemer boste prispevali tako k tekočemu obratovanju kot tudi k zanimivim novim projektom.
To delovno mesto je primerno za posameznika, ki uživa v samostojnosti, tehnični poglobljenosti ter delu na stičišču tehnologije, GMP skladnosti in proizvodne učinkovitosti.

Clinical Manufacturing | Engineering & Automation
Be part of building the future of biologics
At Novartis, we are shaping the future of early‑stage biologics. As part of this journey, BioCampus Mengeš is being developed into a state‑of‑the‑art integrated clinical manufacturing facility for Drug Substance and Drug Product.
To support this growth, we are looking for an experienced Automation Engineer (Expert) who wants to make a real impact in a highly automated, GMP‑regulated environment.
---
Your role
As an Automation Engineer, you will be a key technical expert responsible for automation systems across manufacturing and supporting utilities. You will work closely with engineering, production, QA, IT/OT and external partners, contributing to both ongoing operations and exciting new projects.
This role suits someone who enjoys ownership, technical depth, and working at the interface between technology, GMP compliance and manufacturing performance.


Job Description

Ključne odgovornosti

description:
Classified Information Systems Security Manager (Onsite) (Top Secret Clearance)

Location: US-IA-CEDAR RAPIDS-121 ~ 350 Collins Rd NE ~ BLDG 121

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Date Posted:

2026-08-10
