U.S. Citizen, U.S. Person, or Immigration Status Requirements:

Active and transferable U.S. government issued security clearance is required prior to start date.​ U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance​

Security Clearance Type:

DoD Clearance: Top Secret

Security Clearance Status:

Active and existing security clearance required on day 1

The Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM) serves as the primary cybersecurity authority for assigned classified and controlled information systems. This role is responsible for the end-to-end execution and oversight of cybersecurity activities in compliance with applicable U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) laws, regulations, and contractual requirements. As an advanced individual contributor, the ISSM independently leads system authorization, continuous monitoring, inspection readiness, and risk management activities, while providing technical oversight and mentorship to Information Systems Security Officers (ISSOs) and maintaining accountability for cybersecurity outcomes. Responsibilities include implementing and sustaining cybersecurity requirements defined by government frameworks and guidance, including the Risk Management Framework (RMF), Joint Special Access Program Implementation Guide (JSIG) for SAP systems, NIST publications, NISPOM, and the DCSA Assessment and Authorization Guide (DAAG), and associated assessment and authorization guidance.

** This position is onsite in Cedar Rapids. IA. **

What YOU will do:

  • Independently own cybersecurity responsibilities for assigned information systems, ensuring security objectives are achieved and organizational risk is effectively managed.

  • Serve as the primary cybersecurity authority for inspections, assessments, audits, and continuous monitoring, leading preparation, execution, and response activities to maintain authorization and inspection readiness.

  • Execute and maintain system authorization using the Risk Management Framework (RMF) and applicable guidance, including the Joint Special Access Program Implementation Guide (JSIG) for Special Access Program systems and the DCSA Assessment and Authorization Guide (DAAG) for DoD collateral systems.

  • Maintain awareness and working knowledge of DD Form 254s and contractual security requirements, ensuring cybersecurity controls, inspection scope, and authorization boundaries align with approved mission and program objectives.

  • Develop, maintain, and validate cybersecurity plans, authorization artifacts, and compliance documentation to support audit-ready operations.

  • Identify, assess, and communicate cybersecurity risk to senior leadership and Authorizing Officials, including the impact of system changes, vulnerabilities, inspection findings, and authorization conditions.

  • Lead continuous monitoring activities, including evaluation of security posture, validation of control effectiveness, and tracking of security-relevant data.

  • Develop, manage, and drive closure of Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms) resulting from inspections, assessments, and continuous monitoring activities.

  • Lead and oversee cybersecurity Change Control Boards (CCBs), evaluating proposed system changes for security impact, authorization implications, and alignment with RMF requirements.

  • Execute or coordinate corrective and protective security actions resulting from inspections, continuous monitoring, or identified cybersecurity incidents.

  • Engage with Program Managers to integrate cybersecurity requirements into program execution, schedules, and decision-making, and to address risk impacts to cost, scope, and mission delivery.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Information Technology, Facilities, and Industrial Security, to ensure cybersecurity requirements are integrated into technical, physical, and operational environments.

  • Coordinate with other cybersecurity teams across the enterprise to ensure consistent implementation of cybersecurity processes, standards, and authorization practices.

  • Provide technical direction and mentoring to ISSOs to ensure consistent execution of RMF activities, inspection readiness, and quality of authorization artifacts, while remaining accountable for cybersecurity outcomes.

  • Prepare and deliver cybersecurity status reporting to senior leadership, summarizing authorization posture, inspection readiness, risk trends, POA&Ms, and significant cybersecurity issues.

Qualifications YOU Must Have:

  • Typically requires a University Degree and minimum 8 years prior relevant experience or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 5 years of experience.

  • U.S. Citizen is required as only U.S. Citizen are able to obtain a clearance.

  • Active DOD Top Secret Security Clearance day one.

  • IAM Level III certification compliant with DoD 8570 / DoD 8140 (e.g., CISSP, CISM, GSLC).

  • Experience performing ISSM responsibilities for classified or controlled information systems.

  • Advanced knowledge of RMF and DoD system authorization processes.

  • Experience executing authorization and continuous monitoring using JSIG and/or DAAG.

  • Knowledge of cybersecurity regulations, contractual requirements, and DD Form 254 interpretation.

  • Experience supporting inspections, assessments, and audit activities.

  • Ability to independently assess risk and communicate cybersecurity status to leadership.

  • Must be willing to travel domestically up to 20%, generally supporting other company facilities.

Qualifications We Prefer:

  • Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Experience as the primary ISSM for SAP and/or DoD collateral systems.

  • Experience owning ATOs and driving POA&M closure.

  • Experience mentoring ISSOs and providing technical oversight.

  • Experience leading Change Control Boards (CCBs).

  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and enterprise cybersecurity organizations.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for senior leadership briefings.

What We Offer:

Some of our competitive benefits packages include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Three weeks of vacation for newly hired employees.

  • Generous 401(k) plan that includes employer matching funds and separate. employer retirement contribution, including a Lifetime Income Strategy option.

  • Tuition reimbursement program.

  • Student Loan Repayment Program.

  • Life insurance and disability coverage.

  • Optional coverages you can buy pet insurance, home and auto insurance, additional life and accident insurance, critical illness insurance, group legal, ID theft protection.

  • Birth, adoption, parental leave benefits.

  • Ovia Health, fertility, and family planning.

  • Adoption Assistance.

  • Autism Benefit.

  • Employee Assistance Plan, including up to 10 free counseling sessions.

  • Healthy You Incentives, wellness rewards program.

  • Doctor on Demand, virtual doctor visits.

  • Bright Horizons, child, and elder care services.

  • Teladoc Medical Experts, second opinion program.

  • And more!

title: Senior Assessor- Field Trials (Casual)
description:
Field Trials Assistant – Casual
Location: Lincoln

The Opportunity
Our Plant & Seed group provides biosecurity monitoring, inspection, auditing, certification, and quality management services to the forestry, horticultural, and seeds industries.

We have an exciting casual opportunity for one motivated individual to assist with field trials over the summer season. In this role, you’ll help maintain field trials in line with the New Zealand Seed Certification Scheme, as well as carry out measurements on a range of grass species to support Plant Variety Rights (PVR) assessments – a type of intellectual property right.

This is a casual role, offered on an as-and-when required basis. The amount of work available will vary, as it is highly dependent on weather and seasonal conditions. Ideally, you will be available from October 2026 to mid-January 2027.

About You
We are looking for someone who brings:

  • Prior on-farm experience and a full driver’s licence.
  • A tertiary qualification in Agriculture (or working towards one).
  • A go-getter attitude with the ability to work well in a team and under pressure.
  • Strong attention to detail, along with great written and verbal communication skills.

Previous experience in seed or cropping inspections will be an advantage. Full training will be provided, and you will work under the supervision of experienced AsureQuality team members until approved to conduct inspections independently.

As Kaitiaki Kai – guardians of food, we take pride in doing the right thing for food and the environments it comes from. We are committed to attracting, developing, and retaining great people, supporting them to be their best. We know diverse teams are stronger teams and believe in fairness and opportunity for all.

If you’re looking for a hands-on summer opportunity where you can apply your agricultural knowledge, gain valuable industry experience, and contribute to protecting New Zealand’s primary industries, we’d love to hear from you.

Helping Aotearoa shape a better food world - Join us today!

    Salgsrådgiver til Synoptik Lyngby Storcenter
    Brænder du for det personlige salg og formår at skabe stærke kundeoplevelser? Bliv salgsrådgiver i Synoptik og gør en forskel - én kunde ad gangen.

      

      
  
    
    Søg stillingen

  







  
    
      

        
        
      
    

      
  

    Har du erfaring fra tøjbranchen, skønhedsbranchen eller inden for personlig pleje?
Er du klar til at tage skridtet videre i din karriere og udforske nye muligheder? Så er du måske vores nye salgsrådgiver i Synoptik.

I Synoptik er vi ikke kun fascineret af synet. Vi er også fascineret af at rådgive og give vores kunder den bedste købsoplevelse. For vi sælger ikke kun briller og kontaktlinser. Vi sælger også mode og livskvalitet. Og vi gør det overbevisende. For vi elsker, hvad vi laver - og vi elsker at skabe værdi for vores kunder.

Lige nu er vi på udkig efter en ny kollega, der kan være med til at gøre salgs- og købsoplevelsen i butikken komplet. Hvis du brænder for det samme som os, og hvis du elsker at sælge og rådgive kunder i, hvordan de kan få mest værdi for pengene, så er det måske dig, der er vores nye salgsrådgiver. Du behøver ikke have tidligere erfaring fra branchen, vores stærke onboarding-program skal nok lære dig det hele. Det vigtigste er, at du elsker at sælge, er åben for nye udfordringer og glæder dig til at blive klogere på vores produkter og spændende brands. Hvis du er klar på nye udfordringer inden for detailbranchen, så tøv ikke med at sende os din ansøgning.
Om stillingen
Som salgsrådgiver hos Synoptik får du mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel i menneskers liv ved at hjælpe dem med at forbedre deres syn og livskvalitet. Du vil være en del af et engageret team, der arbejder for at levere førsteklasses service og rådgivning til vores kunder.

Som salgsrådgiver i Synoptik tager du dig af butikkens salgsdel og alle kundevendte opgaver, mens vores optikere tager sig af den faglige, optiske del. Men hvad kommer du mere konkret til at lave? Du får en spændende hverdag med varierende arbejdsopgaver. Du skal blandt andet:


Være en del af et glad, smilende og imødekommende team, der elsker at have det sjovt sammen



Tag imod kunder, sælge de bedste løsninger og formidle de nyeste modetrends



Rådgive og vejlede om stel, solbriller og kontaktlinser



Booke synsprøver, foretage elektroniske synstest samt udføre lettere reparationer



Hjælpe kunder, der er inde for at afhente deres færdige briller, og hjælpe kunder telefonisk



Oprette journaler i IT-systemet og styre en aftalekalender



Trimme butikken og få den til altid at se knivskarp og salgsklar ud



Håndtere kassen, deltage i status samt bestille og modtage varer

Dine udviklingsmuligheder
I Synoptik er udviklingsmulighederne mange og vores brede E-learningsplatform summer konstant af nye kurser, webinars og podcasts. Dertil kommer fysiske kompetencedage, salgskurser og muligheden for at blive en del af vores interne talentprogram. Vi elsker nemlig at udvikle os - og vi elsker at give dig mulighed for at blive dygtigere til det, du brænder for.
Vores forventninger til dig
En personlig og tillidsfuld kommunikation med vores kunder er afgørende for, at du kan rådgive og vejlede kunderne bedst muligt i deres valg af stel, solbriller og forskellige typer af glas og kontaktlinser. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du både taler, skriver og forstår dansk. Du nyder den direkte kundekontakt, og du har overskud og lyst til at lære kundernes hverdag og fritidsliv at kende. Du er god til at formidle din produktviden, forklare fordele og give kunderne sikkerhed om, at de får værdi for pengene, når de handler hos os.
Din profil:
Vi søger engagerede kandidater, der:


er ivrige efter at lære og konstant udvide deres viden og færdigheder



udviser nysgerrighed omkring de nyeste produkter og markedstendenser



værdsætter mangfoldighed og kan samarbejde med mennesker fra forskellige baggrunde



er team-orienterede og bidrager aktivt til at forbedre teamets præstation



er reflekterende og innovative i deres tilgang til at optimere processer



er fleksible og positive over for forandringer



kommunikerer klart og effektivt, både mundtligt og skriftligt på dansk

Bliv en del af vores team
Hos Synoptik er vi drevet af engagement, ekspertise og nysgerrighed. Vi inviterer dig til at blive en del af vores team og gøre en reel forskel i menneskers liv. Sammen kan vi forbedre synet og livskvaliteten for vores kunder, én kunde ad gangen. Er du klar til at tage det næste skridt i din karriere og blive en del af Synoptik-familien?
Rekrutteringsprocessen
Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og besætter stillingen, når den rette kandidat melder sig, så skynd dig at sende dit CV samt en kort motivation for stillingen afsted. Vi modtager ikke ansøgninger via mail.

I forbindelse med en samtale vil vi bede om en reference fra en nuværende - eller tidligere chef, så find allerede kontaktinformationen frem og indskriv i forbindelse med din ansøgning.

Hvis du er interesseret i mere end én stilling, så kan du blot angive, hvilke andre butikker du også ønsker at komme i betragtning til. Vores HR-afdeling læser alle tilsendte ansøgninger og fordeler efterfølgende kandidater til de enkelte butikker.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!
Ansættelsesforhold
Stillingen er en fastansættelse på gennemsnitligt 37 timer pr. uge. Vi følger Butiksoverenskomsten for Butikker mellem Dansk Erhverv Arbejdsgiver og HK Handel.

Du kan finde butikkens åbningstid her.

Vi værdsætter mangfoldighed og opfordrer alle kvalificerede ansøgere til at søge, uanset alder, køn, etnicitet, nationalitet, religion, seksuel orientering eller funktionsnedsættelse og forpligter os til at skabe et inkluderende miljø for alle medarbejdere. Vi hylder mangfoldighed og tilbyder lige muligheder til alle, uanset race, køn, etnicitet, religion, handicap, seksuel orientering eller andre karakteristika, der gør os unikke.

title: Team Leader - Commercial Management & Quantity Surveying
description:
Associate - Commercial Management & Quantity Surveying is responsible for providing commercial leadership across UK projects, managing end‑to‑end cost management services, and leading the India QS teams in coordination with UK counterparts.

The role demands a balance of technical expertise, team leadership, client interface capabilities, business development support, and capability building. A key expectation is to expand UK workshare, showcase team capabilities, and mentor future QS professionals. The role requires ownership of commercial leadership and full‑cycle cost management for UK commissions delivered from India. It includes leading a high‑performing QS team, supporting bids, and enhancing delivery quality through structured QA/QC frameworks, training, and digital QS adoption across buildings and infrastructure sectors.

1. Leadership & Delivery Governance
Build and lead a high‑performing QS team through resource planning, mentorship, performance reviews, and workload allocation. Establish engagement models, SLAs, RACIs,and manage mobilisation and transitions with UK teams. Implement QA/QC gates—checklists, peer reviews, and senior sign‑off—to ensure right‑first‑time outputs. Standardise delivery processes including SOPs, templates, naming conventions, and knowledge repositories.


2. UK Client Interface & Capability Showcases
Serve as the primary commercial interface for UK project leads, PMs, and designers.
Conduct capability presentations including case studies, sample deliverables, and CostX/5D
demos. Define expectations regarding scope, deliverables, assumptions, information exchange, and programme.


3. Commercial & Technical Delivery (UK Standards)
Lead RIBA Stage 0–4 cost planning with benchmarking, allowances, and risk/optimism bias
guidance. Oversee BoQ preparation to NRM/CESMM standards with measurement
consistency and quality. Provide contractual leadership across NEC/JCT/FIDIC:
compensation events, variations, risk, and change control. Direct cost reporting, CVRs,
forecasts, cashflow analysis, and earned value insights. Drive procurement strategies,
tender documentation, and commercial evaluations. Guide value engineering, life‑cycle
costing, and carbon‑cost trade‑off advisory. Promote risk identification, QRA interpretation,
and maintenance of commercial risk registers.

4. Business Development & Work Winning
Support bid responses (SQ/PQQ/ITT), fee proposals, scopes, and mobilisation planning.
Create account growth strategies with UK partners; track pipeline, revenue, margin, and
win‑rate.

5. Digital QS & Reporting
Champion CostX (2D/3D/5D), model‑based take‑off, and structured cost databases.
Encourage data‑driven reporting using advanced Excel and optional Power BI dashboards.


6. Training, Mentoring & Capability Uplift
Develop structured training covering NRM/CESMM, NEC/JCT, CostX, CVR, risk, and
reporting standards. Mentor team members on UK standards and high‑quality commercial
advice.


7. Governance, Quality & Compliance
Align with RICS QS & Construction Pathway competencies. Uphold RICS Rules of Conduct.

Bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying/Civil Engineering (Master’s preferred).
15–20 years of QS/Cost Management experience with substantial 5 years UK project
exposure. Proven experience leading multi project teams in a UK–India delivery model and
interfacing with UK clients/consultants/contractors. Strong working knowledge of NEC/JCT
(FIDIC familiarity is an advantage) and NRM/CESMM measurement norms. Evidence of
delivering RIBA 0–4 cost planning, CVRs/Forecasting, Procurement and Change Control.

Tools & Technology
CostX (advanced), MS Excel (Power Query/Pivots),
Microsoft suit - PowerPoint, Word.
Exposure to 5D/BIM workflows, Power BI for dashboards.

BGV:

  • Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
  • Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

														 Souschef - Fuldtid - Kongelundsvej 
													 

																									 

											 

											 
										 

										
 
											
 
																																				
  
  
 
 
   Introduktion  
 

 
 Kan du motivere branchens bedste kolleger og bidrage til, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar? Så er du måske vores nye souschef. 

 Hos Lidl bliver du en del af Europas største dagligvarekæde med 150+ butikker i Danmark. Sammen er vi drevet af et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, og på #teamlidl kommer du med på en succesfuld rejse -- på et hold med høje ambitioner til fælles. Vi har brug for stærke ledere, der giver vores medarbejdere retning og overskud, så vi sammen skaber rammerne for landets bedste indkøbsoplevelse.
 Som souschef tager du aktiv del i det daglige arbejde i butikken, og får medansvar for butikkens drift og resultater. Hos os får du ansvar lige fra første arbejdsdag og bliver samtidig en del af et ambitiøst karriereudviklingsforløb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi nemlig høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen, med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig.
 Som souschef i Lidl får du en ansvarsfuld rolle med spændende udfordringer og en konkurrencedygtig lønpakke. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, så du har forudsætningerne for at opnå succes i din nye stilling.
     
 
 

 
   Om jobbet  
 

 
 Som souschef er du med til at drive butikken og lede medarbejderne. Du har medansvar for, at butikken lever op til kundernes forventninger, så de bliver ved med at handle hos os. Ud over at bestille varer, fylde op og ekspedere kunderne ved kassen, får du også følgende opgaver, som du løser i tæt samarbejde med butikschefen: 
 
 Planlægning af ressourcer og prioritering af arbejdsopgaver  

 Oplæring af medarbejdere, så de efterlever Lidls værdier og butikskoncepter 

 Ledelse af medarbejdere så de lykkes i deres job 

 Sørge for, at vores butikskoncepter overholdes 

 Ansvar for butikken når butikschefen ikke er til stede  
  
 

 
   Om dig  
 

 
 Du er en empatisk og stærk ledertype, der har nemt ved motivere dine medarbejdere. Du bliver respekteret for din faglighed, og du sætter en ære i at tage del i arbejdsopgaverne i den daglige drift, og være med til at sikre, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar. 
 Du er godt rustet til jobbet, hvis du: 
 
 Har brancheerfaring og gerne erfaring fra lignende stilling 

 Har gennemført et lederkursus eller er motiveret for at udvikle dig som leder 

 Har en venlig og professionel fremtoning 

 Inspirerer dine medarbejdere til at følge dit gode eksempel 

 Har overblik og fokus på detaljen  

 Ser butikken som et team og ikke er bleg for at give en hånd med, når en kollega har brug for hjælp 

 Har god forståelse for arbejdsprocesser, procedurer og koncepter 
  
 

 
   Vi tilbyder  
 

 
 Som souschef i Lidl får du:  
 
 En udfordrende rolle, hvor tingene går stærkt 

 Verdensklasse sammenhold 

 En konkurrencedygtig lønpakke på 26.000 - 32.500 kr. brutto om måneden 

 Et udbetalt tillæg i henhold til overenskomsten, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter - fx aftener, weekender og helligdage 

 Løn og vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst med HK 

 En grundig oplæring i vores arbejdsgange og koncepter 

 Adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt 

 Mulighed for sundhedsordning 

 Rabatordning hos flere udbydere af rejser, shopping, kultur, fitness mm.

title: Suuhygienisti, Pori
description:
Haemme suuhygienistiä määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Satakunnan hyvinvointialueen Läntiseen palveluryhmään (Pori ja Ulvila). Haettavan toimen sijoituspaikka on Pori.

Työssä aloitus mahdollisimman pian. Määräaikaisuuden kesto 1.3.2027 asti.

Tarjoamme suun terveyttä edistävää ja ylläpitävää, suusairauksia ehkäisevää, hoitavaa ja kuntouttavaa hoitoa. Meillä pääset osaksi nuorekasta, kehitystä tukevaa työyhteisöä, jossa monipuolinen työnkuva ja myönteinen ilmapiiri tukevat ammatillista kasvua ja viihtyvyyttä. Käytössämme on Lifecare-potilastietojärjestelmä.

Suuhygienistin työ on itsenäistä potilastyötä. Tehtäviin kuuluu suun terveyden edistäminen ja ylläpito, eri-ikäisten henkilöiden suun terveystarkastukset sekä suun infektiosairauksien ehkäisy ja hoito. Terveysneuvonta- ja omanhoidonohjaus, hoidontarpeen arviointi, toteutus ja seuranta. Parodontologisten ja kariologisten infektiosairauksien ennaltaehkäisy sekä niiden varhainen ja ylläpitävä hoitaminen. Hammaslääkärin lähetteellä rtg-kuvien ottaminen. Erilaiset toimistotyöt, välinehuolto sekä instrumenttien teroitus. Hoitohuoneen toimintavalmiudesta ja aseptiikasta huolehtiminen.

Tarjoamme sinulle liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedun sekä maksuttoman kuntosalin Raumalla, Harjavallassa, Porissa ja Ulvilassa. Työsuhteeseen kuuluu työterveyshuolto ja kattava sisäinen koulutustarjonta.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on suuhygienistin AMK-tutkinto tai vastaava aikaisempi tutkinto ja terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain (559/1994) mukainen laillistus.

Otamme myös huomioon loppuvaiheen suuhygienistiopiskelijoiden hakemukset.

Oikomishoidon osaaminen / hallinta katsotaan eduksi tehtävää täytettäessä. Työskentelykielemme on suomi, joten odotamme sinulta sujuvaa suullista ja kirjallista suomen kielen taitoa.

Arvostamme vastuullista ja reipasta työotetta, sekä joustavuutta ja halua oman sekä työyhteisön toiminnan jatkuvaan kehittämiseen.

Palvelussuhteen ehdot ja palkkaus määräytyvät SOTE-sopimuksen mukaan.

Palvelussuhteessa noudatetaan kolmen (3) kuukauden koeaikaa. Tarkastamme alkuperäiset todistukset haastateltavilta.

Haastatteluja voidaan tehdään jo hakuaikana ja valinta tehdään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Hakuaikaa on jatkettu ja aiemmin hakeneet huomioidaan automaattisesti.

Hakemukset lähetetään ensisijaisesti sähköisesti työpaikkailmoitukselta löytyvän linkin kautta.

title: Monteur Units
location: Koudekerk aan den Rijn, Zuid-Holland, Nederland
description:
Van monteren en installeren tot aanpassen en oplossen. Jij maakt iedere unit klaar voor zijn volgende bestemming.

Jouw baan als Monteur Units bij RECO

Op onze afdeling Accommodaties zorgen we ervoor dat tijdelijke units helemaal klaar zijn voor hun volgende bestemming. Dat kan een kantoor zijn, een klaslokaal, woonruimte, zorglocatie of iets heel anders. Iedere unit heeft weer een andere bestemming en vraagt dus om een andere aanpak.

Als Monteur Units werk je in onze werkplaats in Koudekerk aan den Rijn. Samen met je collega's zorg je ervoor dat units worden opgebouwd, aangepast, ingericht en technisch klaargemaakt voor gebruik.

Je bent lekker praktisch bezig en ziet direct resultaat van je werk. De ene dag monteer je een keuken of plaats je een wand, de volgende dag houd je je bezig met verlichting, deuren of andere onderdelen van een unit. Geen dag is precies hetzelfde en je krijgt volop de ruimte om mee te denken over slimme oplossingen.

Jouw belangrijkste werkzaamheden bestaan uit:

✅ Het opbouwen, aanpassen en inrichten van tijdelijke units;

✅ Het monteren van onder andere keukens, wanden, deuren, sloten en verlichting;

✅ Het uitvoeren van verschillende technische en praktische werkzaamheden in en rondom de units;

✅ Het strippen en demonteren van units en deze klaarmaken voor een nieuwe bestemming;

✅ Het oplossen van technische uitdagingen en zorgen dat het eindresultaat netjes en compleet is;

✅ Samenwerken met je collega's om iedere accommodatie op tijd en volgens afspraak klaar te maken.

Wat breng jij mee?

👍 Je hebt technisch inzicht en bent handig;

👍 Je vindt het leuk om verschillende werkzaamheden op te pakken en nieuwe dingen te leren;

👍 Je bent oplossingsgericht en denkt graag mee over hoe iets beter of slimmer kan;

👍 Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar vindt het ook leuk om samen met collega's een klus te klaren;

👍 Je werkt nauwkeurig en vindt het belangrijk dat het eindresultaat netjes is;

Bij RECO willen we jou blij maken met:

✅ Een goed salaris;

✅ 28 vakantiedagen per jaar, oplopend tot 31 dagen als waardering voor geen ziekteverzuim;

✅ Overwerkvergoeding;

✅ Een collectieve zorgverzekering én goede pensioenregeling met maar 3,3% eigen bijdrage, de rest betaalt RECO;

✅ Werken met het nieuwste gereedschap;

✅ Veel opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden via onze RECO Academy;

✅ Werken in een hechte organisatie: iedereen kent elkaar bij naam, de lijnen zijn kort en je loopt gemakkelijk bij elkaar binnen. Daarnaast organiseren we een goed verzorgde zomerbarbecue en een groots eindejaarspersoneelsfeest! Klik hier voor een kijkje in onze RECO-Cultuur.

Over RECO

RECO is dé specialist in het verhuren van bouwplaats materialen voor uiteenlopende projecten in de bouw, infra, renovatie, overheid en evenementen. Met een aanpakkers mentaliteit en betrokken collega’s werken we samen aan slimme materieeloplossingen.

Enthousiast over RECO, maar weet je niet zeker of je aan alle eisen voldoet? Bel gerust—de koffie staat klaar! We kijken graag met jou naar jouw inzet, motivatie en de mogelijkheden!

Ik ben enthousiast! Wat nu?

Neem dan contact op met onze collega’s Emma of Ilona, zij staan je graag te woord! Bel hun op 06-82978749, of stuur een whatsapp bericht. Je kunt natuurlijk ook direct het sollicitatieformulier invullen!

Wij vervullen onze vacatures graag zelf, om die reden stellen wij acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature niet op prijs!

title: Practice Manager - Cloud, DevOps & AI Practice
description:
Job Description

Practice Manager – Cloud, DevOps & AI Practice

Company: Teceze Ltd

Position: Practice Manager – Digital Engineering & AI Innovation

Practice Area: Cloud & DevOps, AI & Intelligent Automation, Application Modernization

Location: Chennai or Bangalore

Employment Type: Full-time

About Teceze

Teceze is a global technology partner focused on operational resilience, digital transformation, and scalable growth. We simplify architectural complexity and accelerate business velocity by uniting next-generation innovation under a highly accountable delivery model.

Our Digital Engineering Innovation Engine integrates Cloud & DevOps frameworks, Application Modernization, and AI & Intelligent Automation. We construct production-grade computing, delivery pipelines, and data architectures that allow enterprise clients to transform legacy operational structures into scalable, future-ready business outcomes.

Position Overview

We are seeking a visionary, growth-oriented, and highly execution-driven Practice Manager to lead and scale our Cloud, DevOps, and AI Practice. In this strategic role, you will hold end-to-end accountability for the health, growth, capabilities, and delivery excellence of this specialized business unit.

You will operate at the intersection of business strategy, technology leadership, and talent enablement. As the Practice Manager, you will define our market offerings, support pre-sales engineering to win high-impact enterprise accounts, oversee global delivery frameworks, and cultivate a world-class engineering team. The ideal candidate can confidently pivot between high-level C-suite consulting and deep technical governance across public cloud, continuous integration, and generative AI initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Practice Strategy & Offering Development

  • Define the commercial roadmap, solution offerings, and go-to-market (GTM) strategy for the Cloud, DevOps, and AI practice lines.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging tech trends (e.g., LLMOps, serverless architectures, FinOps, agentic AI workflows) to build highly relevant, repeatable transformation playbooks for enterprise clients.

2. Pre-Sales Support & Revenue Acceleration

  • Partner closely with the Business Development team as the primary technical and strategic authority during early-stage client pursuits.
  • Lead executive discovery workshops, architect high-level solutions, review technical proposals, and construct robust Statements of Work (SOWs).
  • Drive practice-sourced revenue growth by identifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts.

3. Delivery Governance & Quality Assurance

  • Provide leadership, technical direction, and delivery oversight across a portfolio of complex digital transformation projects.
  • Ensure projects are executed on time, within scope, and aligned with enterprise architectural best practices (e.g., Well-Architected Frameworks).
  • Act as the ultimate escalation point for delivery hurdles, working alongside Solution Architects to maintain client satisfaction.

4. Talent Management & Capability Building

  • Attract, mentor, and retain a high-performing team of cloud engineers, DevOps professionals, and AI/Data scientists.
  • Establish structured training programs, clear certification pathways (AWS, Azure, GCP, NVIDIA, Hugging Face), and standard engineering methodologies to keep the practice at the absolute cutting edge.

Requirements & Qualifications

Experience

  • 10 to 14+ years of total IT experience, with at least 3 to 5 years spent in a practice leadership, delivery management, or principal consulting role within a global systems integrator or managed IT services environment.
  • A proven track record of managing a technical business unit, including direct experience driving pre-sales pipelines and hitting utilization/profitability benchmarks.
  • Demonstrated experience successfully steering multi-cloud transformations, agile software delivery initiatives, and enterprise AI production deployments out of sandbox environments.

Technical Fluency

  • Cloud & DevOps: Strong conceptual and strategic understanding of multi-cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), container orchestration (Kubernetes), and modern CI/CD patterns.
  • Artificial Intelligence: solid understanding of Machine Learning lifecycles (MLOps), Generative AI deployment architectures (RAG systems, vector data engineering), and data integration pipelines.
  • Ability to evaluate the commercial feasibility, infrastructure costs, and business ROI of complex technical systems.

Core Competencies

  • Executive Presence: Superb communication, negotiation, and storytelling skills, with comfort acting as a trusted advisor to C-level executives (CIOs, CTOs, CDOs).
  • Operational Excellence: Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage resource allocation, project utilization rates, and global delivery margins effectively.

description:
JOB REQUISITION

St Louis Technology Audit & Advisory Experienced Consultant

LOCATION

ST. LOUIS

ADDITIONAL LOCATION(S)

JOB DESCRIPTION

You Belong Here

The Protiviti Career provides opportunity to learn, inspire, and advance within a collaborative and inclusive culture. We hire curious individuals for whom learning is a passion. We lean into our mission: We Care. We Collaborate. We Deliver.

At every level, we champion leaders who live our values of integrity, inclusion, innovation, and commitment to success. Imagining our work as a journey, we believe integrity guides our way, inclusion moves us forward together, innovation creates new destinations, and our commitment to success empowers us to deliver on our vision to be the most trusted global consulting firm.

Where We Need You:

Protiviti is looking for a Technology Audit & Advisory Experienced Consultant to join our growing team.

What You Can Expect:

As an Experienced Consultant, you’ll be provided excellent training and meaningful mentorship to deepen your understanding of business processes and build technical skills. You’ll conduct interviews, compile, and analyze data, and document findings. Through interaction with client and project team personnel, you’ll develop professional relationships that contribute to exceptional client service. You’ll learn time and project management and take ownership of assignments.

At Protiviti, Technology Audit & Advisory focuses on:

  • Helping clients better manage risks associated with their use of technology, protecting and enhancing enterprise value.

  • Innovation: identifying solutions to client problems related to technology, helping them to rethink how technology processes are managed by incorporating AI and automation.

  • Technology enablement: Incorporating analytics, AI, automation and other new tools and methods in the execution of audit work for our clients, enabling a deeper, broader, more efficient, and more insightful analysis of our clients’ technology risks.

  • Staying current: We support a broad set of potential certifications and related trainings for our team, equipping our technology audit organization to stay at the forefront of emerging risks and trends.


Consultants in Technology Audit & Advisory work with clients to assess, identify risk, advise, and consult on different technology-related topics, including:

  • Cybersecurity

  • Cloud Assurance

  • Project Risk Advisory

  • Technology Risk Management and Assessment

  • IT General Controls (ITGC)

  • AI and Data Governance

  • Data Privacy

  • Technology Regulations

  • Enterprise Applications

  • Technology Resilience

  • IT Sarbanes-Oxley Compliance

  • Emerging Technologies

  • 2nd Line Controls Governance

  • Technology Enablement

What Will Help You Be Successful:

  • You enjoy gathering, summarizing, and examining data.

  • You are motivated to learn and are interested in all things related to data and technology, including the latest trends and developments.

  • You are passionate about contributing to client relationships and providing clients with exceptional experiences.

  • You facilitate teamwork by contributing to team effort, sharing responsibility for team results, and exhibiting a positive attitude.

  • You are eager to learn the client’s business and industry which in turn helps you build out your business knowledge and skills.

  • You have interest in working with a diverse portfolio of clients across multiple industries.

  • You are versed in leveraging AI to enhance personal productivity as well as internal audit and SOX activities, including planning, fieldwork and reporting.

Do Your Talents Include the Following?

Experience with or understanding of:

  • IT audit methodologies and developing necessary audit deliverables, including process flows, work programs, audit reports, and control summaries.

  • Commonly used internal control frameworks, including COBIT, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS, ITIL, etc.

  • Sarbanes-Oxley Act provisions and methodologies for achieving compliance, in particular the technology implications and requirements.

Exposure to and/or interest in:

  • The latest trends and developments in data and technology, including high-growth topics of cybersecurity, cloud, data governance, privacy, analytics, enterprise applications (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Workday, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics etc.), disaster recovery, systems development methodologies etc.

  • Analytics and technology enablement (automation, AI/ML etc.).

  • Experience performing documentation of findings and summarizing recommendations.

Your Educational and Professional Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., Accounting, Finance, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or business-related field).

  • 1+ years working in internal audit, consulting, assurance services, risk and control programs, or related field, either in professional services or industry.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite applications with specific emphasis on Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Secondary emphasis on Visio and Access.

  • Proficiency in PowerBI, Tableau, Alteryx, SQL, Python, and/or RPA Solutions a plus.

  • Professional certification such as CIA, CRMA, CISA, CISM, CISSP, or similar a plus.

Our Hybrid Workplace

Protiviti practices a hybrid model, which is a combination of working in person with a purpose and working remotely. This model creates meaningful experiences for our people and our clients while offering a flexible environment. The ratio of remote to in-person requirements varies by client, project, team, and other business factors. Our people work both in-person in local Protiviti offices and on client sites, which can include local or out-of-state travel based on our projects and client requests and commitments.

Starting salary is based on a full-time equivalent schedule. Placement in the range is dependent upon experience, skills and geographic work location. Below is the salary range for this job.

$62,000.00 - $93,000.00

We offer eligible employees a company 401(k) savings and investment plan with an employer match of 50% on the first 6% of your contributions. title: Ohjaaja
description:
Tule mukaan tekemään merkityksellistä työtä Villa Kukkumäkeen - sinne, missä riittää vilinää ja vilskettä, mutta ennen kaikkea välittämistä ja vahvaa ammattitaitoa!

Etsimme joukkoomme uutta ohjaajaa työskentelemään erityistä tukea tarvitsevien lasten ja nuorten parissa. Villa Kukkumäki on lastensuojelun erityisyksikkö, jossa tehdään intensiivistä ja pitkäjänteistä työtä traumataustaisten, psyykkisesti oireilevien lasten ja nuorten kanssa. Yksikössämme asustelee 7–17-vuotiaita lapsia, joilla on usein jonkin asteisia kehitysviiveitä, neuropsykiatrisia erityispiirteitä ja käytöshäiriöille ominaista oireilua.

Villa Kukkumäen arki on täynnä elämää, tilanteita ja tunnetta – ja juuri siksi se on merkityksellistä. Arkemme rakentuu selkeistä rajoista ja rakkaudesta, yhteisöllisyydestä sekä ennakoitavasta ympäristöstä, jossa jokaisella lapsella on mahdollisuus kasvaa ja kehittyä yksilöllisesti. Työmme tavoitteena on mahdollistaa lapsille ja nuorille eheyttävä arki, jossa lapsi voi kokea tulevansa nähdyksi, kuulluksi ja hyväksytyksi juuri sellaisena kuin on.

Toivomme sinulta:

  • Valmiutta kohdata lasten haastava käyttäytyminen sensitiivisesti ja jämäkästi.

  • Aitoa kiinnostusta työskennellä haastavissa elämäntilanteissa olevien lasten kanssa.

  • Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja, joustavuutta ja paineensietokykyä.

  • Halua sitoutua korjaavien ihmissuhteiden rakentamiseen ja pitkäjänteiseen työskentelyyn.

Odotamme sinulta:

  • Soveltuvaa sosiaali- ja terveysalan tutkintoa (esim. sosionomi, sairaanhoitaja).

  • Kokemusta lastensuojelusta ja erityistä tukea tarvitsevien lasten kanssa työskentelystä.

  • Kiinnostusta tai osaamista traumatyöstä, kiintymyssuhdehäiriöistä ja käyttäytymisen haasteista.

Plussaa, jos sinulla on:

  • Kokemusta neuropsykiatrisesta kuntoutuksesta tai traumaosaamista.

  • Luovaa otetta – ehkä soitat kitaraa, pidät eläimistä, askartelet tai tykkäät metsäretkistä.

Jos haluat tulla osaksi työyhteisöä, jossa vilinä ja vilskekin voi olla voimavara – ja jossa jokaisella on mahdollisuus olla juuri oma itsensä – lähetä hakemuksesi meille!

title: Design Quality Engineer
description:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

If you don’t choose easy and you want to build something way bigger than yourself then, choose the challenge, choose Heidi.

The Role

What you’ll do

As our Design Quality & Compliance Engineer, you’ll sit at the heart of Heidi’s mission to make world-class care faster and safer through intelligent, compliant technology. Reporting into the Legal & Regulatory Affairs team, but working day-to-day within Engineering, you’ll be the key link ensuring our agile software development practices remain fully aligned with global medical device and information security standards.

Your core mission is to help ensure that our software design and development activities meet global medical device requirements, leading the practical implementation of IEC 62304 (software lifecycle), ISO 14971 (risk management), and ISO 13485 (quality management systems) within an agile, iterative environment. You’ll help shape how design inputs, verification, validation, and risk controls are captured, reviewed, and evidenced.

This is a hybrid role for someone who can masterfully implement compliance within a modern, agile software culture, enabling engineering teams to build quickly and safely, while ensuring every release stands up to regulatory scrutiny.

What you'll do

Drive Medical Device Design Control Processes

  • Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of design control processes across the software lifecycle in alignment with IEC 62304, ISO 14971, and ISO 13485.

  • Partner with engineers and product managers to ensure requirements, risk controls, verification, and validation activities are clearly defined, documented, and traceable.

  • Support the creation and maintenance of technical documentation, including requirements specifications, risk management files, verification reports, and change records.

  • Support external ISO 13485 and Notified Body audits, with a focus on Design and Development aspects.

  • Champion compliance in software development by translating complex and opaque IEC/ISO standards into clear, actionable processes that engineering teams can follow.

What we will look for

  • SaMD Experience: Prior experience working on Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) or other regulated healthtech products, ideally in a start-up or scale-up environment.

  • Standards: Strong working knowledge of standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 14971, and ISO 27001, and the ability to apply these in practical, developer-friendly ways.

  • Technical Skills: A solid understanding of technical security domains, including cloud security, access control, network security, and secure software development lifecycles.

  • Proactive & Detail-Oriented: A commitment to quality and the ability to drive tasks to completion in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Collaboration & Communication: Excellent communication skills, enabling you to work effectively with internal teams (engineers, product) and manage external partners (auditors, customers).

  • A Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant scientific, engineering, regulatory, legal, or governance discipline is a plus.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team focused on real-world impact over imaginary valuations and glossy PR. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders, and designers who’ve felt the moral and practical toll of what non-care feels like. True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose to build something that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognise that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it. The work is hard, but you will trust and admire the people you work beside, and rest easy knowing you’re doing the defining work of your career.

We take care of you.

We offer comprehensive private medical and dental cover through Bupa, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a £100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a £500 home office budget, a £700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to £7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year,

Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

title: PostgreSQL Database Administrator
description:
PostgreSQL Database Administrator (Production DBA)

Location: Toronto, ON

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

About Centric Software:

Centric Software® is a global leader, providing an innovative and AI-enabled product-concept-to-commercialization platform for retailers, brands and manufacturers of all sizes. We equip retail, fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home and consumer goods brands with pioneering best-of-breed solutions to plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, sell and replenish products. Our technology powers brands to streamline processes, drive efficiency and operate with confidence in an ever-changing market.

Our story is one of rapid growth, bold ideas and extraordinary opportunities. We’re here to challenge the status quo—and we’re looking for brilliant people who want to do the same. No matter where you are in the world, this is your chance to be part of something exceptional.

Position Summary

We are seeking a PostgreSQL expert to join our R&D Customer Support team as a Production DBA. This role is focused on bringing deep Postgres expertise in-house to analyze, troubleshoot, and improve production database environments, perform root cause analysis on issues ranging from long-running queries to hosting environment problems and heavy traffic scenarios, and ensure our customers’ PostgreSQL deployments remain healthy, performant, and reliable. While the primary focus is production operations, the DBA will also work across development environments as needed to trace issues to their source and collaborate with engineering on fixes.


Position Details

Job title: PostgreSQL Database Administrator (Production DBA)

Team: R&D – Customer Support

Location: Remote (US/Canada)

Employment Type: Full-time

Compensation: $136K USD

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the PostgreSQL expert and primary Production DBA within the R&D Customer Support team, driving the stability, performance, and reliability of customer-facing database environments.

  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) on production incidents spanning query performance, database configuration, infrastructure-level bottlenecks, and traffic/load conditions.

  • Diagnose and resolve complex PostgreSQL performance, availability, and data-integrity issues, including query tuning, index strategy, vacuum/auto vacuum behavior, and lock contention.

  • Troubleshoot and analyze production PostgreSQL systems across diverse hosting environments, ensuring performance, availability, and data integrity.

  • Review execution plans, analyze slow queries, and recommend configuration, schema, or indexing changes to optimize production workloads.

  • Support customers running PostgreSQL across on-premises, cloud (AWS RDS/Aurora, Azure, GCP), and self-managed deployments.

  • Work across development and production environments to trace issues to their source and collaborate with engineering on fixes and product improvements.

  • Advise on high-availability and disaster-recovery architectures including streaming replication, logical replication, failover, backup/restore (pg_basebackup, pgBackRest, WAL-G), and point-in-time recovery.

  • Create and maintain internal knowledge-based articles, runbooks, and best-practice documentation for the support team.

  • Mentor support engineers and developers on Postgres internals, SQL tuning, and operational best practices.

  • Participate in on-call rotation for critical customer escalations as needed.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience as a PostgreSQL DBA, with deep knowledge of Postgres internals (MVCC, WAL, query planner, locking, buffer management) and operational best practices.

  • Proven track record managing PostgreSQL in production environments, including incident response, root cause analysis, and performance optimization under heavy traffic.

  • Strong SQL skills, including query optimization and execution-plan analysis (EXPLAIN / EXPLAIN ANALYZE).

  • Experience with PostgreSQL performance tuning: indexing strategies, autovacuum, connection pooling (PgBouncer), and configuration tuning (postgresql.conf).

  • Experience with high availability and replication: streaming replication, logical replication, Patroni, or equivalent.

  • Experience with backup and recovery tooling such as pgBackRest, WAL-G, pg_basebackup, or Barman.

  • Proficiency with Linux/Unix operating systems and shell scripting (Bash or similar).

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex database concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Located in North America with the ability to work core hours that overlap with the team.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting PostgreSQL on AWS RDS, Aurora Postgres, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, or Google Cloud SQL.

  • Scripting or automation experience in Python, PowerShell, or similar.

  • Familiarity with monitoring/observability tooling (Datadog, New Relic, Prometheus, pganalyze, Sentry).

  • Experience working in a customer-facing or customer-support-adjacent role.

  • Exposure to additional database platforms (Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, MongoDB) and migration experience to/from Postgres.

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and containerized workloads (Kubernetes).


What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days, the successful candidate will have ramped up on our product and support workflows, taken ownership of escalated Postgres cases, and begun contributing to internal documentation and knowledge sharing. Within six months, they will be the go-to Postgres resource for the team, materially reducing time-to-resolution on database-related customer issues and partnering with engineering on product improvements informed by field data.

Centric Software provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status or genetic information.

The AI & Data Delivery Specialist will lead complex, cross-functional initiatives by translating business problems into actionable roadmaps, managing budgets, and aligning stakeholders and teams across the organization.

The ideal candidate has experience in technical project management, preferably in data, analytics, or AI-focused environments, and brings strong expertise in configuring Jira to support effective delivery. This person should also have strong data literacy and practical experience serving as a Scrum Master in an Agile environment.

What you will do:

  • Project Intake & Portfolio Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for new AI and data project requests. Assess incoming projects for business impact, feasibility, and priority. Manage the backlog and continuously reprioritize work as business needs evolve.

  • Jira Administration & Tracking: Own and manage the team’s Jira environment. Build and maintain Kanban and Scrum boards, optimize workflows, configure automation, and use Jira reporting and analytics to monitor capacity and delivery performance.

  • Resource Management & Budgeting: Develop resource plans using internal and external resources and identify additional support as needed. Manage vendor contracts, statements of work (SOWs), and purchase orders/requisitions. Partner with Procurement, IT, and FP&A to track and manage project expenses accurately.

What you will bring:

  • Project Management Experience: 3+ years of experience managing technical projects, with a focus on delivering data products, data pipelines, business intelligence solutions, or AI initiatives.
  • Technical Background / Data Literacy: 2+ years of hands-on experience in a technical data-related role (such as Data Analyst, Data Engineer, or Business Analyst), with a strong understanding of data and analytics concepts.
  • Jira Expertise: Strong experience with backlog and sprint management, workflow and issue tracking, reporting and metrics, and permissions/integrations within Jira.
  • Agile / Scrum Experience: Deep knowledge of Agile Scrum and Kanban methodologies, along with practical experience serving as a Scrum Master for technical teams.

title: SR QA SW ENGINEER 10381-  Layer2/Layer3 Protocol Testing- Python |Data Center Networking
description:
Role Overview:

Experience: 5-10 Years

Role: PRINCIPAL QA SW ENGINEER

We are seeking a highly skilled Solution Test Engineer to validate end-to-end solutions across modern data center and 5G networking environments. This role combines manual and automated testing, ensuring high-quality delivery of IP fabric-based solutions through robust validation frameworks developed in Python and Go (Golang).

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and execute test plans and test cases for complex networking solutions (L2/L3, IP Fabric, EVPN/VXLAN)
  • Validate 5G and data center architectures, including integration, scalability, and performance testing

  • Develop end-to-end solution validation, including interoperability and system-level testing
  • Automate regression, functional, and performance test suites
  • Troubleshoot and debug issues across network, system, and application layers
  • Collaborate with engineering, QA, and product teams to ensure high-quality releases
  • Analyze logs, packet captures, and system behavior to identify root cause issues
  • Support CI/CD pipelines and continuous testing strategy.

Required Skills

Technical

  • Strong programming skills in:
    • Python (must-have)
    • Golang (preferred / strong plus)
  • Solid understanding of:
    • Data center networking (Leaf-Spine, IP Fabric, Clos architectures)

  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Test automation frameworks

Preferred Qualifications

title: Aurinkopaneelien asentaja, Uusimaa
description:
Etsimme nyt asiakasyrityksellemme sähköasentajaa aurinkopaneeliasennuksiin Uudenmaan alueelle.

Työtä tehdään vaihtuvissa kohteissa ympäri Uudenmaan aluetta. Työ vaatii huolellisuutta sekä tarkkuutta ja oma-aloitteista asennetta. Töitä tehdään osittain myös katoilla, joten suotavaa olisi, että et kaihda korkeita paikkoja.

Hakijalta edellytämme sähköasentajan tutkintoa. Työtehtäviin saat kunnon perehdytyksen, mutta arvostamme, mikäli sinulta löytyy aikaisempaa kokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä. Työtehtävässä vaaditaan sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.

Hyvälle tekijälle on tarjolla töitä pitkäksi aikaa, sekä mahdollisuus työllistyä suoraan asiakasyrityksen kirjoille. Tarjoamme osaamistasoasi vastaavan palkkauksen.

Edellytämme hakijoilta:

  • Sähköasentajan koulutusta.
  • Pätevyyskorttien voimassaoloa.
  • Aiempaa kokemusta aurinkopaneelien parista
  • Oma-aloitteisuutta sekä halua kehittyä.
  • B-ajokorttia

Hakijalle tarjoamme:

  • Osaamistasi vastaavan palkkauksen
  • Kattavat työvarusteet
  • Työtehtäviisi perehdytyksen

Mikäli kiinnostuit tehtävästä, haethan mahdollisimman pian, sillä avoimet työpaikat täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si palkkatoivomuksineen oheisen hakulinkin kautta. Huomioithan, että haastattelemme potentiaalisia hakijoita jatkuvasti.

Mestarit Henkilöstöpalvelut Oy on rakennusalan ja talotekniikan toimialoilla toimiva henkilöstöpalveluyritys. Yrityksille tuotamme henkilöstöpalveluratkaisuja vahvalla ammattitaidolla. Työntekijöillemme olemme turvallinen ja luotettava työnantaja ja väylä rakennusalan uusiin haasteisiin. Mestareiden toiminta perustuu vahvoihin kumppanuussuhteisiin ja asiakaslähtöisyyteen.

Teamleder for kvalitetssikring






REMA Distribution søger lige nu en Teamleder for Kvalitetssikringsafdelingen for Frugt og Grønt og Ferskvarer. Har du lyst til at stå i spidsen for en nyoprettet kvalitetssikringsafdeling med ansvar for høj og stabil varekvalitet på frugt, grønt og ferskvarer?


Hos REMA Distribution Danmark A/S søger vi en teamleder, der brænder for kvalitet og for at omsætte krav til løsninger i hverdagen. Du får ansvar for den daglige ledelse af afdelingen, som i dag består af 2 medarbejdere, og en central rolle i samarbejdet med kategoriansvarlige, leverandører, lagre og butikker.



Om jobbet

Som Teamleder får du ansvar for at sikre varekvaliteten fra ankomst på centrallager til varen står i butikken. Stillingen refererer til kategorichefen for Frugt og Grønt, men du vil også få tæt samarbejde med kategorichefen for køl og frost. Dine opgaver bliver bl.a. at:



	
lede og udvikle kvalitetssikringsafdelingen

	
følge op på varekvalitet på centrallager og i butikker

	
Vejlede kollegaer og butikspersonale om kvalitet og optimal varehåndtering

	
håndtere reklamationer, afvigelser og kvalitetsproblemer

	
samarbejde tæt med kategoriansvarlige om standarder og kvalitetsniveau

	
udvikle retningslinjer, procedurer og arbejdsgange

	
bruge data og nøgletal til at identificere forbedringsmuligheder




Hverdagen og kulturen

I hverdagen kan du forvente:



	
En uformel og direkte omgangstone

	
Et arbejdsmiljø præget af tillid, ansvarlighed og ordentlighed

	
En kultur med høj faglig stolthed og fokus på kvalitet - også når tempoet er højt

	
Tæt samarbejde med kolleger i distribution, indkøb, kategori, logistik og butikker

	
En hverdag, hvor både faste kontroller og akutte kvalitetsudfordringer skal håndteres




Vi hjælper hinanden, når der er travlt, og forventer, at du tager ansvar, følger sagerne til dørs og skaber løsninger, der om muligt forbedrer kundeoplevelsen i butikkerne.



Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:



	
har erfaring med frugt og grønt, fersk kød og fisk

	
har erfaring fra detail, engros, produktion eller kvalitetssikring

	
har ledelseserfaring eller potentiale til at tage ledelsesansvar

	
arbejder struktureret og deltager aktivt i den daglige drift

	
er stærk i samarbejde og kommunikation




Kendskab til Microsoft 365 Business Central og Microsoft AX 2009 er en fordel, men ikke et krav.



Vi tilbyder



	
en nøgleposition i en ny afdeling med stort udviklingspotentiale

	
mulighed for at præge processer, arbejdsgange og retning

	
en hverdag tæt på driften, hvor din indsats gør en synlig forskel

	
tæt samarbejde med engagerede kolleger på tværs af organisationen

	
løn og vilkår efter kvalifikationer

title: Chief Cloud Engineer (AWS)
description:
We are in search of a highly skilled Chief Cloud Engineer with deep AWS knowledge to become part of our team.

Serving as an AWS Cloud Cost Optimization Engineer, you will improve visibility into cloud expenses by establishing a data-centric methodology for monitoring, reporting on, and fine-tuning cloud costs. The right fit for this role has real-world experience in DevOps or SRE, extensive know-how in examining and streamlining costs across sizable AWS deployments, a keen interest in data analysis, and strong capabilities in working cooperatively with colleagues company-wide.

Responsibilities

  • Team up with development and engineering units to discover ways to optimize spending, increasing ROI on cloud resources while driving down costs
  • Build a comprehensive grasp of the client's product, how it's architected and deployed in the cloud, and the expenses linked to every segment of the environment
  • Provide direction to architects and engineers on optimizing resources, cutting down waste, planning capacity, and defining KPIs
  • Keep watch over cloud spending patterns to detect sudden increases and irregular usage, then investigate the underlying causes
  • Oversee usage of cloud reservations and savings plans, working in tandem with teams to shift freed-up resources elsewhere
  • Study data trends and outliers to extract insights that inform both high-level strategy and daily operations
  • Uncover savings potential connected to cloud commitment choices (Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, Spot Instances, Committed/Sustained Use) and track how they're being used
  • Detect areas of waste and design realistic strategies to improve efficiency
  • Develop, update, and maintain dashboards, reports, and automated systems for tracking costs, usage, alerts, and projections
  • Build dashboards and automated reporting infrastructure to ensure ongoing compliance with cost objectives
  • Play a role in developing, improving, automating, and governing policies and best practices around cost optimization
  • Share KPI updates and put forward savings recommendations to the relevant stakeholders
  • Work in partnership with engineering teams to validate that cost-reduction efforts are producing the desired outcomes

Requirements

  • A minimum of 7 years of hands-on professional experience with AWS cloud infrastructure, including cost reporting and optimization at a large scale
  • At least 2 years of experience in a leadership or team oversight role
  • Practical experience with AWS EKS and related containerization technologies
  • Proficient with cost tracking and cloud management tools such as AWS Cost Explorer, AWS Cost and Usage Report, AWS Budgets, CloudHealth, AWS Managed Services, Amazon EC2, and Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service
  • Working knowledge of GitHub, Jenkins, and Terraform for managing version control, automation, and infrastructure setup
  • Track record of developing cost optimization dashboards, models, and reports for engineering teams leveraging cloud services
  • Strong attention to detail combined with a real passion for turning data into practical insights
  • Comfortable juggling several projects at once, whether working solo or as part of a team
  • Outstanding communication skills, both written and verbal, capable of engaging technical and non-technical audiences
  • Natural curiosity and willingness to explore and implement new and emerging technologies
  • Proficient written and spoken English at a B2 level or above

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of AWS Lambda for developing serverless applications and automating cost management tasks
  • Hands-on experience with Amazon CloudWatch for monitoring cloud resources and tracking performance indicators
  • Familiarity with Amazon S3 for managing and assessing storage costs and usage patterns
  • Experience with Datadog for monitoring, setting alerts, and visualizing data across cloud infrastructure
  • Applied experience with Python for scripting, automating tasks, and developing custom tools that support cost analysis and reporting

Benefits

  • International projects with top brands
  • Work with global teams of highly skilled, diverse peers
  • Healthcare benefits
  • Employee financial programs
  • Paid time off and sick leave
  • Upskilling, reskilling and certification courses
  • Unlimited access to the LinkedIn Learning library and 22,000+ courses
  • Global career opportunities
  • Volunteer and community involvement opportunities
  • EPAM Employee Groups
  • Award-winning culture recognized by Glassdoor, Newsweek and LinkedIn

		    Begynd din karriere med en elevplads hos Scan Global  Logistics
				


			

Bliv en del af SGL, en verdensomspændende logistikvirksomhed med fokus på den gode kundeoplevelse og et positivt og udviklende arbejdsmiljø. 

Vi transporterer varer over hele verden med fly, skib eller bil, og du kan være med til at planlægge den næste transport. 

Hos os får du mulighed for at lære og udvikle dig, du får ansvar i takt med din udvikling og der er altid en, du kan spørge til råds. 

Det er vigtigt for os, at du fra dag et føler dig velkommen og inkluderet og at vi sammen skaber den bedste uddannelse. 

Så er du klar på en uddannelse med masser af praktisk erfaring, arbejde på tværs af landegrænser og fart på hverdagen? Så er det nu, du skal søge om at blive vores næste speditørelev på et af vores kontorer i Herning eller Viby/Århus. 
Mulighederne venter på dig
Du kommer til at arbejde i teams med erfarne speditører, som er klar til at hjælpe dig igang, give gode råd og støtte op om din udvikling. Vi lægger stor vægt på, at vi skal have det sjovt sammen i en uformel atmosfære, hvor der er plads til at fejle og lære. 

Vores elevforløb er skræddersyet til at udvikle dig til at blive en af de bedste i branchen - og det er vores ambition, at alle vores nyudlærte speditører bliver tilbudt et fast job efter endt uddannelse. Vi vil nemlig gerne både fastholde og udvikle vores egne talenter. 

Citat fra Simon: Der er kun en vej og det er fremad! 

Vi har kontorer i hele verden, så der er mulighed for at gøre karriere både i Danmark og i udlandet. Med mere end 5.100 kollegaer i 60 lande fordelt på over 200 kontorer bliver du en del af et bredt globalt netværk, som kan hjælpe dig med at lykkes i hverdagen.
Hvad laver en speditør?
Som speditørelev hos os er du med til at planlægge, hvordan varer transporteres fra A til B. Med fly fra Kastrup til Hong Kong, med bil fra Viby til Oslo eller måske med søfragt fra Hamburg til New York, ønskerne fra vores kunder er mange....og vi løser dem med et smil!

Har du, hvad der skal til?

Spedition handler om mennesker, så det er vigtigt, at du er god til at tale med andre, kan finde løsninger og tænke hurtigt. Den gode kundeoplevelse er nøglen til din og vores succes, og så forventer vi, at du er en god kollega med mod på nye udfordringer. Resten lærer vi dig.
Bliv en del af holdet
Selve speditøruddannelsen finder sted på et af vores kontorer i Danmark og er et toårigt kontor-forløb med speciale i vejtransport, sø- eller luftfragt. Uddannelsen veksler mellem teori og praktik, med fokus på masser af praktisk erfaring i dagligdagen. Vi samler alle vores elever fra hele landet flere gange for at skabe et stærkt netværk og for, at du kan lære om alle kroge af vores virksomhed. 
Din baggrund
Du har gennemført en HHX, STX, HTX, HF eller EUX. 
Har du en STX, HTX eller HF, skal du tage et fem ugers supplerende EUS-kursus.


Du har kørekort til bil (kategori B).

Du taler og skriver både dansk og engelsk på et højt niveau.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du har haft et studiejob, som har givet dig en handels- og forretningsmæssig forståelse eller haft et længerevarende ophold i udlandet.

Send din ansøgning allerede nu. Vi holder samtaler løbende og forventer, at starte elevforløb op hurtigst muligt. 

Vi søger elever til vores kontorer i Herning eller Viby/Århus.

Vi håber, at høre fra dig!

title: Analyst-Compliance GFCSU Testing
description:
The Global Risk & Compliance (GRC) organization serves as American Express’ independent risk management function. GRC maintains the enterprise risk framework, provides oversight and challenge, and monitors key risks. By embedding risk discipline into strategy and operations, GRC enables responsible growth, innovation, and long-term value creation while protecting customers and shareholders.

American Express’s Global Financial Crimes Surveillance Unit (GFCSU) and the US Investigations Unit (USIU) are part of the broader Global Risk & Compliance organization, operating within Global Financial Crimes Compliance (GFCC). Together, they provide end-to-end oversight and support of global financial crimes investigations. In partnership with GFCC, GFCSU and USIU develop and implement transaction monitoring rules, reports, and other tools to detect potential criminal activity. They investigate suspicious financial behavior and, when necessary, file Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) with the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) or refer cases to internal compliance partners for global reporting. These teams also manage risk related to politically exposed persons (PEPs) through sanctions screening and enhanced due diligence processes, as well as improper payments that may signal bribery, corruption, or other illicit conduct. GFCSU and USIU play a vital role in ensuring compliance with key regulations, including the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), USA PATRIOT Act, and the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act. They also support law enforcement by providing critical information to combat money laundering, terrorist financing, credit card fraud, identity theft, and other financial crimes.

They investigate suspicious financial behavior and, when necessary, file Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) with the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) or refer cases to internal compliance partners for global reporting. These teams also manage risk related to politically exposed persons (PEPs) through sanctions screening and enhanced due diligence processes, as well as improper payments that may signal bribery, corruption, or other illicit conduct. GFCSU and USIU play a vital role in ensuring compliance with key regulations, including the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), USA PATRIOT Act, and the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act. They also support law enforcement by providing critical information to combat money laundering, terrorist financing, credit card fraud, identity theft, and other financial crimes.

  • Support the GFCC Enablement transaction monitoring testing team by conducting time-sensitive alert activity reviews across multiple jurisdictions and countries

  • Analyze large quantities of information to validate rule design and performance, and conduct data analysis to support process optimizations and deployments plans

  • Work closely with partner teams to establish test plans and discuss testing outcomes

  • Recommend improvements to rule logic, parameters, and data inputs to enhance detection criteria and/or new processes

  • Produce well-written reports detailing testing outcomes, defect documentation, and testing recommendations

  • Contribute thought leadership and creative problem-solving to deliver process optimizations, drive impactful solutions, and support inventory needs

  • Source and leverage actionable insights and user feedback to identify and inform decision-making

  • Develop and maintain documentation to enable accurate and thorough records of activities, supporting accountability and traceability

  • Provide AML testing support across the wider testing team as needed

  • 2+ years’ experience within Global Financial Crimes (Anti-Money Laundering investigations experience preferred) or experience in other risk-based testing teams

  • Experience with business needs and requirements testing is an asset

  • Strong understanding of the risks and regulatory considerations associated with process design

  • Demonstrate a keen attention to detail in investigation, analysis, and writing.

  • Proven ability to build and leverage relationships, strong presentation and communication skills and an ability to communicate effectively

title: Salesforceutvecklare Stockholm
description:
Sopra Steria har en stark position inom Salesforce i Europa och vi letar nu efter fler duktiga Salesforce-utvecklare som vill vara med och bygga framtidens digitala lösningar. Vi är stolta över att vara Summit Partner med Salesforce och en heltäckande digitaliseringspartner för våra kunder. Nu söker vi dig som vill vara med på vår resa och bidra till innovativa lösningar som gör skillnad!

Vad du kommer att bidra med
Som Salesforce-utvecklare kommer du att vara en viktig spelare när det gäller att designa, implementera och förvalta Salesforce-lösningar för våra kunder. Din roll innebär att skapa skräddarsydda lösningar som effektiviserar affärsprocesser och skapar långsiktigt värde. Dessutom kommer du att vara med och integrera Salesforce med andra system och applikationer för att skapa en sömlös upplevelse. Vi söker dig som:

  • Har cirka 3 års arbetslivserfarenhet av en liknande roll.
  • Har bra koll på Salesforce, inklusive Salesforce Lightning Experience, Apex och Lightning Web Components.
  • Har erfarenhet av att integrera Salesforce med andra system och appar.
  • Behärskar svenska och engelska flytande, både tal och skrift.
  • Är certifierad inom Salesforce (meriterande).

Varför du kommer att trivas hos oss
Hos oss på Sopra Steria handlar det inte bara om att ha ett jobb – här får du möjlighet att växa, utvecklas och verkligen bidra till samhällets digitalisering. Vi tror på frihet under ansvar för en bra balans mellan jobb och fritid!

Vi är dessutom stolta över att ha blivit utsedda till Sveriges bästa arbetsplats av Great Place to Work, där vi fick toppbetyg i kamratskap, arbetsglädje och stolthet. Hos oss får du möjligheten att jobba med riktigt spännande projekt i Europas ledande digitaliseringsbolag. Läs mer om oss här

Bli en del av vårt team!
Låter det här som en plats där du kan blomstra? Tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan! Vi läser ansökningar och kallar till intervju löpande. Rekryteringsprocessen består av tre intervjuer och ett logiskt- och personlighetstest.

På Sopra Steria ställer vi höga krav på både kompetens och säkerhetsmedvetenhet hos våra medarbetare. Innan en eventuell anställning kommer du därför att genomgå en bakgrundskontroll, och vid intervju behöver du kunna uppvisa giltig legitimation.

Har du frågor om rollen? Hör gärna av dig till ansvarig rekryterare, Theresia Wiclander på theresia.wiclander@soprasteria.com.

Vi ser fram emot att höra ifrån dig!
