 Job Description 

 Just imagine helping warehouses and factories around the world run smoothly through software that supports the production and movement of LEGO® products. Then make it real. 

  

 You will help support, enhance, and expand SAP-based warehouse applications used across global warehouses and factories. You'll work on new features, warehouse expansions and integrations with vendor systems, while partnering with business users and engineers to create reliable solutions that deliver value in day-to-day operations. You'll be part of the Manufacturing and Supply Chain Technology area within the LEGO Group, supporting warehousing, logistics and material handling solutions. 

  
 Required Qualifications  
 
 Experience within software development, testing, SAP customising, engineering or a related discipline 
 

 
 Hands-on experience with automated testing and documentation 
 

 
 Understanding of the software development lifecycle and how solutions are delivered 
 

 
 Experience in warehousing, logistics, manufacturing or a similar operational environment 
 

 
 Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues. 
 

 
 Familiarity with agile ways of working, combined with a curious and adaptable mindset 
 
 
  
 Preferred Qualifications  
 
 Knowledge of SAP Customising 
 

 
 Knowledge of SAP ABAP 
 

 
 Experience with warehousing operations 
 

 
 Experience with production or manufacturing environments 
 
 
  
 What you'll build (your key responsibilities)  
 
 Support, enhance and expand SAP-based warehouse applications used globally 
 

 
 Design, test and implement new functionality for warehouse operations and expansions 
 

 
 Support end users and help resolve operational challenges 
 

 
 Participate in projects where warehouse solutions are involved or affected 
 

 
 Collaborate with engineers and offshore teams to deliver scalable, high-quality solutions 
 

 
 Create and maintain documentation and test cases for new developments 
 

 
 Work closely with product management, users and colleagues to maximise business value 
 
 
  

 If you've worked in a role where you've connected technology with operational business needs, you'll feel at home here. What matters most is your ability to learn, collaborate, understand users, and create sustainable solutions that make a difference. 

  
 Life on the team 
 You'll join a team focused on warehousing and site logistics within Manufacturing and Supply Chain Technology. Together, the team supports warehouses and factories around the world with software solutions that help produce, handle and move LEGO® products efficiently. You'll work closely with colleagues who combine technology expertise with a strong understanding of operational processes. 

  
 What success looks like 
 Success in this role means creating dependable solutions that support warehouse operations, improving user experiences, and contributing to technology decisions that have a meaningful impact across manufacturing sites and warehouses. You'll collaborate closely with engineers, product management and business stakeholders while helping shape how software supports global operations in the years ahead.

title: Inventory Planning Associate (IPA)
description:
At Globe, our goal is to create a wonderful world for our people, business, and nation. By uniting people of passion who believe they can make a difference, we are confident that we can achieve this goal.

Job Description

Customer Experience Management:
Applies knowledge of Globe products, services, and related processes and policies in order to effectively support Customer Experience Ambassadors, Sales and Service Specialists, and Cashiers in fulfilling customer requests and resolving issues.

Inventory Management:
Safeguards and monitors the movement of store's total inventory to ensure availability of stocks for selling and maintaining zero variance.

Customer Experience Management:

* Answers queries of customers (whether external or internal) about Globe products, promos, and/or processes.

* Updates the team on status of inventory items.

* Ensures sufficient inventory stock level to avoid stock out.

Inventory Management:

* Physically counts manual accountable forms with signature.

* Counts available stocks, matches it with previous day's stock count sheet and report discrepancies, if any.

* Monitors aging stocks.

* Issues correct stocks and assigns to specialist via MTPOS.

* Updates the team on status of inventory items.

* Ensures sufficient inventory stock level to avoid stock out.

* Coordinates with other custodians to source out customers' required stocks.

* Follows the FIFO (first in, first out) policy when getting/assigning stocks.

* Updates SIR upon every issuance of stocks to specialists.

* Performs physical count of stocks delivered and matches details with delivery documents.

* Accepts delivery of items by signing GTS (delivery receipt) in the presence of the courier.

* Updates receipt of delivery items in MTPOS.

* Forecasts store's stock level requirement of inventory items for selling based on price bulletin/hero offers.

* Triggers request of needed inventory items.

* Monitors, executes, and completes the ECPay machine SIM inventory procedure, ensuring accurate reporting in strict compliance with the cascaded process.

title: Raskaan kaluston asentaja

-Työn aloituksen heti oikean henkilön löydyttyä

-Mahdollisuuden työllistyä hyvään duuniin

title: Network & Security Operations Engineer - Federal Government
description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What you’ll be doing..

As a Network and Security Operations Engineer, you will manage, secure, and optimize our hybrid network and cloud operations supporting business-critical infrastructure for Federal Government clients in Canberra. In this role, you will take hands-on ownership of operational and security tasks, proactively mitigate risks, resolve complex incidents within SLA timeframes, and ensure high service availability and reliability.

Responsibilities:

  • Providing Level 2 support, including the installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and continuous monitoring of enterprise network and security hardware and software.

  • Maintaining high uptime for business-critical services by systematically resolving incidents within defined SLA boundaries and performing smooth escalations.

  • Proactively applying security patches and carrying out routine system upgrades to harden the environment and prevent security breaches.

  • Evaluating security infrastructure, identifying potential risks, and providing actionable remediation recommendations to clients to address security gaps.

  • Collaborating across end-users, partners, and stakeholders to resolve security and network issues efficiently while minimizing operational downtime.

  • Authoring and maintaining comprehensive technical documentation, including operational policies, support guides, and procedural runbooks.

You enjoy solving tough technical problems, keeping network ecosystems secure, and keeping business-critical services running smoothly. You are a proactive engineer with deep hands-on expertise across routing, switching, security appliances, and enterprise network hardening.

You’ll need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.

  • Four or more years of relevant work experience in Network and Security operations or support.

  • Hands-on technical experience with networking protocols (TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, IPSec) and concepts (Routing, VPNs, VLANs, NAT, and Software-Defined Access/SDA).

  • Practical expertise with core security technologies, including Firewalls, Proxy/CASB, IDS/IPS, Load Balancing, Remote Access, Antivirus, and DLP solutions.

Even better if you have:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field.

  • Active ITIL certification or practical experience operating within an ITIL-aligned service management environment.

  • Working knowledge of enterprise cloud platforms, specifically AWS and Azure.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a proven track record of managing stakeholder expectations and explaining complex technical issues.

  • A collaborative, proactive mindset with a drive to mentor junior engineers and excel in dynamic, high-pressure environments.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

title: Strategic Projects Lead - Legal
description:
About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development.

We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it. Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve.

This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Since raising our $30M Series A at a $300M valuation, AfterQuery has grown well over a $100M revenue run rate.

We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity:
We were one of the fastest-growing YC companies in our batch, and we believe we can become one of the fastest-growing YC companies of all time.

Founding Impact:
You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth:
Competitive salary and meaningful equity. As we scale, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the engineering organization and lead major technical initiatives.

Strong Team:
Our founding team has experience from Citadel Securities, Meta, Google, Silver Lake, and Morgan Stanley — work alongside world-class engineers and researchers.

Overview

Responsibilities

  • Project and client management: Partner directly with frontier AI labs on their legal data and evaluation needs — scoping the problem, translating it into a deliverable program, and driving revenue.

  • Manage expert contractor teams: Recruit and lead practicing attorneys and specialists across practice areas and jurisdictions — litigation, corporate and M&A, regulatory, IP, tax, employment — and hold a high bar on the quality of what they produce.

  • Shape AI training: Design the specifications behind legal reasoning datasets, contract and document review tasks, statutory and case-law interpretation problems, multi-step research workflows, and the rubrics used to grade them.

  • Define what "correct" means: Build the grading standards and evaluation criteria that let a lab distinguish real legal reasoning from confident-sounding error, including citation integrity and jurisdictional accuracy.

  • End-to-end execution: Own projects from scoping through final delivery, in a fast-moving environment where the spec often does not exist yet.

  • Operational impact: Support initiatives across building, analysis, coordination, and

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years practicing law at a leading firm, in-house at a sophisticated company, a government or regulatory body, or a legal AI startup.

  • JD (or equivalent qualification) and a track record of substantive legal work: you have drafted, negotiated, litigated, or advised, not just coordinated.

  • Deep command of legal reasoning and research methodology, and strong opinions about what separates rigorous analysis from surface-level answers.

  • High agency and the ability to execute in ambiguity; comfort defining the problem before solving it.

  • Analytical ability; can break down complex legal problems and work flows into component parts.

  • Genuine passion for AI and interest in entrepreneurship.

  • Demonstrated track record of competitive success.

  • Strong leadership and communication skills.

  • Comfort with data and AI tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Python proficiency or hands-on experience with data analysis.

  • Experience with legal technology, e-discovery, contract analytics, or AI-assisted legal workflows.

  • Depth in a technically demanding practice area (securities, antitrust, tax, patent prosecution, complex regulatory).

  • Multi-jurisdictional or non-US legal experience.

  • Experience using AI tools to automate workflows and build products.

title: Senior Engineer - Carbon Management (Roads)
description:
Your Team
Our Roads Net Zero team sits within our wider Roads group and guides clients and colleagues through transport and infrastructure decarbonisation, embedding carbon thinking at the heart of our projects.
We deliver carbon assessment and management for transport infrastructure projects; quantifying and assessing carbon to inform strategies and plans, provide carbon management reporting and develop carbon management policies and advice for clients.
Since its inception three years ago, our Transport Net Zero team has led industry change—authoring the Department for Transport’s Quantifiable Carbon Reduction guidance; working with Sub‑National Transport Bodies to develop baseline emissions models and support regional decarbonisation strategies; advising local authority clients; and developing carbon management policies for major transport programmes and organisations.
As one of the largest suppliers of professional services to various clients, we influence change through client engagement, we invest heavily in R&D to drive innovation across decarbonisation and climate resilience. Our current frameworks and strategic partnerships spanning National Highways (SDF), National Gird (GGP) work and other frameworks provide a strong platform for impact and growth.
Joining the team at this critical time for climate action presents a great opportunity to influence transport policies, shape WSP’s and our client’s decarbonisation approaches, and play a meaningful role on the national pathway to net zero.

You will be responsible for:
·Leading and support carbon management inputs for highways and multidisciplinary infrastructure projects across all stages of design.
·Acting as the Carbon Lead on projects, embedding PAS 2080 principles, coordinating low-carbon solutions with the Client, ECI contractors and suppliers.
·Challenging designs to identify opportunities for carbon reduction and climate resilience.
· Developing and apply carbon assessment methodologies, governance and tools.
·Advising clients on low‑carbon innovation and climate‑resilient opportunities. Identifying and implementing innovative processes and materials for projects.
·Contributing Net Zero inputs into strategic pursuits and proposals, including coordinating and preparing technical and commercial responses.
·Helping build WSP Net Zero process, fostering a collaborative, 'carbon conscious' culture across our Roads and wider T&I teams.
·Supporting technical development and upskilling of colleagues, including technical leadership and assurance of deliverables
·Contributing to continual improvement and business development within the Roads Net Zero team and National Carbon management activities.
·Reporting achieved carbon reductions back to the client through internal WSP carbon processes.

What we will be looking for you to demonstrate…

  • •Experience in carbon assessments and management of transport infrastructure, including familiarity with PAS 2080
    •Muiti-discipline Experience in infrastructure projects in design life cycle including construction
    •Experience in technical leadership of projects, with an associated client facing role
    •An understanding of the principles of Net Zero in a transport context
    •Confidence in working in complex project teams (often cross-discipline) and ability to upskill staff on best practices in carbon reduction
    •Good written and verbal communication skills
    •Confidence in adapting complex information into concise, plain-language summaries
    •A deep interest and passion for delivering Net Zero

Desired Skills

  • Project management
  • Financial management

Qualifications

  • You will have a bachelor’s or post-graduate degree in Civil Engineering /Environmental Engineering or equivalent with 5+ years post-graduate experience
  • Working towards a recognised professional qualification.

BGV:

  • Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.

  • Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About the Team
Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.
Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉
We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.
But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs, to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who is passionate about solving high impact problems in a fast paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category mgmt., marketing, operations, finance, etc to bring a new product to life.

What will you do

  • Market & Customer Understanding: Understand the e-commerce market and needs of customers/sellers deeply through landscape analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
  • Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
  • Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritized problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engg., business, etc. Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
  • Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (design, engineering, business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
  • Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
  • Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
  • Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3-month forward looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.
  • Team Leadership: Manage a small team of product analysts and associate product managers, and guide them towards product execution.

    • What you will need

  • Overall experience of 7+ yrs with atleast 4+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company (consumer internet space is preferred)
  • Exceptional problem solving skills based on first principles thinking
  • Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps

title: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer, Domain Enablement (R5536)
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Job Description:

The Senior Data & Analytics Engineer is a hybrid builder role focused on enabling business domains onto the Databricks platform by developing governed Silver and Gold assets, reusable semantic patterns, and domain-ready analytical models. This role sits between pure data engineering and pure analytics engineering: it requires enough technical depth to work comfortably with transformations and lakehouse patterns, and enough business fluency to build trustworthy models that business stakeholders can use and extend.

Initial focus for this role is expected to be G&A and GTM-oriented domains such as Accounting, Program Finance, RevOps, Marketing, HR, and adjacent business functions, while remaining flexible enough to support more complex future domains such as Product or Engineering as the team matures. This role is not a dashboard factory; it is responsible for durable, governed datasets and semantic assets that accelerate domain self-service while maintaining enterprise consistency.

What you'll do:

    • Build and maintain Silver and Gold data models, domain marts, curated datasets, and semantic assets for priority domains onboarding to Databricks.

    • Partner directly with business stakeholders to translate domain requirements and KPI definitions into governed, testable, and reusable transformation logic.

    • Apply enterprise modeling standards, naming conventions, semantic definitions, and promotion rules, contributing practical improvements back into those standards.

    • Create reusable domain patterns and analytical building blocks that allow teams such as FP&A, RevOps, and Marketing to operate more self-service over time.

    • Support the design of semantic views and curated layers that can be consumed by BI tools, Databricks SQL, and Genie or related AI/BI experiences.

    • Work across domain boundaries when metrics overlap or interact, especially where G&A, GTM, workforce, and product-adjacent concepts intersect.

    • Ensure data sensitivity, classification, and approved use are reflected in modeling choices, joins, and semantic exposure, particularly for regulated or restricted datasets.

    • Review and refine partner-delivered or domain-contributed data models to ensure they are production-worthy, understandable, and aligned with enterprise definitions.

    • Help domain teams grow into more self-service analytics by providing patterns, documentation, examples, and technical guidance rather than permanently centralizing every request.

    Required qualifications:

      • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, BI engineering, data engineering, or a hybrid role spanning modeling and transformation work.

      • Strong dimensional modeling and semantic design skills, including facts, dimensions, grain, conformed dimensions, and business-friendly analytical structures.

      • Strong SQL skills and comfort working with modern cloud data platforms such as Databricks.

      • Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into precise, auditable, and reusable data models.

      • Enough data engineering fluency to work comfortably in Silver-to-Gold transformations, testing, performance tuning, and production deployment contexts.

      • Ability to understand the business meaning and usage constraints of the data being modeled, not just the technical transformations involved.

      • Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with business stakeholders in domains with evolving definitions and priorities.

      Preferred qualifications:

        • Experience in finance, program finance, RevOps, marketing analytics, HR analytics, product analytics, or another cross-functional business domain.

        • Experience building modular, tested transformation pipelines on Databricks (SQL/pyspark, Delta Live Tables, or equivalent).

        • Experience with semantic layer tooling, governed metrics, or AI/BI consumption layers.

        • Experience in regulated or security-sensitive industries.

        • Ability and interest to expand from initial G&A/GTM domain focus into more technical domains such as Product or Engineering over time.

        #LC

        Full-time regular employee offer package:

title: Levyseppähitsaaja
description:
Etsimme ammattitaitoista levyseppähitsaajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen asiakkaallemme Timeka Oy:lle Mynämäkeen.

Timeka Oy on suomalainen konepajayritys, joka on erikoistunut mm. koneistukseen ja vaativien metallikomponenttien valmistukseen. Yrityksellä on moderni ja monipuolinen konekanta, mikä mahdollistaa sekä yksittäiskappaleiden että pienten sarjojen laadukkaan tuotannon. Timekalla hitsataan asiakkaille räätälöityjä koneiden ja laitteiden osia. Materiaaleihin kuuluvat niin musta rauta, alumiini kuin hapon kestävä teräs. Toiminta perustuu laatuun, toimitusvarmuuteen ja joustavaan palveluun. Timeka Oy:lla työskentelet osana ammattitaitoista ja mutkatonta tiimiä nykyaikaisessa tuotantoympäristössä.

Työtehtävät

Pääset työskentelemään laaja-alaisesti konepajatuotannon parissa ja tehtäväkenttääsi voidaan muokata aiemman kokemuksesi ja vahvuuksiesi mukaan. Työpäiväsi koostuvat muun muassa:

- Levyosien ja metallirakenteiden valmistuksesta piirustusten mukaan
- Mustan raudan hitsauksesta (pääsääntöisesti 4–8 mm ainevahvuuksilla)
- Osien kokoonpanosta, mittauksesta ja huolellisesta viimeistelystä
- Laadunvarmistuksesta asiakkaan tarkkojen laatukriteerien mukaisesti
- Muista konepajan monipuolisista ylläpito- ja valmistustehtävistä

Mitä toivomme sinulta? Etsimme tiimiin tekijää, jolla on jo näyttöä levyseppähitsaajan tehtävistä sekä aito palo kehittyä alan vahvaksi ammattilaiseksi.

- Sujuva piirustustenlukutaito on tehtävässä menestymisen edellytys.
- Arvostamme huolellista, tarkkaa ja oma-aloitteista otetta työhön.
- Sopeudut joustavasti vaihteleviin tilanteisiin ja puhallat yhteen hiileen muun tiimin kanssa.
- Työskentelet sujuvasti suomen kielellä.
- Työtä tehdään pääsääntöisesti päivävuorossa, mutta odotamme sinulta valmiutta tarvittaessa myös kaksivuorotyöhön.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

- Vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työn vakavaraisessa konepajayrityksessä
- Kilpailukykyisen, osaamistasi vastaavan palkkauksen
- Nykyaikaiset ja laadukkaat MIG/MAG- ja TIG-hitsauslaitteet sekä modernin työympäristön
- Mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi vaativien ja räätälöityjen asiakastilausten parissa
- Innostavan ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön sekä esihenkilöt, jotka arvostavat laadukasta työnjälkeä ja tukevat ammatillista kehittymistäsi

title: Market Strategist, North America Power Transmission
description:

Job Description:

About us

Our purpose is to bring together people, energy and markets to power and navigate a changing world. In a time of constant change and possibility we need new talent to pursue commercial opportunities, fueled by world-class insight and expertise. We’re always striving for more innovative digital solutions, sustainable outcomes and closer collaboration across our company and beyond, and you could be part of that too. Together we continue to grow as the world’s leading energy company!

About the role

The Trade Analytics & Insights team supports commercial teams across London, Singapore, New York and Houston. We are seeking a Transmission Market Strategist to join the NY Gas & Power trading team, working in a fast-paced front-office environment.

This role is fully embedded with traders and a cross-discipline team of strategists passionate about understanding, forecasting and monetising transmission congestion across major US power markets. You will combine deep transmission market expertise with quantitative and fundamental analysis to support commercial decision-making, embed insights into fundamental models, and construct and develop trading strategy.

Working at the intersection of trading, analytics and technology, you will act as a key link between traders, market strategists, data strategists and technology teams, helping transform transmission market expertise into scalable analytical solutions.

As a strategist specialising in transmission, you will explain, model and predict relevant congestion patterns and forecast price running simulations of various ISOs (PJM, MISO, ERCOT) using tools (Dayzer, PowerWorld). You will work side-by-side with traders, contributing insight, shaping strategy development, and its commercial application. Trading activity can occur in the monthly CRR/FTR auctions, virtuals and in the Day Ahead and Real-Time markets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Forecast congestion, nodal pricing and transmission risk across major US ISOs including PJM, MISO and ERCOT
  • Work with traders to develop analytical frameworks used to understand congestion drivers and market behaviour.
  • Work with other power strategists to ensure network models and assumptions are fit for purpose for other price and stack models in use on the team (eg Dayzer, PyPSA).
  • Analyse transmission, outage, weather, generation and market datasets.
  • Support the development of fundamental outlooks as shaped by transmission understanding in the near and long term.
  • Monitor changes in power markets by following regulatory developments and participating in ISO interested party meetings.
  • Identify trade strategies for the CRR / FTR auctions.
  • Work collaboratively across regions sharing research, tools, and best practices
  • Build strong partnerships with traders and technology to implement robust, scalable, production-ready solutions.

Essential education, experience and requirements

  • A degree in Electrical Engineering with a Power Systems focus (degrees in other quantitative fields such as Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, etc. will be considered)
  • Demonstrated experience analysing transmission congestion, binding constraints, power flows and nodal pricing.
  • Strong understanding of one or more major US ISOs and the drivers of congestion and price formation.
  • Undergraduate in STEM degree from a top-class institution.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and experience working with large datasets.
  • Experience using transmission and power market modelling tools such as Dayzer, PowerWorld.
  • Ability to apply rigorous statistical thinking to forecasting, backtesting and risk assessment.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable trading insights.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with traders, market strategists, quantitative researchers and technology teams.

title: Senior D365 F&O Developer
description:
JOB TITLE: Senior D365 F&O Developer
WORK LOCATION: Bangalore, India
WORKING MODE: Hybrid (3 days office)
TYPE OF EMPLOYMENT: Contract (1-2 years)

SUMMARY:

The D365FO Developer, Software Engineer will be a member of Eurofins’ global D365 delivery team, contributing to the design, development, customization, integration, and performance optimization of solutions within the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365FO/SCM) ecosystem. The role works closely with solution architects, technical leads, functional consultants, QA, data, and integration teams to deliver high-quality, scalable, high-performing, and compliant technical solutions aligned with the global D365 program roadmap.

This role is responsible for developing and maintaining D365FO customizations, extensions, and integrations, as well as supporting related .NET applications and services hosted on Microsoft Azure. The successful candidate will actively participate in design discussions, sprint execution, code reviews, testing, deployments, performance testing, and production support, ensuring solutions meet functional requirements, performance expectations, and Eurofins’ development standards.

As part of the D365 program, the D365FO Developer will collaborate with cross-functional IT teams and external implementation partners to ensure consistent technical implementation, strong system integration, and adherence to ALM, CI/CD, and SDLC best practices. A solid technical understanding of D365FO/SCM, X++, Azure services, Power Platform, SQL Server, and integration patterns is essential, along with hands-on experience delivering enterprise-scale solutions in complex, international environments.


POSITION & OBJECTIVES:

Solution Development: Design, develop, and maintain D365FO extensions and customizations using X++, as well as supporting .NET-based components and services within the D365 ecosystem,
Integrations & Interfaces: Develop and support integrations between D365FO and external systems using APIs, Azure integration services, data entities, and middleware platforms (eESB),
Technical Design & Collaboration: Work closely with solution architects, technical leads, and functional consultants and business analysts to translate business requirements into robust technical designs and implementations,
Code Quality & Best Practices: Ensure clean, efficient, and maintainable code following Microsoft and Eurofins development standards, including extensibility, performance, and security best practices,
Performance & Scalability: Proactively identify, analyze, and resolve performance bottlenecks across D365FO layers (application, batch, integrations, database, SQL), ensuring scalable and responsive solutions,
Testing & Quality Assurance: Support unit testing, integration testing, regression testing (RSAT or similar), performance testing (JMeter or similar), and bug fixing activities to ensure stable and reliable solutions across environments,
ALM & CI/CD Participation: Actively contribute to Azure DevOps processes, including source control, build and release pipelines, code reviews, and deployment activities,
Production Support & Optimization: Assist in Go-Live activities, hyper care, and ongoing production support, including issues troubleshooting, performance tuning, root cause analysis, and continuous optimization,
Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Maintain accurate technical documentation and actively share knowledge with team members to support long-term solution sustainability.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

Minimum 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer or Developer in enterprise application environments, with strong hands-on experience in D365FO/SCM development,
Solid experience developing D365FO solutions using X++, extensions, data entities, workflows, and security frameworks,
Proven experience in performance troubleshooting and optimization across D365FO layers, including application logic, batch processing, integrations, database design, and SQL execution,
Strong SQL Server knowledge, including query analysis, indexing strategies, execution plans, and performance tuning in ERP-scale databases,
Knowledge of JMeter or other performance testing tools for D365FO is a strong advantage,
Practical experience with system integrations, data migration concepts, and enterprise integration patterns within ERP landscapes,
Familiarity with Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate) and Power BI/Fabric from a technical integration or extension perspective is an advantage,
Strong knowledge of Git is a must,
Strong knowledge of Azure DevOps is a must, including version control, branching strategies, build/release pipelines (CI/CD), and work item tracking,
Azure cloud administration skills and AKS/Kubernetes skills are a plus,
Ability to work effectively in agile or hybrid delivery models, collaborating closely with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams,
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to debug complex performance and scalability issues across multiple systems,
Good communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders when required,
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, Software Engineering, or a related field,
Excellent command of English, both written and spoken.

Additional Information

title: Senior Research Technologist - Lucas-McAllister Lab
description:
This is an exciting opportunity for an energetic, ambitious, and creative individual to help shape the future of a discovery-oriented biomedical research laboratory. The primary research focus of the lab centers on the interaction of cancer with the immune system. We are searching for an individual to take a major role in operations for this expanding team. The lab is jointly directed by senior Principal Investigators:

Dr. Peter Lucas - Vice Chair for Research, Department of Laboratory Medicine and Pathology

Dr. Linda McAllister - Enterprise Deputy Director, Pediatric Cancer Programs, Mayo Clinic Comprehensive Cancer Center

The successful candidate will work closely with our group, which includes a Principal Research Technologist, a Senior Program Coordinator Administrative Leader, Senior Research Scientists, Post-Doctoral fellows and PhD Student Trainees.

The candidate we seek will:

- Support lab member projects via method development, conduction of experiments, data analysis and interpretation

- Design and complete experiments geared towards research objectives of the lab

- Assist in routine laboratory operations including ordering, regulatory documentation/compliance (chemical safety, biosafety, IACUC and IRBs), personnel training, equipment/reagent management and maintenance 

- Have strong organizational and record keeping skills, as well as the ability to accurately collect, store and interpret research data

- Contribute to manuscript and grant writing

- Present at research laboratory meetings

Additional Job Responsibilities:

1. Assists in design of experiments and protocols. Executes experimental studies in support of lab goals.

2. Demonstrates a basic understanding of lab practices.

3. Performs experiments according to established procedure and under the direction of senior lab personnel.

4. Keeps detailed log of experimental procedures.

5. Trains lab personnel in lab techniques.

6. Maintains equipment and supplies.

7. Assists in the selection of instrumentation and computer software and hardware.

8. Collects, documents and analyzes data.

9. Presents at lab meetings.

10. Reports difficulties in experimentation and data collection and follows through with protocol modifications.

11. Troubleshoots problems using established or novel experimental procedures.

12. Communicates effectively during team meetings about research design and results interpretation.

13. Maintains inventory of supplies, chemicals, animals, in a written or electronic format.

14. Provides training on the use of instrumentation and methods.

15. Maintains governmental laboratory regulations and standards (i.e., IRB, IACUC, OSHA, Bio-safety, etc.).

16. Contributes to IACUC or IRB protocols.

17. Interacts and negotiates with supply and equipment vendors.

18. Prepares graphs, tables and figures for grants and manuscripts.

19. Interprets results and reports results to investigators.

20. Strives to improve knowledge in appropriate field of research investigation.

21. Communicates effectively about projects in teams meetings.

22. Attends lectures, seminars and journal clubs to increase knowledge base.

23. Reads literature to gain knowledge relevant to current work assignment.

Requires bachelor's degree in biology, chemistry, other relevant science. Preference for candidates with 4 to 6 years of relevant research laboratory experience. Must exhibit a solid understanding of lab techniques, equipment, and safety. Must have the ability to organize and carry out laboratory techniques independently and in a team setting. Must be able to work with a variety of people at all levels both within and outside of the institution. Experience with basic data analysis is required. Skills in bioinformatics considered a plus. This position requires demonstrated writing skills.

Note: Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Must be U.S. citizen, permanent resident, refugee or asylee.

Demonstrate ability in these desired skills:

Cell Culture and Viral Techniques: Mammalian cell culture, transient transfection, lentiviral/retroviral production, and stable cell line generation

Protein Analysis: Western blotting, ELISA, immunohistochemistry (IHC), confocal microscopy

Molecular Biology and DNA technologies: qPCR, DNA/RNA preparation, molecular cloning, and plasmid preparation

Flow Cytometry: Sample preparation, staining, and basic data acquisition/analysis

Animal Work: Mouse handling, murine tumor modeling, intraperitoneal (IP) injection, and subcutaneous injection

**Part of the selection process includes an OnDemand (pre-recorded) interview to complete at your convenience. During that interview, a question will appear on your screen, you will have time to consider each question before responding and have the opportunity to re-record your answer to each question – Mayo Clinic will only see the final recording. The complete interview will be reviewed by a Mayo Clinic staff member and you will be notified of next steps.​**

title: API Technical Lead
description:
API Technical Lead

Location: Bangalore, Karnataka

Remote Type: Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.

Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.

We boldly go.

Where is the work:

Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.

What's in it for you:
Trane Technologies is seeking an API Technical Lead who will play a critical role in enabling reliable, secure, and scalable API solutions across our global technology ecosystem. This position sits at the center of enterprise connectivity, ensuring seamless integration and communication between cloud platforms, enterprise applications, digital products, middleware solutions, and business-critical systems.

As an API Technical Lead, you will work with modern API management platforms, integration technologies, and event-driven architectures to build and support resilient, high-performing, and reusable API services that enable business growth and digital transformation. You will collaborate with architects, application teams, infrastructure teams, and business partners to deliver API platform solutions that are secure, scalable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise standards and best practices.

This is an exciting opportunity for a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving complex API and platform engineering challenges, improving operational reliability, and driving innovation across a diverse technology landscape. You will gain exposure to enterprise-scale API ecosystems while contributing to the modernization and continuous evolution of our API platforms.

What you will do:

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in API design, development, and enterprise integration delivery.
  • Strong experience in designing, developing, securing, and managing APIs across on-premises, SaaS, cloud, and hybrid ecosystems.
  • Proven expertise in end-to-end API lifecycle delivery, including planning, design, development, testing, deployment, publishing, and support of enterprise APIs.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Google Apigee API Management/Gateway, including API proxy development, shared flows, traffic management, analytics, and policy enforcement.
  • Strong understanding of API security concepts and implementation, including authentication, authorization, OAuth 2.0, token-based security, throttling, rate limiting, and secure service exposure.
  • Experience developing and testing API proxies, reusable shared flows, and custom policies using JavaScript, Java, Node.js, Python, and related technologies.
  • Deep knowledge of API design patterns, RESTful architecture principles, and enterprise API best practices.
  • Experience implementing advanced API management capabilities such as logging, caching, request/response transformation, custom analytics, monitoring, throttling, and performance optimization.
  • Strong understanding of API standards and integration technologies, including OpenAPI 3.0, Swagger, REST, SOAP, JSON, messaging, microservices, and distributed integration patterns.
  • Hands-on experience designing stateless distributed architectures with strong focus on scalability, resiliency, performance, and maintainability.
  • Experience analyzing, documenting, and improving key API platform capabilities such as API catalogs, developer enablement, monitoring, observability, and analytics.
  • Good understanding of DevSecOps best practices, with exposure to source control, CI/CD pipelines, and automation using GitHub and GitHub Actions.
  • Ability to create architecture diagrams, solution flows, and technical documentation using Visio or similar tools to communicate API and integration designs effectively.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage and collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to champion API best practices, continuous improvement, standardization, and knowledge sharing across large-scale enterprise initiatives.
  • Foster a culture of engineering excellence and innovation by promoting reusable patterns, scalable API architecture, and modern platform engineering practices.

What you will bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical work experience.
  • Proven experience as an API Platform Engineer, Integration Engineer, or similar role, with 7–10 years of experience in a development, engineering, or technical lead capacity.
  • Strong experience in designing, developing, securing, and managing APIs across on-premises, SaaS, cloud, and hybrid ecosystems.
  • Proven expertise in end-to-end API lifecycle delivery, including planning, design, development, testing, deployment, publishing, and support of enterprise APIs.
  • Solid understanding of API platform engineering, API gateways, API management, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Experience implementing scalable, secure, and reusable API solutions aligned with enterprise architecture standards and best practices.
  • Strong knowledge of RESTful APIs, API security, authentication and authorization mechanisms, and service governance.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams including architects, developers, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and technical documentation skills.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

title: Supply Chain Analyst 1
description:
In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:
  • Partner with global Trade Compliance and Operations teams to support adherence to international trade regulations
  • Prepare, validate, and maintain documentation required for global trade compliance and shipment processing
  • Contribute to audit readiness activities and support compliance monitoring efforts
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to resolve trade-related challenges effectively
  • Develop certification documentation for approval by global trade leadership
  • Engage with suppliers to assess eligibility and compliance with Free Trade Agreement (FTA) requirements
  • Design and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and KPI reports using Power BI and Excel
  • Deliver accurate and timely supply chain reports with a focus on on-time delivery and error-free outputs
  • Analyze sourcing, purchasing, and supplier performance data to identify trends and improvement opportunities
  • Generate insights on key metrics such as on-time delivery, defects per million, spend, lead time, and cost savings
  • Ensure data quality, integrity, and governance across systems and reporting platforms
  • Build data models and automate reporting processes to enhance efficiency
  • Integrate data from enterprise systems including ERP platforms
  • Drive continuous improvement in analytics frameworks and reporting capabilities
  • Support strategic planning initiatives by providing data-driven insights to leadership
Who You Are:
You take prompt and effective action in dynamic situations and adapt quickly to evolving priorities. You actively seek input from relevant stakeholders to make well-informed, timely decisions. You encourage open dialogue and build collaborative relationships with diverse teams. You approach challenges with curiosity and use insights to drive meaningful improvements in processes and outcomes.
For This Role, You Will Need:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Operations, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience working in supply chain analytics, trade compliance, operations, or procurement environments
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Power Query, Pivot Tables, Power Pivot, and VBA
  • Hands-on experience with Power BI for data visualization and reporting
  • Knowledge of data modeling and DAX
  • Experience working with SQL and understanding of ETL concepts
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities
  • Ability to work collaboratively across global teams and manage multiple priorities
Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:
  • Exposure to Python (e.g., Pandas, NumPy) for data analysis
  • Familiarity with ERP systems such as SAP or Oracle
  • Experience with Power Apps and Power Automate
  • Understanding of digital transformation initiatives in supply chain or manufacturing
  • Experience working with advanced analytics tools or automation frameworks
  • Awareness of Microsoft 365 Copilot capabilities in analytics workflows
Our Culture and Commitment To You:
At Emerson, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and collaborative environment where individuals are empowered to grow, contribute, and innovate. We value diverse perspectives and believe they drive better outcomes for our teams, customers, and communities.
We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits that support your well-being. Our hybrid work model promotes flexibility and work-life balance, while our strong focus on safety ensures a secure environment for all employees. Through continuous learning opportunities and career development programs, we support your professional growth at every stage.
We are dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and inspired to make a meaningful impact. Together, we strive to solve complex challenges and build a more sustainable future.

    Juniorkonsulent til DSB Sikkerhed - Lær alt om jernbanesikkerhed, kvalitet og processer (studerende)
    
                

            

        

    

    

        

            

                


    
Vil du have et spændende studiejob, hvor du arbejder med data og får indblik i, hvordan DSB sikrer efterlevelse af lovgivning og standarder inden for jernbanesikkerhed, miljø og kvalitet?



Start din karriere hos os


Som juniorkonsulent hos os arbejder du tæt med andre juniorkonsulenter på tværs af enheden DSB Sikkerhed - med særlig tilknytning til afdelingen System- og kvalitetsledelse.


Du får bl.a. mulighed for at arbejde med data og analyser (fx Power BI), udarbejde præsentationer til ledelse og faglige fora, samt understøtte sikkerheds-, kvalitets- og miljøopgaver.


_______________________________________________________________________________________


" Jeg har tidligt fået ansvar og mulighed for at udvikle mig fagligt - blandt andet ved at afprøve koncepter fra mit studie og gennem oplæring samt løbende opgaver. Der er masser af plads til at udfolde sig og tage fat på opgaver, der både inspirerer og udfordrer. Vi har desuden et stærkt fællesskab, hvor man nemt kan få sparring og dele et godt grin i hverdagen",


Fortæller Jonas, Juniorkonsulent


_______________________________________________________________________________________


 


Velkommen til DSB Sikkerhed


Når du træder ind ad døren hos os, vil du blive mødt af ca. 35 kolleger, der arbejder som faglige eksperter og sparringspartnere for organisationen. Vi driver og understøtter et processtærkt DSB, hvor det er nemt for vores kollegaer og samarbejdspartnere at overholde gældende lovgivning og standarder på jernbanesikkerheds- og miljøområdet.


Du vil især få en rolle i samarbejde med System- og kvalitetsledelse, hvor vi



sikrer compliance med lovgivning og standarder


understøtter certificeringer og audit


arbejder med processer, data og løbende forbedringer


Trendmonitorering



 


Hvad skal du lave?


Vi forestiller os, at du arbejder ca. 15 timer ugentligt. Vi planlægger din arbejdstid sammen og tager hensyn til dine eksamensperioder m.m.


Du vil få en bred vifte af opgaver, som giver dig mulighed for at arbejde med både detaljer og helheder.


En typisk arbejdsdag kan starte med, at du dykker ned i data og rapporter for at identificere mønstre eller tendenser. Derefter sparrer du med kolleger om løsninger baseret på dine analyser.


Efter en god frokost med teamet kan du arbejde på opdatering af processer i ledelsessystemet eller tage fat på mindre projekter, der går på tværs af enheden.


 


Dine primære opgaver vil være at



Arbejde med data og rapporter (fx Power BI)


Analysere hændelser og identificere mønstre


Opdatere og forbedre processer i ledelsessystemet


Bidrage til mindre projekter og opgaver på tværs af enheden



 


Hvem er du?


Du er i gang med din bachelor eller lige startet på din kandidatuddannelse. Det er ikke så vigtigt hvilken studieretning du går på - så længe du kan se dig selv i nedenstående.


Det er vigtigt, at du er nysgerrig på nye perspektiver og løsninger. Det er helt okay at stille spørgsmål ved det eksisterende og afprøve nye metoder.


Desuden er du interesseret i data, processer og forretningsforståelse. Du arbejder struktureret og trives med at samarbejde med andre.


Har du følgende faglige kvalifikationer, er det en fordel



Erfaring med Office-pakken (Excel, PowerPoint - og gerne Power BI)


Evnen til at formidle dig klart på dansk - både mundtligt og skriftligt


Nysgerrighed og motivation for at lære




Hvad tilbyder DSB?


Alle vores studerende, praktikanter og nyuddannede kan blive en del af vores Young Professionals’ Network - et internt netværk, som medlemmerne selv varetager med støtte fra HR.


Det er her, I mødes til socialt samvær, forretningsmæssige input og faglige diskussioner.


Du kan se frem til



Udvikling af dine evner og færdigheder


Fleksible arbejdstider og mulighed for hjemmearbejde


Gratis transport med DSB


Træning i DSB’s eget fitnesscenter og gode DSB-rabatter, bl.a. til fitnesscentre


Ansættelse efter gældende AC-overenskomst (mellem Akademikerne og DSB)



 


I DSB har vi røgfri arbejdstid som en del af vores samlede indsats for at fremme sundhed og forebyggelse i DSB.



Søg nu


For at komme i betragtning til stillingen skal du være studieaktiv på en akademisk uddannelse og indskrevet på et universitet.


Ansøgningsfristen er d. 26. august 2026.


Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så skynd dig at søge.


Upload CV og studiedokumentation og evt. karakterudskrift eller eksamensbevis. Vi modtager ikke en skriftlig ansøgning til denne stilling. I stedet bedes du besvare nogle få spørgsmål i forbindelse med at du søger.




Spørgsmål? Ring til Ledelsessystemspecialist Ayoub Bohid på tlf. 2468 2176.



Rekrutteringsprocessen


Hvis du går hele vejen, kan du forvente 1-2 samtaler - evt. med en faglig case til en af samtalerne.

Vi tror nemlig på, at du som kollega bidrager bedst, når du får lov til at udvikle dig.

title: Optometrist (28)
description:
Als (bijna) optometrist bij Bergman Clinics in Amersfoort werk je in een afwisselende en zelfstandige functie, waarbij je kunt rekenen op de expertise en ondersteuning van een professioneel team van oogartsen. Je krijgt de vrijheid om zelfstandig te werken én volop te leren van ervaren collega’s. Initiatief wordt bij ons gewaardeerd en gestimuleerd, waardoor je alle ruimte krijgt om je verder te ontwikkelen en uit te blinken in je vak!

Hoe jij impact kunt maken als Optometrist

Als optometrist werk je nauw samen met onze oogartsen en andere (para)medici. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het gastvrij en professioneel begeleiden van cliënten tijdens jouw onderzoek. Je kan vlot de klacht definiëren en je past direct de juiste onderzoeken toe om te zorgen dat de cliënt zo min mogelijk bezoeken nodig heeft.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Zelfstandig verrichten van (functie-)onderzoeken

  • Ondersteunen van oogartsen

  • Pré- en postoperatieve onderzoeken

  • Informeren, instrueren en begeleiden van cliënten/begeleiders

  • Meedenken over de verbetering van onze processen

  • Administratieve taken zoals het verwerken van informatie van cliënten, overleg met derden, consultverslagen maken

  • Bijwonen van het paramedici overleg, als ook het cliëntenoverleg

Wat heb je nodig om succesvol te zijn in deze rol?
Als optometrist ben je goed in zelfstandig werken, maar je functioneert ook prima in een team. Je communiceert helder en past je communicatiestijl aan, aan de persoon met wie je praat. Hierdoor kun je goed inspelen op de behoeften van de cliënten en deze vertalen naar passende behandeltrajecten. Daarnaast is het belangrijk dat:

  • Je (bijna) een afgestudeerd HBO Optometrie diploma hebt

  • Je bent beschikbaar voor 24 tot 36 uur per week, waarbij jouw werkdagen in overleg worden vastgesteld

  • Je op jouw werkdagen beschikbaar bent tussen 8:30 uur en 17:00 uur

  • Je stressbestendig bent en kalm blijft tijdens drukke werkdagen

  • Je leergierig bent en op de hoogte blijft van ontwikkelingen binnen je vakgebied

Twijfel je of de functie als Optometrist bij Bergman Clinics bij jou past? Neem gerust contact met ons op, we denken graag met je mee

Wat krijg je hier voor terug?

Wij geloven dat goede zorg begint bij onze medewerkers. Daarom zorgen wij goed voor jou.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden

  • Een salaris tussen €4.043,- en €6.058,- bruto per maand (FWG 55), conform cao ZKN op basis van een fulltime dienstverband (40 uur)

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% en vakantietoeslag van 8,33%

  • Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23 per kilometer met een maximum van 80 km (enkele reis). Reis je met het ov? Dan vergoeden wij deze kosten volledig

  • Een contract voor bepaalde tijd met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband

  • Bij een fulltime dienstverband ontvang je 160 vakantie-uren en maar liefst 72 extra PLB-uren per kalenderjaar. Het PLB-urenbudget kent geen verjaringstermijn

  • Een toekomstbestendig pensioen bij PFZW waarbij wij beiden 50% van de pensioenpremie betalen

  • Korting op producten en/of diensten van Bey en Memira: 20% korting voor jou en 10% korting voor Friends & Family

  • Toegang tot Evermood, het welzijnsplatform waar je anoniem terechtkunt voor ondersteuning, inspiratie en coaching op het gebied van vitaliteit, werkplezier en persoonlijke groei

  • Via Alleo profiteer je van diverse fiscale voordelen, zoals een belastbaar vrij budget tot €120,- per jaar, de leasefietsregeling of een sportabonnement

  • Unlimited Learning via Good Habitz: onbeperkt toegang tot honderden trainingen en opleidingen die aansluiten op jouw wensen en ambities via onze eigen Bergman Academy

  • Mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan een collectieve zorgverzekering bij Zilveren Kruis, Menzis of IZZ

  • En nog veel meer, zoals gratis fruit op het werk en gezellige borrels en feestjes

  • Er is een (para)medisch budget beschikbaar voor congressen

  • Vergoeding voor contributie van het OVN lidmaatschap

Daarnaast ondersteunen we je bij het op orde houden van je kwaliteitsregister en zijn er op termijn, bij goed functioneren, mogelijkheden om je verder te ontwikkelen, bijvoorbeeld richting een functie als Physician Assistant.

Waarom werken bij Bergman Clinics?
Alvast een kijkje nemen bij Bergman Clinics? Klik op deze link en ontdek waarom jij beter word van werken bij Bergman Clinics: Werken bij Bergman Clinics, daar word je beter van 2023.

Hier ga je werken
In deze focuskliniek Bergman Clinics | Ogen in Amersfoort maak je onderdeel uit van een team dat bestaat uit: oogartsen, optometristen, orthoptisten, ANIOS, Physician Assistants en TOA's. We bieden persoonlijke, hoogkwalitatieve zorg op maat in een ontspannen sfeer. De kliniek heeft een volledig uitgeruste polikliniek en OK complex. Onder andere staaroperatie, vitrectomie, glaucoomoperaties, corneatransplantaties, traanwegchirurgie, en ooglidoperaties worden hier uitgevoerd. Op de poliklinische behandelkamer worden ivi's en verrichtingen uitgevoerd. De kliniek is vanaf de A1 goed bereikbaar en je parkeert gratis voor de deur.

Ben je enthousiast?
Ben je enthousiast? Solliciteer dan direct door op de button hieronder te klikken. Heb je nog vragen over de vacature? App of bel dan naar onze recruiter.

Screening van CV, diploma's, identiteitsbewijs en VOG (verklaring omtrent gedrag) zal deel uitmaken van de sollicitatieprocedure.

title: Senior Agile Project Leader
description:
ERNI is a fast-growing Software Development company headquartered and founded in Switzerland in 1994, with more than 800 employees. We are highly specialized in IT & software engineering to enable and deliver innovation in process and technology. Our first service center in Asia Pacific is in Metro Manila (Mandaluyong) from where we provide our service to Europe, APAC incl. our local market Philippines, and USA regions. We are now geared towards expansion and are looking for highly motivated joiners.

WHY ERNI is the best place to call HOME? 🏡

  • 🤩 At ERNI, this is how we can support you; ALL company PERKS AND BENEFITS take effect UPON HIRING!

  • Contract: there is always a project and opportunity for you.

  • Personal Development and Travel Opportunities outside the Philippines.

  • Baby Basket – to welcome your newborn to the ERNI family.

  • Fruit Basket – boost of vitamins during hospitalization.

  • Free snacks and coffee in the office

🔐 UNLOCKING NEW DOORS OF GROWTH & OPPORTUNITIES

  • Free Training with Certifications: Grow with us through technical and non-technical training.

  • Challenging Projects: ERNI is dedicated to developing high-quality software in complex technical environments such as MedTech, Industry, Finance, and Transportation. Have the chance to participate in various technically challenging projects amongst passionate and skilled colleagues.

  • Employee Welfare: You will be guided by a group of people who will guide and support you to have the right tools and mindset.

  • Promotions & Recognition: From the very first day, we offer you a way to learn and develop yourself in our company. Your colleagues and superiors consistently recognize and appreciate all efforts, making you feel satisfied with your achievements.

  • Communication: You will find transparency, honesty, and open communication in our working culture. we value suggestions, opinions, and feedback from all employees.

⏱ FLEXIBILITY

  • Hybrid Set-Up: We are combining both remote work and in-person work. The hybrid setup will allow you to reduce commuting time and have a more flexible work schedule. This will help you to manage better your work-life balance.

🎉 EVENTS:

  • We provide many opportunities to connect and build relationships. We are learning, growing, and celebrating achievements together. You will experience a wide range of different exciting activities. What to expect? Leisure Events, Summer Events, Family Events, Social Events, and Year-End Events.

👋 What are our wishes?

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Business, or related field (preferred).

  • Certifications in Scrum Master, Product Owner, or PMP (preferred but not required).

  • 5+ years of experience in Project Management or a similar role.

  • Proven experience as a Technical Product Owner.

  • Proven experience in Stakeholder’s Management.

  • Has technical experience in Data Migration Projects, or API integrations or any other related technical projects.

  • Basic knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and application monitoring tools is an advantage.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage, influence, and inspire partners to drive collaboration and alignment.

  • Strong leadership and interpersonal skills, including mentoring, coaching, collaborating, and team building.

  • Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle.

  • Experience handling multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Experience working with international clients, particularly in the European market.

  • Knowledgeable in Agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, Scrumban, XP).

  • Proficiency with collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, and TFS.


💼 How can you contribute to the team?

Lead and Develop Projects:

  • Oversee and support the successful delivery of software projects from initiation to completion.

  • Ensure that projects are completed on time, within scope, and within budget.

  • Responsible in generating project relevant documentations.

  • Identification of risks and designing a mitigation plan.

Agile Coaching:

  • Serve as an Agile coach to the team and stakeholders, promoting Agile principles and practices.

  • Educate and mentor team members in project management principles, methods, processes, and tools.

Product Owner Responsibilities:

  • Act as a Product Owner as needed to support project requirements.

  • Elicit requirements through series of scoping workshops, stakeholder interviews and through utilizing existing BRDs and SRDs.

  • Identifying Epics, Features and breaking down to workable user stories.

  • Defining and refining acceptance criteria with the scrum team.

  • Prioritize backlogs with the stakeholders.

Scrum Master

  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies (e.g., poker planning, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives).

Stakeholder Management:

  • Act as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for clients regarding project-related concerns.

  • Maintain effective communication with international clients, both local and international clients (European, APAC)

Collaboration and Tools:

  • Utilize various collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, and TFS to manage projects.

  • Ensure the team is well-equipped with the necessary tools and techniques to achieve project goals.

ADDITIONAL LOCATION(S)

JOB DESCRIPTION

You Belong Here

The Protiviti Career provides opportunity to learn, inspire, and advance within a collaborative and inclusive culture. We hire curious individuals for whom learning is a passion. We lean into our mission: We Care. We Collaborate. We Deliver.

At every level, we champion leaders who live our values of integrity, inclusion, innovation, and commitment to success. Imagining our work as a journey, we believe integrity guides our way, inclusion moves us forward together, innovation creates new destinations, and our commitment to success empowers us to deliver on our vision to be the most trusted global consulting firm.

Where We Need You:

Protiviti is looking for a Technology Audit & Advisory Senior Consultant to join our growing team.

What You Can Expect:

As a Senior Consultant, you will be a mentor, trainer, and coach to Interns and Consultants as you facilitate the successful completion of project work plans. You’ll identify areas of risk and opportunities to increase efficiency. You’ll strengthen relationships and deepen your abilities to communicate, gain trust, and network with client personnel and professional associates. At the direction of Managers, you may accept responsibility for decision-making in areas including establishing project scope and work plans, project staffing, preparation of deliverables, and application of methodologies.

At Protiviti, Technology Audit & Advisory focuses on:

  • Helping clients better manage risks associated with their use of technology, protecting and enhancing enterprise value.

  • Innovation: identifying solutions to client problems related to technology, helping them to rethink how technology processes are managed by incorporating AI and automation.

  • Technology enablement: Incorporating analytics, AI, automation and other new tools and methods in the execution of audit work for our clients, enabling a deeper, broader, more efficient, and more insightful analysis of our clients’ technology risks.

  • Staying current: We support a broad set of potential certifications and related trainings for our team, equipping our technology audit organization to stay at the forefront of emerging risks and trends.


Consultants in Technology Audit & Advisory work with clients to assess, identify risk, advise, and consult on different technology-related topics, including:

  • Cybersecurity

  • Cloud Assurance

  • Project Risk Advisory

  • Technology Risk Management and Assessment

  • IT General Controls (ITGC)

  • AI and Data Governance

  • Data Privacy

  • Technology Regulations

  • Enterprise Applications

  • Technology Resilience

  • IT Sarbanes-Oxley Compliance

  • Emerging Technologies

  • 2nd Line Controls Governance

  • Technology Enablement

What Will Help You Be Successful:

  • You enjoy identifying areas of business and technology risk, and opportunities to improve efficiency, increase performance, and help clients better utilize all technologies.

  • You are motivated to learn and interested in all things related to data and technology, including the latest trends and developments.

  • You are passionate about building relationships with clients and providing clients with exceptional experiences.

  • You have an inherent interest in project management and team leadership.

  • You contribute to a positive team culture that fosters open communication among all engagement team members.

  • You create development opportunities for others and ways for your team to improve our clients and communities.

  • You have interest in working with a diverse portfolio of clients across multiple industries.

  • You are versed in leveraging AI to enhance personal productivity as well as internal audit and SOX activities, including planning, fieldwork and reporting.

Do Your Talents Include the Following?

Experience with or understanding of:

  • IT audit methodologies and developing necessary audit deliverables, including process flows, work programs, audit reports, and control summaries.

  • Commonly used internal control frameworks, including COBIT, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS, ITIL, etc.

  • Sarbanes-Oxley Act provisions and methodologies for achieving compliance, in particular the technology implications and requirements.

Exposure to and/or interest in:

  • The latest trends and developments in data and technology, including high-growth topics of cybersecurity, cloud, data governance, privacy, analytics, enterprise applications (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Workday, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics etc.), disaster recovery, systems development methodologies etc.

  • Analytics and technology enablement (automation, AI/ML etc.).

  • Evaluating, summarizing, organizing, and interpreting data.

  • Establishing and cultivating business relationships and a professional network.

  • Ability to translate and communicate technology topics and audit issues to client personnel, including executives.

  • Supervisory experience of teams including mentoring, oversight and review of work, coordination across teams, and understanding how to motivate.

  • Experience performing documentation of findings and summarizing recommendations.

Your Educational and Professional Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., Accounting, Finance, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or business-related field).

  • 2+ years working in internal audit, consulting, assurance services, risk and control programs, or related field, either in professional services or industry.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite applications with specific emphasis on Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Secondary emphasis on Visio and Access.

  • Proficiency in PowerBI, Tableau, Alteryx, SQL, Python, and/or RPA Solutions a plus.

  • Professional certification such as CIA, CRMA, CISA, CISM, CISSP, or similar preferred.

Our Hybrid Workplace

Protiviti practices a hybrid model, which is a combination of working in person with a purpose and working remotely. This model creates meaningful experiences for our people and our clients while offering a flexible environment. The ratio of remote to in-person requirements varies by client, project, team, and other business factors. Our people work both in-person in local Protiviti offices and on client sites, which can include local or out-of-state travel based on our projects and client requests and commitments.

Starting salary is based on a full-time equivalent schedule. Placement in the range is dependent upon experience, skills and geographic work location. Below is the salary range for this job.

$84,000.00 - $125,000.00

Our annual bonus plan provides eligible employees additional cash and/or discretionary stock compensation opportunities. Below is the bonus target opportunity for this job.

10%

Employees are eligible for medical, dental, and vision coverages, FSA and HSA healthcare accounts, life and accident insurance, adoption and fertility assistance, paid parental leave up to 10 weeks, and short/long term disability. We offer eligible employees a company 401(k) savings and investment plan with an employer match of 50% on the first 6% of your contributions. We provide Choice Time Off (CTO) for vacation, personal needs, and sick time. The amount of (CTO) varies based on years of service. New hires receive up to 20 days of CTO per calendar year.
