title: Yard Master - RTS OPS IOC
description:
Downer Rail & Transit Systems a leading name in the manufacturing and maintenance of rolling stock across Australia has an exciting opportunity for an experienced Yard Master to join our in Auburn. This is a full-time permanent opportunity.

The Yard Master is primarily responsible for the safe movement of all rail vehicles within the boundaries of the Auburn Maintenance Facility.

Working a 24/7 roster; the Yard Master will plan for all rail vehicles to be suitably positioned to allow for relevant maintenance activities and ensure the production targets are met. The organisation of the yard area and rail vehicle stabling should allow for all departures to occur as per plan with no delays.

The Yard Master will also be able to carry out train moves where necessary and liaise with relevant personnel, to manage any rail vehicle move. Wash plant operations are controlled by the Yard Master as is any activity being carried out within the yard boundary.

About You:

  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience within the rail industry with the proven ability to conduct safe and efficient rolling stock movements.
  • Must hold a drivers licence C level or above.
  • Must have very good communication skills.
  • Highly developed planning and organisational skills
  • The ability to plan stabling positions to ensure arrivals are positioned relevant to their activities and departure constraints thus maximizing the efficiency of site operations.
  • Commitment to maintaining a high level of customer service whilst meeting stringent operational targets.
  • Must be computer literate and have good working skills of Microsoft Office applications such as Word and excel.
  • An understanding of Lean and Continuous Improvement procedures
  • Ability to motivate team members and encourage morale & team building.
  • The ability to demonstrate clear logical thought processes and remain calm in a pressured environment.
  • Always maintain a commitment to ZERO HARM policy.

What we offer:

  • Highly supportive, team orientated organisation
  • A strong commitment to maintaining a Zero Harm environment for all our employees and visitors

  • Competitive remuneration with on-going training and support

Se mere














Esmark i Henne Strand søger en kontormedhjælper (weekend)Skab ferieglæde for Esmarks gæster og tjen din egen perfekte ferie 
Velkommen til Henne Strand

Fra det øjeblik, du træder gennem dørene til vores kontor, mærker du feriestemningen og sammenholdet. Esmark Henne Strand består af et hold på 7 faste medarbejdere, der hver dag samarbejder om at servicere vores gæster og give dem gode oplevelser med hjem fra deres ferie.

Det er et alsidigt job, hvor du sammen med de andre Esmakkere kommer til at hjælpe med alle forefaldende opgaver på kontoret samt servicering af vores mange gæster og husejere. Hvis du står og mangler en ekstra indtjening eller bare har lyst til at være en del af Esmark, så tøv ikke med at kontakt os.

Tiltrædelsesdato: hurtigst muligt 

Vi søger 1-2 kontormedhjælper, som har mulighed for at arbejde 15 timer om ugen, der arbejdes primært i weekenderne og ferier.

Derudover er det vigtigt, at vores nye kolleger har følgende egenskaber: 


Fleksibilitet og overskud - også i travle perioder



Du har et positivt livssyn



Du er åben, ærlig og god til at samarbejde



Du har kørekort



Du kan forstå og tale tysk på et elementært niveau



Hvis du vil være med til at give vores gæster verdens bedste ferie, indebærer det blandt andet følgende opgaver: 


Servicere vores husejere og gæster på telefon, e-mail og ved personlig henvendelse på kontoret.



Modtagelse og afrejsehåndtering af gæster, herunder velkomst af ankommende gæster samt udtjekning ved afrejse.



Klargøring og håndtering af bestillingsvarer til gæster, herunder sengelinned, barnesenge, højstole, trækvogne og øvrige tilkøbsprodukter.



Diverse ad hoc-opgaver i forbindelse med den daglige drift af bureauet.



Vi er altid friske på nye udfordringer og lægger stor vægt på det sociale, så alle esmakkere har det godt. Hos os får du ikke kun et helt bundt fantastiske kolleger, men også en spændende og farverig hverdag spækket med nye udfordringer og positive oplevelser.

title: Nodalas Vadītājs (-a) T/C Domina, H&M Rīga (pilna slodze)
description:
KĀDI BŪS TAVI PIENĀKUMI

Tu kā nodaļas vadītājs būsi tas, kas atbalstīs un iedrošinās visu savu komandu. Veicinot iekļaujošu iekšējo kultūru, sadarbību un uzņēmējdarbības garu, Tu veidosi darba vidi, kurā ikviens var attīstīties. Rīkojoties saskaņā ar mūsu vērtībām, Tu veicināsi gan savus, gan uzņēmuma panākumus.

Tu:

  • Vadīsi savu komandu, nodoršinot izcilu iepirkšanās pieredzi mūsu klientiem un izcilus rutīnu izpildes un vizuālos standartus, vienlaikus aktīvi reklamējot un pārdodot mūsu produktus.
  • Uzņemsies atbildību par sava veikala un nodaļas stiprajām pusēm, analizēsi pārdošanas rezultātus, identificēsi uzlabošanās iespējas, uzstādīsi mērķus un veidosi plānus, lai optimizētu veikala rezultātus, peļņu un krājumu līmeni.
  • Pārvaldīsi komandas pienākumu plānošanu, veidosi grafikus un nodrošināsi netraucētu atvēršanas un aizvēršanas rutīnu izpildes kārtību.
  • Rekrutēsi, atbalstīsi jauno kolēģu darbā pieņemšanas procesus un attīstīsi savu komandu, vienlaikus veicinot iekļaujošu un uz sadarbību vērstu iekšējo kultūru, kas veicina izaugsmi un inovācijas.
  • Sekosi līdzi modes tendencēm, klientu vēlmēm un vajadzībām, kā arī mūsu konkurentiem, lai mūsu veikals saglabātu konkurētspēju.
  • Pozitīvi reprezentēsi sevi un mūsu zīmolu, kontaktējoties ar klientiem.

AR KO TU STRĀDĀSI

Mūsu veikali ir mūsu uzņēmuma sirds, kur klienti iepazīst mūsu zīmolu. Tev kā dinamiskās veikala komandas daļai — no pārdevējiem-konsultantiem, nodaļu vadītājiem, veikalu vadītājiem un vizuālajiem dekoratoriem līdz finanšu operatoram — ir jāpalīdz radīt iedvesmojošu un viesmīlīgu vidi. Tu arī sazināsieties ar plašāko apgabala komandu, sadarbojoties dažādos veikalos, lai dalītos gūtajā pieredzē un kopīgi gūtu panākumus. Kopā ar savu komandu Tev būs svarīga loma, palīdzot klientiem justies pārliecinātiem un izteikt savu individualitāti ar jaunākajām tendencēm un nenovecojošiem stila pamatiem. Veidojot nozīmīgus sakarus ar klientiem mūsu veikalos, mēs padarām modi pieejamu visiem un ilgtspējīgu.

KAS TU ESI

Mēs meklējam tādus cilvēkus, kuriem…

  • Ir pieredze veikalu vadībā un tirdzniecības procesu nodrošināšanā;
  • Ir pieredze pārdošanas rezultātu plānošanā, analīzē un pēcpārbaudē, izmantojot uz klientu orientētus rīkus un atskaites.

Un cilvēkus, kuri…​

  • Ir spēcīgi un drosmīgi līderi, kas iedvesmo, apmāca un pilnveido savu veikala komandu, esot mūsu vērtību un iekšējās kultūras paraugs;
  • Labi funkcionē dinamiskā un uz sadarbību balstītā darba vidē, ar uz risinājumiem vērstu domāšanas veidu;
  • Vēlas radīt lielisku klientu pieredzi, vienlaikus reklamējot un pārdodot mūsu produktus;
  • Interesējas par modi un vēlas nodrošināt izcilu iepirkšanās pieredzi, uzturēt veikala komercialitāti un veicināt pārdošanu, analizējot konkurentus;
  • Spēj efektīvi komunicēt, ir radoši un zinātkāri;
  • Ir elastīgi, analītiski un uz sasniegumiem orientēti, ar spēju strādāt ar statistiskajiem datiem un skaitļiem.

KAS MĒS ESAM

H&M Grupa ir globāls ietekmīgu modes zīmolu uzņēmums. Mūsu mērķis ir pierādīt, ka nevajag meklēt kompromisu starp izcilu dizainu, pieņemamām cenām un ilgtspējīgiem risinājumiem. Mēs vēlamies padarīt modi pieejamu ikvienam, un mūsu klienti ir katra mūsu lēmuma pamatā.

Mūsu uzņēmums sastāv no tūkstošiem degsmīgu un talantīgu kolēģu, kurus vieno mūsu kopīgā kultūra un vērtības. Mēs vēlamies izmantot mūsu kopīgo spēku, mērogu un zināšanas, lai virzītu modes industriju uz iekļaujošāku un ilgtspējīgāku nākotni.

KĀDĒĻ TEV PATIKS ŠEIT STRĀDĀT ​

H&M Grupā mēs lepojamies, ka esam tik dinamisks un pretimnākošs uzņēmums. Mēs piedāvājam saviem darbiniekiem pievilcīgus labumus ar plašām attīstības iespējām visā pasaulē.

  • 25% personāla atlaide visos mūsu H&M Grupas zīmolos – gan veikalos, gan tiešsaistē (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories un ARKET).
  • Apmācību iespējas, lai veidotu ilgstošu karjeru lielā un dinamiskā modes preču uzņēmumā

  • Stebby platformas kompensācija

  • "Iesaki kolēģi" programma jaunu darbinieku uzņemšanai

  • Apmaksātas slimības lapas un ikgadējo atvaļinājumu

  • Veselības apdrošināšanu

  • Ziemassvētku kuponu

PIEVIENOJIES MUMS

Mūsu unikalitāti veido vairāku aspektu kombinācija — mūsu iekļaujošā un uz sadarbību balstītā iekšējā kultūra, mūsu spēcīgās vērtības un izaugsmes iespējas, bet galvenokārt mūsu kolēģi ir tie, kas padara mūs tādus, kādi mēs esam.

Šis ir pastāvīgs pilnas slodzes amats.
Piesakies, sūtot savu CV pēc iespējas ātrāk, bet ne vēlāk kā līdz 12.09.2026. Datu politikas dēļ mēs pieņemam pieteikumus tikai caur mūsu karjeras lapu.

Alga ir 1580 Euro pirms nodokļu nomaksas.

Sper nākamo soli savā karjerā kopā ar mums! Ceļojums sākas šeit.

*Mēs esam apņēmušies nodrošināt godīgu, taisnīgu un uz kompetencēmi balstītu personāla atlases procesu. Tādēļ lūdzam nepievienot pieteikumam motivācijas vēstuli.

title: Research Technologist - Lucas-McAllister Lab
description:
This is an exciting opportunity for an energetic, ambitious, and creative individual to help shape the future of a discovery-oriented biomedical research laboratory. Primary research focus of the lab centers on the interaction of cancer with the immune system. We are searching for an individual to take a major role in operations for this expanding team. The lab is jointly directed by senior Principal Investigators:

Dr. Peter Lucas - Vice Chair for Research, Department of Laboratory Medicine and Pathology

Dr. Linda McAllister - Enterprise Deputy Director, Pediatric Cancer Programs, Mayo Clinic Comprehensive Cancer Center

The successful candidate will work closely with our group, which includes a Principal Research Technologist, a Senior Program Coordinator Administrative Leader, Senior Research Scientists, Post-Doctoral fellows and PhD Student Trainees.

The candidate we seek will:

- Support lab member projects via method development, conduction of experiments, and data analysis and interpretation

- Design and complete experiments feared towards research objectives of the lab

- Assist in routine laboratory operations including ordering, regulatory documentation/compliance (chemical safety, biosafety, IACUC and IRBs), personnel training, equipment/reagent management and maintenance 

- Have strong organizational and record keeping skills, as well as the ability to accurately collect, store and interpret research data.

- Contribute to manuscript and grant writing

- Present at research laboratory meetings

Additional Job Responsibilities:

1. Assists in design of experiments and protocols. Executes experimental studies in support of lab goals.

2. Demonstrates a basic understanding of lab practices.

3. Performs experiments according to established procedure and under the direction of senior lab personnel.

4. Keeps detailed log of experimental procedures.

5. Trains lab personnel in lab techniques.

6. Maintains equipment and supplies.

7. Plans for equipment repair or replacement.

8. Assists in the selection of instrumentation and computer software and hardware.

9. Collects, documents and analyzes data.

10. Prepares graphs, tables and figures for grants and manuscripts.

11. Presents at lab meetings.

11. Reports difficulties in experimentation and data collection and follows through with protocol modifications.

Requires bachelor's degree in biology, chemistry, other relevant science. Preference for candidates with at least 2 to 4 years of relevant research laboratory experience. Must exhibit a solid understanding of lab techniques, equipment, and safety. Must have the ability to organize and carry out laboratory techniques independently and in a team setting. Must be able to work with a variety of people at all levels both within and outside of the institution. Experience with basic data analysis is required. Skills in bioinformatics considered a plus. This position requires demonstrated writing skills. Additional responsibilities below.

Note: Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Must be U.S. citizen, permanent resident, refugee or asylee.

  • Preferred skills:
  • Cell Culture and Viral Techniques: Mammalian cell culture, transient transfection, lentiviral/retroviral production, and stable cell line generation
  • Protein Analysis: Western blotting, ELISA, immunohistochemistry (IHC), confocal microscopy
  • Molecular Biology and DNA technologies: qPCR, DNA/RNA preparation, molecular cloning, and plasmid preparation
  • Flow Cytometry: Sample preparation, staining, and basic data acquisition/analysis
  • Animal Work: Mouse handling, murine tumor modeling, intraperitoneal (IP) injection, and subcutaneous injection

**Part of the selection process includes an OnDemand (pre-recorded) interview to complete at your convenience. During that interview, a question will appear on your screen, you will have time to consider each question before responding and have the opportunity to re-record your answer to each question – Mayo Clinic will only see the final recording. The complete interview will be reviewed by a Mayo Clinic staff member and you will be notified of next steps.​**

title: AVOIN HAKEMUS, Metalliala
description:
Etsimme metallialan työntekijöitä niin pitkiin kuin keikkapainotteisiin työsuhteisiin Varsinais-Suomen alueella.

Kaipaatko vaihtelua nykyisiin hommiin?

Haemme avoimella hakemuksella metallialan työntekijöitä erilaisiin tehtäviin niin määräaikaisiin kuin pidempiinkin työsuhteisiin eri paikkakunnille Varsinais-Suomessa. Työtehtäviä voi olla esimerkiksi tuotannossa, hitsauksessa, koneistuksessa ja muissa metallialan tehtävissä.

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan. Työsuhde solmitaan Visio Henkilöstöratkaisujen kanssa, mutta työskentelet aina asiakkaamme tiloissa. Jos sinulla on metallialan koulutus tai jo aikaisempaa työkokemusta metallialalta, jätä avoin hakemus ja etsitään yhdessä sinulle sopiva työpaikka.

Yleiset vaatimukset tehtäviin:

* Metallialan koulutus tai aikaisempaa työkokemusta alalta – pääset nopeasti hommiin kiinni perehdytyksen jälkeen.
* Hyvä työmotivaatio ja asenne – tartut rohkeasti erilaisiin työtehtäviin.
* Sosiaaliset taidot kunnossa – tulet hyvin toimeen työporukan kanssa.

Sinulla on visio hyvästä työelämästä, me autamme toteuttamaan sen.

Oli visiosi työelämästä selkeä tai vasta hahmottumassa, me autamme molemmissa tapauksissa. Varmistamme, etta tyosopimukset ja varusteet ovat kunnossa, ja että ammattilaisena saat osaamistasi vastaavan palkan. Olemme tukena ja turvana, jos sellaista tarvitset. Meille on tarkeaa, etta viihdyt tyossasi.

Näissä tehtävissä tarjoamme sinulle:

* Osaamisesi mukaan määräytyvän palkan
* Tehtävästä riippuen vakituisen työsuhteen 37,5 h/vko tai määräaikaisen työsuhteen erikseen sovittavalla työtuntimäärällä.
* Palkanmaksun kaksi kertaa kuukaudessa.
* Perehdytyksen työhön.
* Jokaiseen tyotehtavaan soveltuvat tyovarusteet.
* Paivittaisen tuen tyoasioissa.
* Mahdollisuuden kehittää ammattitaitoasi ja edetä vaativampiin tehtäviin.
* Hyville tyypeille on aina kysyntää ja autamme sinua löytämään uusia töitä määräaikaisen työsuhteen päättyessä.

Onko meilla yhteinen visio? – Nain teet tyopaikkahakemuksen

Haastattelemme jo hakuaikana potentiaalisia hakijoita, joten mikali koet olevasi etsimamme henkilö, niin nyt on aika jattaa hakemus. Tee se ohessa olevan linkin kautta.

Hakemuksia tulee paljon, ja jotta hakuprosessi on kaikille reilu, voimme ottaa huomioon vain jarjestelmassa tehdyt hakemukset.

Voit parantaa omia mahdollisuuksiasi tulla valituksi, kun:

* liitat hakemukseesi ansioluettelon (CV) tai kirjaat aikaisemmat tyopaikkasi kuluneelta viidelta vuodelta,
* kerrot, miten aiemmissa tyopaikoissa opitut asiat tukevat sinua parjaamaan teollisuuden ja tuotannon tehtävissä.

Visio – aidosti läsnä alueellasi

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut on valtakunnallisesti paikallinen. Tunnemme paikalliset työmarkkinat ja olemme aidosti läsnä alueellasi. Jos haet Varsinais-Suomessa työpaikkaa, siinä auttavat sinua Turusta käsin Jukka, Mikko ja Kristian.

Vision Henkilostoratkaisut

Visio Varsinais-Suomi on osa Visio Henkilostoratkaisut -konsernia, joka on vuonna 2020 perustettu kotimainen henkilostopalvelualan yritys. Pelaamme reilua pelia ja tarjoamme toita niin raudanlujille ammattilaisille, kuin sellaiseksi kehittyville. Yhdistämme työntekijät ja työnantajat niin, että molemmat löytävät juuri tarpeisiinsa sopivan ratkaisun.

Yhteistyo perustuu kaikkien kolmen tahon keskinäiseen luottamukseen. Jos haluat reilun työnantajan, joka arvostaa osaamistasi ja huomaa työpanoksesi, se on Visio.

title: Huishoudelijke hulp Alkmaar
description:
Word jij het zonnetje in huis? Kom werken als Huishoudelijke Hulp!

Werkgebied: Alkmaar
Contract: 2-24 uur per week, flexibele werktijden

Bij Miep Huishoudservice en Begeleiding draait alles om het creëren van een écht thuisgevoel – niet alleen voor onze cliënten, maar ook voor jou als medewerker. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je je gewaardeerd voelt, je werk met plezier doet en altijd de steun krijgt die je nodig hebt. Flexibiliteit, persoonlijke aandacht en een fijne werksfeer staan bij ons centraal!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Huishoudelijke Hulp bij Miep Huishoudservice zorg je ervoor dat onze cliënten zich thuis blijven voelen in hun eigen woning, ook als zij zelf niet meer volledig voor het huishouden kunnen zorgen. Jouw taken bestaan uit:

  • Schoonmaken, stofzuigen en andere huishoudelijke werkzaamheden.

  • Cliënten zoveel mogelijk betrekken bij het huishouden.

  • Persoonlijke aandacht en een luisterend oor bieden.

Jij maakt elke dag het verschil! Dankzij jouw hulp blijft het huis van onze cliënten schoon en fijn, waardoor zij langer zelfstandig kunnen blijven wonen. Een sociaal en dankbaar beroep waarin jij elke dag iets moois betekent voor een ander!

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij ons bepaal jij je eigen werktijden en -dagen! Extra werken in de vakantie? Geen probleem! Je krijgt een salaris volgens de cao VVT, vanaf € 15,07 bruto per uur afhankelijk van ervaring, met jaarlijkse verhogingen tot € 18,27. Daarnaast ontvang je vakantiegeld (8%) en een eindejaarsuitkering (8,33%), die je ook maandelijks kunt laten uitbetalen. Ook bouw je pensioen op en kun je gebruikmaken van een collectieve zorgverzekering. Reiskosten (zoals auto, fiets, brommer of scooter) en reistijd tussen cliënten worden vergoed.

We investeren in jouw groei met een digitaal onboardingsprogramma via de MiepApp vol e-learnings. Wil je alvast een kijkje nemen? Klik dan hier. Je krijgt een contract voor bepaalde tijd met de intentie tot een vaste aanstelling. Twee keer per jaar organiseren we een medewerkersbijeenkomst om je collega’s beter te leren kennen. Miep is een warme, betrokken werkgever die naar je luistert. Jouw werk is niet alleen belangrijk, maar maakt ook écht een verschil voor onze cliënten!

Wie ben jij?

  • Jij bent het zonnetje in huis, zorgzaam en hebt een groot inlevingsvermogen.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor je taken.

  • Je spreekt en begrijpt Nederlands.

  • Je bent minimaal 2 uur per week beschikbaar tussen 9:00 en 18:00 uur (ma-vr).

  • Ervaring is mooi meegenomen, maar enthousiasme en een passie voor schoonmaken zijn minstens zo belangrijk!

  • Je hebt eigen vervoer (auto, scooter of fiets) om naar cliënten te reizen.

Enthousiast geworden?

Wil jij het verschil maken en onze cliënten laten stralen? Solliciteer vandaag nog!
Stuur je CV en motivatie naar ons op en wie weet verwelkomen wij jou binnenkort als onze nieuwe collega. Na je sollicitatie laten we je zo snel mogelijk weten hoe het verder gaat. Bij indiensttreding vragen wij een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) aan.

Meer informatie

title: Associate, Electrical Engineering
description:
This strategy is key to the WSP in India Buildings Mechanical Electrical Public Health (MEP) business as we position ourselves to address the challenges of a changing global economy. The role is the cornerstone of the establishment of a MEP Design Capacity in Noida working and adhering to WSP Global standards and promoting technical excellence, in addition to creating and building a team. This will involve recruiting, leading, developing a team of Engineers over a relatively short period of time. The successful candidate will stimulate and manage significant growth in a technically demanding environment to time, cost and quality targets. Cultural awareness, an open mind and excellent communication skills are essential requirements for the role.

A major element of this role is to liaise with the WSP in India design teams to ensure that the following essential elements of the role are satisfactorily completed: -

  • Agree and confirm the project brief to anticipate and identify needs and expectations in conjunction with others.
  • Agree the project deliverables and programme.
  • Agree the resource in India that will be required to undertake the designs to complete the project brief in time and cost.
  • Agree the project fees according to brief, resource required and programme.
  • Be responsible for the quality of detailed design to WSP in India and Global Building Regulations standards ensuring technical reviews and sign off including complex calculations and co-ordination issues.
  • Ensure design are co-ordinated and due consideration of Health & Safety, Construction Design Management and Quality Assurance standards.
  • Regularly communicate and update the local Indian and wider Global project teams on programme delivery and quality issues through use of staff utilisation charts and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) reporting etc.
  • Review outputs of Computer Aided Design analysis, and determine additional levels of checking needed.
  • Where necessary, development of energy strategies incorporating renewable technologies and low energy designs to satisfy local authority planning requirements and compliance with Building Regulations Part L.
  • Inform the Commercial Director of Professional Indemnity issues in line with WSP in India policy.
  • Ensure all company standards & efficient working practices are adopted.
  • Maintain an overview & understanding of the team workload & associated resource requirements, and work with other team leaders to ensure resources are fully utilised, identify & address effectively any surplus or shortfall in available staff
  • The successful candidate will be a dynamic self-motivated individual who will take on a Leadership role in project work, focused on delivery to the client and technical excellence.
  • The role requires management of a number of projects and becoming involved in design at an early stage.
  • The role includes management of fees, invoicing, project-resource management, mentoring and coaching junior members of the team. The ability to plan and design deliverables against British Engineering standards for each stage of a project is a pre-requisite.
  • The role will include a short term secondment to the to visit some of the key WSP in India offices and WSP in India personnel to better understand WSP in India as a business and to assist with acclimatisation to the WSP in India methods of working.
  • Lead the design process, set clear goals and monitor their progress closely and encourage the rest of the team to deliver appropriate and cost effective solutions to the agreed programme; support those more inexperienced by technical review, mentoring and advice.

title: Lähihoitaja tai sairaanhoitaja kotihoitoon
description:
ETSIMME RAUMAN ALUEELLE LÄHIHOITAJAA TAI SAIRAANHOITAJAA KOTIHOITOON

Kotihoito tarjoaa mahdollisuuden tehdä yksilöllistä ja merkityksellistä työtä, jossa asiakkaan hyvinvointi ja elämänlaatu ovat keskiössä. Etsimme nyt Rauman alueelle lähihoitajaa kotihoitoon arkipäivätyöhön. Työ sisältää myös vaativaa hoidollista työtä.

MITÄ KOTIHOIDON TYÖ SISÄLTÄÄ?

Kotihoidossa työsi on monipuolista, itsenäistä ja ihmisläheistä. Työskentelet asiakkaiden omissa kodeissa ja tuet heitä toimimaan arjessa turvallisesti ja mahdollisimman omatoimisesti. Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat mm.:

* Hoitotyö ja asiakkaan päivittäinen avustaminen

* Lääkehoito (osaamisen ja lupien mukaisesti)

* Terveyden kokonaisvaltainen seuranta ja mittaukset

* Asiakkaan toimintakyvyn ja hyvinvoinnin tukeminen

Kotihoidossa jokainen työpäivä on erilainen. Pääset hyödyntämään ammattitaitoasi laaja-alaisesti ja tekemään työtä, jolla on todellista merkitystä asiakkaiden arjessa.

MITÄ TARJOAMME SINULLE?

* Merkityksellisen, arvostetun ja itsenäisen työn

* Mahdollisuuden hyödyntää laajasti omaa osaamistasi

* Ammattitaitoisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön tueksesi

* Yksityisen sosiaalialan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan

MITÄ TOIVOMME SINULTA?

* Lähihoitajan tutkintoa ja voimassa olevia lupia

* Asiakaslähtöistä, vastuullista ja lämminhenkistä työotetta

* Kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja päätöksentekoon

* Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa

* Oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta, sillä liikut asiakaskohteiden välillä

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi! Haastattelemme jo hakuajan aikana. Nähdään Alinassa!

----------------------------------------

Haluatko tietää lisää meistä? Löydät lisätietoa verkkosivuiltamme [https://alinahoivatiimi.fi/].

Alina on valtakunnallinen ketju, joka työllistää jo 350 alan ammattilaista. Paikallisia Alina-yrityksiä on jo yli 40 eri puolilla Suomea. Työtyytyväisyytemme sai arvosanaksi 4,39/5 vuonna 2025.

Alina on osa Norlandiaa [https://norlandiacare.fi/], joka tarjoaa innovatiivisia ja monipuolisia hyvinvointi- ja terveyspalveluita kaikille vauvasta vaariin sekä nelijalkaisille ystävillemme. Suomessa Norlandian toimintoihin kuuluvat hoivakodit YHDESSÄ palvelukortteleissa, Tampereella sijaitseva potilashotelli, Norlandia Päiväkodit ja Aberia.

title: Applied Artificial Intelligence Research Engineer
location: Boston, MA; Remote; San Francisco, CA
description:
Applied AI Research Engineer

Department: Research

Location: Boston Hub, Remote , San Franscisco Hub

Employment Type: FullTime

About Code Metal

Code Metal is redefining code translation for mission-critical industries, helping defense partners move more quickly and reliably from algorithm to silicon. Our platform accelerates deployment of DSP, RF, communications, and embedded signal processing algorithms onto heterogeneous compute targets, including GPUs, FPGAs, ASICs, and edge SoCs. We also support automotive, aerospace, and semiconductor partners deploying complex algorithms onto constrained hardware with speed and rigor.

About the Role

We're building next-generation AI systems that help military planners explore, compare, and evaluate operational courses of action. Our work combines frontier language models, simulation, planning, and verification into human-in-the-loop decision-support systems for defense applications. As an Applied AI Research Engineer, you’ll focus on human machine teaming and agentic AI to build systems that allow warfighters, planners, analysts, and decision-makers to explore operational choices with speed, confidence, and control.

This role focuses on designing and building agentic AI systems – not chatbots. You'll develop multi-agent workflows, fine-tune and evaluate models, build retrieval pipelines, experiment with post-training techniques, and integrate AI with simulation and planning software. You'll work closely with AI researchers, software engineers, and defense experts to turn research ideas into production-ready capabilities. The goal is to make complex planning, wargaming, adjudication, and analysis workflows faster, more explainable, and more trustworthy.

Research Areas of Interest

An incomplete list of ongoing and near-term directions:

  • Human-machine teaming for AI-assisted course-of-action development, comparison, critique, refinement, and operational decision support

  • Agentic planning systems that integrate language models with simulation, doctrine retrieval, external tools, structured outputs, and deterministic verification

  • Adapting and optimizing foundation models through fine-tuning, post-training, distillation, reinforcement learning, and rigorous evaluation for planning and decision-support tasks

  • Multi-agent AI systems for Red/Blue planning, control-cell support, adjudication, branch-and-sequel analysis, and collaborative planning workflows

  • Building reliable AI systems using self-correction, structured reasoning, constraint-aware generation, verification, and robust tool use

  • Learning from human expertise through planner feedback, preferences, approvals, synthetic data generation, and human-in-the-loop improvement

  • Trustworthy AI for high-consequence applications, with an emphasis on explainability, provenance, traceability, auditability, uncertainty estimation, and model behavior analysis

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build agentic AI systems for planning, decision support, and human-machine teaming

  • Develop AI pipelines that integrate foundation models, retrieval, simulation, external tools, and deterministic software

  • Design, run, and analyze experiments to evaluate model and agent performance, reliability, traceability, latency, cost, and user trust

  • Fine-tune, distill, and evaluate foundation models for domain-specific planning, reasoning, and decision-support tasks

  • Build datasets, retrieval pipelines, automated benchmarks, and experiment infrastructure to support continuous model improvement and reproducible research

  • Partner with software engineers to transition research prototypes into scalable AI services

  • Collaborate with domain experts to translate operational workflows into AI-enabled capabilities while ensuring AI outputs remain explainable, reviewable, and under human control

Why Code Metal?

  • Mission with impact: Build AI systems that help users reason through high-consequence operational decisions.

  • AI beyond demos: Work on systems where models are paired with software, verification, simulation, guardrails, and human oversight.

  • Greenfield research: Explore ambitious ideas in GenAI, RL, agentic workflows, evaluation, and human-machine teaming.

  • Small-team velocity: Move quickly from research question to prototype to user-facing capability.

  • Real users: See your work tested by planners, analysts, engineers, and operational stakeholders.

Must-Have Credentials

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3+ years building AI, machine learning, or applied research systems.

  • Strong Python engineering skills.

  • Experience with PyTorch and modern LLM tooling (Transformers, vLLM, Hugging Face, etc.).

  • Experience building or deploying agentic AI systems, tool-calling workflows, or multi-step reasoning pipelines.

  • Experience fine-tuning, evaluating, or serving language models.

  • Experience with retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, or knowledge retrieval systems.

  • Strong understanding of experiment design, benchmarking, and model evaluation.

  • Ability to move quickly from research prototype to production-quality implementation.

  • Eligible to obtain a U.S. security clearance.

Benefits

  • Pay depends on experience, but we strive to be at the upper end of the salary range

  • Health care plan with 100% premium coverage, including medical, dental, and vision

  • 401k with 5% matching

  • Paid Time Off (uncapped vacation, plus sick and public holidays)

  • Flexible hybrid or remote work arrangement

  • Relocation assistance for qualifying employees

Wage Transparency - The salary range for this role is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as the final offer amount may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, individual proficiency, skills, experience, and location.


We are an equal opportunity employer. US Citizenship may be required for certain project assignments involving security clearance.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

We are seeking a Platform Engineer to integrate software developed in C++, C and Java on hardware operating RedHat and Windows all within a Layer3 network. In this position, you will be responsible for providing practical solutions to difficult technical software problems. You can expect to support multiple programs and multiple platforms within a software product line. Software Engineering positions include working on a variety of different tasks including implementing Operating System (OS) level configurations to support applications and cyber requirements. A person who is successful in this role understands and utilizes agile software development methods, automation, and continuous integration.

This position is on-site in Marlborough Massachusetts. Occasional travel will be expected to stakeholder sites.

What You Will Do

  • Support and Improvement of our DevSecOps Pipeline. This role requires passion to drive improvement via test automation, creative solutions and elimination of non-value steps.

  • Handle emergency situations that stop the pipeline and address quickly and efficiently.

  • Collaborative with engineers of all levels.

  • Debug and correct stability issues in our many software baselines.

  • Configure and install Operating Systems (RHEL).

  • Configure and install Network Switches (Dell, Cisco, etc.).

  • Configure and install other network devices responsible for providing program system requirements (NAS devices, terminal servers, etc.).

  • Perform integration and testing of real-time embedded software, application software, and tools that run on a Linux operating system.

  • Maintenance and enhancement of the tooling infrastructure.

  • Possible opportunities to travel domestically and internationally.

  • Experience with scripting languages (E.g. Perl, Python, Bash).

  • Experience with ClearCase, Git or other configuration management tools.

  • Experience with configuring, deploying, and maintaining Linux operating systems.

  • The ability to obtain and maintain a US Government issued Interim Secret security clearance is required prior to start date. U.S. citizenship is required as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.


Qualifications We Prefer

  • Experience with DevSecOps and test automation using Jenkins and Grafana for virtualization.

  • Experience with configuration of network devices.

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code.

  • Experience with automated Windows setup, deployment and maintenance.

  • Experience with hardening Windows environments.

  • Experience with hardening RedHat Linux environments.

  • Experience with virtualization.

  • Experience with integrating windows environments with monitoring solutions such as Splunk and McAfee TACC.

  • Experience with DISM, PowerShell, .Net, bash, etc.

  • Experience with RedHat IDM.

  • Experience with RedHat Linux system administration.

  • Experience with Collaborator or other source code review tool.

  • Experience with Coverity or other static analysis tools.

  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Artifactory, BitBucket, Coverity, Grafana.

What We Offer

  • Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

  • Relocation eligible.

Candidates will learn more about role type and current site status throughout the recruiting process. For onsite roles, commuting to and from the assigned site is the employee’s personal responsibility.

title: Software Development Engineer , Inventory Accounting
description:
Amazon Leo is launching satellite-based connectivity in 100+ countries. Every country launch requires integration across tax, accounting, disbursement, legal, trade, and core commerce — thousands of test cases, dozens of teams, months of sequential human work. This team operates in a high-velocity environment, adapting and extending Amazon's established first-mile and middle-mile logistics and accounting infrastructure while engineering new capabilities purpose-built for Kuiper's commerce platform, which is launching across 100+ countries.

The Inventory Accounting team owns the end-to-end platform responsible for tracking Kuiper hardware inventory procured by end customers and fulfilled through Amazon's first-mile and middle-mile logistics network, ensuring ledger accuracy and regulatory compliance. The team manages 40+ distinct accounting scenarios per country, encompassing inventory custody transitions across both forward fulfillment and reverse logistics flows.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
Key Job Responsibilities:

*Design and deliver a scalable, end-to-end platform supporting Kuiper commerce logistics operations across global markets.

*Design and implement distributed orchestration systems that coordinate across dozens of domain-specific internal and external services, ensuring reliable end-to-end workflow execution at scale.

*Establish the AI/ML foundation layer, including knowledge base architectures and intelligent automation frameworks, to accelerate developer productivity and reduce time-to-market for new country launches.

*Tackle novel, ambiguous technical challenges at the intersection of artificial intelligence, large-scale distributed systems, and financial domain complexity, delivering production-grade solutions with high operational bar.


A day in the life
As a Software Development Engineer (SDE II) on the Inventory Accounting team, you will own the design, development, and cross team collaboration of end-to-end e-commerce lifecycle systems, spanning requirements definition, implementation, financial configuration, test automation, and production validation. You will enable Amazon Kuiper to scale country and feature launches across 100+ global markets without proportional headcount growth, driving operational efficiency through engineering excellence.

					Back to job offers				
			

			


				
					

 



Ethvert anlægsprojekt hviler på solide geotekniske undersøgelser og i SYSTRAs geotekniske gruppe leverer vi den rådgivning, der er fundamentet for de store infrastrukturprojekter. Gruppen vokser og vi søger derfor endnu en hydrogeolog eller geotekniker med erfaring med hydrogeologi til vores kontor i Ørestad eller Aarhus. Lige nu arbejder vi blandt andet på Horsens Ringvej Syd, Rute 15, Metro M5, ny bro over Tuborgvej. Derudover har vi mange forskellige opgaver for både private og offentlige bygherrer.

 

Context 



Som Hydrogeolog / Geotekniker bliver du en del af afdelingen Geoteknik & Havne. Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet omfatte beregninger og vurderinger i forbindelse med grundvandssænkning, planlægning og gennemførelse af feltundersøgelser samt geoteknisk/grundvandssænkning tilsyn i forbindelse med projekter. Det vil være en fordel, hvis du også har praktisk erfaring og er vant til at arbejde tæt på udførelsen. I det daglige arbejde vil du skulle yde sparring og støtte for dine kollegaer og tage del i projekteringsarbejdet. Projekteringsarbejdet vil inkludere udførelsen og/eller kvalitetssikring af geotekniske/hydrogeologisk design eller parameterrapporter samt grundvandssænkning mv.


I Geoteknik & Havne er vi ca. 15 medarbejdere med en bred fordeling af kompetencer og anciennitet, og ancienniteten spænder således fra 1 til 30+ års erfaring. Vi projekterer alle slags geotekniske konstruktioner, udarbejder geotekniske undersøgelsesrapporter samt yder rådgivning i alle faser inden for fundering af bro-, havne- og anlægskonstruktioner på såvel ny anlæg som renovering og ombygning. Og vores styrker er indenfor bane-, vej- og entreprenørdesign.

 

Missions/Main Duties 



Udviklingsmuligheder i et fleksibelt arbejdsmiljø:
I SYSTRA får du et spændende og udfordrende job, hvor du kommer til at spille en betydelig rolle på nogle af vores samfundsvigtige projekter. Du kommer til at få din daglige gang på kontoret i Ørestad eller Aarhus, hvor du vil møde engagerede og rare kolleger med et højt fagligt niveau. Det gode arbejdsmiljø er kendetegnet ved en høj grad af fleksibilitet med mulighed for at arbejde hjemmefra. Vi har en personalepolitik, som understøtter din karriere og udvikling, og vi tilbyder attraktive løn- og ansættelsesvilkår.

 

Profile/Skills



Vi forestiller os, at du har en uddannelse som diplom- eller civilingeniør med speciale i Geoteknik eller Hydrogeologi, og at du har minimum 3 års erfaring med hydrogeologiske problemstillinger og gerne indsigt i samspillet mellem jordbundsforhold, grundvand og anlægsprojekter. Det forventes at du kan kommunikere skriftligt og mundtligt på både dansk og engelsk. En fordel er at du har erfaring fra internationale projekter eller at du har arbejdet i teams med forskellige nationaliteter.


Kontakt og ansøgning 
Vil du vide mere om jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte Afdelingschef Evelina Vaitkune tlf.: +45 52 51 98 73.


Du behøver ikke skrive en ansøgning, men kan blot sende et opdateret CV. Bemærk, at det kun er muligt at uploade et enkelt dokument på vores ansøgningsside under "Candidate Upload CV", derfor vil vi bede dig samle CV og evt. andet indhold i ét dokument. Vi gennemgår ansøgninger løbende, så send gerne dit cv allerede i dag.

 

 



Vi tilbyder
Vil du være en del af en arbejdsplads, der kombinerer det bedste af stort og småt? Vores styrke er, at vi arbejder i små effektive teams med støtte fra førende eksperter fra hele verden, hvor vi globalt set er 11.000 ansatte. 
Vi tilbyder karrieremuligheder på en moderne arbejdsplads med udfordrende og spændende opgaver i lokale projekter samt mulighed for at arbejde på internationale projekter.

SYSTRA tilbyder dig et godt og trygt arbejdsmiljø med gode udviklings- og karrieremuligheder, faglig sparring og vidensdeling, kollegialt fællesskab, fleksible rammer og attraktiv personalepolitik (seniorordning, gode barselsvilkår for begge forældre), mulighed for hjemmearbejde, gode lønforhold og personalegoder samt en virksomhed med fokus på bæredygtighed g og social ansvarlighed.

 

Om SYSTRA

SYSTRA er en international konsulentvirksomhed, og vi er førende inden for design, planlægning og udførelse af løsninger inden for infrastruktur som jernbaner, veje, letbaner og metro samt forsyning, miljø og vand, projektledelse og digitale løsninger. SYSTRA blev grundlagt i 1957 og har omkring 11.000 medarbejdere i 80 lande med mere end 1100 medarbejdere i Norden.

 

I Danmark er vi omkring 320 projektledere, rådgivere og specialister, som siden 2007 har arbejdet for at skabe, designe og sikre intelligente og bæredygtige infrastrukturløsninger, der styrker et velfungerende og dynamisk samfund. Vi har lokale kontorer i København, Aarhus, Esbjerg og Horsens. Mange af vores projekter er multidisciplinære, hvor vi samarbejder på tværs af organisation og landegrænser for at skabe løsninger, der gør verden mere bæredygtig og digital.

 

Blandt vores største aktuelle projekter er Ny bane over Vestfyn, teknisk rådgivning til DSB's automatiseringsprojekt og til Banedanmarks elektrificeringsprojekt, udvidelse af Øresundsmotorvejen, projektering af forskellige letbaneprojekter, ligesom vi har været med på samtlige metrolinjer på den københavnske metro.

title: Microsoft Full Stack Engineer - Professional
description: Core Responsibilities: Design, implement, and maintain the messaging infrastructure that underpins real-time data exchange between factory automation systems, the MES, and enterprise IT platforms. Deploy and manage distributed message brokers (such as Apache Kafka clusters or MQTT-based systems) to enable streaming communication from shop-floor equipment and sensors to cloud or data center applications. Define and govern message topics/channels and data schemas to ensure consistent structure for all events (e.g. equipment status updates, test results, alarm signals) flowing through the system. Optimize the messaging setup for low latency and high reliability, so that critical events propagate instantly and without loss or duplication. Implement monitoring and alerting for the messaging pipeline – tracking metrics like throughput, lag, and error rates – and quickly troubleshoot any issues in message flow health. Collaborate with other developers to integrate their applications with the messaging layer, and assist in tuning producer/consumer performance to meet factory throughput demands. Must Have Skills: Strong expertise in message-oriented middleware and streaming platforms. Hands-on experience deploying or managing Apache Kafka (preferred) or similar technologies (e.g. RabbitMQ, IBM MQ, Apache Pulsar) in a production environment – including topic design, partitioning, replication, and broker configuration. Proficiency in designing real-time data pipelines with pub/sub patterns, ensuring high throughput and fault tolerance (e.g. using Kafka Connect or MQTT clients to interface with devices and applications). Solid programming skills (Java/Scala or Python) for developing producers and consumers, and optimizing them for performance. Familiarity with messaging system internals (broker clustering, retention policies, consumer groups, offset management) to fine-tune the system for optimal delivery guarantees.

title: Manager, Data Science and Analytics
description:
This role partners with cross-functional business, technology, customer experience, and operations teams to identify opportunities for process improvement, operational optimization, and business growth. The position manages analytics projects, provides subject matter expertise, and ensures the successful delivery of scalable data solutions that improve efficiency, customer experience, and organizational performance.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage analytics teams supporting operational, supply chain, customer-facing, and enterprise technology initiatives.
  • Develop and execute data science and analytics strategies aligned with business objectives and corporate priorities.
  • Oversee the design, development, and implementation of dashboards, reporting solutions, predictive models, and operational analytics tools.
  • Manage analytics projects from initiation through delivery, including project planning, prioritization, resource allocation, and stakeholder communication.
  • Partner with Customer Experience, Product, Operations, Sales, and Technology teams to identify data-driven opportunities and support strategic initiatives.
  • Analyze operational, logistics, transportation, website, API, and customer experience data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support digital platform performance monitoring and operational reporting related to customer-facing technologies and integrations.
  • Ensure data accuracy, reporting consistency, and compliance with enterprise data governance standards.
  • Provide leadership, mentorship, and coaching to analytics team members and cross-functional partners.
  • Research emerging industry trends, analytics technologies, and best practices to drive innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Develop executive-level reporting and presentations to communicate insights, recommendations, and business impacts.
  • Collaborate with customer-facing teams to support consulting initiatives and deliver data-driven business solutions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree or international equivalent required.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Data Science, Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, Operations Research, Supply Chain, Business Analytics, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience managing analytics, business intelligence, or data science teams.

title: Helpdesk Engineer Software Applications
description:

Your tasks:

  • Receive, categorize, and prioritize tickets in the helpdesk system
  • Perform standard troubleshooting, system resets, basic configuration checks, and guided workarounds
  • Monitor system dashboards and alerts for automated storage and conveyor systems
  • Assist operators and Key-Users with login issues, user permissions, and routine tasks
  • Escalate unresolved or complex issues to Level 2 Support with clear documentation
  • Maintain and update the knowledge base with recurring issues and standard procedures
  • Support end-user training sessions or refreshers when needed
  • Technical or logistics background (IT, mechatronics, industrial engineering, logistics)

  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a methodical approach to problem-solving
  • Customer-focused, with strong communication and interpersonal skills

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken)
  • You demonstrate attention to detail.

    Driftmedarbejder til vores OSS og BOPIS team
    Vil du være med bag kulisserne i Magasin? Vi søger to nye kolleger på 25 timer til Operations og BOPIS - dig, der elsker struktur, teamwork og at få hverdagen til at glide.

      

      
    
  
    
    Søg på bare et minut

  









  



    
      

      
  

    
Hej, jeg hedder Caja, og jeg er rekrutteringskonsulent i Magasin. Lige nu søger vi to nye kolleger på 25 timer om ugen til vores Operations-afdeling - én til Operations Sales Support (OSS) og én til vores BOPIS-team.

Fælles for begge stillinger er, at du bliver en vigtig del af maskinrummet i Magasin. Du hjælper med at sikre, at varer, ordrer og kunder bliver håndteret effektivt, og at hverdagen fungerer for både kunder og kolleger.

Vi søger dig, der er struktureret, ansvarsbevidst og praktisk anlagt, og som trives med at få tingene gjort. Du behøver ikke være faglært - det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, tager ansvar og bidrager positivt til teamet.

Som Operations Sales Support bliver du en del af et rutineret Operations-team, der sørger for, at driften og salget kan køre problemfrit.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:


Optælling og lagerstyring



Håndtering af reklamationer og returvarer



Sikre orden og struktur på lageret



Hjælpe med forskellige praktiske driftsopgaver



Understøtte salgsafdelingen, så hverdagen fungerer bedst muligt


Vi søger dig, der har erfaring med optælling, lagerstyring eller varehåndtering, og som har sans for detaljer. Du arbejder grundigt og struktureret og kan både løse opgaver selvstændigt og være en del af et team.

Du bliver en del af et rutineret team, som sørger for at sætte dig godt ind i opgaverne. Du behøver derfor ikke kunne det hele fra første dag - vi lærer dig op og hjælper dig godt i gang.

Arbejdstid: 25 timer om ugen
Primært tidsrum: Kl. 7.00-12.00, men arbejdstiderne kan kombineres anderledes efter behov
Lukkevagter: Nej
Weekend: Som udgangspunkt nej, men der kan forekomme lidt weekendarbejde omkring jul

Som kollega på vores BOPIS-team får du en vigtig rolle i at sikre, at vores kunder får en god og effektiv oplevelse, når de bestiller varer online og efterfølgende henter dem i vores forretning.

BOPIS står for "Buy Online, Pick Up In Store", og din primære opgave bliver at gøre kundernes ordrer klar, så de ligger klar til afhentning senere på dagen.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil være:


Plukke og gøre BOPIS-ordrer klar til kunder



Sikre, at ordrerne er korrekte og klar til tiden



Håndtere varer og sikre god orden og struktur



Hjælpe med reklamationer efter behov



Sende varer ud af huset



Bidrage til de øvrige praktiske opgaver i teamet


Du bliver oplært i de konkrete arbejdsgange. Det vigtigste er, at du er struktureret, har øje for detaljer og kan lide at arbejde praktisk.

Du skal kunne holde styr på flere ordrer ad gangen og samtidig have fokus på, at kunden får den rigtige vare, på det rigtige tidspunkt.

Arbejdstid: 25 timer om ugen
Tidsrum: Kl. 8.00-17.30
Weekend: Hver 3. weekend


Hvem leder vi efter?


Selvom de to stillinger har forskellige primære arbejdsopgaver, er det vigtigt for os, at du:


Er struktureret og detaljeorienteret



Er ansvarsbevidst og mødestabil



Kan arbejde selvstændigt



Er en god teamplayer og hjælper dine kolleger



Trives med praktiske opgaver og faste rutiner



Kan bevare overblikket, når tempoet er højt



Er fleksibel og kan skifte mellem forskellige opgaver



Har en positiv indstilling og lyst til at lære


Erfaring fra lager, varehåndtering, optælling eller lignende er en fordel til OSS-stillingen. Til BOPIS-stillingen er det vigtigste din tilgang til arbejdet.

Magasin som arbejdsplads

I Magasin står vi stærkt på vores værdier Positiv Attitude, Stærkt Holdånd og Godt Købmandskab.

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor vi løfter i flok og hjælper hinanden, når der er behov. Din leder er altid klar til at sparre med dig, men forventer også, at du tager ansvar og gør dit bedste for både kunder og kolleger.

Som medarbejder får du adgang til en række gode medarbejderfordele, blandt andet fælles kaffekantine og attraktive rabatter.

Derudover kan der med tiden opstå spændende muligheder for dig, hvis du har talentet og lysten til at udvikle dig videre i Magasin.

Skal du med på holdet?

Vi søger to nye kolleger på 25 timer - én til Operations Sales Support og én til BOPIS-teamet.
Når du søger, må du meget gerne skrive, hvilken af de to stillinger du er mest interesseret i, eller om du er åben for begge.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.
Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Technical Consultant
description:
As an Analytics, Merchandising, Technical Delivery, you will be responsible for supporting and implementing our NIQ merchandising solutions as well as assisting clients for technical delivery and system / solution support.

  • Single point of contact for clients
  • Ownership of client relationship for support, delivery and consultancy
  • Communicate with client to capture requirements for our solutions
  • Communicate client requirement to appropriate internal team members
  • Testing of solution to ensure client requirement is met
  • Project Management post sales / implementation activities
  • Engaged in training new and existing clients in our merchandising solutions
  • Stakeholder engagement both internally and on the client side
  • Consulting with clients to discuss ongoing enhancement
  • Regular client account reviews
  • Assist in sales activities in terms of preparation of proposal and credential presentations
  • Ensure client service deliverables are aligned o the regional client service standards
  • Regular contact with clients

You’ve dabbled in data. You’ve perused various technologies. And you have the communication chops to translate it all into conversation or presentations. While you’ve worked with global cross-functional teams, you can also put your head down and focus on independent projects. Seeing the big picture takes attention to detail. Keeping up with the fast-changing world of retail and manufacturing sectors. You know what’s happening in data and you’re ready to influence what’s next.

  • Bachelor’s degree graduate or higher
  • Over 2 years relevant working experience
  • Microsoft SQL database experience essential
  • Space Planning/Merchandising experience
  • Service Mind, Presentation available person
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Our Benefits

  • Flexible working environment
  • Volunteer time off
  • LinkedIn Learning
  • Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)

All use of AI is governed by NIQ’s principles of fairness, transparency, human oversight, and inclusion. Final hiring decisions are made exclusively by humans. If you have questions, require accommodations, or wish to request human review were permitted by law, please contact your local HR representative. NIQ is the world’s leading consumer intelligence company, delivering the most complete understanding of consumer buying behavior and revealing new pathways to growth. In 2023, NIQ combined with GfK, bringing together the two industry leaders with unparalleled global reach. With a holistic retail read and the most comprehensive consumer insights—delivered with advanced analytics through state-of-the-art platforms—NIQ delivers the Full View™. NIQ is an Advent International portfolio company with operations in 100+ markets, covering more than 90% of the world’s population.

For more information, visit NIQ.com

Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At NIQ, we are steadfast in our commitment to fostering an inclusive workplace that mirrors the rich diversity of the communities and markets we serve. We believe that embracing a wide range of perspectives drives innovation and excellence. All employment decisions at NIQ are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Senior Software Engineer

Location: Campbell, CA

Remote Type: Home Based/Remote

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

About Centric Software:

Centric Software® is a global leader, providing an innovative and AI-enabled product-concept-to-commercialization platform for retailers, brands and manufacturers of all sizes. We equip retail, fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home and consumer goods brands with pioneering best-of-breed solutions to plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, sell and replenish products. Our technology powers brands to streamline processes, drive efficiency and operate with confidence in an ever-changing market.

Our story is one of rapid growth, bold ideas and extraordinary opportunities. We’re here to challenge the status quo—and we’re looking for brilliant people who want to do the same. No matter where you are in the world, this is your chance to be part of something exceptional.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement backend services using Java, SQL, and TypeScript.
  • Build and enhance TypeScript-intensive features, including UI elements and Custom Actions.
  • Develop scalable REST APIs and microservices supporting enterprise product workflows.
  • Lead architectural discussions and contribute to long-term technical strategy.
  • Deploy and manage containerized services with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Collaborate with Product Management and engineering peers from concept through delivery.
  • Maintain high engineering standards through reviews, mentorship, and technical leadership.
  • Continuously improve system performance, scalability, and reliability.


Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of professional experience with Java.
  • 5+ years of professional experience with TypeScript.
  • Strong SQL proficiency and hands-on experience with relational databases.
  • Proven experience developing server-side applications, distributed systems, and RESTful services.
  • Deep understanding of microservices and service-oriented architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and container orchestration tools such as Kubernetes.
  • Strong mastery of OOP, design patterns, clean code principles, and architectural fundamentals.
  • Experience leading technical design or architectural initiatives (2+ years).
  • Solid understanding of SDLC best practices: code reviews, testing strategies, CI/CD, and release processes.
  • Excellent cross-team communication skills.

Preferred:

  • Experience building TypeScript-based UI components or workflow/custom-action features.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Experience mentoring engineers or serving as a tech lead.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent.


What we offer:

title: Staff Azure Cloud Engineer, Automation
description:
Staff Azure Cloud Engineer, Automation

Team: Business Solutions Group

Location: Fort Worth, TX

Commitment: Full-time

Workplace Type: hybrid

Come for the Challenge. Stay for the Experience.
At HCVT, we believe every challenge presents an opportunity to positively impact our clients and people. Talented and ambitious individuals who seek limitless professional opportunities thrive at HCVT. Our team is known for its technical skill and ability to help clients address complex business issues all while investing in and supporting our people to provide a rewarding employee experience.
What We Do and Who We Serve

We also specialize in serving clients across the following industries: Private Equity, Real Estate & Hospitality, Media & Entertainment, High-Net-Worth Individuals, Manufacturing & Distribution, Professional Services Firms, Technology, Healthcare, Nonprofit Organizations, and Affordable Housing.
We Live Our Core Values
Our values guide us in our day-to-day interactions with our clients and each other—Integrity at our Core; Building Success Together; Passion for Excellence; and Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion. We are focused and committed to the needs of our clients and our team.
Discover How Far You Can Go.
Opportunities abound at HCVT. Our firm has experienced steady growth since its founding in 1991 and continues to expand its client service offerings, creating new opportunities for professionals to grow their careers. We make significant investments in training and provide interesting, diverse, and intellectually stimulating work for our teams—the kind of work that helps you develop and refine your skills to advance in the profession.
Hybrid Work
HCVT currently offers a hybrid work model that allows eligible employees to work both remotely and in the office, based on business needs and team coordination. When working remotely, employees are expected to meet the same performance standards, adhere to the same policies, and maintain the same level of communication, collaboration, and responsiveness as working in the office. Please note that this arrangement is not guaranteed and subject to change at any time. We will strive to provide reasonable notice of any changes to your work location or schedule whenever possible.

About the Role

We are creating a new Azure cloud platform to serve as the foundation for a multi-year cloud modernization program. We need a Lead Azure Cloud Engineer who can walk in, take design ownership, and start building in week one. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role: you will write the code yourself, stand up the pipelines yourself, and set the technical bar the rest of the teams build against.

You are the senior-most and dedicated cloud engineering voice on this program. You need to be well-rounded: as comfortable troubleshooting a firewall rule or a network route as you are writing a Terraform module or designing the pipeline that deploys it. You will need to work with the firm's existing IT, security, and network teams to land on shared standards, and then you're the one who codifies them into automation.

Tools and Stack You'll Work In

Azure (landing zone, networking, Entra ID) - Terraform + Terraform Cloud - Azure Verified Modules - GitHub Actions - Microsoft Defender for Cloud - Azure Policy - Azure Monitor / Log Analytics - GitHub Copilot / Anthropic Claude (AI-assisted delivery). Our policy-as-code and shift-left scanning has not been finalized; helping evaluate and select this tooling is part of the role.

An internal developer platform pattern for self-service application delivery (e.g. HashiCorp HCP Waypoint, which integrates with HCP Terraform).

As the Staff Azure Cloud Engineer, you will be responsible for, but not limited to, the following:

  • Design and build the Azure landing zone, aligned to Microsoft's Cloud Adoption Framework design areas (identity, network topology, resource organization, governance, management, security) and reviewed against the Well-Architected Framework's five pillars at each milestone.
  • Build with Azure Verified Modules (AVM) as the base layer, composing right-sized custom Terraform modules on top rather than hand-rolling every resource or adopting the full CAF Enterprise-Scale module wholesale.
  • Own the Terraform Cloud (TFC) setup end to end: workspace structure (one state file per workload per environment), variable sets, run triggers, and remote state strategy.
  • Own hands-on networking and firewall configuration: hub-spoke topology, NSGs, Azure Firewall, WAF rules, private endpoints, and DNS. There is no separate network architect on this program; you need to be able to design, configure, and troubleshoot these yourself, informed by the firm's existing network/security teams.
  • Work with internal teams to define our to-be cloud native software engineering practice and process, then codify it. Coding standards, module and repo conventions, branching and review workflow, policy-as-code approach, and the shift-left tooling chain (scanning, testing, gating) are not yet decided. You will work with the firm's existing security and engineering teams to land on a standard, and then turns that into working Terraform, pipelines, and documentation.
  • Establish policy-as-code guardrails (approach and tooling still to be decided, e.g. HashiCorp Sentinel, OPA, or another option you recommend and help evaluate) so that governance is enforced automatically on every plan
  • Build the CI/CD pipeline for infrastructure changes: automatic plan on every pull request, mandatory human review, manual apply gate
  • Help stand up our shift-left scanning practice: the goal is that IaC, code, and dependency issues are caught early in the engineering cycle.
  • Set up the security and observability baseline: Microsoft Defender for Cloud, centralized Log Analytics, Azure Policy at the management-group scope, hub-spoke network segmentation, and private endpoints.
  • Coordinate with the firm's identity/security and network teams on Entra ID architecture (app registrations, Conditional Access, PIM) and network/firewall standards.
  • Set the technical example for module structure, versioning, documentation, and code review standards that future hires on this program will follow as the team grows.
  • Extend the paved path from infrastructure to application delivery. Define a golden, self-service deployment pattern so Backend and Frontend engineers can ship application code onto the landing zone without hand-rolling their own pipelines.

We expect that our Staff Azure Cloud Engineer will have the following qualifications:

  • 6+ years in cloud infrastructure/platform engineering, with real production ownership, not just POCs.
  • A well-rounded Azure Cloud generalist, comfortable across Terraform/IaC, Azure networking, and firewalls/network security,
  • Deep, hands-on Terraform experience: module authorship, remote state, workspace/environment strategy, version pinning, and awareness of the tradeoffs in monorepo vs. per-module repo structures.
  • Strong, hands-on Azure networking and security: hub-spoke topology, NSGs, Azure Firewall, WAF rules, private endpoints, DNS, and hybrid/legacy connectivity patterns, plus identity (Entra ID, RBAC, managed identity) and governance (management groups, Azure Policy).
  • Working knowledge of SOC 2 control families (access control, change management, logging/monitoring, network security) well enough to design a landing zone that satisfies them by default, even without prior formal audit experience.
  • Able to work effectively with the firm's existing security, network, and IT teams
  • Direct experience building CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure changes (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent), including plan/apply gating patterns.
  • Working knowledge of policy-as-code approaches (e.g. Sentinel, OPA) and IaC/security scanning practices.
  • Comfortable being the first cloud engineer on the program: able to make and defend decisions yourself.
  • Strong scripting ability (PowerShell, Bash, or Python) for tooling and automation glue.
  • Comfortable defining a self-service application deployment pattern (a “golden path”) that other engineers can use to ship application code without needing deep Terraform expertise themselves.

    • Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience with Terraform Cloud/Enterprise specifically (not just open-source Terraform CLI).
  • Prior experience building a landing zone from zero, versus inheriting and extending one.
  • Experience consuming (or ideally contributing to) Azure Verified Modules.
  • Direct experience operating in a compliance-driven environment (SOC 2, HIPAA, or similar) through an actual audit cycle, where controls needed to be demonstrable, not just implemented.
  • Experience mentoring other infrastructure/platform engineers.
  • Experience with HashiCorp HCP Waypoint, or a similar internal developer platform (IDP) approach, for standardizing self-service application deployment.
  • HashiCorp Terraform Associate or Professional certification.
  • Microsoft certifications: AZ-305 (Solutions Architect) and/or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer); AZ-500 (Security) is a plus.

title: Product Manager - Loyalty Performance Management
description:
About LJI

Loyalty Juggernaut (LJI) is a leading B2B SaaS company redefining how enterprises drive customer engagement and loyalty. Our flagship platform, GRAVTY®, enables global brands to transform loyalty programs into measurable, revenue-generating growth engines.

Built as an AI-first, next-generation solution, GRAVTY® empowers organizations to deliver highly personalized, real-time experiences at scale—helping them increase customer lifetime value and deepen brand relationships.

Headquartered in Palo Alto, California, LJI partners with leading enterprises across 16 major industries including airlines, retail, hospitality, financial services and telecommunications powering some of the most innovative loyalty ecosystems worldwide.


Our Global Impact:

  • 400+ Million members connected through our platform.
  • 100+ Global Brands trust us to drive loyalty and brand devotion.
  • 3-Time Winner of “Best Technology Innovation in Loyalty”.
  • Global recognitions for Excellence in Loyalty Management under numerous categories.
  • Recognised as a ‘Strong performer’ in The Forrester Wave™ Loyalty Platforms, Q4 2025.


Explore more about us at


The OPPORTUNITY


Loyalty Juggernaut is seeking a Product Manager - Loyalty Performance Management to identify, validate, launch, and scale new consulting, managed-service, and technology-enabled offerings.


We design and run loyalty and customer-engagement programs for some of the world's most recognized brands. Growth doesn't only come from the platform - it comes from new offerings: new consulting, managed-service, and technology-enabled practices that clients need before anyone has packaged them. This role finds those opportunities and turns them into real businesses.



As a Product Manager You own the full lifecycle - from an initial idea or market signal through research, business case, offer design, pilot, commercialization, and practice development. After launch, you act as the business owner for the incubated practice: setting its roadmap, sharpening the proposition and delivery model, watching commercial performance, and building the repeatability it needs to become a standalone unit.



This is not a traditional software product management role. It blends market strategy, services design, product marketing, commercial ownership, and venture incubation. You are as comfortable building a market landscape and modeling unit economics as you are shaping a client-ready offer, creating sales enablement, and leading cross-functional execution.



What will you DO:


Opportunity discovery & market validation

  • Build and manage a pipeline of new-service ideas.
  • Conduct structured market, customer, category, and competitor research.
  • Define the ideal customer profile, economic buyer, priority use cases, customer pain points and desired outcomes.
  • Lead interviews and working sessions with clients, prospects, sales, delivery teams, product leaders, subject-matter experts, and partners.

Business case, pricing & investment recommendation

  • Build decision-grade business cases that connect market opportunity, strategic fit, client value, investment requirements, risks, and expected business impact.
  • Define pricing, packaging, contract structure, and monetization options - fixed fees, subscriptions, usage or outcome-based fees, revenue share, and hybrid models.
  • Translate assumptions into an executive recommendation and a clear investment ask; track actual performance against the approved case and update the forecast as evidence improves.

Service product design & productization

  • Turn a validated opportunity into a repeatable, sellable offer with a defined customer, outcome, scope, deliverables, methodology, timeline, dependencies, exclusions, and acceptance criteria.
  • Design the end-to-end service blueprint: client journey, discovery and design activities, delivery workflows, roles and RACI, governance, data and technology requirements, quality controls, SLAs, and KPI framework.
  • Translate service requirements into a prioritized roadmap for platform, data, analytics, automation, and internal tooling in partnership with product and engineering.

Go-to-market & sales enablement

  • Partner with Marketing to define the name, positioning, value proposition, audience, messaging architecture, launch plan, and campaign strategy.
  • Create client-ready sales materials: offering decks, one-pagers, vertical use cases, executive narratives, case studies, ROI tools, proposal content, demo stories, objection handling, and competitive battlecards.
  • Translate complex capabilities into clear stories that connect the customer requirement, the service or solution design, the commercial logic, and the measurable outcome.

Launch, roadmap & practice incubation

  • Own cross-functional launch readiness: milestones, dependencies, decisions, risks, enablement, delivery capacity, operational controls, measurement, and executive reporting.
  • Maintain the post-launch roadmap and prioritized backlog across proposition, methodology, commercial model, sales enablement, delivery operations, technology, analytics, and partner ecosystem.
  • Create the operating cadence for the practice: performance dashboards, pipeline and delivery reviews, roadmap decisions, client feedback loops, and quarterly business reviews.

Graduation to a standalone unit

  • Prepare the scale plan: market focus, product and service roadmap, P&L and forecast, organization design, hiring profile, partner model, governance, and investment needs.
  • Transition the practice to its permanent leader with clear ownership, documented IP and processes, an active roadmap, trained teams, customer and pipeline context, and a complete performance baseline.



You will be a GREAT FIT if you have:


  • Strong market research and customer discovery skills, with the ability to turn incomplete signals into a structured point of view and testable hypotheses.
  • Commercial and financial fluency: business-case development, pricing and packaging, scenario modeling, unit economics, margin, forecasting, and investment recommendations.
  • Experience designing productized consulting, implementation, advisory, or managed-service offers with clear methods, deliverables, operating models, and measurement.
  • A track record partnering with Marketing and Sales to position, launch, enable, and sell enterprise offerings - and comfort supporting early client pursuits directly.
  • The ability to translate client needs into business requirements and roadmaps, working effectively with product, engineering, data, operations, and delivery teams.
  • Exceptional written, visual, and verbal communication; able to produce executive-grade presentations, models, proposals, and decision documents.
  • A builder's instinct - you create clarity, structure, and momentum where no established playbook exists, and you influence across functions without relying on hierarchy.



Nice to have:

  • Experience in loyalty, customer engagement, enterprise SaaS, travel, hospitality, retail, financial services, or adjacent industries.
  • A track record in corporate innovation, venture building, or standing up a new practice from zero to a repeatable, sustainable business.
  • Exposure to outcome and usage-based commercial models, partner or coalition economics, and managed-service delivery at scale.



Education & Experience:


Education

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • An advanced degree (MBA / PGDM or similar) is helpful but not required.

Experience

  • 5+ years in services product management, consulting offer development, strategy, professional services, product marketing, corporate innovation, venture building, or a closely related role.
  • Demonstrated success taking at least one B2B service, solution, or practice from concept through launch and into measurable commercial growth.
  • Direct experience building business cases and financial models used to inform real investment decisions - not academic exercises.
  • Experience presenting solutions and recommendations to senior client and internal stakeholders, including executives.
