title: Product Manager - Integrations
description:
We Care, We Challenge, We Commit, We Collaborate

Join Scrive and be part of an international, fast-growing company headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. Collaborate with smart, caring, and driven colleagues across Europe as we shape the Scrive story. 🚀

As part of our growing product organisation, you’ll join a diverse and collaborative team working on solutions that make a real difference in our customers’ daily operations. We work in cross-functional teams (squads) and use modern tools like Claude, Productboard, Figma, and Amplitude.

The opportunity
We are currently looking for a Product Manager to join our team and play a key role in owning our integrated experience. This role is an exciting opportunity to manage a growing portfolio of native integrations that connect Scrive with the tools our customers use every day, spanning both the integrations we build outward into other platforms and making it easier for other systems to embed Scrive into their own products. These include CRM systems like Salesforce and HubSpot, document management tools like SharePoint and Google Drive, and Microsoft products such as Microsoft365 and Power Automate.

📍 The role will preferably be based in Stockholm, but Copenhagen is also an option, and you will report to Group Product Manager.

As a Product Manager, you will:

  • Own and manage the roadmap for our native integration portfolio.

  • Work closely with customers and commercial teams to identify integration needs and pain points, and drive the development of new standard integrations.

  • Define requirements and collaborate with engineering to scope and deliver new integration features.

  • Support go-to-market teams with product documentation, training, and launch readiness.

  • Maintain and improve existing integrations, balancing tech quality and usability.

  • Collaborate with internal teams on packaging, pricing, and positioning of integrations.

  • Track integration usage and gather feedback to guide continuous improvement.

  • Collaborate with external consultancy firms that build and maintain selected outsourced integrations, ensuring quality, alignment, and timely delivery.



What we’re looking for
You don’t need to have all the answers on day one, but we’re looking for someone curious, structured, and eager to grow.

To succeed in this role, you should have:

  • 1-3 years of experience in a product-related role (e.g., Product Manager, Product Owner, Business Analyst).

  • An understanding of SaaS platforms and B2B user needs.

  • Experience working with APIs, integrations, or workflow tools.

  • A structured approach to discovery, documentation, and decision-making.

  • A forward-thinking mindset where you naturally integrate AI-tools into your daily workflows, along with an enthusiasm to explore their potential together with us.

  • Fluency in English, both written and verbal.

  • EU residency, or Valid EU working permit.


🌟 Bonus points if you have:

  • Fluency in Nordic languages, German or Dutch.


In this role, we see that you demonstrate strong skills in Problem framing, Stakeholder management, Documentation and Commercial awareness. These skills will play a key role in our assessment and discussions during the recruitment process.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Apply anyway! Studies show that women and people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every qualification. At Scrive, we value diverse perspectives and encourage anyone who is excited about this role to apply.

title: Kunnossapitoasentaja Heinolaan
description:
Haemme asiakasyrityksellemme kunnossapitoasentajaa tehtaalle Heinolaan.

Mikä Amiko? Olemme kotimainen henkilöstöpalvelualan yritys. Tarjoamme lukuisilta aloilta töitä, jotka joustavat elämäntilanteesi mukaan, tuovat uusia haasteita tai kasvattavat osaamistasi-sinä päätät! Meidän tehtävänämme on mahdollistaa työllistyminen ja pitää tekijöistämme huolta.

Millainen työ sinua odottaa?

Työnkuvaasi kuuluu monipuolisesti tuotantolaitoksen mekaaninen kunnossapito, laitteiden ylläpito, huollot sekä asennukset.

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan heti kuin on mahdollista. Työtä tehdään kahdessa vuorossa. Työ alkaa 6kk määräaikaisella työsuhteella Amikon kautta, jonka jälkeen sinulla on mahdollisuus vakinaistua asiakkaamme kirjoille.

Palkkaus on sopimuksen mukaan, huomioiden osaamisesi. Kirjaathan siis palkkatoiveesi hakemukseen.

Kuulostaa hyvältä, mutta miksi hakisin töitä juuri Amikon kautta? Amiko tarjoaa kaiken tasoisille teollisuusalojen ja tuotannon ammattilaisille laajan valikoiman töitä. Olemme sinulle reilu, luotettava ja joustava työelämän kumppani. Amikolla on hyvä maine työmarkkinoilla. Pyrimme aina etsimään parhaat mahdolliset ratkaisut työllistymisesi tueksi. Amikolaisena saat:

  • Vähintään TES:in mukaisen palkkauksen – palkkausjärjestelmämme on kannustava, joskus jopa suurempi kuin työllistyessä suoraan yrityksen palkkalistoille.
  • Laajasti erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia – meillä on kattavat verkostot ja laaja työpaikkavalikoima niin osa-aikaisia, kokopäiväisiä kuin sesonkitöitä monelta eri alalta. Kun sopiva työ löytyy, monille tarjoutuu myös mahdollisuus siirtyä vakituiseksi työntekijäksi asiakasyritykseen.
  • Oman yhteyshenkilön ja yksilöllistä työnhakua – Amikolta saat henkilökohtaista palvelua ja oman tutun yhteyshenkilön, johon voit olla suoraan yhteydessä.
  • Kattavat työterveyspalvelut, normaalin eläkekertymän ja sairausajan palkan sairauden sattuessa – Vaikka teetkin työsi asiakasyrityksessämme, olet amikolainen ja kannamme sinusta vastuun ja huolehdimme eduistasi.
  • … vai kenties jotain ihan uutta urallesi? Autamme myös alanvaihdossa. Räätälöidyt uravalmennukset auttavat päivittämään osaamistasi ja löytämään uuden suunnan urallasi.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Työtehtävän menestyksellinen hoitaminen edellyttää kokemusta mekaanisesta kunnossapidosta, itseohjautuvuutta, kiinnostusta itsesi jatkuvaan kehittämiseen, analyyttistä ongelmanratkaisukykyä, paineensietokykyä, joustavuutta työtehtävien suhteen sekä hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja. Ratkaisevinta on kuitenkin positiivinen ja kehityshakuinen asenne.

Sinulla tulee olla tai olet valmiina suorittamaan nopealla aikataululla tulityö- ja työturvallisuuskortit. B-ajokortti on pakollinen tehtävään. Suomen kieltä vaaditaan tehtävässä, myös kyky kommunikoida englanniksi tehtävässä on toivottavaa.

Kiinnostuitko? Täytä siis hakemuksesi osoitteessa www.amiko.fi ja kerro meille osaamisestasi. Lisätietoa tehtävästä saat Amikon Mikalta, 050 463 2668. mika.niemi@amiko.fi

Huomioithan, että emme käsittele sähköpostitse vastaanotettuja hakemuksia vaan jätäthän hakemuksen nettisivujemme kautta tietosuojasyistä. Please note that we do not process applications submitted by e-mail, so please submit your application via our website for privacy and data protection reasons.

title: Senior Engineer - Carbon Management (Roads)
description:
Your Team
Our Roads Net Zero team sits within our wider Roads group and guides clients and colleagues through transport and infrastructure decarbonisation, embedding carbon thinking at the heart of our projects.
We deliver carbon assessment and management for transport infrastructure projects; quantifying and assessing carbon to inform strategies and plans, provide carbon management reporting and develop carbon management policies and advice for clients.
Since its inception three years ago, our Transport Net Zero team has led industry change—authoring the Department for Transport’s Quantifiable Carbon Reduction guidance; working with Sub‑National Transport Bodies to develop baseline emissions models and support regional decarbonisation strategies; advising local authority clients; and developing carbon management policies for major transport programmes and organisations.
As one of the largest suppliers of professional services to various clients, we influence change through client engagement, we invest heavily in R&D to drive innovation across decarbonisation and climate resilience. Our current frameworks and strategic partnerships spanning National Highways (SDF), National Gird (GGP) work and other frameworks provide a strong platform for impact and growth.
Joining the team at this critical time for climate action presents a great opportunity to influence transport policies, shape WSP’s and our client’s decarbonisation approaches, and play a meaningful role on the national pathway to net zero.

You will be responsible for:
·Leading and support carbon management inputs for highways and multidisciplinary infrastructure projects across all stages of design.
·Acting as the Carbon Lead on projects, embedding PAS 2080 principles, coordinating low-carbon solutions with the Client, ECI contractors and suppliers.
·Challenging designs to identify opportunities for carbon reduction and climate resilience.
· Developing and apply carbon assessment methodologies, governance and tools.
·Advising clients on low‑carbon innovation and climate‑resilient opportunities. Identifying and implementing innovative processes and materials for projects.
·Contributing Net Zero inputs into strategic pursuits and proposals, including coordinating and preparing technical and commercial responses.
·Helping build WSP Net Zero process, fostering a collaborative, 'carbon conscious' culture across our Roads and wider T&I teams.
·Supporting technical development and upskilling of colleagues, including technical leadership and assurance of deliverables
·Contributing to continual improvement and business development within the Roads Net Zero team and National Carbon management activities.

title: Business Analyst I - Governance
description:
Enterprise Shared Services (ESS) comprises key functions that are core to the company’s operations, including Global Real Estate & Workplace Experience, Global Supply Management, Business Resilience & Corporate Functions Governance, Aviation, Internal Fraud, and Global Security. ESS helps keep our company growing and puts our colleagues at the center of everything they do by delivering best-in-class services that power safe, resilient, and efficient operations around the world. This role will be part of the Global Operational Excellence & Risk Management function within the Global Real Estate & Workplace Experience (GREWE) team, driving operational excellence, governance, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement across the global real estate portfolio.

Operational Governance & Process Excellence

  1. Risk & Control Analysis: Analyze Risk Performance Rating (RPR), PRSA/RCSA, and Compliance Risk Assessment data to identify control gaps, support remediation initiatives, and enhance the effectiveness of risk and control frameworks.
  2. Business Analysis & Process Improvement: Gather business requirements, map current and future-state processes, identify process improvement opportunities, and support the implementation of risk and compliance initiatives.
  3. Regulatory Reporting & Governance: Support regulatory reporting, policy governance, and sustainability reporting by coordinating data collection, validating information, and ensuring adherence to internal policies and regulatory requirements.
  4. Stakeholder & Third-Party Management: Collaborate with business, compliance, procurement, and technology stakeholders to manage Third-Party Lifecycle Management (TLM), resolve issues, and ensure timely execution of governance activities.
  5. Risk Reporting & Insights: Develop dashboards, management reports, and performance metrics to monitor Operational Risk Events (OREs), Issues, Remediations, and key risk indicators, providing actionable insights to leadership.
  6. Audit & Compliance Support: Coordinate internal and external audit activities, track audit findings and remediation plans, maintain governance documentation, and support compliance reviews to ensure effective control execution.
  7. Ad hoc Responsibility: Perform other duties and special projects as assigned to support business and organizational objectives. Responsibilities may evolve over time to meet changing business needs.

Critical Factors to Success

  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to analyze complex business processes, interpret risk and compliance data, identify gaps, and recommend practical, data-driven solutions.
  • Risk & Regulatory Acumen: Strong understanding of operational risk, control frameworks, regulatory requirements, and governance processes, with the ability to apply them effectively in a business environment.
  • Stakeholder Management: Ability to build effective relationships across business, compliance, procurement, technology, and audit teams, influencing stakeholders and driving collaboration.
  • Communication & Documentation: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document business requirements, prepare governance reports, and present insights clearly to senior leadership.
  • Execution & Attention to Detail: Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, ensure high-quality deliverables, and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset: Proactive approach to identifying process improvement opportunities, leveraging data, automation, and best practices to enhance operational efficiency and strengthen controls.
  • 5+ years of experience, including 3+ years in Third Party Risk Management, Vendor Governance, Operational Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, or a related governance function.
  • Experience managing end-to-end third-party lifecycle activities, including due diligence, contracting support, ongoing monitoring, issue management, and governance reporting.
  • Proven experience leading cross-functional projects and driving process governance, operational improvements, and regulatory or policy compliance.
  • Strong analytical, reporting, and risk assessment skills, with experience identifying trends, evaluating risks, and recommending practical solutions.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills with the ability to influence diverse stakeholders and present to leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Risk Management, or a related field; relevant certifications (PMP, CRISC, CISA, Lean Six Sigma, etc.) are an advantage.

title: Strategic Projects Lead - AI Safety
description:
About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development.

We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve.

This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Since raising our $30M Series A at a $300M valuation, AfterQuery has grown well over a $100M revenue run rate.

We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity:
We were one of the fastest-growing YC companies in our batch, and we believe we can become one of the fastest-growing YC companies of all time.

Founding Impact:
You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth:
Competitive salary and meaningful equity. As we scale, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the engineering organization and lead major technical initiatives.

Strong Team:
Our founding team has experience from Citadel Securities, Meta, Google, Silver Lake, and Morgan Stanley — work alongside world-class engineers and researchers.

Responsibilities

  • Project and client management: Partner directly with the safety, alignment, and trust & safety teams at frontier AI labs — scoping their hardest data problems, translating them into deliverable programs, and driving revenue.

  • Manage expert teams: Recruit and lead specialized contributors — red teamers, security researchers, trust & safety practitioners, and domain risk experts — and hold a high bar on the quality of what they produce.

  • Shape how frontier models are made safe: Design the specifications behind adversarial datasets, jailbreak and attack taxonomies, refusal-boundary and over-refusal sets, and safety benchmarks that labs use to measure and improve model behavior.

  • Build the red teaming machinery: Stand up repeatable methodologies — human red team campaigns, automated attack generation, coverage tracking against harm taxonomies — rather than one-off deliverables.

  • End-to-end execution: Own projects from first conversation through final delivery, in a fast-moving environment where the spec often does not exist yet.

  • Operational impact: Support initiatives across building, analysis, coordination, and execution as we scale the safety practice.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years in AI safety, red teaming, trust & safety, adversarial ML, or security research; at a frontier AI lab, FAANG, top security firm, or equivalent.

  • Hands-on adversarial experience: jailbreaking or stress-testing frontier models, prompt injection research, offensive security, penetration testing, bug bounty, CTFs, or trust & safety investigations and enforcement.

  • Fluency with how safety work is actually structured (harm taxonomies, evaluation design, safety frameworks and model policy).

  • High agency and the ability to execute in ambiguity; comfort defining the problem before solving it.

  • Strong writing. Much of this job is specifying risk precisely enough that fifty other people can execute against it.

  • Genuine passion for AI and interest in entrepreneurship.

  • Demonstrated track record of competitive success.

  • Strong leadership and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Depth in a high-consequence risk domain (cyber, bio, fraud and financial crime, child safety, influence operations).

title: Junior User Researcher
description:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

About the role

We’re looking for a passionate Junior User Researcher to join our growing team. This role is perfect for someone with an analytical mindset and strong interest in user-centered design and a knack for turning insights into actionable improvements.

In addition to core user research responsibilities, we need someone who’s comfortable diving into design tools to develop UX prototypes. You’ll partner with other user researchers helping set up and analyze design studies and building testable prototypes yourself.

What you'll do

  • Plan and execute user research studies (e.g., usability testing, interviews, surveys, product benchmarking / capability mapping).
  • Synthesize findings into clear, actionable insights for the product team.
  • Collaborate with Product Designers and Product Managers to define and refine research goals.
  • Create lightweight prototypes or wireframes for testing purposes.
  • Contribute to the setup facilitation and analysis of design validation tests.
  • Document and share research learnings across teams.
  • Learning from this all along the way, and getting better every time you do it.

About you

Must have skills:

  • Foundational knowledge of user-centered research methods and tools.
  • Familiarity with tools like Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, or similar. Ability to wireframe or prototype is a must.
  • User research, UX design or related fields. Entry-level candidates with strong portfolios are welcome.

It would be nice if you:

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills, especially when working with cross-functional teams.
  • A proactive approach to problem-solving and an eagerness to learn.
  • English proficiency
  • Knowledge of usability testing platforms (e.g., UserTesting, Lookback.io) or data analysis.

Your growth trajectory

In your first 3 months you'll work alongside our User Researchers collecting data with a range of primary methods, dig into large datasets to extract meaningful insights, and start packaging and sharing findings with colleagues and external partners. You'll also build your understanding of Fever's business context and develop your awareness of where solutions might lie.

By month 6 you'll be designing and optimising systems for the collection, analysis, and dissemination of research data. You'll have an eye for the gaps in our knowledge and a sense of how to fill them — ensuring data validity, addressing biases, and identifying trends in our data that constitute real business opportunities.

Benefits & Perks

  • Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance.
  • Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences

  • Health insurance and other benefits such as Flexible remuneration with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee.
  • English Lessons
  • Gympass Membership
  • Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow.

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. Working alongside Defence stakeholders, industry partners and specialist engineering teams, you’ll support the verification, testing and validation of the Aegis Baseline 9 Combat System Upgrade across the Hobart Class Destroyers. As a V&V Engineer, you will support the planning, execution and assessment of combat system testing activities across a major maritime Defence program. You will develop verification plans, review test procedures, analyse test results and ensure all verification evidence is complete, traceable and aligned to Defence requirements.

Working across systems engineering, design assurance and test environments, you will collaborate with Defence, prime contractors and engineering teams to verify the performance of combat system capabilities prior to platform integration, sea trials and operational release.

This role offers exposure to advanced naval combat systems, complex engineering environments and senior Defence stakeholders while providing opportunities to further develop your systems engineering and Defence test expertise.

About the Program

Working within the Maritime Business Unit, you will contribute to the enhancement of Australia's air and missile defence capability through modernisation of the Royal Australian Navy's premier guided missile destroyers. The program is delivered in partnership with the Commonwealth, and partners, supporting the modernisation of one of the Royal Australian Navy’s most important surface combatant capabilities.

Does This Sound Like You?

You are analytical, detail-oriented and thrive in environments where testing, verification and evidence-based decision making are critical to program success.

You may have experience in:

  • Verification and validation activities
  • Test and evaluation programs
  • Combat systems or systems engineering
  • Requirements traceability and verification management
  • Defence, maritime or complex engineering environments

What You’ll Bring

Essential

  • Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline
  • Experience in verification and validation, test and evaluation, or systems engineering roles
  • Experience supporting complex Defence or naval combat system programs
  • Knowledge of verification methods, requirements traceability and test documentation practices
  • Experience developing or reviewing test procedures and acceptance criteria
  • Ability to analyse test outcomes and support issue resolution activities

Desirable

  • Experience supporting sea trials, harbour acceptance testing or platform integration activities
  • Familiarity with DOORS, Jama or similar requirements management tools
  • Experience working within multi-prime Defence delivery environments
  • Experience supporting Commonwealth-led test and evaluation programs


Due to the nature of the work, you are required to currently hold and maintain a clearance as required by the Commonwealth. In some instances, compliance with International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) requirements may also be an inherent requirement.

More than anything, you’ll bring a strong work ethic, a positive attitude, and a commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes for our clients.

Why Downer Professional Services

At Downer Professional Services, we’re not just a workplace - we’re a business dedicated to contributing to the shaping of the future of defence in Australia. As the country’s only sovereign prime, we’re committed to making a real difference in protecting Australia’s interests.

What is means to belong at Downer Professional Services

  • Meaningful work: Help to deliver critical Defence projects that protect Australia and shape its future.
  • Professional development: Access career mapping, accelerated learning programs, and shared learning through our Communities of Practice.
  • Great perks: Enjoy discounts on healthcare, retail, vehicles, and more through Perks@Downer.
  • Veteran support: Benefit from initiatives like up to 20 days of Reservist Leave to stay connected post-service.

You want your work to matter and so do we. With over 26,000 people across Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific, our team is made up of individuals with unique perspectives, backgrounds, and ideas.

We know that diversity makes us stronger and we actively celebrate it through our commitment to inclusion and belonging.

We’re committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities we serve and we welcome people of all ages, genders, sexual orientations, cultures, abilities, and lived experiences. We especially encourage applications from those whose voices have traditionally been underrepresented in our industry, including women, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples, Māori and Pasifika Peoples, veterans, people with disability, and neurodivergent individuals. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with this role, we’d still like to hear from you. If it feels like the right fit, apply - potential counts, and so do you.

As a WORK180 Endorsed Employer, we support flexibility that works for your life, inclusive leadership that values your voice, and equitable access to opportunity so you can do your best work and bring your whole self to it.

If you need support or adjustments through the recruitment process, just let us know, we’re here to help you.

														 Souschef - Fuldtid - København V (Vesterbrogade) 
													 

																									 

											 

											 
										 

										
 
											
 
																																				
  
  
 
 
   Introduktion  
 

 
 Kan du motivere branchens bedste kolleger og bidrage til, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar? Så er du måske vores nye souschef. 

 Hos Lidl bliver du en del af Europas største dagligvarekæde med 150+ butikker i Danmark. Sammen er vi drevet af et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, og på #teamlidl kommer du med på en succesfuld rejse -- på et hold med høje ambitioner til fælles. Vi har brug for stærke ledere, der giver vores medarbejdere retning og overskud, så vi sammen skaber rammerne for landets bedste indkøbsoplevelse.
 Som souschef tager du aktiv del i det daglige arbejde i butikken, og får medansvar for butikkens drift og resultater. Hos os får du ansvar lige fra første arbejdsdag og bliver samtidig en del af et ambitiøst karriereudviklingsforløb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi nemlig høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen, med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig.
 Som souschef i Lidl får du en ansvarsfuld rolle med spændende udfordringer og en konkurrencedygtig lønpakke. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, så du har forudsætningerne for at opnå succes i din nye stilling.
     
 
 

 
   Om jobbet  
 

 
 Som souschef er du med til at drive butikken og lede medarbejderne. Du har medansvar for, at butikken lever op til kundernes forventninger, så de bliver ved med at handle hos os. Ud over at bestille varer, fylde op og ekspedere kunderne ved kassen, får du også følgende opgaver, som du løser i tæt samarbejde med butikschefen: 
 
 Planlægning af ressourcer og prioritering af arbejdsopgaver  

 Oplæring af medarbejdere, så de efterlever Lidls værdier og butikskoncepter 

 Ledelse af medarbejdere så de lykkes i deres job 

 Sørge for, at vores butikskoncepter overholdes 

 Ansvar for butikken når butikschefen ikke er til stede  
  
 

 
   Om dig  
 

 
 Du er en empatisk og stærk ledertype, der har nemt ved motivere dine medarbejdere. Du bliver respekteret for din faglighed, og du sætter en ære i at tage del i arbejdsopgaverne i den daglige drift, og være med til at sikre, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar. 
 Du er godt rustet til jobbet, hvis du: 
 
 Har brancheerfaring og gerne erfaring fra lignende stilling 

 Har gennemført et lederkursus eller er motiveret for at udvikle dig som leder 

 Har en venlig og professionel fremtoning 

 Inspirerer dine medarbejdere til at følge dit gode eksempel 

 Har overblik og fokus på detaljen  

 Ser butikken som et team og ikke er bleg for at give en hånd med, når en kollega har brug for hjælp 

 Har god forståelse for arbejdsprocesser, procedurer og koncepter 
  
 

 
   Vi tilbyder  
 

 
 Som souschef i Lidl får du:  
 
 En udfordrende rolle, hvor tingene går stærkt 

 Verdensklasse sammenhold 

 En konkurrencedygtig lønpakke på 26.000 - 32.500 kr. brutto om måneden 

 Et udbetalt tillæg i henhold til overenskomsten, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter - fx aftener, weekender og helligdage 

 Løn og vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst med HK 

 En grundig oplæring i vores arbejdsgange og koncepter 

 Adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt 

 Mulighed for sundhedsordning 

 Rabatordning hos flere udbydere af rejser, shopping, kultur, fitness mm. 
 
   

 Vil du med på #teamlidl?
 Sådan søger du stillingen: 
 
 Klik på "Søg nu" 

 Udfyld formularen 

 Vedhæft dit motiverede CV  
 
   

 Vi rekrutterer løbende, så send dit motiverede CV hurtigst muligt. Da butikken er åben alle ugens dage, vil der forekomme dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.
 Vores rekrutteringsproces består af en telefonsamtale og en fysisk samtale i butikken. 

 Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller ansøgningsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Recruiting på  jobilidloest@lidl.dk  eller tlf. 7635 0635, mandag - torsdag 8.00 - 15.00/ fredag 08.00 - 14.00.  

 Vi ser frem til at modtage dit CV! 
 
 
 


  
 

												
 
     
  Transskription 
 Der er ikke nogen bedre følelse end når der er ordentlig tingene og Når alting står snur lige nede i butikken handler det for mig om at hjælpe kunderne og at gøre mit til at vi har en indbydende butik at det samtidig sker i samarbejde med de bedste kollegaer det gør det bare fedt at gå på arbejde

title: Dallas Technology Audit & Advisory Senior Consultant
description:
JOB REQUISITION

Dallas Technology Audit & Advisory Senior Consultant

LOCATION

DALLAS

ADDITIONAL LOCATION(S)

JOB DESCRIPTION

You Belong Here

The Protiviti Career provides opportunity to learn, inspire, and advance within a collaborative and inclusive culture. We hire curious individuals for whom learning is a passion. We lean into our mission: We Care. We Collaborate. We Deliver.

At every level, we champion leaders who live our values of integrity, inclusion, innovation, and commitment to success. Imagining our work as a journey, we believe integrity guides our way, inclusion moves us forward together, innovation creates new destinations, and our commitment to success empowers us to deliver on our vision to be the most trusted global consulting firm.

Where We Need You:

Protiviti is looking for a Technology Audit & Advisory Senior Consultant to join our growing team.

What You Can Expect:

As a Senior Consultant, you will be a mentor, trainer, and coach to Interns and Consultants as you facilitate the successful completion of project work plans. You’ll identify areas of risk and opportunities to increase efficiency. You’ll strengthen relationships and deepen your abilities to communicate, gain trust, and network with client personnel and professional associates. At the direction of Managers, you may accept responsibility for decision-making in areas including establishing project scope and work plans, project staffing, preparation of deliverables, and application of methodologies.

At Protiviti, Technology Audit & Advisory focuses on:

  • Helping clients better manage risks associated with their use of technology, protecting and enhancing enterprise value.

  • Innovation: identifying solutions to client problems related to technology, helping them to rethink how technology processes are managed by incorporating AI and automation.

  • Technology enablement: Incorporating analytics, AI, automation and other new tools and methods in the execution of audit work for our clients, enabling a deeper, broader, more efficient, and more insightful analysis of our clients’ technology risks.

  • Staying current: We support a broad set of potential certifications and related trainings for our team, equipping our technology audit organization to stay at the forefront of emerging risks and trends.


Consultants in Technology Audit & Advisory work with clients to assess, identify risk, advise, and consult on different technology-related topics, including:

  • Cybersecurity

  • Cloud Assurance

  • Project Risk Advisory

  • Technology Risk Management and Assessment

  • IT General Controls (ITGC)

  • AI and Data Governance

  • Data Privacy

  • Technology Regulations

  • Enterprise Applications

  • Technology Resilience

  • IT Sarbanes-Oxley Compliance

  • Emerging Technologies

  • 2nd Line Controls Governance

  • Technology Enablement

What Will Help You Be Successful:

  • You enjoy identifying areas of business and technology risk, and opportunities to improve efficiency, increase performance, and help clients better utilize all technologies.

  • You are motivated to learn and interested in all things related to data and technology, including the latest trends and developments.

  • You are passionate about building relationships with clients and providing clients with exceptional experiences.

  • You have an inherent interest in project management and team leadership.

  • You contribute to a positive team culture that fosters open communication among all engagement team members.

  • You create development opportunities for others and ways for your team to improve our clients and communities.

  • You have interest in working with a diverse portfolio of clients across multiple industries.

  • You are versed in leveraging AI to enhance personal productivity as well as internal audit and SOX activities, including planning, fieldwork and reporting.

Do Your Talents Include the Following?

Experience with or understanding of:

  • IT audit methodologies and developing necessary audit deliverables, including process flows, work programs, audit reports, and control summaries.

  • Commonly used internal control frameworks, including COBIT, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS, ITIL, etc.

  • Sarbanes-Oxley Act provisions and methodologies for achieving compliance, in particular the technology implications and requirements.

Exposure to and/or interest in:

  • The latest trends and developments in data and technology, including high-growth topics of cybersecurity, cloud, data governance, privacy, analytics, enterprise applications (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Workday, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics etc.), disaster recovery, systems development methodologies etc.

  • Analytics and technology enablement (automation, AI/ML etc.).

  • Evaluating, summarizing, organizing, and interpreting data.

  • Establishing and cultivating business relationships and a professional network.

  • Ability to translate and communicate technology topics and audit issues to client personnel, including executives.

  • Supervisory experience of teams including mentoring, oversight and review of work, coordination across teams, and understanding how to motivate.

  • Experience performing documentation of findings and summarizing recommendations.

Your Educational and Professional Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., Accounting, Finance, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or business-related field).

  • 2+ years working in internal audit, consulting, assurance services, risk and control programs, or related field, either in professional services or industry.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite applications with specific emphasis on Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Secondary emphasis on Visio and Access.

  • Proficiency in PowerBI, Tableau, Alteryx, SQL, Python, and/or RPA Solutions a plus.

  • Professional certification such as CIA, CRMA, CISA, CISM, CISSP, or similar preferred.

Our Hybrid Workplace

Protiviti practices a hybrid model, which is a combination of working in person with a purpose and working remotely. This model creates meaningful experiences for our people and our clients while offering a flexible environment. The ratio of remote to in-person requirements varies by client, project, team, and other business factors. Our people work both in-person in local Protiviti offices and on client sites, which can include local or out-of-state travel based on our projects and client requests and commitments.

Starting salary is based on a full-time equivalent schedule. Placement in the range is dependent upon experience, skills and geographic work location. Below is the salary range for this job.

$90,000.00 - $134,000.00

Our annual bonus plan provides eligible employees additional cash and/or discretionary stock compensation opportunities. Below is the bonus target opportunity for this job.

10%

The total cash range is estimated from the sum of the base salary range plus the bonus target opportunity. Below is the estimated total cash range for this job.

$99,000.00 - $147,400.00

Employees are eligible for medical, dental, and vision coverages, FSA and HSA healthcare accounts, life and accident insurance, adoption and fertility assistance, paid parental leave up to 10 weeks, and short/long term disability. We offer eligible employees a company 401(k) savings and investment plan with an employer match of 50% on the first 6% of your contributions. We provide Choice Time Off (CTO) for vacation, personal needs, and sick time. The amount of (CTO) varies based on years of service. New hires receive up to 20 days of CTO per calendar year. Protiviti also recognizes up to 11 paid holidays each calendar year.

Learn more about the variety of rewards we offer at Protiviti at .

Any benefits outlined are part of our reward offerings for full-time employees in the U.S. Your Open Enrollment materials, insurance contracts, plan documents and Summary Plan Descriptions together comprise the official plan document which legally governs the administration of your benefit plans. Protiviti reserves the right to terminate or amend your benefit plans in any way and at any time.

Protiviti is an Equal Opportunity Employer. M/F/Disability/Veteran

As part of Protiviti’s employment process, any offer of employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check.

Protiviti is committed to being an equal employment employer offering opportunities to all job seekers, including individuals with disabilities. If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to apply for a position, please contact us by sending an email to HRSolutions@roberthalf.com or call 1.855.744.6947 for assistance.

In your email please include the following:

  • The specific accommodation requested to complete the employment application.

For positions located in San Francisco, CA: Protiviti will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

For positions located in Los Angeles County, CA: Protiviti will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

title: Underground Technologies Sr. Project Lead
description:
Career Area:

Engineering

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

About Caterpillar & MineStar

Caterpillar is a global leader in mining technology, delivering integrated solutions that improve safety, productivity, and operational performance.

Cat® MineStar™ Solutions is our flagship digital platform, connecting equipment, people, and data across mining operations. Through advanced automation, tracking, safety, and productivity technologies, MineStar enables customers to operate more efficiently while supporting safer and more autonomous mining environments.

The Underground Technologies team develops and supports a broad portfolio of solutions including automation and tele-remote machine operation, positioning and production recording, people and vehicle tracking, and proximity awareness and collision avoidance systems. These solutions are deployed globally and help customers safely and efficiently manage their underground mining operations.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Sr. Project Lead - Underground Technologies to lead investigation and resolution activities for customer-reported issues across Caterpillar’s underground technology portfolio.

This role sits at the intersection of customer support, engineering, product development, and validation. You will work closely with product support teams, deployment specialists, systems engineers, software developers, architects, and validation teams to understand complex customer challenges, perform deep technical analysis, and drive engineering improvements that enhance product quality and customer outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Lead Customer Issue Resolution

  • Lead a small technical team responsible for daily customer issue triage across the Underground Technologies product portfolio.

  • Work closely with Product Support, Deployment, and Application Specialists to understand customer-reported issues and prioritise investigation activities.

  • Facilitate technical discussions across multiple teams and stakeholders.

  • Track issue progress from initial report through analysis, root cause identification, and resolution.

Drive Technical Analysis

  • Perform detailed analysis of customer and engineering data to understand system behaviour and identify root causes.

  • Develop advanced data collection and experimentation plans to support complex investigations.

  • Apply modern data analysis techniques and AI-assisted tools to accelerate problem solving and engineering decisions.

  • Identify product improvement opportunities through analysis of customer issues and operational trends.

Partner with Engineering Teams

  • Work with architects and software engineering teams to determine corrective actions and long-term product improvements.

  • Support implementation and validation of engineering solutions.

  • Provide technical leadership for cross-functional investigations involving hardware, software, communications, and operational systems.

Improve Product Quality

  • Partner with Systems Integration and Validation teams to improve engineering test coverage, data collection methods, and troubleshooting processes.

  • Develop better validation approaches for identifying issues before deployment.

  • Drive continuous improvement in root cause analysis and product quality processes.

Support Underground Technology Solutions

  • Automation and Tele-remote capabilities for LHDs

  • Positioning and Production Recording systems

  • People and Vehicle Tracking solutions

  • Proximity Awareness and Collision Avoidance technologies

Stakeholder Leadership

Partner with:

  • Product Support and Deployment teams to understand customer challenges

  • Software, Systems, and Architecture teams to develop effective solutions

  • Integration and Validation teams to improve product robustness

  • Global customers and mining operations to support data-driven investigations

Act as a technical leader who can align teams, communicate complex findings, and drive resolution of highly complex system-level issues.

What You Bring

Experience

  • Previous experience in underground mining and mining technologies.

  • Technical leadership experience leading teams or complex engineering initiatives.

  • Experience troubleshooting and resolving complex systems issues in operational environments.

  • Experience working across multiple engineering disciplines including software, systems, integration, and validation.

Capabilities

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to lead investigations involving multiple stakeholders and technical disciplines.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

  • Ability to influence technical direction and drive alignment across organisations.

  • Experience working in global cross-functional teams.

Technical & Domain Knowledge

Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:

  • Underground mining technologies

  • Data analytics and data science

  • AI-based tools for data analysis

  • Mining automation and tele-remote systems

  • Positioning and production management systems

  • People and vehicle tracking technologies

  • Proximity awareness and collision avoidance systems

  • Systems integration and validation

What Success Looks Like

  • Faster identification and resolution of customer-reported issues.

  • Improved product quality, reliability, and customer satisfaction.

  • Strong collaboration between support, engineering, and validation teams.

  • Better engineering data collection and root cause analysis capabilities.

  • Measurable improvements delivered across Caterpillar’s Underground Technology products.

Why Join Us

  • Work on some of the most advanced underground mining technologies in the world.

  • Help shape the future of underground automation and autonomy.

  • Solve challenging real-world engineering problems impacting mining operations globally.

  • Influence product quality and technology strategy across a growing portfolio.

  • Be part of a highly collaborative global team focused on innovation, safety, and customer success.

Additional Information

Location: This position can be based in either Perth (Bibra Lake) or Brisbane

This position requires working onsite five days a week.

Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

Posting Dates:

August 12, 2026 - August 27, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

title: Head of Growth
description:
Bailey Nelson is one of Australia's high-growth success stories, growing at double-digit comps and opening around 20 new stores per year across our three markets of Australia, New Zealand and Canada. We are fast becoming the smarter choice in eyewear for our customers - and we have ambitious growth plans ahead of us.


We are a tight-knit bunch of down-to-earth individuals who constantly look for ways to improve on everything we do, every day. We believe our team is the secret to our success - the interactions we have with one another and with our customers define the essence of who we are.



About This Role

We're looking for a Head of Growth to join us at a pivotal moment in our expansion. It's a genuine opportunity to build the growth engine that will take Bailey Nelson into its next chapter, backed by a leadership team that values what great marketing can deliver. At its core, this role is about getting more customers through our doors. That means filling new stores from the day they open, and bringing existing customers back more often. It also means unlocking online, an exciting and currently underdeveloped channel for us. You'll own the growth strategy and marketing budget, lead a team of marketers, and build the measurement foundations that let us invest with confidence. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer and working closely with our founders, this is a role for a strategically minded, commercially sharp leader. You'll be equally at home setting direction, developing your team, and getting into the detail of what's driving performance. If this sounds like the kind of challenge you've been looking for, we'd love to hear from you.
What success looks like
You'll be measured on four objectives:

  • Build brand recognition: Grow awareness and consideration of Bailey Nelson across our markets.
  • Launch new stores: Fill new stores from day one with local marketing that builds awareness and drives footfall.
  • Grow customer lifetime value: Bring customers back into store more often, and keep them with us for longer.
  • Unlock online: Double our online sales and turn the channel into a meaningful contributor to revenue.


Responsibilities include

  • Growth Strategy & Budget Ownership: Own the marketing growth strategy and budget end to end across markets. That means allocating spend across channels, setting targets for each, and building the foundations to evaluate marketing as a commercial investment with a return, not a cost item.
  • New Store Openings: Develop and execute pre-opening marketing that builds local awareness and drives footfall from launch, working with store and brand teams to make every opening a strong start.
  • Customer Lifetime Value & CRM: Grow frequency and retention across new, existing and lapsed customers by owning the recall and CRM programs that bring customers back in store.
  • Online Sales & Website: Grow online, today underdeveloped relative to peers, into a more meaningful channel. Treat the website as both a growth opportunity and a key brand asset, working with product and tech on traffic, conversion and revenue.
  • Channel Mix Development & Optimisation: Develop and continuously improve our channel mix across paid digital, offline, CRM, referral and new channels, building the measurement capability to understand what's working and why.
  • Growth Leadership: Lead, coach and develop a team of growth marketers, setting clear priorities, building capability, and ensuring initiatives are delivered to a high standard. Represent growth at leadership-team level.
  • Testing & Experimentation: Build a test-and-learn culture. Generate ideas across channels and creative, define how each test will be measured, prioritise by likely commercial impact, and communicate results clearly.
  • Insight & Reporting: Report on the metrics that matter, diagnose gaps, and translate data into clear actions for the growth team and leadership.


What we're looking for

We care as much about raw capability as your CV. We're after an exceptional problem-solver with a track record of fast career progression, and some experience in growth, retention and/or marketing.

  • Outstanding problem-solving and structured thinking, likely built through a few years in top-tier consulting, strategy or a similarly analytical environment (around 4 to 6 years' experience overall)
  • Hands-on marketing, retail, growth or CRM experience. Ecommerce a plus.
  • Strong commercial judgement, treating marketing as an investment with a return and prioritising by business impact
  • Analytical and comfortable with data and financial modelling
  • Experience leading teams and working across functions
  • Highly organised, with strong execution skills and close attention to detail
  • Able to lead projects end to end, from strategy through to delivery
  • Based in our Woolloomooloo, Sydney office a minimum of 4 days per week

What are you waiting for? Frame your future and apply now!

title: Software Development Engineer II, Fintelligence Workplace
description:

3. Take a lead role in guiding and supporting junior engineers, promoting best practices in design, coding, testability, and security.

4. Encourage the adoption of new technologies and devise efficient algorithms tailored to our extensive customer base.

Fintelligence is FGBS's strategic innovation team solving complex, cross-domain finance challenges through AI/ML. Our mission is to amplify human productivity by building reusable, intelligent automation and decision-support solutions that accelerate value creation across Amazon's finance organization and beyond. We combine deep product knowledge, scientific expertise, agile engineering practices, and scalable AI frameworks to streamline financial processes, reduce operational costs, and unleash innovation at scale.

title: Kotisiivooja, Joensuu, ANNU sosiaalipalvelut
description:
ANNU sosiaalipalvelut hakee nyt joukkoonsa työntekijää sosiaalihuollon tukipalveluihin. Työ sisältää pääsääntöisesti kotisiivouksia, mutta sinun on mahdollista auttaa asiakkaita myös asioinneissa ja vapaa-ajan tekemisissä. Meillä työssä menestyy ihminen, joka kykenee työskentelemään asiakastyössä omatoimisesti ja ammattitaitoisesti.

Työ ANNU sosiaalipalveluilla on monipuolista ja palkitsevaa. Työajat vaihtelevat asiakkaiden toiveiden ja Sinun työskentelymahdollisuuksiesi mukaisesti arkisin klo 8-18 välillä. Työpäiväsi sisältää pääasiallisesti kotisiivoustehtäviä, joten alalle soveltuva koulutus ja/tai kokemus vastaavista tehtävistä on toivottavaa. Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus on edellytys asiakaskohteisiin pääsemiseksi ja siivousvälineiden kuljettamiseksi. Edellytämme työntekijöitä erinomaista suomen kielen osaamista.

Tarjoamme joustavan, merkityksellisen palkkatyön:

- Vaikutat itse työtunteihisi. Työtä on tarjolla arkisin klo 8-18 välillä.

- Työ sopii hyvin myös opiskeluiden tai toisen työn ohessa tehtäväksi.

- ANNU sosiaalipalveluilla sinulla on työntekoasi tukeva esihenkilö.

- Tarjoamme kattavan perehdytyksen ennen työtehtävien alkamista, perehdytys on palkallinen ja se maksetaan ensimmäisen palkanmaksun yhteydessä.

- Noudatamme yksityisen sosiaalialan työehtosopimusta ja maksamme työstä työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan (G17B)

Työ alkaa mahdollisimman pian. Täytämme paikan heti sopivan tekijän löytyessä, joten jätäthän hakemuksesi pian!

ANNU sosiaalipalvelut on ystävänpäivänä 2023 perustettu, sote-alan ammattilaisten luotsaama yritys. Tervetuloa mukaamme luomaan Suomen parasta sosiaalialan työpaikkaa!

title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
Cloud Operation Engineer

Location: London, UK

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

About Centric Software:

Centric Software® is a global leader, providing an innovative and AI-enabled product-concept-to-commercialization platform for retailers, brands and manufacturers of all sizes. We equip retail, fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home and consumer goods brands with pioneering best-of-breed solutions to plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, sell and replenish products. Our technology powers brands to streamline processes, drive efficiency and operate with confidence in an ever-changing market.

Our story is one of rapid growth, bold ideas and extraordinary opportunities. We’re here to challenge the status quo—and we’re looking for brilliant people who want to do the same. No matter where you are in the world, this is your chance to be part of something exceptional.

Job Summary:

This role will be responsible for utilizing a diverse set of cloud technologies to support Centric Cloud Customers, and to help build and maintain a scalable, robust, highly available platform for Centric’s C8 cloud application.

This position will report to the Senior Director, Cloud Operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Respond to and resolve time-critical customer issues in the public cloud
  • Perform customer deployments, migrations and upgrades in the cloud environment
  • Support automation projects including writing coding
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, maintain, and manage servers in multiple cloud environments
  • Create, manage, and maintain Cloud networking components
  • Perform backups and restores of database and servers
  • Assist in ensuring security processes are followed and customer data is secured
  • Perform other administrative tasks in cloud environments as directed.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, DevOps, and Support teams to resolve issues
  • Build effective working relationships with cross-functional team member

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree Computer Science, MIS, or related technology field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years working with Public Cloud infrastructure AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
  • Advanced Linux or Open Source knowledge
  • Expert in Containerization ie Kubernetes
  • Solid understanding of cloud networking and security
  • Infrastructure and Configuration as Code methodologies
  • Detailed knowledge Microservices and DevOps
  • 3+ years in incident response and major incident management
  • Experience with the following technologies: Docker, Rancher, Virtualization, VPN, Kafka, RDP
  • Advanced Linux and Windows experience
  • Experience with the following is highly desirable: Confluence/Jira, Nagios, SSO, and SQL.

What we offer:

· Competitive salary and benefits

  • A multifaceted job with a high degree of responsibility and a broad spectrum of opportunities
  • Opportunity to work remotely with a dedicated and motivated team
  • A remote work environment built on collaboration, flexibility, and respect
  • Varied and challenging work to help you grow your technical skillset.

Centric Software provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status or genetic information.

title: ESS Project Manager Officer - Spain
description:
¡Hola y bienvenido/a a Sungrow! We are excited to welcome an ESS Project Manager to our Energy Storage Business Sector in Spain. In this role, you will help deliver high-impact battery storage projects across Southern Europe and contribute directly to a more sustainable energy future.

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of ESS projects, from purchase order through commissioning and final handover.
  • Build and manage project plans, schedules, budgets, resources, risks, and mitigation actions.
  • Act as the main contact for customers, EPC partners, suppliers, and internal teams throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Coordinate cross-functional colleagues in sales, engineering, logistics, service, finance, and quality to keep delivery on track.
  • Manage contract obligations, payment milestones, technical documentation, and project reporting.
  • Ensure projects meet agreed quality, safety, timeline, and customer-satisfaction standards.

Sounds like your kind of challenge? To thrive in this role, you bring a structured, collaborative approach and enjoy turning complex renewable-energy projects into successful customer outcomes.

  • You hold a degree in Electrical Engineering, Renewable Energy, Industrial Engineering, Project Management, or a comparable field.

You will have space to grow your project expertise while helping shape the next generation of clean-energy infrastructure.

Rådgive og vejlede om stel, solbriller og kontaktlinser



Booke synsprøver, foretage elektroniske synstest samt udføre lettere reparationer



Hjælpe kunder, der er inde for at afhente deres færdige briller, og hjælpe kunder telefonisk



Oprette journaler i IT-systemet og styre en aftalekalender



Trimme butikken og få den til altid at se knivskarp og salgsklar ud



Håndtere kassen, deltage i status samt bestille og modtage varer

Dine udviklingsmuligheder
I Synoptik er udviklingsmulighederne mange og vores brede E-learningsplatform summer konstant af nye kurser, webinars og podcasts. Dertil kommer fysiske kompetencedage, salgskurser og muligheden for at blive en del af vores interne talentprogram. Vi elsker nemlig at udvikle os - og vi elsker at give dig mulighed for at blive dygtigere til det, du brænder for.
Vores forventninger til dig
En personlig og tillidsfuld kommunikation med vores kunder er afgørende for, at du kan rådgive og vejlede kunderne bedst muligt i deres valg af stel, solbriller og forskellige typer af glas og kontaktlinser. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du både taler, skriver og forstår dansk. Du nyder den direkte kundekontakt, og du har overskud og lyst til at lære kundernes hverdag og fritidsliv at kende. Du er god til at formidle din produktviden, forklare fordele og give kunderne sikkerhed om, at de får værdi for pengene, når de handler hos os.
Din profil:
Vi søger engagerede kandidater, der:


er ivrige efter at lære og konstant udvide deres viden og færdigheder



udviser nysgerrighed omkring de nyeste produkter og markedstendenser



værdsætter mangfoldighed og kan samarbejde med mennesker fra forskellige baggrunde



er team-orienterede og bidrager aktivt til at forbedre teamets præstation



er reflekterende og innovative i deres tilgang til at optimere processer



er fleksible og positive over for forandringer



kommunikerer klart og effektivt, både mundtligt og skriftligt på dansk

Bliv en del af vores team
Hos Synoptik er vi drevet af engagement, ekspertise og nysgerrighed. Vi inviterer dig til at blive en del af vores team og gøre en reel forskel i menneskers liv. Sammen kan vi forbedre synet og livskvaliteten for vores kunder, én kunde ad gangen. Er du klar til at tage det næste skridt i din karriere og blive en del af Synoptik-familien?
Rekrutteringsprocessen
Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og besætter stillingen, når den rette kandidat melder sig, så skynd dig at sende dit CV samt en kort motivation for stillingen afsted. Vi modtager ikke ansøgninger via mail.

I forbindelse med en samtale vil vi bede om en reference fra en nuværende - eller tidligere chef, så find allerede kontaktinformationen frem og indskriv i forbindelse med din ansøgning.

Hvis du er interesseret i mere end én stilling, så kan du blot angive, hvilke andre butikker du også ønsker at komme i betragtning til. Vores HR-afdeling læser alle tilsendte ansøgninger og fordeler efterfølgende kandidater til de enkelte butikker.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!
Ansættelsesforhold
Stillingen er en fastansættelse på gennemsnitligt 37 timer pr. uge. Vi følger Butiksoverenskomsten for Butikker mellem Dansk Erhverv Arbejdsgiver og HK Handel.

title: Land Surveyor
description:
We're looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Land Surveyor to join our dynamic team in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. In this role, you will be responsible for performing precise surveying and setting-out activities for infrastructure and construction projects. You will ensure that all construction alignments, levels, and coordinates are established accurately and in accordance with approved drawings, project specifications, and local standards. This position offers an excellent opportunity to contribute to significant infrastructure development while working collaboratively with experienced professionals in a goal-oriented environment.

  • Perform topographic, control, and setting-out surveys for infrastructure projects, including pipelines, shafts, chambers, and associated civil structures
  • Establish, verify, and maintain survey control points, benchmarks, and reference grids in coordination with project teams, applying approved drawings and coordinate systems in compliance with local requirements
  • Check and verify horizontal and vertical alignments, pipe inverts, and structure locations, ensuring compliance with allowable tolerances prior to and during construction
  • Conduct as-built surveys and verify the accuracy of contractors' as-built drawings and survey results prior to submission and certification
  • Maintain comprehensive and up-to-date survey records, field books, and digital data files, ensuring full traceability of all survey operations
  • Coordinate with contractors and supervision teams to resolve survey discrepancies or deviations on-site, and participate in pre-construction and progress meetings to provide input on survey status
  • Ensure full compliance with health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards during all field operations, particularly in challenging work environments
  • Provide technical support during testing, commissioning, and handover stages by verifying final levels and coordinates
  • Analyze survey data and prepare detailed reports with clear documentation and recommendations
  • Collaborate with engineering and project management teams to ensure survey activities align with project objectives and timelines

**Education & Certifications:**

  • Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Surveying, Civil Engineering, or related discipline
  • Professional certification in surveying instruments and data management (preferred)
  • Current knowledge of local standards and regulations (RTA, DM, DEWA standards)

**Required Skills & Technical Proficiency:**

  • Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and surveying software
  • Hands-on experience with GPS, Total Station, and other modern surveying instruments
  • Strong mathematical and computational skills with exceptional attention to precision and accuracy
  • Proficient in data management and digital survey file organization
  • Excellent report writing and technical documentation skills

**Experience:**

  • Proven experience performing topographic, control, and setting-out surveys
  • Demonstrated experience with as-built survey verification and accuracy validation
  • Field work experience in infrastructure or construction projects
  • Experience coordinating with multiple stakeholders and resolving technical discrepancies
  • Knowledge of HSE compliance procedures in field operations

**Core Competencies:**

  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Strong organizational skills with meticulous attention to detail
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective collaboration
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in dynamic environments
  • Physical capability to perform fieldwork and operate surveying equipment
  • Resilience and adaptability in managing project challenges
  • Commitment to transparency and maintaining accurate records

title: Software Engineer
description:
• Permanent role based in Melbourne
  • Build applied AI capabilities that help keep REA’s marketplace safe and trusted, with a direct impact across REA’s products.

We're REA
With bold and ambitious goals, REA Group is changing the way the world experiences property. No matter where you're at on your property journey, we're here to help with every step - whether that's finding or financing your next home.

Our people are the key to our success. At the heart of everything we do, is a thriving culture centred around high performance and care. We are purpose driven and collaborative, which drives innovation and our ability to make a real impact. As such, we’re proud to have been named in Australia’s “Top 5” Best Workplaces two years in a row, as well as being recognised as a Best Workplace for Women.

Where the team fits in

The Content Moderation Platform squad is building the tools and services that help REA identify, review and act on harmful or non-compliant content more quickly and consistently. Our mission is to build the tools, services and standards that keep the REA community safe and trusted.

The squad sits within the Customer Enablement portfolio in Experiences & Platforms (XP) and is focused on developing AI-powered capabilities that can proactively detect fraud and content breaches across REA’s marketplace.

What the role is all about

As a Software Engineer in the Content Moderation Platform squad, you will work across the full moderation lifecycle. This includes automated detection pipelines, LLM-based evaluation services, APIs and data workflows, as well as the tools that help human reviewers understand outcomes and take action with confidence.

You will be part of a cross-functional squad and will contribute through hands-on delivery, technical design, production support and continuous improvement. You will also help shape how we build this platform over time, particularly as we explore practical and responsible ways to use AI and LLMs to detect harmful content at scale.

This is a good opportunity for someone who enjoys solving real problems, wants to work with applied AI, and is interested in building a platform that has a direct impact on trust and safety across REA’s products. Day to day you’ll be doing:

  • Design, build, test and document high-quality software in line with REA engineering practices.
  • Build and improve AI-powered detection services, APIs, data pipelines and supporting tools used for content moderation.
  • Maintain and improve existing systems through feature development, bug fixes and operational improvements.
  • Support production systems, including troubleshooting incidents and taking part in support or on-call rotations where required.
  • Work closely with engineers, product, design and other stakeholders to shape technical direction and deliver reliable and explainable moderation outcomes.
  • Contribute to delivery planning and technical design by considering trade-offs, effort, quality and long-term maintainability.
  • Look for ways to improve our products, technology, team processes and ways of working.
  • Keep up with changes in AI and LLM technology and help the team understand where new capabilities could be useful.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully to improve productivity and software quality.
  • Support other engineers through code reviews, pairing and day-to-day knowledge sharing.

Who we’re looking for

  • Strong experience with modern software engineering practices, including automated testing, continuous delivery and collaborative development.
  • Experience building production software with TypeScript.
  • Experience building software that is maintainable, observable, reliable and able to scale.
  • A solid understanding of software design patterns, web or application architecture and cloud-based systems.
  • Experience working with APIs, data pipelines or distributed systems.
  • Some experience with LLMs or AI APIs, or a genuine interest in learning how they can be used responsibly in production systems.
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools to support software delivery, productivity or problem-solving.
  • A practical, solutions-focused mindset and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical people.
  • A strong sense of ownership, curiosity and a willingness to keep learning and improving.

The REA experience

The physical, mental, emotional and financial health of our people is something we’ll never stop caring about. This is a place to learn and grow.

Some of our Perks & Benefits include:

  • A hybrid and flexible approach to working
  • Flexible leave options including, birthday leave and purchase additional leave
  • Flexible parental leave offering for primary and secondary carers
  • Our Because We Care program offers employees volunteering leave, community grants, matched payroll giving and our Community Café donates 100% of revenue to charity
  • Hackdays so you can bring your big ideas to life

Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We are committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity, equity and inclusion. We believe teams with diverse ideas and experiences are more creative, more eﬀective and fuel disruptive thinking. If you've got the skills, dedication and enthusiasm to learn but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

Join our Talent Neighbourhood

Keen to be part of REA but didn't find a perfect match with this opportunity? Perhaps the timing isn't right? You should join our Talent Neighbourhood!
