title: Construction Metro Site Director
description:
Overview

Microsoft Cloud Operations + Innovation (CO+I) is the team behind the cloud. CO+I is responsible for delivering over 200 Microsoft web portals, Live and Online Services around the world including infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide. We are looking for a passionate individual to help build the network that powers the world’s largest online services.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.



Responsibilities

Oversees the team's deployment of large-scale, campus, and/or regionally-based delivery solutions while also socializing with regional and global leaders. Analyzes and recommends innovative delivery options utilizing best practices and trends, supports the development and implementation of all organizational procedures and standards, and ensures they are followed by all team members and vendors. Influences and provides direction and coaching to internal and external partners to facilitate and accomplish complex, critical issues that may significantly impact global construction projects. Reviews and provides feedback to the team regarding resource procurement, allocation, and inventory. Leads the team's accountability for on-schedule delivery of multiple projects by ensuring project progress reports including scope, schedule, and budget are provided. Leads and drives coordination for meetings and activities with vendors, cost managers, and/or owner/architect/contractors. Engages, advises, and collaborates with other internal teams. Manages and advocates for safe worksites by adhering to organizational and industry procedures. Establishes, reviews, approves, and communicates risk mitigation goals and develops metrics, dashboards and/or scorecards to drive progress. Directs and oversees the management of vendors, ensuring compliance with contracts and prior audit results. In addition, this role has people management responsibilities including driving employee growth and development, executing projects, and managing performance.


Budget and Controls

Develops, manages, and reports on the scope, schedule, and budget of the project. Oversees and implements project controls in work activities (e.g., project expenditure requests (PERs), Professional Service Requests (PSRs), change orders, and pay applications).

Change Management

Influences the development and implementation of organizational policies and processes with Cloud Operations + Innovation (CO+I) partners resulting in cost savings, enhanced customer service, or improved asset management.

Coordination

Leads and drives coordination for meetings and activities with vendors, cost managers, and/or owner/architect/contractors. Initializes and identifies opportunities to discuss and integrate lessons learned, advocating for safe and secure security-first mindset during project planning.

Drives Results

Influences and provides direction and coaching to internal and external partners to facilitate and accomplish complex, critical issues that may significantly impact global construction projects (e.g., establishing and executing upon team goals, following business processes, engaging vendor relationships, and fostering cross-group collaboration efforts with the agreed-upon project strategy, milestone delivery, and core values and priorities (Safety, Security, Quality, Schedule, Cost)).

Financial Acumen

Oversees the creation and application of best practices for identifying and driving cost-effective solutions for the strategic and tactical delivery of a construction project.

Goal Alignment

Engages, advises, and collaborates with other internal teams (e.g., Security (OSSC), Information Technology (MSIT), Legal, Project Engineering, Business Risk Management, etc.) to maintain the corporate vision and create goals for the projects.

Managing Resources

Reviews and provides feedback to the team regarding resource procurement, allocation, and inventory. Ensures storage space is provided for equipment/materials.

People Management

Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring. Model: Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles. Coach: Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn. Care: Attract and retain great people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.

Project Management

Oversees the team's deployment of large-scale, campus, and/or regionally-based delivery solutions (e.g., new and/or retrofit data center solutions) while also socializing with regional and global leaders. Sets goals for internal and external project teams under their purview of responsibility, delegates responsibilities measures performance against contracted Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and seeks and delivers feedback to achieve timely results that prioritize security in documentation, design, and/or execution.

Project Tracking

Leads the team's accountability for on-schedule delivery of multiple projects by ensuring project progress reports including scope, schedule, and budget are provided.

Risk Mitigation

Establishes, reviews, approves, and communicates risk mitigation goals and develops metrics, dashboards and/or scorecards to drive progress. Analyzes safety and security metrics and communicates and applies results to drive project action and individual development to lower-level staff and vendors.

Safety and Regulation

Manages and advocates for safe worksites by adhering to organizational and industry procedures. Reviews prior audit results and relevant legislation in order to recommend and manage safety and security compliance. Shares lessons learned with relevant stakeholders.

Technical Acumen

Analyzes and recommends innovative delivery options utilizing best practices and trends, supports the development and implementation of all organizational procedures and standards, and ensures they are followed by all team members and vendors with adherence to security core priorities and guidelines.

Vendor Management

Directs and oversees the management of vendors, ensuring compliance with security policies, non-disclosure agreements, contracts, and prior audit results. Controls vendor performance relative to cash flow and budget summaries (with cost management support). Provides direction and correction to vendors and internal support teams as needed.

Vendor Selection

Manages the preparation of Request for Proposals (RFPs), Project Expenditure Requests (PERs), and other project approval tools and templates. Identifies and directs vendor scope of work, design review of site and building plans, change orders, and invoices.



Qualifications

Required/minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Construction Project Management, Architecture, Engineering, or related field AND 12+ years related experience OR equivalent experience.

Additional or preferred qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree in Construction Project Management, Architecture, Engineering, or related field AND 15+ years related experience OR equivalent experience.

  • 15+ years experience working on data center projects.
  • 10+ years project management experience.
  • 10+ years people management experience.

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Paikkaa pääset hakemaan jättämällä hakemuksen / yhteystietosi hakulinkin kautta.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa arkisin klo 9-15: Wilma Niskanen / wilma.niskanen@visiohr.fi.

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut on vuonna 2020 perustettu kotimainen henkilöstöpalvelualan yritys, joka pelaa reilua peliä. Tarjoamme töitä niin raudanlujille ammattilaisille, kuin sellaiseksi kehittyville. Työntekijöitä autamme löytämään oman visionsa mukaisen työpaikan. Työnantajia taas palvelemme etsimällä oikeat ihmiset avoimiin tehtäviin.

Yhteistyö perustuu jokaisen kolmen tahon kesken vallitsevaan luottamukseen. Mikäli haluat työnantajan, jolle jokainen työntekijä on merkityksellinen ja arvokas, niin se on Visio!

title: Field Service Project Management Specialist
description:
Specialist Field Service Project Management

Location: Taylor, MI, USA

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

POSITION SUMMARY: The primary purpose of the Field Service Project Management Specialist is to understand the customer’s remediation and service needs as they relate to materials, personnel, equipment & documentation for remediation projects. The Field Service Project Management Specialist is in constant contact with the customers to advise them of scheduling and progress made on a project. In-house; the Field Service Project Management Specialist, arranges for the delivery of equipment, rentals, and all corresponding purchase orders to track job costs. The Field Services Project Management Specialist submits proposals, establishes credit, overlooks the project, and finalizes the billing.

PRINCIPLE RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Directs and coordinates activities of project personnel to ensure project progresses on schedule and within prescribed budget.

  • Prepares project reports for management, clients, or others and is responsible for timely, accurate submission of all project activity, incident, logbooks, and other project-related data from the field.

  • Prepares “field” invoices for submission to the accounting department for billing which must include all documents required to support and substantiate timely and accurate invoicing to clients.

  • Attends site walks to prepare reports for bidding opportunities.

  • Plans, coordinates, and manages hazardous waste site remediation projects.

  • Oversees teams that perform lab pack services, segregating and classifying hazardous and non-hazardous materials per Federal DEP & EPA guidelines and State requirements.

  • Completes waste profiles and regulatory documentation including manifests, Land Disposal Restrictions (LDR’s) and container labels.

  • Performs emergency response site evaluation activities including, but not limited to chemical and water spills, biological contamination, tank cleaning, equipment decontamination, etc.

  • Performs projects pertaining to hazardous waste operations; including but not limited to evacuation, drum management and disposal.

  • Oversees an emergency response team and has knowledge of all levels of Personal Protection Equipment.

  • Ensures Health and Safety policies are strictly followed.

  • May be on call due to the emergency response nature of this business.

  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned or apparent.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • At least 10 years of environmental experience.

  • Background in hazardous waste designation.

  • Knowledge of Field Sampling and Hazardous Waste Disposal.

  • Knowledge of facility decontamination.

  • Knowledge of manifests and chemical profiles.

  • Knowledge of Tank System Management and removal.

  • Certification including , Transportation Worker (TWIC) clearance, as may be required by regulations.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Valid Driver’s License

  • High School Diploma or GED

Rewarding Compensation and Benefits

Eligible employees can elect to participate in:
• Comprehensive medical benefits coverage, dental plans and vision coverage.
• Health care and dependent care spending accounts.
• Short- and long-term disability.
• Life insurance and accidental death & dismemberment insurance.
• Employee and Family Assistance Program (EAP).
• Employee discount programs.
• Retirement plan with a generous company match.
• Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP).

• Paid Time Off (PTO)

• Benefits: https://jobs.republicservices.com/us/en/about-us/benefits

The statements used herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of the work being performed by an employee in this position, and are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required by an incumbent so classified. Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of the Company.

EEO STATEMENT:Republic Services is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, relationship or association with a protected veteran (spouses or other family members), genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.


Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).


RECENT RECOGNITION

  • Barron’s 100 Most Sustainable Companies
  • CDP Discloser
  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies
  • Great Place to Work
  • Sustainability Yearbook S&P Global

title: Automyyjä K-Auton vaihtoautomyyntiin Seinäjoelle
description:
K-Auto Seinäjoki etsii nyt tulevaisuuden huippumyyjää henkilöautojen voittavaan joukkueeseen!

Oletko sinä se tyyppi, joka nauttii asiakkaiden kohtaamisesta ja haluaa tehdä kauppaa, jossa jokainen asiakas lähtee tyytyväisenä? Meillä et pelkää tarttua puhelimeen, vastata viesteihin ja ratkoa asiakkaan haasteita – olipa kyseessä rahoitus, vaihtoauto tai toimituksen aikataulu. Osaat pitää monta palloa ilmassa ja tiedät, että hyvä kauppa syntyy rehellisyydellä, ripeällä toiminnalla ja asiakkaan tarpeiden ymmärtämisellä.

Odotamme sinulta, että työssäsi vastaat omista asiakassuhteistasi alusta loppuun:

- Rakennat luottamusta ja pidät yhteyttä asiakkaisiin koko ostoprosessin ajan
- Varmistat, että asiakas saa juuri sen auton ja palvelun, mitä on tullut hakemaan
- Hoidat kaupat, paperityöt ja auton toimituksen sujuvasti
- Hyödynnät digikanavia ja osaat käyttää myynnin järjestelmiä tehokkaasti
- Innostat myös tiimikavereita hyvillä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidoilla

Meillä menestyt, jos:

- Sinulla on kaupallinen koulutus ja kokemusta myyntityöstä
- Olet kaupallinen myyjä, joka haluaa tehdä tulosta ja nauttii asiakkaiden kanssa puhumisesta
- Osaat viestiä selkeästi ja vakuuttavasti myös digitaalisissa kanavissa
- Olet oma-aloitteinen, mutta tykkäät myös tiimityöstä
- Sinulla on ajokortti ja halu oppia uutta joka päivä
- Uskot yhdessä tekemisen voimaan ja haluat rakentaa menestystä tiimisi kanssa

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Ison konsernin tuen ja työsuhde-edut (mm. työsuhdeauto)
- Mahdollisuuden päästä avaamaan täysin uutta toimipistettä ja kehittää osaamistasi
- Ammattitaitoiset kollegat ja reilun työilmapiirin

K-ryhmässä asenne ratkaisee – jos haluat tehdä kauppaa, kasvaa ammattilaisena ja olla mukana rakentamassa tulevaisuuden asiakaskokemusta, hae meille! Meillä jokainen kauppa tehdään asiakasta kunnioittaen ja reilusti.

Tule vakituiseen työsuhteeseen osaksi tiimiä, joka tavoittelee markkinajohtajuutta vaihtoautokaupassa!

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa myyntipäällikkö Hermanni Kulmala, sähköpostitse hermanni.kulmala@k-auto.fi
tai puhelimitse 0503138127 ke 12.08. klo 10–14 tai 14.08 13-17.
Lähetä hakemuksesi viimeistään 24.08.2026 mennessä oheisen linkin kautta, mutta huomaa että käsittelemme hakemuksia hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja palkkaamme sopivan henkilön heti löydettyämme.

Hyödynnämme tässä rekrytoinnissa Minda-testausta, voidaksemme tehdä reilun arvion siitä, kenellä olisi parhaat menestymisen mahdollisuudet meillä vaihtoautomyyjän roolissa. Lähetämme lisätiedot ja kutsun testin suorittamiseen erikseen rekrytointiprosessin edetessä.

Tarkistamme tehtävään valitulta henkilöltä luottotiedot ennen työsuhteen solmimista ja suoritamme huumausainetestauksen viimeistään koeajan aikana.

Me K-ryhmässä arvostamme monimuotoisuutta ja uskomme, että erilaiset taustat ja näkökulmat ovat avain menestykseen. Pyrimme luomaan työympäristön, jossa jokaisella on mahdollisuus kehittyä. Yhdenvertaisuus, syrjimättömyys ja oikeudenmukaisuus ovat keskeisiä periaatteitamme rekrytoinnissa, palkitsemisessa ja urakehityksessä.

title: Teknisk Ingenjör till NG Nordic Sweden
description:
Vill du kombinera teknik, problemlösning och utveckling i en spännande industrimiljö?

Vi söker en Teknisk Ingenjör som vill vara med och utveckla vår verksamhet inom IBA & Ashes, Metal Refinery.

I den här rollen får du en bred och varierad vardag där du kombinerar automation, underhåll, industriell IT/OT, tekniska projekt, aktiviteter kopplat till produktionen och förbättringsarbete. Du blir en viktig teknisk resurs i verksamheten och får stora möjligheter att påverka hur vi utvecklar vår produktion framåt.

Om NG Nordic

NG Nordic är en ledande nordisk leverantör av cirkulära lösningar och miljötjänster. Genom att omvandla avfall till värdefulla resurser och ta bort farliga ämnen från kretsloppet undviker vi utsläpp, skyddar naturliga ekosystem och ökar tillgången till cirkulära material. NG Nordic är en viktig del av den nordiska industriella infrastrukturen och genererar 1,3 miljarder euro i intäkter med ett team på cirka 3 400 anställda och 90 anläggningar.

Om rollen

Som Teknisk Ingenjör arbetar du nära produktion, underhåll, engineering, IT/OT och externa samarbetspartners. Du blir en problemlösare och teknisk specialist som bidrar till att vår anläggning fungerar säkert, stabilt och effektivt.

Du kommer bland annat att:

  • Leda och delta i tekniska projekt och förbättringsinitiativ.
  • Arbeta med PLC, HMI och industriell automation.
  • Optimera mjukvaruinställningar och justera parametrar i styrsystemet.
  • Felsöka och utveckla automations- och produktionssystem.
  • Utveckla strategier för förebyggande och avhjälpande underhåll.
  • Stödja verksamheten vid produktionsstörningar och tekniska problem.
  • Arbeta med industriell IT/OT, nätverk, servrar och fjärråtkomst.
  • Ta fram tekniska lösningar och konstruktioner i CAD.
  • Samordna entreprenörer, leverantörer och tekniska samarbetspartners.
  • Delta i driftsättning och optimering av ny utrustning och nya processer.
  • Genomföra grundorsaksanalyser och driva långsiktiga förbättringar.
  • Följa och analysera tekniska och produktionsrelaterade data för att öka driftsäkerhet och effektivitet.
  • Provtagning, mätning, analysering och uppföljning av material för att säkerställa kvalitén.
  • Bidra till ett systematiskt arbete inom arbetsmiljö, säkerhet och miljö.

Du fungerar som teknisk expert och stöd för produktion och underhåll och får även möjlighet att dela din kunskap genom utbildning och introduktion av kollegor.

Vi tror att du har

  • Utbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet inom teknik, automation, el, mekatronik eller mekanik.
  • Erfarenhet av industriellt underhåll och driftsäkerhet.
  • Kunskap inom PLC, HMI och industriell automation.
  • Erfarenhet av industriella nätverk och IT/OT-miljöer.
  • Erfarenhet av CAD, exempelvis Autodesk Inventor.
  • Erfarenhet av tekniska projekt och/eller samordning av entreprenörer.
  • God problemlösningsförmåga och ett analytiskt tänkande.
  • Ett strukturerat, praktiskt och lösningsorienterat arbetssätt.
  • Goda kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från processindustri, metallindustri eller annan komplex produktionsmiljö.

Vi erbjuder

En bred teknisk roll

Du får arbeta med allt från automation och IT/OT till produktion, underhåll, konstruktion och tekniska projekt.

Möjlighet att påverka

Dina idéer och lösningar får direkt betydelse för anläggningens säkerhet, driftsäkerhet, effektivitet och utveckling.

Teknisk utveckling

Du får möjlighet att utvecklas inom flera teknikområden och arbeta med modern industriell teknik.

Nära verksamheten

Du arbetar nära produktionen och ser konkret resultat av dina insatser.

Varierad vardag

Här är ingen dag den andra lik. Du får kombinera strategiskt förbättringsarbete med praktisk problemlösning och dagliga situationer som dagligen uppstår i produktionen.

Är du vår nästa tekniska problemlösare? Om du gillar att förstå hur tekniska system fungerar, hitta lösningar på komplexa problem och samtidigt vara med och utveckla verksamheten, kan det här vara rätt roll för dig.

Information och ansökan

Vi värdesätter mångfald och välkomnar alla kvalificerade sökande.

  • Omfattning: Heltid
  • Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning
  • Placering: Norrsundet, Gävle

Urval sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, 2026-09-07.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Vi vill att vår rekrytering ska vara rättvis och inkluderande. Därför ber vi inte om bilder eller långa ansökningsbrev. I stället använder vi frågor i ansökningsprocessen som gör det lättare att jämföra kandidater och säkerställa rättvisa. Vi ber om könsuppgift för att kunna främja en god könsbalans i vår rekryteringsprocess.

title: Opas, Rovaniemi Insider
description:
AALTOVOIMA - AALLON VOIMALLA TÖIHIN


Rovaniemi Insider on paikallinen matkailualan yritys, joka auttaa matkailijoita löytämään Lapin parhaat kokemukset ympäri vuoden. Tarjoamme monipuolisia aktiviteetteja, laadukkaita majoitusratkaisuja ja henkilökohtaista palvelua niin kansainvälisille vierailijoille kuin kotimaan matkailijoille. Teemme yhteistyötä alueen matkailuyritysten kanssa ja rakennamme elämyksiä, jotka jättävät pysyvän muistijäljen. Olemme kasvava yritys, ja toimintamme keskiössä ovat paikallinen asiantuntemus, laadukkaat palvelut ja ensiluokkainen asiakaspalvelu.

Etsimme asiakkaallemme Rovaniemi Insiderille energisiä ja ammattitaitoisia oppaita tulevaan talvisesonkiin Lappiin! Työskentelyalue sijoittuu pääosin Rovaniemelle ja muualle Lappiin, mutta tehtävät voivat viedä sinut myös Ruotsin ja Norjan puolelle. Oppaana olet avainasemassa luomassa unohtumattomia elämyksiä kansainvälisille vieraille.

Työ on vaihtelevaa ja sisältää vuoroja kaikkina vuorokauden aikoina (aamu-, päivä-, ilta- ja yövuorot). Työsuhde solmitaan määräaikaisena vuokratyösuhteena Aaltovoima Pohjoisen kanssa.

Arvostamme:

* Kielitaitoa: Sujuva englannin kielen taito on välttämätön. Suurena etuna pidämme espanjan, italian, ranskan tai kiinan kielen taitoa.

* Liikkuvuutta: Voimassa oleva b-ajokortti on välttämätön tehtävässä.

* Asennetta ja taitoja: Erinomaiset kommunikaatiotaidot, ongelmanratkaisukyky sekä kyky työskennellä itsenäisesti haastavissakin olosuhteissa.

* Eduksi katsotaan: EA-kortti, hygienia- ja anniskelupassi sekä valokuvaus- ja kuvankäsittelytaidot.

Tarjoamme:

* Ainutlaatuisen työkokemuksen Lapin upeissa maisemissa ja kansainvälisessä ilmapiirissä

* Joustavat sopimuskaudet: marraskuun alusta maaliskuun loppuun tai joulukuun alusta tammikuun puoliväliin

* Mahdollisuuden edulliseen majoitukseen yrityksen kautta (300–600 €/kk)

* Aalto Henkilöstöpalveluiden tuen koko työsuhteesi ajan

Liity mukaan tiimiimme lähettämällä hakemuksesi jo tänään oheisen linkin kautta. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikat sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa:

Isla Lumme

+358 40 723 8511

isla.lumme@aaltovoima.fi


Aalto Henkilöstöpalvelut on monialainen henkilöstöpalveluyritys Suomesta, joka yhdistää työn ja tekijät. Olemme osa laajempaa Workteam Groupia, joka on henkilöstö- sekä palvelualan konserni.

Perusta toiminnallamme on luotettavuus ja joustavuus. Keskeisimpiä arvojamme ovat yhdessä menestyminen, nopea reagointi ja positiivinen palvelu. Jokainen työntekijä ja asiakas on meille tärkeä.

Henkilöstöllämme on kymmenien vuosien kokemus rakentamisen, logistiikan, teollisuuden ja palvelualojen rekrytoinneista henkilöstöpalvelualalla.

title: Senior Lead, Enterprise Strategy and Operations (R5624)
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Strategy & Operations Lead to help define enterprise strategy and ensure its operational execution. This role offers immersive exposure to the company’s most critical decisions — spanning aircraft systems, AI software (Hivemind), autonomy hardware, and international growth.

As a core member of the Strategy & Operations team, you’ll apply structured problem‑solving, financial rigor, and operational discipline to turn strategic priorities into actionable, measurable outcomes. The role combines high‑performance expectations with a strong learning and development environment — ideal for professionals seeking to grow into future strategy, operations, or general management leaders.

What you'll do:

Enterprise Strategy Development:

  • Support the multi‑year strategic planning and annual operating strategy cycles.
  • Evaluate portfolio tradeoffs across platforms, software, hardware, and emerging growth vectors.
  • Conduct market sizing, competitive analysis, and scenario modeling across U.S. and allied defense markets.

    • Capital Allocation & Business Case Rigor:

  • Build financial models and analytic frameworks for investment decisions (new platforms, manufacturing, international expansion).
  • Assess TAM, margin structure, capital intensity, payback, and risk‑adjusted returns.
  • Contribute to the development of enterprise‑wide capital allocation frameworks and governance processes.

    • Operationalization of Strategy:

  • Translate strategic priorities into cross‑functional execution plans with defined KPIs and milestones.
  • Track and report on progress through structured operating cadences (monthly and quarterly performance reviews).
  • Identify bottlenecks, analyze root causes, and recommend actionable solutions to sustain execution velocity.

    • Required qualifications:

  • Min 12+ years of experience with Bachelors, 8+ with Masters, and 5+ with PhD.
  • Min 4+ years’ experience in a strategy consulting, corporate strategy or other high‑rigor roles.
  • Strong analytical and conceptual problem‑solving abilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous problems and drive insight through analysis.
  • Financial modeling and analytical capability (unit economics, forecasting, scenario analysis).
  • Experience or strong interest in complex, technical, or regulated industries (aerospace, defense, AI, or advanced manufacturing preferred).
  • Ability to work collaboratively across teams and influence senior stakeholders.
  • U.S. citizenship required (ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance).

All offers are contingent on a cleared background and possible reference check. Military fellows and part-time employees are not eligible for benefits. description:
Tilbage til ledige stillinger

     Forsikringsrådgiver til Mariagerfjord 

        
 
            
 Er du til sund fornuft og korte beslutningsveje?
 Har du erfaring med at rådgive om og sælge skadesforsikringer til privatkunder?
 Og er du målbevidst og imødekommende samtidig med, at du finder glæde i at skabe forretninger? 

 Så er du måske den forsikringsrådgiver, vi søger til Mariagerfjord. 

 Om jobbet
 Som forsikringsrådgiver i Mariagerfjord får du ansvaret for at rådgive om og sælge skadesforsikringer til nye og eksisterende privatkunder. Du bliver tilknyttet vores fire privatkundeafdelinger i Arden, Hadsund, Hobro og Mariager. 

 Vores rådgivere booker møderne til dig. Du får administrativ og faglig support fra sparekassens centrale forsikringscenter i Vrå. Derudover arbejder du tæt sammen med sparekassens øvrige forsikringsrådgivere. 

 Du får frihed til at træffe dine egne beslutninger og gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling. 

 For at klare dig godt i rollen er det her vigtigt at vide
 Vi forventer, at du har et højt fagligt niveau og erfaring med at rådgive om forsikringer til privatkunder. Vi forestiller os, at du i dag arbejder som forsikringsassurandør eller forsikringsrådgiver og er uddannet og certificeret inden for skadesforsikringer. 

 Du kan sikkert genkende dig selv i nedenstående karakteristik: 
 
   Du arbejder for høj kundetilfredshed. 

   Du er resultatorienteret, initiativrig og skaber gode relationer. 

   Du trives med at arbejde med tydelige mål og gør det med engagement. 

   Du tilpasser dig kundernes behov og udviser fleksibilitet i dialogen. 

   Du er motiveret for at skabe resultater - både på egen hånd og sammen med andre. 
 
 Vi forventer, at du bidrager med dine værdier, deler dine erfaringer, tilfører hverdagen god energi og medvirker til et godt kollegialt og fagligt miljø. 

 Om at være en del af Kompetencecenter Mariagerfjord
 Du bliver en del af kompetencecentret i Mariagerfjord, hvor du arbejder sammen med specialister inden for blandt andet formueområdet og dermed får gode muligheder for daglig sparring. Kompetencecentrets vigtigste opgave er at understøtte kollegerne i afdelingerne med specialiseret viden og de nødvendige ressourcer inden for de forskellige. Den høje faglighed og tilgængelighed bidrager til en fleksibel hverdag. 

 Vi afholder primært møder med kunderne i vores afdelinger eller online. Med lokal tilstedeværelse og centrale kompetencer understøtter vi vækst og arbejdspladser i vores markedsområde. 

 I sparekassen har vi ordentlighed i højsædet over for både kunder og medarbejdere. Du vil opleve en arbejdsplads, som er præget af nærvær, arbejdsglæde og motivation, og hvor du også har indflydelse på din hverdag. 

 Vi skaber sammen en arbejdsdag for den enkelte, hvor der er balance mellem arbejds- og familielivet med udgangspunkt i vores bærende værdier. 

 Interesseret?
 Er du interesseret i stillingen? Så kan du uploade en kort motiveret ansøgning og et opdateret CV via linket til højre. Du er velkommen til at kontakte os, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen. 
         

        
 
             Om sparekassen 
            
 Sparekassen Danmark er en garantsparekasse. 

 Med vores 400.000 kunder og mere end 1.800 medarbejdere er vi blandt de seks største pengeinstitutter i Danmark. Du finder os på hele 71 adresser i Jylland, på Fyn og i København. 

 Vi driver pengeinstitut ud fra tre værdier: Ambitiøs, sund fornuft og tillid. 

 I praksis betyder det, at vi er ambitiøse i forhold til at gøre en forskel i kundernes liv. At den enkelte har frihed til at bruge sin sunde fornuft i den daglige drift. Og at vi udviser gensidig tillid til hinanden, til vores kunder - og til de beslutninger, der bliver truffet. 

 Du kan læse mere om sparekassens formål og værdier, og hvad du kan forvente at opleve som medarbejder i sparekassen, på vores karrieresite.  Klik hér  .

title: JFM A/S søger kunderådgiver til kundecenteret | jobdanmark
description:
JFM A/S søger kunderådgiver til kundecenteret 
         

     

 

 
 

 
    
 

        
 

             
            
 
                
 
                    
 
                        
 
                                
  
 
 
 
                         

                        
 
                                     fuldtid 
                         

                        
 
                             JFM A/S søger kunderådgiver til kundecenteret 
                             
                                
 
                                         
                                             JFM
                                         
                                 

                                
  
    Banegårdspladsen 1, 5000 Odense C 

                             
                         

                     

                    
 
                        
 Brænder du for at skabe gode kundeoplevelser og gøre en reel forskel for kunder hver dag? 

 Hos JFM i Odense søger vi lige nu to nye kolleger til vores BtC-kundeservice. Vi søger én medarbejder på fuldtid og én på deltid. 
 
 Du bliver en del af kundecenteret for nogle af Danmarks stærkeste lokale og regionale aviser. Hver dag hjælper og rådgiver vi vores læsere med blandt andet abonnementer, levering og brugen af vores digitale produkter. Din indsats er derfor med til at sikre, at vores læsere får en god oplevelse, både med den trykte avis og vores digitale læsestof.
  

 Om stillingen 

 Som en del af BtC-kundeservice du får en vigtig rolle i abonnenternes oplevelse af JFM og vores aviser. Du arbejder primært med telefonisk og skriftlig kundeservice, og sikrer, at alle henvendelser bliver mødt med venlighed, behandlet professionelt, effektivt og med fokus på en god serviceoplevelse. Du vil primært arbejde med abonnementsspørgsmål, kundeaftaler og forskellige ad hoc-opgaver.  

 Derudover bliver du en del af en afdeling, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, deler viden og løfter i flok. I rollen får man en hverdag med både faste rutiner og varierende opgaver, hvor det er vigtigt, at du trives i at arbejde selvstændigt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver.
   

 Hvem er du? 

 Vi forventer ikke en specifik uddannelsesbaggrund, men erfaring fra kundeservice eller kundesupport vil være en fordel. Det vigtigste er, at du er serviceminded, ansvarsbevidst og motiveret for at skabe gode kundeoplevelse. 

 Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du: 
 
 
 Er mødestabil og arbejder struktureret med dine opgaver 
 

 
 Tager ansvar og kan arbejde selvstændigt 
 

 
 Kommunikerer klart, professionelt og imødekommende, både mundtligt og skriftligt 
 

 
 Trives i en hverdag med både faste rutiner og varierende opgaver 
 

 
 Bidrager positivt til samarbejdet og det gode arbejdsmiljø i teamet 
 

 
 For deltidsstillingen er det vigtigt, at du har mulighed for at arbejde om mandagen
   
 
 
 Hvorfor vælge JFM? 

 Hos JFM bliver du en del af et af Danmarks største mediehuse, hvor vi har fokus på trivsel, samarbejde og udvikling. Du træder ind i et team med hjælpsomme kolleger, en uformel omgangstone og rig mulighed for løbende at styrke dine kompetencer gennem sparring og træning.  

 Derudover tilbyder vi: 
 
 
 En fastansættelse på 37 timer ugentligt i fuldtidsstillingen eller en deltidsansættelse på minimum 15 timer om ugen i deltidsstillingen 
 

 
 Et engageret team med et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi afholder fælles arrangementer og konkurrencer 
 

 
 Gode muligheder for både personlig og faglig udvikling - bl.a. træning i service og kommunikation 
 

 
 Ansættelse efter HK-overenskomst inkl. Pension, fritvalgskonto og sundhedsforsikring 
 

 
 Et stærkt arbejdsmiljø med sociale aktiviteter og godt kollegaskab på tværs af afdelinger 
 

 
 Lyder stillingen som noget for dig? Så send os din ansøgning allerede i dag. 
   
 
 
 Ansøgning 

 Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende. Søg stillingen via "Ansøg nu" knappen - du bedes angive, om du søger stillingen på fuldtid eller deltid. Begge stillinger er med opstart hurtigst muligt.  

 Din dagligdag vil være på kontoret i hjertet af Odense lige overfor banegården. 

 Har du spørgsmål til stillingen som kunderådgiver er du velkommen til at kontakte Kundeservicechef Mette Kjær Nikolajsen på mekni@jfm.dk eller til afdelingsleder Ømer Søylemez på omsoy@jfm.dk eller tlf. nr. 65 45 50 69 

 Vi glæder os meget til at høre fra dig. 
   

 Om JFM

På alle platforme informerer og inspirerer vi hver eneste dag med vores historier fra der, hvor livet leves. Vi dækker hele Danmark. Vi er en levende organisation med over 1300 engagerede medarbejdere med arbejdssteder fra Holstebro til Hovedstaden. Medarbejdere, der hver dag lægger al deres energi, viden og kunnen i at informere, inspirere, kommunikere og underholde.

title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Helsinki, Konala
description:
Etsitkö ihmisläheistä työtä, jossa pääset tärkeäksi osaksi toisen ihmisen arkea? Henkilökohtaisena avustajana pääset tukemaan asiakasta niissä tilanteissa, joissa hän tarvitsee toisen ihmisen apua esimerkiksi liikkumisessa, kodin askareissa tai vapaa-ajan toiminnassa. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan tarkoitus on tukea asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta ja mahdollisuutta elää omannäköistä elämää.

Henkilökohtaisen avustajan työ on maanläheistä ja tilanteisiin mukautuvaa. Päivät voivat vaihdella paljon, ja tehtävät suunnitellaan aina asiakkaan tarpeiden mukaan. Aiempaa kokemusta tehtävästä ei tarvita, sillä perehdytämme sinut työhön. Olemme työnantajana aina helposti tavoitettavissa ja tukenasi, jotta työ sujuu turvallisesti ja luontevasti.

Meille on tärkeää, että työ sopii yhtä hyvin avustajalle kuin avustaja asiakkaalle. Työvuorot suunnitellaan yhteisymmärryksessä, jotta arki pysyy kaikille toimivana ja selkeänä.

Etsimme nyt osa-aikaista henkilökohtaista avustajaa asiakkaallemme Helsingin Konalaan. Asiakas on nainen, joka tarvitsee apua arjen askareissa, kuten kotitöissä sekä kodin ulkopuolisilla asiointikäynneillä ja vapaa-ajan vietossa. Avustajan on oltava vastuuntuntoinen ja luotettava.

Työvuoroja on yleensä noin kahdesti viikossa arkisin päiväsaikaan (noin 4-6 tuntia/vuoro). Vuoroja voi olla välillä myös lauantaisin. Asiakas ja avustaja sopivat vuoroista keskenään.

Työhön valitulta henkilöltä vaaditaan rikostaustaselvitys vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työskentelyä varten (Laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta).

Toivomme, että olet:
- Oma-aloitteinen
- Luotettava
- Empaattinen

Työ alkaa mahdollisimman pian tai sopimuksen mukaan. Aloitamme haastattelut ennen hakuajan päättymistä ja tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.



Elämäsi Adato – Sinun elämäsi, sinä päätät
Elämäsi Adato Oy on suomalainen perheyritys, joka on täysin erikoistunut henkilökohtaisen avun järjestämiseen jo yli 15 vuoden ajan. Tavoitteenamme on auttaa jokaista asiakasta toimimaan arjen tilanteissa turvallisesti ja omien toiveidensa mukaisesti, niin että itsemääräämisoikeus säilyy kaikissa päivän kulkuun liittyvissä asioissa.

Haluamme olla asiakkaillemme luotettava kumppani heidän jokapäiväisessä elämässään ja työntekijöillemme välittävä ja joustava työnantaja. Meillä työskentely on konkreettista, ihmisläheistä ja merkityksellistä.

Työllistämme yli 300 henkilökohtaista avustajaa eri puolilla Suomea. Kasvamme vastuullisesti, ihmisten tarpeita kuunnellen.

Lue lisää www.elämäsi.com [http://www.elämäsi.com]

title: Logistics Operations Assistant
description:
Are you interested in logistics, international trading and modern solutions in commerce? Have you just completed your education and gained initial experience that you would like to develop in an international company that operates in an interesting environment?

Then apply now to become part of our logistics team as a Logistics Operations Assistant in the Lomography Headquarter in Vienna! In this varied role you work directly with the International Logistics Managers to ensure the smooth flows of goods in Europe. You will also be involved in international logistics projects and encouraged to bring in yourself in when it comes to the development of new logistics solutions.

Tasks

  • Coordination of B2B orders and submission to our external logistics partner

  • Handling and monitoring the smooth operation of the relevant shipping activities (preparation of delivery documents, invoicing, delivery troubleshooting, checking customs documents, organizings freights)

  • Connection between the sales teams and the warehouse

  • Handling returns

  • Obtaining quotes for international sea and air freights (including analysis)

  • Monitoring the freight dates and updating information in our system, record freight arrivals

  • Administrative tasks and support in the logistics department (data updates, document management, invoice checks, etc.)

  • Research for new logistics solutions

  • Co-Develop and test new tools in the logistics sector (up to testing AI tools)

Requirements

  • Completed Education or about to complete (ideally with some relation to business)

  • Experience in a logistics position is a clear plus

  • Quick comprehension and good with numbers

  • Very good english knowledge, German is a plus

  • Very good computer skills (MS Office, Google Suite, Spreadsheets)

  • Detail orientation and discretion

  • Structured and results-oriented way of working

  • Motivation for proactive participation in processes

Lomography values ​​motivated employees who want to develop their skills through collaboration with experienced teams and offers excellent long-term career development opportunities. If you are looking for an interesting and varied position in a globally operating company and appreciate a creative work environment within a positive, employee-oriented atmosphere, then you've probably come to the right place, and we look forward to receiving your application!

We offer

  • Excellent professional and personal development opportunities within the company

  • A secure job in an exciting and constantly evolving industry.

  • An international team in a positive working environment

  • Varied and exciting areas of responsibility

  • A Workplace in a central location in Vienna's 7th district with excellent public transport connections

  • Connect to a worldwide community of millions of photography enthusiasts, artists and creatives.

title: FTZ - Kundesupporter til FTZ Rørup
description:
FTZ - Kundesupporter til FTZ Rørup
  
	

	
	
	
	
		
	
		
	
	
	
	

	

	  
	
	
	
		
	

	
	









	
	


	
	




			
		

		


	




	

	

		

  			
	    

    

		    	
Flere fordele. For dig. For fremtiden.

		    	Kundesupporter til FTZ Rørup
    

    

    

  

		

			  

				

					

								
Vi søger en erfaren, serviceminded og fagligt stærk kundesupporter til vores lokation i Rørup. Du bliver en del af et team, hvor høj faglighed, samarbejde, videndeling og god kundeservice er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Her får du mulighed for at bringe din erfaring i spil og bidrage med din faglige viden i et miljø med tæt sparring på tværs af organisationen.

Om jobbet

Du møder ind til en hverdag, hvor ingen dage er helt ens. Telefonen ringer, kunderne har spørgsmål, og du hjælper dem med at finde de rette reservedele og løsninger. Nogle opgaver kræver et hurtigt svar, mens andre kræver grundig rådgivning og teknisk indsigt. Du håndterer også indkøb af haste- og skaffevarer hos eksterne leverandører. Uanset opgaven er målet det samme: at sikre kunderne den rette løsning inden for reservedele, værktøj og værkstedsudstyr og give dem en professionel og serviceminded oplevelse hver gang, de er i kontakt med os.

Du får stor frihed til at planlægge din arbejdsdag og refererer til Head of Customer Support Joakim Juncker. 

Dine primære opgaver

Modtage, behandle og ekspedere kundeordrer

Besvare henvendelser og håndtere kundeordrer via telefon, FTZShop og ved kundedisken

Rådgive og vejlede kunder om produkter og løsninger

Sikre en professionel og positiv kundeoplevelse

Indkøbe haste- og skaffevarer hos eksterne leverandører

Bidrage til den daglige drift og de løbende forbedringer i afdelingen 

Om dig
Du har flere års erfaring fra en kundesupportfunktion i autobranchen og trives med tæt kundekontakt. Du kan eksempelvis være uddannet mekaniker eller reservedelsekspedient. Det vigtigste er, at du har et solidt branchekendskab, teknisk forståelse og indgående kendskab til reservedele samt erfaring med at rådgive kunder om de rette løsninger.

Derudover ser vi gerne, at du: 

Har indgående kendskab til produkter og løsninger inden for autobranchen

Arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

Er en stærk kommunikator, der forstår at afdække kundernes behov og finde de rette løsninger

Trives i et team, hvor samarbejde, videndeling og hjælpsomhed er en naturlig del af hverdagen

Har lyst til løbende at udvikle dine kompetencer

Vi tilbyder
FTZ vil fortsat være den ultimative partner for værksteder over hele landet, med en ensartet service, der matcher vores høje standarder. Derfor vil du i FTZ opleve en udviklingsorienteret kultur med en høj grad af samarbejde på tværs af kolleger og afdelinger. Vi skaber rum til, at alle medarbejdere kan levere en dedikeret indsats, hvor faglighed og professionalisme kan blomstre.

Vores tre værdier - Ordentlighed, Samarbejde og Udvikling binder os sammen, og dem ønsker vi at efterleve hver dag. Det er via vores værdier, engagement og indsats at vi sammen gør en forskel. Det skal du have lyst til at blive en del af. Derudover får du:

God introduktion til FTZ og oplæring i vores systemer

Et spændende og udfordrende job med gode muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling.

Et arbejdsmiljø med en glad og uformel omgangstone

Gode arbejdsforhold, løn efter kvalifikationer, en pensionsordning, sundhedsforsikring og kantineordning.

For yderligere oplysninger om jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte Head of Customer Support Joakim Juncker på 2184 8648.

Ansøgninger behandles løbende, og vi afholder samtaler løbende. Når vi har modtaget et passende rekrutteringsgrundlag, vil annoncen blive fjernet fra FTZ.dk/job og karriere.

title: Lægesekretær med sans for drift og patientflow søges til psykiatrisk klinik på Frederiksberg (37 timer)
description:
Har du styr på detaljerne, overblik i en travl hverdag og et smil i stemmen? Da en af vores nuværende sekretærer har ønsket at rykke til vores klinik i Nordsjælland, har vi behov for at finde en ny kollega til klinikken på Frederiksberg.

Om Falkonerklinikken

Falkonerklinikken er en veletableret, privat psykiatrisk klinik med central beliggenhed på Frederiksberg – tæt på metro og med gode parkeringsforhold. Vi er et tværfagligt team på 17 medarbejdere, der brænder for at yde høj faglighed og skabe trygge rammer for vores patienter.

Vi har både forsikrings- og privatfinansierede patientforløb og samarbejder med nogle af Danmarks største sundhedsforsikringer. Hos os er der fokus på faglig sparring, ordentlighed og gode kollegiale relationer – og vi prioriterer fælles pauser og et uformelt, men respektfuldt arbejdsmiljø.

Hvad vi tilbyder

· En fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer pr. uge

· Forventet lønramme 34.400 DKK til 44.400 DKK inkl. 5% firmapension

· 6 ugers ferie, frokostordning og betalt frokostpause

· Mulighed for arbejdsgiverbetalt sundhedsforsikring

· Grundig oplæring og løbende sparring

· En varieret hverdag med både klassiske sekretæropgaver og koordinering af drift og arbejdsgange.

· Du bliver del af et sekretariatsteam med 3 lægesekretærer og 2 receptionister.

Dine opgaver

· Telefonbetjening og kontakt til patienter

· Journalskrivning (i mindre grad) for psykiatere og psykologer

· Booking og koordination af patientforløb

· Overblik over patientflow og optimering af kalenderstrukturen

· Administrative opgaver såsom materialebestilling og koordinering af den daglige drift

Vi forestiller os, at du…

· Er uddannet lægesekretær og har solid erfaring fra en lignende stilling

· Trives med ansvar og har blik for struktur og effektiv drift

· Er selvstændig, løsningsorienteret og har god situationsfornemmelse

· Har flair for både administrative opgaver og menneskelig kontakt

· Taler og skriver engelsk på et godt niveau – vi har mange internationale patienter

· Du må meget gerne have en vis grad for ”IT-flair” (Men vi har fast IT support)

Send din ansøgning og CV til job@falkonerklinikken.dk

Skriv ”Sekretær til Frederiksberg” i emnefeltet

title: Retail Supervisor Wangara WH
description:
Join us and experience Bunnings from the other side of the counter!

What’s in it for you when you’re part of our team:

  • Team discount at Bunnings and other Wesfarmers brands including Kmart, Target and Officeworks to name a few

  • Free standard OnePass membership

  • Access to over 100+ exclusive team member benefits across health, shopping, travel and stay, wealth, work and leave

  • 12 weeks paid parental leave, regardless of gender

  • Fun stuff like annual festive gifts, discounted food and drinks at our Bunnings Cafe, and travelling store team member opportunities

  • We’re genuinely invested in your career and no matter where you start with us, that pathway is yours to build

About the role:


As a Retail Supervisor at Bunnings, you'll be the go-to and support for the store's senior leadership team. You'll keep the energy high and the workflow smooth in your designated department. By leading by example, you'll work with your team to ensure every day is a success and operations run like a well-oiled machine. Get ready to lead, inspire, and make a real impact!


We provide an adult pay rate for 18 years of age and above at $30.78 per hour for this role.


What’s involved:

  • Lead by example by demonstrating best service practices and support the team in providing friendly and helpful advice to customers

  • Coach the team through guidance on appropriate service behaviours

  • Helping onboard and train new team members by providing training and induction support

  • Merchandising standards to ensure all merchandising meets business requirements

  • Managing and coordinating stock effectively.

Who we're looking for:

Our ideal candidate will share a genuine passion for retail and customer service and be complimentary to the store leadership team. You will have previous experience supervising a team in a fast-paced environment, have open communication and a genuine interest in coaching and developing others.

This role is a great opportunity for an aspiring retail leader to grow their leadership career in a supportive team environment. Surrounded by experienced mentors, you'll have the chance to develop your leadership skills, take on exciting challenges, and make a real impact.

You’ll need:

  • The ability to guide, support, coach and provide feedback, so as to bring the best out of your team

  • To be results driven and a team player

  • Be approachable and confident, creating positive experiences when interacting with our customers

  • Have an eagerness and ongoing enthusiasm to learn about new products

  • To be on your feet assisting with customers across a wide range of retail hours

When you’re ready to give this opportunity a Red Hot Go, all you’ll need to do is:

  • Submit an application and complete an online chat interview (20 minutes)

  • If successful, next step includes an online video interview (15 minutes)

  • If you’re a match, we’ll invite you to an onsite meet and greet with our leaders (20 minutes)

You’ll be part of a workplace where you’ll feel like you belong.


We love the diversity across our teams, brought together in an inclusive culture guided by our values. We welcome applications from individuals of all ages, cultural backgrounds, abilities, sexual orientations, and gender identities. We strongly encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples to apply and join us in shaping a workplace that celebrates First Nations voices, perspectives, and contributions. Please note, you must be age 15 or over to apply for a role at Bunnings.

We’re all about fairness at Bunnings, and our team’s here to support you every step of the way. If you need any adjustments, just let us know - we’re here to help. If you’ve got the experience, skills, and drive to grow - but don’t quite nail every part of the job description - we still want to hear from you. For support, contact us at jobs@bunnings.com.au.

Bunnings reserves the right to close job advertisements at any time, so we encourage you to apply early. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies, as we have a dedicated internal Talent Acquisition team managing all hiring processes.

About Us

Bunnings is the leading retailer of home improvement and lifestyle products in Australia and New Zealand. We're proud to support project builders, commercial tradespeople and the housing industry through our network of stores, trade centres, frame and truss sites and online.

At Bunnings, our purpose is simple: we’re here to inspire people to have a red hot go! Whether that's backing our team to grow, supporting customers to take on new projects, or helping communities make a real difference. By joining our passionate and diverse team, you will be part of a culture that encourages you to roll up your sleeves and build something great together. If you’re ready to have a go, apply today.

Please note if you are offered a role with us, background checks may be required. This can include police, employment, medical and qualification checks. If a police check search returns a criminal record, Bunnings will assess whether the record impacts your ability to perform the key requirements of the role.

title: Product Manager (Remote)
description:
Product Manager (Remote, Canada)

Location: Remote

Product Manager
- this role is based for applicants located in Canada

SiteDocs, a GoCanvas company, is a leading provider of digital safety management software, trusted by thousands of teams to modernize and simplify workplace health and safety across construction, engineering, infrastructure, logistics, and beyond. We’re the highest-rated EHS platform on Gartner-owned Capterra, empowering field teams and safety leaders to replace paperwork, boost compliance, and drive real-time visibility where it matters most.

SiteDocs is part of the Nemetschek Group — a publicly traded European software company with a multi-billion-euro market capitalisation. The group brings together more than 15 specialised brands, including GoCanvas, Bluebeam, FirmusAI, Nevaris, AllPlan, VectorWorks, and SpaceWell, serving customers across the full AECO (Architecture, Engineering, Construction & Operations) spectrum. Together, we’re shaping a smarter, safer, and more sustainable built world.


Position overview:
We are seeking a Product Manager to help drive meaningful business outcomes and enable our customers to succeed through the use of our SiteDocs product. As a product-forward company, we focus deeply on customer needs and believe strong product execution is critical to delivering value to the market.

As a Product Manager, you will contribute to the development of new products and features designed to help businesses streamline workplace health and safety moving from error-prone paper processes to enhanced digital workflows. You will work within an established product strategy and roadmap, partnering closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to deliver high-quality solutions that improve the SiteDocs platform and customer experience.

This role is ideal for someone who is building their product career, enjoys hands-on execution, and wants exposure to the full product lifecycle — from discovery through delivery and iteration.

Your Most Important Initiatives
  • Own the discovery, definition, execution, and delivery of product initiatives within a defined product area or roadmap.
  • Drive customer discovery and partner with stakeholders to understand user needs, workflows, and pain points; translate insights into clear product requirements and prioritized backlogs.
  • Monitor competitive offerings and industry trends to help inform roadmap planning and feature enhancements.
  • Collaborate with UX, engineering, marketing, sales, and other product managers throughout the product lifecycle — from concept through launch and post-release iteration.
  • Write clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to enable efficient development and high-quality delivery that meets customer needs.
  • Support sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release coordination with engineering teams.
  • Measure product performance using defined success metrics; analyze usage data, customer feedback, and qualitative insights to inform continuous improvement.

What You Bring
  • Experience contributing to the delivery of successful software products, ideally in a SaaS environment.
  • Working knowledge of Agile product development practices.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to translate complex problems into structured solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with multiple priorities with geographically dispersed teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience; technical background is a plus.
  • 1+ years of experience in product management, business analysis, consulting, or related role.

Why Join Us?
Join a mission-driven team focused on proactive customer success and long-term partnership. You'll collaborate with supportive colleagues, impact business growth, and play a critical role in ensuring our customers thrive with GoCanvas & SiteDocs solutions.

Our success is rooted in a wonderfully wholesome culture, best defined by our four overarching values:
  • Authentic Relationships - People are never a means to an end.
  • Continuous Learning - Test every assumption and never stay stagnant.
  • Interdependence - We build systems that require everyone to perform with excellence, we are a team, and we succeed or fail together.
  • Data Driven Decisions - Because wisdom requires understanding the facts of the matter, disputes between competing perspectives are resolved with data.

If you have any questions about your personal data privacy at SiteDocs, please visit our privacy page.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. title: Construction Project Manager
description:
Overview

Microsoft Cloud Operations + Innovation (CO+I) is the team behind the cloud. CO+I is responsible for delivering over 200 Microsoft web portals, Live and Online Services around the world including infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide. We are looking for a passionate individual to help build the network that powers the world’s largest online services.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.



Responsibilities

Budget and Controls

Monitors the approved project budget, provides oversight, and suggests necessary adjustments for project controls (e.g., Project Expenditure Request (PERs), Professional Services Request (PSRs), Change Orders, Pay Applications, etc.).

Change Management

Partners with the Internal Cloud Operations + Innovation (CO+I) and other Microsoft key stakeholders (e.g., Commercial Software Engineering [CSE], and Real Estate & Facilities [RE&F], etc.) and shares updated process flow information with the project team to ensure new processes are being followed that increase program cost savings and improve overall cycle-time and efficiencies.

Coordination

Attends and advises during scheduled owner/architect/contractor and other project meetings.

Drives Results

Facilitates the delivery of metro-based/campus projects (e.g., new construction and/or retrofits) by making timely data-based decisions in partnership with the local project team and key stakeholders. Champions team and project goals, adhering to business processes, engaging vendor relationships when/where applicable, and fostering positive cross-group collaboration efforts aligned to the program strategy and milestones.

Financial Acumen

Creates and applies best practices to identify and incorporate cost-effective solutions for the strategic and tactical delivery of a construction project. Applies influence, strategy, and decision-making to drive solutions, schedules, and manages change with clients, sponsors, and vendors.

Goal Alignment

Collaborates and contributes needed technical knowledge to internal teams (e.g., Engineering, Operations, Center for International Social Science Research [CISSR], Commercial Software Engineering [CSE], Legal, Project Controls, etc.) and General Contractors/Subcontractors to maintain the corporate vision and goals for the project.

Managing Resources

Oversees timely execution of all procurement activities associated with resourcing and materials necessary for delivering program(s) on time and within project budget forecasts. Evaluates resources and ensures adequate staffing and materials for job completion.

Project Management

Drives campus-based delivery solutions (e.g., new or retrofit data center facilities). Analyzes technical information and provides recommendations to support solutions. Assists campus teams in establishing goals for project teams, assigning responsibilities, measuring performance, and seeking and delivering feedback to achieve timely results.

Project Tracking

Assists with creating and reporting on project progress regarding scope, schedule, standards, and budget.

Risk Mitigation

Communicates risk mitigation goals and develops metrics, dashboards and/or scorecards to track, communicate, and drive progress. Suggests actions to support organizational and national safety goals.

Safety and Regulation

Represents Microsoft as a safety leader and advocate on all Campus/Metro construction programs, ensuring adherence to safety standards and regulatory requirements (e.g., Occupational Safety and Health Administration [OSHA], or equivalent) to ensure compliance and aggressive management of risk. Conducts routine safety program, project, and contractor audits, and performs and participates in incident investigations.

Technical Acumen

Reviews engineering documentation/designs, site, and building plans by examining and analyzing technical information. Identifies potential risks/gaps and provides recommendations to project teams that mitigate risk, and improve overall constructability. Aligns project/program delivery with execution procedures and standards, and ensures alignment with organizational standards and commitments.

Vendor Management

Advises and monitors the performance of vendors and/or contractors, ensuring compliance with contracts and prior audit results. Reviews vendor performance relative to cash flow and budget summaries (with the cost management team) and clarifies those reports in presentations to the delivery and executive teams.

Vendor Selection

Reviews and approves vendor scope of work, design review of site and building plans, pay-application, and invoices.



Qualifications

Required/Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Construction Project Management, Architecture, Engineering, or related field AND 12+ years related experience OR equivalent experience.

Additional Or Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Construction Project Management, Architecture, Engineering, or related field AND 15+ years related experience OR equivalent experience.
  • 15+ years experience working on data center projects.

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

		    Sekretariatsmedarbejder (ca. 10 timer pr. uge) 
				


			

Til Bispeparkens Bestyrelse søger vi pr. 1. oktober eller 1. november en sekretariatsmedarbejder til ca. 10 timers ugentligt arbejde i bestyrelsessekretariatet. 

Måske er du studerende, mangler et deltidsjob eller fleksjob? Måske har du administrativ erfaring fra foreningsarbejde eller frivilligt arbejde? Din baggrund er ikke afgørende. Blot du er ydmyg over for opgaven, har overskud, personligt drive og forståelse for det demokratiske flow i en udviklingsorienteret og mangfoldig boligafdeling med en bred beboersammensætning.

Om Bispeparken

Bispeparken er en grøn oasemidt i storbyen. Bispeparken er en almen boligafdeling, der ligger i den kreative Bispebjerg bydel, fire kilometer fra Københavns Rådhusplads. Bispeparken er et attraktivt sted at bo, især for studerende, og ligger lige ved Bispebjerg Kirkegård og naturen i Utterslev Mose. Bispeparken er en selvstændig afdeling i boligforeningen fsb. Bispeparken er nytænkende og kreativ med en blanding af 786 boliger og 30 erhvervslejemål. Afdelingen er kendetegnet ved et rigt og levende foreningsliv og en aktiv og visionær afdelingsbestyrelse med fokus på beboerdemokrati, miljø, økologi, kommunikation og afdelingens sociale fællesskab. Pt. fylder udviklingen af Bispeparkens kommende helhedsplan meget i bestyrelsens arbejde. 

Du vil dele kontor med bestyrelsen, en regnskabsmedarbejder og to andre sekretariatsmedarbejdere, der er ansat 10-15 timer om ugen. 

Dine arbejdsopgaver er: 

At bistå bestyrelsen med koordineringsopgaver samt planlægning og udførelse af arrangementer f.eks. fællesspisning

Sekretærbistand, også i forbindelse med møder, herunder referatskrivning og eventuelt ansvar for mødeindkaldelser

Koordinering af frivillige 

Facilitering af samarbejde mellem bestyrelse, drift og administration

Korrekturlæsning og kvalitetssikring af referater, notater, rapporter mv.

I mindre omfang modtagelse af beboerhenvendelser på mail

Klargøring af mødelokaler og hjælp med efterfølgende oprydning

Arkivering løbende af projekter og opgaver

Indkøb af kontorartikler og indkøb til møder/arrangementer i samarbejde med bestyrelsen

Løse de opgaver, som bestyrelsen aktuelt har brug for at få løst

Du kan selv være med til at tilrettelægge din arbejdstid - vi er fleksible. De to andre sekretariatsmedarbejdere er primært på kontoret kl. 10-15 i hverdagene. Der er dog mødeaktivitet om aftenen 1-2 gange om måneden, du skal deltage i. 

Vi forventer, at du:

Er proaktiv og god til at planlægge dit eget arbejde

Er engageret, imødekommende, serviceminded og samarbejdsorienteret

Er i besiddelse af en god portion humor, diplomatisk sans

Kan arbejde selvstændigt og overskue komplekse problemstillinger 

Kommunikerer godt i skrift og tale på dansk og gerne også engelsk

Kan bruge Office-pakken og lignende systemer - vi har mange systemer

Derudover er det en fordel, hvis:

Du har kendskab til almene boliger som beboer og eventuelt som aktiv i beboerdemokratiet

Har kendskab til arbejdet i en politisk ledet organisation

Har eller læser på en videregående uddannelse eller en administrativ uddannelse.

title: Päätoiminen tuntiopettaja (luokanopettaja), Mustasaaren Keskuskoulu
description:
Mustasaaren kunta hakee Mustasaaren keskuskouluun päätoimista tuntiopettajaa (luokanopettajan tehtävä) kolmannelle luokalle, määräajalle 9.11.2026-5.6.2027.

Haemme asialleen omistautunutta opettajaa, jolla on laaja-alaista pedagogista osaamista, valmiudet tiimityöskentelyyn sekä aitoa kiinnostusta suunnitella ja kehittää opetusta ja koulua. Asetat aina oppilaan keskiöön ja sovitat opetuksen oppilaitasi ajatellen, jotta he saavat parhaat mahdolliset edellytykset kehittyä. Luokanopettajana luot myönteisen ja osallistavan työilmapiirin, joka hyödyttää oppilaan oppimista ja koulunkäyntiä. Arvostamme myönteistä suhtautumista oppilaisiin, selkeää pedagogista visiota sekä digipedagogista osaamista. Tarjoamme sinulle mukavan työyhteisön, jossa pääset kehittämään opettajan rooliasi.

Kelpoisuus määräytyy asetuksen opetustoimen henkilöstön kelpoisuusvaatimuksista (986/1998) perusteella. Alkuperäiset kelpoisuuden osoittavat tutkintotodistukset on esitettävä mahdollisen haastattelun yhteydessä.

Palkkaus määräytyy kunnallisen opetusalan virka- ja työehtosopimuksen mukaan. Tehtävään valitun on ennen työsuhteen alkua esitettävä nähtäväksi lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) 3 §:n mukainen rikosrekisteriote. Tehtävässä käytetään neljän kuukauden koeaikaa.

Hakemukset toimitetaan Kuntarekryn kautta, työavain KO499-01-83-26, viimeistään 26.8.2026 klo 15. Liitä hakemukseesi kelpoisuuden osoittavat todistukset. Työtodistuksia ei liitetä hakemukseen.

Lue lisää Mustasaaren keskuskoulusta: https://mustasaari.fi/lapsi-ja-koulu/perusopetus/mustasaaren-koulut/mustasaaren-keskuskoulu
