title: Business Performance Improvement - Experienced Senior Consultant
description:
JOB REQUISITION

Business Performance Improvement - Experienced Senior Consultant

LOCATION

MINNEAPOLIS

ADDITIONAL LOCATION(S)

JOB DESCRIPTION

You Belong Here

The Protiviti Career provides opportunity to learn, inspire, and advance within a collaborative and inclusive culture. We hire curious individuals for whom learning is a passion. We lean into our mission: We Care. We Collaborate. We Deliver.

At every level, we champion leaders who live our values of integrity, inclusion, innovation, and commitment to success. Imagining our work as a journey, we believe integrity guides our way, inclusion moves us forward together, innovation creates new destinations, and our commitment to success empowers us to deliver on our vision to be the most trusted global consulting firm.

Where We Need You

Protiviti is looking for a Supply Chain & Operations Senior Consultant to join our growing Supply Chain & Operations Innovation team.

What You Can Expect

As a Senior Consultant, you will be a mentor, trainer, and coach to Interns and Consultants as you facilitate the successful completion of project work plans. You’ll identify areas of risk and opportunities to increase efficiency. You’ll strengthen relationships and deepen your abilities to communicate, gain trust, and network with client personnel and professional associates. At the direction of Managers, you may accept responsibility for decision-making in areas including establishing project scope and work plans, project staffing, preparation of deliverables, and application of methodologies.

What Will Help You Be Successful

  • You enjoy process, relevant analytics and metrics, organization, and strategic design.

  • You are motivated to learn and interested in all things related to strategic sourcing and supplier management, including the latest trends and developments.

  • You are passionate about building relationships with clients and providing clients with exceptional experiences.

  • You have an inherent interest in project management and team leadership.

  • You contribute to a positive team culture that fosters open communication among all engagement team members.

  • You create development opportunities for others and ways for your team to improve our clients and communities.

  • You have interest in working with a diverse portfolio of clients across multiple industries.

Do Your Talents Include the Following?

  • Demonstrated experience with:

    • Core supply chain processes such as Strategic Sourcing, Procurement, Contract Management, Supplier Management, Accounts Payable

    • Designing and implementing digital supply chain solutions, applying technologies

    • Traditional technologies that support key supply chain functions, such as Contract Lifecycle Management, Source-to-Pay, Third Party Risk Management/Monitoring.

    • Process improvement, business transformation and project management methodologies (such as Lean, Agile, Change Management etc.)

    • Financial modeling and business case management

  • Evaluating, summarizing, organizing, and interpreting data.

  • Establishing and cultivating business relationships and a professional network.

  • Ability to translate and communicate supply chain topics and issues to client personnel, including executives.

  • Supervisory experience of teams including mentoring, oversight and review of work, coordination across teams, and understanding how to motivate.

  • Experience performing documentation of findings and summarizing recommendations.

Your Educational and Professional Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., Supply Chain, Operations, or Business Related Field).

  • 2+ years working in Supply Chain, Operations, Consulting, or related field, either in industry or professional services.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite applications with specific emphasis on Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Secondary emphasis on Visio, Access, and Tableau / Power BI.

  • Professional Certification such as CPM, CPSM, CSCP, CPIM, PMP, Six Sigma/ Lean Six Sigma, Certified Scrum Professional, are a plus.

Our Hybrid Workplace

Protiviti practices a hybrid model, which is a combination of working in person with a purpose locally, traveling to clients, and working remotely. This model creates meaningful experiences for our people and our clients while offering a flexible environment. The ratio of remote to in-person requirements vary by client, project, team, and other business factors. Our people work both in-person in local Protiviti offices and on client sites, which can include local or out-of-state travel based on our projects and client requests and commitments.

Starting salary is based on a full-time equivalent schedule. Placement in the range is dependent upon experience, skills and geographic work location. Below is the salary range for this job.

$86,000.00 - $129,000.00

Our annual bonus plan provides eligible employees additional cash and/or discretionary stock compensation opportunities. Below is the bonus target opportunity for this job.

10%

The total cash range is estimated from the sum of the base salary range plus the bonus target opportunity. Below is the estimated total cash range for this job.

$94,600.00 - $141,900.00

Employees are eligible for medical, dental, and vision coverages, FSA and HSA healthcare accounts, life and accident insurance, adoption and fertility assistance, paid parental leave up to 10 weeks, and short/long term disability. We offer eligible employees a company 401(k) savings and investment plan with an employer match of 50% on the first 6% of your contributions. We provide Choice Time Off (CTO) for vacation, personal needs, and sick time. The amount of (CTO) varies based on years of service. New hires receive up to 20 days of CTO per calendar year. Protiviti also recognizes up to 11 paid holidays each calendar year.

Learn more about the variety of rewards we offer at Protiviti at .

Any benefits outlined are part of our reward offerings for full-time employees in the U.S. Your Open Enrollment materials, insurance contracts, plan documents and Summary Plan Descriptions together comprise the official plan document which legally governs the administration of your benefit plans. Protiviti reserves the right to terminate or amend your benefit plans in any way and at any time.

Protiviti is an Equal Opportunity Employer. M/F/Disability/Veteran

As part of Protiviti’s employment process, any offer of employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check.

Protiviti is committed to being an equal employment employer offering opportunities to all job seekers, including individuals with disabilities. If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to apply for a position, please contact us by sending an email to HRSolutions@roberthalf.com or call 1.855.744.6947 for assistance.

In your email please include the following:

  • The specific accommodation requested to complete the employment application.

  • The location(s) (city, state) to which you would like to apply.

For positions located in San Francisco, CA: Protiviti will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

For positions located in Los Angeles County, CA: Protiviti will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

Protiviti is not registered to hire or employ personnel in the following states – West Virginia, Alaska.

Protiviti is not licensed or registered as a public accounting firm and does not issue opinions on financial statements or offer attestation services.

title: Spares Documentation Engineer, 9-month fixed-term contract
description:
Job Description

Electrolux Group

At Electrolux, a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.

Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute, and grow together.

Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home.

About the role:

As a Spares Documentation Engineer, you will play a key role in creating, maintaining, and continuously improving spare parts documentation for appliances, ensuring efficient service and repair operations across different product categories. You will be responsible for delivering accurate and high-quality spare parts information that supports after-sales service activities throughout the entire product lifecycle.

The role involves cooperation with the R&A team as well as regular interaction with various stakeholders across the organization. You will contribute to the timely availability of spare parts documentation, support the implementation of documentation standards and processes, and help ensure that service organizations have access to the information required to diagnose, repair, and maintain products effectively. Through your expertise and attention to detail, you will contribute to enhancing service efficiency and customer satisfaction.

This position is a fixed-term contract for a period of 9 months.

What you will do:

  • Monitor changes in production and product development for a range of household appliances, ensuring spares documentation remains accurate and aligned with ongoing product updates.

  • Prepare spare parts lists within defined timelines and quality standards.

  • Create and maintain entries in spares databases, define spare parts, and update electrical diagrams.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure documentation accurately reflects product and production changes.

  • Support the Spares Planning team in optimizing spare parts availability and supply processes.

  • Identify opportunities to improve documentation quality, data accuracy, and ways of working.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of processes that support efficient service operations and a high-quality customer experience.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Ability to confidently interpret technical drawings and electrical diagrams.

  • Experience using graphics editing software.

  • Solid technical understanding of household appliances and their operation.

  • Experience working with technical documentation, product data, or related engineering information.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

  • High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and ownership of work.

  • Proactive and reliable approach to tasks and responsibilities.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build effective working relationships.

  • Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality and accurate information.

  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and business needs.

  • Positive attitude and continuous learning mindset.

Where you'll be:

You will be based in a modern office in Krakow. Our Global Shared Service Center provides services for all companies in the Electrolux Group worldwide. We are dedicated to Global Finance & Accounting, HR Services, IT, Reporting & Analysis CoE, and Product Documentation. We employ almost 1.000 talented people with respect to diversity & inclusion.

Benefits highlights:

  • Swedish working culture and ethics - we’re famous for our friendly work atmosphere and work-life balance

  • Flexible working hours & hybrid work environment (5 days per month from home)

  • Private medical insurance

  • Discounts on our award-winning products

  • Discounted meals in our canteen

  • Worksmile Cafeteria Platform for co-financing of Multisport and/or vouchers

As part of Electrolux, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.

title: Senior OT System Integration Engineer
description:
Sr. OT System Integration Engineer

Location: Kansas City, MO

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Who We Are: Challenge Manufacturing’s mission is to manufacture with operational excellence by empowering our employee-owners. As a leading tier 1 supplier of complex metal assemblies for the global automotive industry, we drive innovative solutions for future mobility. We believe the best ideas come from individual unique perspectives. These ideas combined with the teamwork of industry leaders allow us to accomplish any challenge. Our team members take pride in the work we do and embody our core values of safety, ownership, and teamwork every day; they are the true driving force in our operations.


Challenge is proud to be one of the largest employee-owned automotive companies in North America. One of the many benefits of joining the Challenge team is the ESOP program. This program allows Challenge to give shares of the Company to all employee-owners annually. These shares are an additional retirement benefit that will continue to grow during your time at Challenge. Being part of an ESOP means our employee-owners share in Challenge’s success!


Challenge is #QualityDriven and #PeoplePowered!



Who We Want:

We are seeking an OT Systems Integration Engineer to lead the integration and standardization of OT systems across multiple automotive plants. This role will be the subject matter expert for Ignition SCADA/IIoT platforms, ensuring reliable data flow, cross-site standardization, and operational excellence. You will collaborate with Production, Engineering, IT, and OT teams to drive data-driven decision-making, predictive maintenance, and high-volume production support, while mentoring engineers and setting best practices for OT system integration.

What You Will Do:

  • Lead design, implementation, and optimization of Ignition SCADA/IIoT platforms across multiple plants.
  • Serve as the primary subject matter expert for Ignition, integrating MES, SCADA, IIoT sensors, robotics, and PLC/HMI systems.
  • Establish cross-plant standardization of dashboards, KPIs, alarms, reports, and system configurations.
  • Oversee multi-plant deployment projects for MES/SCADA, IIoT, robotics, and automation systems.
  • Validate, test, and commission system interfaces, ensuring accurate and reliable data exchange.
  • Collaborate with IT to ensure secure OT/IT connectivity, including adherence to cybersecurity standards.
  • Monitor integration KPIs such as uptime, data accuracy, latency, and cross-site consistency.
  • Develop SOPs, documentation, and best practices for standardized Ignition and OT deployment.
  • Mentor and train OT engineers, automation technicians, and plant personnel on Ignition and multi-site OT standards.
  • Lead initiatives to integrate OT data with analytics platforms, predictive maintenance tools, and quality systems.
  • Evaluate emerging OT and Ignition-related technologies and recommend adoption across sites.
  • Support new vehicle program launches and plant expansions with Ignition-based OT system integration.
  • Troubleshoot complex multi-plant system integration and data flow issues, ensuring rapid recovery and minimal production impact.
  • Collaborate with robotics and automation teams for Ignition integration with PLCs, HMIs, and industrial robots.

Required Qualifications:

  • Associates degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Computer, or Industrial Engineering.
  • 3+ years’ experience in industrial OT system integration, SCADA, or IIoT deployments.
  • Expert-level experience with Ignition SCADA/IIoT software, including dashboard development, scripting, alarms, and data integration.
  • Hands-on experience with MES, SCADA, IIoT, PLC/HMI systems, and robotics integration (Fanuc, ABB, Kawasaki, Rockwell).
  • Proven experience in multi-plant standardization and deployment of OT systems.
  • Knowledge of industrial protocols, OT/IT convergence, and cybersecurity standards.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to lead projects, mentor engineers, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 5+ years’ experience in OT/automation system integration within automotive OEMs or Tier 1 suppliers.
  • Experience designing cross-plant dashboards, KPIs, and reporting frameworks in Ignition.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML applications for predictive maintenance and operational optimization.
  • Strong project management skills (PMP, Agile) for multi-site initiatives.
  • Expertise in integration with ERP (e.g., Plex), MES, SCADA, and IIoT systems.
  • Demonstrated success in automotive vehicle launches and high-volume production environments.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedom and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Raytheon Vision Systems is seeking a talented Senior Mixed Signal Design Engineer to join our design team. As part of this team, you will collaborate in a fast-paced multidisciplinary team environment to develop cutting-edge image sensor products. You will participate in mixed-signal ASIC/ROIC development activities with cross-functional teams including chip architecture, specification, design, verification, validation, fabrication, packaging, debugging, test development, failure analysis, and documentation.

This position will be onsite in Goleta, CA.

What You Will Do

  • Design, development, and verification of read-out ICs (ROICs) for visible and infrared focal plane arrays.
  • Evaluate various aspects of the process flow from design to synthesis, place and route, timing and power use.
  • Determine architecture design, logic design, and system simulation and define module interfaces for simulation.
  • Design mixed-signal integrated circuits for image sensors, including analog signal chain, digital timing and image processing, and low-power 12 – 14 bit on-chip analog to digital converters (ADCs).
  • Guide the successful completion of major design tasks and may function in a project leadership role, which can include technical leadership, budget, schedule, and metrics tracking

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) with a minimum of 5 years of prior relevant experience or an Advanced Degree in a related field and a minimum of 3 years of experience.
  • Experience with full-custom CMOS Integrated Circuit (IC) design at the transistor level using IC Design Flows and tools.
  • Experience with CAD tools such as Cadence and Mentor Graphics (Siemens), with analysis and programming tools such as MATLAB, and with computer programming or scripting languages such as Python.
  • Experience with high-end UNIX based software design tools for circuit simulation and analysis such as noise analysis and for physical design, automation, and verification.
  • Modelling experience with System Verilog/Real Modelling/Verilog AMS and coding synthesizable RTL.

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Advanced digital design skills such as experience with Conformal, experience with Digital-on-top mixed-signal design flow including utilization of Innovus for final chip construction, and experience writing behavioral models for digital circuits and analog/mixed signal interfaces and circuits.
  • Experience with certain IP and circuit blocks such as LVDS transmitters and receivers, low noise and low power amplifiers, ADC design, PLL/Transmitter design and radiation and cryogenic tolerant design techniques.
  • Familiarity with ROIC architecture, design concepts, operational control and timing, with prior experience successfully executing quick turn developments for commercial, defense, and/or space industries.
  • Knowledge of semiconductor device physics, semiconductor processing, physical design (including the ability to perform hand layout of critical analog & mixed-signal circuits) and testing.

What We Offer

  • Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.
  • This position is relocation eligible.

title: Associate, Electrical
description:
This strategy is key to the WSP in India Buildings Mechanical Electrical Public Health (MEP) business as we position ourselves to address the challenges of a changing global economy. The role is the cornerstone of the establishment of a MEP Design Capacity in Noida working and adhering to WSP Global standards and promoting technical excellence, in addition to creating and building a team. This will involve recruiting, leading, developing a team of Engineers over a relatively short period of time. The successful candidate will stimulate and manage significant growth in a technically demanding environment to time, cost and quality targets. Cultural awareness, an open mind and excellent communication skills are essential requirements for the role.

A major element of this role is to liaise with the WSP in India design teams to ensure that the following essential elements of the role are satisfactorily completed: -

  • Agree and confirm the project brief to anticipate and identify needs and expectations in conjunction with others.
  • Agree the project deliverables and programme.
  • Agree the resource in India that will be required to undertake the designs to complete the project brief in time and cost.
  • Agree the project fees according to brief, resource required and programme.
  • Be responsible for the quality of detailed design to WSP in India and Global Building Regulations standards ensuring technical reviews and sign off including complex calculations and co-ordination issues.
  • Ensure design are co-ordinated and due consideration of Health & Safety, Construction Design Management and Quality Assurance standards.
  • Regularly communicate and update the local Indian and wider Global project teams on programme delivery and quality issues through use of staff utilisation charts and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) reporting etc.
  • Review outputs of Computer Aided Design analysis, and determine additional levels of checking needed.
  • Where necessary, development of energy strategies incorporating renewable technologies and low energy designs to satisfy local authority planning requirements and compliance with Building Regulations Part L.
  • Inform the Commercial Director of Professional Indemnity issues in line with WSP in India policy.
  • Ensure all company standards & efficient working practices are adopted.
  • Maintain an overview & understanding of the team workload & associated resource requirements, and work with other team leaders to ensure resources are fully utilised, identify & address effectively any surplus or shortfall in available staff
  • The successful candidate will be a dynamic self-motivated individual who will take on a Leadership role in project work, focused on delivery to the client and technical excellence.
  • The role requires management of a number of projects and becoming involved in design at an early stage.
  • The role includes management of fees, invoicing, project-resource management, mentoring and coaching junior members of the team. The ability to plan and design deliverables against British Engineering standards for each stage of a project is a pre-requisite.
  • The role will include a short term secondment to the to visit some of the key WSP in India offices and WSP in India personnel to better understand WSP in India as a business and to assist with acclimatisation to the WSP in India methods of working.
  • Lead the design process, set clear goals and monitor their progress closely and encourage the rest of the team to deliver appropriate and cost effective solutions to the agreed programme; support those more inexperienced by technical review, mentoring and advice.
  • Lead from the front accepting design challenges and giving them due consideration with the support of others to achieve resolution.

Establishment and growth of GCC

  • Responsible for the recruitment of the design team, in liaison with the Head of GCC
  • Contribute to the design of operational processes, systems and measures
  • Working with Support Services, the local resources and the other disciplines to ensure that all hardware, software, workspace and IT infrastructure is in place
  • Provide the technical training, mentoring and support to members of the new team, ensuring that the team is capable in the use of the required standards, processes and software tools at the earliest opportunity.
  • Provide highly visible, inspirational leadership and direction for the emerging Buildings team, ensuring the Noida based team feel part of the wider team
  • Liaise with the established leadership of the GCC facility across the globe.
  • Promote WSP in India Vision and Values - see below.
  • Support and promote team work within the team, and the wider business

Technical and Project Management

  • Raise the level of technical competence within the teams
  • Implement delivery and quality measurement processes
  • Agree Key Performance Indicators (KPI s) with the Head of GCC monitoring and regularly reporting. Identify and implement improvements to increase KPIs accordingly
  • Promote technical excellence in all our projects
  • Undertake technical reviews and contribute to the concept design
  • Provide continuous feedback to the Head of GCC on the effectiveness of the protocols and processes in place with a view to continuous improvement

Commercial

  • Implement the project delivery systems and structures
  • Support management of resource requirements versus project requirements
  • Support liaison with UK business to drive up utilisation of GCC team
  • Support and advise UK on implementation of GCC within fee bid
  • The applicant will have proven experience in the design of Building Services with significant experience in a similar role or demonstration of a good track record.
  • The applicant will have proven experience in the design of Engineering Building Services.
  • Must be conversant with technical mechanical or electrical software, such as IES, Amtech, Hevacomp, Relux and Dialux.
  • A sound understanding of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, Project is essential.
  • Must be fluent in English with an excellent understanding of technical terminology.
  • A sound understanding of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and project is essential.
  • Must be fluent in English with an excellent understanding of technical terminology.
  • The applicant should ideally have obtained British Chartered Engineer status or equivalent, possess a degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering and possess membership to an accredited engineering body.

BGV:

  • Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.

  • Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Pricing Actuary
description:
Job Summary

IGI is has a global underwriting presence. This role will:
• Report to the Head of Pricing
• Work with Underwriters based in all of IGI’s offices providing Actuarial review of Underwriting Submissions
• Develop Underwriting Pricing Tools
• Develop, monitor and enhance Underwriting Key Performance Indicators
• Report on and evolve rate monitoring

The role has a strong mandate from both underwriters and senior management.

This role will share ideas, initiatives, methodologies, techniques with the Group Chief Actuary, Pricing Actuaries and wider Actuarial team, as well as working closely with the respective underwriting teams, underwriting operations and Senior Management.

This role is based in London with occasional travel to other offices, particularly Amman (Jordan).

Job Description

Company Description

IGI - International General Insurance Co. Ltd. is a leading international specialist commercial insurer and reinsurer with a global portfolio of Energy, Property, Construction & Engineering, Ports & Terminals, Marine, Financial Institutions, General Aviation, Professional Indemnity, Casualty, Directors’ and Officers’, Legal Expenses, Political Violence, Contingency and Treaty Reinsurance. Registered in Bermuda as a limited liability company, with operational headquarters in Amman, Jordan and offices in London, Malta, Bermuda, Norway, Dubai, Kuala Lumpur and Casablanca, we aim to deliver outstanding levels of service to our clients and brokers.

Key Responsibilities

Technical

  • Submissions: Work with underwriters to provide actuarial analysis of relevant submissions.

  • Deep dive: Work with Senior Management on Performance Management to identify well and poorly performing niches, emerging risks and desirable movements in risk profile. Identification and recommendation of remedial actions and/or changes to process.

  • Processes: Augment existing underwriting processes with actuarial and data science perspectives that are timely and commercial. Continuously improve.

  • Augmentation of data: Develop optimal use of submission data, facilitate identification and capture of external information (web, commercial provider, broker…). Develop databases of exposure and claims information where these will provide valuable perspective of profitability, frequency and/or severity.

  • Innovation: Use all available and emerging sources of data and tools to evolve dashboards and pricing tools.

  • Development of Rating Tools:

  • Develop new and evolve existing rating tools and processes.
  • Where these are not already on one of the rater platforms; develop stand-alone and/or Proof-of-Concept raters (in conjunction with underwriters and the Pricing Model and Rating Tool Actuary).
  • Raters are implemented on hX’s Python/Json/Java rating platform.

  • Parameterisation of Rating Tools: Work closely with Underwriters, Pricing Actuaries, Pricing Model and Rating Process Actuary and Actuarial Reporting Team to parameterise tools.

  • Rate Change:

  • Report on and evolve the rate change process.
  • Optimise and embed use of rate change outputs in other areas such as reserving and business planning.

  • Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports to monitor price adequacy, portfolio metrics and support data-driven decision-making.

  • Thought leadership: Identify emerging opportunities, including but not limited to; business areas, tools and methodologies (actuarial, data science, engineering, statistical etc…) and information. Develop influence with decision-makers.

  • Reserving and Capital: Work closely with reserving and capital actuaries to feed in and take out the relevant shared insight and models

Relationships

  • Essential to develop excellent working relationships with Underwriters and Management.

  • Work closely with Underwriters, Group Chief Actuary, Head of Pricing, Actuarial, Risk Management and Reinsurance teams.

  • Will require presentation to and sharing of ideas, analysis and findings with Underwriters and Management.

  • Frequent interaction with Brokers.

Professional

  • All work should be compliant, and documented in accordance, with Professional and Technical Actuarial standards.

Leadership

  • This role models the IGI corporate values of Integrity, Genuine and Innovative, ensuring own and other team members’ behaviours and ways of working respect and mirror these values.

Key Attributes & Professional Qualifications

  • Nearly or newly qualified actuary with 3+ years of Property/Casualty experience, at least 18 months of which within Pricing Specialty Lines.

  • A bachelor’s degree

  • Excellent verbal and written communications skills and the ability to work in a multicultural environment

  • Creative, innovative, logical thinking and great attention to detail

  • Ability to think strategically, proactively and commercially

  • Experience of working with and constructively challenging underwriters

  • Good knowledge of Power BI or other business intelligence and visualisation tools

  • Knowledge of programming languages (at least VBA, ideally Python or R, knowledge of SQL and/or Access).

  • Ability to exploit emerging tools to enhance processes

  • Self-motivated and solutions-oriented

Conduct Rules

SMCR was introduced by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), includes a set of Conduct Rules that apply to most employees in UK financial services firms. These rules aim to improve individual accountability and promote a healthy culture across the industry.

Individual Conduct Rules

These are the core five rules that apply to all employees

  • Act with integrity

  • Act with due skill, care and diligence

  • Be open and cooperative with the FCA, PRA, and other regulators

  • Pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly

  • Observe proper standards of market conduct

title: Chicago Internal Audit & Financial Advisory Senior Consultant
description:
JOB REQUISITION

Chicago Internal Audit & Financial Advisory Senior Consultant

LOCATION

CHICAGO

ADDITIONAL LOCATION(S)

JOB DESCRIPTION

You Belong Here

The Protiviti Career provides opportunity to learn, inspire, and advance within a collaborative and inclusive culture. We hire curious individuals for whom learning is a passion. We lean into our mission: We Care. We Collaborate. We Deliver.

At every level, we champion leaders who live our values of integrity, inclusion, innovation, and commitment to success. Imagining our work as a journey, we believe integrity guides our way, inclusion moves us forward together, innovation creates new destinations, and our commitment to success empowers us to deliver on our vision to be the most trusted global consulting firm.

Where We Need You:

Protiviti is looking for an Internal Audit & Financial Advisory Senior Consultant to join our growing team.

What You Can Expect:

As a Senior Consultant, you will be a mentor, trainer, and coach to Interns and Consultants as you facilitate the successful completion of project work plans. You’ll identify areas of risk and opportunities to increase efficiency. You’ll strengthen relationships and deepen your abilities to communicate, gain trust, and network with client personnel and professional associates. At the direction of Managers, you may accept responsibility for decision-making in areas including establishing project scope and work plans, project staffing, preparation of deliverables, and application of methodologies.

What Will Help You Be Successful:

  • You enjoy identifying areas of business and process risk, and opportunities to improve efficiency, increase performance, and help clients manage risk.

  • You are motivated to learn and interested in all things related to internal audit and business processes, including the latest trends and developments.

  • You are passionate about building relationships with clients and providing clients with exceptional experiences.

  • You have an inherent interest in project management and team leadership.

  • You contribute to a positive team culture that fosters open communication among all engagement team members.

  • You create development opportunities for others and ways for your team to improve our clients and communities.

  • You have interest in working with a diverse portfolio of clients across multiple industries.

  • You are versed in leveraging AI to enhance personal productivity as well as internal audit and SOX activities, including planning, fieldwork and reporting.

Do Your Talents Include the Following?

Experience with or understanding of:

  • Audit methodologies and developing important internal audit deliverables, including process flows, work programs, audit reports, and control summaries.

  • Risk and control programs.

  • Business processes such as Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Inventory, Revenue with knowledge of accounting operations and/or financial frameworks.

  • Commonly used International Professional Practices Framework, including COSO and PCAOB.

  • Sarbanes-Oxley Act provisions and methodologies for achieving compliance.

  • The Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA’s) code of ethics and compliance requirements.

  • Evaluating, summarizing, organizing, and interpreting data.

  • Establishing and cultivating business relationships and a professional network.

  • Ability to translate and communicate risk topics and audit issues to client personnel, including executives.

  • Supervisory experience of teams including mentoring, oversight and review of work, coordination across teams, and understanding how to motivate.

  • Experience performing documentation of findings and summarizing recommendations.

  • You are versed in leveraging AI to enhance personal productivity as well as internal audit and SOX activities, including planning, fieldwork and reporting.

Your Educational and Professional Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., Accounting, Finance, or business-related field).

  • 2+ years working in internal audit, consulting, assurance services, risk and control programs, or related field, either in professional services or industry.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite applications with specific emphasis on Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Secondary emphasis on Visio and Access.

  • Professional Certification such as CPA, CIA, or similar preferred.

Our Hybrid Workplace

Protiviti practices a hybrid model, which is a combination of working in person with a purpose and working remotely. This model creates meaningful experiences for our people and our clients while offering a flexible environment. The ratio of remote to in-person requirements varies by client, project, team, and other business factors. Our people work both in-person in local Protiviti offices and on client sites, which can include local or out-of-state travel based on our projects and client requests and commitments.

Starting salary is based on a full-time equivalent schedule. Placement in the range is dependent upon experience, skills and geographic work location. Below is the salary range for this job.

$84,000.00 - $126,000.00

Our annual bonus plan provides eligible employees additional cash and/or discretionary stock compensation opportunities. Below is the bonus target opportunity for this job.

10%

The total cash range is estimated from the sum of the base salary range plus the bonus target opportunity. Below is the estimated total cash range for this job.

$92,400.00 - $138,600.00

Employees are eligible for medical, dental, and vision coverages, FSA and HSA healthcare accounts, life and accident insurance, adoption and fertility assistance, paid parental leave up to 10 weeks, and short/long term disability. We offer eligible employees a company 401(k) savings and investment plan with an employer match of 50% on the first 6% of your contributions. We provide Choice Time Off (CTO) for vacation, personal needs, and sick time. The amount of (CTO) varies based on years of service. New hires receive up to 20 days of CTO per calendar year. Protiviti also recognizes up to 11 paid holidays each calendar year.

title: Sr Software Engineer - BIOS, AWS Hardware Engineering, Firmware Development
description:
The AWS BIOS Engineering team creates and maintains custom firmware solutions for Amazon's innovative server platforms. Our BIOS/UEFI implementations are industry-leading in security, performance, and operational excellence, and are critical to the success of AWS's massive-scale infrastructure that millions of customers rely on daily. Our BIOS engineers solve complex firmware challenges and build robust, secure bootloader solutions that enable AWS to maintain its competitive edge in data center infrastructure.

The ideal candidate will be a senior firmware engineer with 7+ years of hands-on embedded or BIOS/UEFI development experience. You will bring deep expertise in x86 platform architecture, secure boot implementations, and low-level system programming. You will have a track record of leading complex firmware projects end-to-end and collaborating with silicon vendors on platform bring-up and reference code integration. You will gain intimate understanding of AWS's custom server firmware stack and analyze it for both current needs and future scalability. You will leverage your system-level expertise to find optimal solutions to complex boot-time challenges. You will collaborate with internal teams (hardware, validation, security) and external partners (silicon vendors, ODMs) while leading critical firmware development efforts.

What you will do:

- Design and implement custom UEFI/BIOS features for AWS server platforms
- Debug complex firmware issues using tools like ITP, ScanTool, and JTAG
- Optimize boot time performance and platform initialization sequences
- Implement secure boot mechanisms and firmware security features
- Develop and maintain Power-On Self Test (POST) code
- Create firmware update mechanisms and recovery solutions
- Work with hardware teams on board bring-up and platform validation

Why it matters:

AWS's custom server platforms require specialized firmware solutions that maximize performance, security, and reliability at scale. Your BIOS developments will directly impact millions of servers running in AWS data centers worldwide, requiring unique optimizations that benefit our infrastructure and customers.

Why you will love it:

- Work on cutting-edge server platforms and next-generation silicon
- Direct impact on AWS infrastructure efficiency and security
- Ownership of critical firmware components from design through deployment
- Collaboration with industry leaders in data center infrastructure
- Access to advanced hardware labs and debug equipment
- Opportunity to influence future server architecture decisions
- Work with a team of experienced firmware engineers
- Join our diverse engineering organization where you'll help deliver the firmware foundation for AWS's global infrastructure. You'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes innovative ideas and empowers you to own complex technical challenges through to completion.

Key job responsibilities
UEFI/BIOS Development:
- Develop and maintain UEFI/BIOS code for server platforms
- Implement ACPI tables and power management features
- Create and maintain Platform Reference Code (PRC)
- Debug complex firmware issues using ITP, and JTAG tools

ODM/OEM Collaboration:
- Work directly with ODM partners
- Coordinate BIOS development efforts
- Review and validate ODM-provided BIOS code
- Support manufacturing bring-up and validation

Platform Integration:
- Interface with CPU/GPU vendors (Intel, AMD and Nvidia) for new platform bring-up
- Integrate and rebase Reference Code packages
- Support system validation and debugging

Leadership Responsibilities:
- Provide technical leadership in advanced features
- Mentor junior BIOS engineers
- Review technical specifications and design documents
- Lead architecture discussions and technical planning
- Establish coding standards and best practices

Project Management:
- Coordinate between international teams (US and Taiwan)
- Track project timelines and deliverables
- Interface with product management and customer teams

Ecosystem Management:
- Maintain relationships with silicon vendors
- Participate in industry forums and standards bodies
- Keep up with emerging technologies and industry trends

About the team
"*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional."

description:
TEE JAYS søger tekstilkonstruktør / Product Developer 
       
  
        Send din ansøgning

        
      
   
         
  
  
 
       
 




       
 VÆR MED TIL AT UDVIKLE NÆSTE GENERATION AF PREMIUM APPAREL 


 Hos TEE JAYS udvikler vi produkter, der skal sætte standarden i det europæiske premium B2B-marked. Vores ambition er, at hver style skal sætte standarden i sin kategori - med fokus på kvalitet, pasform, materialer og de detaljer, der gør forskellen. Vi søger en Tekstilkonstruktør / Product Developer med stærke kompetencer inden for konstruktion, pasform og teknisk produktudvikling kombineret med en veludviklet æstetisk sans.
 Du motiveres af at videreudvikle og forfine produkter, hvor kvalitet, funktionalitet og design går op i en højere enhed. Du få en central del af udviklingen af vores kollektioner og får ansvar for både den tekniske kvalitet og den løbende optimering af vores produkter. 


 OM TEE JAYS 


 TEE JAYS A/S er en danskejet tekstilvirksomhed med mere end 50 års erfaring inden for kvalitetsbeklædning til B2B-markedet. Vi samarbejder med nogle af Europas største distributører og førende detailkæder i Skandinavien. Vi udvikler bæredygtige produkter gennem vores Signature Collection til Corporate Wear og UNLABELED Studio til merchandise og private label. Vores fokus er kompromisløs kvalitet, gennemtænkte løsninger og lang levetid. Hovedkontoret ligger i Svenstrup ved Aalborg med ca. 60 medarbejdere. 


 STILLINGEN 


 Du bliver en nøglespiller i udviklingen af Tee Jays’ kollektioner og refererer til Head of Purchasing.
 Du får ansvar for at sikre, at vores produkter lever op til de høje kvalitetskrav - fra konstruktion og pasform til det færdige produkt.
 Vi udvikler årligt 10-15 nye styles og arbejder samtidig målrettet med løbende produktforbedringer af vores NOOS-kollektion.
 Stillingen indebærer 1-2 rejser årligt til leverandører i Asien samt deltagelse på relevante messer. 


  


 DINE PRIMÆRE ARBEJDSOPGAVER 


 • Konstruktion, pasformsudvikling og grading. 


 • Udarbejdelse og vedligeholdelse af målskemaer, arbejdstegninger og produktdokumentation. 


 • Vedligeholdelse af tech packs. 


 • Gennemgang og godkendelse af udviklings-, size set- og produktionsprøver. 


 • Kvalitetssikring af materialer, konstruktion, trims og finish. 


 • Teknisk dialog med leverandører. 


 • Videreudvikling af eksisterende styles samt udvikling af nye produkter og detaljer. 


 DIN PROFIL 


 Du har erfaring med teknisk produktudvikling og en stærk forståelse for konstruktion, pasform og materialer. Du 


 arbejder detaljeorienteret og har sans for produkter med høj kvalitet og et eksklusivt udtryk. 


 VI FORESTILLER OS, AT DU: 


 • Har minimum 3-5 års relevant erfaring. 


 • Er uddannet tekstilkonstruktør, Product Developer eller tilsvarende. 


 • Har erfaring med konstruktion, grading og teknisk produktudvikling. 


 • Behersker Adobe Illustrator. 


 • Taler og skriver dansk og engelsk. 


 • Erfaring med asiatiske leverandører er en fordel. 


 Som person er du kvalitetsbevidst, struktureret, selvstændig og en stærk samarbejdspartner. 


 VI TILBYDER 


 Et spændende job med stor indflydelse på kollektionsudviklingen, korte beslutningsveje, høj faglighed, gode udviklingsmuligheder og en attraktiv lønpakke i en uformel og ambitiøs organisation. 


 ANSØGNING 


 Send din ansøgning og CV til gitte@teejays.dk mærket "Tekstilkonstruktør / Product Developer".

title: AI Adoption & Enablement Lead
location: Spring, Texas, United States of America
description:
AI Adoption & Enablement LeadThis role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

Responsibilities:

  • Own and lead the AI adoption and enablement strategy for Quote-to-Cash transformation initiatives, ensuring every AI use case, pilot, and scaled deployment has a clear change approach, defined stakeholder engagement model, user readiness plan, communication strategy, training path, and measurable adoption outcome.
  • Translate AI transformation priorities into practical adoption roadmaps that define impacted user groups, business process changes, role-level behavior shifts, readiness milestones, adoption risks, communications touchpoints, learning activities, and reinforcement mechanisms required to drive sustained usage.
  • Partner closely with business leaders, product owners, PMO, UX designers, technology teams, process owners, operations stakeholders, data teams, change champions, and external partners to embed adoption requirements from ideation through design, pilot, launch, stabilization, and scaled deployment.
  • Develop and manage comprehensive change management plans, including stakeholder impact assessments, persona-based engagement plans, change networks, communications calendars, readiness checklists, training schedules, manager toolkits, feedback mechanisms, and adoption measurement frameworks.
  • Design and deliver role-based enablement programs that may include learning journeys, user guides, process playbooks, training materials, demos, FAQs, office hours, adoption clinics, manager briefings, knowledge articles, and reusable content that helps users understand, trust, and consistently apply AI-enabled workflows.
  • Establish, activate, and sustain champion networks, super-user communities, peer-learning groups, and communities of practice to accelerate awareness, reinforce new ways of working, surface user feedback, and create local advocacy for AI-enabled process change.
  • Create targeted communications and storytelling assets that explain the purpose, value, impact, and responsible use of AI solutions in clear, compelling language for different audiences, including frontline users, managers, business sponsors, transformation teams, and senior leaders.
  • Define, monitor, and report adoption metrics, readiness indicators, training completion, usage trends, user sentiment, behavior-change signals, feedback themes, support needs, and benefit-realization inputs to evaluate whether AI solutions are being adopted and delivering intended business value.
  • Identify adoption barriers, resistance patterns, capability gaps, process concerns, user experience issues, and change risks early; work with delivery, UX, business, and leadership teams to recommend corrective actions, targeted interventions, additional enablement, or escalation where required.
  • Support leadership reviews, SteerCo forums, adoption governance meetings, transformation updates, and decision boards by preparing concise adoption summaries, readiness status, change risks, user feedback, training progress, success stories, and recommended decisions or actions.
  • Capture and communicate user stories, measurable outcomes, lessons learned, testimonials, adoption insights, and examples of improved ways of working to build confidence in AI-enabled transformation and support broader organizational momentum.
  • Drive continuous improvement in adoption and enablement practices by standardizing reusable templates, playbooks, governance rhythms, feedback loops, communication patterns, training assets, and measurement approaches across AI Q2C initiatives.
  • Provide guidance, coaching, and mentoring to workstream leads, change representatives, trainers, and less-experienced team members to strengthen change management discipline, stakeholder engagement, communication quality, and outcome-based adoption execution.

Education and Experience Required:

  • First level university degree or advanced degree preferred.
  • Overall experience of 8+ years of which at least 3+ years of experience in change management or in like roles/businesses.
  • Prosci Certified preferred

Knowledge, Skills, and Competencies:

  • Extensive experience in change management, adoption strategy, enablement, learning and development, transformation communications, or business readiness for complex cross-functional programs involving multiple stakeholder groups, business functions, and delivery teams.
  • Strong understanding of structured change management methods such as Prosci, ADKAR, or similar frameworks, with the ability to apply these methods pragmatically to enterprise transformation, digital workflow change, AI solution adoption, and operational behavior change.
  • Demonstrated ability to create and manage adoption artifacts such as stakeholder impact assessments, change plans, communication calendars, training plans, readiness checklists, persona maps, champion network plans, adoption dashboards, feedback logs, and reinforcement plans.
  • Experience designing and delivering enablement programs for diverse user groups, including role-based learning journeys, user guides, manager toolkits, office hours, demos, FAQs, process playbooks, and other learning assets that support practical usage and sustained adoption.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex AI, process, technology, and transformation topics into clear, audience-specific messages for frontline users, managers, senior leaders, business sponsors, and cross-functional partners.
  • Strong storytelling and executive communication capability, including the ability to create concise leadership updates, adoption summaries, SteerCo materials, change narratives, success stories, and decision points that clearly communicate progress, risks, user impact, and required actions.
  • Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, and influencing skills, with the ability to build trust, manage resistance, align competing priorities, facilitate workshops, engage change champions, and build consensus across matrixed business, technology, operations, and leadership teams.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to define adoption KPIs, measure training effectiveness, interpret usage data, assess readiness, identify adoption barriers, synthesize user feedback, and connect change-management insights to business outcomes and benefit realization.
  • Business transformation acumen with the ability to understand end-to-end Quote-to-Cash or similar enterprise processes, operational pain points, user personas, workflow changes, stakeholder needs, and the impact of AI, automation, data, and digital tools on ways of working.
  • Working knowledge of AI-enabled solution delivery, responsible AI adoption, digital transformation, process redesign, user experience considerations, change reinforcement, and experience-led delivery; direct experience supporting AI, automation, or workflow transformation programs is preferred.
  • Experience working with collaboration, planning, and communication tools such as Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, PowerPoint, Excel, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Jira, Azure DevOps, learning platforms, survey tools, or similar systems used to manage change activities, training, feedback, and reporting.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a large matrixed organization with limited ambiguity, demonstrating ownership, sound judgment, attention to detail, proactive follow-through, and the discipline to maintain momentum across planning, execution, communication, reinforcement, and outcome tracking.
  • Strong coaching and mentoring capability, with the ability to guide workstream leads, trainers, change representatives, and less-experienced team members in adoption planning, stakeholder engagement, communication quality, and measurable change execution.

What We Can Offer You:

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

title: Senior Specialist, Engagement & Organization Development, APAC SA&I
description:
We are looking for a passionate and experienced professional with a background in Organization Development, Employee Engagement, Learning & Development, and Change Management who is energized by helping organizations and people thrive.

You are a strong communicator, relationship builder, and project manager who can partner effectively with leaders across functions, markets, and cultures. You are equally comfortable developing engagement strategies, driving organizational development initiatives, facilitating change, managing business projects, analyzing data, and translating business priorities into compelling employee communications.

You will play a key role in shaping the employee experience and supporting the evolution of the SA&I organization as it transforms into a growth-oriented, solutions-focused, and AI-enabled organization.

This role operates with the scope, visibility, and stakeholder engagement typically associated with a Manager to Senior Manager-level individual contributor.

Role Purpose

The Senior Specialist, Engagement & Organization Development will lead our ongoing efforts to create a great place to work and build a future-ready organization across the Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams within the APAC Strategic Analytics & Insights (SA&I) business.

As SA&I evolves towards a more growth-oriented, solutions-focused, and AI-enabled future, much of the transformation will be driven through how we serve clients and deliver value. With Customer Success playing a central role in leading this change, this position will help leaders and teams build the capabilities, culture, and ways of working needed to support the future of the organization.

The role, based in Malaysia, reports directly to the Customer Success Leader, SA&I APAC, and works closely with the SA&I Leadership Team, HR Business Partners, and functional leaders across the region.

Employee Engagement & Learning

  • Partner with business leaders and HR Business Partners to implement employee engagement, learning and development, and organization development initiatives aligned with business priorities to engage, develop, and retain talent.
  • Provide data-driven input before, during, and after implementation to measure effectiveness and drive continuous improvement.
  • Serve as the key point of contact for employee engagement activities, initiatives, campaigns, and events.
  • Support leaders and HR in identifying capability gaps and learning needs.

Internal Communications & Change Enablement

  • Own internal communications for employee engagement, learning, organization development, and transformation initiatives.
  • Create communication and engagement plans to drive awareness, participation, and adoption of key initiatives.
  • Develop and manage the annual engagement and communications calendar.
  • Support leadership communications, including town halls, business updates, and employee forums.

Workforce Planning & Organizational Effectiveness

  • Support workforce planning activities by assessing current and future talent and capability needs.
  • Analyze workforce and engagement data to provide insights and recommendations.
  • Support initiatives that improve organizational effectiveness, employee experience, and workforce readiness.

Key Transformation Initiatives

  • Support the execution of key transformation initiatives, e.g. Future of Customer Success, including capability building, AI adoption, and new ways of working.
  • Develop project plans, track progress, and coordinate stakeholders to ensure successful execution.
  • Prepare updates and recommendations for leadership teams

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, Human Resources, Organizational Development, Communications, Psychology, or equivalent business experience. Qualifications in Human Resources or Organization Development are an advantage.
  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Employee Engagement, Organization Development, Learning & Development, Internal Communications, Change Management, HR Programs, Project Management, or related disciplines.
  • Experience working in a regional or cross-market environment.
  • Experience implementing people initiatives aligned with organizational strategy and business goals.
  • Knowledge of HR and Organization Development best practices is an advantage.
  • Ability to use data, conduct analysis, generate insights, and support data-driven decision-making.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders at different levels of the organization.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Ability to work independently and navigate ambiguity in a dynamic and evolving environment.
  • AI proficiency, Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel and Powerpoint

Our Benefits

  • Flexible working environment
  • Volunteer time off
  • LinkedIn Learning
  • Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)

title: Sr. Observability Engineer – Grafana & Prometheus
description:
This role is part of the large-scale integration modernization program, focused on migrating WebMethods-based integrations to AWS-native architecture. The engineer will design and implement a centralized observability platform leveraging AWS Managed Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, and OpenTelemetry across APIs, messaging, MFT, and SAP integrations.
The engineer will contribute to building unified dashboards, SLA monitoring, and AI-driven alerting to provide real-time insights into system health, integration flows, and business KPIs. The role is critical to ensuring reliability, troubleshooting efficiency, and operational intelligence across ~100M monthly transactions and ~1,500 flows.

Observability Platform Engineering

  • Set up and manage Prometheus (metrics collection) and Grafana dashboards (AWS Managed Services)
  • Build and maintain AWS-native observability platform including metrics, logs, and traces using CloudWatch, X-Ray, and OTEL instrumentation
  • Implement instrumentation across APIs, messaging, MFT, and batch integrations for end-to-end visibility

Monitoring & Dashboards

  • Monitor application and infrastructure performance across AWS integration estate
  • Create dashboards for KPIs, system health, SLA tracking, and integration performance
  • Develop master dashboards covering API performance, messaging queues, infra health, and integration status

Alerting & Reliability

  • Configure alerts, thresholds, and proactive monitoring frameworks
  • Enable AI-driven alerting and anomaly detection integrated with ITSM tools
  • Support high availability and reliability through proactive observability practices

Troubleshooting & Operations

  • Support troubleshooting using metrics, logs, traces, and dashboards
  • Provide deep visibility into payload tracking, error handling, and integration health
  • Enable root cause analysis and faster resolution through observability insights

Standardization & Best Practices

  • Establish monitoring standards, observability patterns, and dashboard blueprints
  • Implement structured logging, correlation IDs, and traceability across distributed systems
  • Contribute to observability maturity including automated alerts, runbooks, and analytics

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Strong experience with Grafana and Prometheus
  • Experience setting up monitoring dashboards, alerts, and observability pipelines
  • Basic knowledge of AWS cloud services (CloudWatch, X-Ray, etc.)
  • Solid understanding of monitoring, logging, and alerting concepts
  • Good troubleshooting and analytical skills

Good to Have

  • Knowledge of OpenTelemetry (OTEL) instrumentation
  • Exposure to Kubernetes/EKS monitoring
  • Familiarity with integration monitoring (APIs, messaging, batch flows)
  • Understanding of AI-driven observability and anomaly detection concepts
  • Experience in enterprise integration and cloud modernization programs preferred

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field
  • 8–12 years of experience

Job Description

About Centric Software:

Centric Software® is a global leader, providing an innovative and AI-enabled product-concept-to-commercialization platform for retailers, brands and manufacturers of all sizes. We equip retail, fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home and consumer goods brands with pioneering best-of-breed solutions to plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, sell and replenish products. Our technology powers brands to streamline processes, drive efficiency and operate with confidence in an ever-changing market.

Our story is one of rapid growth, bold ideas and extraordinary opportunities. We’re here to challenge the status quo—and we’re looking for brilliant people who want to do the same. No matter where you are in the world, this is your chance to be part of something exceptional.

Job title: Cloud Principal Engineer

Location: Anywhere in US / Remote

Experience level: 5 Years

Compensation: Negotiable

Role Summary

We are building a new Cloud Engineering function to modernize our platform, improve infrastructure economics, and increase delivery reliability across AWS, Azure, and limited GCP workloads.

The Cloud Principal Engineer will work in define the cloud strategy and execution model, build the initial team, and deliver measurable business outcomes across cost optimization, platform standardization, observability modernization, and application modernization.

Why This Role Exists

Our current environment is operational but fragmented across deployment patterns and cloud operations workflows. This role exists to create a single execution backbone that aligns engineering work with business priorities:

  • Infrastructure cost reduction and waste elimination.

  • Standardized, scalable Kubernetes-based platform foundations.

  • Simplified and cost-aware observability strategy.

  • Automation-first operations for non-production controls.

  • Application modernization toward stateless, Linux-aligned deployment patterns.

Business Objectives This Role Owns

  • Drive cloud cost optimization initiatives from audit to remediation execution.

  • Lead platform direction for managed Kubernetes in a multi-cloud operating model.

  • Lead migration programs such as Kafka to Kafka-as-a-Service and ARM adoption.

  • Establish decision framework and rollout plan for Datadog alternatives.

  • Implementation of governance and automation for non-production shutdown schedules.

  • Partner with application teams to enable stateless architecture transitions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Work in Defining the cloud engineering operating model and role boundaries across DevOps, Cloud Ops, and R&D teams.

  • Build and mentor the initial cloud engineering team and hire pipeline.

  • Prioritize roadmap initiatives into quarterly execution plans with clear owners and milestones.

  • Establish platform and automation standards for infrastructure provisioning, CI/CD integration, security controls, and reliability.

  • Lead cross-functional programs that require coordinated cloud, platform, and application changes.

  • Ensure decisions are evidence-driven with transparent measurement and reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years in cloud/platform engineering, SRE, or infrastructure leadership roles.

  • 3+ years leading cross-functional technical programs with direct business impact.

  • Strong hands-on depth in at least two of the following: Kubernetes platforms, cloud infrastructure automation, cost optimization, observability, CI/CD systems.

  • Experience across AWS and Azure in production environments.

  • Proven ability to translate business goals into technical roadmap execution.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Technical Skills

  • Managed Kubernetes platforms: EKS and/or AKS architecture and operations.

  • Infrastructure as Code: strong hands-on depth in Terraform or OpenTofu or Pulumi.

  • Cloud automation and scripting: Python and/or TypeScript for workflow and operations automation.

  • CI/CD implementation: Git-based pipelines, environment promotion, release controls, rollback patterns.

  • Cloud security foundations: IAM, secrets management, policy enforcement, and least-privilege design.

  • Cost optimization engineering: rightsizing, idle resource remediation, schedule automation, and governance controls.

  • Observability foundations: metrics, logs, traces, alert design, and SLO-oriented operating practices.

Preferred Technical Skills

  • Configuration management and systems automation (Ansible or equivalent).

  • Experience evaluating or migrating monitoring stacks (for example, Datadog alternatives).

  • Experience with Kafka platform migrations, including Kafka-as-a-Service adoption.

  • Experience enabling ARM64 migration and multi-arch build/deployment practices.

  • Experience driving stateless architecture transitions and config externalization patterns.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading cloud transformation in multi-tenant or regulated environments.

  • Experience with FinOps practices and cost governance operating models.

  • Experience with platform migration programs (for example, KaaS, ARM, stateless modernization).

  • Experience hiring and developing high-performing platform teams.

Leadership Competencies

  • Systems thinking with bias for execution.

  • Strong ownership and accountability.

  • Pragmatic decision-making under delivery constraints.

  • Ability to build alignment across engineering, operations, and business stakeholders.

title: Software Development Engineer, RBS Tech
description:
Join us to design and build large-scale distributed systems that directly impact millions of customers, sellers, and products worldwide. In this role, you'll solve complex business problems through innovative technology solutions, working on catalog automation, supply chain optimization, and retail process improvements that drive billions of dollars in business value.



Key job responsibilities
- Design and develop scalable, distributed software systems that solve complex retail business problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices to ensure stability and performance
- Collaborate with stakeholders including applied scientists, business partners, and peer engineers to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions
- Participate actively in code reviews, design discussions, and architectural planning, helping your team evolve through constructive feedback and knowledge sharing
- Drive operational excellence by identifying technical and process improvements, proposing solutions, and taking ownership of projects that enhance team capabilities and software quality
- Support team growth by mentoring new engineers, documenting system architecture and operations, and sharing knowledge about how our software integrates into the broader business context

As a Software Development Engineer II on our Retail Business Services tech team, you'll spend your day architecting and developing automation solutions that leverage machine learning and large language models to tackle high-impact retail challenges. You might begin by collaborating with applied scientists and peers to design a new feature for catalog enrichment, then transition into code review discussions where you provide constructive feedback on a teammate's implementation. Throughout the day, you'll make critical design trade-offs, evaluate technology choices, and ensure your solutions are both performant and maintainable. You'll also mentor newer engineers, participate in incident response when needed, and contribute to continuous improvements in how our team operates and delivers value.



About the team
We are a diverse group of software engineers and applied scientists dedicated to transforming retail operations through technology. Our team values knowledge sharing and mentorship—you'll have opportunities to learn from senior engineers through one-on-one conversations, technical discussions, and collaborative problem-solving. We're building an environment where people can go deep into their domain expertise or wear multiple hats depending on their interests. Our vision is to automate complex retail processes that currently require significant human effort, enabling our business to scale while maintaining the quality and accuracy our customers expect. You'll be part of a group that celebrates both technical excellence and work-life harmony, where we believe the right balance between professional and personal pursuits leads to sustained success and fulfillment.

description:
Staff Azure Cloud Engineer, Automation
