title: Digital Solution Specialists
location: Hong Kong SAR, Hong Kong Island, Hong Kong
description:
Overview

Are you passionate about AI and eager to transform the IT landscape? Join our dynamic Cloud & AI team as we lead the charge in AI transformation! As trusted advisors, we help customers modernize their infrastructure, optimize operations, and drive innovation with Cloud & AI's cutting-edge AI capabilities. Whether it's migrating and modernizing estates to be AI-ready, accelerating innovation with AI agents and platforms, empowering development teams with AI, or unifying and modernizing data estates, we help customers build technology solutions to achieve their business needs.

In this role, you'll be at the forefront of AI growth and disruption, guiding customers through their AI journey and helping them achieve their strategic goals. You'll ensure customers can fully harness the transformative potential of AI to stay ahead of the competition. If you're ready to make a significant impact and drive AI transformation, we invite you to join us and be part of this exciting journey!

At Small Medium Enterprises and Channel (SME&C), we are leading a high-growth, AI-powered global sales team—one that is deeply connected to our partners and driven by customer success. By uniting our Small Medium Business, Corporate, Strategy, and Partner teams, we are unlocking the largest customer opportunity, backed by the industry’s most significant investments. Leveraging the power of AI and our extensive partner ecosystem, we are redefining how businesses of all sizes adopt technology to drive growth and innovation.

SME&C is more than a sales organization—it’s a culture of innovation, opportunity, and inclusivity. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, high-performing, and customer-obsessed team where collaboration, connection, and continuous learning fuel everything we do.

If you thrive in a fast-paced, digital-first environment and are eager to make a meaningful impact, explore how SME&C can be the next step in your career. Together, we are shaping the future of business.

As a Cloud & AI Digital Solution Area Specialist you will be a solution sales leader within our mid-market sales organization working with our most important customers. You will collaborate with a team of technical, partner, and consulting resources to advance the sales process and exceed quarterly Cloud & AI revenue targets in your assigned accounts.

This opportunity will allow you to:

  • Accelerate your career growth by leading high-impact Cloud and AI Solution Plays across diverse industries and engaging in strategic customer conversations.
  • Hone your technical and consultative selling skills through deep engagements with customers and partners, while building confidence in solution design and execution.
  • Develop deep business acumen by aligning cloud strategies with customer transformation goals and success metrics, and by participating in immersive learning experiences.
  • Strengthen your leadership and influence by collaborating across teams, contributing to a culture of innovation, and sharing best practices.
  • Build future-ready capabilities through certifications, hands-on workshops, and continuous learning in cloud and AI technologies.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

Lead Customer Engagements: Act as the Cloud & AI sales lead, guiding customers through cloud transformation across infrastructure, data, and AI platforms. Address business and technical needs with demos, whiteboarding, and solution storytelling.

Own and Convert Pipeline: Manage forecast and pipeline from early-stage to close. Use tools like Industry Account Plans (IAP), Landing Experience Plans (LXP), and checklists to execute territory planning and strategies and drive revenue.

Orchestrate Across Teams: Partner with Account Executives, Solution Engineers, Cloud Solution Architects, and partners to co-sell, validate solutions, and ensure successful deployment through the Cloud & AI Marketplace.

Accelerate Decisions: Engage decision-makers with clear business cases using Cloud & AI Pricing Calculator, ROI, and TCO tools. Scope proofs of concept and lead customers from commitment to consumption.

Inspire and Influence: Bring technical fluency and inclusive leadership to virtual teams. Solve challenges with expertise in virtualization, cloud-native tech, data modernization, and AI.



Qualifications

Required Qualifications (RQs)

  • Experience in technology related Sales/Solution Sales in a reputable software company
  • A track record of meeting and exceeding revenue targets
  • Experience engaging with mid-market or corporate customers, including managing multiple stakeholders and navigating moderately complex sales cycles.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or related field AND 4+ years technology-related sales or account management experience OR 5+ years technology-related sales or account management experience.
  • Working knowledge of Cloud Platform: Understanding of Microsoft Cloud & AI infrastructure, data, and AI application platforms, with the ability to articulate technical solutions to business and IT stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications (PQs)

  • Experience selling business solutions to global customers with a focus on Cloud Native, AI, or Data platform and analytics
  • Master's Degree in Business Administration (i.e., MBA), Information Technology, or related field AND 3+ years technology-related sales or account management experience OR bachelor’s degree in information technology, or related field AND 6+ years technology-related sales or account management experience OR 7+ years technology-related sales or account management experience.
  • 4+ years solution or services sales experience.


This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.



Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. title: Senior Programme Manager - Technology and Innovation - Careers - LEGO.com
description:
Senior Programme Manager - Technology and Innovation  
 

 
 
 
 
 
 Share on: 
 
     

     
  

  Apply now   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  
 

 
  
  
 Management Level 
 Senior Manager   

  
 Job ID 
 0000037127   

  
 Category 
 Project / Program Management   

  
 Location 
 Billund, Denmark   
  
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 Job Description 

  The Creative Play Lab is the innovation engine within the LEGO Group, imagining radically new ways to play with the LEGO brick and pioneering the future of play. As a centre of experimentation and forward-thinking product development, the Lab operates at the intersection of creativity, technology and play — translating bold ideas into tangible innovations that delight children and families around the world.  

  The Senior Programme Manager sits at the heart of this mission, responsible for leading and orchestrating the end-to-end delivery of complex, single and multi-year technology enablement programmes that support the Lab's innovation agenda. Working closely with the CLAb Leadership Team and cross-functional teams across product, engineering, mission capabilities and operations, this role ensures that new technologies and tools - including AI initiatives - are successfully adopted into workflows and ways of working, driving measurable improvements in how the Creative Play Lab operates and innovates.  
 Responsibilities 
 
 
 Leads end-to-end delivery of single and multi-year technology enablement programmes within the Creative Play Lab (the Lab), spanning product innovation and internal workflow improvement, ensuring plans are executed on time, within scope, and to quality standards (e.g. AI upskilling and tooling programmes). 
 

 
 Operationalises technology programme objectives set by senior leadership into structured delivery plans with clear roadmaps, milestones, resource plans and risk registers, tracking progress and providing regular visibility to the Lab’s Leadership Team (CPL LT) on programme health. 
 

 
 Drives technology and tooling adoption across the Lab through structured implementation and change management plans, including communications, training and capability building activities, to embed new ways of working into everyday workflows and innovation processes. 
 

 
 Acts as the primary day-to-day interface between technical teams and business stakeholders across the Lab, collaborating with product, engineering, mission capabilites and operations to align programme objectives, manage dependencies and facilitate decision-making across competing priorities, escalating where appropriate. 
 

 
 Operates within and actively maintains programme governance structures, reporting cadences and decision forums, proactively identifying, escalating and mitigating risks related to technology, compliance, and quality standards in line with company policies and regulatory requirements. 
 

 
 Manages relationships with external vendors, technology partners and consultancies, ensuring delivery quality, cost control and alignment with internal programme standards and objectives. 
 

 
 Defines, tracks and reports on programme success metrics (e.g. adoption rates, operational efficiencies, innovation speed), surfacing insights and recommending adjustments to programme delivery to the CPL LT for review and direction. 
 

 
 Mentors and supports more junior project team members in programme management practices, fostering a collaborative team culture and contributing to capability building within the Creative Play Lab area. 
 
 
 Requirements 
 
 
 Significant programme or project management experience, with a proven track record of delivering complex, multi-year technology enablement, digital transformation or innovation-driven programmes in cross-functional environments. 
 

 
 Demonstrated ability to operationalise strategic objectives into structured delivery plans, translating technical concepts and capabilities into tangible business value for non-technical stakeholders. 
 

 
 Familiarity with AI, machine learning or emerging technology concepts and their practical business applications; experience delivering AI or technology adoption programmes is a strong advantage. Experience working at the intersection of technology and consumer products - particularly hardware, toys or physical goods - is highly desirable. 
 

 
 Proven change management and adoption experience, including the design and delivery of upskilling, communications and capability building initiatives to embed new tools and ways of working across an organisation. 
 

 
 Strong vendor and partner management experience, including oversight of external technology consultancies or delivery partners, with demonstrable budget and cost control accountability. 
 

 
 Proficiency in Agile, Scrum or hybrid delivery frameworks; formal programme or project management certification (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, MSP or equivalent) is required. 
 

 
 Exceptional resilience and composure — demonstrates the ability to maintain momentum and lead teams through ambiguity, shifting priorities and organisational complexity, recovering quickly from setbacks without losing focus on delivery outcomes. 
 

 
 This role is based in Billund, Denmark, but will be working day-to-day with Lab colleagues in London, Singapore and Boston Hubs, primarily online, and may require periodic travel to LEGO Group sites and external partner locations. Under 'best of both' rules the candidate is expected to be work a minimum of 3 days a week in the office. 
 
 
 Nice to have 
 
 
 Previous experience working within an R&D, innovation lab, creative agency or product development environment, particularly within a consumer products, toys, gaming or entertainment business. 
 

 
 Hands-on exposure to AI, machine learning or emerging technology tooling platforms (e.g. Microsoft Copilot, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Adobe Firefly, Vertex AI or similar), with an appreciation of how these tools can be practically applied to improve business workflows and product development processes. 
 

 
 Strong strategic awareness combined with pragmatic execution instincts — able to understand and operationalise the long-term technology vision set by senior leadership, connecting it to incremental, feasible delivery steps whilst balancing innovation with practical and safety considerations. 
 

 
 Consumer and product sensibility — an appreciation of the unique requirements of physical and consumer-facing products, and how technology enablement can meaningfully enhance product experiences whilst respecting safety, quality and brand standards. 
 

 
 Excellent communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences, with the ability to create clarity and alignment through structured updates, data-driven storytelling and well-crafted written and verbal communication. 
 
 
  

 Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Account Director
description:
We are looking for a highly qualified Account Director to take on the role of Client Lead — the single point of accountability for solving a client's B2B business problems, whatever form they take. The AD is not a specialist in one narrow service; s/he is expected to understand a client's business, sales, and marketing objectives holistically, and to bring together the right mix of strategy, creative, and execution capabilities from across Dentsu B2B to solve it — from concept to delivery.

The AD will own P&L responsibility for their account group, lead the professional development of their team, and build senior relationships with client stakeholders across business, sales, and marketing functions. The AD is expected to operate as a true consultant and partner to the client — proactively identifying problems, shaping solutions, and expanding the scope of the relationship over time.

Job Description:

  • Act as the Client Lead — the single point of accountability for the account
  • Create and foster client relationships across business, sales, and marketing stakeholders
  • Deliver targeted P&L across the account portfolio
  • Understand and translate client's business, sales, and marketing objectives into effective solutions
  • Proactively identify and pitch new opportunities that expand the client relationship
  • Lead the concept-to-delivery lifecycle of client engagements, partnering with internal specialist teams as needed
  • Manage team — Account Managers and Account Executives
  • Train and develop junior staff members
  • Drive opportunities for additional revenue through account growth
  • Budgeting and account planning

title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Helsinki, Huopalahti
description:
Etsitkö ihmisläheistä työtä, jossa pääset tärkeäksi osaksi toisen ihmisen arkea? Henkilökohtaisena avustajana pääset tukemaan asiakasta niissä tilanteissa, joissa hän tarvitsee toisen ihmisen apua esimerkiksi liikkumisessa, kodin askareissa tai vapaa-ajan toiminnassa. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan tarkoitus on tukea asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta ja mahdollisuutta elää omannäköistä elämää.

Henkilökohtaisen avustajan työ on maanläheistä ja tilanteisiin mukautuvaa. Päivät voivat vaihdella paljon, ja tehtävät suunnitellaan aina asiakkaan tarpeiden mukaan. Aiempaa kokemusta tehtävästä ei tarvita, sillä perehdytämme sinut työhön. Olemme työnantajana aina helposti tavoitettavissa ja tukenasi, jotta työ sujuu turvallisesti ja luontevasti.


Etsimme nyt osa-aikaista henkilökohtaista avustajaa asiakkaallemme Helsingin Huopalahteen. Asiakas on nainen, joka tarvitsee apua arjen askareissa, kuten kotitöissä. Avustajan on oltava vastuuntuntoinen ja luotettava.

Työvuoroja on yleensä kerran viikossa maanantaisin joko klo 9-13 tai 16-20.

Työhön valitulta henkilöltä vaaditaan rikostaustaselvitys vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työskentelyä varten (Laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta).

Toivomme, että olet:
- Oma-aloitteinen
- Luotettava
- Empaattinen

Työ alkaa mahdollisimman pian tai sopimuksen mukaan. Aloitamme haastattelut ennen hakuajan päättymistä ja tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.



Elämäsi Adato – Sinun elämäsi, sinä päätät
Elämäsi Adato Oy on suomalainen perheyritys, joka on täysin erikoistunut henkilökohtaisen avun järjestämiseen jo yli 15 vuoden ajan. Tavoitteenamme on auttaa jokaista asiakasta toimimaan arjen tilanteissa turvallisesti ja omien toiveidensa mukaisesti, niin että itsemääräämisoikeus säilyy kaikissa päivän kulkuun liittyvissä asioissa.

Haluamme olla asiakkaillemme luotettava kumppani heidän jokapäiväisessä elämässään ja työntekijöillemme välittävä ja joustava työnantaja. Meillä työskentely on konkreettista, ihmisläheistä ja merkityksellistä.

Työllistämme yli 300 henkilökohtaista avustajaa eri puolilla Suomea. Kasvamme vastuullisesti, ihmisten tarpeita kuunnellen.

Lue lisää www.elämäsi.com [http://www.elämäsi.com]

title: Sr Software Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

Apex Fintech Solutions (Apex) powers innovation and the future of digital wealth management by building tech-forward solutions that help simplify, automate, and facilitate access to financial markets for all. Our robust suite of fintech software enables us to support clients such as Stash, Betterment, SoFi, Webull, and eToro, amongst many others; collectively, Apex powers access to the stock market for over 22+ million end customers.

At Apex, we are changing how the securities industry operates by reinventing the status quo, which was manual, slow, and accessible only by the ultra-wealthy. We're digitizing and democratizing systems so that everyone has an opportunity to invest.

When you're at Apex, you drive this change. You're part of a global team with a clear vision: to be the trusted technology that powers the digital economy. Our offices in Austin, Dallas, Chicago, New York, Portland, Belfast, and Manila are home to over 1,000 employees.

Together, we’re shaping the future of financial innovation. Embrace change. Solve big. Win together. And be G.R.E.A.T. — grit, results, empathy, accountability, and teamwork — with Apex.

We’re proud to be recognized for the innovative work we do, the purpose-driven nature of our work, and the collaborative culture we’ve created. Here are just a few of the many awards we’ve recently received:

Best Places to Work

2026, 2025, 2024, 2023 - Presented by BuiltIn

WealthTech of the Year

2025 - Presented by US FinTech Awards

The World’s Top 250 Fintech Companies

2024 - Presented by CNBC

ABOUT THIS ROLE

At Apex Fintech Solutions, we're transforming the future of digital wealth management by seamlessly connecting financial platforms and simplifying access to financial markets for millions.

As a Sr Software Engineer, you will be working alongside experienced software engineers, product managers, and data engineers to design, build, deploy, and maintain services and systems at the core of our cloud native Data Platform and APIs. We build and own services spanning across, APIs & data access, data processing services, tooling & infrastructure for storage & access, machine learning & predictive APIs, and engineering for data analytics. This role offers an opportunity to build cloud services across many of these domains, or specialize as an SME as you establish yourself within Apex. The ideal candidate is one that integrates well within a team and strives for collaborative, modern cloud engineering and team practices, acting as a multiplier for the team day to day.

Duties/Responsibilities

  • Develop, test, and maintain microservice service architectures, pipelines, data stores, and other cloud systems for the Apex data layer and APIs.

  • Collaborate and solve complex engineering problems, and solve them for scale with the autonomy to drive technical directions and decisions.

  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, clients, and other stakeholders to understand client & business problems and requirements and work towards solutions.

  • Create, and own scalable cloud services and pipelines for our various data-driven service domains.

  • Manage, optimize, and improve existing cloud data platform solutions for performance, availability, scaling etc.

  • Write self-documenting and well-tested code with an emphasis on sustainable devSecOps practices.

  • Work as a part of a productive development team that puts an emphasis on code quality, peer reviews, documentation and strong modern engineering practices.

Education and/or Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related technical field or equivalent work experience

  • Experience in software development in at least one or more of the following languages: Java, Python, Go, etc.

  • 2+ years of experience in cloud engineering, particularly around; microservices, scalability and best practices, build and implementation, data technologies and services.

  • 3+ years of experience in infrastructure, modern IaC (e.g. Terraform), cloud service deployment and management, and modern CI/CD

  • Experience working with modern database systems (e.g. Bigquery, Postgres, AlloyDb, Redis, etc)

  • Strong background and proven experience developing, testing, and maintaining REST APIs.

  • A problem-solving mindset, with the ability to think critically through challenging engineering scenarios.

  • Experience in the financial industry preferred

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Ability to interpret technical design documents to build solutions.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to communicate well at all levels to varied stakeholders.

  • Strong proficiency in relevant programming language(s) for building and deploying cloud (micro)services

  • A desire to strive for modern collaborative engineering practices and standards, a DevSecOps mindset, and a desire to push good practice within your team and at a wider level to deliver value.

  • Adaptability to learn new technologies/systems/languages as needed day to day.

  • Understanding of event driven, real-time data pipelines, data replication, data streaming.

​Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Our Rewards

We offer a robust package of employee perks and benefits, including a market-leading salary with an annual bonus, 20 days of vacation leave plus regular and special non-working holidays, and a training and development budget. Our benefits also cover private health insurance for medical and dental, as well as life insurance. We emphasize work-life balance with flexible working hours, parental leave, a modern city center office, and a hybrid work schedule that allows for greater flexibility by partially working from home. Additional perks include monthly team lunch-outs, unlimited drinks and snacks, and company recognition & rewards.

EEO Statement

Apex Fintech Solutions is an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other protected characteristic. Our hiring practices ensure that all qualified applicants receive fair consideration without regard to these characteristics.

Disability Statement

Apex Fintech Solutions is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace for all candidates, including those with disabilities. We are dedicated to ensuring equal employment opportunities and providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require reasonable accommodations to participate in the application or interview process, please submit your request via the Candidate Accommodation Requests Form. We will work with you to provide the necessary accommodations to ensure your full participation in our hiring process.

We bring together technology and process expertise to deliver the next generation of applications for Shared Platforms Services. You are responsible for building next generation tools and services that serve consumer ready product information to Nike experiences and back end teams. We are in the process of modernizing our entire product data platform, building scalable applications and services in the cloud. Our operations tools are used by hundreds of users across the globe to plan, prepare, and activate Nike products across multiple Nike consumer experiences. Our product data services are being updated to unlock Omni-channel business cases, and support billions of API calls per month. This is a team that’s always on the offense, working on innovative solutions and building world class solutions to serve Nike teams and consumers around the globe.

As a Software Engineer II for the Geographies & Marketplace Experiences team, you will be part of a mission critical team focused on building a high-throughput, low-latency, fault-tolerant Order Management platform that drives Nike’s Digital transformation and growth strategies.

  • A minimum of 3+ years software development experience.

  • Experience working in a highly collaborative, multi-discipline development team environment

  • Experience working in a distributed/cloud-based environment (e.g. AWS Services, GCE, Azure etc.)

  • Experience in micro service architecture, domain driven design, and RESTful Services using Java and Spring Boot framework mandatorily.

  • Demonstrate an AI-first mindset, actively leveraging AI powered developer tools (e.g., Cursor) to accelerate development and learning.

  • Experience in Test Driven development – with Junit, Mockito, cucumber, Playwright etc.,

  • Experience with monitoring and tracing tools like Splunk, SignalFx, Kibana/Grafana etc.

  • Experience working with NoSQL data stores like DynamoDB and relational data stores like MySQL, Oracle etc.

  • Experience with continuous integration, unit testing, static analysis, and automated integration tests. Continuous delivery experience preferred.

  • Working knowledge of Scrum and agile principles.

  • Working in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment with globally distributed and diverse teams

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Gigs

At Gigs, we're building the operating system for mobile services—a platform that lets tech companies embed global connectivity into their products effortlessly.

Just as Stripe lets any business add a payment button in seconds, Gigs empowers platforms to weave in connectivity—bridging the traditional world of telecom with modern tech. From fintechs launching mobile services to HR platforms offering work phone plans, we automate provisioning and remove telecom complexity.

Our team of around 150 people across the US and Europe, backed by nearly $100 million in funding from Ribbit Capital, Google, and Y Combinator. As one of the fastest-growing tech companies, bringing together early-stage engineers, product builders, and business athletes from companies like Stripe, Airbnb, and Shopify. We’re tackling deep technical and regulatory challenges to make connectivity truly seamless.

If you’re driven by curiosity, creativity, and the chance to shape the future of telecom, we’d love to hear from you.

Things We Care About

We are building in a highly complex space and tackling a massive problem. We want people who lean in when things get hard.

  • Speed. We move and we ship. We set bold deadlines and treat every week like it matters.
  • Ownership. If you see something broken, fix it. We don't wait for permission.
  • Customer Obsession. Our customers' product is our product.
  • Ambiguity. We're building frontier technology in a complex domain. You'll need sound judgement and good instincts to make decisions without complete information.
  • First principles. We don't ask how things have been done before. We ask why they were done that way at all.

The Role

As a Senior Data Engineer on the Data Team, you'll continue to build and and improve the data platform the whole company relies on. Data at Gigs cuts across everything: usage events from telecom networks, billing and revenue data, product analytics, and the numbers Finance closes the books with.

We build data systems to solve business problems, not for their own sake. You'll make pragmatic technical decisions based on what the business needs, balancing speed, correctness, and long-term maintainability.

You care deeply about data modeling and how data is consumed, not only how it's moved and stored. As a senior engineer, you'll set architectural patterns and standards, and you'll make decisions the team builds on as it scales.

It's a cross-functional role. You'll work closely with Finance, Network Integration, Product, and other teams to understand their problems and turn them into reliable data products. You'll join a small Data Team reporting to our Head of Data, with a big surface area and significant influence over the technical direction of data at Gigs.

Salary range for Senior Data Engineer:

  • EU: €90,000-125,000
  • UK: £90,000-125,000

(The final offer depends on your background, skills, and how you perform through the process.)

What You Will Do

  • Build systems that turn complex usage and operational data into trustworthy datasets used for billing, financial reporting, and product decisions.
  • Build and operate the data platform and pipelines that power these use cases.
  • Integrate data from across the business — internal systems, third-party tools, and external partners — into one consistent platform.
  • Own data model ing across the warehouse and set standards for how data is structured as we scale.
  • Work mostly in Python and SQL, with Dagster as our orchestrator.
  • Build and maintain the cloud infrastructure behind the platform, managed with Terraform.
  • Work directly with stakeholders. Understand their problem, then deliver data they can trust.
  • Design for correctness and observability. Build the tests, monitoring, and data quality checks that make our numbers reliable.
  • Take problems from scoping to production, and operate what you build.

You can find more about how we work on our engineering page.

What We Are Looking For

  • You've designed and operated production data platforms. You've made architectural decisions around ingestion, storage, modeling, orchestration, and reliability, and you understand the trade-offs between them.
  • You have strong data modeling fundamentals. You have well-developed views on how data should be structured, can explain the trade-offs behind them, and know when different approaches make sense.
  • You put business value first. You build for impact, not for the sake of building, and you know how to make pragmatic trade-offs between speed and quality.
  • You're comfortable working with ambiguity. You can take an underspecified problem, work out what matters, and drive it to a production solution.
  • You use AI tools effectively as part of your engineering workflow. You give agents good context, critically review their output, recognize when they're wrong, and stay accountable for the code and technical decisions that result.
  • You're strong in Python and SQL, and experienced with modern cloud data platforms such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Databricks.
  • You've worked with data orchestration tools such as Dagster, Airflow, or Prefect. We use Dagster.
  • You're comfortable owning cloud infrastructure. You can work with infrastructure-as-code such as Terraform and own the infrastructure your data systems depend on.
  • You communicate clearly across technical and non-technical teams. You can understand stakeholder problems in Finance, Network Integration, Product, and beyond, challenge assumptions when needed, and explain technical decisions and trade-offs.
  • You don't need to know the telecom industry.

Bonus Points If:

  • You have experience with GCP data services such as BigQuery, Pub/Sub, or Dataflow.
  • You know stream processing. We don't do much of it yet, but it's coming soon.
  • You've worked with dbt or similar transformation and modeling frameworks.
  • You're comfortable reading or contributing to application code in Go or Ruby when needed for an integration. Our backend is mostly written in those languages.
  • You've worked with financial, billing, metering, or usage data where errors have real downstream consequences.

Work At Gigs

At Gigs, we value in-person collaboration. We believe the best ideas, decisions, and relationships are built when teams spend meaningful time together, and our culture is designed around that belief. We support flexibility where it makes sense. Some focused work can be done remotely, and not every role or week looks the same. You should expect regular time in one of our hubs, as well as occasional travel for team workshops, customer meetings, and Gigs Republic, our bi-annual company off-site. Our offices are designed to feel like home-inspired workspaces, with plants, thoughtful tools, and small, tight-knit teams that make collaboration feel natural, energizing, and effective.

What We Offer

At Gigs, we believe in rewarding excellence. We offer competitive compensation and stock options because we see you as a true partner in our growth. We also provide stipends for your home office or work setup, a budget for learning and development to fuel your career, and of course, a free phone and international data plan

Want to learn more about our benefits, hubs, and what it’s like to work at Gigs? Check out our Careers page.

title: Myyjä / Asiakaspalvelija, Rovaniemi Insider
description:
AALTOVOIMA - AALLON VOIMALLA TÖIHIN

Tarjoamme monipuolisia aktiviteetteja, laadukkaita majoitusratkaisuja ja henkilökohtaista palvelua niin kansainvälisille vierailijoille kuin kotimaan matkailijoille. Teemme yhteistyötä alueen matkailuyritysten kanssa ja rakennamme elämyksiä, jotka jättävät pysyvän muistijäljen. Etsimme asiakkaallemme Rovaniemi Insiderille myynti-/ ja asiakaspalveluhenkistä henkilöä monipuolisiin tehtäviin Rovaniemelle!

Työtehtäviin kuuluu majoitus- ja aktiviteettipalveluiden myynti ja tarjoaminen asiakkaille sekä asiakkaiden ohjaus ja neuvonta kasvotusten sekä sähköisissä kanavissa. Asiakkaat ovat pääasiassa suomalaisia, mutta sujuva englannin kielen taito on tehtävässä välttämätön. Tehtävä vaatii aitoa halua tehdä aktiivista myyntiä ja palvella asiakkaita sydämellä.

Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan syksyn aikana syys-marraskuussa, ja jatkuu määräaikaisena maaliskuun 2027 loppuun saakka. Työsuhde solmitaan vuokrasuhteena Aaltovoima Pohjoisen kanssa

Tarjoamme sinulle:

* Määräaikaisen sesonkiroolin kansainvälisessä ilmapiirissä
* Kannustavan ja myyntiin perustuvan provisiomallin

* Hyvän perehdytyksen tehtäviin ja työyhteisön vankan tuen

* Aalto Henkilöstöpalveluiden luotettavan työnantajakokemuksen

Arvostamme:

* Sujuvaa englannin kielen taitoa (muu kielitaito on eduksi)

* Reipasta asennetta ja hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja

* Halua tehdä aktiivista myyntiä

* Aikaisempaa kokemusta myyntitehtävistä

Liity mukaan tiimiimme lähettämällä hakemuksesi jo tänään oheisen linkin kautta.

http://aaltovoima.likeit.fi/apply/14913121

Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikat sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa:

Noora Kärkinen

+358406686518

noora.karkinen@aaltovoima.fi



Aalto Henkilöstöpalvelut on monialainen henkilöstöpalveluyritys Suomesta, joka yhdistää työn ja tekijät. Olemme osa laajempaa Workteam Groupia, joka on henkilöstö- sekä palvelualan konserni.

Perusta toiminnallamme on luotettavuus ja joustavuus. Keskeisimpiä arvojamme ovat yhdessä menestyminen, nopea reagointi ja positiivinen palvelu. Jokainen työntekijä ja asiakas on meille tärkeä.

Henkilöstöllämme on kymmenien vuosien kokemus rakentamisen, logistiikan, teollisuuden ja palvelualojen rekrytoinneista henkilöstöpalvelualalla.

title: Personal Banking Advisor
description:
What's the role?

A Personal Banking Advisor at Westpac is a professional who assists customers with their banking needs, offering tailored advice and solutions. They help with tasks like opening accounts, managing finances, and providing guidance on Westpac's products and services. Their role is customer-focused, aiming to build strong relationships and ensure a positive banking experience.

  • Assist customers with banking transactions including cash deposits and withdrawals
  • Maintain accurate cash handling and ensure end-of-day balancing
  • Educate customers on digital platforms such as online banking and our award-winning mobile app
  • Identify opportunities to improve customers’ financial wellbeing through tailored solutions
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies
This is a branch-based role working 32 hours per week across five days, Tuesday to Saturday. Hours will be rostered within branch operating times, providing a great opportunity to build a rewarding career while maintaining work-life balance.

What do I need?

  • Thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments with variety in daily tasks.
  • Proven experience in meeting and exceeding KPI targets while delivering exceptional customer service.
  • Passion for building and maintaining strong customer relationships to support sales and banking needs.
  • Strong communication skills and excellent time management.
  • A willingness to learn and grow professionally.

No banking experience? No problem. At Westpac, we’re committed to your success from day one. You will receive comprehensive training on our banking products and services and our supportive team will provide hands-on guidance and resources to help you master everything you need to flourish in your new role. We’re here to empower you with the knowledge and skills to thrive and advance your career with us!

Why join us?

We’re obsessed with becoming our customers’ #1 banking partner for life and we’re looking for people who are passionate about helping us achieve that goal. In return, we’re committed to making Westpac the best place to work in the country. Here are just a few of the ways we’re already doing that:

  • Special offers on banking products and discounts from top brands, including generous employee-only mortgage rates!
  • A variety of leave options including Culture, Lifestyle and Wellbeing leave
  • Tailored learning and development opportunities to help your grow your career within the bank
  • Lots of opportunities to ‘give back’ to the Community by getting involved in our many volunteering initiatives

Create your future today

To get started, simply click on the APPLY or APPLY NOW button.

We’re all about creating a supportive and inclusive community. We welcome everyone – no matter your age, gender, background, or abilities. We also provide additional support to welcome our veterans, Indigenous Australians and neurodiverse community.

If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, you can find out more information and additional contact details by visiting the "People with Disability and/or needing Accessibility Requirements" page on our website.

We may close this job advertisement earlier than the advertised closing date if suitable candidates are identified. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Sr Lead Software Engineer
description:
Be an integral part of an agile team that's constantly pushing the envelope to enhance, build, and deliver top-notch technology products.

As a Senior Lead Software Engineer at JPMorganChase within the Commercial & Investment Bank, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. Drive significant business impact through your capabilities and contributions, and apply deep technical expertise and problem-solving methodologies to tackle a diverse array of challenges that span multiple technologies and applications.

Job responsibilities
  • Design and build core application features hands-on (backend, APIs, integration, and UI as needed).
  • Own technical design and implementation patterns to deliver secure, scalable, maintainable solutions.
  • Lead design/code reviews and enforce engineering standards across the delivery lifecycle.
  • Partner with product and UAT teams to translate requirements into working software and support acceptance testing.
  • Influence senior business and technology stakeholders; communicate clearly with BAs, PMs, and engineers.
  • Drive continuous improvement through pragmatic, innovative solutions, and better team processes.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues, prioritize effectively, and deliver to deadlines with a customer-first mindset.
  • Mentor engineers and foster a collaborative, inclusive, high-performance team culture.
  • Drives adoption and governance of approved AI-assisted engineering practices across teams to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-assisted code review/refactoring, test acceleration, release readiness, incident/root-cause analysis), while establishing measurable validation standards (secure coding, peer review, automated testing) and promoting reuse of proven patterns and automation within the SDLC/TLM toolchain.

  • Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including approved AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation at scale.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience
    Strong CS fundamentals: OOAD, data structures/algorithms, and design patterns.
  • Expert in Java with modern frameworks (Spring Boot, Dropwizard, or equivalent). Microservices architecture; RESTful services and WebSockets.
  • Containers and orchestration: Docker and Kubernetes. Messaging/integration: JMS, RabbitMQ, AMQP, MQ, Kafka.
  • Front-end proficiency in at least one modern web framework (React + Redux, Angular, Node.js, etc.). Testing discipline with common frameworks (JUnit, Mockito, Selenium/Cucumber; plus relevant JS test tools).
  • Persistence layer experience: JDBC and ORM frameworks (Hibernate/MyBatis). Strong SDLC knowledge and Agile delivery experience.
  • Databases: Oracle (strong), Sybase. Cloud experience: AWS/Azure/GCP and/or Cloud Foundry.
  • Excellent analytical/debugging skills and strong written/verbal communication. Proven ability to manage stakeholder relationships and prioritize within complex programs
  • Demonstrated experience leading effective use of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, code review, test acceleration, troubleshooting) with the ability to set team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security

  • Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching senior engineers/leads on compliant usage patterns and controls.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • Financial services domain experience.
  • Technical coach/leader who helps teams solve hard engineering problems.
  • Scrum execution experience (planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives).
  • Understanding of security standards/frameworks and secure engineering practices.
  • Exposure to NoSQL (HBase/Cassandra) and Spark is a plus

title: AI Product Engineer
description:
[About the role]

This role is for someone who thrives at the intersection of great engineering and great product thinking. You'll design and ship robust frontend solutions, contribute to SDK development, and collaborate across teams to bring complex features to life seamlessly. Someone who takes full ownership, sweats the details, and raises the engineering culture around them will do exceptionally well here.

[Key Responsibilities]

  • Minimum 7 years of professional frontend development experience

  • Solid experience with MVVM or similar architecture patterns in production environments
  • Experience working with RESTful APIs, including network request lifecycle, error handling, and API versioning

  • Track record of leading code reviews, mentoring junior developers, and establishing engineering best practices
  • Demonstrated ability to own features end-to-end from concept through deployment, collaborating closely with product managers, designers, and backend engineers

[Required Experience]

  • Advanced understanding of browser/platform internals, system-level APIs, and performance optimization techniques
  • Expertise in WebSocket technologies and real-time communication architecture design
  • Experience with low-latency streaming, adaptive bitrate streaming (HLS/DASH), and related protocols

  • Prior experience designing and implementing custom media pipelines

  • Familiarity with Web Audio API or media player SDK development
  • Experience publishing and maintaining npm packages
  • Contributions to open-source frontend projects

title: Ledningssystemansvarig till Billerud Skärblacka, Norrköping
description:
Vi på Billerud tror att när vi har morgondagen i åtanke gör vi vårt bästa idag. Tack vare våra medarbetare är vi ett världsledande företag inom vår bransch av förnybara papper- och förpackningsmaterial. Vi jobbar med hållbarhet i alla led för att skapa en hållbar framtid – från produkt till människan. Vill du uppnå din fulla potential och bidra till en hållbar morgondag? Bli en del av oss!

Vill du bidra till utvecklingen av vårt ledningssystem och stödja verksamheten i arbetet med ständiga förbättringar? Då kan detta vara rollen för dig.

Vi söker nu en Ledningssystemansvarig till Billerud Skärblacka, Norrköping

Du tillhör sektionen Kvalitet och Miljö, som ansvarar för att utveckla brukets arbetssätt för ständiga förbättringar genom våra ledningssystem. I rollen ansvarar du för att utveckla och förvalta ledningssystem inom kvalitet, miljö, energi, arbetsmiljö och livsmedelssäkerhet. Du planerar och genomför interna revisioner, samordnar externa revisioner och kundaudits samt stödjer verksamheten inom processkartläggning, dokumentstyrning och verksamhetssystem.

Rollen innebär många kontaktytor och nära samarbete med chefer och medarbetare på bruket, externa revisorer samt kollegor inom Billerud.

Anställningen är en tillsvidareanställning på dagtid

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter kommer att vara:

  • Utveckla och förvalta ledningssystem inom kvalitet, miljö, energi, arbetsmiljö och livsmedelssäkerhet.
  • Planera och genomföra interna revisioner samt samordna externa revisioner och kundaudits
  • Stödja verksamheten inom processkartläggning och processtyrning
  • Ge stöd och utbildning till chefer och medarbetare i frågor kopplade till ledningssystem
  • Bidra till utveckling och effektivisering av arbetssätt för avvikelsehantering
  • Ansvara för och utveckla IT-stöd för verksamhetssystemet för styrande dokumentation

Vi sätter Safety First! Hos oss på Billerud ansvarar vi alla för att bidra till en säker arbetsmiljö.

Kvalifikationer

För att lyckas i rollen som Ledningssystemansvarig tror vi att du har:

  • Högskoleutbildning inom kvalitet, verksamhetsutveckling eller motsvarande kompetens som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig
  • Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift
  • Kunskap om ledningssystem och standarder
  • Erfarenhet av Revisioner

Det är meriterande om du har:

  • Erfarenhet av ledningssystem för ett stort företag, gärna processindustri eller tillverkande företag
  • Erfarenhet av att arbeta med IT-stöd för process- och dokumentstyrning

Personliga egenskaper

Vi lägger stor vikt vid din personlighet. För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du är strukturerad, självgående och kvalitetsmedveten. Du har lätt för att skapa goda relationer, samarbeta med olika funktioner och anpassa din kommunikation efter mottagaren. Eftersom rollen innebär att stötta och utbilda verksamheten är du även pedagogisk, serviceinriktad och trivs med att dela med dig av din kunskap.

Våra värderingar är viktiga för oss och vi tror att du som söker känner igen dig i våra värdeord: Värna om varandra och vi håller det vi lovar.

Kontakt

Vill du veta mer om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Anna Kullberg, Avdelningschef Kvalitet och Miljö på telefon +46 70 317 86 79 eller epost anna.kullberg@billerud.com

För frågor om rekryteringsprocessen kan du kontakta Ida Rosén på epost ida.e.rosen@Billerud.com

Sista dag för ansökan

2026-08-30

Ansökningsinformation

Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-08-30. Urval sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Billerud är en jämställd arbetsgivare. Vi omfamnar mångfald och är engagerade i att skapa en inkluderande miljö för alla anställda och kandidater.

Varför oss?

  • En möjlighet att bidra till en mer hållbar framtid
  • Utvecklings- och karriärmöjligheter
  • Prestationsbaserad bonus, tjänstepension, semester och fritidsbostäder, samt en rad olika förmåner enligt företagets policy.
  • Möjlighet till hybridarbete enligt företagsstandard

Genom att arbeta hos oss i Skärblacka får du möjlighet att kombinera en roll i en global industriverksamhet med en vardag där karriär, utveckling och livskvalitet går hand i hand.

Skärblacka ligger strategiskt placerad i en vacker miljö med närhet till både Norrköping, Finspång, Söderköping och Linköping. Läs mer om hur det är att leva och bo i regionen: East Sweden Business Region.

Vår rekryteringsprocess innehåller: intervjuer, rekryteringstester, referenstagning samt alkohol- och drogtest.

title: Buyers Assistant
description:
Join us and experience Bunnings from the other side of the counter!

What’s in it for you when you’re part of our team:

  • Team discount at Bunnings and other Wesfarmers brands including Kmart

  • Access to over 100+ exclusive team member benefits across health, shopping, travel and stay, wealth, work and leave

  • 12 weeks paid parental leave, regardless of gender

  • Fun stuff like annual festive gifts, discounted food and drinks at our Bunnings Cafe, and travelling store team member opportunities

  • We’re genuinely invested in your career and no matter where you start with us, that pathway is yours to build

About the role.

We have an exciting opportunity to join the Merchandise Team in the role of Buyer’s Assistant - Building Supplies & Plumbing.

If you love variety this is for you as no two days will be the same!

As a Buyers Assistant you will have an exciting role reporting to and providing direct support to the National Buyers. You will assist in range reviews and merchandise strategy along with general administration support, processing of advertising material and you will assist with stores and suppliers in liaison with the Buyer.

What's involved.

  • Support the buyer with admin associated with range management, including product changes, allocations and inventory management
  • Action cost and retail changes as advised by the Buyer
  • Monitor competitor activity
  • Provide support to stores by liaising with suppliers, Operations, Marketing and other stakeholders.

Who we’re looking for.

The successful candidate will be an excellent communicator with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. Your strong planning & organisational skills combined with your passion for merchandising will set you above the rest.

You’ll need:

  • Exceptional organisational skills
  • Proficient with MS word, Excel, and PowerPoint
  • Understands the importance of timelines
  • Has the ability to self-manage and prioritise effectively
  • Possesses well developed written and verbal communication skills
  • Ideally you have a relevant tertiary qualification, however not essential and may have experience in store retailing.
  • You enjoy the challenge of a fast paced environment with many and varied daily activities working with a dynamic team where fun is as much part of the culture as hard work.

Nau mai, haere mai - you’ll be part of a workplace where you’ll feel like you belong.

We love the diversity across our teams, brought together in an inclusive culture guided by our values. We welcome applications from individuals of all ages, cultural backgrounds, abilities, sexual orientations, and gender identities. Join us in shaping a workplace that celebrates all voices, perspectives, and contributions and reflects the communities we serve across Aotearoa. We value te reo Māori and tikanga Māori, and we respect the whenua we do business on.

Please note, you must be age 15 or over to apply for a role at Bunnings.

We’re all about fairness at Bunnings, and our team’s here to support you every step of the way. If you need any adjustments, just let us know - we’re here to help. If you’ve got the experience, skills, and drive to grow - but don’t quite nail every part of the job description - we still want to hear from you. For support, contact us at jobs@bunnings.co.nz.

Bunnings reserves the right to close job advertisements at any time, so we encourage you to apply early. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies, as we have a dedicated internal Talent Acquisition team managing all hiring processes.

About Us

Bunnings is the leading retailer of home improvement and lifestyle products in Australia and New Zealand. We're proud to support project builders, commercial tradespeople and the housing industry through our network of stores, trade centres, frame and truss sites and online.

At Bunnings, our purpose is simple: we’re here to inspire people to have a red hot go! Whether that's backing our team to grow, supporting customers to take on new projects, or helping communities make a real difference. By joining our passionate and diverse team, you will be part of a culture that encourages you to roll up your sleeves and build something great together. If you’re ready to have a go, apply today.

Please note if you are offered a role with us, background checks may be required. This can include police, employment, medical and qualification checks. If a police check search returns a criminal record, Bunnings will assess whether the record impacts your ability to perform the key requirements of the role.

   Introduktion  
 

 
 Kan du motivere branchens bedste kolleger og bidrage til, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar? Så er du måske vores nye souschef. 

 Hos Lidl bliver du en del af Europas største dagligvarekæde med 150+ butikker i Danmark. Sammen er vi drevet af et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, og på #teamlidl kommer du med på en succesfuld rejse -- på et hold med høje ambitioner til fælles. Vi har brug for stærke ledere, der giver vores medarbejdere retning og overskud, så vi sammen skaber rammerne for landets bedste indkøbsoplevelse.
 Som souschef tager du aktiv del i det daglige arbejde i butikken, og får medansvar for butikkens drift og resultater. Hos os får du ansvar lige fra første arbejdsdag og bliver samtidig en del af et ambitiøst karriereudviklingsforløb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi nemlig høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen, med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig.
 Som souschef i Lidl får du en ansvarsfuld rolle med spændende udfordringer og en konkurrencedygtig lønpakke. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, så du har forudsætningerne for at opnå succes i din nye stilling.
     
 
 

 
   Om jobbet  
 

 
 Som souschef er du med til at drive butikken og lede medarbejderne. Du har medansvar for, at butikken lever op til kundernes forventninger, så de bliver ved med at handle hos os. Ud over at bestille varer, fylde op og ekspedere kunderne ved kassen, får du også følgende opgaver, som du løser i tæt samarbejde med butikschefen: 
 
 Planlægning af ressourcer og prioritering af arbejdsopgaver  

 Oplæring af medarbejdere, så de efterlever Lidls værdier og butikskoncepter 

 Ledelse af medarbejdere så de lykkes i deres job 

 Sørge for, at vores butikskoncepter overholdes 

 Ansvar for butikken når butikschefen ikke er til stede  
  
 

 
   Om dig  
 

 
 Du er en empatisk og stærk ledertype, der har nemt ved motivere dine medarbejdere. Du bliver respekteret for din faglighed, og du sætter en ære i at tage del i arbejdsopgaverne i den daglige drift, og være med til at sikre, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar. 
 Du er godt rustet til jobbet, hvis du: 
 
 Har brancheerfaring og gerne erfaring fra lignende stilling 

 Har gennemført et lederkursus eller er motiveret for at udvikle dig som leder 

 Har en venlig og professionel fremtoning 

 Inspirerer dine medarbejdere til at følge dit gode eksempel 

 Har overblik og fokus på detaljen  

 Ser butikken som et team og ikke er bleg for at give en hånd med, når en kollega har brug for hjælp 

 Har god forståelse for arbejdsprocesser, procedurer og koncepter 
  
 

 
   Vi tilbyder  
 

 
 Som souschef i Lidl får du:  
 
 En udfordrende rolle, hvor tingene går stærkt 

 Verdensklasse sammenhold 

 En konkurrencedygtig lønpakke på 26.000 - 32.500 kr. brutto om måneden 

 Et udbetalt tillæg i henhold til overenskomsten, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter - fx aftener, weekender og helligdage 

 Løn og vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst med HK 

 En grundig oplæring i vores arbejdsgange og koncepter 

 Adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt 

 Mulighed for sundhedsordning 

 Rabatordning hos flere udbydere af rejser, shopping, kultur, fitness mm. 
 
   

 Vil du med på #teamlidl?
 Sådan søger du stillingen: 
 
 Klik på "Søg nu" 

 Udfyld formularen 

 Vedhæft dit motiverede CV  
 
   

 Vi rekrutterer løbende, så send dit motiverede CV hurtigst muligt. Da butikken er åben alle ugens dage, vil der forekomme dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.
 Vores rekrutteringsproces består af en telefonsamtale og en fysisk samtale i butikken. 

 Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller ansøgningsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Recruiting på  jobilidloest@lidl.dk  eller tlf. 7635 0635, mandag - torsdag 8.00 - 15.00/ fredag 08.00 - 14.00.

title: Moniosaaja
description:
Etsimme asiakasyrityksemme kasvavaan tarpeeseen MONIOSAAJAA Varkauden alueelle.

Moniosaajana pääset työskentelemää asiakasyrityksemme vaihtuvissa kohteissa keskuskeittiöissä, kouluissa, asumispalveluyksiköissä sekä päiväkodeissa. Työpäiväsi ovat vaihtelevia, ja tehtäviisi voi kuulua esimerkiksi siivousta, ruoan esivalmistelua, astiahuoltoa, tuotteiden pakkaamista sekä keräilyä.

Sinulta odotamme:

- Aikaisempaa kokemusta vastaavanlaisista tehtävistä tai alan koulutusta.
- Hyvää suomen kielen taitoa.
- Hygieniapassia ja voimassa olevaa salmonellatodistusta.
- Vastuullisuutta ja halua oppia uutta.
- Halua oppia uutta ja tarttua erilaisiin työtehtäviin.

Ja puolestamme tarjoamme:

Etsimme tekijöitä vaihteleviin työtehtäviin, joissa työvuoroja on tarjolla muutamana päivänä viikossa. Satunnaisesti tarjolla on myös pidempiä sijaisuuksia aina muutamasta viikosta useampaan kuukauteen. Työtä tehdään pääsääntöisesti arkisin klo 7.00-15.00 välillä.

Lisäksi tarjoamme:

- Työn, jossa voit itse vaikuttaa siihen, missä ja milloin työskentelet.
- Mahdollisuuden edetä urallasi uusiin tehtäviin.
- Sähköisen perehdytysalustan työn tueksi.
- Kattavan perehdytyksen työsuhteesi alussa.

Työsuhteiden pituudet vaihtelevat toiveidesi ja käytettävyytesi mukaan, joten kerrothan hakemuksessasi tarkemmin, millainen työ sopisi sinulle parhaiten.

Me Eezyllä haluamme juuri sinut!

Hakuaika päättyy 30.8.2026, mutta käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana. Palkkauksessa noudatetaan asiakasyrityksessämme käytettävää YTES-työehtosopimusta.

Mikäli haluat tiedustella lisää, olethan rohkeasti yhteydessä.

Työssäsi pääset olemaan osa hoivakotikohteiden arkea Rovaniemen alueella. Tässä tehtävässä huolehdit siitä, että tilat ovat asukkailleen siistit, turvalliset ja viihtyisät. Siivottavia tiloja ovat muun muassa asukashuoneet, toimistot, pukuhuoneet, käytävät, saniteettitilat sekä muut yleiset tilat.
Työtehtäväsi sisältävät sekä ylläpitosiivouksen että perussiivouksen tehtäviä, mutta lisäksi työsi on kohtaamisia, hymyjä ja pieniä hetkiä, joissa olet läsnä. Siivoustyön lomassa vaihdat kuulumisia hoivakodin henkilökunnan ja asukkaiden kanssa, ja huolehdit omalta osaltasi siitä, että asiakaskokemus on lämmin ja positiivinen. Juuri siksi etsimme henkilöä, joka on aidosti asiakaspalveluhenkinen ja viihtyy erilaisten ihmisten parissa myös muuttuvissa tilanteissa.
Vaikka aiempi kokemus siivous- tai asiakaspalvelutehtävistä on plussaa, tärkeintä on asenne. Sinut perehdytetään huolella kohteeseen ja työtehtäviisi. Käytössäsi on monipuoliset siivousvälineet ja –koneet.
Siivottavan kohteen luonteen mukaan voi olla myös mahdollista, että ennen työsuhteen alkua vaadimme valitulta henkilöltä tartuntatautilain pykälä 48 mukainen rokotussuojan (joko rokotuksen tai sairastetun taudin antama suoja tuhkarokkoa ja vesirokkoa vastaan).

Mitä työssä menestyminen edellyttää?
* Aiempi kokemus alalta sekä puhtaus- ja kiinteistöpalvelualan tutkinto katsotaan eduksi
* Ilahdumme erityisesti, mikäli sinulla on aiempaa kokemusta sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon kohteiden siivouksesta
* B-ajokorttia ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta työajoihin
* Huolellista ja vastuullista työotetta sekä hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja
* Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa(Fluency in Finnish is a requirement for this position)


Miksi Luotealle töihin?
Me Luoteallapidämme aidosti huolta työntekijöistämme ja haluamme, että viihdyt ja voit hyvin joka päivä. Saat meistä rinnallesi luotettavan ja luotsaavan suomalaisen työnantajan, joka toimii vastuullisesti, pitää lupauksensa sekä huolen siitä, että palkanmaksusi on ajallaan.
Perehdytämme sinut huolella työsuhteen käytäntöihin ja työtehtäviisi, sekä erikseen jokaiseen kohteeseen, jossa työskentelet. Käyttöösi saat asianmukaiset ja modernit työvarusteet. Meillä et jää yksin, vaan sinulla on aina saatavilla esihenkilösi tuki.
Osaavat työntekijät ovat meille tärkeä voimavara ja kannustamme henkilöstöämme osaamisen kehittämiseen ja kouluttautumiseen. Meillä työskentelevillä on mahdollisuus kehittää omaa ammattitaitoaan esimerkiksi suorittamalla ammattitutkinto tai sen osia.
Meillä saat myös työterveyshuollon tuen, joka tuo turvaa arkeen. Päätoimisille (20 h/vko tai enemmän) tarjoamme laajemmat palvelut ja osa-aikaisille (alle 20 h/vko) tarjoamme hoitajan sairausvastaanoton. Yli 20 tuntia viikossa työskentelevillä on lisäksi kattava sairaskassa lääkkeisiin, silmälaseihin ja lääkärikäynteihin.

Miten haet meille?
Hakemukset kulkevat meillä vain hakulomakkeen kautta: näin varmistamme reilun pelin ja tietosuojan. Klikkaa itsesi hae -painikkeen kautta hakulomakkeelle ja kerro meille, mikä tekisi sinusta meille sopivan työntekijän.

Miten rekrytointi etenee?
Hakuaika tehtävään päättyy 25.8.2026, mutta käsittelemme hakemuksia ja etenemme rekrytointiprosessissa jo hakuajan aikana, joten kannattaa toimia nopeasti.Kun rekrytointi etenee seuraaviin vaiheisiin, otamme sinuun yhteyttä joko puhelimitse tai sähköpostitse. Varmuuden vuoksi kannattaa tarkistaa ajoittain myös roskaposti.
Jos jokin mietityttää, laita viestiä rekry@luotea.com. Psst! Muista liittää viestiisi haun viisinumeroinen pyynnön tunnus (löytyy ilmoituksen yläreunasta).

Pintaa syvemmälle –Luotea
Luotea on kiinteistöalan palveluyritys, joka tarjoaa kokonaisvaltaisia ratkaisuja kiinteistöjen koko elinkaarelle, yhdistäen energiatehokkuuden ja älykkään teknologian. Näin parannamme kiinteistöjen arvoa ja luomme parhaat mahdolliset olosuhteet kiinteistöjen käyttäjille.
Palveluihimme kuuluvat monipuoliset ja edistykselliset kiinteistöjen ylläpito-, tekniikka- ja asiantuntijapalvelut sekä siivous- ja tukipalvelut. Kasvamme kannattavasti ja huomioimme toimintamme vaikutukset kiinteistöihin, ympäristöön ja yhteiskuntaan. Luotea toimii Suomessa ja Ruotsissa. Yhtiön liikevaihto vuonna 2024 oli 346 miljoonaa euroa ja yhtiö työllistää noin 5000 henkilöä. Luotea on listattu Nasdaq Helsingissä. https://www.luotea.com/fi/
Avainsanat: Luotea, puhtaanapito, kiinteistöpalvelut, kunnossapito, siivooja, siivoojia, kokoaikainen, kokoaikatyö, Rovaniemi

Ottaisitko siis urasi seuraavan askeleen hyvässä seurassa, omiesi joukossa?

title: Pattern Technologist
description:
Pattern Technologist

(Based at Ratmalana)

The Bodywear Value Stream of MAS Holdings delivers end-to-end design, innovation and manufacturing solutions across lingerie, swimwear and next-to-skin categories. It brings together broad expertise in fit, comfort, performance and aesthetics to serve leading global brands at scale.
With design and innovation hubs in Sri Lanka, the USA, Canada and Hong Kong and manufacturing operations across Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, India, Vietnam, Indonesia and Kenya, Bodywear offers a diverse portfolio spanning bras, briefs, shapewear, sleepwear, performance bodywear and Olympic grade swimwear. The value stream portfolio includes Victoria’s Secret, Calvin Klein, Marks & Spencer, Triumph, Speedo and Aerie. Positioned as a global centre of excellence, the Bodywear Value Stream combines advanced product innovation, technology-led solutions and operational scale to meet evolving consumer expectations across intimate and swim categories.

⁠⁠Empower transformation by becoming a driving force of change at MAS. We are on the lookout for a dedicated individual to accept and develop a product (style) for correct fit and construction by getting technical leadership and working with the internal (IE/ Sew tech/ Bonding Tech/ molding tech/ costing and development merchandizing) and external (customer) in achieving total calendar timelines.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Understand the fit and pattern blocks to be used and fill the DMQ with a pattern and product perspective.

  • Maintain budget RMC, Embellishment and Material Percentage to the assigned target. Work with Garment technical, Consumption team continuous basis and adjust the workings accordingly.

  • Help improve Chassis alignment at loading stage for the JV by reducing the number of chasiss and standardizing operations while maintaining toolbox adherence of 80% for all internal development.

  • Ensure pattern issuance target per the month, on time performance and the pattern accuracy expectations are met and stick to the target set by the management.

  • Identify the correct fit & construction requirement of a style & develop patterns, arrange style file, following up the sample progress with garment tech and send the samples to customer with proper review. Work with development merchandizing team to ensure meeting style calendar dates & customer communication.

  • Liaise with production teams to transfer the product development knowledge into production in an effective manner in order to ensure optimum production performance.

  • Ensure the product risk are thoroughly evaluated with Garment technologist team and proper actions are documented and drive to mitigate the risk.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS :

  • Degree in Apparel or Textile from a recognized university.

  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience in similar capacity.

  • Advanced knowledge of fit evaluation of close-body garments and the pattern making skills for 3D contouring garments (Bra and Tights)

  • Experience in handling pattern making CAD software.

  • Advanced knowledge of different fabrics and trims in the industry and the effect of those behaviors in garment fit and construction.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
• Permanent role based in Melbourne
  • Join a collaborative team where you can work with modern cloud and data technologies while building products that improve the mortgage lifecycle.

We're REA
With bold and ambitious goals, REA Group is changing the way the world experiences property. No matter where you're at on your property journey, we're here to help with every step - whether that's finding or financing your next home.

Our people are the key to our success. At the heart of everything we do, is a thriving culture centred around high performance and care. We are purpose driven and collaborative, which drives innovation and our ability to make a real impact. As such, we’re proud to have been named in Australia’s “Top 5” Best Workplaces two years in a row, as well as being recognised as a Best Workplace for Women.

Where the team fits in

This role is based within the Mortgage Solutions team in the Financial Services business, supporting the Mortgage Choice and PropTrack brands. Mortgage Solutions provides lenders and mortgage brokers with tools that enhance efficiency in property valuation and risk assessment across the full mortgage lifecycle.

What the role is all about

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, implementing and maintaining our products in a collaborative team environment. You will work with a range of programming languages, databases and cloud technologies to deliver high-quality solutions.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, code, test and deploy data products using a variety of technologies and platforms
  • Maintain and enhance existing products, including bug fixes and BAU feature improvements
  • Ensure the reliability, availability and security of our systems and data
  • Play a key role in developing new services and modernising our existing technical infrastructure

Who we’re looking for

  • End-to-end ownership of the software product lifecycle, including design, coding, testing, release, and production support
  • Hands-on experience with AWS (Lambdas, RDS, Dynamo, S3, EC2)
  • Hands-on database development experience, including strong T-SQL and stored procedure skills
  • Proven experience in database design, data pipelines, and analytics platforms
  • Practical experience in performance tuning and optimization, applying secure coding practices, and designing for scalability, reliability, and resilience
  • Experience building ETL systems using technologies such as Airflow or SSIS
  • Experience building solutions with Node.js, TypeScript, and serverless environments
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and authentication schemes
  • Ability to deep-dive into data and APIs to diagnose issues and uncover insights
  • Understanding of BigQuery and data warehouse concepts
  • Experience working with build pipelines, Docker, and modern continuous integration and delivery practices
  • A genuine passion for data and for keeping up to date with modern data technologies

The REA experience

The physical, mental, emotional and financial health of our people is something we’ll never stop caring about. This is a place to learn and grow.

Some of our Perks & Benefits include:

  • A hybrid and flexible approach to working
  • Flexible leave options including, birthday leave and purchase additional leave
  • Flexible parental leave offering for primary and secondary carers
  • Our Because We Care program offers employees volunteering leave, community grants, matched payroll giving and our Community Café donates 100% of revenue to charity
  • Hackdays so you can bring your big ideas to life

Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We are committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity, equity and inclusion. We believe teams with diverse ideas and experiences are more creative, more eﬀective and fuel disruptive thinking. If you've got the skills, dedication and enthusiasm to learn but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

Join our Talent Neighbourhood

Keen to be part of REA but didn't find a perfect match with this opportunity? Perhaps the timing isn't right? You should join our Talent Neighbourhood!

title: Tjener med ansvar - Restaurant & Hotel
description:
Som tjener med ansvar får du en vigtig rolle i både den daglige service og i udviklingen af restaurantens vin- og selskabsforretning. 				 

				 

				
 
				
 
					
 Om stillingen 


 Vi søger en tjener med ansvar, som har lyst til at blive en vigtig del af Højmølle Kros videre udvikling. 


 Højmølle Kro har siden januar 2024 arbejdet med et restaurantkoncept med både set-menu og à la carte. Konceptet er fortsat under udvikling, og vi leder efter en person, som har lyst til at være med til at påvirke restaurantens videre retning. 


 Hovedfokus er de lokale gæster, og ambitionen er at skabe restaurantoplevelser, som gæsterne kommer for - ikke kun for maden, men for den samlede oplevelse. 


 Menuen udskiftes løbende for at følge sæsonerne og samtidig holde restauranten relevant for de lokale gæster. 


 Som tjener med ansvar får du en vigtig rolle i både den daglige service og i udviklingen af restaurantens vin- og selskabsforretning. 


 Vin og sommelieransvar 


 Vi søger en tjener med godt kendskab til vin. Du er gerne uddannet sommelier eller har et ønske om at udvikle dig i den retning. 


 Hvis du har ambitionerne, men endnu ikke har taget sommelieruddannelsen, vil vi gerne investere i det rette match og betale for kurset. 


 Du får blandt andet ansvar for: 

 

 

 Udarbejdelse af vinmenuer til restaurantens signaturmenuer 

 


 

 Bestilling af vin til vinmenuerne 

 


 

 Videre udvikling af vinkortet 

 


 

 Ansvar for vinkælderen 

 


 

 Udvikling af vinområdet sammen med restaurantens øvrige team 

 

 

 Der vil være to tjenere i teamet, som er forholdsvis nye inden for vin, og som starter på sommelierforløbet snarest. Du får derfor også en naturlig rolle i forhold til at dele din viden og understøtte deres udvikling. 


 Ansvar for selskaber og arrangementer 


 Højmølle Kro har et selskabslokale med plads til omkring 100 gæster, hvor vi afholder livets store begivenheder, konferencer og andre arrangementer. 


 Interessen for selskabslokalet er stor, og vi ønsker at sætte endnu mere fokus på denne del af forretningen. Ambitionen er blandt andet at få fyldt flere lørdage i kalenderen. 


 Der vil i den nærmeste fremtid blive investeret i at få mest muligt ud af lokalet, og der er planer om renovering. 


 Som en del af din rolle bliver du ansvarlig for: 

 

 

 At holde møder med kunder om selskaber og konferencer 

 


 

 At lukke aftaler vedrørende selskaber og arrangementer 

 


 

 Planlægning af selskaber og konferencer 

 


 

 Koordinering af de enkelte arrangementer 

 


 

 At være ansvarlig for afviklingen af de planlagte selskaber afhængigt af vagtplanen 

 

 

 Restaurant, selskaber og hotel 


 Til Højmølle Kro hører også en hotelbygning med 22 værelser, som løbende skal renoveres. 


 Det betyder, at vi også har en del overnattende gæster. Tidligere har der ikke været samme fokus på, at hotellets gæster skulle vælge restauranten som en del af deres ophold. Det ønsker vi at ændre. 


 Siden starten af 2026, hvor vi overtog hoteldriften, har vi blandt andet udviklet forskellige opholdspakker. Det er et område, som vi ønsker at promovere og udvikle yderligere i fremtiden. 


 Du bliver derfor en del af en virksomhed, hvor restaurant, selskaber og hotel udvikles side om side. 


 Vi er ikke som sådan en sæsonforretning og holder åbent alle årets måneder, dog med enkelte ugers lukning i løbet af året. 


 Vi forventer, at du 

 

 

 Har erfaring som tjener 

 


 

 Har et godt kendskab til vin 

 


 

 Gerne er uddannet sommelier eller har lyst til at tage et sommelierforløb 

 


 

 Har interesse for vin, gastronomi og gode gæsteoplevelser 

 


 

 Har erfaring med selskaber, konferencer eller arrangementer 

 


 

 Kan tage ansvar og arbejde selvstændigt 

 


 

 Har lyst til at være med til at udvikle restaurantens koncept og forretning 

 


 

 Arbejder struktureret og kan bevare overblikket 

 


 

 Er serviceminded og professionel i mødet med gæster 

 


 

 Har lyst til at bidrage til teamets udvikling 

 

 

 Vi tilbyder 

 

 

 En central rolle i en restaurant og hotelvirksomhed i udvikling 

 


 

 Ansvar for vinmenuer, vinkort og vinkælder 

 


 

 Mulighed for at få betalt et sommelierkursus 

 


 

 Ansvar for selskaber, konferencer og arrangementer 

 


 

 Mulighed for at præge restaurantens videre udvikling 

 


 

 En arbejdsplads med fokus på lokale gæster og gode oplevelser 

 


 

 Mulighed for at arbejde på tværs af restaurant, selskaber og hotel 

 

 

 Om Højmølle Kro 


 Højmølle Kro er en restaurant og kro med tilhørende hotel. Restauranten arbejder med både set-menu og à la carte og udvikler fortsat på konceptet. 


 Fokus er på de lokale gæster, sæsonernes råvarer og på at skabe restaurantoplevelser, som gæsterne har lyst til at vende tilbage til. 


 Med restaurant, selskabslokale med plads til omkring 100 gæster og 22 hotelværelser er der flere dele af forretningen, som skal udvikles yderligere i de kommende år.

title: Formsnickare till Forsmark
description:
Formsnickare till Forsmark

Vi söker erfarna snickare med god formkunskap till Forsmark som har erfarenhet av avancerad formsättning.

I tjänsten kommer du även att samarbeta nära med kollegor inom armering och gjutning. Som snickare blir du en viktig del av projektet och behöver därför ha gedigen erfarenhet, god yrkeskunskap och förståelse för arbetet.

Krav:

  • Gedigen erfarenhet inom snickeri
  • Erfarenhet av storform, systemform och stomme
  • Förmåga att läsa och arbeta efter ritningar
  • God kommunikationsförmåga på svenska
  • Yrkesbevis eller motsvarande, alternativt minst 6 års dokumenterad erfarenhet
  • Svenskt medborgarskap

Meriterande:

  • Heta arbeten

Vi erbjuder:
