title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Helsinki, Huopalahti
description:
Etsitkö ihmisläheistä työtä, jossa pääset tärkeäksi osaksi toisen ihmisen arkea? Henkilökohtaisena avustajana pääset tukemaan asiakasta niissä tilanteissa, joissa hän tarvitsee toisen ihmisen apua esimerkiksi liikkumisessa, kodin askareissa tai vapaa-ajan toiminnassa. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan tarkoitus on tukea asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta ja mahdollisuutta elää omannäköistä elämää.

Henkilökohtaisen avustajan työ on maanläheistä ja tilanteisiin mukautuvaa. Päivät voivat vaihdella paljon, ja tehtävät suunnitellaan aina asiakkaan tarpeiden mukaan. Aiempaa kokemusta tehtävästä ei tarvita, sillä perehdytämme sinut työhön. Olemme työnantajana aina helposti tavoitettavissa ja tukenasi, jotta työ sujuu turvallisesti ja luontevasti.


Etsimme nyt osa-aikaista henkilökohtaista avustajaa asiakkaallemme Helsingin Huopalahteen. Asiakas on nainen, joka tarvitsee apua arjen askareissa, kuten kotitöissä. Avustajan on oltava vastuuntuntoinen ja luotettava.

Työvuoroja on yleensä kerran viikossa maanantaisin joko klo 9-13 tai 16-20.

Työhön valitulta henkilöltä vaaditaan rikostaustaselvitys vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työskentelyä varten (Laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta).

Toivomme, että olet:
- Oma-aloitteinen
- Luotettava
- Empaattinen

Työ alkaa mahdollisimman pian tai sopimuksen mukaan. Aloitamme haastattelut ennen hakuajan päättymistä ja tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Elämäsi Adato – Sinun elämäsi, sinä päätät
Elämäsi Adato Oy on suomalainen perheyritys, joka on täysin erikoistunut henkilökohtaisen avun järjestämiseen jo yli 15 vuoden ajan. Tavoitteenamme on auttaa jokaista asiakasta toimimaan arjen tilanteissa turvallisesti ja omien toiveidensa mukaisesti, niin että itsemääräämisoikeus säilyy kaikissa päivän kulkuun liittyvissä asioissa.

Haluamme olla asiakkaillemme luotettava kumppani heidän jokapäiväisessä elämässään ja työntekijöillemme välittävä ja joustava työnantaja. Meillä työskentely on konkreettista, ihmisläheistä ja merkityksellistä.

Työllistämme yli 300 henkilökohtaista avustajaa eri puolilla Suomea. Kasvamme vastuullisesti, ihmisten tarpeita kuunnellen.

title: Marine Technical Advisor
description:
As a Marine Technical Advisor, you will play a critical role in managing Viva Energy's shipping and marine risk, ensuring compliance with international maritime regulations, industry standards and company assurance processes.

Working within the Marine Technical team, you will provide expert advice across the business, supporting Supply, Refining and Commercial operations while partnering closely with marine terminals, vessel operators, regulators and industry stakeholders.

The role combines technical expertise, stakeholder engagement, operational assurance and leadership, with travel required to locations where we operate across Australia.

Key Responsibilities

Marine Assurance & Vetting

  • Conduct vessel vetting to ensure vessels and barges engaged by Viva Energy meet company standards and industry best practice.
  • Manage marine assurance processes to support compliance with IMO conventions, local regulations and industry guidelines.
  • Conduct audits of Viva Energy and third-party marine terminals across Australia.
  • Conduct management reviews of ship owners and operators.

Operational Support

  • Provide technical advice on shipping and marine operations.
  • Support marine terminals with ship/shore interface management.
  • Investigate and advise on operational issues including cargo contamination, product quality and quantity disputes, and marine incidents.
  • Assist with oil spill preparedness activities and incident response.
  • Work closely with bunker barges operating in Brisbane, Sydney and Melbourne.
  • Train and mentor shore-based personnel on marine operations, risk management and assurance requirements.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Represent Viva Energy with regulators, port authorities, ship owners, and industry associations
  • Maintain strong relationships with shipping partners, marine service providers and industry bodies including OCIMF.
  • Support business development initiatives through technical advice and innovative maritime supply chain solutions.

About you

You are a respected maritime professional with extensive tanker operations experience and the credibility to influence stakeholders from frontline operators through to senior executives.

You will bring:

Essential Qualifications & Experience

  • Master Unlimited or Chief Engineer Unlimited Certificate of Competency with an Oil Tanker endorsement.
  • Senior sea-going experience on oil tankers.
  • Strong understanding of ship vetting, marine assurance and maritime risk management.
  • Knowledge of international and Australian maritime regulations and industry standards.
  • Proven leadership and stakeholder management capability.

Desirable

  • Lead Auditor. Training.
  • Experience with oil spill preparedness and incident response.
  • Familiarity with Australian shipping and bunker operations.
  • Exposure to CPP tanker operations, particularly within the Asia-Pacific region.
  • Experience with ship/shore interface management and terminal operations.

What Success Looks Like

  • You will be successful in this role if you can:
  • Manage maritime risk to protect Viva Energy's people, assets, reputation and customers.
  • Drive continuous improvement while maintaining industry-leading safety performance.
  • Communicate complex maritime issues clearly to stakeholders at all levels.
  • Influence outcomes with regulators, industry bodies and external partners.
  • Provide practical, commercially focused solutions to technical and operational challenges.

Why Join Viva Energy?

This is a rare opportunity to transition your senior maritime expertise into a highly influential role where you will help shape marine assurance standards across a major Australian energy business. You'll work alongside experienced professionals, contribute to critical operational decisions and play a key role in ensuring safe, efficient and compliant marine operations nationwide.

If you're a Master Unlimited or Chief Engineer with extensive oil tanker experience and a passion for marine safety, assurance and operational excellence, we'd love to hear from you.

About Viva Energy

Join a team that values diversity. Viva Energy is a great place to be yourself. We believe in our people, trust in their positive intentions, and empower everyone to amplify their voice across the business. We value inclusion because that’s how we get the best outcomes.

Awarded the WGEA Employer of Choice for Gender Equality for the past five years highlights that we are driven by our people and continuing our focus on making Viva Energy reflect the ever-changing face of Australia.

We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and encourage and support diversity in our traditional and non-traditional roles.

At Viva Energy Australia, we believe flexibility is the new normal. We are open to flexibility options including hybrid, part-time, job-share and flexibility in start and finish times. We are happy to explore what this could look like for you during the recruitment process.

Please note: This role is being sourced through Viva Energy Australia, therefore we will not be accepting applications via external recruitment agencies.

Only applications from candidates holding full working rights for employment in Australia will be considered.

title: Salesforcekonsult Stockholm
description:

Sopra Steria är en stolt Summit Partner med Salesforce och har en stark position i Europa. Nu söker vi fler medlemmar till vårt Salesforce-team som vill kombinera strategisk rådgivning och teknisk implementation för att optimera våra kunders affärsprocesser. Är du redo att arbeta med de senaste teknologierna och vara en del av ett globalt nätverk där innovation och samhällsnytta står i fokus? Då är detta rollen för dig!

Vi söker dig med gedigen erfarenhet av Salesforce som kan arbeta både med strategisk rådgivning och praktisk konfiguration. I rollen kommer du att:

  • Arbeta med lösningsdesign och implementering av Salesforce-projekt, inklusive nya funktioner och optimering av befintliga lösningar.
  • Implementera och konfigurera Salesforce-applikationer, såsom Sales Cloud och Service Cloud.
  • Automatisera processer med verktyg som Salesforce Flow Builder och andra low-code-lösningar.
  • Leda workshops och kravinsamling med kunder.
  • Ge rådgivning om hur Salesforce kan användas för att skapa affärsnytta.
  • Delta i projekt med nya teknologier som Agentforce, Data Cloud och Revenue Cloud.

Kvalifikationer

  • 3–5 års erfarenhet av Salesforce, inklusive kravanalys, lösningsdesign och konfiguration.
  • Erfarenhet av Salesforce Core Clouds: Sales, Service och Experience Cloud.
  • Kompetens inom Salesforce-konfiguration, särskilt Flow Builder och low-code-automation.
  • Erfarenhet av nya teknologier, som Generative AI och integrationslösningar.
  • Kunskap i kravinsamling, projektledning och agila arbetsmetoder.
  • Förmåga att agera rådgivare, förstå kundbehov och översätta dem till värdeskapande lösningar.
  • Flytande svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift.

Meriterande

  • Salesforce-certifieringar: Salesforce Administrator, Salesforce App Builder.
  • Kunskap om Salesforce AI-funktionalitet, gärna visad genom certifieringen AI Specialist.

Varför välja oss?
Hos Sopra Steria får du mer än bara ett jobb – du blir en del av ett team som värdesätter gemenskap och personlig utveckling. Vi tror på balans mellan arbete och fritid och erbjuder en arbetsplats där du verkligen kan växa och bidra till samhällets digitalisering. Som en del av vårt växande Salesforce-team får du tillgång till ett globalt nätverk och möjligheten att arbeta i spännande projekt med hög teknisk nivå.

Bli en del av vårt team!
Känner du att detta är rätt möjlighet för dig? Tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag! Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande och kallar till intervjuer kontinuerligt. Rekryteringsprocessen består av tre intervjuer och ett logiskt- och personlighetstest.

På Sopra Steria ställer vi höga krav på både kompetens och säkerhetsmedvetenhet hos våra medarbetare. Innan en eventuell anställning kommer du därför att genomgå en bakgrundskontroll, och vid intervju behöver du kunna uppvisa giltig legitimation

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Job Description:

The Sr. Staff Platform / Data Reliability Engineer is responsible for making Databricks a reliable, secure, scalable, and operationally mature platform for enterprise use. This role focuses on the platform itself rather than domain-specific business modeling, ensuring the lakehouse can support multiple domains, regulated data handling, and a growing set of production workloads without becoming fragile, expensive, or hard to govern.

This role partners closely with the Senior Staff Data Engineer, who focuses more heavily on ingestion and medallion implementation patterns, and with the existing Cloud & Infrastructure team, which owns cloud accounts, networking, and foundational infrastructure. The Platform / Data Reliability Engineer owns the Databricks operational layer that sits above that foundation: reliability, observability, deployment standards, compute and job policies, and platform enablement patterns for internal users.

What you'll do:

    • Own operational excellence for the Databricks platform, including monitoring, alerting, observability, incident response support, and production runbook patterns for data jobs and platform services.

    • Define and maintain CI/CD and promotion standards for Databricks assets, including workflows, jobs, notebooks, code packages, infrastructure configuration, and environment promotion from dev to prod.

    • Design and maintain platform standards for job orchestration, cluster and compute policies, service principal usage, environment isolation, and production execution reliability.

    • Establish reusable operational templates and enablement patterns for new domains onboarding to Databricks, including logging conventions, job tagging, metadata capture, and support handoff expectations.

    • Partner with the Senior Data Engineer to ensure ingestion and medallion patterns are implemented in a way that is observable, recoverable, cost-aware, and secure in production.

    • Work with the cloud/infrastructure team to align Databricks configuration and usage patterns with broader enterprise cloud standards, especially where commercial and future government-hosted environments are involved.

    • Help enforce technical controls for data segregation, access boundaries, and operational compliance in a highly regulated environment.

    • Track and improve platform health metrics such as job success rates, incident trends, data pipeline reliability, cost efficiency, and environment drift.

    • Document platform standards, operational expectations, and support models so the Databricks platform can scale beyond a small founding team.

    • Mentor internal engineers who are growing into platform responsibilities, helping expand Databricks operational knowledge within the team.

    Required qualifications:

title: Lead Information Security Engineer
description:
Security Architecture and Cyber Defence

InfoSec covers a vast domain of knowledge within the organization. Our mission is to embed security excellence in our business to foster client trust and increase Thoughtworker confidence. Security is an integral part of the change Thoughtworks brings to clients and the industry. We make the right things easy to do. InfoSec work includes security consulting, risk management, cyber security, incident response, and more. InfoSec is a distributed team, spread across the Americas, Europe, India, China, Southeast Asia, and Australia.

The Security Architecture and Cyber Defence functions within InfoSec work closely together to improve Thoughtworks' collective security posture. Security Architecture connects incidents, risks, priorities, and initiatives into a whole-of-business security plan of work and partners with other business functions to deliver on those plans; leads our offensive security testing program; and secures our adoption of AI and agentic systems. The Security Engineering function within the Cyber Defence team builds and operates many of the tools, platforms, and controls that put these strategies into practice. Together, these teams are a trusted source of security know-how for Thoughtworkers and a partner to business and technology teams across the organisation.

This role will be situated in India. The role is remote first, with some expectation to be able to work from the closest Thoughtworks office on a regular cadence. Calls and collaboration outside standard local business hours are a normal and expected part of the role.

Job responsibilities:

The Senior Security Consultant is a hands-on, technical role that sits across both the Security Architecture and Security Engineering teams, reporting to the Head of Security Architecture. You will work as a practitioner, reading and contributing to code, operating and extending security tooling, running projects and workstreams, and working directly with engineering and product teams across the business. You will be expected to lead initiatives independently, drive them to completion, and represent the security function credibly with stakeholders at all levels.

Technical depth and human skills are equally important in this role. Working across a distributed, multicultural organisation means that trust and clear communication are the mechanism by which the technical work gets done. The ability to build solid working relationships across functions, time zones, and cultures is a core part of what we are looking for.

Essential job duties and responsibilities

1. Security architecture and posture improvement

  • Lead and contribute to hands-on security architecture initiatives across multi-functional, multi-disciplinary teams, bringing technical know-how, a strong security mindset, and project leadership skills.
  • Work in ongoing partnership with the internal application security team to harden the organisation's security posture across our estate.
  • Review and threat model system and application designs, identify security gaps, and provide actionable, constructive recommendations that teams can implement without stalling delivery.
    • While AI tooling is in active use in the team, candidates will be expected to demonstrate a baseline capability to recognise, describe, and suggest improvements to common software and system architecture patterns, integration strategies, etc without AI assistance.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of security standards, processes, and patterns for the broader organisation.
  • Harden the security architecture of our cloud-based and SaaS-based estates, including identity, network exposure, and configuration.

2. Offensive security and AI agent security

  • Review AI system designs and guardrail implementations, and give security-by-design feedback before deployment.
  • Test AI and LLM-backed applications and agents for security weaknesses, including prompt injection, tool and MCP integration security, excessive agency, and identity and authorisation issues.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline security standards and to hardening the paths by which company software reaches production.
  • Plan and run offensive security tests across web applications, APIs, cloud environments, and other infrastructure, combining manual testing with automated and agentic AI tooling. The emphasis is on judgement and quality of findings rather than volume.
  • Validate, triage, and de-duplicate findings, and support engineering teams through remediation and re-testing with clear, actionable reporting.

2. Security engineering

  • Write and contribute to scripts, automation, and tooling to support security operations and testing workflows. While AI tooling is used within the team for code generation and other activities, candidates will be expected to demonstrate that they can read and describe what a codebase, snippet, or script does without AI assistance.
  • Support the evaluation and integration of new security tools and platforms, with a focus on practical capability and operational fit.
  • Operate, maintain, and extend our SIEM (Google SecOps), including implementing new connectors to data sources, tuning detection rules, and improving alert quality to reduce noise and increase signal.
  • Contribute to SOAR playbook development to automate containment and response actions.
  • Contribute to incident response and post-incident review activity, including analysis, containment support, and improvement of detections.

Skills and experience

Required

  • At least 5-7 years of hands-on experience in information security, spanning security engineering, testing, or architecture.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead initiatives across multi-disciplinary teams, manage competing priorities, and drive work to completion.
  • Ability to read, reason about, and contribute to code and scripts as a working practitioner. The use of AI-assisted and AI-driven coding tools is a common practice within the team. However, the right candidate should be able to read and explain the basic functionality of unobfuscated code without AI assistance.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with different types of audiences, including explaining technical risk to non-technical stakeholders and working constructively with engineering teams who may be new to security engagement. The ability to build trust and working relationships across the organisation is a core competency of this role.
  • Comfort working across different cultural contexts, time zones, and communication styles. Our team is global, and the ability to adapt your communication and collaboration approach accordingly is essential.
  • A high standard of written and spoken English.

Highly desirable

  • Practical experience assessing and improving security posture in cloud environments (AWS, GCP), including identity, network exposure, and configuration.
  • Familiarity with AI system security, or a strong interest and foundational understanding (prompt injection, agent and tool security, the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications).
  • Experience contributing to or leading security architecture discussions across multi-functional teams, and confidence in giving security input at the design stage of the SDLC.
  • Practical experience operating and tuning a SIEM (experience with Google SecOps is a strong advantage. Demonstrated depth in any enterprise SIEM is acceptable). Experience implementing log sources and connectors and developing detection content.
  • Hands-on experience with penetration testing across web, API, and cloud environments, with working knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security Top 10. Depth in one or more areas is valued.

Education and certification requirements

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, information assurance, MIS, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Certification: CISSP, CCSP, SANS certifications (e.g., GSEC, GCIH, GCIA) a plus.

Traits we are looking for in a candidate:

  • Have a solid moral compass on which to base your security work. Understand the difference between finding a weakness and the responsible handling of it
  • Strong empathy, including the ability to understand where a colleague or team is coming from, meet them there, and build trust across technical and non-technical boundaries
  • Ability to communicate effectively to different types of audiences, adapting style and register as needed
  • Ability to categorise, visualise, and present findings to stakeholders
  • Strong interest in continued learning in the security domain, particularly as AI tools reshape the threat landscape and the way we work
  • Understanding of how security vulnerabilities translate into business risks
  • Capable of self-management while following broad strategic objectives on a distributed, autonomous team
  • Strong sense of commitment and delivery
  • Ability to prioritise and handle unplanned work

Other things to know

Learning & Development

There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.

Onsite Work Expectation

You may be expected to work out of our Thoughtworks office or at our client's office location for all five working days of the week, depending on business or clients’ needs.

About Thoughtworks

Thoughtworks is a global technology consultancy that integrates strategy, design and engineering to drive digital innovation. For 30+ years, our clients have trusted our autonomous teams to build solutions that look past the obvious. Here, computer science grads come together with seasoned technologists, self-taught developers, midlife career changers and more to learn from and challenge each other. Career journeys flourish with the strength of our cultivation culture, which has won numerous awards around the world.

Join Thoughtworks and thrive. Together, our extra curiosity, innovation, passion and dedication overcomes ordinary.

See here our AI policy.

title: Er du vores nye teamleder, som vi skal byde velkommen til Boligerne ved Grønningen, hvor vi sammen skaber en meningsfuld og berigende hverdag for borgerne samt et godt arbejdsmiljø?
description:
Tre citater fra medarbejdere i din levegruppe:

"Grønningen er en skøn arbejdsplads med kontinuerlig personlig og faglig udvikling. Jeg lærer noget nyt hver dag"

"Grønningen er en organisation med stor diversitet. Det gør, at vi som personale har mange forskellige faglige kompetencer at trække på i vores arbejde med hinanden og vores borgere."

"Vores motto på Grønningen er, at "vi har brug for hinanden". En god huskeregel, når uenighed opstår eller hverdagen bare føles travl."

Alice, pårørende til en borger:

”Jeg har oplevet lidt af hvert med min datter på botilbud for voksne med handicap.

Det vigtigste er god ledelse med de rette faglige kompetencer, der kan tage hånd om personalet, kender beboerne og deres pårørende og kan indgå i et positivt samarbejde.

Det er også meget vigtigt, at medarbejderne kommer på faglige kurser og bliver dygtige til at håndtere svære situationer med beboerne. Alt dette fungerer på Grønningen.”

Er det citater fra medarbejder og pårørende, som du kan se dig selv i, - som vores kommende teamleder! Så synes vi, at du skal læse videre.

I Boligerne ved Grønningen bor der 24 borgere i alderen fra 19 og op efter fordelt i 3 levegrupper. 10 borgere benytter vores eget aktivitets- og samværstilbud, der ligger tæt ved. Borgerne har alle betydeligt nedsat fysisk og psykisk funktionsevne og Autismespektrumforstyrrelser. Grønningen er oprettet efter ABL §105 og SEL §§ 85, 104.


Vores pædagogiske tilgang?

Vi tager afsæt i viden om autismespektrumforstyrrelser, low arousal, neuropædagogisk referenceramme og blindepædagogiske metoder for at skabe et miljø, der understøtter borgernes ressourcer.

Som teamleder er din opgave at fremme samarbejde, udvikle teamarbejde og styrke det pædagogiske arbejde baseret på borgernes ressourcer og behov. Du skal sikre den røde tråd i vores arbejde, sikre kontinuitet og have fokus på et positivt arbejdsmiljø samt støtte og udvikle pårørendesamarbejdet.

Hvad kan vi tilbyde dig?

  • En spændende organisation, hvor du får mulighed for at være med til at videreudvikle vores tilbud
  • Du vil blive en fast del af en engageret ledergruppe, hvor din erfaring, kompetencer, og idéer vil blive værdsat
  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø. Arbejd i en organisation med højt til loftet, fokus på kerneopgaven og et
  • godt arbejdsmiljø
  • Vi bygger på tillid, ansvar og ligeværd – hele vejen rundt

Hvem er du?

  • Du har erfaring med ledelse og har en pædagogisk uddannelse
  • Du er motiveret for at arbejde med ledelse i en teambaseret pædagogisk organisation
  • Er samarbejdsaktiv i en hverdag fyldt med mange forskellige ledelsesmæssige udfordringer
  • Kan fastholde den røde tråd i arbejdet, planlægge, organisere og arbejde struktureret i en travl hverdag
  • Er en synlig og empatisk leder, som arbejder omsorgsfuldt og tålmodigt, og som har etikken med i dit virke


Teamledelsens opgaver

Som teamleder har du ansvar for at styrke samarbejde, trivsel og faglig udvikling blandt både medarbejdere og ledere. Du arbejder med kompetenceudvikling, supervision og sparring med fokus på at udvikle den pædagogiske praksis og sikre et struktureret og forudsigeligt miljø med udgangspunkt i borgernes ressourcer og trivsel.

Du har desuden fokus på dokumentation i det pædagogiske arbejde, herunder mål og delmål samt på at skabe et godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor både den enkelte og fællesskabet trives. Derudover indgår du aktivt i samarbejdet med pårørende og understøtter medarbejderne i den fortsatte udvikling af dette samarbejde.

Så, hvad siger du? Er du klar til at være en del af os på Grønningen?

Vi håber virkelig, at du har lyst til at være med!

Få mere at vide

Du er velkommen til at kontakte teamleder Maria Schneider på tlf. 21 54 58 23 eller Karna Christiansen tlf. 92 43 53 62 på hverdage mellem kl. 8-10.

Læs mere om os på vores hjemmeside Boligerne ved Grønningen

title: Business Performance Improvement- Experienced Senior Consultant
description:
JOB REQUISITION

Business Performance Improvement- Experienced Senior Consultant

LOCATION

CHICAGO

ADDITIONAL LOCATION(S)

HOUSTON

JOB DESCRIPTION

You Belong Here

The Protiviti Career provides opportunity to learn, inspire, and advance within a collaborative and inclusive culture. We hire curious individuals for whom learning is a passion. We lean into our mission: We Care. We Collaborate. We Deliver.

At every level, we champion leaders who live our values of integrity, inclusion, innovation, and commitment to success. Imagining our work as a journey, we believe integrity guides our way, inclusion moves us forward together, innovation creates new destinations, and our commitment to success empowers us to deliver on our vision to be the most trusted global consulting firm.

Where We Need You

Protiviti is looking for a Supply Chain & Operations Experienced Senior Consultant to join our growing Supply Chain & Operations Innovation team.

What You Can Expect

As an Experienced Senior Consultant, you will be a mentor, trainer, and coach to Interns and Consultants as you facilitate the successful completion of project work plans. You’ll identify areas of risk and opportunities to increase efficiency. You’ll strengthen relationships and deepen your abilities to communicate, gain trust, and network with client personnel and professional associates. At the direction of Managers, you may accept responsibility for decision-making in areas including establishing project scope and work plans, project staffing, preparation of deliverables, and application of methodologies.

What Will Help You Be Successful

  • You enjoy process, relevant analytics and metrics, organization, and strategic design.

  • You are motivated to learn and interested in all things related to strategic sourcing and supplier management, including the latest trends and developments.

  • You are passionate about building relationships with clients and providing clients with exceptional experiences.

  • You have an inherent interest in project management and team leadership.

  • You contribute to a positive team culture that fosters open communication among all engagement team members.

  • You create development opportunities for others and ways for your team to improve our clients and communities.

  • You have interest in working with a diverse portfolio of clients across multiple industries.

Do Your Talents Include the Following?

  • Demonstrated experience with:

    • Core supply chain processes such as Strategic Sourcing, Procurement, Contract Management, Supplier Management, Accounts Payable

    • Designing and implementing digital supply chain solutions, applying technologies

    • Traditional technologies that support key supply chain functions, such as Contract Lifecycle Management, Source-to-Pay, Third Party Risk Management/Monitoring.

    • Process improvement, business transformation and project management methodologies (such as Lean, Agile, Change Management etc.)

    • Financial modeling and business case management

  • Evaluating, summarizing, organizing, and interpreting data.

  • Establishing and cultivating business relationships and a professional network.

  • Ability to translate and communicate supply chain topics and issues to client personnel, including executives.

  • Supervisory experience of teams including mentoring, oversight and review of work, coordination across teams, and understanding how to motivate.

  • Experience performing documentation of findings and summarizing recommendations.

Your Educational and Professional Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., Supply Chain, Operations, or Business Related Field).

  • 2+ years working in Supply Chain, Operations, Consulting, or related field, either in industry or professional services.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite applications with specific emphasis on Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Secondary emphasis on Visio, Access, and Tableau / Power BI.

  • Professional Certification such as CPM, CPSM, CSCP, CPIM, PMP, Six Sigma/ Lean Six Sigma, Certified Scrum Professional, are a plus.

Our Hybrid Workplace

Protiviti practices a hybrid model, which is a combination of working in person with a purpose locally, traveling to clients, and working remotely. This model creates meaningful experiences for our people and our clients while offering a flexible environment. The ratio of remote to in-person requirements vary by client, project, team, and other business factors. Our people work both in-person in local Protiviti offices and on client sites, which can include local or out-of-state travel based on our projects and client requests and commitments.

Starting salary is based on a full-time equivalent schedule. Placement in the range is dependent upon experience, skills and geographic work location. Below is the salary range for this job.

$92,000.00 - $138,000.00

Our annual bonus plan provides eligible employees additional cash and/or discretionary stock compensation opportunities. Below is the bonus target opportunity for this job.

10%

The total cash range is estimated from the sum of the base salary range plus the bonus target opportunity. Below is the estimated total cash range for this job.

$101,200.00 - $151,800.00

Employees are eligible for medical, dental, and vision coverages, FSA and HSA healthcare accounts, life and accident insurance, adoption and fertility assistance, paid parental leave up to 10 weeks, and short/long term disability. We offer eligible employees a company 401(k) savings and investment plan with an employer match of 50% on the first 6% of your contributions. We provide Choice Time Off (CTO) for vacation, personal needs, and sick time. The amount of (CTO) varies based on years of service. New hires receive up to 20 days of CTO per calendar year. Protiviti also recognizes up to 11 paid holidays each calendar year.

Learn more about the variety of rewards we offer at Protiviti at .

Any benefits outlined are part of our reward offerings for full-time employees in the U.S. Your Open Enrollment materials, insurance contracts, plan documents and Summary Plan Descriptions together comprise the official plan document which legally governs the administration of your benefit plans. Protiviti reserves the right to terminate or amend your benefit plans in any way and at any time.

Protiviti is an Equal Opportunity Employer. M/F/Disability/Veteran

As part of Protiviti’s employment process, any offer of employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check.

Protiviti is committed to being an equal employment employer offering opportunities to all job seekers, including individuals with disabilities. If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to apply for a position, please contact us by sending an email to HRSolutions@roberthalf.com or call 1.855.744.6947 for assistance.

 Har du lyst til at stå i spidsen for den daglige drift på en malkekvægsbedrift? 


   


 Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter! 


   


 Vi søger en engageret og ansvarsbevidst driftsleder til vores besætning på ca. 115 malkene køer + opdræt.

 Vi driver sideløbende anden mælkebedrift i nærheden med sparring 


   


 Ombygning til robotstald er i vores overvejelser 


   


 Lyder det som noget for dig?

title: Associate Director, Global Commercial & Medical Data Products
description:
Associate Director, Global Commercial & Medical Data Products

Location: Redwood City, California, United States

Department: Information Technology

Revolution Medicines is a late-stage clinical oncology company developing novel targeted therapies for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. The company’s R&D pipeline comprises RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to suppress diverse oncogenic variants of RAS proteins. The company’s RAS(ON) inhibitors daraxonrasib (RMC-6236), a RAS(ON) multi-selective inhibitor; elironrasib (RMC-6291), a RAS(ON) G12C-selective inhibitor; zoldonrasib (RMC-9805), a RAS(ON) G12D-selective inhibitor; and RMC-5127, a RAS(ON) G12V-selective inhibitor, are currently in clinical development. As a new member of the Revolution Medicines team, you will join other outstanding professionals in a tireless commitment to patients with cancers harboring mutations in the RAS signaling pathway.

The Opportunity

Revolution Medicines Information Sciences & Digital Innovation (ISDI) is seeking an Associate Director, Global Commercial & Medical Data Products to lead the strategy, evolution, and delivery of enterprise Commercial and Medical data products supporting international markets, with an initial focus on Europe and Japan.

Reporting to the Director, Commercial & Medical Data Solutions, this role translates regional Commercial and Medical priorities into scalable product capabilities that support customer engagement, omnichannel execution, analytics, Market Access, Medical Affairs, and commercial operations. Working across business, analytics, engineering, and technology teams, you will shape product roadmaps, recommend investment priorities, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

The role combines product leadership, commercial acumen, and technology expertise to build trusted enterprise data products that improve user experience, accelerate launch readiness, and create reusable global capabilities. You will continuously identify opportunities to leverage AI, intelligent automation, and advanced analytics to simplify workflows and improve commercial decision-making. Key responsibilities include:

  • Lead the product strategy and roadmap for global Commercial and Medical data products supporting Europe, Japan, and future international markets.

  • Partner with Commercial, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Analytics & Insights, Information Systems, and regional affiliates to translate business priorities into scalable product capabilities.

  • Prioritize product investments that improve launch readiness, customer engagement, omnichannel execution, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.

  • Collaborate with domain Product Owners to extend enterprise capabilities across international markets while maintaining global consistency.

  • Ensure enterprise data products meet expectations for governance, quality, interoperability, privacy, lineage, observability, and compliance.

  • Evaluate build, buy, partner, and integration options based on business value, scalability, maintainability, and user outcomes.

  • Identify opportunities to apply AI, intelligent automation, and advanced analytics to improve workflows and commercial decision-making.

  • Partner with Analytics & Insights, Data Science, and Engineering to prototype and deliver intelligent product capabilities.

  • Measure success through adoption, business outcomes, user satisfaction, and continuous product improvement.

  • Build trusted relationships with regional business leaders and technology partners to support ongoing global expansion.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Life Sciences, Analytics, or related discipline.

  • 10+ years of experience in Product Management, Commercial Data Products, Commercial Technology, CRM, Omnichannel, Commercial Analytics, or related disciplines within biotechnology, pharmaceutical, healthcare technology, or another regulated industry.

  • Demonstrated success defining product strategy, developing roadmaps, and delivering measurable business outcomes.

  • Experience supporting Commercial and/or Medical Affairs organizations.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise data products, governance, interoperability, metadata, lineage, privacy, and data quality.

  • Experience evaluating commercial platforms, vendor solutions, and enterprise integrations.

  • Familiarity with AI-enabled capabilities, automation, and advanced analytics.

  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder leadership skills across global organizations.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience supporting commercial launches across Europe and/or Japan.

  • Experience with Salesforce, Veeva CRM, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, PharmaForceIQ/Aktana, Databricks, or similar platforms.

  • Experience delivering enterprise Commercial or Medical data products.

  • Oncology, specialty pharmaceutical, or emerging biotechnology experience.

  • Experience applying AI and workflow automation to improve commercial capabilities.

title: Senior AI Test Engineer
description:
Senior AI Test Engineer (Remote)

Location: Remote

TestPros delivers innovative independent IT assessment solutions to critical challenges facing the nation and the world. We support the U.S. Federal/State/Local Government and Commercial clients within the continental USA. TestPros is dedicated to making lives better, safer and more secure.

TestPros is seeking a Senior Artificial Intelligence (AI) System Test Engineer with an analytical, customer-focused mindset and experience with the OWASP AI Testing Guide and other guidelines from NIST, ISO, and IEEE.

Start: Future projects in late 2026 or 2027 (not an immediate job opening)

Type: Part-time consulting

Overview

Focus: Software test end evaluation

Regulatory Basis: OWASP AI Testing Guide, NIST AI Risk Management Framework (RMF)

Location: Remote, with occasional travel to customer sites or TestPros labs in Sterling, VA

This role evaluates AI systems and software for alignment with the intended functions and features, plus additional assessment focused on AI-specific validation, including model robustness, data integrity, adversarial defense, performance, usability, reliability, security, maintainability, safety, and other aspects of overall quality.
.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop and execute test plans and evaluate software for compliance with the OWASP AI Testing Guide and other guidance, create defect and remediation records, capture test evidence and document defects with clear reproduction steps and severity ratings, report results to senior management and stakeholders.

Required Skills.

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software/System Testing and Quality Engineering (QE), including enterprise-scale transformation programs.
  • Solid understanding of and experience with the OWASP AI Testing Guide, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework (RMF).
  • 4+ years hands-on experience defining the testing strategy for large scale programs and ensuring requirements traceability throughout the system development lifecycle. Experience should include leading the testing efforts, including experience with all phases of testing: system integration, user acceptance, and performance testing.
  • A deep understanding of testing planning and associated delivery challenges.
  • A strong understanding of the various approaches used in testing techniques - white-box, black-box, load testing, coverage testing and regression testing.
  • Proven experience in defining and executing QE transformation strategy.
  • Hands-on expertise in Agentic AI / GenAI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Cursor, etc.).
  • Experience working in Cloud, Web and Mobile Testing platforms - Saucelabs, Browerstack are preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning models.
  • Experience in Python NLTK or similar natural language processing technology.
  • Practical experience implementing AI-driven QE solutions such as:
  • Autonomous test generation
  • Self-healing automation
  • Defect prediction and intelligent triaging
  • Expertise in test automation tools (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, etc.).
  • Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps integration (GitHub).
  • Solid understanding of API, microservices, and cloud-native architectures.
  • Experience evaluating or testing Artificial Intelligence (AI) Large Language Model (LLM)-based application features (e.g., chatbots, copilots, RAG-based systems), including prompt-response validation and hallucination/edge-case testing.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted defect triage or root-cause analysis tools that reduce manual investigation time.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) in QE/AI context.
  • Exposure to self-healing test automation frameworks (AI-driven locator repair, visual AI testing).
  • Understanding of responsible AI/testing governance principles (bias detection, explainability, model validation) as applied to QE.
  • Experience contributing to or influencing AI-adoption roadmaps within a testing/QE organization.
  • Experience implementing testing best practices specific to the test planning and execution processes and gaining buy-in for changes from executives.
Preferred Skills
  • Experience with test automation tools, and AI assisted test tools
  • Familiarity with JIRA project/test management system
  • Knowledge of other IT compliance such as WCAG/Accessibility, IT Security, IT Privacy
  • Professional certifications in the software testing discipline

Work Environment: Hands-on testing role. Remote-friendly with occasional on-site or hybrid work as needed.

title: Digital Product Owner søges til Molslinjen
description:
Digital Product Owner søges til Molslinjen 
				
  

			
 
 Udvikling er i fokus hos Molslinjen, og vores digitale løsninger spiller en stadig større rolle i at skabe gode kundeoplevelser og understøtte vores fortsatte vækst. Derfor søger vi en kommerciel stærk Digital Product Owner, der kan være med til at drive udviklingen af vores digitale produkter og sikre, at vores løsninger skaber værdi for både kunder og forretning. 

 Som Digital Product Owner får du en central rolle i udviklingen af vores kundevendte digitale produkter og e-commerce-platforme. Du bliver ansvarlig for at drive digitale initiativer fra idé til implementering og får en vigtig rolle i samarbejdet mellem forretningen, teamet og eksterne samarbejdspartnere. 

 Du bliver en del af vores digitale team på hovedkontoret i Aarhus, hvor du får mulighed for at sætte dit præg på vores digitale rejse i en hverdag med højt tempo, stor variation og masser af udvikling. 

 Dine primære arbejdsopgaver bliver at: 
 
 Drive produktledelsen af kundevendte digitale produkter og e-commerce-platforme i samarbejde med interne og eksterne samarbejdspartnere 

 Skabe retning for den digitale brugeroplevelse på tværs af web og app 

 Prioritere udviklingsinitiativer og omsætte dem til konkrete user stories og opgaver for udviklingsteamet 

 Sikre en succesfuld implementering af nye features, herunder opfølgning på KPI'er samt intern kommunikation og forankring 

 Bidrage til den løbende udvikling og optimering af vores digitale produkter med fokus på kundeoplevelse og forretningsværdi 
 
 Din profil 
 
 Minimum 3 års erfaring med digital produktledelse, projektledelse eller en lignende rolle 

 Solid forståelse for digitalisering med et stærkt kommercielt fokus 

 Evnen til at opbygge og vedligeholde gode relationer samt samarbejde på tværs af organisationen og med eksterne samarbejdspartnere 

 Arbejder datadrevet og trives med en produktorienteret tilgang, hvor tidlig test, løbende leverancer og værdiskabelse er i fokus 

 Arbejder struktureret og bevarer overblikket - også når tempoet er højt 
 
 Du trives med et stort selvstændigt ansvar, men værdsætter samtidig samarbejde, sparring og videndeling som en naturlig del af hverdagen. Du motiveres af at skabe værdi gennem digitale løsninger og har en positiv og løsningsorienteret tilgang til dine opgaver. 

 Vi tilbyder: 
 
 En central rolle med ansvar for udviklingen af digitale produkter i Nordens førende færgerederi 

 Mulighed for at sætte dit præg på vores digitale udvikling med stor opbakning fra vores ejere EQT, som har et stærkt digitalt fokus 

 En arbejdsdag med stor indflydelse og høj grad af frihed under ansvar 

 Et stærkt fagligt miljø med tæt samarbejde og gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling 

 En attraktiv medarbejderpakke med blandt andet sundhedsordning, frokostordning, fitnessfaciliteter og en lang række medarbejderrabatter 
 
 Vil du med ombord?
 Så send os gerne dit CV og ansøgning allerede i dag. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og afslutter rekrutteringsprocessen, når den rette kandidat er kommet med ombord. 

 Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Digital Development Manager, Josephine Nordborg, på jno@molslinjen.com  

 Om Molslinjen 

 Rederiet Molslinjen driver ALSLINJEN, BORNHOLMSLINJEN, FANØLINJEN, LANGELANDSLINJEN, MOLSLINJEN, SAMSØLINJEN, ØRESUNDSLINJEN og KOMBARDO EXPRESSEN. 

 Molslinjen er en del af EQT-ejede Nordic Ferry Infrastructure (NFI), der opererer færgeruter i Norge, Danmark og Sverige med en flåde på mere end 90 skibe, over 50 ruter og ca. 26 millioner passagerer årligt. 

 Vi har skabt en arbejdsplads, der tilbyder vores ca. 2.000 medarbejdere en spændende hverdag, hvor en uformel omgangstone, høj faglighed og frihed under ansvar går hånd i hånd. 

 Når du hører os sige "Kombardo", så er det et udtryk for den service og omsorg, vi præsenterer vores færgegæster for - men samtidig er Kombardo også et udtryk for, hvordan vi omgås og hjælper hinanden som kolleger. Vil du med ombord? Så Kombardo!

title: DevOps / System Engineer
description:
DevOps / Systems Engineer

Reporting To: DevOps Lead

Location: Sydney (Hybrid)

Job Type: Full-Time


About the Role

As a DevOps / Systems Engineer, you will drive our cloud and core system infrastructure, network reliability, and automation efforts. Working closely with the DevOps Lead, you will be responsible for ensuring the stability, performance, security, and scalability of our AWS-based cloud environment alongside our underlying network and hardware infrastructure. This hybrid infrastructure serves thousands of customers globally, influencing the experiences of millions of people across the world.

You will bring a strong background spanning systems administration, network engineering, and modern DevOps practices. You have a passion for network architecture, firewall management, hardware troubleshooting, automation, CI/CD, Kubernetes, and cloud technologies—striving to streamline operational workflows while maintaining maximum uptime and security.


Key Responsibilities

  • Cloud Infrastructure & Kubernetes: Design, deploy, and manage AWS infrastructure and production Kubernetes clusters, ensuring high availability and cost optimization.
  • Automation & CI/CD: Develop, maintain, and optimize Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and CI/CD pipelines to streamline software delivery and systems provisioning.
  • Security & Compliance: Implement and enforce security best practices across network devices, firewalls, cloud services, and containerized environments.
  • Incident Response & Monitoring: Monitor overall system health, identify performance bottlenecks, and serve as an escalation point for production, hardware, and network outages.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with developer teams and technical stakeholders to improve core infrastructure operational standards, systems tooling, and developer experience.
  • Network & Systems Administration: Design, configure, and maintain local and cloud networking environments, including VPCs, subnets, VPNs, routing protocols, and firewall rules to ensure secure, high-speed connectivity.
  • Hardware & Infrastructure Support: Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve hardware failure, server degradation, and physical or virtual connectivity issues.


Requirements

  • Cloud & Containers: Strong expertise in AWS services (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, Lambda) and hands-on experience managing production Kubernetes clusters.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Proficiency with IaC tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • CI/CD & Scripting: Solid experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and strong scripting skills in Bash, Python, or similar languages.
  • Monitoring & Observability: Experience with system monitoring, logging, and alerting stacks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, ELK).
  • Systems & Network Engineering: Proven experience in systems administration, network management, and network security protocols.
  • Networking & Firewalls: Hands-on experience configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting firewalls, routers, switches, VPNs, and cloud network architectures (AWS VPC, NAT gateways, Security Groups).
  • Hardware Troubleshooting: Demonstrated ability to diagnose and fix server, storage, and peripheral hardware issues.
  • Problem Solving: Excellent analytical skills to troubleshoot complex system-level and network-level incidents in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience: Minimum 3 years of proven demonstrable industry experience.


Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Kafka for real-time data streaming and event-driven architectures.
  • Knowledge of spatial data processing frameworks.
  • Relevant industry certifications (e.g., AWS Certified / Solutions Architect, Cisco CCNA/CCNP) or equivalent experience of minimum 3 years.

Diversity and Inclusion

Our Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, & Belonging Vision:

Beonic values the diversity of the people it hires and serves. We want to bring out the best in our global team members by creating a sense of belonging, being a place where they can grow, and ensuring everyone feels valued, heard, and supported.

Perks and Benefits

  • Hybrid model: Remote work with collaborative in-office team days (2 days per week)
  • Extra day off on your Birthday
  • Clear career growth pathways and skills development opportunities

title: Data Center Engineering Operations Technician, AWS Data Center Engineering Operations
description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running.

The Infrastructure Operations (Data Center) team is the backbone of AWS, supporting the rapidly growing AWS business and customers 24/7. We are committed to maintain the physical infrastructure of AWS, ensuring the standards for operational performance in the areas of safety, security, availability, productivity, capacity, efficiency, and cost.

We are looking for Data Center Engineering Operations Technicians to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak performance.

Roles available across locations in Sydney, NSW.


Key job responsibilities
Key Job Responsibilities

• Undertake and support management of both routine maintenance and emergency service of critical systems such as switch-gear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, and fire systems

• Installation of new rack capacity and provisioning of power/cooling

• On-site management of contractors and vendors, ensuring all work is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation

• Take daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment through routine rounds/log-taking

• Generate change management requests & incident management tickets for all facility-related events

• Assist in the resolution of infrastructure engineering and services issues

• Troubleshoot events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs)

• Follow and maintain the highest safety standards and encourage a world-class safety culture

Additional Requirements

• This role involves bending, lifting 20Kgs stretching, reaching, ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely

• Must be able to work in cramped or elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines

• 24/7 shift coverage is required and includes 12-hour rotating shifts

• Due to the location of our sites, candidates should ideally possess a valid driver’s license and their own vehicle

A day in the life
At today's large-scale data centers, you will be involved in:
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs.
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service-Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility management
- Provide operational readings and key performance indicators to make sure uptime is maintained
- On-site management of contractors, subcontractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Performance and oversight of maintenance and operations on all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Driftingenjör Energi & Fastighetsdrift – Scandic Hotels Stockholm
description:
Tjänstebeskrivning & erbjudande

Scandic Hotels är Nordens ledande hotellkedja med ett starkt fokus på hållbarhet, energieffektivisering och smart fastighetsdrift. Nu söker vi en Driftingenjör som vill ta ett helhetsansvar för att optimera energiförbrukningen på våra hotell i Stockholmsområdet. I rollen arbetar du strategiskt och operativt med 28 hotell i Stockholm, där varje fastighet har sina egna tekniska förutsättningar, avtal och energibehov. Du utgår från det hotell som ligger närmast din bostad men kommer att röra dig mellan våra hotell för att analysera, följa upp och utveckla driften. Det här är en nyckelroll där ditt arbete direkt påverkar både hotellens ekonomi och Scandics hållbarhetsarbete. Om rollen: Som Driftingenjör ansvarar du för att säkerställa en energieffektiv och välfungerande teknisk drift på våra hotell. Du arbetar nära hotellets lokala tekniker, fastighetsägare och externa servicepartners. Du kommer inte själv att utföra det löpande underhållet eller reparationerna, men fungerar som teknisk specialist, rådgivare och bollplank till de lokala driftorganisationerna. Rollen innebär även att du vid behov kan behöva utföra praktiskt arbete på plats på hotellen, exempelvis skruva, justera eller felsöka utrustning. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter: • Analysera energiförbrukning och identifiera förbättrings- och besparingsmöjligheter • Optimera ventilation, värme och kylsystem för bästa möjliga driftsekonomi och gästkomfort • Arbeta med styr- och övervakningssystem för att säkerställa effektiv drift • Felsöka och åtgärda tekniska driftavvikelser • Säkerställa att hotellens ronderingsrutiner och driftprocesser fungerar enligt uppsatta standarder • Planera och följa upp förebyggande underhåll tillsammans med hotellens tekniker • Samordna och följa upp externa entreprenörer och serviceleverantörer • Säkerställa efterlevnad av myndighetskrav, säkerhetsföreskrifter och besiktningar • Vara tekniskt expertstöd vid renoverings- och investeringsprojekt • Bidra till utvecklingen av Scandics långsiktiga energi- och hållbarhetsarbete

Personprofil

För att passa i tjänsten tror vi att du har arbetat med energieffektivisering inom hotell eller kommersiella fastigheter. Vi söker dig som kombinerar tekniskt kunnande med ett analytiskt arbetssätt. Du tycker om att förstå hur olika system samverkar och drivs av att hitta förbättringar som ger mätbara resultat. För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du: • Har erfarenhet av fastighetsdrift, energioptimering eller tekniska installationssystem • Har god förståelse för HVAC-system (ventilation, värme och kyla) • Har erfarenhet av styr- och reglersystem • Är van att analysera data och omsätta insikter till konkreta åtgärder • Är självgående och trivs med ett stort eget ansvar • Har lätt för att skapa förtroende och samarbeta med både tekniker, entreprenörer och fastighetsägare • Har goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska Scandic har riktigt bra förmåner så som förmånsbeskattad frukost och lunch varje dag, gratis tillgång till gym på hotellet, fina rabatter när du bokar hotell – både för dig själv men även för dina nära och kära, och flera andra förmåner.

Övrigt

Start: Enligt överenskommelse Omfattning: Heltid och tillsvidare Arbetstid: 8 – 16:30, flextid Plats: Du utgår från ett Scandic-hotell nära din bostad, men en stor del av arbetet sker ute på våra 28 hotell i Storstockholm. PerformIQ – rekrytering av personal med egenskaper från idrott/föreningsliv, är vår samarbetspartner och vi hänvisar eventuella frågor om tjänsten till Rekryteringskonsult Mattias Söderberg på nr. 072-157 27 76. Skicka in din ansökan redan idag då intervjuer sker löpande. Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Ansvarig rekryterare är på semester och urval startar den 10 augusti. Välkommen in med din ansökan!

                    Studenterprogrammør til Online Brand Protection-team i Aalborg
                
        
    






    

        

                            
Vil du være med til at tage kampen op mod svindlere og kopister på internettet?

            

                
Publiceret den 11. august 2026


Vi søger en skarp softwarestuderende til vores Online Brand Protection-team i Aalborg. Her arbejder vi med at bekæmpe svindel, kopivarer og andre krænkelser af virksomheders rettigheder på nettet.


Som studenterprogrammør bliver du en del af udviklingen af vores egne interne og eksterne værktøjer, som bruges hver dag til at identificere og håndtere ulovligt misbrug på nettet. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med både vores udviklere og juridiske team.

Hvem er vi?

Patrade er et konsulenthus med speciale i immaterialret. Det betyder, at vi hjælper virksomheder med at beskytte og håndhæve rettigheder til blandt andet ophavsret, patenter, varemærker og design.

Hvorfor Patrade?


Rigtig impact - hurtigt: De værktøjer, du arbejder på, er fundamentet for at kunne fjerne skadeligt indhold og hjælpe rigtige virksomheder. Du kan derfor se resultatet af dit arbejde i praksis.


Moderne tech stack: Vi anvender de mest passende teknologier til opgaven og er ikke bundet af årtiers tech-gæld


God kultur og stærkt sammenhold: Du bliver en del af et ungt og ambitiøst team med høj trivsel, uformel tone og mulighed for at få indflydelse fra dag ét


Dine opgaver

Du kommer blandt andet til at:



udvikle og vedligeholde vores platform på tværs af frontend, backend og dataindsamling


indgå i et mindre udviklerteam, hvor du på sigt får mulighed for at tage ejerskab over egne områder


komme med egne idéer og føre dem fra idé til implementering


samarbejde tæt med vores juridiske team om at finde de bedste tekniske løsninger på konkrete problemstillinger


Din profil

Vi forestiller os at du:



læser software, datalogi eller lignende og er på 3. - 5. semester


har kendskab til JavaScript/TypeScript, React, HTML, CSS, REST API’er og PostgreSQL


interesserer dig for software, udvikling og AI


er nysgerrig og eksperimenterende af natur


trives i et miljø, hvor vi både giver og modtager feedback - formelt såvel som uformelt


Det får du


Fleksibel ansættelse på 8-12 timer om ugen med respekt for dit studium, som vi forventer, at du prioriterer højest


Oplæring i både softwareudvikling og jura (immaterialret), så du får et indblik i et område, der kombinerer teknologi og jura


En international konsulentvirksomhed med højt tempo og korte veje fra idé til handling


Et kollegialt og rummeligt miljø i lækre rammer i vores Aalborg-afdeling


Sådan søger du


Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

    Souschef i Emmerys - Sjælland
Er du klar til at tage næste skridt i din lederkarriere - og vil du være med til at skabe en hverdag, hvor kvalitet, god stemning og høj energi går hånd i hånd?

Emmerys er i rivende udvikling og søger dygtige souschefer til vores eksisterende og kommende butikker i København og Nordsjælland.
Hvem er du?
Du har erfaring med drift og personaleansvar - gerne fra café, bageri eller detailbranchen - og du har lyst til at vokse i en lederrolle. Du trives i et dynamisk miljø med mange bolde i luften og har hjertet med i det, du laver. Du møder både kolleger og gæster med et smil og har en naturlig evne til at skabe god stemning.
Som souschef er du butikschefens højre hånd og går forrest med energi, overblik og struktur. Du har lyst til at være med til at udvikle både teamet og butikken.
Dine arbejdsopgaver
Som souschef er du en vigtig del af butikkens daglige drift. Du arbejder tæt sammen med butikschefen og er med til at sikre den høje standard, som vores gæster forventer af Emmerys. Dine opgaver vil bl.a. omfatte:



Dine arbejdsopgaver


Salg og service af Emmerys produkter



Tilberedning af kaffe og øvrige drikke



Sikre en indbydende og velopfyldt butik i forhold til koncept



Ansvar for egenkontrol, herunder temperaturkontrol, dokumentation og rutiner i henhold til Fødevarestyrelsens krav.



Bestilling af varer



Daglig rengøring og vedligeholdelse af café- og bagerområdet



Bidrage til et godt samarbejde i teamet og en positiv arbejdsplads



Varetage ansvaret for driften i butikschefen fravær inkl. sygdom.

Hvad tilbyder vi dig?

En fuldtidsstilling med ansvar og mulighed for at vokse i rollen



En hverdag fyldt med gode råvarer, god kaffe og gode kolleger



Grundig oplæring og tæt samarbejde med butikschefen



Et stærkt team og en kultur præget af hjælpsomhed og fleksibilitet



Mulighed for på sigt at avancere til butikschef

Arbejdsbetingelser
Stillingen er på fuldtid. Du vil indgå i en vagtplan med skiftende vagter - herunder morgen-, aften- og weekendvagter. Som souschef forventes det, at du er klar til at tage ansvar ved sygdom eller behov for ekstra bemanding. Du refererer til butikschefen og har distriktschefen som sparringspartner.
Lyder det som noget for dig?
Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte:
Anne Steiner, Distriktschef og Rekrutteringsansvarlig                                                                     as@emmerys.dk

    Erhvervskonsulent søges til håndværksafdelingen i HTH Glostrup
    Vil du være den faste samarbejdspartner, som håndværkere og erhvervskunder kan regne med?


      

      
    
  
    
    Ansøg her

  









  



    
      

      
  

    
Hos HTH Glostrup søger vi en ny kollega til vores Håndværksafdeling. Vi leder efter dig, der trives med at opbygge relationer og som motiveres af at følge en sag hele vejen fra idé til færdig levering.

Du behøver ikke komme fra køkkenbranchen. Måske arbejder du i dag med salg, byggematerialer, håndværk eller rådgivning. Det vigtigste for os er, at du har lyst til at lære, tager ansvar og kan lide at skabe gode oplevelser for kunderne.

Afdelingen 
I vores Håndværksafdeling hjælper vi hver dag professionelle kunder med at finde de rigtige løsninger til køkkener, bad og garderober. Vores kunder er blandt andet tømrermestre, entreprenører og installatører. 

Du bliver en del af et team på 12 personer, hvor samarbejde, faglighed og gode kundeoplevelser er i centrum. Vi har travlt, og derfor udvider vi nu teamet med en ny kollega. 

Hos os er der kort vej fra idé til handling. Vi sparrer med hinanden, deler erfaringer og hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes, når man både tager ansvar for sit eget arbejde og samtidig er en god kollega.

Din rolle
Som erhvervskonsulent bliver du kundernes faste kontaktperson og får ansvar for dine egne projekter. Du følger kunderne gennem hele processen fra den første dialog om behov og muligheder til tilbud, bestilling og levering.

Du kommer blandt andet til at:


Rådgive håndværkere og erhvervskunder om køkken-, bad- og garderobeløsninger



Afholde kundemøder og afdække kundernes behov



Visualisere løsninger og udarbejde indretningstegninger



Beregne priser og udarbejde tilbud



Koordinere bestillinger, levering og montage



Sikre en god dialog med kunder, leverandører og samarbejdspartnere


Hvem er du?
Vi forestiller os ikke én bestemt profil. Måske har du erfaring fra køkken, byggeri, salg eller en anden branche, hvor du har arbejdet med kunder og løsninger. Det vigtigste er at du:


Kan skabe gode relationer og møder mennesker i øjenhøjde



Arbejder struktureret og kan bevare overblikket, når der er mange bolde i luften



Har lyst til at arbejde med tilbud, beregninger og rådgivning



Er nysgerrig på materialer, indretning og praktiske løsninger



Trives med en varieret hverdag mellem kundekontakt, administration og rådgivning



Bidrager positivt til teamet og hjælper dine kolleger


Vi tror på, at den rette indstilling og personlighed betyder mindst lige så meget som erfaring. Derfor sørger vi for, at du får den nødvendige oplæring og støtte til at blive stærk i rollen.

En arbejdsplads med plads til udvikling
HTH er en del af Nobia, som er Europas største køkkenspecialist. Det betyder, at du bliver en del af en international virksomhed med stærke brands og gode udviklingsmuligheder.

Vi sørger for, at du kommer godt fra start med:


Et struktureret onboardingforløb, hvor der også vil være et besøg på vores fabrik i Ølgod



Træning i vores produkter



Løbende faglig udvikling gennem hele din karriere



Et miljø, hvor du kan vokse - både som specialist og som menneske


Samtidig bliver du en del af hele HTH Glostrup med omkring 100 kolleger på tværs af huset. Vi har kantineordning, personaleforening og sociale aktiviteter, hvor vi også mødes uden for arbejdet.

Arbejdstider
Vores erhvervskunder skal kunne få fat i os, når de har brug for os. Derfor ligger arbejdstiden primært mandag til fredag mellem kl. 06.00 og 16.00 samt fredag til kl. 15.30. 

Der vil forekomme 5-6 lørdagsvagter om året. Vagterne ligger i tidsrummet fra 10-15, og én arbejdsdag tæller som én vagt. 

Der er mulighed for fleksibilitet og indflydelse på planlægningen, så arbejdsliv og privatliv kan hænge godt sammen.

Lyst til at høre mere? 
Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send dit motiverede CV. Vi afholder løbende ansættelsessamtaler og tager annoncen ned, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

title: Gymnasiejob.dk - Gefion Gymnasium søger en dygtig gymnasiesekretær / AC-medarbejder
description:
Gefion Gymnasium søger en dygtig gymnasiesekretær / AC-medarbejder 
                
 
                    
 Gefion Gymnasium er et stort og velansøgt gymnasium placeret centralt i København med 15-16 spor pr. årgang, ca. 1.200 elever og en engageret medarbejderstab med et godt samarbejde mellem lærere, ledelse og administration. 



 En af vores dygtige medarbejdere har valgt at gå på pension, og vi leder derfor efter en ny medarbejder til vores meget velfungerende og kompetente administration. 



 Stillingen er på 35 timer ugentligt med tiltrædelse pr. 1. oktober 2026. 



 Et uhøjtideligt fællesskab med høj faglig kvalitet 



 Du vil indgå i et tæt og stabilt administrativt team. Vi lægger stor vægt på at yde den bedste service i et uhøjtideligt og rart arbejdsfællesskab, hvor humøret er højt. Vi arbejder tæt sammen med skolens ledelse og har en uformel tone og højt til loftet. 



 Vi vægter faglig udvikling og høj kvalitet i opgaveløsningen. Gefion er en del af Gymnasiefællesskabet, hvor kontoret bl.a. får support til HR, jura, løn og GDPR. 



 Vi tilbyder en fleksibel arbejdsplads, hvor det bl.a. er kontoret selv, der aftaler vagtplaner, og hvor vi vægter muligheden for kompetenceudvikling samt muligheden for at få ansvar for egne områder. Kontoret er skolens hjerte og vi får besøg af mange elever og lærere, som vi hjælper med stort og småt. 



 Dine arbejdsopgaver 



 Du vil få dine egne selvstændige ansvarsområder, som du selv kan være med til at udvikle og drive. Opgaverne løses i tæt samarbejde med dine kolleger i administrationen. Du vil være en nøgleperson i udviklingen af vores administrative systemer, herunder vil du være sammen med den øvrige administration og ledelse være med i udviklingen af brug af AI i vores administration. Det endelige opgaveansvar fastlægger vi i fællesskab ud fra dine spidskompetencer inden for fx elevadministration, dataanalyse, eksamensadministration, procesoptimering og studieadministrative systemer. Du vil også indgå i den daglige løsning af store og små driftsopgaver.  



 Hvem er du? 



 Vi leder efter en profil med en høj faglig integritet - uanset om du har en stærk administrativ kontorbaggrund eller en akademisk overbygning (AC-er). Det vigtigste er, at du brænder for administration på højt niveau og kan være med til at bevare vores gode samarbejdskultur. 



 Vi forestiller os, at du: 


 
	
 
	
 Er en fleksibel og serviceminded samarbejdspartner for dine kolleger i administrationen, lærere og ledelse 

	 

	
 
	
 Har erfaring med administrative opgaver eller institutionsdrift - meget gerne fra et gymnasium 

	 

	
 
	
 Er detaljeorienteret, struktureret og proaktiv - du spotter selv, hvor processer kan optimeres, og du tager initiativ 

	 

	
 
	
 Kommunikerer sikkert og professionelt både på skrift og i tale 

	 

	
 
	
 Finder ægte glæde i at arbejde i et ungdomsmiljø og understøtte de 15-20-åriges vej mod studentereksamen 

	 

 


   



 Hvad tilbyder vi? 



 Du får et spændende og ansvarsfuldt job på en af Københavns mest centrale uddannelsesinstitutioner. Vi har en flad struktur og et arbejdsmiljø præget af tillid. Vi tilbyder gode arbejdsforhold, herunder: 


 
	
 
	
 Fleksibel arbejdstid og høj grad af indflydelse på din egen hverdag 

	 

	
 
	
 Betalt frokostpause 

	 

	
 
	
 Fri i skolernes ferieperioder 

	 

 


   



 Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår: 



 Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst med mulighed for forhandling af tillæg baseret på dine kvalifikationer og erfaring. 



 Ansøgning og kontakt 



 Vi ønsker at fremme ligestilling og mangfoldighed og opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede til at søge stillingen - uanset baggrund. 



 Vi modtager kun elektroniske ansøgninger via www.gymnasiejob.dk. Husk at vedhæfte dit CV, relevante uddannelsespapirer samt eventuelle udtalelser. 



 Ansøgningsfrist: Den 13. august 2026. 



 Vil du vide mere? 



 Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte vicerektor Louise Westmark på mail lwe@gefion-gym. Du er også velkommen til at kontakte os på skolens telefon på tlf. nr. 33 96 41 41. 



 Bemærk venligst: Gefion Gymnasium holder sommerlukket mellem d. 2. juli og 5. august, men vi glæder os til at læse din ansøgning, så snart vi er tilbage i starten af august!
