title: Associate - Managed Solutions Specialist
description:
Join a collaborative team that empowers Advisors and clients with tailored investment solutions and market intelligence.
Leverage your asset class knowledge to deliver curated content, portfolio analytics, and timely updates.
Drive impactful client engagement by coordinating with global partners and specialists to provide cohesive investment information.


As an Investment Specialist within the Wealth Management Investment Solutions team, you educate Advisors on product attributes and portfolio positioning.
You curate and deliver content, answer advisor and client queries, and provide market updates across asset classes.
You coordinate with Specialists, Portfolio Managers, and partner teams to ensure consistent, high-quality information for clients and prospects.

Job Responsibilities

  • Work with Client Advisors in educating them various attributes (e.g. asset allocation, performance, holdings etc.) of our products & portfolios. Additionally this team curates content for Advisors (e.g. prospecting, portfolio positioning, commentaries, portfolio analytics on underlying products) and answers related advisor / client queries
  • Allign to the respective asset classes like Fixed Income, Equities, Private Equity, Hedge Funds, Private Placements, Endowments & Foundations, etc. within Wealth management and are expected to know the asset class/client set they are supporting
  • Provide Periodic updates consisting of market information, ratings changes, news, asset allocation studies etc. pertaining to our portfolios and funds
  • Co-ordinate with Specialists and Portfolio managers to provide regular insights on the funds/strategies via manager calls or prospective events
  • Author Request for Proposals (RFPs) covering and highlighting the breadth of our investment and solutions platforms. Co-ordinate Request for Information (RFIs) for Institutional and Wholesale clients / prospects
  • Co-ordinate with Specialists, PMs, and other partner / service teams to deliver high quality, consistent and cohesive quantitative and qualitative information to existing clients invested in retail and institutional products

  • Support stakeholder and project management initiatives to deliver information management and business intelligence strategies across sales, marketing, and technology groups

Required Qualifications, capabilities and skills

  • Hold an MBA (Finance) with relevant industry experience and knowledge of sales processes, global markets, and asset classes including Equities, Fixed Income, Alternatives, MAS, and ETFs.
  • Complete CFA or CAIA Level I, or be an aspiring CFA/CAIA, with relevant industry experience and strong understanding of asset classes and alternatives.
  • Demonstrate 5+ years of experience in BFSI, Asset/Wealth Management, Capital Markets, and asset classes such as Equity and Fixed Income.
  • Apply strong quantitative and analytical skills, including proficiency in data analysis, understanding data flows, and numbers.
  • Communicate effectively with excellent soft skills, stakeholder management, client-focused approach, and strong presentation abilities.
  • Utilize advanced Microsoft skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio), external tools like Bloomberg, FactSet, Morningstar, and project management software such as MS Project.
  • Exhibit attention to detail, exceptional problem-solving skills, good judgment with confidential information, strong team player qualities, entrepreneurial initiative, and confidence to complete assignments independently.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
At SolarWinds, we’re a people-first company. Our purpose is to enrich the lives of the people we serve—including our employees, customers, shareholders, partners, and communities. Join us in our mission to help customers accelerate business transformation with simple, powerful, and secure solutions.

The ideal candidate thrives in an innovative, fast-paced environment and is collaborative, accountable, ready, and empathetic. We’re looking for individuals who believe they can accomplish more as a team and create lasting growth for themselves and others. We hire based on attitude, competency, and commitment. Solarians are ready to advance our world-class solutions in a fast-paced environment and accept the challenge to lead with purpose. If you’re looking to build your career with an exceptional team, you’ve come to the right place. Join SolarWinds and grow with us!

We work in hybrid mode 3+2, at least 3 days at the office (with mandatory Wednesdays and Thursdays) and 2 days at the home office.

The location of our office is Puszkarska 7J/Building E, 30-644 Kraków, Polska.

We employ only via an employment contract – FTE.

What you will do

SolarWinds is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer with 5+ years of experience to help build, operate, and improve the systems that support our products and internal platforms. This role is ideal for someone who is hands-on, dependable, and comfortable working across Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, Linux, and Database environments in a production setting.

The right candidate has a strong foundation in site reliability engineering, enjoys solving problems in live environments, and understands the importance of reliability, automation, and operational discipline.

  • Operate, maintain, upgrade and improve production Kubernetes clusters and workloads across AWS and Azure environments.
  • Manage Kubernetes platform components and technologies such as Helm, Kustomize, operators, istio, autoscaling, and cluster/node lifecycle management.
  • Support and maintain production database platforms such as ClickHouse, Aurora and other distributed data systems, including performance troubleshooting and operational health.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure using Terraform.
  • Develop automation and tooling to reduce operational toil and improve reliability using Python, Go, Bash, or similar technologies.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation, respond to production incidents, and lead or contribute to incident resolution and root-cause analysis.
  • Improve observability, monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response across infrastructure and services.
  • Partner closely with software engineering and platform teams to design and deploy reliable, scalable services.
  • Contribute to capacity planning, performance optimization, patching, upgrades, and infrastructure lifecycle management.
  • Develop and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides.
  • Participate in reliability initiatives, including automation, resilience engineering, disaster recovery, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Systems Engineering, Platform Engineering, or a related field.
  • Strong hands-on production Kubernetes experience, including operating, upgrading and troubleshooting Kubernetes clusters and workloads.
  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes fundamentals, including:
    • Pods, Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, Jobs, CronJobs
    • Services, Ingress, DNS, and Kubernetes networking
    • ConfigMaps, Secrets, and persistent storage
    • Resource requests/limits and scheduling
    • Autoscaling across workloads, clusters, and nodes
    • Pod Disruption Budgets and high availability patterns
    • Kubernetes upgrades and cluster lifecycle management
  • Experience troubleshooting Kubernetes at both the application workload and cluster infrastructure levels.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS and Azure cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong Linux systems administration and troubleshooting skills.
  • Experience operating customer facing, highly available production systems.
  • Experience participating in a production on-call rotation and responding to high-severity incidents.
  • Strong experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Experience with scripting and automation using Python, Go, Bash, or similar languages.
  • Strong understanding of infrastructure concepts including compute, networking, storage, DNS, load balancing, and security.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to methodically diagnose complex distributed-system failures.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineering and cross-functional teams.

What we are looking for

  • Ownership mindset and strong operational discipline
  • Ability to stay calm and effective during incidents
  • Willingness to learn, improve systems, and drive reliability-focused changes
  • Practical approach to solving infrastructure and operational problems
  • Team player who values clear communication and documentation
  • Continuous learner stays current with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, and modern SRE practices.

On-Call Expectations

This position requires participation in a scheduled on-call rotation to support production systems and help ensure service reliability and availability.

Our benefits:

  • 10 study days per year
  • 2 volunteering days per year
  • 30-day holidays after 5-year tenure, Sabbatical Leave
  • 4 weeks of paternity leave
  • Up to 8700 PLN personal education budget per year
  • 300 PLN corrective glasses reimbursement every two years
  • Medical care with Luxmed – individual, partner, or family package fully paid by the company
  • The company fully pays for group life insurance
  • Pension scheme (employee capital plans) with 1.5% employer contribution
  • Unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning
  • English/Polish classes
  • MyBenefit platform with a monthly subsidy of 103 PLN (with various vouchers and Multisport cards available)
  • 500 PLN per year of race fee reimbursement
  • Solarian Referral Program
  • SolarWinds Appreciation Program
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Free lunches at the office on Wednesdays

title: Byggesagsbehandler til Team Byg
description:
Vi søger en dygtig og engageret byggesagsbehandler

Er du interesseret i bygge- og planloven samt frisk på at indgå i dialog med borgere og virksomheder? Så mangler Thisted Kommune netop dig.
Vi søger en byggesagsbehandler med fokus på god service og høj faglig kvalitet.

Om stillingen
Stillingen som byggesagsbehandler er alsidig og spændende. Du kommer til at spille en central rolle i behandlingen af byggesager og sikre overholdelse af gældende regler og lovgivning.

Du bliver en del af et fagligt stærkt team, hvor vi arbejder med forskellige typer byggesager – fra enfamiliehuse til erhvervsbyggeri, dispensationer og lovliggørelsessager. Du får ansvaret for dine egne sager, men der er selvfølgelig mulighed for sparring fra dine hjælpsomme kollegaer.

Du får som byggesagsbehandler mange samarbejdsrelationer både internt og eksternt, da sagsbehandlingen ofte foregår i samarbejde med de øvrige teams i huset samt i dialog med ansøger.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
  • Dialog med ansøgere og rådgivere
  • Gennemgang og vurdering af byggeansøgninger
  • Sagsbehandling og udarbejdelse af afgørelser efter bygge- og planloven
  • Tilsyn og opfølgning på igangværende byggesager
  • Andre sagsområder som hegnsyn, skimmelsvamp mv.

Vi forventer af dig
  • Relevant uddannelse indenfor byggeri – bygningskonstruktør, ingeniør, arkitekt mv.
  • Gerne erfaring med byggesagsbehandling og kendskab til bygge- og planlovgivning
  • Gode kommunikations- og samarbejdsevner
  • Evne til at arbejde struktureret og selvstændigt

Vi tilbyder dig
  • En spændende og udfordrende stilling
  • Mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling
  • Et dynamisk arbejdsmiljø med engagerede kollegaer

Om os
Du bliver ansat i Plan- og Miljøafdelingen, der er en af de tre afdelinger, som udgør Teknik, Erhverv og Beskæftigelse. Her vil du blive en del af Sektion Byg & Byfornyelse, som består af 17 medarbejdere. Du vil indgå i Team Byg med 10 medarbejdere. Teamet er et godt og stabilt team med masser af humor og energi, så det er vigtigt at du trives i sådanne rammer. Vi er uformelle, ærlige og humoristiske i vores interne kommunikation.

Arbejdsstedet er placeret i Hurup Thy og stillingen indebærer som udgangspunkt fysisk fremmøde. Hvis du har en længere transportafstand til arbejdsstedet, beder vi dig i din ansøgning kort beskrive dine overvejelser om den daglige transport, og hvordan du forventer at få hverdagen til at fungere i forhold til fremmøde.

Generelt om rekrutteringsprocessen
Ansøgningsfrist: 16. september 2026.
Samtaler forventes afholdt: 21. september 2026.
Tiltrædelse: 1. november 2026.

Ansættelsesvilkår
  • Løn fastsættes efter gældende overenskomst og principperne for lokal løndannelse. Det konkrete lønspænd oplyses senest til samtalen.
  • Stillingen er på 37 timer/uge.

Kontakt vedrørende stillingen
For yderligere oplysninger kan du kontakte sektionsleder for Byg og Byfornyelse, Lars Nørgaard Hedegaard på telefon 99 17 21 43 eller mail lnh@thisted.dk.
Alle henvendelser behandles fortroligt.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

The Naval Power Engineering Execution Team is seeking a highly motivated SM-3 Software, Algorithms, and Simulations, Integrated Product Team Lead (SAS IPTL) for the Standard Missile 3 (SM-3) portfolio within the Shipboard Missiles Sub-Strategic Business Unit (SSBU). The SAS IPT is a large, multi-disciplined organization working throughout the product lifecycle of all three SM-3 variants and is involved in nearly every phase of the product lifecycle and program evolution.

This position reports to the Office of the Chief Engineer (OCE) and several SM-3 Program Managers. This IPT lead will be responsible for driving consistent execution across a broad portfolio of programs and projects, managing competing priorities, and aligning resources to meet program expectations.

In addition, it is expected this person will work across all Raytheon functional organizations to staff the IPT and ensure the timely start-up and delivery of products in accordance with the contract(s).

This is an onsite position located in Tucson, AZ

What You Will Do

  • Drive technical, schedule, and cost performance while delivering a product which is compliant with the contract. This involves developing solutions which are the best fit for the overall program performance, supportability and long-term sustainment.
    Communicate status, issues and resolutions to leadership on matters that significantly impact program success.

  • Ensuring cost and schedule for on time delivery of software to meet the mission, contractual obligations, and customer expectations.

  • Interacting daily with other cross-discipline teams to meet program goals and objectives while driving on-time and on-budget performance.

  • Frequent interaction with the customer community, the program office, functional and technical leaders.

  • Early identification of risks and opportunities, along with mitigation and capture plans.

  • Partnering with the leads including chief engineers and technical leads to provide the most cost-effective technical solutions.

  • Establish open and effective communication with team members, ensuring team cross training, mentoring and growth opportunities.

  • Attending regular customer meetings and ensuring a positive customer relationship.
    Supporting strategic efforts to identify and advocate for future growth of system operability.

  • Regular review of program status including tracking and review by both Engineering and Program Leadership.

  • Responsibility for development of SAS IPT relevant proposals and support to all program proposal efforts, including negotiations and reviews for any new scope and any potential contract modifications to ensure success and growth for the business.


Qualifications You Must Have

  • Typically requires Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Math (STEM) and a minimum of 12 years of prior relevant experience unless prohibited by local laws/regulations.

  • Experience managing project or program cost, schedule and risk or experience with Earned Value Management, Risk & Opportunity, IMS or IMP tools.

  • Earned Value Management System Certification or ability to get it within 12 months of starting in the position.

  • Experience presenting program and technical issues to senior stakeholders.

  • Experience in Software Engineering, Systems Engineering and/or System Integration.

  • Experience supporting production programs.

  • Active and transferable Top Secret U.S. government-issued security clearance is required before the start date. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.


Qualifications We Prefer

  • Strong interpersonal skills working in a team environment with positive interaction.

  • Self-starter – proactive in determining goals and objectives and pursuing the necessary course of action.

  • Experience with proposal or capture efforts.

  • Experience in preparing customer and/or management level briefings.

  • Experience with DoD or similar major programs throughout the product lifecycle.

  • Experience working with the MDA customer to propose and execute development and transition-to-production programs.

  • Experience working on a development program using agile/scrum and in DevSecOps/Automation.


What We Offer

  • Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

  • Relocation Eligible.


Learn More & Apply Now!

Please consider the following role type definition as you apply for this role. Onsite: Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

Candidates will learn more about role type and current site status throughout the recruiting process. For onsite roles, commuting to and from the assigned site is the employee’s personal responsibility.

This position requires a security clearance. DCSA Consolidated Adjudication Services (DCSA CAS), an agency of the Department of Defense, handles and adjudicates the security clearance process.

More information about Security Clearances can be found on the US Department of State government website here: https://www.state.gov/m/ds/clearances/c10978.htm

As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.

The salary range for this role is 157,200 USD - 298,800 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.

Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply.

title: Supervisor - Ramp Airport Operations
description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

At United, we fly into airports around the entire world. And we need a whole team of people to keep things running in tip-top shape! From the exceptional service at the check-in counter to the departure gate, and even behind the scenes making sure your checked bags arrive with you, our Airport Operations team keeps operations at our airports running smoothly every single day.

The supervisor will focus on leading and developing the skills of front-line co-workers with the goal of delivering consistent and excellent customer service and delivering a quality product in accordance with Company guidelines. Assign and delegate tasks appropriately; provide ongoing coaching, recognition, and skill development focused on service and operational excellence. title: Product Designer, Platform Teams
description:
About Assembled

Great customer support requires human agents and AI in perfect balance, and Assembled is the only unified platform that orchestrates both at scale. Companies like Canva, Etsy, and Robinhood use Assembled to coordinate their entire support operation — in-house agents, BPOs, and AI — in a single operating system. With AI Agents that resolve cases end-to-end, AI Copilot for agent assistance, and AI-powered workforce management that optimizes both human and AI capacity, Assembled helps teams deliver faster, better service while making smarter decisions about how to staff and automate. Backed by $71M from NEA, Emergence Capital, and Stripe, we're building the platform that makes AI and human collaboration actually work.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Designer to take on some of the broadest and most complex product problems at Assembled. You’ll design tools that help support teams understand what’s happening across their operations, make high-stakes decisions, plan for the future, and increasingly work alongside AI to get things done.

This is a role for someone excited by making sophisticated software feel remarkably simple. You’ll work across new products, foundational workflows, data-rich experiences, and emerging agentic UX patterns. You’ll help define how people delegate work to AI, understand its decisions, intervene when needed, and stay confidently in control. You’ll have significant ownership: working directly with customers, helping identify the right problems to solve, shaping product strategy, and carrying ideas from early research through polished, shipped experiences.

This is an onsite role based in our New York City office, five days a week (Monday–Friday).

What You'll Do

  • Turn complex operational workflows into products that feel intuitive, powerful, and approachable.

  • Define new interaction patterns for working with AI agents, including how users delegate work, understand decisions, and stay in control.

  • Design data-rich experiences that help customers understand what’s happening, why it matters, and what to do next.

  • Shape new product areas and foundational workflows, from planning and analytics to setup, configuration, and integrations.

  • Lead customer research and discovery, translating real operational needs into product strategy and decisions the team can rally around.

  • Partner deeply with product and engineering to influence the roadmap, prototype quickly, and carry ideas through implementation and launch.

  • Use AI agents to instrument experiences, prototype ideas, and run experiments—applying the technology we build on to how we build.

What Excites Us

  • 3+ years designing and shipping production B2B software, with a pull toward complex, consequential customer problems.

  • Strong systems and interaction design; you can distill messy, multi-stakeholder needs into clear, reusable experiences.

  • You turn ambiguity into shipped product quickly, without losing sight of craft or customer impact.

  • You lead your own research and build close relationships with the people who use what you design.

  • You're a strong communicator who brings customers, engineers, product partners, and teammates along with your thinking.

  • You make powerful, data-dense products approachable for non-technical operators without sacrificing depth or flexibility.

  • You're energized by broad ownership and comfortable influencing both product strategy and execution.

Nice to Have

  • You get into the code and have used coding agents to prototype or ship.

  • AI fluency in practice (Cursor, Claude, and whatever comes next), with an informed view of what AI can and can't do today.

Our U.S. benefits

  • Generous medical, dental, and vision benefits

  • Flexible time off

  • Monthly credits for professional development, general wellness, Assembled customers, and commuting

  • Paid parental leave

  • Catered lunches every day (M–F) and fully stocked SF office

  • 401(k) plan enrollment

The estimated base salary range for this role is $130,000 - $180,000 per year. The base pay offered may vary depending on location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Stock options are provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered.

We know great candidates don’t always meet every requirement listed in a job description. If the role excites you and you believe you can make an impact at Assembled, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels like they belong and has the opportunity to do their best work. We look forward to hearing from you!

For United States Applicants:
Assembled participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the United States.

For United Kingdom Applicants:
Assembled is required to verify your right to work in the UK and will conduct a Right to Work check prior to employment in accordance with applicable law.

title: (Junior) Video Editor
description:
Zie jij in een paar ruwe smartphonebeelden meteen een pakkende TikTok of Reel? Maar draai jij je hand ook niet om voor een strakke brandingvideo in Premiere Pro? Dan zoeken wij jou!

Bij Social Deal zijn we volop bezig met de volgende stap in onze videocontent. Naast professionele video’s zetten we steeds meer in op snelle, laagdrempelige mobile content die opvalt én scoort op social media. Als (Junior) Video Editor weet jij precies wat een video nodig heeft om de aandacht te pakken en vast te houden.

Je volgt de nieuwste contenttrends, experimenteert graag met nieuwe tools en AI en ziet kansen om slimmer en efficiënter te werken. Van een snelle Reel tot een professionele campagnevideo: jij maakt van ruwe beelden content die mensen willen bekijken.

Een dag als (Junior) Video Editor bij Social Deal

Je begint je dag met een lekkere cappuccino en duikt daarna in het nieuwste videomateriaal. Met jouw edit skills maak je van losse beelden een video die vanaf de eerste seconden de aandacht trekt. Timing, muziek, tekst, tempo: jij zorgt dat het klopt.

Later die ochtend werk je verder aan een bijzondere employer branding-productie: de videoreeks rondom het 15-jarig jubileum van Social Deal. Je selecteert de beste beelden, denkt mee over de verhaallijn en zorgt ervoor dat iedere video dezelfde herkenbare uitstraling heeft. Zo breng je niet alleen onze collega’s en cultuur in beeld, maar vertel je ook het verhaal van 15 jaar Social Deal.

’s Middags komt er vanuit Marketing een briefing binnen voor een nieuwe social campagne. Dit keer geen uitgebreide productie, maar snelle mobile content voor TikTok en Instagram. Jij ziet meteen mogelijkheden en gaat aan de slag. Ondertussen probeer je een nieuwe AI-tool uit waarmee je een deel van je editproces nét wat slimmer kunt aanpakken.

Geen dag en geen video is hetzelfde. En juist die afwisseling tussen creativiteit, commercie en verschillende soorten content maakt jouw werk zo leuk.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je monteert en bewerkt video’s voor verschillende kanalen en doelgroepen: van snelle social content tot professionele branding- en campagnevideo’s

  • Je maakt content voor onder andere onze website, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook en LinkedIn

  • Je vertaalt ruwe beelden en briefings naar pakkende content die past bij het platform én de doelgroep

  • Je schakelt met accountmanagers over dealvideo’s en denkt mee over hoe we onze partners aantrekkelijk in beeld brengen

  • Je maakt samen met het marketingteam uiteenlopende videocontent: van campagnes en employer branding tot commerciële content voor onze deals en partners

  • Je houdt trends en ontwikkelingen rondom video en social media in de gaten en vertaalt deze naar nieuwe ideeën

  • Je experimenteert met AI en andere slimme tools om sneller, creatiever en efficiënter te werken

  • Je denkt actief mee over hoe we onze videocontent én onze manier van werken steeds beter kunnen maken

Met wie ga je dat doen?

Je wordt onderdeel van ons gezellige en veelzijdige marketingteam. Van content en design tot performance: iedereen heeft zijn eigen specialisme, maar we zoeken elkaar juist veel op.

Er wordt serieus en geconcentreerd gewerkt wanneer dat nodig is, maar minstens zoveel gelachen. Heb jij een goed idee, spot je een nieuwe TikTok-trend of ontdek je een tool waarmee we ons werk slimmer kunnen doen? Deel het vooral. We houden van mensen die initiatief nemen en graag samen iets nóg beter maken.

Wat vinden wij belangrijk?

  • Je hebt ervaring met het editen van video’s, bijvoorbeeld vanuit een opleiding, stage, bijbaan of eerste baan

  • Je kunt goed overweg met Adobe Premiere Pro

  • Je hebt gevoel voor social media en begrijpt dat een TikTok of Reel om een andere edit vraagt dan een brandingvideo

  • Je bent creatief en hebt oog voor beeld, timing en storytelling

  • Je volgt trends en vindt het leuk om nieuwe formats en technieken uit te proberen

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig naar AI en andere tools die je creatieve proces slimmer of efficiënter kunnen maken

  • Je kunt snel schakelen en denkt in oplossingen

  • Je hebt commercieel inzicht en kunt je verplaatsen in zowel onze partners als onze doelgroep

  • Ervaring met Adobe After Effects, Photoshop en/of filmen is mooi meegenomen

  • En natuurlijk vinden we het vooral belangrijk dat jij met plezier naar je werk gaat!

Herken jij jezelf in dit profiel? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Solliciteer direct!

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een mooi salaris, afhankelijk van jouw opleidingsniveau en ervaring + 8% vakantiegeld

  • Een arbeidsovereenkomst voor 32 tot 40 uur per week bij een werkgever die 2 keer op rij is uitgeroepen tot Beste Werkgever door Indeed

  • Reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer vanaf 10 km

  • 25 betaalde vakantiedagen, met in 2026 een eenmalige uitbreiding naar 28 betaalde vakantiedagen (o.b.v. fulltime)

  • Mogelijkheid tot 25 extra onbetaalde vakantiedagen (o.b.v. fulltime)

  • Pensioenopbouw (waarvan 50% voor rekening van Social Deal)

  • De mogelijkheid om gedeeltelijk thuis te werken na het inwerktraject

  • Werken in een schitterend kantoor op een toplocatie in ’s-Hertogenbosch, direct achter het Centraal Station

  • Uitgebreide lunch verzorgd door een topcateraar, een eigen gym, vers fruit, een gameroom en vrijdagmiddagborrels aan onze eigen bar of op ons dakterras

  • We vieren onze successen met unieke legendarische events

  • 10% korting op alle Social Deals én gratis de allertofste deals speciaal voor medewerkers; van sportlessen tot proeverijen en van massages tot workshops. Alles met de focus op teambuilding, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en natuurlijk ontspanning

title: Director, Windows Performance & Analytics
description:
Overview

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organisation on the planet to achieve more. In Windows Consumer, we play a critical role in shaping how customers experience the PC ecosystem across retail, partner, digital, and commercial-through-consumer channels.

The Director, Windows Performance & Analytics will lead the end-to-end performance, insights, and operating rhythm for the Windows Consumer business. This role will be accountable for establishing a trusted, consistent view of business performance, translating data into clear strategic narratives, and enabling senior leaders to make timely decisions on growth priorities, competitive response, investment allocation, and execution focus.

This is a senior individual contributor role requiring strong business ownership, analytical depth, executive communication, and cross-functional leadership. The successful candidate will operate across regional and worldwide stakeholders, partner closely with Finance, Sales, Category, Marketing, Operations, and Business Planning teams, and serve as a key orchestrator of Windows Consumer performance management.

The role requires someone who can move seamlessly between strategy and operations: defining the performance model, driving RoB discipline, identifying risks and opportunities early, and converting signals into actions that improve business outcomes.



Responsibilities

1. Windows Consumer Performance Model, Insights & Governance

  • Own the Windows Consumer performance model, defining the key metrics, leading indicators, dashboards, and reporting standards required to manage the business with consistency and accountability.
  • Establish and govern one trusted source of truth for Windows Consumer performance across scorecards, dashboards, market views, partner signals, and investment tracking.
  • Analyse performance across first-party, third-party, partner, market, and competitive data sources to identify drivers of growth, share movement, risks, and emerging opportunities.
  • Translate complex data into clear, decision-ready insights that inform business planning, GTM execution, investment prioritisation, and corrective actions.
  • Drive adoption of standard dashboards and performance views so that regional, market, and leadership teams operate from a common understanding of business health and key drivers.
  • Identify performance gaps, underlying causes, and actionable recommendations, ensuring insights lead to clear ownership, interventions, and measurable outcomes.

2. Operating Rhythm & RoB Leadership

  • Lead the Windows Consumer rhythm of business across performance reviews, scorecard reviews, forecast discussions, investment reviews, and executive updates.
  • Embed a consistent operating discipline across markets and teams, ensuring business reviews are grounded in facts, clear metrics, accountable actions, and timely follow-through.
  • Partner with key JCA stakeholders to surface risks, opportunities, and decisions required from senior leadership.
  • Drive a JCA cadence of reporting and reviews to ensure performance trends, execution gaps, and competitive dynamics are understood and acted upon.
  • Create clarity across stakeholders by connecting strategy, targets, investment, execution plans, and business outcomes into one integrated operating view.
  • Strengthen the quality of business reviews by moving discussions beyond status reporting toward insight-led decision making and action.

3. Chief Business Storyteller

  • Serve as the chief business storyteller for Windows Consumer performance, translating data signals into compelling executive narratives.
  • Develop concise, insight-led communications for senior leaders, connecting performance outcomes to business drivers, market dynamics, partner execution, competitive pressure, and required actions.
  • Prepare executive-ready business updates, performance narratives, issue briefs, and decision memos that enable clear alignment and faster decision making.
  • Partner across Category, Marketing, Sales, Finance, and Worldwide teams to ensure the business story is consistent, accurate, and grounded in a shared view of performance.
  • Build narratives that communicate not only what happened, but why it happened, what it means for the business, and what actions are required.
  • Influence senior stakeholders through clarity of insight, structured recommendations, and strong business judgement.

4. Targets, Forecasting & Investment Governance

  • Partner with Finance, Sales, Category, and Business Planning teams to cascade Windows Consumer targets and ensure alignment across markets, partners, programs, and scorecards.
  • Govern investment performance end-to-end, connecting funding decisions to business priorities, ROI expectations, execution progress, and measurable impact.
  • Lead performance reviews that assess whether investments are delivering expected outcomes and recommend reallocations where required.
  • Surface help-needed signals early, including target gaps, budget constraints, market headwinds, partner execution risks, and competitive threats.
  • Support fiscal planning, forecasting, and business reviews by ensuring leaders have a clear view of performance trajectory, investment effectiveness, and trade-off decisions.
  • Establish mechanisms to improve accountability for targets, investments, and execution commitments across stakeholders.

5. Cross-Functional Strategy & Stakeholder Leadership

  • Act as a senior liaison across regional, market, and worldwide teams, ensuring Windows Consumer priorities are clearly understood and reflected in planning, execution, and investment decisions.
  • Partner with Category, Finance, Marketing, Sales, Sales Excellence, Business Operations, and Worldwide teams to align on business priorities, performance expectations, and execution plans.
  • Influence cross-functional teams without direct authority, creating alignment across complex stakeholder groups and driving decisions through data, insight, and business judgement.
  • Champion regional and market perspectives in worldwide discussions, ensuring local realities, competitive dynamics, and partner signals inform broader Windows Consumer strategy.
  • Build scalable performance and insights practices that improve organisational capability and help teams make better, faster decisions.


Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS

Required/minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Economics, Public Relations, Engineering, or related field AND 8+ years category management, product management, marketing strategy, business planning, product planning, or related work experience OR equivalent experience.

Additional or preferred qualifications

  • 10+ years experience managing and expanding a category and attaining sales and profitability targets within a complex (e.g., multinational or matrixed) organization OR equivalent experience.
  • Proven ability to translate financial share and volume models into prioritized growth plans, TAM gap analyses, and committed sales priorities.
  • Strong competitive intelligence muscle — ability to synthesize moves from Apple, Google, and adjacent platforms into a clear, actionable point of view.
  • Track record orchestrating annual planning across Sales, Marketing, Business Planning, and Finance — influencing senior executives and large cross-functional organizations without direct authority.
  • Fluency with developed and emerging market dynamics, channel structures (Retail, OEM, online), and partner ecosystems (OEM, silicon, retail).
  • Comfort operating in a high-stakes competitive consumer PC market with clear share defense and growth targets.


This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

   Introduktion  
 

 
 Kan du motivere branchens bedste kolleger og bidrage til, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar? Så er du måske vores nye souschef. 

 Hos Lidl bliver du en del af Europas største dagligvarekæde med 150+ butikker i Danmark. Sammen er vi drevet af et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, og på #teamlidl kommer du med på en succesfuld rejse -- på et hold med høje ambitioner til fælles. Vi har brug for stærke ledere, der giver vores medarbejdere retning og overskud, så vi sammen skaber rammerne for landets bedste indkøbsoplevelse.
 Som souschef tager du aktiv del i det daglige arbejde i butikken, og får medansvar for butikkens drift og resultater. Hos os får du ansvar lige fra første arbejdsdag og bliver samtidig en del af et ambitiøst karriereudviklingsforløb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi nemlig høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen, med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig.
 Som souschef i Lidl får du en ansvarsfuld rolle med spændende udfordringer og en konkurrencedygtig lønpakke. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, så du har forudsætningerne for at opnå succes i din nye stilling.
     
 
 

 
   Om jobbet  
 

 
 Som souschef er du med til at drive butikken og lede medarbejderne. Du har medansvar for, at butikken lever op til kundernes forventninger, så de bliver ved med at handle hos os. Ud over at bestille varer, fylde op og ekspedere kunderne ved kassen, får du også følgende opgaver, som du løser i tæt samarbejde med butikschefen: 
 
 Planlægning af ressourcer og prioritering af arbejdsopgaver  

 Oplæring af medarbejdere, så de efterlever Lidls værdier og butikskoncepter 

 Ledelse af medarbejdere så de lykkes i deres job 

 Sørge for, at vores butikskoncepter overholdes 

 Ansvar for butikken når butikschefen ikke er til stede  
  
 

 
   Om dig  
 

 
 Du er en empatisk og stærk ledertype, der har nemt ved motivere dine medarbejdere. Du bliver respekteret for din faglighed, og du sætter en ære i at tage del i arbejdsopgaverne i den daglige drift, og være med til at sikre, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar. 
 Du er godt rustet til jobbet, hvis du: 
 
 Har brancheerfaring og gerne erfaring fra lignende stilling 

 Har gennemført et lederkursus eller er motiveret for at udvikle dig som leder 

 Har en venlig og professionel fremtoning 

 Inspirerer dine medarbejdere til at følge dit gode eksempel 

 Har overblik og fokus på detaljen  

 Ser butikken som et team og ikke er bleg for at give en hånd med, når en kollega har brug for hjælp 

 Har god forståelse for arbejdsprocesser, procedurer og koncepter 
  
 

 
   Vi tilbyder  
 

 
 Som souschef i Lidl får du:  
 
 En udfordrende rolle, hvor tingene går stærkt 

 Verdensklasse sammenhold 

 En konkurrencedygtig lønpakke på 26.000 - 32.500 kr. brutto om måneden 

 Et udbetalt tillæg i henhold til overenskomsten, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter - fx aftener, weekender og helligdage 

 Løn og vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst med HK 

 En grundig oplæring i vores arbejdsgange og koncepter 

 Adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt 

 Mulighed for sundhedsordning 

 Rabatordning hos flere udbydere af rejser, shopping, kultur, fitness mm. 
 
   

 Vil du med på #teamlidl?
 Sådan søger du stillingen: 
 
 Klik på "Søg nu" 

 Udfyld formularen 

 Vedhæft dit motiverede CV  
 
   

 Vi rekrutterer løbende, så send dit motiverede CV hurtigst muligt. Da butikken er åben alle ugens dage, vil der forekomme dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.
 Vores rekrutteringsproces består af en telefonsamtale og en fysisk samtale i butikken. 

 Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller ansøgningsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Recruiting på  jobilidloest@lidl.dk  eller tlf. 7635 0635, mandag - torsdag 8.00 - 15.00/ fredag 08.00 - 14.00.  

 Vi ser frem til at modtage dit CV!

description:
HAEMME VARHAISKASVATUKSEN OPETTAJAA NORLANDIA LOUNAAN [https://norlandiapaivakodit.fi/norlandia-louna]

Tänään me rakennettiin avaruusalus. Me päätettiin, että se lentää Marsiin. Mutta ensin piti laskea, montako rakettia se tarvitsee. Ja sitten me opittiin, mitä tarkoittaa painovoima.

Tältä näyttää arki varhaiskasvatuksessa lasten silmin, kun he ihmettelevät, kokeilevat, kysyvät ja oppivat. Sinä näet sen pedagogina ja oppimisen mahdollistajana, jossa jokainen hetki tukee lasten oppimista ja oivalluksia.

MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA?

* Olet pätevä varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja, joka haluaa tehdä työnsä ammattimaisesti lasten oppimisen ja oivallukset huomioiden.

* Vastaat oman ryhmäsi pedagogiikasta, ohjaat lasten oppimista ja osallistut päiväkodin kehittämiseen.

* Hyödynnät tekoälyä ja digitaalisia työkaluja suunnittelun ja arvioinnin tukena, mutta tärkein työvälineesi olet kuitenkin sinä, varhaiskasvatuksen ammattilainen, joka tuo tiimiin oman osaamisensa sekä tunnistaa lasten tarpeet ja mahdollisuudet.

TARJOAMME SINULLE

* vakituisen työsuhteen 9.11.2026 alkaen

* yksityisen työterveyshuollon

* liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedut

* edullisen työpaikkaruokailun

* Norlandia Akatemian koulutusmahdollisuudet

MIKSI NORLANDIA PÄIVÄKODIT?

Työntekijämme kertovat, että Norlandiassa parasta on se, että esihenkilöt ja tukiorganisaatio ovat aidosti lähellä ja tukena arjen tilanteissa. Meillä jokaisella on mahdollisuus vaikuttaa omaan työhönsä ja kehittää arkea. Jokainen päiväkotimme toimii omalla paikallisella otteellaan ja ketjun tarjoamat edut tukevat arjen sujuvuutta. Yhteisöllisyys ja osallisuus tekevät meistä työpaikan, jossa viihdytään pitkään.

HAE MUKAAN!

Lähetä hakemuksesi viimeistään 30.8.2026. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa päiväkodin johtaja Jaana Grönlund numerosta 046 923 5570 tai osoitteesta jaana.gronlund@norlandia.com

Tehtävään valitun henkilön on esitettävä rikosrekisteriote ennen työsuhteen alkamista (laki lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä 504/2002).

11/08/2026


Danish Crown Foods


DNK-Randers, Danish Crown Vej


 


Demand Planning Analyst - Planning & Supply Chain 

Do you want to play a key role in shaping how demand is planned and translated into high delivery performance across a complex food supply chain? Are you motivated by improving forecast accuracy, strengthening forecasting processes, and creating transparency in demand signals? And would you like to be part of building a stronger, more integrated planning setup across demand and supply? Then this position may be interesting to you.


 


About the job


Planning & Supply Chain consists of two sub-departments: Demand Planning and Master Planning. We are looking for a dedicated and structured Demand Planning Analyst to join our planning team at the head office in Randers. You will become part of a newly strengthened planning team where Demand Planning and Master Planning are brought together to ensure closer alignment between demand and supply.


 


In this newly established position, you will plan and govern demand across selected categories and markets and play a key role in shaping how Danish Crown works with forecasting and demand planning going forward - with a strong focus on forecast accuracy, robust forecasting processes and a reliable and transparent demand plan.


 


At the same time, you will contribute to creating balance between demand and supply, and you should expect to support or take part in tasks related to Master Planning to ensure a balanced and aligned planning process.


 


Your impact and key responsibilities are:



Be accountable for the quality and continuous improvement of demand forecasts within your scope, with a clear focus on forecast accuracy and bias reduction


Act as the central link between Sales, Category, and Supply Planning to ensure a shared and transparent demand plan


Drive and develop forecasting processes and structured demand reviews, combining data and analytical precision with commercial insights to translate market activities and promotions into a reliable demand signal


Be a key contributor in weekly S&OE forums to ensure alignment between short-term execution and commercial priorities


Own and drive the monthly demand reviews as part of the S&OP process, providing a validated forecast contributing to long-term demand outlooks


Identify forecast risks and demand volatility early and proactively support mitigation actions to secure high delivery performance


Develop and maintain demand planning tools, reports, and KPIs (e.g. forecast accuracy, bias, demand volatility) to support data-driven decision-making


Conduct scenario planning to assess the impact of demand changes and commercial decisions on service level, inventory, and capacity


Drive continuous improvement of demand planning processes, standards, and best practices across markets - e.g. implementation of machine learning models


Support planning activities across the team when needed, including collaboration with Master Planning to ensure end-to-end balance between supply and demand



 


How you create impact and drive collaboration


We are looking for self-driven and structured demand planners who can elevate forecasting processes and forecast quality across selected categories and markets in close collaboration with Sales. Most importantly, you are passionate about driving change and continuous improvement and are motivated by contributing to the development of future planning processes and ways of working.


 


You are confident working with data, numbers, and insights, and you can combine analytical thinking with commercial understanding. You bring structure to complex topics and turn data into clear messages that support decision-making.


 


Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills are essential for success in this role. You work cross-functionally and across regions, collaborating closely with sales, supply, and planning teams to create a shared understanding of demand. You communicate clearly, use data storytelling to build alignment, and thrive in a complex stakeholder landscape where trust, transparency, and strong relationships are key.


 


The ideal candidate would:



Hold a relevant Master's degree within Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration, or a similar field


Be a recent graduate, preferably with relevant experience from student worker positions or have limited professional experience in the field, but a strong motivation to develop and build a career within Planning and Supply Chain


Have a strong analytical mindset and the ability to translate complex data into clear insights and actionable demand plans


Be confident working with Microsoft 365, particularly Excel. Experience with demand planning systems (e.g. SAP APO, IBP, or similar) is considered an advantage


Be proactive, structured, and comfortable challenging assumptions to improve forecast quality


Thrive in a dynamic environment with close collaboration across commercial and supply chain functions


Be fluent in Danish and English — knowledge of other European languages is considered an advantage





Appetite for more?


We are writing the next chapter for planning at Danish Crown and invite you to be part of it.


If you have any questions about the position, please do not hesitate to contact Kamilla Hellerup, Manager, Planning & Supply Chain, phone: +45 29893293 to learn more about the position.



We review candidates continuously, so send your CV and a few words on why you are a candidate to consider as soon as possible, as we reserve the right to stop the search once we have found the right candidate.


 


We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Helsinki, Konala
description:
Etsitkö ihmisläheistä työtä, jossa pääset tärkeäksi osaksi toisen ihmisen arkea? Henkilökohtaisena avustajana pääset tukemaan asiakasta niissä tilanteissa, joissa hän tarvitsee toisen ihmisen apua esimerkiksi liikkumisessa, kodin askareissa tai vapaa-ajan toiminnassa. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan tarkoitus on tukea asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta ja mahdollisuutta elää omannäköistä elämää.

Henkilökohtaisen avustajan työ on maanläheistä ja tilanteisiin mukautuvaa. Päivät voivat vaihdella paljon, ja tehtävät suunnitellaan aina asiakkaan tarpeiden mukaan. Aiempaa kokemusta tehtävästä ei tarvita, sillä perehdytämme sinut työhön. Olemme työnantajana aina helposti tavoitettavissa ja tukenasi, jotta työ sujuu turvallisesti ja luontevasti.

Meille on tärkeää, että työ sopii yhtä hyvin avustajalle kuin avustaja asiakkaalle. Työvuorot suunnitellaan yhteisymmärryksessä, jotta arki pysyy kaikille toimivana ja selkeänä.

Etsimme nyt osa-aikaista henkilökohtaista avustajaa asiakkaallemme Helsingin Konalaan. Asiakas on nainen, joka tarvitsee apua arjen askareissa, kuten kotitöissä sekä kodin ulkopuolisilla asiointikäynneillä ja vapaa-ajan vietossa. Avustajan on oltava vastuuntuntoinen ja luotettava.

Työvuoroja on yleensä noin kahdesti viikossa arkisin päiväsaikaan (noin 4-6 tuntia/vuoro). Vuoroja voi olla välillä myös lauantaisin. Asiakas ja avustaja sopivat vuoroista keskenään.

Työhön valitulta henkilöltä vaaditaan rikostaustaselvitys vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työskentelyä varten (Laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta).

Toivomme, että olet:
- Oma-aloitteinen
- Luotettava
- Empaattinen

Työ alkaa mahdollisimman pian tai sopimuksen mukaan. Aloitamme haastattelut ennen hakuajan päättymistä ja tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Elämäsi Adato – Sinun elämäsi, sinä päätät
Elämäsi Adato Oy on suomalainen perheyritys, joka on täysin erikoistunut henkilökohtaisen avun järjestämiseen jo yli 15 vuoden ajan. Tavoitteenamme on auttaa jokaista asiakasta toimimaan arjen tilanteissa turvallisesti ja omien toiveidensa mukaisesti, niin että itsemääräämisoikeus säilyy kaikissa päivän kulkuun liittyvissä asioissa.

Haluamme olla asiakkaillemme luotettava kumppani heidän jokapäiväisessä elämässään ja työntekijöillemme välittävä ja joustava työnantaja. Meillä työskentely on konkreettista, ihmisläheistä ja merkityksellistä.

Työllistämme yli 300 henkilökohtaista avustajaa eri puolilla Suomea. Kasvamme vastuullisesti, ihmisten tarpeita kuunnellen.

title: NOC Analyst
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

NOC Analyst will provide day-to-day network, application, AI, cloud, infrastructure monitoring as well as support escalations. This includes front line support and coordinating with Senior NOC Analysts and other levels. This interaction can range from opening/closing tickets, escalating to management/admins via phone/email and sending notices to business on issue status. Act as a liaison between the vendors, internal staff and IT Org. Work with IT Org on projects when required. Take part in a 24x7x365 rotation.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide 24-hour Network, Application and Infrastructure Health surveillance and alarm reporting utilizing multiple monitoring and surveillance software.
  • Monitor service desk requests and coordinate support with IT infrastructure teams.
  • Perform standardized maintenance and administrative functions related to IT infrastructure and cloud (AWS/Azure) systems.
  • Ability to follow NOC instructions and processes as well as contribute to the objectives of the NOC.
  • Experienced in writing reports and daily shift logs.
  • As this individual often represents the internal and external customers and colleagues – professionalism is a must.
  • Must possess strong interpersonal skills and have the ability to interact with all levels of employees in a professional manner.
  • As an essential function of this position, the employee must be able to handle high levels of stress satisfactorily and be friendly with other employees and customers at all times.
  • Critical thinking is essential in fast paced environment of NOC. Need to be able to successfully balance multiple tasks at once.
  • Strict adherence to company policies, confidentiality, and mature judgment must be demonstrated at all times
  • Assigned duties should be performed in a timely and accurate manner.
  • Knowledge and some experience in AI tools like Claude and Copilot.
  • Must handle responsibilities by multi-tasking, working independently and with minimal direction. Must deliver objectives both individually and by interaction with others, therefore must demonstrate an understanding of organizational functions and departments.
  • Quickly and effectively communicate with the Company Profile within our SLA.
  • Familiar in Documenting of Incident, Change and Problem Management.
  • Monitor and Maintain SFTP Environments
  • Addition and removal of duties may take place over time


REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and Experience:

  • Degree/Diploma in Computer Studies or equivalent work experience
  • Team player, self-motivator, with excellent Can “DO” Motivation.
  • Basic Knowledge on Network, Server, Cloud, System admin, Linux CLI.
  • AWS/Azure Cloud, Cisco CCNA or Microsoft MCP certifications a nice to have.
  • Knowledge on NOC monitoring Platforms like Nagios, SolarWinds, Pingdom, Honeycomb.
  • Knowledge of NOC management Platforms like JIRA, Confluence, OpsGenie/JSM, Microsoft Teams
  • AI Tools like Copilot and Claude.
  • Microsoft Office suite Outlook, Word and Excel

Specialized Skills:

  • One-year Network Operations Center experience or equivalent.
  • Must be familiar with US and UK accent and need to work in rotational shifts 24/7 including weekends ​
  • Responsible for basic analysis and troubleshooting network routers and switches, server’s environment to isolate the trouble and take appropriate action to resolve.
  • Monitor deployed production network, cloud, servers and all devices, capturing and analyzing customer QoS and RFC events using tools and Emails.
  • Ensure timely resolution to Issues; follow up with IT Team, Clients, Vendors via e-mails or phone calls and able to open bridge on dependence of issue severity.
  • Knowledge of monitoring tools like (Nagios, SolarWinds, Pingdom, Honeycomb).
  • Knowledge of SFTP environments GlobalScape as well as Backup environments NetBackup.
  • Experience in NOC operations and process management.
  • Excellent written, verbal and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical, technical and problem-solving skills.

Core Competencies:

Client Focus - Demonstrates a strong customer orientation, builds partnerships, and work well across functions in order to service internal and external clients in a timely fashion.

Communication Skills – Adjusting accordingly to demonstrate sensitivity to cultural differences while maintaining highest level of abilities in all aspects of communication, written, oral, listening and expressing ideas.

Critical Thinking - Understands business strategy and processes while able to applying to local objectives.

Team Work - Ability to work effectively independently and harmoniously within a team while communicating a “can do” attitude and positive outlook. Willing to pitch in and do more than is required.

title: Medicinsk vårdadministratör, VO Kärl- och thorax, administration, USÖ
description:
Vi söker ersättare för en planerad föräldraledighet. Vi erbjuder dig ett självständigt och varierande arbete, där du blir en del av ett team med kompetenta och engagerade kollegor samt har ett nära arbeta med övriga personalkategorier.

Kärl- och toraxadministration består av 5 medicinska vårdadministratörer och 1 IT-administratör.

Arbetsuppgifter

I tjänsten ingår sedvanliga arbetsuppgifter för en medicinsk vårdadministratör såsom medicinsk dokumentation, diagnosklassificering, remisshantering, posthantering samt andra förekommande administrativa arbetsuppgifter. Arbetet kan variera utifrån de ansvarsuppdrag du får.

Kvalifikationer

Godkänd utbildning som medicinsk vårdadministratör, medicinsk sekreterare eller läkarsekreterare. Du har goda kunskaper i svenska språket och kan uttrycka dig väl i tal och skrift.

Vi värdesätter egenskaper som positiv attityd, god samarbetsförmåga och flexibilitet. Du har ett etiskt och professionellt förhållningssätt i alla möten. Är noggrann och kan organisera och prioritera ditt arbete på ett självständigt och effektivt sätt.

Ansökan

Urval sker löpande.

Ansökan ska innehålla CV och personligt brev. Intyg, betyg, examensbevis med mera ska lämnas vid en eventuell intervju.

Om du är eller tidigare varit anställd i Region Örebro län kommer vi ta interna referenser från din nuvarande eller tidigare chef, om du blir aktuell för anställning.

Kontroll av registerutdrag från Polismyndigheten kan komma att ske enligt aktuell lagstiftning.

Som anställd i Region Örebro län omfattas du av trygga kollektivavtal. Läs mer om villkor och förmåner.

Vi sätter löner individuellt och differentierat. Läs mer om lön och lönestatistik.

Vi krigsplacerar våra tillsvidareanställda och i vissa fall även visstidsanställda. Läs mer om vad det innebär.

Om verksamheten

Verksamhetsområde Kärl och Thorax består av en vårdavdelning med tillhörande intermediärvårdsavdelning (IMA), intensivvårdsavdelning, operationsavdelning, kärlmottagning samt administration. Vi utför ca 1600 operationer/år inom öppen hjärtkirurgi, allmän thoraxkirurgi, kärlkirurgi samt arytmiverksamhet. Utifrån patientens fokus präglas verksamheten av en stark produktionsinriktning i kombination med ett intensivt forsknings- och utvecklingsarbete. Vi bedriver avancerad kärl-thoraxkirurgisk sjukvård dygnet runt och specialister finns inom thoraxkirurgi, kärlkirurgi och thorax-anestesiologi. Totalt är vi ca 200 engagerade medarbetare som dagligen bidrar till ett öppet arbetsklimat och ett utpräglat teamarbete.

Region Örebro län är en av länets största arbetsgivare. Tillsammans med 11 000 kollegor kan du skapa ett bättre liv för de vi finns till för. Hos oss finns meningsfulla och samhällsviktiga jobb där du kan göra skillnad i invånarnas vardag, hälsa och livskvalitet. Dygnet runt, året om, ansvarar vi för hälso- och sjukvård, tandvård och länets kollektivtrafik. Vi har också det regionala utvecklingsansvaret i länet och ett uppdrag att bidra till kulturlivet.

Övrig information

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Vi har gjort vårt medieval för denna rekrytering och undanber oss därför erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annonsering.

title: Stödassistent till Linden, Enheten Daglig verksamhet
description:
Vill du vara med och göra Gävle ännu bättre med oss? I Gävle kommun arbetar vi engagerat tillsammans för att kunna erbjuda våra invånare en trygg och inspirerande miljö. Vi erbjuder dig en tillitsfull arbetsplats där du kan utvecklas i ditt arbete och växa som människa. Välkommen med din ansökan!

Linden är en av våra grupper inom Daglig verksamhet. På Linden möter du vuxna personer med måttlig till grav intellektuell funktionsnedsättning, i kombination med flerfunktionsnedsättningar som har ett beslut om daglig verksamhet enligt Lagen om Stöd och Service för vissa funktionshindrade (LSS). På Linden finns aktivitetsrum speciellt utformade för att stimulera alla sinnen. Det finns rum både för avslappning och aktivitet. Lindens dagliga verksamhet ligger i ett bostadsområde på stadsdelen Söder.

2 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
På Linden möter du vuxna personer med måttlig till grav intellektuell funktionsnedsättning, i kombination med flerfunktionsnedsättningar. Linden är en verksamhet med stort pedagogiskt syfte. Du kommer att arbeta i en miljö där ljudnivån stundtals är hög, tempot varierar och där du ständigt möter både brukare, kollegor och personliga assistenter.

	• Som stödassistent är du en nyckelperson i att skapa en innehållsrik dag för varje individ.
	• Ditt huvudsakliga uppdrag är att säkerställa att brukarna får rätt stöd och möjlighet att utvecklas utifrån sina individuella förutsättningar. Genom individ- och gruppanpassade aktiviteter bidrar du till att stärka deras självständighet, delaktighet och utveckling.
	• Du deltar i och leder aktiviteter som sinnesstimulering, musik, massage, uteaktiviteter och skapande. 
	• Du arbetar både individuellt och i grupp, och du är trygg i att leda och inspirera. 
	• Arbetet omfattar personlig omvårdnad och manuella förflyttningar, vilket innebär att du behöver vara bekväm med ett arbete som stundtals är fysiskt krävande.
	• Inom Daglig verksamhet, arbetar vi aktivt med brukarinflytande och vårt arbete utgår från ett pedagogiskt förhållnings-och arbetssätt (PFA) som tydliggör och anpassar arbetsuppgifterna utifrån varje enskild person.
	• Du ska kunna arbeta självständigt utifrån målsättningar, riktlinjer, aktiviteter och individuella genomförandeplaner. Tillsammans med kollega eller enskilt ansvarar du för planering, genomförande, utvärdering samt utveckling av verksamheten.
	• Arbetet bygger på ett strukturerat arbetssätt och i ditt bemötande arbetar du för att brukaren möts på sin nivå. I vår verksamhet arbetar du med brukaren i centrum genom att du och dina kollegor skapar en trygg och utvecklande miljö på arbetsplatsen.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Formella kompetenser

	• Vi söker dig som har examen från vård- och  omsorgsprogrammet, barn- och fritidsprogrammet med inriktning socialt arbete, stödassistentutbildning eller annan yrkesutbildning på gymnasienivå mot målgruppen.
	• Du har goda kunskaper om och erfarenhet av arbete inom LSS samt minst två års erfarenhet av att arbeta med målgruppen. 
	• Erfarenhet av dokumentation inom LSS, socialjournaler och genomförandeplaner. 
	• Du har förmåga att uttrycka dig väl i det svenska språket i såväl tal som skrift
	• B-körkort

Meriterande för tjänsten är ergonomisk kunskap, gärna inom förflyttningsteknik.

För att lyckas i rollen

	• Har du starkt engagemang för målgruppen. 
	• Du har lätt för att samarbeta med andra samtidigt som du tar egna initiativ och driver ditt arbete framåt. I samarbetet med kollegor och andra aktörer har du ett prestigelöst förhållningssätt
	• Du inger trygghet och skapar förtroende i mötet med andra.
	• Du är kreativ, flexibel och lösningsorienterad, med god förmåga att hantera situationer som uppstår i vardagen. Du anpassar dig till olika förutsättningar och har lätt för att ändra ditt synsätt när situationen kräver det.
	• Du ser möjligheter i förändringar och bidrar aktivt till utveckling och förbättring.

Vi tror att rätt personlighet gör stor skillnad därför är dina personliga egenskaper viktiga för oss.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare, tillträde: Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.
Arbetstid: Dagtid.

För att kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsprocessen i Gävle kommun samt möjliggöra god kommunikation med våra sökande ber vi dig att skicka in din ansökan digitalt via Visma Recruit, inte via e-post eller pappersformat. Om du har skyddad identitet ber vid dig att ta kontakt med rekryterande chef, skicka inte in din ansökan digitalt.

Om du söker en deltidstjänst hos oss så finns ett beslut inom Gävle kommun som innebär att du som tillsvidareanställd medarbetare kan begära att du vill arbeta heltid. En sådan begäran kan innebära att du kan behöva utföra andra arbetsuppgifter än dina ordinarie.

Gävle kommun hör till finskt förvaltningsområde. Om du därför utöver våra övriga kompetenskrav även talar finska, kan det vara en merit.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har Gävle kommun tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanbeder oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

title: SAP Data Migration Lead
description:
About Us:
ABeam Consulting is a global professional services company that specializes in delivering business transformation and technology solutions to clients across a wide range of industries. With a global presence and over 9000 employees worldwide we aim to be the transformation partner of choice for all of our clients.

Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced SAP Data Migration Lead to lead end-to-end data migration activities for a large-scale SAP implementation and rollout to the United States business operations. The successful candidate will be responsible for defining and executing the data migration strategy, ensuring data quality, and managing data migration activities across multiple business functions and stakeholders.
The role requires close collaboration with business users, functional consultants, technical teams, and client stakeholders across Singapore, offshore delivery centers, and the USA.

Responsibilities
Data Migration Leadership
  • Define and execute the overall data migration strategy, approach, and governance framework.
  • Lead all phases of the SAP data migration lifecycle including Data Assessment, Data Cleansing, Data Extraction, Transformation, Validation, Mock Loads, Cutover, and Go-Live Support.
  • Develop and maintain the Data Migration Plan, Migration Tracker, Risk Register, and Status Reports.
  • Drive data migration workshops with business stakeholders and process owners.
Data Management
  • Identify data objects, mapping requirements, transformation rules, and data quality requirements.
  • Establish data quality metrics and monitor data readiness throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Oversee cleansing activities and coordinate issue resolution with business users.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance and master data management standards.
SAP Migration Execution
  • Lead migration activities using SAP Data Migration Cockpit, SAP S/4HANA Migration Tools, SAP BODS, SAP Data Services, LSMW, or other approved migration tools.
  • Coordinate data extraction from legacy systems and loading into SAP environments.
  • Manage multiple mock conversions and reconciliation cycles.
  • Ensure successful migration of master data, transactional data, and open items.
Stakeholder Management
  • Act as the primary point of contact for all data migration matters.
  • Work closely with USA business stakeholders to align migration schedules, testing activities, and cutover requirements.
  • Facilitate discussions between business, technical, functional, and offshore teams.
  • Provide regular executive-level updates on migration progress, risks, and dependencies.
Testing & Cutover
  • Support SIT, UAT, Dress Rehearsal, and Go-Live activities.
  • Coordinate data validation and reconciliation activities with business users.
  • Lead migration cutover planning and execution.
  • Ensure post-go-live data stabilization and issue resolution.
Requirements
  • Minimum 10+ years of SAP experience with at least 5 years leading SAP Data Migration workstreams.
  • Proven experience in at least 2 full-cycle SAP S/4HANA implementations or global rollouts.
  • Strong experience in:
    • SAP S/4HANA Data Migration
    • SAP Migration Cockpit
    • SAP Data Services (BODS)
    • SAP MDG (preferred)
    • Data Mapping and Data Governance
    • Data Quality and Reconciliation
  • Experience migrating:
    • Business Partners
    • Customers
    • Vendors
    • Materials
    • Finance Data
    • Open Transactions
    • Inventory and Asset Data
  • Strong understanding of SAP business processes across Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Sales, and Manufacturing.
  • Experience managing offshore and distributed delivery teams.
  • Excellent stakeholder and communication skills.
  • SAP S/4HANA Certification is preferred.
  • Experience with USA rollouts and multi-country implementations will be an advantage.
  • Knowledge of SOX controls and compliance requirements is highly desirable.
  • Experience in Pharmaceutical, Manufacturing, Retail, Consumer Goods, or Distribution industries is preferred.
  • Familiarity with SAP Activate methodology would be beneficial.
  • Strong leadership, stakeholder management, planning, execution, problem-solving, and risk management skills are advantageous.
  • Experience driving data quality improvements and managing complex migration cutovers and go-live activities would be a plus.

Why Join Us
At ABeam Consulting, we place a strong emphasis on collaboration, and helping our employees grow and develop their skills, offering a supportive and empowering work environment. With a presence in multiple countries and a diverse range of clients, Abeam Consulting offers an exciting and dynamic workplace for individuals looking to build a career in consulting. Abeam Consulting has also recently joined SAP’s regional strategic partner initiative as their first regional partner in the region and has also been recognized by UiPath as a Diamond Partner in providing RPA solutions. With such accolades, we aim to continue driving enterprise and digital transformation initiatives in order to transform the way people work and communicate in the digital age. In addition, our industry team is working tirelessly in order to bring more solutions to the banking and finance sector.

We regret only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

   Introduktion  
 

 
 Kan du motivere branchens bedste kolleger og bidrage til, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar? Så er du måske vores nye souschef. 

 Hos Lidl bliver du en del af Europas største dagligvarekæde med 150+ butikker i Danmark. Sammen er vi drevet af et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, og på #teamlidl kommer du med på en succesfuld rejse -- på et hold med høje ambitioner til fælles. Vi har brug for stærke ledere, der giver vores medarbejdere retning og overskud, så vi sammen skaber rammerne for landets bedste indkøbsoplevelse.
 Som souschef tager du aktiv del i det daglige arbejde i butikken, og får medansvar for butikkens drift og resultater. Hos os får du ansvar lige fra første arbejdsdag og bliver samtidig en del af et ambitiøst karriereudviklingsforløb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi nemlig høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen, med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig.
 Som souschef i Lidl får du en ansvarsfuld rolle med spændende udfordringer og en konkurrencedygtig lønpakke. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, så du har forudsætningerne for at opnå succes i din nye stilling.
     
 
 

 
   Om jobbet  
 

 
 Som souschef er du med til at drive butikken og lede medarbejderne. Du har medansvar for, at butikken lever op til kundernes forventninger, så de bliver ved med at handle hos os. Ud over at bestille varer, fylde op og ekspedere kunderne ved kassen, får du også følgende opgaver, som du løser i tæt samarbejde med butikschefen: 
 
 Planlægning af ressourcer og prioritering af arbejdsopgaver  

 Oplæring af medarbejdere, så de efterlever Lidls værdier og butikskoncepter 

 Ledelse af medarbejdere så de lykkes i deres job 

 Sørge for, at vores butikskoncepter overholdes 

 Ansvar for butikken når butikschefen ikke er til stede  
  
 

 
   Om dig  
 

 
 Du er en empatisk og stærk ledertype, der har nemt ved motivere dine medarbejdere. Du bliver respekteret for din faglighed, og du sætter en ære i at tage del i arbejdsopgaverne i den daglige drift, og være med til at sikre, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar. 
 Du er godt rustet til jobbet, hvis du: 
 
 Har brancheerfaring og gerne erfaring fra lignende stilling 

 Har gennemført et lederkursus eller er motiveret for at udvikle dig som leder 

 Har en venlig og professionel fremtoning 

 Inspirerer dine medarbejdere til at følge dit gode eksempel 

 Har overblik og fokus på detaljen  

 Ser butikken som et team og ikke er bleg for at give en hånd med, når en kollega har brug for hjælp 

 Har god forståelse for arbejdsprocesser, procedurer og koncepter 
  
 

 
   Vi tilbyder  
 

 
 Som souschef i Lidl får du:  
 
 En udfordrende rolle, hvor tingene går stærkt 

 Verdensklasse sammenhold 

 En konkurrencedygtig lønpakke på 26.000 - 32.500 kr. brutto om måneden 

 Et udbetalt tillæg i henhold til overenskomsten, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter - fx aftener, weekender og helligdage 

 Løn og vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst med HK 

 En grundig oplæring i vores arbejdsgange og koncepter 

 Adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt 

 Mulighed for sundhedsordning 

 Rabatordning hos flere udbydere af rejser, shopping, kultur, fitness mm. 
 
   

 Vil du med på #teamlidl?
 Sådan søger du stillingen: 
 
 Klik på "Søg nu" 

 Udfyld formularen 

 Vedhæft dit motiverede CV  
 
   

 Vi rekrutterer løbende, så send dit motiverede CV hurtigst muligt. Da butikken er åben alle ugens dage, vil der forekomme dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.
 Vores rekrutteringsproces består af en telefonsamtale og en fysisk samtale i butikken. 

 Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller ansøgningsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Recruiting på  jobilidloest@lidl.dk  eller tlf. 7635 0635, mandag - torsdag 8.00 - 15.00/ fredag 08.00 - 14.00.  

 Vi ser frem til at modtage dit CV! 
 
 
 


  
 

												
 
     
  Transskription 
 Der er ikke nogen bedre følelse end når der er ordentlig tingene og Når alting står snur lige nede i butikken handler det for mig om at hjælpe kunderne og at gøre mit til at vi har en indbydende butik at det samtidig sker i samarbejde med de bedste kollegaer det gør det bare fedt at gå på arbejde
