title: Staff Software Engineer, Managed Gateways
description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role

Cloud Gateways is Kong's foundational cloud-native SaaS platform powering its managed API and AI Gateway offerings. It provides a multi-tenant control plane, automation and platform services that enable customers to securely deploy, operate and scale dedicated gateway infrastructure with the simplicity of a fully managed cloud service.

Behind that experience is a distributed platform responsible for provisioning, fleet management, software lifecycle, zero-downtime upgrades, observability, security and multi-region operations across globally distributed cloud infrastructure. The platform powers mission-critical workloads with a target of 99.99% availability, balancing reliability, performance, operational excellence and infrastructure efficiency at global scale.

As enterprises increasingly adopt AI alongside traditional APIs, Cloud Gateways becomes an increasingly important part of Kong's API and AI strategy. Every improvement in automation, scalability and operational excellence accelerates the delivery of new platform capabilities and enables product teams to innovate faster.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll help define and build that platform.

The problems you'll solve span software engineering, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure and site reliability engineering, requiring a systems mindset and a passion for building platforms that are reliable, scalable and simple to operate.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role with end-to-end ownership of core platform capabilities. You'll shape technical strategy, influence platform architecture and solve complex engineering challenges while working across engineering organizations globally.

We're looking for engineers who think beyond individual services, treat platforms as products and embrace a system ownership mindset. You'll be equally comfortable diving deep into production issues, designing resilient distributed systems and influencing long-term platform architecture and engineering strategy.

Success in this role requires balancing software engineering, cloud infrastructure and operational excellence while always optimizing for the platform as a whole rather than individual services.

Why Join Cloud Gateways?

Cloud Gateways is more than a product. It's the foundational platform powering Kong's managed API and AI Gateway offerings, and the platform on which future managed connectivity services will be built.

It provides the common platform for provisioning, fleet management, software lifecycle, upgrades, observability, reliability and operational excellence. Every investment in Cloud Gateways enables product teams to deliver new capabilities faster while giving customers a consistent, secure and fully managed experience.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll help build the platform that sits at the center of Kong's API and AI strategy. Your work won't be confined to a single service or feature. You'll influence the underlying platform that multiple products depend on.

You'll work on engineering problems such as:

Building a distributed platform that powers Kong's managed API and AI Gateway offerings.

Operating globally distributed control plane services at enterprise scale.

Managing the lifecycle of thousands of dedicated gateway deployments across multiple cloud regions.

Designing zero-downtime provisioning, upgrades and fleet-wide orchestration.

Building self-healing systems through software, automation and intelligent operations.

Improving reliability, observability and operational excellence at scale.

Scaling the platform that enables the next generation of managed connectivity services.

If you enjoy building foundational platforms, thinking in systems, and solving problems that span software engineering, cloud infrastructure and distributed systems, you'll have the opportunity to shape the platform powering Kong's next generation of managed API and AI offerings.

What You'll Do

Own the Cloud Gateways Platform

Own the technical direction, architecture and evolution of Cloud Gateways, the foundational platform powering Kong's managed API and AI Gateway offerings. Design and evolve highly available cloud-native infrastructure across Kubernetes and public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure and GCP), building a scalable, resilient, secure and operationally efficient platform for globally distributed gateway infrastructure.

Drive Reliability & Operational Excellence

Own the availability, reliability, performance and operational health of the Cloud Gateways platform. Define and drive SLIs, SLOs and error budgets while ensuring the platform consistently meets its 99.99% availability objectives. Continuously improve observability, scalability, capacity, infrastructure efficiency and platform resilience through software engineering, automation, incident management and operational excellence.

Automate & Optimize Platform Operations

Build platform capabilities that automate provisioning provisioning, lifecycle management, fleet-wide upgrades, configuration management and infrastructure orchestration. Continuously improve platform performance, infrastructure utilization and cloud efficiency while balancing reliability, scalability, security and customer experience.

Lead Through Technical Influence

Influence technical strategy and architectural direction across engineering organizations. Build alignment with engineering leadership, lead cross-functional initiatives and mentor engineers through architecture reviews, technical guidance and engineering best practices to raise the engineering bar across the Managed Gateways organization.

What You'll Bring

Software & Platform Engineering

Experience building or operating large-scale multi-tenant SaaS platforms. Experience running infrastructure or platform services ("X-as-a-Service") at scale is strongly preferred.

Significant experience designing, building and operating large-scale distributed systems in production.

Experience at Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer or equivalent technical leadership level.

Strong software engineering skills with production experience in Golang.

Deep expertise in Kubernetes and at least one major public cloud provider (AWS, Azure or GCP), including compute, networking, storage and cloud-native infrastructure services.

Strong understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, load balancing, reverse proxies, ingress controllers and service mesh technologies.

Curiosity and ability to dive deep into systems, understand infrastructure internals and solve complex problems across the software and cloud stack.

Reliability & Operational Excellence

Strong understanding of Site Reliability Engineering principles, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, incident management, capacity planning and operational excellence.

Experience owning business-critical production platforms with stringent availability and reliability objectives.

Proven experience leading production incidents, driving blameless postmortems and continuously improving operational maturity through automation.

Strong observability experience using metrics, logging, tracing and monitoring platforms such as Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana or OpenTelemetry.

Passion for building software that eliminates operational toil while improving reliability, scalability and operational efficiency.

Technical Leadership & Cross-Organizational Influence

Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across multiple levels of abstraction, from debugging low-level production issues and optimizing cloud infrastructure to defining long-term platform architecture and engineering strategy.

Strong system ownership mindset with the ability to balance customer experience, platform reliability, engineering productivity, infrastructure efficiency and long-term platform evolution.

Proven ability to influence technical direction across multiple engineering organizations through strong communication, collaboration and technical leadership.

Comfortable navigating ambiguity, simplifying complex systems and making pragmatic engineering decisions that create long-term platform leverage.

Nice to Have

Experience with API gateways, AI gateways, reverse proxies, edge networking or service mesh technologies.

Experience designing distributed control planes, fleet management systems or cloud infrastructure platforms.

Experience operating large Kubernetes fleets across multiple regions.

Familiarity with security, compliance and multi-tenant cloud architectures.

About Kong

Kong Inc. is a leading developer of API and AI connectivity technologies, building the infrastructure that powers the agentic era. Trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises and innovative startups alike, Kong's unified API and AI platform, Kong Konnect, enables organizations to securely connect, govern, accelerate and monetize APIs and AI services across any environment.

At Kong, you'll work alongside world-class engineers solving some of the industry's most challenging distributed systems and cloud infrastructure problems. Your work will directly influence the platform powering the next generation of API and AI connectivity used by thousands of organizations worldwide.

About Kong:

Kong Inc., a leading developer of API and AI connectivity technologies, is building the infrastructure that powers the agentic era. Trusted by the Fortune 500 and startups alike, Kong's unified API and AI platform, Kong Konnect, enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI models. For more information, visit .

title: Project Manager (Insurance)
description:
About Capco

Capco is a global business and technology consultancy dedicated exclusively to the financial services industry. Our consultants bring innovative thinking together with deep, first‑hand industry experience to help clients solve their most complex business and technology challenges.

We partner with leading banks, capital markets firms, and wealth & investment managers to deliver transformation across finance, risk & compliance, regulatory change, and technology. With offices across major financial centres in North America, Europe, and APAC, Capco offers the opportunity to work on large‑scale, high‑impact programmes that shape the future of financial services.

At Capco, collaboration, delivery excellence, and entrepreneurship define how we work and succeed.

Role Overview

The Project Manager will be responsible for leading the delivery of business and technology projects across Life, General, and/or Medical Insurance. The role will manage project planning, governance, stakeholder engagement, vendor coordination, risks, dependencies, and execution activities to ensure successful delivery of transformation initiatives.

Working closely with business stakeholders, product owners, technology teams, vendors, and programme leadership, the Project Manager will drive project outcomes from mobilisation through implementation, ensuring delivery aligns with business objectives, timelines, budgets, and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

1) Project Planning & Delivery

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of insurance transformation and technology projects.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, milestones, timelines, and delivery roadmaps.
  • Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, and success criteria.
  • Monitor project progress and proactively manage delivery risks and issues.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to agreed quality standards.
  • Support project mobilisation, implementation, and transition activities.

2) Stakeholder Management & Governance

  • Build strong relationships with business stakeholders, sponsors, technology teams, and external partners.
  • Facilitate project governance forums, working groups, and steering committee meetings.
  • Prepare and present project status reports, dashboards, and executive updates.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and maintain alignment across project teams.
  • Escalate key decisions, risks, and issues appropriately.

3) Risk, Issue & Dependency Management

  • Establish and maintain project RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies).
  • Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate delivery risks.
  • Manage project dependencies across business, technology, and vendor workstreams.
  • Implement issue resolution and escalation processes to minimise project impacts.
  • Support change control processes and assess impacts to scope, budget, and timelines.

4) Vendor & Delivery Coordination

  • Coordinate activities across internal delivery teams, vendors, and third-party partners.
  • Track vendor deliverables and ensure alignment with project objectives and timelines.
  • Support vendor governance, performance monitoring, and issue resolution.
  • Facilitate collaboration across multiple workstreams and stakeholder groups.

5) Financial & Resource Management

  • Manage project budgets, forecasts, and financial reporting.
  • Support resource planning and allocation across project workstreams.
  • Monitor project expenditure and provide regular financial updates.
  • Ensure effective utilisation of project resources and delivery capacity.

6) Business Change & Implementation Support

  • Partner with business and technology teams to support solution delivery and implementation.
  • Coordinate testing, deployment, business readiness, and transition activities.
  • Support change management and adoption initiatives.
  • Ensure successful handover into business operations and support teams.

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • 7-12 years of project management experience within insurance transformation environments.
  • Proven experience delivering business and technology transformation projects.
  • Strong understanding of Life, General, and/or Medical Insurance operations and processes.
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams and multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering projects involving technology implementation, digital transformation, or process improvement.
  • Experience working within multi-vendor environments.
  • Consulting, system integration, or insurance transformation experience is advantageous.

Why Join Capco?

  • Work exclusively with leading financial services clients on high‑impact programmes
  • Be part of a globally connected consulting firm with strong APAC growth momentum
  • Operate in an entrepreneurial, collaborative culture with clear accountability and ownership
  • Accelerate your career through exposure to complex transformations and senior stakeholders

Job Profile Summary - Physical Security Leader (Grade F)
Years of experience - 15+ Years

Accountable for establishing, operating, and continuously improving the physical security
function for Lloyds Technology Centre (LTC) India.
The role exists to deliver a locally operated, regulatorily compliant, and group-aligned
physical security model, replacing the current structurally unfit operating construct and
addressing identified risks across life safety, compliance, technology, and operations.
Owns end-to-end physical security across technology, operations, vendors,
governance, and people, ensuring the function is effective, auditable, and sustainable at
scale.
Acts as the senior accountable leader for physical security at LTC, representing the
function with LTC leadership, Group Security, regulators, and external agencies, and taking
ownership of outcomes during incidents, audits, and regulatory engagements.
Success in role is defined by:
• Establishment of a fully operational local physical security model aligned to
Group standards
• Measurable reduction in life safety, compliance, and operational risk exposure
• Delivery of fit-for-purpose technology, vendor, and governance constructs
• Creation of a sustainable, high-performing Physical Security capability at LTC
Job Description
Operating Model Ownership
• Owns the design, implementation, and steady-state operation of the LTC physical
security model, ensuring it is locally administered, regulatorily compliant, and
aligned to Group standards.
• Transitions LTC from a centrally administered model to a locally controlled
operating model with defined Group oversight and information flows.
Transformation Delivery
• Leads the end-to-end physical security transformation programme, including:
o Technology replacement and platform modernisation
o Network and infrastructure changes
o Vendor exit and re-contracting
o Establishment of local administration capability
• Delivers against defined risk priorities, timelines, and regulatory requirements.
Technology & Architecture
• Owns the physical security technology architecture for LTC, ensuring:
o Systems are fit for India operational requirements
o Full compliance with applicable regulatory frameworks
Draft – Job Description – Physical Security Lead
o Integration into PSOC and wider security infrastructure
• Oversees lifecycle management, resilience, and performance of all security
systems.
Vendor & Commercial Ownership
• Defines and executes the physical security vendor strategy:
o Direct contract ownership
o Competitive tendering and selection
o Performance and SLA management
• Ensures vendors are capable, compliant, and aligned to LTC operational needs.
Regulatory & Compliance Accountability
• Accountable for ensuring LTC physical security meets all relevant legal,
regulatory, and Group standards.
• Ensures capability to respond to law enforcement requirements, data handling
obligations, and audit expectations.
Governance & Reporting
• Establishes the physical security governance framework, including:
o Defined information flows to Group (real-time, periodic, on-demand)
o Performance metrics and reporting cadence
o Escalation and incident management protocols
• Ensures complete, timely, and accurate visibility of physical security posture to LTC
and Group stakeholders.
Risk Management & Assurance
• Owns physical security risk identification, assessment, and mitigation across LTC.
• Ensures continuous improvement of the control environment and demonstrable
compliance.
Incident Leadership & Resilience
• Acts as the senior escalation point for physical security incidents.
• Defines and embeds emergency response, crisis management, and business
continuity arrangements related to physical security.
People & Capability Build
• Builds and leads the LTC physical security function, including:
o Hiring and structuring the team
o Capability development across operations and technology
o Performance management and succession planning
• Establishes a sustainable model capable of independent operation.

Stakeholder Management
• Engages senior stakeholders across LTC, Group Security, and external agencies.
• Balances local operational autonomy with Group alignment and accountability.

title: Social- og sundhedsassistent søges til Præsthøjgården
description:
Brænder du for ældrepleje med høj faglighed, kontinuitet og helhedsblik?

Vi søger en engageret social- og sundhedsassistent, der med omsorg, faglighed og nærvær vil være med til at skabe et værdigt og meningsfuldt ældreliv. Du ser det hele menneske og tager udgangspunkt i den enkelte borgers ønsker, behov og ressourcer.

Du møder borgerne med respekt og ligeværd og arbejder med fokus på selvbestemmelse, livskvalitet, tryghed og stærke relationer. Sammen med kollegaer bidrager du til en helhedsorienteret indsats, hvor borgeren er aktiv medspiller i eget liv.

Lyder det som en stilling for dig?

Vi er en afdeling i udvikling, hvor faglig kvalitet, samarbejde og arbejdsglæde vægtes højt. Med Ældrelovens fokus på kontinuitet, sammenhængende indsatser og beboerens behov, søger vi en SSA, der har lyst til at sætte retning i den daglige praksis.

Vi har 26 beboere og 2 gæstepladser.

Stillingen er på 37 timer og primært i dagtimerne, men for at understøtte kontinuitet og de rette kompetencer hele døgnet, jf. Ældreloven, vil der også forekomme aftenvagter. Du har fri hver anden weekend.

Vi søger en social- og sundhedsassistent der:
  • Har interesse for ældre mennesker og deres livskvalitet.
  • Trives med at tage ansvar og håndtere komplekse borgerforløb.
  • Arbejder struktureret, selvstændigt og tværfagligt.
  • Har stærke kommunikative og pædagogiske kompetencer.
  • Er udviklingsorienteret og motiveret for at styrke fagligheden i plejen.
  • Er synlig, nærværende og en faglig rollemodel.

Vi forventer du:
  • Deltager i plejen og omsorgen omkring beboerne.
  • Bidrager aktivt til implementering af den nye Ældrelov i praksis.
  • Deltager i og følger op på tværfaglige indsatser omkring beboerne.
  • Arbejder med forebyggende og sikrer høj kvalitet i beboernes individuelle behov og ønsker.
  • Sikrer sammenhængende sygeplejefaglig dokumentation og vidensdeling på tværs af vagter.
  • Samarbejder med relevante samarbejdspartnere i Sundhed og Ældre i relation til beboernes behov.
  • Ser pårørende som tætte samarbejdspartnere for at sikre trivsel hos beboerne.

Vi kan tilbyde dig følgende:
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor der er plads til forskellighed, og hvor du kan være med til at udvikle og sætte dit eget præg.
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor der er fokus på både medarbejdernes, beboernes og de pårørendes trivsel.
  • Kollegaer for hvem det er vigtigt med humor og fællesskab, og hvor man arbejder sammen om at løse opgaverne.
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor der er fokus på borgersikkerhed, faglig sparring og udvikling.

Vi arbejder ud fra Horsens Kommunes værdigrundlag: Helhed, Respekt, Kvalitet og Resultat.

Det praktiske:
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst.

Ansøgningsfrist 20. september 2026.
Der afholdes samtaler løbende
Tiltrædelse snarest muligt.
Du vil i din intro periode i afdelingen være i intro i både dag- og aftenvagten.

Kontakt:
For nærmere information kan du kontakte daglig leder Mia Louise Lønborg Mikkelsen på 22473973.
Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

De bedste hilsner,
Beboere og personale på Præsthøjgården afd. B/C

I Horsens Kommune ser vi mangfoldighed som en styrke, og vi opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede til at søge uanset alder, køn, religion, etnisk tilhørsforhold og handicap.

title: Ohjaaja (lähihoitaja), Onnikoti Katariina, Helsinki
description:
Ohjaaja (lähihoitaja), Onnikoti Katariina, Helsinki

Tule tekemään kehitysvammaisten ohjaustyötä ainutlaatuiseen joukkoomme uuteen yksikköömme Onnikoti Katariinaan, Helsinkiin!

Rakennamme uutta tiimiä, ja etsimme joukkoomme lähihoitajaa ohjaajaksi vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden päästä mukaan rakentamaan toimivaa arkea aivan uudessa, viihtyisässä kodissamme yhdessä iloisen ja moniammatillisen tiimin kanssa. Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan, kehittämään ja jättämään oman kädenjälkesi työn arkeen.

Mihin tulet töihin?
Onnikoti Katariina sijaitsee keskeiselle paikalle Helsingin Munkkiniemessä. Tarjoamme ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista täysi-ikäisille kehitysvammaisille, jotka eivät vammaisuutensa vuoksi kykene itsenäiseen asumiseen kotona tai läheisten luona. Onnikodeille on tärkeää, että jokainen asukas voi asua ja elää omannäköistään elämää sekä keskittyä itselleen tärkeisiin asioihin turvallisessa ja välittävässä ympäristössä. Onnikoti Katariinassa on paikka 25 asukkaalle ja meillä työskentelee joukko monipuolisia ammattilaisia.

Mitä pääset tekemään?
Ohjaajana pääset tekemään merkityksellistä, jokapäiväistä hoitotyötä sekä kehittämään yksikkömme toimintaa yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa. Meillä pääset hyödyntämään omia vahvuuksiasi monipuolisesti ja kannustamme sinua tuomaan osaamisesi, ideasi ja kiinnostuksenkohteesi osaksi arkea. Arkemme on toiminnallista ja järjestämme jatkuvasti aktiviteetteja asukkaillemme.

Kuka sinä olet?
Olet koulutukseltasi lähihoitaja. Joukossamme viihtyy parhaiten positiivisesti asioihin suhtautuva ja oma-aloitteinen henkilö, joka on aidosti kiinnostunut työskentelemään kehitysvammaisten parissa. Jos innostut uuden luomisesta ja haluat olla osa merkityksellistä työtä tekevässä yhteisössä, saatat olla juuri oikea henkilö meille. Sinulle on luontaista toimia toinen toisiaan opettaen ja kannustaen kohti yhteistä päämäärää, laadukkaasti sekä yksilöllisesti. Osaaminen kehitysvammaisten ja autismin kirjon henkilöiden kanssa työskentelystä sekä vaihtoehtoisten kommunikaatiomenetelmien käyttämisestä katsotaan eduksi.

Miksi tulisit meille töihin?
Onnikoti Katariinassa pääset osaksi yhteen hiileen puhaltavaa työyhteisöä, jossa töitä tehdään hymy huulilla. Olemme joustava työnantaja ja meillä kaikki saavat osallistua työvuorosuunnitteluun. Mehiläisenä saat käyttöösi hyvät henkilöstöedut, kuten liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun, työterveyshuollon ja digiklinikan palvelut 24/7. Onnikotien työtekijänä sinulla on monipuoliset koulutus- ja kehittymismahdollisuudet.

Työ on vuorotyötä ja tehtävän palkkaus on yksityisen sosiaalialan TES:n mukainen. Tehtävä on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen. Hoitotyön tehtävien hoitaminen edellyttää B1 tai vastaavaa suomen kielen kielitaitotasoa, sekä sitoutumista kielitaidon ylläpitämiseen.

Sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti tehtävään valittavien ikääntyvien tai vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työskentelevien on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitetturikosrekisteriote. Edellytämme myös tartuntatautilain 48§ mukaista rokotesuojaa.

Hae tehtävää rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta mahdollisimman pian. Toimithan nopeasti, sillä täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löytyessä. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

Kerron mielelläni lisää:
Yksikönjohtaja Sanna Paunonen
puh. 040 125 6047 (arkisin klo 8–16)
sanna.paunonen@onnikodit.fi

Tutustu kotiimme: https://onnikodit.fi/toimipaikat/onnikoti-katariina

Tehtävänä ainutlaatuinen elämä.

Onnikodeissa tarjoamme tukea tarvitsevalle kodin, jossa hän voi elää mahdollisimman antoisaa ja turvallista arkea. Panostamme yksilöllisyyteen sekä laatuun ja palvelumme lähtökohtana ovat aina asukkaan omat ainutlaatuiset ominaisuudet, vahvuudet, mielenkiinnon kohteet sekä tuen tarpeet.

Onnikodit on osa Mehiläistä. Mehiläisen sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluiden ammattilaiset työskentelevät joka päivä tinkimättömästi yksityis-, yritys- ja hyvinvointialueasiakkaidemme hyväksi. Tervetuloa mukaan vahvistamaan ammattilaistemme joukkoa!

title: Senior Front-End Developer
description:
Senior Front-End Developer


















  
  
    












  
   








  
Contact
 





 



 

 
Senior Software Engineer 
We're looking for a senior full-stack engineer to join our Tech team in Copenhagen! Someone who's excited about where software development is heading and wants to help shape how we build with AI.


 


 
  

 
  


We’re an award-winning digital agency developing digital products used by millions of people worldwide. Perhaps we're a match made in heaven?

 
 




Hi! 
As a member of our Tech team, you'll be an essential part of developing digital products together with our clients and the team around you. Since we're an agency, we work with a wide range of clients, typically in focused sprints where we build new products or improve products we've built with them before. Our stack is TypeScript with Next.js and React at its core, extending into backend services, APIs and integrations as projects demand.

We're operating in a time of agentic engineering. AI agents are changing how software gets built, and we embrace that: we use agentic tools to ship faster and build AI-powered features into client products. At the same time, we know that reaching the quality we aim for means sticking to the fundamentals of good software development. Agents amplify good engineering, they don't replace it. We're looking for someone with strong fundamentals in architecture, code quality and judgment, who can put these new tools to work without compromising on craft.

We have an excellent team across our Copenhagen, Montreal, London and Toronto offices. We'll throw challenges at you, teach you new things, learn from you, and make sure we grow together toward our ambition of setting new and higher standards for the web.

Check out some of our great work HERE..
Key tasks:

Shape, build and improve digital products end to end, from frontend (Next.js/React) to backend services, APIs and integrations



Inspire adoption of agentic engineering: use AI coding agents in daily work and share learnings and insights with a team that explores and grows together



Build AI-powered features and agentic systems into client products, such as MCP/LLM integrations, automations and intelligent product experiences



Take technical ownership on client projects: architecture decisions, technical direction, and quality



Lead by example on good development practices and ways of working, across both technical and non-technical team members



Stay ahead of new trends and bring them into the team so we keep delivering top services to our clients



Support with tech knowledge and skills across Signifly's different teams

Hands-on experience with AI-assisted and agentic development (tools like Claude Code or similar) and real curiosity about pushing this frontier



Experience building AI-native APIs and product features is a big plus



You're good at understanding real-world client problems and proposing smart technical solutions to address them



You thrive in helping others, whether it's a client, a project manager, a developer colleague or the sales team



You take ownership: of your code, your projects, and the growth of the people around you

Please expect no less from us
The most important thing that we offer is an inspiring and ambitious work environment, with an emphasis on learning and developing, both personally and as a team. We have an informal organization with minimal hierarchy, where there is plenty of room for being ambitious within your own area of expertise, as well as taking part in shaping our team, culture, and product offering.

But, of course, we can also tempt you with:


Yearly one-week team trip with both social and professional focuses (paid) - in 2025 we went to Belgium.



Fresh catered lunch of mostly organic produce and with vegetarian options



Coffee, tea, soft drinks, snacks, etc. day and night - and wine, beer and drinks on Fridays



Beautiful office space with emphasis noise reduction, centrally located in Vesterbro



Paid equipment of high quality - you choose what you prefer



In-office massage service



Inspiration-trips to events, meet-ups, and conferences



Company paid pension and health insurance



Competitive salary based on qualifications and performance



Career progress based on merits rather than seniority



Opportunity to work-exchange with our office in Montreal, London and Toronto


And if you think something is missing, just let us know. We can probably work together to add it. After all, we are trying to create the best possible place to work!




About Signifly
Signifly is one of the fastest growing agencies in Denmark, and our young and energetic team has won several awards for our innovative approach to digital products and user experiences. We are a young and ambitious team that are constantly pushing the limits for our work and our own capabilities.

At Signifly, we collaborate with a broad range of clients from all industries, to create new and innovative digital products and business models. title: Radio System Engineer
description:
Join our Team

About us

Ericsson is opening a state‑of‑the‑art R&D center in Yokohama focused on Radio and Software development. This new hub will support leading Japanese CSPs, partner with local vendors and deliver Japan‑driven products and solutions that shape networks worldwide. We are establishing and growing the team and building advanced laboratory and office facilities. We are hiring across different experience levels — from early‑career engineers to experienced developers and technical leaders.

The opportunity

You would participate in and lead radio system design work for a cross‑functional engineering team to turn high‑level market and product needs into concrete requirements for next‑generation radio products. The role combine hands‑on technical ownership: defining and documenting product/spec requirements, driving continuous product and process improvements, troubleshooting and customer support, and coordinating with Product Management, program teams and other design sites.

Why join us

  • Work on high‑impact radio hardware and software used in carrier networks across the world.
  • Be part of a new, mission‑driven site — strong growth, clear career pathways and visible ownership of products.
  • Collaborate closely with Japanese operators and vendors, with opportunities to influence product direction globally.
  • Access cutting‑edge lab facilities for prototyping, verification and system integration.
  • Multicultural, inclusive environment: we value both Japanese and English communication and offer international career mobility across Ericsson’s global R&D network.

Who we want

  • We welcome applicants across a range of experience levels -- from early‑career engineers eager to grow in radio system engineering to senior engineers seeking technical leadership opportunities - with background in wireless communications, radio systems, firmware, hardware, software, or systems engineering with a degree in Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Computer Science or related field (BSc/MSc or equivalent)
  • Having a willingness to learn, collaborate, and contribute to team and product success regardless of experience level.

Desired skills

  • Radio systems knowledge: LTE/5G NR, OFDM, MIMO, beamforming
  • Radio Requirement allocation between different parts of the radio
  • Functional Systemization for HW and SW parts
  • Study leaders for new radio products
  • RF/hardware design and measurement, antenna systems, lab instrumentation
  • Embedded/firmware development (C/C++), Linux, BSPs
  • Signal processing and algorithm development (MATLAB, Python)
  • Network protocols, system integration and troubleshooting
  • Experience with product release, lifecycle management and working with carriers

Why join Ericsson?At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

    Tømrersvend til service- og vedligeholdsopgaver i København og omegn
    Er du tømrer med sans for kvalitet og selvstændighed? Hos Viebke & West får du frihed, ansvar og spændende serviceopgaver hos kunder i København og omegn. 

      

      
    
  
    
    Søg jobbet her

  









  



    
      

      
  

    
Hos Viebke & West A/S oplever vi stigende aktivitet hos vores kunder og søger derfor endnu en dygtig og fleksibel tømrersvend til at blive en del af vores team.

Vi arbejder med service-, vedligeholds- og spjældopgaver for offentlige og erhvervsmæssige kunder og søger en kollega, der sætter en ære i godt håndværk, ordentlighed og høj kvalitet.

Vi er et hold, der går op i ordentlighed, kvalitet og kollegaskab, og vi leder efter én, der gør det samme.

Dine opgaver:

Der er aldrig to dage, der er ens. Du får en arbejdsdag med frihed, ansvar og gode kolleger i ryggen.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet bestå af:


Service-, vedligeholds- og spjældopgaver hos vores kunder.



Mindre reparationer, ombygninger og tilpasningsopgaver.



Udbedring af skader, herunder vandskader.



Planlægning og udførelse af opgaver i tæt dialog med din tømrerkonduktør.



Samarbejde med andre håndværksgrupper for at sikre den bedste løsning for kunden.



Selvstændig håndtering af opgaver, hvor kvalitet og service er i fokus.


Du får stor indflydelse på tilrettelæggelsen af dit arbejde og bliver en del af et team, hvor frihed under ansvar er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Friheden hænger dog tæt sammen med evnen og lysten til at arbejde selvstændigt.

Vi leder derfor efter en kollega, der trives med at tage ansvar for egne opgaver og selv kan planlægge sin arbejdsdag.

Geografisk arbejdsområde:
Stillingen omfatter opgaver på projekter i København og omegn. Du bliver tilknyttet vores afdeling i Søborg, men har din daglige gang ude på projekterne, og kørsel mellem opgaverne er derfor en naturlig del af arbejdsdagen.

Hvem er du?

Du er fagligt stolt, stabil, omstillingsparat og klar på at tage ansvar.

Vi søger dig som har:


Svendebrev som tømrer.



Forståelse for almindeligt dansk.



Gyldigt kørekort.



Evnen til at arbejde selvstændigt og finde løsninger.



Respekt for omgivelserne og fokus på sikkerhed.


Og så er du typen, der møder til tiden, gør dig umage og bidrager til godt humør på pladsen.

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen og hjælper hinanden, når det giver mening. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du er åben for indimellem at give en hånd på andre projekter. Vi ved, at fleksibilitet går begge veje, og vi gør altid vores bedste for, at det fungerer for alle parter.

Hvad får du hos os?


Fast arbejde året rundt i en solid virksomhed.



Frihed under ansvar - du styrer i høj grad selv din dag. Det kræver, at du er selvkørende, tager ejerskab og trives med at arbejde selvstændigt.



Et team med høj faglighed og godt humør.



Gode kolleger, der hjælper hinanden og holder sammen.



Mulighed for udvikling og kurser - og på sigt mere ansvar, hvis du vil.



Konkurrencedygtig løn og ordnede forhold.



Ikke akkordarbejde - vi går efter kvalitet, ikke hast.


Kort sagt: Hvis du kan lide godt håndværk, ordentlige mennesker og en hverdag med stor frihed og ansvar, hvor du selv tager styringen på dine opgaver, så kommer du til at trives hos os.

Interesseret?

Kan du se dig selv i ovenstående, så send hurtigst muligt din ansøgning ved blot at svare på et par enkelte spørgsmål.

Vi gennemgår ansøgninger og holder samtaler løbende. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at ringe til Tømrermester Kenneth Zetner på 4262 0517 - eller kontakte os på mail karriere@vogw.dk.

Lidt om os

Viebke & West er en af Danmarks største og mest erfarne aktører inden for byggebranchen. Vi beskæftiger i dag 265 dedikerede håndværkere og funktionærer, og vores historie går tilbage til 1944.

Vi arbejder med tre hovedområder i virksomheden:


Service og flyttelejligheder, hvor vi løser mangeartede opgaver for boligforeninger og ejendomsadministratorer



Fagentreprise, hvor vi står for større maler-, tømrer- og gulvprojekter i tæt tværfagligt samarbejde



Hovedentreprise, hvor vi tager det samlede ansvar for renoverings- og byggeopgaver fra første møde til færdig aflevering


Fælles for alle vores afdelinger er, at vi tror på det gode håndværk, tydelig ledelse og stærke relationer som fundament for kvalitet og samarbejde. Vi er drevet af faglighed, båret af sjæl, skabt med stolthed og fornyet med mod både i det, vi bygger, og den måde vi samarbejder på.

Vi bygger på tillid og på mennesker

Hos Viebke & West tror vi på, at forskellighed er en styrke hvad enten det er kultur, baggrund eller perspektiv. Vi ønsker at skabe et arbejdsmiljø, hvor alle føler sig værdsat og kan udvikle sig fagligt og menneskeligt. Det betyder hos os konkret at vi:


Lægger vægt på lige muligheder for alle, uanset køn, alder, etnicitet, seksualitet, uddannelse eller baggrund



Aktivt inviterer forskellige stemmer og synsvinkler med i beslutningerne, fordi vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger opstår i fællesskab



Konkret arbejde med inkluderende tiltag som plads til udvikling, fleksibilitet i hverdagen og en kultur, hvor man hver dag kan være sig selv



Er ærlige om, at vi stadig er på vej og forpligter os til at måle vores fremgang og tage ansvar for at blive bedre hele tiden



Hos os er der både plads til at vokse og til at gøre en forskel sammen med andre, der brænder for deres fag.


Opstartsdato: Hurtigst muligt.

    Om Viebke & West A/S

    

Viebke & Wests rødder strækker sig tilbage til 1944, hvor malermester Erik Prag stiftede sit malerfirma på Søborg Hovedgade i Gentofte. Sønnen Henrik tog over, indtil malerfirmaet blev solgt til malermestrene Ulf Viebke og Philip West, der drev virksomheden videre fra Virum og senere Rødovre.






Fra at starte som en mindre familievirksomhed er Viebke & West i dag vokset til at være et af Danmarks stærkeste malerfirmaer med afdelinger flere steder i landet. Virksomheden beskæftiger i dag omkring 300 medarbejdere.







Gennem årene har Viebke & West gennemgået en strategisk udvikling. Hvor virksomheden tidligere udelukkende var en malerfaglig specialist, samler Viebke & West i dag flere håndværksfag under ét tag. Det betyder, at malere, tømrere, murere og gulvfolk nu arbejder side om side. Denne bredere faglighed gør det muligt for virksomheden at indgå tidligere i byggeprocessen, tage et større ansvar for opgaverne og sikre et bedre flow på byggepladserne, hvilket i sidste ende skaber endnu bedre løsninger for kunderne.

title: Principal Systems Engineer

Principal Systems Engineer - Requirements Development/Requirements Management (Top Secret)

Date Posted:

2026-08-10

United States of America

Location:

U.S. Citizen, U.S. Person, or Immigration Status Requirements:

Active and transferable U.S. government issued security clearance is required prior to start date.​ U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance​

Security Clearance Type:

Top Secret - Current

Security Clearance Status:

Active and existing security clearance required on day 1

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

The Systems Engineering and Test Capabilities (SETC) organization is currently hiring a Principal Systems Engineer, for the Effectors team to join our Tucson, AZ location. SETC is an exciting and challenging environment where you will have the opportunity to design, develop and partner with multi-disciplines to shape innovative solutions for our customers. Join our organization and experience the Systems V engineering life cycle while interfacing with a variety of engineering disciplines, subject matter experts, Chief Engineers, Chief Technologists, the customer, and so many more to ensure we design, integrate, and strengthen our systems to work the first time and every time for our warfighters!

As a Principal Systems Engineer you will be responsible for technical rigor of requirements documents, including developing/writing requirements, updating existing requirements, coordination of requirement maintenance, across team collaboration, sharing program process knowledge, mentoring engineers, and working with the technical and program leads execute program tasks. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, requirements management, providing SE oversight during integration and test activities. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work on an effectors project pertinent to the systems lifecycle. This role is on-site at our Tucson, AZ campus.

What You Will Do

  • Update, maintain, and improve requirements and requirements documentation for development and production efforts

  • Support Design and System Verification testing

  • Provide SE guidance and support during integration and test efforts

  • Support system performance analysis, and Integration and Test

  • Mentor and guide team members, including engagement of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs)

  • Participate in Failure Investigations

  • Facilitate knowledge transfer within and across IPTs/CPTs to include Cross-Functional collaboration and coordination

  • Conduct Trade Studies and present results to customers

  • Support test equipment software integration and verification for system test

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Typically requires a Bachelor’s in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM preferred) and a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience

  • Experience in Systems Engineering in one or more of the following areas: Developing & Refining CONOPS, System Architecture, System Requirement, Requirements Verification Strategies & Plans

  • Experience with developing system requirements specifications and requirements management processes

  • Verification and Qualification testing experience

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Masters or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, Math or Physics

  • Experience working with multi-disciplinary technical and/or engineering teams

  • Experience in Systems Engineering on a Missile Program

  • Experience in the Defense Industry beyond Raytheon

  • Experience using Agile framework development methods / processes

  • Experience with Model-Based Systems Engineering and associated tools

  • SW/FW Verification and Qualification testing experience

  • Prior experience with foreign military sales

  • A self-starter who can take on task with limited guidance

  • Customer focus and collaboration skills

  • Experience with performance analysis

  • Experience with DOORS and/or cPDM

  • Ability to perform trade studies to optimize system performance

  • Understanding of Systems Engineering Product Development Cycle

  • Familiarity with system safety, reliability, and configuration management

  • Experience with Agile, Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), and/or Digital Engineering

What We Offer

  • Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

  • Relocation Eligible – Relocation assistance is available

Learn More & Apply Now!

  • Please consider the following role type definition as you apply for this role.

  • Onsite: Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

  • This position requires a security clearance. DCSA Consolidated Adjudication Services (DCSA CAS), an agency of the Department of Defense, handles and adjudicates the security clearance process. More information about Security Clearances can be found on the US Department of State government website here: https://www.state.gov/m/ds/clearances/c10978.htm

  • This position is an onsite role – Tucson, AZ : https://careers.rtx.com/global/en/raytheon-tucson,-az-location

  • We Are RTX

As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.

The salary range for this role is 107,500 USD - 204,500 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.

Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Specific benefits are dependent upon the specific business unit as well as whether or not the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement.

Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance.

This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply.

RTX anticipates the application window closing approximately 40 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require RTX to shorten or extend the application window.

RTX is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. title: Business Developer
description:
Hur skapar man verklig trygghet i en komplex och global leveranskedja?

För oss på Bufab handlar det inte bara om att leverera produkter – vi vill skapa Peace of Mind för våra kunder genom att ta ansvar för hela lösningen av så väl C-parts som logistiklösningar. Genom vår globala och lokala närvaro, starka affärsförståelse och nära samarbeten hjälper vi våra kunder inom industrin att effektivisera, säkra och utveckla sin affär.

Nu söker vi en Business Developer som vill vara med och driva utveckling av våra kundrelationer i takt med våra fortsatta tillväxtmål. Är du intresserad av en roll som innebär att utveckla både affär och kundrelationer – och skapa verkligt värde tillsammans med oss? Då ska du läsa vidare!

⭐ Vi börjar med varför du kommer trivas hos oss på Bufab

Hos oss får du:

  • En affärsnära roll med stort genomslag

    Du hittar, utvecklar och arbetar med kunder där ditt arbete direkt påverkar tillväxt, kundvärde och lönsamhet.

  • Mandat att påverka

    Vi är i en fas där vi vill höja nivån ytterligare och växa – här får du både utrymme och förtroende att utmana, förbättra och driva affären framåt.

  • Internationell kontext i en entreprenöriell miljö

    Du arbetar i en global kontext med både internationella och nationella kunder, samtidigt som du får korta beslutsvägar och hög grad av eget ansvar.

  • Ett team som vill framåt

    Du blir en del av ett erfaret team där ambitionen är tydlig – att jobba för tillväxt, vinna affärer och skapa starka kundrelationer över tid.

🫱🏼‍🫲🏼 Här kommer du in i bilden

Som Business Developer hos oss arbetar med du kunder inom utvalda segment inom industrin där krav på kvalitet, leveransprecision och affärspartner är höga – och där vi har en tydlig ambition att växa och ta en ännu starkare position.

Du är både strategisk och operativ i din roll – du driver utvecklingen hos kunder, identifierar nya affärsmöjligheter och säkerställer att vi levererar värde över tid.

Ditt uppdrag i korthet

I rollen kommer du att:

  • Driva tillväxt och identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter
  • Förhandla avtal och hantera komplexa affärsdialoger
  • Vara Bufabs ansikte utåt och kundens viktigaste kontaktpunkt
  • Ansvara för och utveckla relationen med strategiska kunder
  • Leda det interna samarbetet kring kunden tillsammans med innesälj och övriga funktioner
  • Utmana kund och organisation med nya idéer, perspektiv och lösningar
  • Säkerställa hög kundnöjdhet och långsiktiga partnerskap

🤷‍♀️🤷‍♂️ Vem är du?

Vi tror att du är en affärsdriven och relationsstark person som trivs i en roll med stort eget ansvar. Vi söker dig som är trygg i dialogen på managementnivå, som trivs i komplexa affärer och som vill bidra med nya perspektiv, energi och affärstänk.

Du har:

  • Erfarenhet av liknande roller inom affärsutveckling, Key Account Management och försäljning
  • Vana av förhandlingar i komplexa affärer
  • Erfarenhet av att arbeta i internationell miljö, gärna inom industri eller större bolag
  • Förmåga att arbeta både strategiskt och operativt
  • Ett starkt eget driv och en entreprenöriell inställning

Du kommunicerar på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift, och du har B-körkort.

Som kollega och representant för Bufab står du för och arbetar aktivt efter våra värdeord:

  • Vi är ansvarstagande - Du tar ägandeskap för dina kunder och affären. Du är strukturerad, driver ditt arbete framåt och säkerställer resultat – även i utmanande situationer.
  • Vi är entreprenörer - Du ser möjligheter, tänker nytt och vågar utmana både kund och intern organisation. Du är intresserad av, och använder digitala möjligheter – som AI och nya arbetssätt – för att skapa ytterligare värde i affären. Du bidrar med energi, nya perspektiv och utvecklar både affär och arbetssätt.
  • Vi levererar alltid som ett team - Du bygger starka relationer – både hos kund och internt. Du förstår värdet av samarbete och ser till att vi tillsammans skapar bästa möjliga resultat.

✅ Några saker som kan vara bra att veta

  • Tjänsten är på heltid
  • Placeringsort: Stockholm eller Västerås
  • Din ledare kommer vara Lukas Älverdal som är Sales Manager för Team Norr
  • Resor i tjänsten förekommer, ca 5–8 dagar per månad

🔩 Och till sist, om oss – din framtida arbetsgivare

Bufab Group har cirka 1800 medarbetare och över 50 helägda operativa dotterbolag i mer än 30 länder. Våra medarbetare är nyckeln till vår framgång. Till våra kunder levererar vi lösningar snarare än bara skruvar och muttrar, eller C-parts, som vi kallar det för. Bufab är börsnoterat på Nasdaq Stockholm under namnet "BUFAB". Läs mer på http://www.bufab.com.

Vi jobbar med löpande urval och för de kandidater som går vidare genomför vi flera olika steg i processen för att skapa en så rättvis, träffsäker och transparent process som möjligt. title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
Full Stack Software Engineer - Community

Department: Engineering

Location: San Francisco (HQ)

Employment Type: FullTime

Substack is building a new economic engine for culture, giving the brightest, most interesting, and most creative people on the internet the power of their own publishing platform. The terms of our culture should not be set by gate-keeping legacy media or chaos-fueling social media, but by the people who actually make and participate in that culture. Substack’s model, based on direct subscriptions, has fueled an explosion of independent publishing. It empowers creators with economic autonomy, creative ownership, and a direct connection to their most engaged audiences.

About the Community Team

We’re working on the next frontier of products and features to help Substack creators connect and manage their community. This ranges from DMs to Substack Chat to entirely new products.

Our team brainstorms with the CEO, Chris Best, and each engineer contributes ideas for new products and UI/UX upgrades to existing products. Ultimately those ideas become internal prototypes, and then become products shipped to our millions of users.

We’re a small team of generalists, so we especially value an interest in working across our tech stack, willingness to prototype, and product-mindedness.

Responsibilities:

  • Build frontend and backend (and sometimes mobile) features that help creators manage their communities, and users connect more deeply within these communities.

  • Collaborate with designers, writers, support staff, and many others. From product concept and research to implementation and deployment, we expect you to own your work and operate autonomously.

  • We work with TypeScript, especially Node/Express and React, and Postgres. It’s helpful if you know these technologies already; if not, we’ll be excited to help you learn.

Requirements:

  • At least 7+ years of software engineering experience.

  • Independent and autonomous. We’re too small to micromanage, and expect that every person at the company owns their work and can be a leader.

  • Hold yourself and others to a high standard when working on production systems.

  • Take pride in building elegant and delightful product experiences. Substack works best when it gets out of the way so writers can focus on writing and connecting with their readers.

  • Enjoy collaboration with a diverse group of thinkers while bringing our own unique experience and background to the team.

  • Believe in Substack’s mission to build a better business model for writing.

  • Experience working with ML technology would be beneficial.

Experience at a fast-growing startup or working on a high-performing growth team is not required, but is a plus.

Substack's compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, and exceptional benefits. Our cash compensation salary range for this role is $140,000 - $260,000. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Substack is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or transgender status), age, national origin, veteran or disability status. We’re seeking people passionate about enabling independent expression and building a better business model for creators. If you want to see what media, communities, and content can become when unmoored from advertising models, and you have the skills and experience to contribute, we’d love to meet you.

Please see our Privacy Notice for details regarding Substack's collection and use of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking here.

title: Senior Network Engineer (Tooling)
description:
What’s the role?
A Senior Network Engineer (Tooling) will be working in a dynamic team responsible for delivering a highly-fault tolerant Network infrastructure. The team is responsible for design, develop and implementation of Tooling Infrastructure Environment along with Machine Learning Ops solutions for routers, switches, firewalls, load-balancers, DNS, IPAM and other related to network and security infrastructure. The team handles the full life cycles of the Network Tools platform from design, procurement, deployment, support and maintenance.
  • Work closely with project team for any opportunity for Tooling and MLOps
  • Participate in operation support for the Tools and MLOps platform
  • When requested, work with the network architect or Lead engineer
  • Work with management and team members to create and enhance processes and procedures and spot opportunity for Machine Learning.
What do I need?
  • Minimum 5 years' experience administering Linux operating systems in an enterprise environment.
  • Minimum 5 years' experience administering at least one of the following platforms: SolarWinds, Cisco ISE, Netscout, Cisco Secure Network Analytics (UDP Director), Elasticsearch, Tufin, or ThousandEyes.
  • Minimum 2 years' experience with automation and scripting using Shell, Python, or Ansible Playbooks.
  • Experience supporting and managing network security technologies including Juniper SRX, Check Point Firewalls, and VMware NSX DFW.
  • Knowledge of load balancing technologies, including F5 LTM and GTM.
  • Experience with core network services and infrastructure, including DNS, DHCP, IPAM, and enterprise monitoring solutions.
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts, including Cisco routing and switching, VMware vRealize, and dynamic routing protocols such as BGP and OSPF.
Why join us?
We’re obsessed with becoming our customers' #1 banking partner for life and we’re looking for people who are passionate about helping us achieve that goal. In return, we’re committed to making Westpac the best place to work in the country. Here are just a few of the ways we’re already doing that:
  • Special offers on banking products and discounts from top brands, including generous employee-only mortgage rates!
  • Flexible work arrangements to help you achieve a greater work/life balance, and a variety of leave options including Culture, Lifestyle and Wellbeing leave.
  • Tailored learning and development opportunities to help your grow your career within the bank.
  • Lots of opportunities to ‘give back’ to the Community by getting involved in our many volunteering initiatives.
Create your future today
To get started, simply click on the APPLY or APPLY NOW button
We’re all about creating a supportive and inclusive community. We welcome everyone – no matter your age, gender, background, or abilities. We also provide additional support to welcome our veterans, Indigenous Australians and neurodiverse community.
If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, you can find more information and contact details on our FAQs and how to contact us page, under the ‘Diversity, sustainability and flexibility’ section.
We may close this job advertisement earlier than the advertised closing date if suitable candidates are identified. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Erityisopettaja
description:
Suunnittelette työtä yhdessä ja toimitte tiiviissä vuorovaikutuksessa aineenopettajien kanssa. Olet tunneilla antamassa ryhmäkohtaista tukea ja samanaikaisopetusta. Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on erityisopettajan kelpoisuus. Lisäksi erityisluokanopettajan kelpoisuus on toivottava, koska tässä tehtävässä annat myös oppilaskohtaisia tukitoimia tarpeen mukaan. Osallistut oppilaspalavereihin ja oppilashuoltoryhmään. Autat tukeen liittyvien asiakirjojen ajantasaisessa päivityksessä. Opetusvelvollisuus on 24 tuntia viikossa. Viikkotunteja on 24 + konsultaatiotunti. Kasiluokkien tiimissä on mukana lisäksi yksi koulunkäynninohjaaja.

Toivomme saavamme sinusta mukavan työkaverin työyhteisöömme. Salpausselän koulu on noin 650 oppilaan yläkoulu Lahdessa. Opetusta annetaan luokka-asteilla 7-9. Lisäksi koulussamme toimii kaksi JOPO-luokkaa. Painotettua opetusta järjestämme liikunnassa ja LUMA-aineissa. Olemme Olympiakomitean yhteistyökoulu urheiluyläkoulutoiminnassa. Opetushenkilöstöä koulussamme on reilut 50 opetuksen ammattilaista: 45 opettajaa ja neljä koulunkäynninohjaajaa. Panostamme tavoitteelliseen aineenopetukseen, pyrimme hyvään työrauhaan ja henkilöstön kesken vallitsee hyvä yhteishenki. Koulullamme on yhteistyökoulut Ranskassa ja Saksassa. Lisäksi olemme mukana Erasmus+ ohjelmassa.

Opettajan kelpoisuudet määräytyvät opetustoimen henkilöstön kelpoisuusvaatimuksista annetun asetuksen no 986/98 mukaisesti. Mikäli kelpoisia hakijoita ei ole, tehtävä voidaan täyttää hakijalla, jolla ei ole kelpoisuutta virkaan. Tehtävän hoito edellyttää hyvää suomen kielen taitoa.

Merkitse hakemukseesi kelpoisuutesi ja liitä kopiot kelpoisuuden osoittavista tutkintotodistuksista sähköiseen hakemukseen liitteeksi, alkuperäiset todistukset katsotaan mahdollisessa haastattelussa. Tehtävään valittavan on esitettävä nähtäväksi lain 504/2002 edellyttämä rikostaustaote ennen tehtävän vastaanottamista. Tehtävään valittavalta voidaan pyytää huumausainetestiä koskeva todistus. Tehtävässä noudatetaan 5 kuukauden koeaikaa.

Hakemukset Kuntarekry.fi -järjestelmän kautta viimeistään 24.8.2026 klo 15.00.

Tervetuloa tutustumaan työntekijöidemme arkeen. Tällaista on olla töissä Lahden kaupungilla!

https://www.lahti.fi/tyo-ja-yrittaminen/lahti-tyonantajana/tyontekijatarinoita/

Lahden kaupunki on vastuullinen työnantaja, joka tarjoaa työntekijöilleen monipuolisesti henkilöstöetuja. Käytössäsi on hyvinvoinnin tukemiseen liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointietu, olet oikeutettu työsuhdematkaetuun sekä sovittuihin lounastarjouksiin.

Lahden kaupungin perusopetuspalvelut kuuluvat sivistyksen palvelualueelle. Sivistyksen palvelualue on uudistuva, osaamista arvostava ja aktiivinen yhteistyökumppani. Perusopetusta järjestetään 20 koulussa. Oppilaita on reilu 10 000, opettajia ja koulunkäynninohjaajia noin 1 200.

title: UI Engineer
description:
UI Engineer - Mocks and Wireframes Specialist

Location: London, UK

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

About Centric Software:

Centric Software® is a global leader, providing an innovative and AI-enabled product-concept-to-commercialization platform for retailers, brands and manufacturers of all sizes. We equip retail, fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home and consumer goods brands with pioneering best-of-breed solutions to plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, sell and replenish products. Our technology powers brands to streamline processes, drive efficiency and operate with confidence in an ever-changing market.

Our story is one of rapid growth, bold ideas and extraordinary opportunities. We’re here to challenge the status quo—and we’re looking for brilliant people who want to do the same. No matter where you are in the world, this is your chance to be part of something exceptional.

Job Specification: UI Engineer - Mocks and Wireframes Specialist

Location: Remote

Position Type: Permanent


Job Overview:
We are seeking a highly skilled UI Engineer with expertise in creating mockups, wireframes, and interfaces for data-driven applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for translating design concepts into visually appealing and functional user interfaces. This role requires a strong understanding of user experience (UX) principles, proficiency in designing mockups and wireframes, and the ability to interface with APIs for seamless data integration.


Key Responsibilities:

Mockup and Wireframe Design:

  • Develop high-fidelity mockups and interactive wireframes that align with the project requirements and design guidelines.

  • Collaborate closely with UX designers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand user needs and business objectives.

Interface Design:

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, user-friendly features and products using TypeScript, React and TailwindCSS.

  • Create intuitive, scalable, and high-performance user experiences through interactive UI components and effective application state management.

  • Implement responsive design principles to ensure compatibility across various devices and screen sizes.

Data Integration:

  • Interface with APIs to integrate data seamlessly into the user interface.

  • Collaborate with backend developers to understand data structures and optimize data presentation within the UI.

Prototyping:

  • Create interactive prototypes to demonstrate the flow and functionality of the proposed user interfaces.

  • Gather feedback from stakeholders and iterate on designs to achieve optimal results.

Usability Testing:

  • Conduct usability testing on prototypes and finalized interfaces, incorporating user feedback into design improvements.

  • Stay informed about industry best practices and emerging trends in UI/UX design.

Documentation:

  • Document design decisions, guidelines, and specifications to ensure consistency and clarity for development teams.

  • Work with cross-functional teams to maintain design documentation throughout the project lifecycle.

Qualifications:

  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, CSS, React, TailwindCSS and extensive experience building complex web applications with React.js.

  • Proficiency in design tools such as Sketch, Figma, or Adobe XD.

  • Experience working with APIs and integrating data into user interfaces.

  • Knowledge of user-centered design principles and usability testing methodologies.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate ideas and collaborate effectively across teams.

If you are passionate about creating visually stunning and user-centric interfaces while excelling in collaborative environments, we invite you to apply for this exciting UI Engineer position. Join our team and contribute to building cutting-edge data-driven applications that redefine user experiences.

Centric Software provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status or genetic information.

title: Cloud/DevOps Engineer

title: Kirvesmies / Timpuri, ammattilainen
description:
KIRVESMIES / TIMPURI

Etsimme rakennusalan asiakasyrityksellemme moniosaavaa rakennusalan ammattilaista vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.

Oletko kokenut kirvesmies tai timpuri, joka tarttuu ennakkoluulottomasti erilaisiin rakennus- ja remontointitöihin? Haluatko tehdä työnjälkeä, josta voi olla aidosti ylpeä?

Haemme moniosaavaa rakennusalan tekijää erityisesti sisätilojen saneeraus- ja remontointikohteisiin.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

Työtehtävät painottuvat sisätilojen saneeraukseen ja remontointiin. Työpäiväsi voivat sisältää esimerkiksi:

* purku- ja rakennustöitä

* väliseinien ja rakenteiden rakentamista

* levytystöitä

* ovien, listojen ja muiden rakennusosien asennuksia

* kaluste- ja kiintokalusteasennuksia

* erilaisia viimeistely- ja korjaustöitä

* muita työmaalla tarvittavia rakennusalan tehtäviä osaamisesi mukaan

Etsimme ennen kaikkea moniosaajaa, joka pystyy työskentelemään itsenäisesti mutta myös osana tiimiä. Oma-aloitteisuutta ja silmää löytää ratkaisut myös silloin, kun työmaalla tulee vastaan jotain ennalta arvaamatonta.

Millainen tekijä sopii tähän työtiimiin?

Toivomme sinulta:

* aikaisempaa kokemusta kirvesmiehen/timpurin töistä

* monipuolista rakennusalan osaamista

* huolellista ja laadukasta työnjälkeä

* oma-aloitteista ja itsenäistä työotetta

* hyvää asennetta ja yhteistyökykyä

* kykyä toimia erilaisilla työmailla ja erilaisten asiakkaiden kanssa

Alan koulutus katsotaan eduksi, mutta ennen kaikkea arvostamme käytännön osaamista ja tekemisen meininkiä.

Mitä tarjoamme?

* monipuolisia ja vaihtelevia työtehtäviä

* mahdollisuuden hyödyntää laajasti omaa ammattitaitoasi

* ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön

* työpaikan, jossa laadukas työnjälki ja hyvä tekemisen meininki ovat tärkeitä

Jos olet käytännönläheinen rakennusalan moniosaaja, joka ei säikähdä erilaisia työtehtäviä ja haluaa tehdä työnsä kunnolla, saatat olla juuri etsimämme henkilö.

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro meille lyhyesti itsestäsi, aikaisemmasta kokemuksestasi sekä siitä, millaisissa rakennus- ja saneeraustöissä olet parhaimmillasi.

Tule mukaan ammattilaisten tiimiin tekemään laadukasta jälkeä!

Laitapa siis hakemusta tulemaa mitä pikimmiten, kuitenkin viimeistään 2.8.2026 mennessä. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.



Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa:

Sari Nordlin / WireStaff Turku

050 394 8760

sari.nordlin@wirestaff.fi <mailto:sari.nordlin@wirestaff.fi>





#Hyvässä Wireessä!

Wire on tuore, mutta kokenut henkilöstöalan toimija.

Osaamisemme pohjautuu yhteensä yli 40 vuoden kokemukseen henkilöstövuokrauksesta ja rekrytoinneista useilta eri toimialoilta. Meille on tärkeää, että tunnemme asiakkaamme ja työntekijämme henkilökohtaisesti. Ymmärrämme myös erilaisten työympäristöjen haasteet ja vaatimukset. title: Unicon - Vi søger betonchauffør til Unicon Fredericia
description:
Unicon - Vi søger betonchauffør til Unicon Fredericia
  
	

	
	
	
		
	
		
	
	
	
	

	

	

		
	
	
	
	
  









	
	


	
	




			
	


	

    			
		        

        

        

        


        Vi søger betonchauffør til Unicon Fredericia
        

        

        

  



    

		

			

				
Vil du køre nogle af Danmarks mest ikoniske lastbiler og være med til at levere fundamentet for fremtidens byggeri?



Hos Unicon søger vi en betonchauffør til vores fabrik i Fredericia. Som betonchauffør hos os er du meget mere end chauffør. Du er en vigtig del af støbningen og den, der sikrer, at betonen kommer sikkert frem, i den rette kvalitet og på det rigtige tidspunkt.

Du trives bag rattet i en stor bil, men mindst lige så vigtigt er det, at du kan samarbejde med kunderne på byggepladsen og arbejde tæt sammen med kollegerne på fabrikken.


Du bliver en vigtig del af byggepladsen

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du betonen fra fabrikken til byggepladsen, hvor du samarbejder med både kunden, pumpechaufføren og kollegerne om at få støbningen til at forløbe som planlagt.

Du leverer ikke bare et produkt - du er med til at sikre, at byggeriet kan fortsætte.

Nogle leverancer losses direkte fra bilens bånd, mens andre overføres til en betonpumpe. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du kan samarbejde med de mennesker, der modtager betonen, og bidrage til, at arbejdet udføres sikkert og effektivt.

Du kommer til at navigere på byggepladser, hvor pladsen ofte er trang, og hvor præcision og overblik er afgørende. Det kræver gode køreevner, sikkerhedsfokus og evnen til at holde hovedet koldt, når forholdene er udfordrende.


Mere byggeplads end landevej

Hvis du drømmer om lange ture gennem Europa, er dette nok ikke det rette job.

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du typisk mange korte ture mellem fabrikken og lokale byggepladser. Til gengæld bliver du en del af byggeprojekterne og får en hverdag med tæt kontakt til kunder, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere.

Det er et job for dig, der kan lide variation, ansvar og en arbejdsdag, hvor du gør en synlig forskel.


Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

Har stort kørekort inkl. hænger/trailer (CE)

Har EU-bevis

Har fokus på din egen og andres sikkerhed

Trives med at køre og manøvrere store køretøjer under krævende forhold

Er serviceminded og professionel i mødet med kunderne

Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine leverancer

Har fysik til rengøring og vedligeholdelse af bilen

Holder orden omkring dig og dit materiel

Det er en fordel, hvis du har krancertifikat eller erfaring fra bygge-, entreprenør- eller transportbranchen, men det er ikke et krav.


Derfor skal du vælge Unicon

Hos Unicon bliver du en del af Danmarks førende betonproducent og et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor sikkerhed, kvalitet og samarbejde går hånd i hånd.

Vi tilbyder:

Branchens bedste ansættelsesforhold

Grundig oplæring og introduktion til jobbet

Moderne materiel og gode arbejdsforhold

Betalt arbejdstøjsordning inklusive vask

Gode udviklingsmuligheder - både fagligt og personligt

En unik holdånd og stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

Overenskomst gennem Dansk Industri og 3F

En hverdag med selvstændighed og ansvar

En arbejdsdag, hvor kunderne er med til at sætte dagsordenen

Som betonchauffør er din arbejdsdag styret af byggepladsernes behov og dagens leverancer.

Du får typisk besked om mødetid den følgende dag om eftermiddagen, når næste dags produktion og leverancer er planlagt. Arbejdsdagen slutter, når den sidste tur er kørt, og dagens leverancer er gennemført.

Derfor er det ikke et traditionelt 7-15-job.

Nogle dage bliver kortere end forventet, mens andre dage bliver længere. Overarbejde forekommer jævnligt, men bliver naturligvis honoreret, og vi har gode muligheder for både udbetaling og opsparing af afspadsering, som mange af vores chauffører bruger til hele fridage.

Hvis du trives med variation, ansvar og en hverdag, hvor opgaven bliver gjort færdig, vil du passe godt ind hos os.


Sådan bliver du en del af holdet

Med udgangspunkt fra vores fabrik i Fredericia bliver du en del af et stærkt team af chauffører og kolleger, som hver dag arbejder sammen om at levere beton til nogle af områdets vigtigste byggeprojekter.

Du refererer til fabrikkens daglige leder.

  • საოპერაციო კუთხით არსებული პრობლემების შემთხვევაში დააფიქსირებ და მოაგვარებ მათ.
  • უზრუნველყოფ გადარიცხვებს (მათ შორის ავტომატურ გადარიცხვებს)
  • მოახდენ 80 000 ლარამდე სესხების პირველად შეფასებას.

ველოდებით გამოხმაურებას, თუ:

  • ხარ საქმეზე კონცენტრირებული და შეგიძლია მაქსიმალური სიზუსტით შეასრულო დავალება
  • შენთვის მნიშვნელოვანია ადამიანებზე ზრუნვა
  • გაქვს განვითარების მოტივაცია და ხარ შედეგებზე ორიენტირებული

თიბისი ვაკანსიაზე კანდიდატის შესაბამისობის დადგენის მიზნით, კანდიდატის პერსონალურ მონაცემებს "პერსონალურ მონაცემთა დაცვის შესახებ" საქართველოს კანონის მოთხოვნების შესაბამისად ამუშავებს. ინფორმაცია კანდიდატის შესახებ, ასევე, შეიძლება დამუშავდეს სამომავლო ვაკანსიაზე კანდიდატის შესაბამისობის დადგენის მიზნით. ინფორმაცია კანდიდატის შესახებ ინახება არაუმეტეს 3 წლის ვადით. იმ შემთხვევაში, თუ არ გსურს მონაცემთა შემდგომი დამუშავება და გსურს მონაცემთა ცვლილება ან წაშლა, გთხოვ, მოგვმართე ბმულზე და დაგვიკავშირდი ამავე ბმულზე განთავსებული საკომუნიკაციო არხების საშუალებით: კონფიდენციალურობა - TBC Bank

თიბისი, თქვენს ინფორმაციას თიბისი ჯგუფში (TBC Bank Group PLC) შემავალ კომპანიებსაც უზიარებს. შვილობილი კომპანიებიც უზრუნველყოფენ პერსონალურ მონაცემთა დამუშავებას კანონმდებლობით გათვალისწინებული წესით. იმ შემთხვევაში, თუ არ გსურს მონაცემების თიბისი ჯგუფში შემავალი კომპანიებისთვის გაზიარება, მოგვმართეთ იგივე ბმულზე: კონფიდენციალურობა - TBC Bank

თიბისიში კანდიდატთა შერჩევის პროცესი “დისკრიმინაციის ყველა ფორმით აღმოფხვრის შესახებ” კანონის მოთხოვნებისა და პირთა მიმართ თანაბარი მოპყრობის პრინციპების შესაბამისია, რაც გამორიცხავს პირთა მიმართ დისკრიმინაციას ნებისმიერი ნიშნით. თუ შენ მიმართ დისკრიმინაციული მოპყრობის ნიშნებს ხედავ, შენ შეგიძლია დააფიქსირო შემთხვევა და იყო დარწმუნებული, რომ შეტყობინებას აუცილებლად მოჰყვება რეაგირება. თიბისიში შეგიძლია, შენი ხმა სხვადასხვა საკომუნიკაციო არხით გააჟღერო და ინციდენტი სრულად ანონიმურად ან ღიად დააფიქსირო:
