title: Kokenut ravintola-alan ammattilainen vastuulliseen asiakaspalvelurooliin
description:
Kokenut ravintola-alan ammattilainen vastuulliseen asiakaspalvelurooliin

Haemme asiakkaallemme vakituiseen työsuhteeseen kokenutta ravintola- ja palvelualan ammattilaista monipuoliseen tehtävään, jossa yhdistyvät korkeatasoinen ravintola- / asiakaspalvelu, palvelukokonaisuuksien koordinointi sekä tapahtumien käytännön toteutus.



Tehtävässä vastaat erilaisiin asiakastilaisuuksiin liittyvien palveluiden sujuvasta toteutuksesta sekä osallistut niiden suunnitteluun, koordinointiin ja kehittämiseen. Työ sisältää sekä käytännön hands on asiakaspalvelua että erilaisten palvelu- ja tapahtumakokonaisuuksien organisointia yhteistyössä asiakkaiden, yhteistyökumppaneiden ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa.



Etsimme henkilöä, joka viihtyy näkyvässä asiakaspalveluroolissa ja kykenee huolehtimaan korkeasta palvelutasosta myös vaihtelevissa tilanteissa. Tehtävässä tarvitaan oma-aloitteisuutta, organisointikykyä, vastuunkantoa, erinomaista palveluasennetta sekä aitoa halua tuottaa laadukkaita asiakaskokemuksia.



Toivomme sinulta

* ravintola-alan koulutusta tai vastaavaa osaamista
* useamman vuoden kokemusta ravintola-alan vastuullisista tehtävistä
* kokemusta asiakastilaisuuksien, tarjoiluiden tai tapahtumien toteuttamisesta
* kykyä toimia itsenäisesti ja tehdä päätöksiä muuttuvissa tilanteissa
* erinomaisia asiakaspalvelu- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja
* sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa
* joustavuutta työaikojen suhteen
* järjestelmäosaamista
* ajokorttia



Arvostamme lisäksi kokemusta korkeatasoisista palveluympäristöistä, edustustilaisuuksista, tapahtumatuotannosta tai esihenkilövastuista.



Tarjoamme

* vastuullisen ja monipuolisen tehtävän
* mahdollisuuden työskennellä laadukkaiden palveluiden ja asiakaskokemusten parissa
* vakaan ja arvostetun työnantajan
* ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön tuen
* mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja vaikuttaa toimintatapojen kehittämiseen.



Vastaanotamme hakemuksia vain hakemuslomakkeen kautta. Liitäthän mukaan sekä CV:n että hakemuksen. Työhaastattelut käynnistyvät sopivimpien hakijoiden kesken 13.8. alkaen ja työn aloitus syyskuun aikana. Kontaktoimme kaikki hakijoita henkilökohtaisesti 13.8. alkaen, jolloin on myös mahdollisuus esittää rooliin liittyviä lisäkysymyksiä.

title: Takealot Group - Product Manager
description:
Takealot Group (Takealot.com), South Africa’s leading online retailer, is looking for a highly talented Product Manager to join our Takealot Group Product team.

We are a young, dynamic, hyper-growth company looking for smart, creative, hard-working people with integrity to join us!

Think you’ve been challenged before? Think again!

  • Scale: Over 2.5 million happy shoppers shop online on takealot.com. Show them what you can do.
  • Learn: We work with the best of the best, and then some. Code alongside industry leaders and upskill in record time.
  • Grow: Expand your career in the fast-growing Takealot Group: takealot.com, and Mr D Food. We like to promote from within: Here’s your chance.

Who’s who in the tech space

This position reports to the Product Lead - Customer Service.

Your mission, should you choose to accept it:

  • The overall vision and roadmap of features for the Takealot Group CS Platform, with a primary focus on reducing contact resolution time by providing our customer service agents with the features and functionality needed to action customer requests quickly and accurately.
  • The role is inherently cross-functional working closely with customer service, engineering, design, operations, and executive teams to bring about product enhancements that will benefit our customers and business.
  • You will work with business owners to understand their strategy, requirements, and priorities in order to translate needs into recommended initiatives & projects that affect the product.
  • You will define and track the metrics and data that will inform all decisions on product features and functionality.
  • Create business cases to motivate the prioritization of these initiatives.
  • You will analyze and understand project scope and core objectives through requirements workshops with stakeholders to define business requirements.
  • You will elicit detailed, low-level functional requirements and document these requirements such that detailed technical specifications can be compiled by Engineering.
  • Collaborate with technical lead and subject matter experts to establish the technical vision and analyze trade-offs between usability and performance needs.
  • Evolve appropriate Product Management practices for a responsive, dynamic environment to foster effective execution to commitments.
  • Be proactive in ensuring that the development and QA teams understand the requirements by attending backlog grooming and sprint planning sessions and initiating functional clarification sessions where needed.
  • Setting timelines, driving project schedules, and leading cross-functional development teams from design through to release.
  • Review the test plan and test scripts to ensure quality and coverage.
  • Performing user acceptance testing.

The skills we need:

  • Must have a proven track record of execution and can formulate a detailed product roadmap, and to execute on that plan.
  • Ability to wear multiple hats to guide junior product managers, business analysts, UX experts and engineering to deliver world-class products.
  • Solution-oriented, accountable, highly motivated and have a robust personality.
  • The ability to take initiative in ambiguous situations, by identifying critical problems and driving solutions.
  • Data-driven decision-making.
  • Outstanding organizational and communication skills and the ability to balance multiple priorities
  • Attention to detail
  • An avid customer advocate

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor's Degree or Advanced Diploma in a related field and a minimum of 5 years Product Management experience, of which a minimum of 2 years experience in a Product Development environment is required.
  • In the event that a candidate does not have a Bachelor’s Degree or Advanced Diploma in a related field, an equivalent experience requirement must be met, which equates to a minimum of 8 years of Product Management experience, of which a minimum of 2 years experience in a Product Development environment is required.
  • Experience in an e-commerce environment or in an API-driven technical environment would be an advantage.
  • Experience in online restaurant and grocery shopping and customer experience is advantageous
  • JIRA and Confluence experience

Let’s talk about life @ Takealot Group

  • The power is in your hands: We offer a market-related, Total Remuneration Package that allows full flexibility according to your needs. Go on, be the master of your own destiny.
  • No doors: We aren’t fans of stuffy offices or siloed work environments. See someone you like? High five, collab and make something great.
  • Remote working: Love water cooler chats and working from home? Takealot.com offers a hybrid working model for the best of both worlds.
  • Mentorship programme: We aren’t kidding when we say the people with the best people win. Now’s your chance to be one of the best, by learning from the best.
  • Naspers Tech Community & Online Learning: Share ideas and grow with global industry leaders who are all just a Slack message away. Love to learn? Up-skill with free access to courses on MyAcademy, Udacity, Coursera and more.
  • Good times: Get to know the other extraordinary minds at takealot.com during regular social events and out-of-office activities (think hikes, think mini-golf, think good times).
  • Staff discount. Millions of products across 28 departments. What more could you ask for?
  • TakealotMORE Benefit
  • Birthday leave: Cake Day all the way. Enjoy your day off - you deserve it.
  • Right tools, right job: Mac or Windows, two monitors or one. Whatever your preference, you’ll work on the latest tech, off the latest tech.
  • Help when you need it most: Confidential counselling, legal support and financial guidance, for free, anytime, anywhere.
  • Tech stack (for days): ReactJS, Python, Scala, Kotlin, Swift, Google Cloud, Kafka, Redis, Kubernetes and all things machine learning. If you build it, they will come.
  • Free parking: No more 5km fun runs to your desk (unless you want to).

Like what you see?

If you meet the above you are an Extraordinary Mind. Apply today!!

Takealot is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants from the previously disadvantaged groups and people with disabilities will be given preference.

title: Senior Vice President, Real Estate Equity Finance & Investment
description:
To lead and deliver complex Equity Finance & Investment (EF&I) solutions across the deal lifecycle, by managing and executing the end-to-end design and implementation of client centric Real Estate Finance solutions, that deliver exceptional client experience with a noticeable impact on the Structured Capital revenue targets, market share growth and maintaining the CIB brand as the Go-To Lending Bank.

Essential Functions of the role include :

  • Act as the trusted partner by providing expert opinion, insights on best-in-class EF&I Solutions that win client business by leveraging internal sector expertise to optimise and strengthen the solution, ensuring the needs of the client are met. Lead post pitch follow-ups with clients to finalise commercial terms and close deals.
  • Drive the achievement of objectives and delivery of EF&I and Real Estate Finance solutions, by providing on the job guidance and effectively leading and managing a team by setting targets, reviewing the quality of work, providing feedback and promoting personal and professional development to build capability within the team and enhance performance.
  • Manage the EF&I and Real Estate Finance solutions pitch book, planning for quality and execution (excellence) and approve final proposals, pitch books and other client content, adding expert opinion and refining recommendations for use in client engagements.
  • Oversee the deal closing process, as well as lead negotiations for complex deals, and coordinate internal and external stakeholders to complete all contracting requirements, deal commercial terms and closing processes to drive the realisation of commercial targets, maximising shareholder returns and growing IB revenue.
  • Present to relevant committees and stakeholders to obtain buy-in, approval for complex deals. Review loan agreements, prepare pre-screens and final committee papers / applications for new financing opportunities to ensure compliance with credit approved terms, credit sanctions and CIB risk and regulatory framework
  • Provide insight and recommendations into the development and execution of the EF&I goal and objectives to optimise client and / or shareholder returns, grow IB revenue and protect / grow the Lending market share.
  • Post Graduate Degree in Commerce, Finance or Accounting
  • Post Graduate Degree in Property Studies
  • 5-7 years previous Investment Banking experience in Advisory, Private Equity or Debt Solutions.Knowledge of the markets in which Standard Bank operates and experience working in South Africa and / or Africa regions in leading, originating and implementing client solutions.
  • 5 - 7 years experience in leading and supporting Commercial Property Finance deals
  • 5 - 7 years In depth understanding and knowledge of local and global Lending products / solutions to effectively develop and present innovative client solutions.
  • 5-7 years experience in coaching, managing, leading and coordinating teams with a proven track record of delegating and prioritising task, setting KPI's and conducing performance discussions

Behavioural Competencies:

  • Convincing People
  • Directing People
  • Establishing Rapport
  • Examining Information
  • Exploring Possibilities
  • Generating Ideas
  • Impressing People
  • Interpreting Data
  • Making Decisions
  • Pursuing Goals
  • Seizing Opportunities
  • Understanding People

Technical Competencies:

  • Business Insights
  • International Market Knowledge
  • Product Development
  • Risk/ Reward Thinking

At Raytheon, the foundation of everything we do is rooted in our values and a higher calling – to help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression. We bring the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. Our team solves tough, meaningful problems that create a safer, more secure world.

The Systems Engineering and Test Capabilities (SE&TC) Life Cycle Engineering (LCE) Long Range Radars department is seeking a Senior Reliability Engineer, focusing on the Reliability Engineer discipline. This role is an onsite role based out of Woburn, MA location. Life Cycle Engineering (LCE) is responsible for ensuring our products are Safe, Reliable, Maintainable and delivered on time. Life Cycle Engineering consists of multiple disciplines that support engineering, our program offices and our customers. Our Life Cycle Engineering disciplines participate in the total life cycle of our products from conception to deactivation. Our focus area is product support, including the following disciplines: Reliability, System Safety, and Supportability.


What You Will Do

This role will support both functions of Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability (RAM) Engineering and Failure Reporting Analysis, and Corrective Action System (FRACAS) Engineering and will be responsible for executing the RAM/FRACAS program activities such as:

  • Conducting RAM analyses, including reliability predictions and maintainability predictions.

  • Performing Failure Modes Effects and Criticality Analyses (FMECA) and Fault Detection/Fault Isolation (FDFI) analyses.

  • Generating Reliability Block Diagrams (RBDs)/system models.

  • Defining/allocating RAM requirements.

  • Reviewing field failure data and assessing performance using calculations such as Mean Time Between Failure (MTBF), Mean Time Between Critical Failure (MTBCF) & Operational Availability (Ao).

  • Interpreting data and analyzing results.

  • Ensuring performance compliance to requirements.

  • Assisting in maintaining FMECAs and RBDs.

  • Providing RAM input and support to program meetings such as Failure Review Boards (FRBs) and Technical Interchange Meetings (TIMs).

  • Working cross-functionally with Sustainment, Site, and other Life Cycle Engineering teams.

  • Supporting the proposal process in developing Basis of Estimates (BOEs) for RAM work.

  • Tracking Earned Value (EV) and providing accurate status on the schedule and budget for the RAM scope.

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 5 years of prior relevant experience.

  • Experience with Failure Analysis, Reliability, and/or FRACAS Engineering concepts.

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Experience with Reliability Engineering Concepts including knowledge of reliability and maintainability predictions, FMECA/FDFI, RBDs, MTBF/MTBCF, Ao.

  • Electrical Engineering experience, Electrical Engineering degree/education preferred.

  • Task leadership or project management experience, familiar with concepts such as Earned Value.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to present technical material to audiences.

  • Ability to work collaboratively across disciplines.

What We Offer

  • Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

  • Relocation Eligibility – Relocation assistance available.

title: Ohjaaja, Lastensuojeluyksikkö Lehtosara Joutseno, Familar Oy
description:
Haluatko työskennellä innostavassa työyhteisössä, jossa työtä tehdään suurella sydämellä? Jos vastasit kyllä, saatat olla uusi tiimimme jäsen!

Haemme ohjaajaa lastensuojeluyksikkö Lehtosara Joutsenoon, Familar Oy

Familar Lehtosara Joutseno on pitkään toiminut lastensuojeluyksikkö sijoitetuille lapsille ja nuorille. Yksikkömme on 14- paikkainen erityistason yksikkö, jossa hoidamme lapsia ja nuoria, joilla voi olla esimerkiksi psyykkistä tai neuropsykiatrista oireilua. Asumme Joutsenon Ahvenlammella uudessa hirsitalossa, luonnon keskellä. Meille on tärkeää luoda vuorovaikutukseen perustuva suhde lasten ja nuorten kanssa. Toiminta-ajatuksen mukaisesti lämmin vuorovaikutus, yksilöllinen huomioiminen, empatian osoittaminen ja turvan luominen ovat toimintamme perustat.

Ohjaajana meillä toimit osana moniammatillista työryhmää oman koulutusalasi näkökulmasta, luotettavana omaohjaajana ja kasvatusvastuullisena aikuisena yhteistyössä lapsen vanhempien ja muun verkoston kanssa. Joukkueessamme viihtyy oma-aloitteinen ja huumorintajuinen tiimipelaaja. Edellytämme sinulta sosiaali- tai terveysalan ammattikoulututkintoa sekä työkokemusta lastensuojelusta tai sosiaali- ja terveysalalta. Luemme eduksesi lisäkoulutuksen liittyen mielenterveys- ja päihde - trauma ja/tai psykiatriseen työhön.

Työ on kolmivuorotyötä ja tehtävä on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen. Toivomme, että suhtaudut avoimesti uuden oppimiseen, sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutus ja tunnetaidot ja olet valmis sitoutumaan pitkäjänteisesti meille sijoitettujen lasten ja nuorten hoito- ja kasvatustyöhön.

Tehtävään valittavien on esitettävä lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämistä koskevan lain (505/2002) edellyttämä rikosrekisteriote. Edellytetään lisäksi voimassa olevaa Suosikki/Terhikki-rekisteröintiä ja ammattikorttia sekä ajokorttia ja hygieniapassia.

Tarjoamme:
- työkavereiden ja esihenkilöiden tuen työhön
- joustava työvuorosuunnittelun
- kattavat ja monipuoliset täydennyskoulutukset sekä koulutus- ja kehitysmyönteisyyden
- ammatillisen kasvun mahdollisuudet kehittyvän ja vakavaraisen työnantajan palveluksessa
- toimialan nykyaikaisimmat työvälineet ja mahdollisuuden arvioida työn tuloksia ja vaikuttavuutta
- liikunta- ja kulttuurisaldon, työterveyshuollon ja Mehiläisen digiklinikan palvelut 24/7
- yhteistyöverkostomme kautta kattavasti henkilöstöetuja ja -alennuksia erilaisista tuotteista ja palveluista
- palkkaus yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:n mukaisesti

Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan. Tervetuloa mukaan kasvavaan joukkoomme!

Lähetäthän hakemuksen tehtävään rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta 4.9.2026 mennessä. Haastatteluja toteutetaan haun aikana.

puh. 040 906 6865
tiina.naukkarinen@familar.fi

        Job Description: 
        

    
Are you a seasoned Senior Project Manager passionate about elevating Business Finance Reporting through data-driven transformation? Do you excel at leading complex projects focused on standardizing data management, maintaining and developing Power BI solutions, and enhancing internal performance management and cost reporting frameworks?


 


Join Tryg’s Strategy Execution team, where you will play a critical role in shaping the future of business finance reporting and analytics as part of our ongoing Target Operating Model transformation within the CFO office. You’ll lead initiatives that modernize and consolidate financial data capabilities, enabling robust decision-making and performance insights across the Nordic region.


 


If you are energized by leveraging data and technology to drive finance transformation and business impact, this is your chance to make a lasting difference.


 


About the job | Senior Project Manager - Business Finance Reporting & Data Standardization


As a Senior Project Manager within Tryg’s Strategy Execution team under the CFO office, you will lead end-to-end projects designed to reshape and optimize our finance reporting and data management capabilities. 


 


Your focus areas will include:



Driving the development of financial data management across the organization to ensure data integrity, accessibility, and consistency.


Leading the maintenance, enhancement, and development of Power BI reporting tools to support timely and insightful business finance reporting.


Overseeing internal performance management frameworks and cost reporting processes, delivering actionable insights that enable better financial stewardship and operational efficiency.


Managing the delivery of Target Operating Model initiatives related to business finance reporting and analytics within the CFO area.


Collaborating across Finance, IT, Business Units, and external partners to align on reporting standards, automation, and data governance best practices.


Applying structured project governance, risk management, and stakeholder engagement techniques to ensure timely, high-quality delivery aligned with Tryg’s strategic priorities.


Leading change management and capability-building efforts to embed new reporting processes, tools, and data culture throughout the Nordic region.


Acting as a mentor and advisor within the Strategy Execution portfolio, promoting a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision-making.



 


Location: Copenhagen, with significant collaboration across Nordic locations and occasional travel.


 


About you | Experienced senior project manager with strategic ambition


You bring 5+ years of proven experience managing finance transformation programs focused on business finance reporting, data management, and analytics platforms like Power BI. You thrive in complex, cross-functional environments and are passionate about combining strategic thinking with hands-on delivery to transform how finance provides insights and drives performance.


 


Ideal qualifications:



Senior Project Manager with 5+ years’ experience leading transformation projects in finance reporting, data standardization, and BI tool development, ideally within insurance, financial services, or similarly regulated industries.


Strong expertise in Power BI or equivalent BI/reporting tools, including maintenance, development, and user enablement.


Deep understanding of internal performance management and cost reporting frameworks to support strategic and operational decision-making.


Experience driving Target Operating Model (TOM) transformations and embedding new ways of working in finance.


Exceptional stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior leaders and collaborate across diverse finance and IT teams.


Excellent communication skills in English and fluency in one Scandinavian language (Danish, Swedish, or Norwegian).


Educational background in Finance, Business, Economics, Data Analytics, or related fields.


A proactive, structured, and analytical leader with a drive to create sustainable impact through data and technology.



 


You are a clear communicator, an inspiring leader, and have an analytical mindset. You take ownership, work in a structured and proactive way, and are motivated by creating a lasting impact. 


 


About us | A Nordic leader in insurance 


Tryg is one of the leading insurance companies in the Nordics, with a strong focus on financial governance, digitalization, and strategic development. We are on a journey to build a more transparent, agile, and future-ready organization - you will be part of making that happen. 


 


Curious? | Join us in shaping the future 


Ready to grow your career and make an impact? Please send your application and CV no later than August 28. We encourage you not to attach a photo to your CV. 


 


We invite relevant candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application today. Once the right candidate has been found, the recruitment process will be closed. 


 


For questions about the role, contact Claus Michael Svendsen, Head of Strategy Execution, at claus.svendsen@tryg.dk.

We encourage everyone regardless of gender identity, age, background, disability or origin to apply for the position. We are proud to have high employee satisfaction, strong professionalism and equal opportunities to develop your career in the Tryg Group. Tryg is the largest non-life insurance company in Scandinavia with activities in Denmark, Norway and Sweden. Every day we strive - each in our own way - to create peace of mind and affect the lives of most Scandinavians. Join New Era Technology, where People First is at the heart of everything we do. title: Varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja, päiväkoti Lauttasaari, Lauttasaari
description:
Haemme päiväkoti Lauttasaareen varhaiskasvatuksen opettajaa.

Etsimme opettajaa, joka hallitsee 4-5-vuotiaiden lasten lasten pedagogiikan. Työparinasi toimii varhaiskasvatuksen lastenhoitaja. Ryhmässä on 14 lasta.

Päiväkoti Lauttasaaressa on mahtavat sisätilat liikuntasaleineen ja työpajoineen. Luonto on helposti saavutettavissa metsien ja rantojen kautta ja tarjoaa mahdollisuuden hyödyntää moninaista oppimisympäristöä.

Meillä on mahtava, iloinen ja tekevä porukka. Kehitämme innolla Helsingin varhaiskasvatusta Helsingin varhaiskasvatussuunnitelman mukaisesti. Yksikössämme painottuvat leikki ja kaveritaidot sekä sensitiivinen lapsen kohtaaminen arjessa sekä yhteisöohjautuus henkilökunnan kanssa.

Meille tärkeää on aito kohtaaminen, yhteisöllisyys sekä tiimien toimivuus.

Tule meille tekemään töitä ilolla ja positiivisella asenteella!

Miksi töihin meille?
Meille on tärkeää, että voit tehdä vaikuttavaa työtä hyvän helsinkiläisen elämän eteen. Haluamme, että onnistut ja innostut työssäsi. Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisia mahdollisuuksia kasvaa ja kehittyä ammattilaisena. Tuoreimman henkilöstökyselyn mukaan meillä viihdytään ja työ koetaan mielekkääksi!

Saat käyttöösi Suomen suurimman työnantajan henkilöstöedut, kuten tukea työmatkoihin ja jopa 550 euron kulttuuri-, liikunta- ja hyvinvointiedun. Lue lisää henkilöstöeduistamme ja tutustu Helsingin kaupunkiin työnantajana osoitteessa hel.fi/fi/avoimet-tyopaikat/miksi-toihin-kaupungille

Varhaiskasvatuksen opettajana vastaat lapsiryhmäsi toimintakulttuurin ja oppimisympäristön rakentumisesta, pedagogisen toiminnan suunnittelusta, toteuttamisesta, kehittämisestä ja arvioinnista sekä lasten yksilöllisen oppimisen tukemisesta Helsingin varhaiskasvatus- ja esiopetussuunnitelman, varhaiskasvatusyksikön toimintasuunnitelman sekä lapsen vasun mukaisesti.


Kelpoisuusehdot:
Edellytämme, että sinulla on varhaiskasvatuslain (540/2018) mukainen kelpoisuus tai siirtymäsäännöksen (75 §) mukaisesti kasvatustieteen kandidaatin tutkinto (lto), soveltuva ammattikorkeakoulututkinto tai aikaisempi vastaava opistotasoinen tutkinto, esim. lastentarhanopettajan tai sosiaalikasvattajan tutkinto (laki 272/2005 ja asetus nro 608/2005). Kelpoisuusvaatimuksen täyttää myös Opetushallituksen ulkomaisen koulutuksen perusteella tekemä tunnustamispäätös kelpoisuudesta haettavaan tehtävään.

Lisäksi edellytämme sinulta hyvää suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa. Valitun henkilön tulee esittää voimassa oleva rikostaustaote lasten kanssa toimimiseen (504/2002). Alle kouluikäisten lasten kanssa työskentelevien hengityselinten tuberkuloosia koskeva selvitys tarkastetaan (tartuntatautilaki § 55).

Aloittaessasi vakituisen työsuhteen varhaiskasvatuksen opettajana Helsingin kaupungilla vuonna 2026 tarjoamme sinulle 2000 euron kannustuspalkkion. Lisätietoja saat rekrytoivalta päiväkodin johtajalta.

title: Senior IT Consultant – ERP Application Management CTBC
description:
The Senior IT Consultant – ERP Application Management is responsible for ensuring the security, compliance, governance, and reliable operation of the global SAP application landscape. The role focuses on SAP IT Audit & Compliance, SIVIS Suite Administration and Identity & Access Management (IAM). The position acts as a subject matter expert for Sivis Suite and IAM, ensuring that SAP systems comply with corporate policies, audit requirements, while supporting business continuity and operational excellence.

Identity & Access Management (IAM)

  • Govern SAP user lifecycle processes, including onboarding, role changes, and offboarding.
  • Ensure integration between SAP systems and enterprise IAM solutions.
  • Support access request, approval, and provisioning processes.
  • Drive automation and standardization of access management processes.
  • Ensure traceability, transparency, and audit readiness of access controls

SIVIS Suite Administration

  • Administer and maintain the SIVIS Suite environment.
  • Support access governance, role analytics, compliance monitoring, and reporting.
  • Ensure data quality and reliability within the SIVIS landscape.
  • Collaborate with SAP Security and IAM teams to improve controls and reporting capabilities.

Jeg giver hermed mit samtykke til, at Sinatur Hotel & Konference, hvor jeg søger ansættelse, og Garuda AS, som fungerer som databehandler, kan indsamle og registrere de personoplysninger, jeg afgiver. Du kan læse samtykkeerklæringen ved at klikke her.

 Oplysning om indsamling af dine personoplysninger:

Ved udfyldelse af spørgeskemaet indhentes oplysninger om dit navn, e-mail, køn, CV og ansøgning.


Vi behandler de personoplysninger, du har afgivet i dette spørgeskema. Derefter indhenter og behandler vi eventuelt yderligere oplysninger om dine arbejdsevner fra referencer og sociale medier med henblik på en vurdering af dine kompetencer og erfaringer i relation til den pågældende stilling. På grundlag af alle disse oplysninger udarbejder vi en profil, som vi registrerer og opbevarer i en periode på 6 måneder.


Formålet med ovennævnte behandling af dine personoplysninger er en vurdering af dine kompetencer i forhold til det konkrete opslag hos virksomheden/organisationen, du har søgt ansættelse hos, samt i forhold til fremtidige stillinger.


Dine oplysninger i dette spørgeskema kan blive omfattet af en automatisk afgørelse, herunder profilering. Logikken bag denne afgørelse er brug af saglige kriterier, som gør det muligt at finde frem til de registrerede, som har de kompetencer, som søges til den pågældende stilling.


Som led i vurderingen kan dine dokumenter (fx CV og ansøgning) blive analyseret ved hjælp af kunstig intelligens (AI) med det formål at generere indsigter til brug for vurderingen. AI-analysen anvendes som støtte og træffer ikke selvstændige afgørelser - den endelige vurdering foretages altid med menneskelig involvering. Behandlingen kan indebære overførsel af dine oplysninger til tredjelande uden for EU/EØS, som sker på grundlag af EU-Kommissionens standardkontraktsbestemmelser (SCC) og/eller EU-US Data Privacy Framework. Du kan få oplyst det nærmere overførselsgrundlag ved henvendelse til den dataansvarlige.


Behandlingen af dine personoplysninger er baseret på dit samtykke.


Dit samtykke til de ovennævnte behandlinger af dine oplysninger kan til enhver tid tilbagekaldes med det resultat, at registreringen af oplysningerne slettes. Tilbagekaldelse kan ske ved henvendelse til den dataansvarlige.


Dine personoplysninger vil blive opbevaret i en periode på 6 måneder og derefter slettet.


Det er frivilligt at besvare de stillede spørgsmål, men undlader du at besvare spørgsmålene, bevirker det, at den dataansvarlige ikke vil være i stand til at vurdere din kompetence på den forudsatte måde.

Har passion for god mad og gode råvarer

Har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med resten af holdet

title: Principal Systems Engineer, Logistics Engineering
description:
Principal Systems Engineer - Logistics Engineering

Location: US-MA-WOBURN-WB2 ~ 225 Presidential Way ~ GODDARD BLDG

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Date Posted:

2026-08-10

Country:

United States of America

Location:

US-MA-WOBURN-WB2 ~ 225 Presidential Way ~ GODDARD BLDG

Position Role Type:

Onsite

U.S. Citizen, U.S. Person, or Immigration Status Requirements:

The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required.​ U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance

Security Clearance Type:

DoD Clearance: Secret

Security Clearance Status:

Active and existing security clearance required after day 1

At Raytheon, the foundation of everything we do is rooted in our values and a higher calling – to help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression. We bring the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. Our team solves tough, meaningful problems that create a safer, more secure world.

The Systems Engineering and Test Capabilities (SETC) Life Cycle Engineering (LCE) Long Range Radars department is seeking a Principal Logistics Systems Engineer to join our team onsite in Woburn, MA. In this role, you will be an integral part of the LCE team, working alongside talented professionals and engaging directly with internal stakeholders and customer program leaders.

Life Cycle Engineering (LCE) ensures our products are Safe, Reliable, Maintainable, and delivered on time. Our team supports the entire product lifecycle, from conception to deactivation, with a focus on product support disciplines, including Reliability, System Safety, and Supportability. Your contributions will directly impact the success of critical missions and our customers’ ability to achieve their objectives.

Do you excel in analytical and communication skills? Do you thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments? If so, this opportunity may be the perfect fit for you. At Raytheon, we value the unique perspectives each team member brings. If you’re passionate about making an impact, we’d love to hear from you!

What You Will Do

  • Develop and maintain detailed Logistics Supportability Analyses (LSA), provisioning data for parts, and spares analysis for hardware across product lines.

  • Apply advanced logistics principles to design and implement complex program-level concepts and execution plans.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Chief Engineers, Program Directors, and Program Managers, to ensure seamless integration of logistics strategies into overall program objectives.

  • Create Basis of Estimates (BOEs) to support proposal efforts and drive strategic decision-making.

  • Act as an interface between internal teams, stakeholders, and customer program leaders to ensure alignment and successful program execution.

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 8 years of prior relevant experience.

  • Experience with Technical Data Packages such as drawings, parts lists and/or electrical schematics.

  • Experience using GEIA-STD-0007 and/or MIL-STD-1388 compliant software.


Qualifications We Prefer

  • Familiarity with 3D modeling tools such as SolidWorks or CreoView.

  • Experience reviewing and interpreting system drawings.

  • Proficiency in performing Spares Analysis and Spares List Development (e.g., Poisson-Based Statistical Analysis, OPUS Suite, or similar tools).

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.

  • “Hands-on” experience with hardware repair and maintenance.

  • Experience working with relational databases.

  • Knowledge of Logistics Product Data (LPD) development and maintenance, in accordance with standards like GEIA-STD-0007 or MIL-STD-1388-2B.

  • Familiarity with software tools such as EAGLE, POWERLOG, or SLICWave.

  • Experience with Earned Value Management (EVMS) and/or Control Account Management (CAM).

  • Familiarity with U.S. military supply chain processes.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

  • Demonstrated leadership and team collaboration skills.

What We Offer

  • Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

  • Relocation Eligibility– Relocation assistance available.

Learn More & Apply Now!

  • Please consider the following role type definition as you apply for this role.

  • Onsite: Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.

The salary range for this role is 107,500 USD - 204,500 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.

Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Specific benefits are dependent upon the specific business unit as well as whether or not the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement.

Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance.

This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply.

RTX anticipates the application window closing approximately 40 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require RTX to shorten or extend the application window.

title: Partenaire d’affaires en acquisition de talents, Est du Canada
description:
Chez GHD, nous ne nous contentons pas de croire en la force de l’engagement, nous la vivons chaque jour.

C’est pourquoi nous faisons la promesse d’épauler et d’outiller notre personnel pour générer des retombées positives en collaboration avec toute l’entreprise pour stimuler le changement. Nous vous aiderons à accélérer votre carrière en profitant des technologies et de la formation dont vous aurez besoin pour donner vie aux idées et aux projets.

En travaillant de pair avec vos collègues, clients et partenaires, vous produirez des retombées positives qui se répercuteront à grande échelle. Découvrez jusqu’où votre engagement pourrait vous mener.

Qui cherchons-nous?

GHD est actuellement à la recherche d’un(e) partenaire d’affaires en acquisition de talents basé(e) à l’un de nos bureaux de la région de Montréal ou de Québec. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez le processus de recrutement pour un portefeuille de postes attribué et vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les gestionnaires du recrutement afin de créer des approches d’embauche efficaces, de clarifier les besoins en matière de talent, et d’appuyer des décisions d’embauche éclairées. Vous fournirez des informations pratiques à propos du marché et démontrerez un bon jugement ainsi qu’une approche consultative pour aider à attirer et à évaluer les talents correspondant aux besoins de l’entreprise. Vous ferez partie d’une équipe d’acquisition des talents connectée à l’échelle mondiale et qui travaille dans toutes les régions afin de fournir des résultats cohérents et de haute qualité.

En travaillant avec une équipe dynamique et hautement performante, vous réaliserez une variété de tâches et assumerez les responsabilités suivantes :

  • Travailler en partenariat avec les gestionnaires du recrutement afin de préciser les exigences du poste, d’assurer l’uniformité de l’approche d’embauche et de créer des profils de rôles et des résumés de candidature efficaces.
  • Diriger l’ensemble des activités de recrutement de votre portefeuille, y compris l’exécution du sourçage, de la présélection, de la sélection, de l’évaluation et de l’offre.
  • Bâtir et maintenir des banques de candidatures grâce à plusieurs canaux de sourçage afin de répondre aux besoins d’embauche actuels et futurs.
  • Offrir des conseils pratiques, des informations sur le marché et des recommandations de candidat(e)s afin d’appuyer des décisions d’embauche éclairées et des attentes réalistes.
  • Guider les gestionnaires du recrutement à propos des processus, des normes et des pratiques exemplaires en lien avec le recrutement afin d’appuyer des résultats cohérents et de haute qualité.
  • Coordonner les entrevues et les évaluations, recueillir des rétroactions et aider à maintenir la dynamique et l’alignement tout au long du processus d’embauche.
  • Appuyer les campagnes de recrutement et les initiatives d’embauche ciblées, alignées sur la marque de l’employeur et les priorités de l’entreprise.
  • Établir une solide compréhension des priorités de l’entreprise afin d’aligner les activités d’acquisition de talents sur les besoins en main-d’œuvre et les plans d’embauche.
  • Cerner les occasions d’améliorer les processus de recrutement, l’expérience des candidat(e)s et l’efficacité de l’embauche pour le portefeuille dont vous avez la charge.
  • Favoriser des pratiques d’embauche inclusives et appuyer la diversité des candidat(e)s.

Ce que vous apporterez à l’équipe

  • Capacité d’attirer, d’évaluer et de recommander des talents avec un bon jugement et une approche axée sur l’entreprise.
  • Grand sens de la gestion des parties prenantes, avec une capacité à renforcer sa crédibilité et à influencer les décisions d’embauche.
  • Aptitudes de communication démontrées et grande assurance pour offrir des conseils pratiques et des recommandations.
  • Habileté à gérer plusieurs priorités et à travailler de façon indépendante avec un portefeuille varié.
  • Solides compétences de planification et d’organisation, avec la capacité de trouver l’équilibre entre le rythme, la qualité et les attentes des parties prenantes.
  • Approche axée sur les clients et engagement à assurer une expérience d’embauche positive.
  • Capacité d’adaptation dans un environnement changeant.

  • Compréhension du marché des talents et capacité d’aligner les approches d’embauche sur les besoins et les priorités de l’entreprise.

Qualifications

  • Baccalauréat ou combinaison équivalente d’études et d’expérience
  • Expérience en acquisition de talents, idéalement dans un environnement de services professionnels à rythme rapide et impliquant plusieurs parties prenantes.
  • Expérience de collaboration avec les gestionnaires du recrutement en lien avec la définition de la portée des rôles, l’évaluation des candidat(e)s et les décisions d’embauche
  • Connaissance des systèmes d’acquisition des talents, des outils de sourçage, de la recherche sur le marché des talents, et de plateformes comme Oracle Cloud Recruiter et LinkedIn Recruiter
  • Excellentes aptitudes de communication tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit (français et anglais*)

*Dans le cadre de cette fonction, vous devrez intervenir avec des clients clés internes et externes dans l’équipe de l’Est du Canada et les équipes canadiennes ou mondiales de façon régulière, autant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit.

Seuls les CV soumis en anglais et en français seront examinés et pris en considération.

Information importante :

  • Chez GHD, nous encourageons une culture d’innovation, d’inclusion et de succès partagé, où vos idées ont de l’importance, où votre croissance sera soutenue et où vos contributions ont un effet réel. Notre modèle de travail hybride est conçu pour vous permettre de vous épanouir au travail et au-delà. Il vous offre deux jours de travail à la maison chaque semaine tout en vous permettant de rester en mesure de communiquer et de collaborer avec notre environnement dynamique en présentiel.
  • L’intelligence artificielle (IA) dans le recrutement en est à ses débuts et pourrait être utilisée pendant le processus pour améliorer l’efficacité et l’équité. Votre candidature peut être examinée par l’IA et notre équipe d’embauche. Même si l’IA intervient dans certaines étapes du processus, toutes les décisions d’embauche finales sont prises par des humains.
  • En tant qu’organisation diversifiée et inclusive, nous encourageons les réalisations individuelles et reconnaissons la force d’un milieu de travail diversifié. GHD est un employeur souscrivant au principe de l’égalité d’accès à l’emploi. Sur demande, GHD fournira des mesures d’adaptation raisonnables pour les candidat(e)s en situation de handicap tout au long du processus de recrutement et de sélection.

Envie de collaborer avec l’entreprise et de participer à quelque chose de grand grâce à l’embauche?

Postulez maintenant pour joindre l’équipe d’acquisition des talents de GHD.

**********************************

At GHD, we don’t just believe in the power of commitment, we live and breathe it every day!

That’s why we pledge to support and empower all of our people to make a positive impact when working hand in hand with our business to drive change. We’ll help you accelerate your career and empower you with the right technology and training as you bring ideas and projects to life.

Together with your colleagues, clients and partners, you'll make an impact that is felt by all. See where your commitment could take you.

Who are we looking for?

GHD has an exciting opportunity for a Talent Acquisition Business Partner based in our Montreal area or Quebec City offices. In this role, you will lead recruitment delivery across an assigned portfolio of roles and partner closely with hiring managers to shape effective hiring approaches, clarify talent needs, and support confident hiring decisions. You will bring practical market insight, sound judgement, and a consultative approach to help attract and assess talent aligned with business needs. You’ll be part of a globally connected Talent Acquisition team that works across regions to deliver consistent, high-quality hiring outcomes.

Working with an energetic, high-performing team, this role offers a variety of work where you will:

  • Partner with hiring managers to clarify role requirements, align on hiring approach, and develop effective role profiles and candidate briefs
  • Lead end-to-end recruitment activity across your portfolio, including sourcing, screening, shortlisting, assessment, and offer execution
  • Build and maintain candidate pipelines through multiple sourcing channels to meet current and future hiring needs
  • Provide practical advice, market insight, and candidate recommendations to support informed hiring decisions and realistic expectations
  • Guide hiring managers on recruitment processes, standards, and best practices to support consistent, high-quality hiring outcomes
  • Coordinate interviews and assessments, gather feedback, and help maintain momentum and alignment through the hiring process
  • Support recruitment campaigns and targeted hiring initiatives aligned with employer brand and business priorities
  • Build strong understanding of business priorities to align talent acquisition activity with workforce needs and hiring plans
  • Identify opportunities to improve recruitment processes, candidate experience, and hiring effectiveness within the portfolio you support

  • Champion inclusive hiring practices and support diverse candidate slates

What you’ll bring to the team

  • Ability to attract, assess, and recommend talent with sound judgement and a business-focused approach
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build credibility and influence hiring decisions
  • Clear communication skills and confidence providing practical advice and recommendations
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently across a varied portfolio
  • Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to balance pace, quality, and stakeholder expectations
  • A client-focused approach and commitment to a positive hiring experience
  • Adaptability in a changing environment

  • Understanding of talent markets and the ability to align hiring approaches to business needs and priorities

Fiserv is seeking a Product Owner to lead the development and delivery of Person-to-Person (P2P) payment solutions. This role serves as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, clients, technology teams, operations, and risk/compliance functions to deliver secure, scalable, and customer-centric digital payment experiences.

The Product Owner will be responsible for managing the product backlog, defining and prioritizing requirements, creating user stories and acceptance criteria, and driving Agile delivery of new capabilities. The role requires strong expertise in digital payments, real-time money movement, and financial services, with a focus on enhancing customer experience, ensuring regulatory compliance, and supporting business growth.

The ideal candidate will have experience with P2P payments, real-time payments, API-based products, Agile methodologies, and stakeholder management, along with the ability to translate complex business needs into high-quality product solutions.

Key Qualifications

Mandatory Skills

  • Product Ownership and Agile/Scrum delivery
  • P2P Payments domain expertise
  • Digital Payments and Money Movement solutions
  • Backlog management, user story creation, and prioritization
  • API integrations and payment processing workflows
  • Jira, Confluence, and stakeholder management
  • Strong communication and analytical skills

Good-to-Have Skills

  • RTP, FedNow, ACH, and Digital Wallets
  • Fraud, Risk, AML, and Compliance knowledge
  • SQL, Postman, Microservices, and Cloud platforms (Azure/AWS)
  • Data analytics and reporting tools (Power BI/Tableau)
  • CSPO, SAFe POPM, or other Agile certifications

  • Product adoption and transaction growth
  • Compliance and risk adherence
  • Improved customer experience
  • High-quality Agile execution and stakeholder satisfaction
  • Reduced defects and enhanced operational efficiency

This role is ideal for a product professional who is passionate about real-time payments, digital banking innovation, and delivering market-leading money movement experiences for financial institutions and consumers.

title: Product Designer - AI
description:
Job Description

About the team

Salvador Dali once famously said "Have no fear of perfection -- you'll never reach it". We love you Dali, but you kinda don't know the design team at slice. Meticulousness, attention to detail, creativity - 3 strong pillars that make every design ever created at slice perfection. Check out our website and you know we ain't lying.

About the role

If creating elegant and customer-focused designs that make people talk about it is your thing, and you're as comfortable designing products with AI tools as you are designing on Figma, then this role is for you. Such products come out of working in close collaboration with business, product, technology teams, and fellow designers. You would also be presenting design propositions and solutions to stakeholders using wireframes, mock-ups, or high-fidelity prototypes. Feedback is breakfast of champions, and we'd ensure you'd get as much as you need to iterate and improve to reach our mutual goal of building a world-class product.

What you'll do

  • Ideate and implement solutions that overlap customer needs, design and technology.
  • Gather requirements from stakeholders, derive problem statements and plan design engagements. Also, proactively launch efforts to improve different aspects of the product.
  • Be the owner & decision-maker of design for one or more major features in the consumer app.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers, and content strategists to oversee the user experience of a product from conception until its launch.
  • Ensuring design quality, consistency, and coherence within the product.
  • Design flows and experiences that are incredibly simple and elegant. Give and solicit feedback from other designers to continually raise our bar for quality.
  • Comfortably build out experiences on design tools as well as AI/vibe-coding interfaces.
  • Conceptualise original ideas that bring simplicity and user-friendliness to complex design roadblocks.
  • Collaborate and conduct user research and evaluate user feedback on designs and do iterations according to feedback.
  • Research, learn and implement design guidelines, best practices and design standards. Experiment and validate design ideas and opinions.

What you'll need

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent practical experience in design.
  • 1-4 years of experience designing in consumer-focused product companies.
  • Expertise in design tools like Figma, Sketch, Principle etc.
  • Experience designing using AI/vibe-coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Google Stitch, Figma Make, Lovable etc. We don't need you to know/use all of them, but we'd like you to be proficient in at least one of them.
  • Exceptional analytical skills, with an ability to quickly translate both qualitative and quantitative data-driven insights into actions.
  • Excellent visual design skills, experience in illustration & motion design is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills & attention to detail.

About us

slice

A new bank for a new India

slice's purpose is to make the world better at using money and time, with a major focus on building the best consumer experience for your money. We've all felt how slow, confusing, and complicated banking can be. So, we're reimagining it. We're building every product from scratch to be fast, transparent, and feel good, because we believe that the best products transcend demographics, like how great music touches most of us.

Our cornerstone products and services: slice savings account, slice UPI credit card, slice UPI, and slice business are designed to be simple, rewarding, and completely in your control. At slice, you'll get to build things you'd use yourself and shape the future of banking in India. We tailor our working experience with the belief that the present moment is the only real thing in life. And we have harmony in the present the most when we feel happy and successful together.

We're backed by some of the world's leading investors, including Tiger Global, Insight Partners, Advent International, Blume Ventures, and Gunosy Capital.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Quality Engineer

Location: Bridgeton, MO

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Who We Are: Challenge Manufacturing’s mission is to manufacture with operational excellence by empowering our employee-owners. As a leading tier 1 supplier of complex metal assemblies for the global automotive industry, we drive innovative solutions for future mobility. We believe the best ideas come from individual unique perspectives. These ideas combined with the teamwork of industry leaders allow us to accomplish any challenge. Our team members take pride in the work we do and embody our core values of safety, ownership, and teamwork every day; they are the true driving force in our operations.


Challenge is proud to be one of the largest employee-owned automotive companies in North America. One of the many benefits of joining the Challenge team is the ESOP program. This program allows Challenge to give shares of the Company to all employee-owners annually. These shares are an additional retirement benefit that will continue to grow during your time at Challenge. Being part of an ESOP means our employee-owners share in Challenge’s success!


Challenge is #QualityDriven and #PeoplePowered!



Who We Want:

The Quality Engineer is responsible for conducting on going analysis of the production process inputs and output to ensure that customer (internal and external) quality requirements are being achieved.

What You’ll Do:

  • “Safe Launch” participant to constructively accept a detailed hand-off of product requirements from APQP QE.
  • The “Safe Launch” hand-off process links the APQP QE and Current Production QE when the first MRD parts are being run. These QEs work together to obtain and complete the necessary quality system documentation, dimensional data, GP-12 support, and PTR/MRD packaging and labeling for shipment.
  • Supporting the “Safe Launch” process also includes providing the plant communication linkage for a formal tooling buy-off process, including Run at Rate support and associated documentation to declare die/welder readiness for production. This is then followed by the preparation of all PPAP documentation for submission.
  • Responsible for all plant level quality concerns for assigned product.
  • Serve as direct point of contact for customer complaints.
  • Manage Quality System for all changes after launch.
  • Obtain “Master Samples” from 300-piece initial production run for Program archiving of Part Quality at start of production.
  • Update Control Plans & FMEA as Issues Arise from the Floor or Customer.
  • Issue Product Quality Check Deviations following direction from management.
  • Provide timely acknowledgement responses to customer complaints.
  • Provide formal documentation PRR/HTR, responses to the customer.
  • Be a presence at the assembly plants to provide face-to-face interaction and ensure customer satisfaction while developing relationships.
  • Understand how each part is utilized in the vehicle build and become the “expert” regarding what the customer expects from us as the supplier of this part.
  • Provide the plant management with the “voice of the customer” and explain what key part attributes are important to manage on each part and why.
  • Train plant level quality auditors and production team leaders on part-to-part concerns regarding acceptability, inspection methodology, and customer expectations.
  • Direct Quality Technicians to provide supporting product quality documentation (Part Picture Visuals, Packaging Instructions, Gage Instructions, Quality Alerts, etc.), and floor support as necessary.
  • Provide plant with priorities for part improvement to ensure the most important attributes are addressed first, and stress continuous improvement.
  • Address plant floor quality concerns as they arise, provide timely opinions for acceptability, and be able to provide the proper decision criteria for management to direct the part disposition.
  • Champion problem control meetings for customer complaints, and attendees need to be accountable for their problem control responsibilities by area managers.
  • The QE should be involved in monitoring daily part quality and spend time on the floor checking parts and auditing product and process to verify that customer requirements are met.
  • Participate in the layered process audits.
  • Implement new methods of inspection and control when required. (i.e.: enhanced containment techniques and documentation, SPC data, scheduled CMM runs or Roamer scans, etc.)
  • The QE is responsible for supporting all QSB+ and TS requirements associated with his/her assigned part responsibilities.

When and Where:

This will be a 1st Shift / 7 AM - 3:30 PM, M-F position located at our plant in Bridgeton, MO.

What You Need to Have:

  • Associate degree from a 2- or 4-year college
  • 5 Years in related experience and/or training
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Bachelor of Science Degree from a 4-year college or university preferred
  • 10 to 15 years related experience and/or training preferred
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience preferred
  • Has high standards of performance for self.
  • Takes responsibility for actions, results, and mistakes.
  • Is thorough, accurate, and reliable when performing and completing job tasks; demonstrates honesty and integrity in all aspects of work.
  • Takes positive action to objectively resolve conflict by listening, staying focused on issue to find resolution, and monitoring progress.
  • Maintains positive relationships by constructively resolving conflicts.
  • Uses feedback from others to continuously improve performance and work relationships.
  • Moves within own and/or other work areas (flexes) to support plant flow.
  • Works with sense of urgency to meet needs of customers.
  • Has necessary experience, skills, and knowledge to perform all aspects of job; rotates through all job responsibilities.
  • Maintains knowledge and skills to perform job effectively.
  • Has ability to focus on benefits of change and see it as positive; approaches change or newness in constructive/objective manner; views change as learning opportunity.
  • Looks for good in others; works collaboratively with others; shares information and knowledge.
  • Is at work when scheduled and ensures coverage when absent; takes timely breaks/lunches; uses time wisely.
  • Advance GD&T training
  • Understanding of the Specific Customer Requirements
  • Understanding the PPAP Process
  • Understanding of the APQP Process
  • Understanding of dimensional data and the ability to analyze and make decision
  • Understand problem solving and all the involved core tools

Jeg giver hermed mit samtykke til, at City Container A/S, hvor jeg søger ansættelse, og Garuda AS, som fungerer som databehandler, kan indsamle og registrere de personoplysninger, jeg afgiver. Du kan læse samtykkeerklæringen ved at klikke her.

Hvis du allerede er oprettet som ansøger til stillingen, kan du logge direkte ind her.

Samtykkeerklæring



Dataansvarlig

City Container A/S





 Oplysning om indsamling af dine personoplysninger:

Ved udfyldelse af spørgeskemaet indhentes oplysninger om dit navn, e-mail, køn, CV og ansøgning.


Vi behandler de personoplysninger, du har afgivet i dette spørgeskema. Derefter indhenter og behandler vi eventuelt yderligere oplysninger om dine arbejdsevner fra referencer og sociale medier med henblik på en vurdering af dine kompetencer og erfaringer i relation til den pågældende stilling. På grundlag af alle disse oplysninger udarbejder vi en profil, som vi registrerer og opbevarer i en periode på 6 måneder.


Formålet med ovennævnte behandling af dine personoplysninger er en vurdering af dine kompetencer i forhold til det konkrete opslag hos virksomheden/organisationen, du har søgt ansættelse hos, samt i forhold til fremtidige stillinger.


Dine oplysninger i dette spørgeskema kan blive omfattet af en automatisk afgørelse, herunder profilering. Logikken bag denne afgørelse er brug af saglige kriterier, som gør det muligt at finde frem til de registrerede, som har de kompetencer, som søges til den pågældende stilling.


Som led i vurderingen kan dine dokumenter (fx CV og ansøgning) blive analyseret ved hjælp af kunstig intelligens (AI) med det formål at generere indsigter til brug for vurderingen. AI-analysen anvendes som støtte og træffer ikke selvstændige afgørelser - den endelige vurdering foretages altid med menneskelig involvering. Behandlingen kan indebære overførsel af dine oplysninger til tredjelande uden for EU/EØS, som sker på grundlag af EU-Kommissionens standardkontraktsbestemmelser (SCC) og/eller EU-US Data Privacy Framework. Du kan få oplyst det nærmere overførselsgrundlag ved henvendelse til den dataansvarlige.


Behandlingen af dine personoplysninger er baseret på dit samtykke.


Dit samtykke til de ovennævnte behandlinger af dine oplysninger kan til enhver tid tilbagekaldes med det resultat, at registreringen af oplysningerne slettes. Tilbagekaldelse kan ske ved henvendelse til den dataansvarlige.


Dine personoplysninger vil blive opbevaret i en periode på 6 måneder og derefter slettet.


Det er frivilligt at besvare de stillede spørgsmål, men undlader du at besvare spørgsmålene, bevirker det, at den dataansvarlige ikke vil være i stand til at vurdere din kompetence på den forudsatte måde.

Er du fleksibel, rutineret bag rattet og trives du i en hverdag med fart på?
Vi søger lige nu erfarne chauffører til komprimatorkørsel.

Kan du lide at køre lastbil, sætter du en ære i god kundeservice og trives du med frihed under ansvar? Så vil vi rigtig gerne have dig med på holdet.

title: Carer
description:
Transform lives, every single day

Would you like to use your compassion and care for greater impact? At Anglicare Sydney, you can. And together, we will. We’re a well-respected not-for-profit that’s been serving society’s most vulnerable for more than 170 years. Each year, we achieve life-changing outcomes for the 40,000+ people who rely on our person-centred support.

As a Carer, you will make a difference that enriches lives and strengthens communities. In return for your dedication, you'll find genuine support, rewarding career opportunities, and the balance you need to thrive in all areas of your life.

Your opportunity

As a Carer at Dorothy Boyt House in Malabar, you will provide high quality care and support to residents, helping them live with dignity and purpose. You will assist with daily tasks, provide emotional support, and offer companionship to residents. You will ensure the physical comfort and emotional health of our residents are met in a caring and nurturing environment. With kindness and understanding, you will:

  • Provide personal care assistance, including showering, dressing, grooming and feeding.

  • Support residents with mobility and physical assistance.

  • Provide companionship and emotional support.

  • Monitor and document residents’ progress, ensuring their needs and preferences are met.

  • Work collaboratively with healthcare professionals to deliver person-centred care while fostering a positive and inclusive environment within the facility.

What you’ll bring

You are a kind-hearted, patient and respectful person who is passionate about enhancing the lives of older people. You share our organisational values of integrity, justice, compassion and excellence, and bring them to everything you do. To thrive in this role, you will need:

  • A Certificate III in Aged Care, Individual Support or equivalent qualification, a minimum of 2 years’ experience in a similar role.

  • An NDIS Worker Screening Check Clearance ID.

  • All required qualifications must be recognised under the Australian Qualifications Framework.

You will also have:

  • A passion for working with older people and enhancing their quality of life.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to work effectively in a team and independently.

  • An understanding of the importance of maintaining residents’ dignity and independence.

  • Alignment with Anglicare’s Christian ethos and values.

  • A valid driver’s license and access to a car are preferred (not mandatory) due to the home’s location.

Why Anglicare Sydney?

At Anglicare Sydney, you will belong to a community of kind, humble and respectful people of all faiths and backgrounds - people who respect you for you and genuinely care. You’ll also be surrounded by leaders and mentors who support you to grow your career and find the balance that’s right for you. Other benefits include:

  • Above award hourly rates of pay and tax-free benefits for permanent employment.

  • Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.

  • Supportive and inclusive team environment.

  • Opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the lives of others.

  • Access to Anglicare’s rewards program with discounts to over 400 retailers.

  • Employee Assistance program and Fitness Passport with discounts to over 800 gyms for you and your family.

Are you ready for a career that means more?

To apply for this role, please click the ‘Apply’ button or submit your resumé and a cover letter via our application portal at

As soon as you apply, you will be invited to a short interview via Chat and Video. You will be able to record your answers from the comfort of your own home via mobile phone or laptop/computer. We ask 5 questions that relate to your experience and insights on personal care in life or at work, to help us understand your unique qualities and how they’ll align to the people we serve. After completing this interview, you will then be invited to a short video interview where you will be asked three scenario-based questions relating to your experience and insights on personal care. You will be able to record your answers from the comfort of your own home via mobile phone or laptop/computer.

Applications close : All applicants will receive a response.

Anglicare Sydney is as wonderfully diverse as the customers and communities we support. While we are guided by our Christian-based values, our team includes people of all faiths and backgrounds who share our commitment to serving others, and we value the diverse perspectives they bring. We strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, and people of all ages, genders, abilities and cultural backgrounds.

Application Close Date: August 31, 2026

title: Marketing Designer
description:
About Ladders

Ladders builds AI-powered job search products and services that help professionals find better opportunities, stand out to employers, and land more interviews.

We are a fast-moving, collaborative team that values ownership, experimentation, and measurable results.

The Role

We are looking for a Marketing Designer to create compelling, conversion-focused work across paid advertising, email, web, ecommerce, and social channels.

This is not a traditional product design role.

You will design landing pages, marketing campaigns, lifecycle emails, website promotions, paid media creative, and customer journeys that increase engagement and revenue.

The ideal candidate combines strong visual design skills with an understanding of performance marketing, customer behavior, and conversion optimization.

Portfolio required. We want to see examples of paid media, landing pages, emails, ecommerce experiences, social creative, and integrated campaigns.

What You'll Do

    • Design creative for paid social, display, email, web, ecommerce, and organic social.

    • Develop campaign concepts that work across multiple channels and formats.

    • Create and optimize landing pages, promotional experiences, checkout flows, and paywalls.

    • Produce creative variations for A/B testing.

    • Partner with Marketing, Product, Engineering, Analytics, and leadership.

    • Manage projects from concept through launch and iteration.

    • Use performance data and customer insights to improve creative.

Success In This Role Looks Like

    • Higher-performing ads, emails, and landing pages.

    • Increased engagement, conversion, and revenue.

    • Faster creative testing and iteration.

    • High-quality work launched quickly.

    • Consistent campaigns across channels.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in growth, marketing, digital, or performance design.

  • A strong portfolio showing work across multiple marketing channels.

  • Experience designing ads, landing pages, emails, ecommerce flows, and digital campaigns.

  • Strong visual design, typography, layout, and art direction skills.

  • Understanding of performance marketing and conversion optimization.

  • Experience developing creative for A/B testing.

  • Expertise in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.

  • Ability to move quickly, manage multiple priorities, and respond well to feedback.

    • Bonus Qualifications

    • Experience with subscription, membership, ecommerce, or consumer brands.

    • Motion graphics or short-form video experience.

    • Familiarity with Meta, Google, TikTok, Reddit, or programmatic advertising.

    • Understanding of responsive email and web design.

      • You’ll Thrive Here If You

      • Are comfortable designing an ad, email, landing page, and ecommerce experience.

      • Care about performance as much as aesthetics.

      • Generate multiple ideas and iterate quickly.

      • Take ownership and move work forward.

      • Balance brand quality with business goals.

Benefits and Perks

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage with approximately 83% employer-paid premiums.

  • 20 days of PTO plus company holidays.

  • Home office stipend and gym reimbursement.

  • Company-paid life and disability insurance.

  • Remote-friendly culture

  • Healthcare and dependent care Flexible Spending Accounts.

Why Join Ladders?

You'll help shape the future of AI-powered job search while working directly with company leadership. This is an opportunity to directly influence product strategy, growth, customer experience, and business results. If you enjoy moving quickly, shipping meaningful work, and seeing your ideas have an impact, we'd love to meet you.

Pratt & Whitney is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.


What you Will Do:

  • Plan and develop model predictive control and parameter estimation algorithms for military and commercial engine programs.
  • Develop engine, actuation, and fuel system dynamic models and apply these models for development of functional requirements for control law algorithms, fuel system and actuation dynamics.
  • Develop model-based sensor and actuator fault detection, isolation, and accommodation (FDIA) algorithms.

  • Realtime gas turbine engine modeling and analysis.
  • State estimation for gas turbine engine performance estimation.
  • Engine operability and performance.
  • Engine control law software verification and validation.
  • State of the art dynamic modeling methodologies.
  • Model based requirements processes.

  • Expertise developing physics-based models of fuel systems and fueldraulic actuation systems.
  • Expertise developing dynamic models using the Modelica modeling language.
  • Expertise designing and analyzing estimation algorithms by applying methods and tools from multi-input multi-output dynamical linear system and estimation theory.
  • Expertise applying statistical models and methods for modeling uncertainty propagation in dynamical systems.
  • Demonstrated mastery of one or more of the following technical areas: multivariable feedback control, model predictive control, numerical optimization, state estimation, stability analysis of multivariable and hybrid systems, real-time propulsion system and fuel system dynamic modeling, simulation, and dynamic analysis.
