Seniorprojektleder til teknologiprojekter i eltransmission



Vil du være ansvarlig for tekniske udviklingsprojekter, der understøtter den grønne omstilling og styrker fremtidens el-infrastruktur?



Vi leder efter to erfarne seniorprojektledere, der kan omsætte komplekse teknologiprojekter fra koncept til realisering. Du motiveres af at samle mennesker om fælles mål, skabe fremdrift og omsætte tekniske muligheder til konkrete løsninger med værdi for forretningen.



Du får en central rolle i udviklingen af ny teknologi, hvor du samarbejder med specialister, ledere og samarbejdspartnere på tværs af organisationen.





Vær med til at udvikle og implementere ny teknologi



Du bliver en del af afdelingen Product & Technology Management i Energinet Eltransmission på vores hovedkontor i Fredericia.

Afdelingen fungerer som bindeled mellem forretning og teknik. Vi arbejder med produktstrategier, teknologiudvikling og koordinering af større udviklingsinitiativer, så nye løsninger skaber reel værdi for Energinet og det danske elsystem.

Vi er i en spændende udvikling i afdelingen, som fortsat styrkes og udbygges. I dag består teamet af 15 medarbejdere, og du får derfor gode muligheder for at udvikle både arbejdsformer, processer og samarbejder.



"Vi har brug for seniorprojektledere, som kan skabe retning og holde momentum i komplekse projekter. Du skal kunne samle forskellige fagligheder om fælles mål og sikre, at vi omsætter gode idéer til konkrete resultater," siger Senior Manager Adam Vest.

 



Tag ansvar for projekter fra idé til implementering



Som seniorprojektleder har du ansvaret for, at teknologiinitiativer planlægges, prioriteres og gennemføres med fokus på kvalitet, ressourcer og forretningsværdi.

Du kommer blandt andet til at:



	
planlægge og gennemføre tekniske udviklingsprojekter med ansvar for scope, tid, økonomi og kvalitet

	
prioritere aktiviteter i projekt- og teknologiporteføljen ud fra risici, afhængigheder og ressourcer

	
facilitere samarbejdet i tværfaglige projektteams og skabe engagement omkring fælles mål

	
håndtere interne og eksterne interessenter samt sikre tydelig forventningsafstemning

	
rapportere status, risici og anbefalinger til ledelse og øvrige beslutningstagere

	 




Du forstår både teknik, forretning og mennesker



Du har erfaring med projektledelse i teknisk komplekse organisationer og trives i krydsfeltet mellem strategi, teknologi og eksekvering.

Din uddannelsesbaggrund kan fx være ingeniør, maskinmester eller lignende. Alternativt har du opbygget tilsvarende erfaring gennem arbejde med tekniske produkter eller udviklingsprojekter.



Vi forestiller os, at du:



	
har mindst 3-5 års erfaring med projektledelse i en teknisk eller produktionstung virksomhed

	
forstår, hvordan tekniske beslutninger påvirker værdikæder, drift og forretning

	
arbejder struktureret og metodisk med planlægning, prioritering og opfølgning

	
har erfaring med porteføljestyring, teknologi-roadmaps eller udviklingsinitiativer

	
kommunikerer klart og skaber fremdrift gennem samarbejde og involvering af relevante interessenter

	 




Særlige forhold



Jobbet kræver, at du kan opnå og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelse. På PET's hjemmeside kan du læse mere om sikkerhedsgodkendelse.

 



Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel sammen med os?



Så ser vi frem til at modtage din motiverede ansøgning og dit CV senest 6. september 2026. Sæt allerede nu et par forsigtige kryds i kalenderen 11. september, hvor vi holder 1. samtaler online og 17. september, hvor vi holder 2. samtaler i Fredericia.



Er du nysgerrig på din kommende leder, eller har du spørgsmål til jobbet? Se nærmere på LinkedIn eller ring til Senior Manager Adam Vest på telefon 40 12 78 99.





Særlige forhold: Da Energinet løser samfundskritiske opgaver, udfører vi baggrundstjek forud for ansættelsen. Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at dit baggrundstjek er foreneligt med ansættelse i Energinet. Baggrundstjekket gennemføres desuden én gang årligt. Jobbet kræver desuden, at du kan opnå og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelse. På PET's hjemmeside kan du læse mere om  sikkerhedsgodkendelse.





Vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke og opfordrer alle kvalificerede, uanset baggrund, til at søge jobbet. Vi arbejder aktivt og målrettet med mangfoldighed i Energinet og opfordrer dig derfor til at udelade billede, oplysninger om alder, civilstand og lignende, for at minimere ubevidste biases i processen. Du kan læse mere om vores mangfoldighedspolitik her.





Du bliver en del af Energinet Eltransmission A/S, der har til opgave at udvikle, bygge, eje og drive det nødvendige eltransmissionsnet, Herefter stilles det til rådighed for samfundet med den rette kapacitet, i den rette kvalitet, så omkostningseffektivt som muligt og således, at anlægget kan udnyttes optimalt og sikkert. Eltransmission sikrer optimal Asset Management ved at have fokus på anlæggenes samlede levetid - fra vugge til grav.




























Glæd dig til at blive en del af en organisation med et meningsfuldt formål, hvor vi forsyner Danmark med el og gas, og omstiller energisystemet til grøn energi.


For at lykkes med den opgave, skal vi have dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere. Derfor har vi skabt rammer, hvor udvikling prioriteres, nye idéer bliver taget alvorligt, og der er balance mellem arbejde og privatliv. Location: Lexington, Kentucky

Remote Type: Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.

Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.

We boldly go.

Where is the work:

Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.

What's in it for you:

As an Electrical Engineer supporting the Airside Data Center Computer Room Air Handler (VCDC) Pod, you will play a key role in the engineering activities that support sales order processing and execution for one of our important data center product platforms. This role provides the opportunity to work closely with cross-functional teams and support customer-focused engineering execution from bid support through manufacturing release and field issue resolution.


You will contribute to job bidding, submittal generation, BOM development, model generation, electrical design execution, production support, and field support. This position offers broad exposure across the order execution lifecycle and the opportunity to influence product quality, responsiveness, manufacturability, and continuous improvement through practical engineering solutions and ongoing design enhancements.


What you will do:

  • Support electrical engineering activities for the Airside Data Center Computer Room Air Handler (VCDC) Pod.
  • Support job processing activities, including bid support, submittals, order release, BOM development, and model generation.
  • Develop and review electrical design content to support customer-specific orders and product configurations.
  • Coordinate with mechanical and design resources to ensure complete and accurate engineering deliverables.
  • Support production and field activities by resolving electrical design issues and providing timely technical assistance.
  • Participate in risk assessments, design reviews, and problem-solving activities to support safe, reliable, and manufacturable designs.
  • Help identify and implement design improvements that enhance product quality, manufacturability, and customer satisfaction.
  • Partner with manufacturing engineers to incorporate DFM principles into electrical designs and documentation to improve quality, safety, and assembly efficiency.
  • Work with lab engineers to ensure customer witness test readiness and support validation of electrical system performance.
  • Support root cause analysis and corrective actions related to quality, reliability, and field issues.
  • Create and maintain engineering documentation, including drawings, specifications, and related product records.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with operations, manufacturing, quality, and product management to support business objectives.
  • Support year-over-year cost and margin improvement initiatives.

What you will bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related engineering field is required.
  • Experience in design engineering, product engineering, or electrical engineering support is preferred.
  • Experience supporting configured-to-order or engineered-to-order products is preferred.
  • Ability to travel up to 15% of the time is required.
  • Working knowledge of electrical systems, wiring packages, component integration, and engineering documentation.
  • Ability to work effectively across engineering, design, operations, and manufacturing teams.
  • Strong analytical, technical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and make progress across concurrent assignments.
  • Customer-focused mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Experience in HVAC, air handling equipment, or related engineered product environments is preferred.

$52,300.00 - $107,400.00

Salary

Incentive Eligible:

No

Sales Commission Eligible:

No

The actual compensation will depend on elements such as seniority, merit, geographic location, education, experience, travel requirements, and union designation. Our compensation range is generally based on the national average for the country. Additionally, benefits may vary depending on the region, business alignment, union involvement, and employee status.

Thrive at work and at home:

  About CooperSurgical  


  CooperSurgical is a leading fertility and women’s healthcare company dedicated to putting time on the side of women, babies, and families at the healthcare moments that matter most in life. As a business unit of CooperCompanies   (Nasdaq: COO)  , we're driven by a unified purpose of helping people experience life’s beautiful moments. Guided by our shared values - dedicated, innovative, friendly, partners, and do the right thing - our offerings support patients throughout their lifetimes, from contraception to fertility and birth solutions, to women’s and family care, and beyond. We currently offer over 600 clinically relevant medical devices to healthcare providers, including testing and treatment options, as well as an innovative suite of assisted reproductive technology and genomic testing solutions. Learn more at    www.coopersurgical.com.   
 

     

 

 
 
         
     

 

 
         
     

 

 
        
         
 
    
 
         
         
 
       
 

       
 

    
 
         
          

 
    

    
 
         
         Responsibilities 
         

        
 
   

 Job Summary: 

   

 As Senior Global Product Manager, IVF Equipment, you are accountable for both on-market portfolio performance and future portfolio development for defined product categories within the IVF Equipment portfolio.  

   

 Your responsibilities include product category strategy, product lifecycle management, product positioning, pricing strategy, competitive intelligence, customer insight, product requirements, launch strategy, commercial readiness, and input into new product innovation projects. 

   

 This is a strategically important global role where you will use your marketing toolkit, strong business acumen, customer insight skills, and technical curiosity to ensure CooperSurgical maintains a competitive IVF Equipment offering that maximizes both short-term and long-term profitable growth. 

   

 A key focus of the role will be strengthening the link between market insight, customer needs, product requirements, and successful commercialization. You will lead Voice-of-Customer activities, define customer, user and business needs, develop business cases, shape product and portfolio roadmaps, and partner closely with R&D, PMO, Regulatory, Quality, Service, Operations, Business Development, and global commercial teams. 

   

 You will report to the Global Product Director, IVF Equipment. You will work in a dynamic global environment with multiple activities running in parallel.  

   

 Essential Functions & Accountabilities: 
 
  Lead category strategy, portfolio roadmap development, and lifecycle planning for assigned IVF Equipment categories, using customer insight, regional feedback, competitive intelligence, installed-base data, and business performance to guide product and portfolio decisions.  

  Define user needs, product requirements, value propositions, and business cases for new product innovation and lifecycle management projects. Partner with R&D, PMO, Regulatory, Quality, Service, Pricing, Finance, Business Development, and commercial teams to ensure product management input is clear, timely, and aligned with portfolio strategy.  

  Lead global launch strategy and execution, including positioning, go-to-market planning, commercial readiness, sales enablement, launch metrics, and post-launch performance tracking.  

  Maintain a detailed understanding of portfolio performance, including revenue, margin, market share, pricing, customer feedback, service considerations, and regional commercial needs.  

  Develop and execute product category growth strategies across the full product lifecycle, identifying opportunities to improve customer adoption, retention, competitive positioning, portfolio performance, and long-term profitable growth.  

  Own global pricing strategy for assigned product categories, including annual price optimization, price positioning, and pricing input for new product launches.  

  Drive lifecycle management activities, including portfolio optimization, rationalization, replacement opportunities, and product performance improvements.  

  Support cross-portfolio growth initiatives where relevant, including installed-base growth, replacement strategies, bundling, lab-build solutions, service-related offerings, and commercial excellence projects.  

 
  Communicate portfolio strategy, opportunities, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders.  

   
 
 
 Travel:  

 Travel up to 20% (50 days) per year, conditional to business need. 
 

     

 

 
 
         
     

 

 
         
     

 

 
        
         
 
    
 
         
         
 
       
 

       
 

    
 
         
          

 
    

    
 
         
         Qualifications 
         

        
 
 Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: 

   
 
  Analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.  

  Strong business acumen.  

  Attention to detail and highly organized, while ensuring progress to meet deadlines.  

  Growth mindset with a proactive approach and drive for results.  

  Experience leading upstream marketing activities, including Voice-of-Customer, value proposition development, business cases, product requirements input, and commercial launches.  

  Strong experience developing and executing commercial marketing initiatives, including campaigns, go-to-market planning, segmentation, targeting, positioning, and sales enablement.  

  Strong interpersonal skills, with excellent networking and collaborative behavior across functions and regions.  

  Team player, while also able to work independently and effectively.  

  Strong communication and presentation skills. Able to create compelling PowerPoint presentations and detailed financial analysis in Excel.  

  Robust mindset and influential personality.  

  Proven ability to run multiple tasks concurrently in a fast-paced working environment and remain comfortable with sometimes short deadlines.  

  Scientific interest, technical understanding, and strong customer / market curiosity are essential.  

  Knowledge of IVF, fertility, embryology, laboratory workflows, high-tech medical devices, laboratory equipment, and/or software-enabled devices is considered a strong advantage.  

  Fluent English, spoken and written, is mandatory.  
 
   

   

 Work Environment: 
 
  On Site: US or Denmark   
 
   

 Experience: 
 
  A minimum of 6 years of product management, global marketing, upstream marketing, or strategic marketing experience, preferably from medical devices, MedTech, diagnostics, life sciences, laboratory equipment, capital equipment, or other technically complex healthcare industries.  

  Experience with capital equipment, hardware/software-enabled products, connected devices, digital solutions, fertility, IVF, or laboratory workflows is considered a key advantage.  

  Experience developing global product, portfolio, or category strategies is a strong advantage.  

  Experience leading new product launches, including launch strategy, commercial readiness, go-to-market planning, sales enablement, and post-launch performance tracking, is a strong advantage.  
 
   

 Education: 
 
  Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or Science.

Please visit us at    www.coopersurgical.com    to learn more about CooperSurgical and the benefits of becoming a member of our team.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.  If you are interested in applying and require special assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please contact us at talent.acquisition@coopersurgical.com

  • Du bliver en del af en stor offentlig sundhedsorganisation, hvor alle faggrupper spiller sammen om én ting: at sikre, at borgere og patienter altid er i trygge og ordentlige rammer – også når det “bare” handler om, at der er rent, ryddeligt og imødekommende.
Om jobbet I denne rolle bliver du en nøglespiller i at holde hospitalets miljø rent, sikkert og indbydende.
  • Du bliver en del af serviceområdet på etage 205 som er medicinske sengeafsnit
  • Serviceområdet understøtter behandling og pleje gennem professionel rengøring og praktiske opgaver, der får hverdagen til at glide for både patienter og personale.
  • Det kræver både faglighed, fleksibilitet og lysten til at give en ekstra hånd med, når der er brug for det.
Du vil få faste opgaver, men hverdagen kan være varieret, og du vil møde mange forskellige mennesker. Dine kerne opgaver er blandt andet:
  • Madhåndtering til patienter til alle dagens måltider. Du skal kunne håndterer madbestilling, anretning og servering for patienterne.
  • Daglig rengøring af patientstuer, gange, toiletter og fællesarealer hvor hygiejne og sikkerhed er ekstra vigtig og det er efter fastlagte standarder
  • Håndtering af rengøringsmidler og -maskiner på en sikker og ansvarlig måde
  • Affaldshåndtering, opfyldning af sæbedispensere, papir m.m.
  • Et tæt samarbejde med plejepersonale og andre faggrupper om at skabe rene og trygge rammer
  • At bidrage til løbende forbedring af arbejdsgange og høj kvalitet i rengøringen
Arbejdstiden
  • Du får en foreløbig plan for 24 uger, men kender altid din plan 4 uger frem.
  • Arbejdsplanen samt ferie og fri tilrettelægges i jeres medbestemmende team i samarbejde med leder.
  • Vagterne er skiftende:
    • På hverdage dagvagter fra kl. 6.00-13.54 og senvagter fra kl. 11.36-19.00.
    • I weekenden er der vagt hver 4. uge i dagvagter fra kl. 6.00-13.24.
Om dig Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis mange års erfaring fra hospital, men du skal have lyst til at tage ansvar for kvaliteten i dit arbejde og gå op i, at detaljerne er på plads.

  • Der lægges vægt på, at du kan se meningen med rengøring som en vigtig del af patientsikkerheden – og at du trives i et miljø, hvor der er mange mennesker omkring dig.
Regionshospital Nordjylland søger en person, der så vidt muligt matcher disse ønsker:
  • Uddannelse eller 3 års erfaring inden for rengøring, husassistentarbejde eller servicefag
  • Kendskab til eller interesse for hygiejne, rengøringsstandarder og brug af rengøringsmidler
  • Gode danskkundskaber, så du kan kommunikere med patienter, pårørende og kolleger
  • Evnen til at arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret – også når der er travlt.
  • Du kan forvente afløsning i andre rengøringsteam på lige fod med dine kollegaer.
  • Fire vigtigste personlige egenskaber:
    • ansvarlig, fordi patienter og kolleger skal kunne regne med dig;
    • imødekommende, fordi du møder mennesker i sårbare situationer;
    • samarbejdsorienteret, fordi opgaverne løses bedst, når alle hjælper hinanden
    • Nysgerrig på at lære nyt og tage del i faglig introduktion og oplæring
Hvorfor du vil være glad for at arbejde her Hos Region Nordjylland bliver du en del af et fællesskab, hvor kolleger hjælper hinanden, deler viden og tager ansvar sammen. Der er en stærk faglig stolthed – man må gerne være stolt af at være dygtig til sit fag – og der er fokus på, at kvalitet og ordentlighed også viser sig i den måde, serviceopgaver bliver løst på.

Du kan forvente et arbejdsmiljø, hvor indflydelse, tillid, ordentlighed og professionalisme tages alvorligt.

  • Det betyder blandt andet, at du bliver lyttet til, at der er tillid til, at du gør dit bedste, og at du bliver mødt med respekt og anerkendelse.
  • Introduktion og oplæring er fra dine kollegaer, så du kommer godt ind i både arbejdsopgaver og kultur.
  • Der er plads til faglig udvikling, løbende sparring og et kollegialt fællesskab, hvor humor og hverdagssnak også har sin helt naturlige plads.
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår Stillingen er placeret på RHN, Bispensgade 37, 9800 Hjørring.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til overenskomst for husassistenter mellem Danske Regioner og FOA.

Hvordan du søger Hvis du kan se dig selv som en vigtig del af holdet rundt om patienten, og hvis du har lyst til at bringe din faglighed og gode energi i spil i hverdagen.

  • Så er du meget velkommen til at sende en ansøgning via Region Nordjyllands elektroniske rekrutteringssystem.
  • Vedhæft ansøgning, opdateret CV og relevante uddannelses- eller kursusbeviser.
  • Skriv gerne et par linjer om, hvorfor lige netop rengøringstekniker / husassistent på RHN i Hjørring tiltaler dig.
  • Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte den angivne kontaktperson i opslaget.
Der ses frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

Stillingerne ønskes besat senest 15. oktober 2026 eller efter aftale

Der er forventelig samtaler den 9. september 2026 mellem kl. 8 og 14.

title: Hud- och spaterapeut
description:

Vi på Axelsons SPA & Skin Clinic Malmö växer så det knakar och behöver nu stärka upp vårt härliga team med en receptionsansvarig.

Just nu är det en behovstjänst som är tillgänglig.

title: Farmaceut
description:
Jobba för originalet.

Välkommen till Apoteket, nummer ett sedan 1971. Med visioner för framtiden och kvalitet i varje detalj, skapar vi förutsättningar för ett liv i hälsa. Hos oss utvecklas du i en kultur där din röst alltid blir hörd. Och allt vi får över ger vi tillbaka till samhället. Det är så vi gör skillnad på riktigt.

Om Apoteket Falken

Här på apoteket Falken arbetar vi i ett modernt apotek som ligger centralt i en galleria i Falkenberg. Apoteket är mellanstort med en stor egenvårdsavdelning och en Doktor24-mottagning flera dagar i veckan vilket skapar en omväxlande miljö att arbeta i. Vi har ett välfungerande team med tre farmaceuter och en apotekstekniker som stöttar varandra och skapar en vänlig och hjälpsam arbetsmiljö.

Vi tillhör en apoteksgrupp tillsammans med apoteket Vipan i Halmstad där det finns möjlighet att jobba samt på andra apotek i regionen. Arbetstiderna för denna tjänst ligger inom ramen för det lokala apotekets öppettider: vardagar 10.00–18.00, lördagar 10.00–15.00.

Din roll

Våra farmaceuter arbetar alltid med omtanke, kvalitet och kundens behov i fokus. I din roll hos oss bidrar du till en trygg, professionell och välkomnande upplevelse för alla som besöker oss. I din roll har du hand om rådgivning, receptexpedition och egenvård, och tar ansvar för trygghet och service i varje kundmöte.

Vad du kommer att göra hos oss:

  • Ge professionell rådgivning och skapa mervärde i varje kundmöte, med omtanke och förståelse för människors olika behov.

  • Bidra till patientsäkerhet och kvalitet i allt du gör, så att våra kunder kan känna sig trygga med oss.

  • Dela kunskap och erfarenhet med dina kollegor – vi växer och utvecklas tillsammans.

  • Hålla dig uppdaterad kring vårt sortiment och våra kampanjer, för att ge kunderna bästa möjliga hjälp.

  • Bidra med idéer och initiativ för att utveckla både arbetsvardagen och kundupplevelsen på vårt apotek.

Vem söker vi?

För den här tjänsten behöver du vara legitimerad receptarie eller apotekare, med ett tydligt intresse för människor, hälsa och läkemedel.

  • Du kan vara en nyexaminerad farmaceut eller ha tidigare erfarenhet från rollen som farmaceut.

  • Du har ett varmt och professionellt bemötande där du ser varje kund.

  • Du samarbetar gärna och bidrar positivt till team.

  • Vi tror att du trivs i ett sammanhang där struktur och resultat går hand i hand.

Vi erbjuder...

  • Friskvårdsbidrag: 5000 kr per år.

  • Personalrabatt: Förmånliga priser på många av våra produkter.

  • Flexibla helgdagar: Möjlighet att byta arbetsfria helgdagar mot andra dagar på året.

  • Förmånsportal (Benify): Erbjudanden inom bland annat kollektivtrafik, leasingbil, gym och hälsobehandlingar.

  • Trygga försäkringar: Förstärkt föräldrapenning, tjänstepension (ITP) och kompletterande försäkringar.

Om oss

Apoteket grundades 1971 och ägs av svenska staten, vilket innebär att vi arbetar både ansvarsfullt och långsiktigt. Vårt viktiga samhällsuppdrag handlar om att förbättra människors hälsa, läkemedelsanvändning och bidra till ökad patientsäkerhet. Med omkring 400 apotek och 3000 medarbetare över hela landet har vi nära samarbete med hälso- och sjukvården – alltid med omtanke om både människor och miljö.

Vårt mål är tydligt: Ett liv i hälsa, för alla.

Nyfiken? Det räcker gott.

Hör av dig om rollen fångar ditt intresse! Vi berättar gärna mer om tjänsten och vår verksamhet – så du får en tydligare bild och kan avgöra om det känns helt rätt. Vänta bara inte för länge, urval och intervju sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.

Skicka ditt CV tillsammans med svar på våra urvalsfrågor. Du behöver inte skriva ett personligt brev – frågorna är utformade för att hjälpa oss förstå mer om dina erfarenheter och kompetenser för matchning mot tjänst.

Vi använder tester för objektivt urval som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess. Provanställning tillämpas.

Välkommen till Apoteket!

title: VAPT-DevSecops Experts(Individual contributor)
description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

Senior Vulnerability Remediation Engineer

P R O D U C T S E C U R I T Y · A N A P L A N

Reports to: Senior Manager, Platform Security
Working model: Gurugram (Hybrid)

Why this role matters

This is an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact at Anaplan! In this role, you will be at the forefront of scaling security through automation and self-service. You’ll be the driving force behind transforming security intent into enforced, self-service controls across the SDLC and CI/CD pipelines. Think dependency policy, secrets handling, least-privilege access, and the guardrails that allow engineering teams to innovate rapidly without compromising security.

When done right, this is some of the most high-leverage work in our function. Every control you implement will run continuously for every team, seamlessly integrated into their workflows!

Why Anaplan

Anaplan is not just another SaaS application; it’s a powerful platform that performs highly dimensional, enterprise-scale modeling with responsive recalculation and strong correctness expectations. Our technical landscape is rich and varied, featuring the legacy Hyperblock engine, the innovative Polaris engine, and an expanding suite of AI-powered products like CoModeler for AI-assisted model building and CoPlanner for conversational, analyst-style planning support.

With AI revolutionizing software development, we are embracing more generated code and autonomous changes, making the need for encoded, verifiable guardrails more critical than ever. Security is woven into the fabric of how our platform evolves, rather than treated as an afterthought. Join our small, dynamic team where your contributions to automation will set the gold standard!

What you'll do

  • Automate across the pipeline: build security automation into CI/CD and the broader SDLC so that controls run as code.
  • Leverage AI to scale security automation: harness AI and LLM-assisted tools to speed up control development, triage, and remediation, extending automated coverage beyond what traditional scripts can achieve.
  • Implement policy-as-code: encode guardrails for dependency and package policies, secrets, and configurations so they enforce themselves effortlessly.
  • Build the controlled-repository model: automate the restriction of external dependencies and provide safe, approved package paths for our engineers.
  • Automate secrets management and detection: ensure mishandled or leaked secrets are automatically caught and managed without the need for manual sweeps.
  • Reduce standing privilege: develop automation for least privilege and just-in-time access, making persistent access the exception rather than the rule.
  • Tame scanner output: integrate detection into low-noise, actionable workflows that feed remediation, preventing overwhelming flood of alerts.
  • Automate attack-surface hardening: drive the creation of hardened, golden images and enforce baselines through code.
  • Make controls self-service: default to providing engineers with a paved path wherever it’s safe to do so, rather than imposing unnecessary gates.

What we're looking for

  • Strong automation and engineering skills, particularly in languages such as Python or Go, along with expertise in infrastructure-as-code and pipeline work.
  • In-depth knowledge of DevSecOps: CI/CD security and hands-on experience with policy-as-code using tools like OPA, Conftest, or Kyverno.
  • Foundational understanding of cloud-native security, particularly in Kubernetes and at least one major cloud provider, along with knowledge of secrets management and identity basics.
  • A builder's instinct: you create tools that engineers love because they simplify their work.
  • Genuine care for developer experience, always striving to reduce friction rather than adding unnecessary barriers.
  • The discernment to identify which controls are truly worth encoding and which can be set aside.

Nice to have

  • Experience with supply-chain security: understanding of provenance and signing, as well as software or model bills of materials.
  • Familiarity with zero-trust and least-privilege automation, including just-in-time access.
  • Experience working in a regulated, enterprise environment.
  • Contributions to open-source security tooling or relevant certifications.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

Brænder du for at arbejde som dedikeret sikringstekniker indenfor sikring og ønsker at blive en del af Danmarks førende Brand & Sikring afdeling?


 


I Kemp & Lauritzen søger vi lige nu en ny kollega til vores Brand & Sikring team i Vejle. Vi er et dedikeret og sammentømret team, som sætter pris på sammenhold, godt humør og at sikre høj kvalitet for vores kunder. Som vores nye kollega, vil du blive en del af et godt team, som vil støtte op omkring dig.


 


Vores kunder spænder over alt fra mindre lokale aktører til nogle af Danmarks største virksomheder og kommunale aftaler. Du vil derfor få mulighed for at arbejde med din faglighed på tværs af mange spændende kunder og projekter.




Arbejd for de største kunder og med de bedste kolleger



Som Sikringstekniker i Kemp & Lauritzen kommer du ind i en af Danmarks førende teknikvirksomheder. Vi laver service og entrepriser for kunder i alle størrelser landet rundt og du bliver en del af en moderne arbejdsplads. Sammen med dine kolleger deltager du i installation, programmering, instruktion og efterfølgende servicering af anlæggene.


 


I Brand & Sikring er vi mere end specialister, når det gælder brand & sikring af vidt forskellige typer bygninger. Vi skaber tryghed, begrænser skader og sikrer et minimalt driftstab for vores kunder. Vi gør os umage og tager kvalitet personligt.


 


Dine opgaver:


Servicering, fejlfinding, programmering og udvidelser indenfor følgende Sikringsanlæg:


 


•    AIA
•    ADK
•    TVO


 


Vigtigst er, at du har det rette drive samt lysten og evnerne til at gå i dialog med kunderne og leverer det høje kvalitetsniveau som kendetegner Kemp & Lauritzen.




Din baggrund




Uddannet elektriker og har kendskab til svagstrømsinstallationer


Erfaring indenfor områderne AIA/ADK/TVO


Gennemført kursus Sikring 1 + 2


Kørekort kategori B



 


Din person



Din energi og gode humør smitter af på de opgaver og mennesker, du omgiver dig med.


Du arbejder selvstændigt med et godt overblik og tager et stort ejerskab for dine opgaver.


Du er desuden kvalitetsbevidst og lægger vægt på ordentlighed i udførelsen af dit arbejde, så din kunde får en tilfredsstillende service.


Dine gode samarbejdsevner gør dig til en vellidt kollega og en god ambassadør for Kemp & Lauritzen ude hos kunden.





Bliv en af ’Kemperne’



Kemp & Lauritzen A/S er Danmarks førende digitale og grønne teknikpartner med 3.000 medarbejdere fordelt over hele landet. Vi leverer løsninger inden for el, VVS, ventilation og køl - fra daglig service til store entrepriser og unikke specialer.


 


Hos Kemp & Lauritzen får du en hverdag fyldt med faglige opgaver, indflydelse og gode muligheder for at udvikle dine både faglige og personlige kompetencer. Vi tager ansvar i alt vi gør, og vi ønsker at skabe plads til forskellighed - og være én af Danmarks bedste arbejdspladser.


 


Virksomheden er ejet af Kemp & Lauritzen Fonden, som investerer i vores medarbejdere og samfundet som helhed.


 


Hos os handler det om ordentlighed


I 2023 vandt vi prisen som 'Årets virksomhed med mere end 500 medarbejdere' ved Danish Diversity Awards og i 2025 var vi nomineret igen. Vi arbejder løbende og aktivt med at blive én af Danmarks bedste arbejdspladser.




Ansøg nu



Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Serviceleder, Ole Vincent Maciejewski på telefon 51515131.



Vi inviterer løbende til samtale, så søg stillingen allerede i dag eller hurtigst muligt.


 


Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Cookie Crew
description:
Insomnia Cookies was founded in a college dorm room by then-student, Seth Berkowitz. Fast forward 20 years and so... many....cookies... later, our innovative bakery + delivery concept has become a cult brand known for its rabid following of cookie lovers who crave Insomnia’s warm, delicious delivery all day and late into the night. With an expanding footprint of over 350 stores globally, an experiential, “sweet-easy” flagship concept, and large scale operations and delivery capabilities ... Insomnia Cookies is revolutionizing the cookie game by truly "Imagining What’s Possible"!

At Insomnia Cookies, warm cookies are just the beginning.

As a Cookie Crew Member, you're part baker, part hospitality expert, and part late-night hero. Whether you're welcoming guests into the bakery, pulling a fresh tray of cookies from the oven, or packing the perfect delivery order, you'll help create the experience that keeps our fans coming back night after night.

Our bakeries move fast, especially after the rest of the world has called it a night. Every shift is a team effort, and every warm cookie, friendly interaction, and perfectly packed order matters.

If you enjoy working with great people, thrive in an energetic environment, and love making someone's day just a little sweeter, you'll fit right in.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Every shift is a little different, but you can expect to:

  • Welcome every guest with genuine hospitality and make every interaction memorable.
  • Prepare, bake, and package our warm cookies, brownies, ice cream, and other treats to Insomnia's quality standards.
  • Accurately prepare in-store, pickup, delivery, and online orders.
  • Operate the register and process guest transactions.
  • Keep the bakery clean, stocked, organized, and food-safe throughout every shift.
  • Jump in wherever your team needs you, whether that's restocking supplies, helping a teammate, or keeping the line moving.
  • Resolve guest concerns with empathy and urgency, partnering with your Shift Leader when needed.
  • Deliver the kind of experience that turns first-time guests into lifelong Insomniacs.
QUALIFICATIONS
  • Must be 18 years of age or older
  • Ability to obtain any required food safety certifications applicable to the location
  • Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

    • Physical Requirements

    This position regularly requires the ability to:

  • Stand and walk for extended periods of time (up to 8 hours per shift).
  • Frequently reach, bend, stoop, twist, kneel, and lift.
  • Lift, carry, push, and pull up to 30 pounds regularly.
  • Occasionally lift up to 50 pounds with assistance.
  • Use hands and fingers to handle bakery equipment, food products, and a point-of-sale system.
  • Work in environments with varying temperatures, including around ovens, freezers, and refrigeration units.
  • Safely operate kitchen equipment in accordance with company procedures.
  • Read order screens, recipes, and safety information.
  • Communicate effectively with guests and team members in a fast-paced environment.

    • Work Environment

    This position works in a fast-paced bakery environment that includes frequent interaction with guests, exposure to heat from ovens, refrigerated storage areas, cleaning chemicals, and moderate noise levels. Evening, late-night, weekend, and holiday shifts are a regular part of the business.

    Schedule Expectations

    Our bakeries are busiest during evenings, late nights, weekends, and holidays. Team Members should have availability during these peak business hours. Scheduling needs vary by location.

    Equal Employment Opportunity

    Insomnia Cookies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law.

    Reasonable Accommodation

    If you require a reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or hiring process, please let us know. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.

    Additional Information

    Employment with Insomnia Cookies is contingent upon successful completion of any background checks, employment verification, and other pre-employment requirements applicable to the position and permitted by law.

    Ready to Join the Cookie Crew?

    Whether this is your first job or your next step, we're looking for people who bring great energy, take pride in their work, and love making someone's day a little sweeter.

    When you join Insomnia Cookies, you'll enjoy:

    • Competitive hourly pay
    • Early Wage Access (get paid the next day!)
    • Flexible scheduling
    • Employee discount (free cookies!)
    • Opportunities for growth into Shift Leader and other bakery leadership roles

    Many of our leaders started as Cookie Crew Members and Delivery Drivers. If you're looking for more than just a job, you'll find plenty of opportunities to grow with us.

    We can’t wait to meet you!

title: Sr. Specialist Solutions Architect
description:
FEQ427R339

Location: Melbourne or Sydney

As a Specialist Solutions Architect (SSA), you will be the trusted technical ML & AI expert to both Databricks customers and the Field Engineering organization. You will work with Solution Architects to guide customers in architecting production-grade ML & AI applications on Databricks, while aligning their technical roadmap with the continually evolving Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. You will continue to strengthen your technical skills through applying cutting-edge technologies in GenAI, MLOps, and ML more broadly, expanding your impact through mentorship, and establishing yourself as an AI thought leader.

The impact you will have:

  • Architect production-level ML & AI workloads for customers using our unified platform, including agents, end-to-end ML pipelines, training/inference optimization, integration with cloud-native services, MLOps, etc.
  • Serve as a trusted practitioner for enterprise GenAI solutions, including RAG architectures, agentic systems (tool-calling agents, multi-agent orchestration, guardrails), natural language querying of structured data, AI evaluation and observability, and monitoring systems
  • Build, scale, and optimize customer AI workloads and apply best-in-class MLOps to productionize these workloads across a variety of domains
  • Provide advanced technical support to Solution Architects during the technical sale, ranging from feature engineering, training, tracking, serving, to model monitoring, all within a single platform, as well as participating in the larger ML SME community in Databricks
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with the product and engineering teams to represent the voice of the customer, define priorities, and influence the product roadmap, helping with the adoption of Databricks’ AI offerings

What we look for:

  • 5+ years of hands-on industry ML experience in at least one of the following:
    • ML Engineer: Build and maintain production-grade cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) infrastructure that supports the deployment of ML applications, including drift monitoring.
    • AI Engineer: Experience with the latest techniques in LLMs & agentic systems, including vector databases, fine-tuning LLMs, AI guardrail systems, and deploying LLMs with tools such as HuggingFace, Langchain, and OpenAI
  • Graduate degree in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research, etc.) or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience communicating and/or teaching technical concepts to non-technical and technical audiences alike
  • Passion for collaboration, life-long learning, and driving business value through ML & AI
  • [Preferred] 2+ years customer-facing experience in a pre-sales or post-sales role
  • Can meet expectations for technical training and role-specific outcomes within 3 months of hire

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

title: CDN & Edge Security Engineer
description:
CDN & Edge Security Engineer

Position Overview:

  • We are seeking a skilled CDN & Edge Security Engineer to design, implement, and support global content delivery and edge security solutions for large-scale digital platforms. This individual will serve as a subject matter expert in CDN technologies, web application security, DNS architecture, DDoS protection, bot mitigation, and application performance optimization.
  • The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong troubleshooting abilities and can lead complex incident response efforts, drive security improvements, and provide strategic guidance on edge architecture across cloud and multi-CDN environments.


Key Responsibilities:

CDN & Edge Infrastructure

  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-scale CDN and edge delivery solutions.
  • Optimize content delivery performance, availability, and reliability across global environments.
  • Manage and support multi-CDN architectures and traffic routing strategies.
  • Configure and maintain DNS, caching, load balancing, and edge security services.
  • Evaluate and recommend enhancements to improve platform scalability and performance.

Security Operations & Architecture

  • Develop, implement, and optimize Web Application Firewall (WAF) policies and security controls.
  • Lead bot management initiatives including detection, mitigation, and tuning strategies.
  • Design and support DDoS protection architectures and response procedures.
  • Conduct threat analysis and security assessments to identify vulnerabilities and reduce risk.
  • Analyze and reduce false positives while maintaining effective security posture.

Incident Response & Operational Support

  • Serve as a Level 3 escalation point for complex production incidents involving CDN, DNS, networking, and application security services.
  • Lead technical investigations for performance, availability, and security-related issues.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders, cloud providers, and technology vendors during critical incidents.
  • Develop root cause analyses and implement long-term corrective actions.

Monitoring & Observability

  • Utilize telemetry, logging, and monitoring platforms to improve visibility into platform performance and security events.
  • Analyze operational and security metrics to identify trends and optimization opportunities.
  • Build dashboards and reporting capabilities to support proactive monitoring and incident response.
  • Leverage observability data to drive architectural and operational decision-making.


Required Qualifications

  • Previous experience supporting enterprise CDN, networking, or application security environments.
  • Strong experience with leading CDN platforms such as Akamai, Cloudflare, Fastly, or similar technologies.
  • Deep understanding of:
  • DNS architecture and management
  • HTTP/HTTPS protocols
  • TCP/IP networking
  • Layer 3, 4, and 7 security concepts
  • Web Application Firewalls (WAF)
  • DDoS mitigation techniques
  • Experience supporting large-scale production environments and critical customer-facing applications.
  • Proven experience troubleshooting complex performance, routing, and security incidents.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience operating multi-CDN environments.
  • Experience with bot management platforms and anti-automation technologies.
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust and edge security architectures.
  • Experience with infrastructure automation and scripting (Python, PowerShell, Bash, Terraform, etc.).
  • Knowledge of API security controls and modern web application architectures.
  • Experience within large enterprise or global e-commerce environments.

title: Management Trainee (Honolulu International Airport)
description:
At SIXT, we don't just hire for jobs - we build leadership careers. 1ST GEAR! is our global Management Trainee Program - a dynamic, 12-month journey designed to fast-track your way into a real leadership role. From day one, you’ll gain hands-on experience, take on responsibility, and develop the skills you need to lead in one of the world’s most innovative mobility companies. What makes this program unique? You don’t just complete it - you graduate into a leadership position. Whether it’s managing your own downtown branch or becoming part of a high-performing airport leadership team, your next career step is guaranteed. Earn an hourly rate of $23.68 with a performance-based bonus, and the use of a company car upon successful completion of the program.

We’re looking for ambitious, curious, and proactive individuals who are ready to roll up their sleeves and grow fast. If you want to make an impact, lead with confidence, and shape the future of mobility, 1ST GEAR! is your starting line.

YOUR MANAGEMENT CAREER PATH AT SIXT

  • You take on responsibility early in your 12-month program, support the achievement of our operational goals, and contribute to greater efficiency and shared success within the team. Upon successful completion of the program, you will be placed directly in a leadership position anywhere in the United States
  • You gain insights into key business areas such as Sales, Customer Service, Fleet Management, and Performance Management, and develop further along clear learning and performance goals
  • You work in the operational day-to-day business from day one, get to know all aspects of our core operations from sales to fleet operations, and are supported through training in communication, conflict resolution, sales, and problem-solving strategies
  • You collaborate closely with Branch Managers and Area Directors to learn leadership on the job

YOUR SKILLS MATTER

  • Growth Mindset You have completed a bachelor's degree or gained relevant professional experience in Sales, Customer Service, Tourism, Hospitality and Management
  • Leadership and Entrepreneurial Potential You have a hands-on, entrepreneurial mindset, driven to lead - you don’t wait for instructions, you take the lead
  • Communication Excellence You have strong communication skills in English (other languages are a plus)
  • Proactive Attitude You work independently, solve problems, and take ownership
  • Agile Flexibility You are required to work and travel within the United States as business needs dictate. This is not a fully remote position and may require periodic travel of up to 50% during the first year of the program as well as temporary assignments across various locations within the United States
  • Mobility Readiness You hold a valid driver’s license and have at least 1 year of driving experience

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Guaranteed Leadership Landing Role And privilege use of a company car upon successful program completion
  • Attractive Compensation Package Competitive base salary and performance-based bonus
  • Exclusive Employee Benefits From discounted rentals and dry-cleaned uniforms to comprehensive healthcare and retirement plans
  • Paid Time Off & Sick Leave Recharge with PTO and sick leave to ensure a balanced work-life experience
  • Career Mobility & International Growth Opportunities across functions, cities, and even countries
  • Fast-track Leadership Development A structured 12-month program that sets you up for your first management role

About us:

We are a globally leading mobility service provider with a revenue of €4.00 billion and around 9,000 employees worldwide. Our mobility platform ONE combines our products SIXT rent (car rental), SIXT share (car sharing), SIXT ride (taxi, ride, and chauffeur services), and SIXT+ (car subscription), giving our customers access to our fleet of 350,000 vehicles, the services of 4,000 cooperation partners, and around 5 million drivers worldwide. Together with our franchise partners, we are present in more than 110 countries at 2,000 rental stations. At SIXT, top-tier customer experience and outstanding customer service are our highest priorities. We believe in true entrepreneurship and long-term stability and align our corporate strategy with foresight. Get started with us and apply now!

title: Software Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

Apex Fintech Solutions (Apex) powers innovation and the future of digital wealth management by building tech-forward solutions that help simplify, automate, and facilitate access to financial markets for all. Our robust suite of fintech software enables us to support clients such as Stash, Betterment, SoFi, Webull, and eToro, amongst many others; collectively, Apex powers access to the stock market for over 22+ million end customers.

At Apex, we are changing how the securities industry operates by reinventing the status quo, which was manual, slow, and accessible only by the ultra-wealthy. We're digitizing and democratizing systems so that everyone has an opportunity to invest.

When you're at Apex, you drive this change. You're part of a global team with a clear vision: to be the trusted technology that powers the digital economy. Our offices in Austin, Dallas, Chicago, New York, Portland, Belfast, and Manila are home to over 1,000 employees.

Together, we’re shaping the future of financial innovation. Embrace change. Solve big. Win together. And be G.R.E.A.T. — grit, results, empathy, accountability, and teamwork — with Apex.

We’re proud to be recognized for the innovative work we do, the purpose-driven nature of our work, and the collaborative culture we’ve created. Here are just a few of the many awards we’ve recently received:

Best Places to Work

2026, 2025, 2024, 2023 - Presented by BuiltIn

WealthTech of the Year

2025 - Presented by US FinTech Awards

The World’s Top 250 Fintech Companies

2024 - Presented by CNBC

ABOUT THIS ROLE

At Apex Fintech Solutions, we're transforming the future of digital wealth management by seamlessly connecting financial platforms and simplifying access to financial markets for millions.

As a Software Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and optimizing platform solutions that power this transformation. You’ll have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge software architectures, solve challenging problems, and collaborate with diverse teams to create impactful solutions for our fast-paced fintech environment. We’re looking for engineers who thrive when tackling complex, meaningful challenges and have a strong foundational knowledge of software development across multiple languages and frameworks. We are innovators who operate in a collaborative, entrepreneurial environment while valuing continual learning, flexibility, and adaptability. If you’re looking for a role that combines creative problem-solving with the drive to make an immediate impact on an evolving industry, let’s change everything together.

Duties/Responsibilities:

As a Software Engineer, you will:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and design scalable software systems and applications.

  • Write, test, and maintain high-quality, reusable code that adheres to development best practices.

  • Build, deploy, optimize microservices and cloud-based system architectures.

  • Support deployment pipelines, CI/CD practices, and agile workflows to accelerate development cycles.

  • Conduct rigorous code reviews to ensure strong engineering principles and maintainable solutions.

  • Debug and fix errors across the software stack to enhance performance, stability, and maintainability.

  • Create alerts and dashboards in Datadog for monitoring application

  • Ensure compliance with regulatory standards and industry protocols while adhering to the firm’s policies.

Required Skills/Abilities:

To be successful in this role, you should have:

  • Proven experience in at least one or more of the following languages: Java, Python, Go, etc.

  • Understanding public cloud infrastructure, particularly Google Cloud Platform and microservices architecture.

  • Strong background and proven experience developing, testing, and maintaining REST APIs.

  • A problem-solving mindset, with the ability to think critically through challenging engineering scenarios.

  • An innate passion for learning new technologies, frameworks, and tools to contribute to dynamic software solutions.

Education and Experience:

  • BS degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Management Information Systems, engineering or similar undergraduate program

  • 2+ years of related industry experience, preferably in a technical solutions role within financial services, technology, or a related sector.

Work Environment:

  • This job operates in a hybrid, office environment 2 days per week.

​Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Our Rewards

We offer a robust package of employee perks and benefits, including a market-leading salary with an annual bonus, 20 days of vacation leave plus regular and special non-working holidays, and a training and development budget. Our benefits also cover private health insurance for medical and dental, as well as life insurance. We emphasize work-life balance with flexible working hours, parental leave, a modern city center office, and a hybrid work schedule that allows for greater flexibility by partially working from home. Additional perks include monthly team lunch-outs, unlimited drinks and snacks, and company recognition & rewards.

title: Sr. Platform Engineer I
description:
Who are we?

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.

Position Summary:

The Platform Engineer will be a key member of the S&E (Solutions and Enablement ) team, responsible for designing, building, and maintaining cloud infrastructure and platform services. This role focuses on enabling reliable, scalable, and secure platform operations while supporting oncall rotations and ensuring system availability across global operations.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure on AWS, including compute, networking, storage, and security components.
  • Manage and optimize Kubernetes clusters (EKS) for containerized workloads, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, following best practices for modularity, security, and reusability.
  • Configure and manage Istio service mesh for traffic management, security policies, and observability.
  • Implement and maintain GitOps workflows for continuous deployment and infrastructure management.
  • Support release engineering processes including CI/CD pipeline development, deployment automation, and release coordination.
  • Manage secrets and sensitive configuration using HashiCorp Vault, ensuring compliance with security policies.
  • Participate in oncall rotation to provide 24x7 support for critical platform services.
  • Collaborate with development teams to enable customer onboarding on the Fabric platform, including EA (Enterprise Archive) tenants.
  • Document runbooks, architecture decisions, and operational procedures.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum 4 years of experience in platform engineering, DevOps, or SRE roles.
  • Strong proficiency with AWS services including EC2, EKS, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, Lambda, and CloudWatch.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes administration and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in Terraform for infrastructure provisioning and management.
  • Experience with Istio or similar service mesh technologies.
  • Working knowledge of GitOps tools such as ArgoCD or Flux.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools including GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI.
  • Familiarity with HashiCorp Vault for secrets management.
  • Scripting proficiency in Python, Bash, or Go.

    • Soft Skills

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a distributed, global team environment.
  • Self-motivated with ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Willingness to participate in oncall rotations and respond to incidents.

    • Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or equivalent).
  • Experience with observability tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, or Grafana.
  • Knowledge of incident management and RCA processes.
  • Experience with multi-region or multi-account AWS architectures.
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to enterprise environments.
    • About our culture

    Smarsh hires lifelong learners with a passion for innovating with purpose, humility and humor. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We work closely with the most popular communications platforms and the world’s leading cloud infrastructure platforms. We use the latest in AI/ML technology to help our customers break new ground at scale. We are a global organization that values diversity, and we believe that providing opportunities for everyone to be their authentic self is key to our success. Smarsh leadership, culture, and commitment to developing our people have all garnered Comparably.com Best Places to Work Awards. Come join us and find out what the best work of your career looks like.

description:
Projekti-insinööri / Projektinhoitaja BASys Oy, Lahti

Haluatko mukaan kasvavaan rakennusautomaation asiantuntijayritykseen?

BASys Oy on nopeasti kasvava, pieni ja ketterä rakennusautomaatioalan yritys Lahdesta. Toteutamme rakennusautomaatiourakoita erityisesti Fidelixin, Schneider Electricin ja Oumanin järjestelmillä. Asiakkaitamme ovat niin julkisen kuin yksityisen sektorin toimijat, ja henkilöstöllämme on pitkä kokemus rakennusautomaation ja talotekniikan parista.

Etsimme nyt joukkoomme projekti-insinööriä ja/tai projektinhoitajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.

Tehtäväsi

Toimit osana projektitiimiämme kiinteistöautomaatioprojektien parissa. Työtehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa:

  • rakennusautomaatiojärjestelmien ohjelmointi

  • järjestelmien käyttöönotto

  • suunnitteluun osallistuminen

  • projektien tekninen koordinointi asiakkaiden ja yhteistyökumppaneiden kanssa

Työ on monipuolista ja tarjoaa mahdollisuuden kehittyä rakennusautomaation ammattilaiseksi.

Kenelle tehtävä sopii?

Tehtävä sopii erinomaisesti myös vastavalmistuneelle automaatio-, talotekniikka- tai ohjelmistoinsinöörille. Aiempi kokemus rakennusautomaatiosta on etu, mutta ei välttämätöntä – perehdytämme sinut tehtävään huolellisesti.

Jos olet jo kokeneempi rakennusautomaation tai talotekniikan ammattilainen, voimme räätälöidä työnkuvan osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaiseksi. Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan omaan rooliisi ja vastuualueisiisi.

  • hyvää motivaatiota ja halua oppia uutta

  • vastuullista työotetta ja arvostusta omaa työtä kohtaan

  • soveltuvaa teknistä koulutusta (esim. automaatio-, talotekniikka- tai ohjelmistoala)

  • ajokorttia ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta (oma auto on tehtävässä välttämätön)

Eduksi katsomme

  • osaamisen talotekniikasta

  • ohjelmointiosaamisen

  • kokemuksen rakennusautomaatiojärjestelmistä

Työtä tehdään pääasiassa Päijät-Hämeen ja Uudenmaan alueella.

Tarjoamme

  • vakituisen työn kasvavassa yrityksessä

  • monipuoliset ja vaihtelevat projektit

title: FIELD SPECIALIST III - RTA
description:
Field Specialist III-MPD

We are looking for a motivated and technically skilled Field Engineer / Field Specialist to support operations across a variety of products and services in the Oil & Gas sector.
Depending on MPD experienced especially in recent MPD Deepwater, the role ranges from entry-level execution to senior-level leadership, including troubleshooting complex technical issues, mentoring junior engineers, and acting as a key interface with clients at well sites.

Key Responsibilities

Health, Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure adherence to company HSE, security, and compliance standards
  • Maintain safe working conditions and prioritize environmental protection
  • Participate in safety meetings, toolbox talks, and hazard analysis
  • Promote continuous improvement in safety and operational practices

Operations & Service Delivery

  • Execute job planning, preparation, mobilization, and field operations
  • Operate, test, and maintain tools and equipment
  • Monitor operational data and recommend solutions
  • Prepare and submit job reports, service tickets, and documentation
  • Support 24/7 on-call operations as required
  • Manage inventory and equipment at well site
  • Assist or lead root cause analysis for equipment failures
  • Deliver high-quality service to clients and maintain relationships

Technical & Leadership (Mid/Senior Levels)

  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues and recommend solutions
  • Perform engineering calculations and software-based checks onsite
  • Lead field crews and mentor junior engineers
  • Act as technical advisor to clients and internal stakeholders
  • Oversee installation of complex equipment

Quality Assurance

  • Ensure compliance with company quality policies
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives
  • Maintain service delivery excellence

Communication & Stakeholder Management

  • Maintain strong communication with internal and external stakeholders
  • Build and sustain positive client relationships
  • Clearly communicate expectations within teams

Financial Accountability

  • Manage expenses within approved budgets
  • Follow financial processes and timelines

People Development

  • Participate in training and career development programs
  • Work with managers on performance and growth plans
  • Support talent development and knowledge sharing (for senior roles)

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or Science
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Oil & Gas (intermediate roles)
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in MPD. Especially on Deepwater project (preferred)
  • Relevant experience in field operations (preferred for senior roles)

Skills & Competencies

  • Knowledge of mechanics, electronics, pneumatics, hydraulics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Understanding of basic physics, chemistry, and mathematics
  • Computer literacy and technical reporting skills
  • Strong decision-making and time management abilities
  • Ability to work in physically demanding environments
  • Effective communication and teamwork skills
